domains.name: shipment
domains.description: Core operational domain managing end-to-end shipment lifecycle from booking through delivery across express parcel, freight, and cross-border movements. Owns shipment identity, tracking events, POD/ePOD, ETA/ETD milestones, exception management, and AWB/BOL/HAWB/MAWB document references. Serves as the transactional backbone integrating TMS, FourKites visibility, and carrier execution data for D2D services.
domains.references: IATA Resolution 600 Series, IMO FAL Convention, WCO

products.name: consignment
products.description: Core master entity representing a shipment booking/consignment record — the primary business object in the shipment domain. Captures the full lifecycle identity of a shipment from booking through final delivery, including service type (express parcel, freight, cross-border), origin/destination, declared weight, volumetric/DIM weight, CBM, number of pieces, incoterms code, COD flag, DDP/DAP/FOB terms, booking channel, booking date, committed SLA type, committed delivery date, transit time commitment, SLA source (customer contract/rate card/spot booking), priority level, delivery instructions (instruction type, preferred time window, special access notes, safe place, alternative address, contact phone), current lifecycle status, and OTD/OTIF target. Serves as the anchor entity integrating SAP TM freight orders, Oracle TMS shipment execution records, and FourKites visibility events. SSOT for shipment identity and service commitment across the enterprise.

products.name: shipment_leg
products.description: Represents an individual transport leg within a multi-leg shipment journey, including ETA/ETD milestone predictions and last-mile dispatch details. Each consignment may traverse multiple legs (e.g., first-mile pickup → origin hub → linehaul → destination hub → last-mile delivery). Captures leg sequence number, transport mode (air/ocean/road/rail), carrier SCAC/IATA code, origin and destination location codes, planned and actual departure/arrival timestamps (ETD/ETA), predicted ETA with confidence score and prediction source (FourKites AI/carrier EDI/manual), vehicle/vessel/flight reference, leg status, distance, delivery agent ID (for last-mile legs), route code, dispatch sequence, and delivery attempt number. Enables end-to-end route visibility, SLA milestone tracking per leg, ETA prediction, and last-mile delivery performance measurement. Sourced from SAP TM route segments, Oracle TMS load plans, and FourKites predictive ETA engine.

attributes.name: delay_duration_minutes

attributes.name: delay_reason_code

attributes.name: distance_km

attributes.name: origin_location_code

attributes.name: planned_arrival_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Planned Arrival Timestamp (Estimated Time of Arrival - ETA)
attributes.description: Scheduled arrival date and time for this leg as planned at booking or route optimization. Represents the original ETA before any real-time adjustments.

attributes.name: planned_departure_timestamp

attributes.description: Scheduled departure date and time for this leg as planned at booking or route optimization. Represents the original ETD before any real-time adjustments.

attributes.name: predicted_eta_timestamp

attributes.name: voyage_number

products.name: tracking_event
products.description: Immutable, append-only record of any shipment event captured throughout the shipment lifecycle — including carrier-reported tracking milestones, internal hub/sortation operational events, exception/deviation events, and business lifecycle state transitions. Each event records the event category (tracking/hub_operation/exception/lifecycle), event type code (e.g., PICKUP, DEPARTED, ARRIVED, SORTED, LOADED_OUTBOUND, EXCEPTION_DELAY, STATUS_CHANGE), event timestamp, location (facility code, city, country, GPS coordinates), event source (FourKites, carrier EDI, WMS scan, sortation system, TMS), operator ID, severity (for exceptions), resolution fields (for exceptions), previous/new status (for lifecycle transitions), and raw event description. Serves as the unified event log enabling OTD calculation, predictive ETA updates, exception detection, and full shipment audit trail. Never updated after insert.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vehicle, truck, aircraft, or vessel involved in the event. Used for fleet management and route optimization. Nullable for stationary hub events.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time of final delivery to consignee. Only populated for DELIVERED event types. Used for OTD (On-Time Delivery) and OTIF (On-Time In-Full) KPI calculation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of lading number associated with this event, if applicable. Used for ocean and ground freight shipments. May be MBL (Master Bill of Lading) or HBL (House Bill of Lading).

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Standard code identifying the transportation carrier responsible for the shipment at the time of this event. Examples: IATA airline codes, SCAC codes for ocean/trucking. Nullable for internal hub operations.

attributes.name: container_number
attributes.description: ISO container number for ocean freight shipments. Format: 4-letter owner code + 6-digit serial number + check digit. Only populated for containerized freight events.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_status
attributes.description: Status of customs clearance at the time of this event. Only populated for cross-border shipments and customs-related events. Cleared: customs released; Held: under inspection; Rejected: entry denied.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Standards, AMS/AES Reporting

attributes.name: damage_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the damage observed. Only populated when damage_reported = True. Used for claims investigation and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: damage_reported
attributes.description: Indicates whether damage to the shipment was observed and reported during this event. True if damage detected, False otherwise. Triggers claims workflow.

attributes.name: edi_message_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the EDI message that generated this event, if applicable. Used for EDI 214 carrier status messages and event reconciliation.

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Updated ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival) for final delivery, recalculated at the time of this event. Predictive ETA updates from FourKites or carrier systems. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: event_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the event type. Tracking events are carrier-reported milestones; hub operations are internal facility scans; exceptions are deviations or delays; lifecycle events are status transitions.

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Human-readable narrative description of the event. May include raw event text from carrier or system source. Used for audit trail and customer communication.

attributes.name: event_source
attributes.description: System or channel that generated the event. Examples: FourKites, carrier EDI feed, Manhattan WMS scan, sortation system, SAP TM, manual entry. Enables event provenance and quality assessment.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the tracking event occurred in the real world. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. This is the business event time, distinct from record creation time.

attributes.name: event_type_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the specific event type. Examples: PICKUP, DEPARTED, ARRIVED, IN_TRANSIT, SORTED, LOADED_OUTBOUND, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, EXCEPTION_DELAY, EXCEPTION_DAMAGE, STATUS_CHANGE. Aligns with IATA and carrier EDI standards.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo-IMP Message Standards, EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status

attributes.name: exception_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the root cause of the exception. Examples: WEATHER_DELAY, CUSTOMS_HOLD, ADDRESS_INCORRECT, DAMAGE_IN_TRANSIT, REFUSED_BY_CONSIGNEE. Only populated for exception events.
attributes.references: Internal Exception Taxonomy, EDI 214 Exception Codes

attributes.name: exception_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting how the exception was resolved, actions taken, and any follow-up required. Only populated for exception events.

attributes.name: exception_resolution_status
attributes.description: Current resolution state of the exception. Only populated for exception events. Tracks whether the issue has been addressed.

attributes.name: exception_resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exception was resolved. Only populated for exception events that have been closed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: exception_severity
attributes.description: Severity level of the exception event. Only populated for event_category = exception. Low: minor delay; Medium: moderate delay or documentation issue; High: significant delay or damage; Critical: shipment at risk or lost.

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: Internal code identifying the facility, hub, sortation center, or warehouse where the event occurred. Nullable for in-transit or external carrier events.

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the event location in decimal degrees. Range: -90.0000000 to +90.0000000. Captured from GPS-enabled devices or FourKites real-time tracking.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the event location in decimal degrees. Range: -180.0000000 to +180.0000000. Captured from GPS-enabled devices or FourKites real-time tracking.

attributes.name: humidity_percentage
attributes.description: Relative humidity percentage recorded at the time of the event. Used for sensitive cargo monitoring. Range: 0.00 to 100.00. Nullable for non-humidity-controlled shipments.

attributes.name: location_city
attributes.description: City name where the tracking event occurred. Used for customer visibility and geographic analytics.

attributes.name: location_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the event occurred. Examples: USA, CAN, GBR, DEU, CHN.

attributes.name: location_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the event location. Used for last-mile delivery precision and route optimization.

attributes.name: location_state_province
attributes.description: State or province code where the event occurred. ISO 3166-2 subdivision code preferred.

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The shipment status after this lifecycle event. Only populated for event_category = lifecycle. Represents the state transition target.

attributes.name: pieces_count
attributes.description: Number of pieces, packages, or handling units scanned or processed in this event. Used for piece-level tracking and inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: pod_image_url
attributes.description: URL or storage path to the scanned or photographed proof of delivery document. Used for audit and claims resolution.

attributes.name: pod_recipient_name
attributes.description: Name of the person who received and signed for the shipment. Only populated for delivered events with POD. Personally identifiable information.

attributes.name: pod_signature_captured
attributes.description: Indicates whether a physical or electronic signature was captured at delivery. True if signature obtained, False otherwise. Used for delivery verification and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The shipment status immediately before this lifecycle event. Only populated for event_category = lifecycle. Enables status transition audit trail.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this tracking event record was first inserted into the data platform. Immutable. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Distinct from event_timestamp which is the business event time.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that originally created this event record. Examples: SAP TM, Oracle TMS, Manhattan WMS, FourKites, carrier EDI gateway. Used for data lineage and quality assessment.

attributes.name: scan_type
attributes.description: Method used to capture the tracking event. Barcode: handheld or fixed scanner; RFID: radio frequency identification; Manual: keyboard entry; OCR: optical character recognition.
attributes.references: GS1 Barcode Standards, ISO/IEC 18000 RFID Standards

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Security seal number applied to container or trailer. Used for customs compliance and tamper detection. Recorded at sealing and verified at unsealing events.
attributes.references: ISO 17712 Freight Container Seals, C-TPAT Security Standards

attributes.name: temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Ambient or cargo temperature recorded at the time of the event, in degrees Celsius. Used for cold chain monitoring and compliance. Nullable for non-temperature-controlled shipments.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Actual or verified weight of the shipment at the time of the event, in kilograms. May differ from booking weight. Used for weight reconciliation and billing adjustments.

products.name: pod
products.description: Proof of Delivery (POD / ePOD) record capturing evidence of successful shipment delivery and any Cash on Delivery (COD) collection at the point of delivery. Stores delivery timestamp, recipient name, recipient signature (base64 or reference URI), delivery location coordinates (GPS), delivery type (door/reception/locker/neighbour), ePOD image reference, delivery agent employee ID, device ID used for capture, delivery notes or exceptions noted at delivery, POD status (accepted/disputed/pending), COD amount, COD currency, payment method (cash/card/digital wallet), amount collected, collection timestamp, remittance status, and any variance between COD amount and collected amount. Aligns with ePOD standards and supports COD reconciliation, remittance tracking to shippers, claims management, and financial settlement. SSOT for delivery confirmation evidence and COD collection.

attributes.name: pod_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the proof of delivery record. Primary key for the POD entity.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.bank_account. Business justification: COD collections (cod_amount, amount_collected, remittance_batch_id) are deposited to specific bank accounts. FK enables cash application, bank reconciliation, and remittance tracking per treasury mana

attributes.name: cargo_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cargo claim record if a claim was filed related to this delivery. Links POD to claims management process.

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment for which this proof of delivery was captured. Links POD to the parent shipment transaction.

attributes.name: delivery_transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.transport_asset. Business justification: Proof of delivery must record which vehicle performed the delivery for driver accountability, vehicle performance tracking, and dispute resolution. Role-prefixed because delivery context is specific.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: COD collection and remittance transactions must be recognized in correct fiscal period per collection_timestamp. Essential for revenue cutoff, period-end close, and cash flow statement accuracy per ac

attributes.name: pod_delivery_agent_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (driver, courier, or delivery agent) who executed the delivery and captured the POD.

attributes.name: pod_verified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who verified or approved the POD record. Supports quality control and audit requirements.

attributes.name: amount_collected
attributes.description: The actual amount collected from the recipient at delivery. May differ from COD amount if partial payment or variance occurred.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: awb_number
attributes.description: Air Waybill number associated with the shipment for which this POD was captured. Links POD to air freight documentation.

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number associated with the shipment for which this POD was captured. Links POD to ocean or ground freight documentation.

attributes.name: cod_amount
attributes.description: The total amount to be collected from the recipient at the time of delivery as per the COD terms. This is the target collection amount agreed upon at shipment booking.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: cod_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the COD amount to be collected.

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the COD payment was collected from the recipient. May differ slightly from delivery timestamp if payment processing occurred after handover.

attributes.name: collection_variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the COD amount and the amount collected. Positive value indicates over-collection, negative indicates under-collection or shortfall.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this POD record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: delivery_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the physical address where the delivery was completed. Captures street number and street name.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union S42 International Postal Address Components

attributes.name: delivery_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the delivery address. May include apartment number, suite, building name, or other secondary address details.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union S42 International Postal Address Components

attributes.name: delivery_city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the delivery was completed.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union S42 International Postal Address Components

attributes.name: delivery_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the delivery location.

attributes.name: delivery_exception_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating any exception or deviation from normal delivery process noted at the time of delivery (e.g., damaged package, partial delivery, refused).

attributes.name: delivery_latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate of the exact delivery location captured by the delivery agent's device at the time of delivery.

attributes.name: delivery_longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate of the exact delivery location captured by the delivery agent's device at the time of delivery.

attributes.name: delivery_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the delivery agent at the time of delivery. May include special instructions followed, access issues, or recipient comments.

attributes.name: delivery_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code of the delivery location.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union S42 International Postal Address Components

attributes.name: delivery_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region where the delivery was completed.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union S42 International Postal Address Components

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the shipment was delivered to the recipient. This is the principal business event timestamp for the POD transaction, distinct from audit timestamps.

attributes.name: delivery_type
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery method used to complete the shipment handover. Indicates where and how the package was left.

attributes.name: device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the mobile device or handheld scanner used by the delivery agent to capture the POD. Supports audit trail and device tracking.

attributes.name: dispute_raised_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the shipper or recipient has raised a dispute regarding this delivery or COD collection. True indicates an active or historical dispute.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for the delivery or COD dispute, if one was raised. Supports claims management and customer service resolution.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: External business identifier or document number for the POD record. May be printed on physical POD forms or referenced in customer communications.

attributes.name: epod_image_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) Image Reference
attributes.description: URI or storage path reference to the digital photograph of the delivered package taken at the delivery location. Supports ePOD standards for visual delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this POD record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking for POD status updates or dispute resolution.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used by the recipient to settle the COD amount at delivery (e.g., cash, credit card, mobile wallet).
attributes.references: PCI DSS Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: pod_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the POD record. Indicates whether the delivery evidence has been accepted by the shipper, is under dispute, or is pending verification.

attributes.name: recipient_contact_number
attributes.description: Phone number of the recipient who accepted the delivery. Used for delivery confirmation and follow-up communication.

attributes.name: recipient_email
attributes.description: Email address of the recipient who accepted the delivery. Used for sending electronic proof of delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: recipient_id_number
attributes.description: Identification document number presented by the recipient at delivery. Captured for high-value shipments or regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: recipient_id_type
attributes.description: Type of identification document presented by the recipient at delivery for high-value or restricted shipments.

attributes.name: recipient_name
attributes.description: Full name of the person who received the shipment at the delivery location. This is the identity label for the receiving party.

attributes.name: recipient_signature
attributes.description: Base64-encoded signature image or reference URI to the signature captured at delivery. Serves as biometric proof of receipt.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9 - Special Categories of Personal Data

attributes.name: remittance_batch_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the financial batch in which this COD collection was remitted to the shipper. Supports reconciliation and audit of COD settlements.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: remittance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the collected COD amount was remitted to the shipper. Used for financial settlement tracking and Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: remittance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the COD amount remittance back to the shipper. Tracks the financial settlement lifecycle from collection through to shipper payment.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: transaction_reference_number
attributes.description: External payment transaction reference number or receipt number for non-cash COD payments. Links POD to payment gateway or card processor transaction.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining why the collected amount differs from the COD amount (e.g., partial payment, pricing dispute, damaged goods discount).

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the POD record was verified or approved by operations or quality control staff.

products.name: eta_milestone
products.description: Stores planned and predicted ETA/ETD milestone records for each shipment leg and overall consignment. Captures milestone type (ETD_ORIGIN, ETA_TRANSIT_HUB, ETD_TRANSIT_HUB, ETA_DESTINATION, ETA_DELIVERY), original committed datetime, current predicted datetime, prediction source (FourKites AI, carrier EDI, manual override), prediction confidence score, variance in hours from original commitment, and last updated timestamp. Enables SLA breach prediction, proactive customer notification, and OTIF performance measurement. Sourced from FourKites predictive ETA engine.
products.reference: ETA / ETD Milestone — FourKites Predictive ETA

attributes.name: eta_milestone_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) Milestone ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ETA/ETD milestone record. Primary key for the eta_milestone product.

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment for which this milestone applies. Links to the shipment product.

attributes.name: contract_sla_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_sla_commitment. Business justification: ETA milestones directly measure on-time delivery performance against specific contractual SLA commitments. This link enables automated SLA breach detection, penalty calculation, and customer performan

attributes.name: shipment_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shipment.shipment_leg. Business justification: ETA milestones track predicted arrival times for transport legs. The product already has freight_leg_id (cross-domain FK to freight domain), but shipment_leg is the in-domain leg entity. Adding shipme

attributes.name: actual_datetime
attributes.description: The actual recorded datetime when the milestone event occurred (e.g., actual departure, actual arrival). Populated after the event has been confirmed. Null until the event is completed.

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: IATA or SCAC carrier code for the carrier responsible for this leg of transport. Used to track carrier-specific performance.
attributes.references: IATA Airline Codes, SCAC (Standard Carrier Alpha Code)

attributes.name: created_datetime
attributes.description: Timestamp when this milestone record was first created in the system. Audit field for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: current_predicted_datetime
attributes.description: The most recent predicted ETA or ETD datetime based on real-time tracking, AI/ML models, or carrier updates. This value is continuously updated as new information becomes available.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether customs clearance is required at this milestone location. True = customs clearance required, False = no customs clearance required.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_status
attributes.description: Current status of customs clearance at this milestone location. NOT_REQUIRED = no customs clearance needed, PENDING = awaiting customs processing, IN_PROGRESS = customs processing underway, CLEARED = customs clearance completed, HELD = shipment held by customs, REJECTED = customs clearance rejected.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality score (0.00 to 100.00) indicating the completeness and reliability of the data used to generate this milestone prediction. Higher scores indicate better data quality.

attributes.name: delay_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for delay if the milestone is at risk or delayed. WEATHER = adverse weather conditions, TRAFFIC = road/air/sea traffic congestion, CUSTOMS_DELAY = customs clearance delays, MECHANICAL = vehicle/equipment breakdown, CAPACITY = capacity constraints, PORT_CONGESTION = port or terminal congestion, DOCUMENTATION = missing or incorrect documentation, SECURITY = security screening delays, LABOR_STRIKE = labor action or strike, OTHER = other unspecified reasons. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WEATHER|TRAFFIC|CUSTOMS_DELAY|MECHANICAL|CAPACITY|PORT_CONGESTION|DOCUMENTATION|SECURITY|LABOR_STRIKE|OTHER — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Delay Codes, Industry Best Practices

attributes.name: delay_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional detail about the delay reason. Supplements the delay_reason_code with specific context.

attributes.name: distance_remaining_km
attributes.description: Estimated distance remaining in kilometers from current position to the milestone location. Updated in real-time based on GPS tracking data.

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether an exception event has been recorded for this milestone. True = exception exists, False = no exception.

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Type of exception event if exception_flag is true. DELAY = shipment delay, ROUTE_CHANGE = route deviation, DAMAGE = cargo damage, LOSS = cargo loss or theft, SECURITY_INCIDENT = security breach, DOCUMENTATION_ERROR = documentation issues, NONE = no exception. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DELAY|ROUTE_CHANGE|DAMAGE|LOSS|SECURITY_INCIDENT|DOCUMENTATION_ERROR|NONE — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this shipment contains hazardous materials requiring special handling. True = hazmat shipment, False = non-hazmat shipment.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: last_modified_datetime
attributes.description: Timestamp when this milestone record was last modified. Audit field for tracking changes to milestone data.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA or UN/LOCODE location code for the milestone location (airport, seaport, or inland terminal).

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the milestone location (e.g., Los Angeles International Airport, Port of Rotterdam).

attributes.name: milestone_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order number of this milestone within the overall shipment journey. Used to track progression through the shipment lifecycle (e.g., 1 = first milestone, 2 = second milestone).

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: Type of milestone event in the shipment lifecycle. ETD_ORIGIN = Estimated Time of Departure from origin, ETA_TRANSIT_HUB = Estimated Time of Arrival at transit hub, ETD_TRANSIT_HUB = Estimated Time of Departure from transit hub, ETA_DESTINATION = Estimated Time of Arrival at destination facility, ETA_DELIVERY = Estimated Time of Arrival for final delivery to consignee, ETD_PICKUP = Estimated Time of Departure for pickup from shipper.

attributes.name: notification_sent_datetime
attributes.description: Timestamp when the customer notification was sent for this milestone update. Null if no notification has been sent.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a proactive customer notification has been sent for this milestone update. True = notification sent, False = notification not yet sent.

attributes.name: original_committed_datetime
attributes.description: The original committed ETA or ETD datetime provided at booking or shipment creation. This is the baseline SLA commitment against which performance is measured.

attributes.name: prediction_confidence_score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0.00 to 100.00) indicating the reliability of the current predicted datetime. Higher scores indicate greater confidence based on data quality, historical accuracy, and real-time signal strength.

attributes.name: prediction_last_updated_datetime
attributes.description: Timestamp when the current predicted datetime was last updated. Used to track the freshness of prediction data and trigger re-prediction cycles.

attributes.name: prediction_source
attributes.description: Source system or method that generated the current predicted datetime. FOURKITES_AI = FourKites predictive analytics engine, CARRIER_EDI = Electronic Data Interchange from carrier, TMS_CALCULATION = Transportation Management System route calculation, MANUAL_OVERRIDE = Manual adjustment by operations team, GPS_TRACKING = Real-time GPS device data, HISTORICAL_AVERAGE = Statistical average based on historical performance.
attributes.references: FourKites API Documentation, EDI ANSI X12 214

attributes.name: prediction_update_frequency_minutes
attributes.description: Frequency in minutes at which the prediction is updated for this milestone. Varies based on transport mode, priority, and data availability (e.g., 15 minutes for air, 60 minutes for ocean).

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for this shipment milestone. STANDARD = normal priority, EXPEDITED = faster than standard, URGENT = high priority requiring special attention, CRITICAL = highest priority requiring immediate action.

attributes.name: sla_status
attributes.description: Current SLA compliance status for this milestone. ON_TIME = predicted to meet commitment, AT_RISK = potential delay within threshold, DELAYED = predicted or actual breach of commitment, EARLY = predicted or actual early completion.

attributes.name: sla_threshold_hours
attributes.description: The acceptable variance threshold in hours for this milestone as defined in the customer SLA. Variance beyond this threshold triggers SLA breach status.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this shipment leg requires temperature-controlled handling. True = temperature control required, False = no temperature control required.

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the milestone location (e.g., America/Los_Angeles, Europe/Amsterdam). Used to ensure accurate local time representation.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation for this milestone leg. AIR = air freight, OCEAN = ocean freight, ROAD = road/truck transport, RAIL = rail transport, INTERMODAL = combination of multiple modes.

attributes.name: variance_hours
attributes.description: Variance in hours between the current predicted datetime and the original committed datetime. Positive values indicate delay (late), negative values indicate early arrival/departure. Used for SLA breach prediction and OTIF measurement.

attributes.name: vehicle_identifier
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific vehicle, vessel, aircraft, or container handling this leg (e.g., flight number, vessel name, truck license plate, container number).

attributes.name: weather_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether adverse weather conditions are impacting or predicted to impact this milestone. True = weather impact detected, False = no weather impact.

products.name: exception_event
products.description: Operational exception record raised during shipment execution when a deviation from the planned journey occurs. Captures exception type (DELAY, DAMAGE, LOST, CUSTOMS_HOLD, ADDRESS_ISSUE, WEATHER, MECHANICAL, REFUSED_DELIVERY, ATTEMPTED_DELIVERY), severity level, exception raised timestamp, location at time of exception, root cause code, responsible party (carrier/shipper/consignee/customs), resolution action taken, resolution timestamp, and escalation flag. Sourced from FourKites exception management module and Oracle TMS exception workflows. Feeds into claims and SLA breach reporting.

attributes.name: exception_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the exception event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cargo_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cargo claim record created as a result of this exception event, if applicable.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier responsible for the shipment leg where the exception occurred.

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment that experienced this exception. Links to the shipment master record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Exception events with financial_impact_amount (delays, damages, SLA breaches) require cost center attribution for operational variance analysis, budget impact assessment, and management reporting of e

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or team member currently assigned to manage and resolve this exception.

attributes.name: related_exception_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to another exception event that is related to or caused by this exception, enabling exception chain analysis.

attributes.name: shipment_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shipment.shipment_leg. Business justification: Exceptions occur during specific transport legs (e.g., 'flight delayed' is leg 2 air segment, 'customs hold' is leg 3 cross-border segment). Adding shipment_leg_id enables leg-level exception analytic

attributes.name: assigned_to_team
attributes.description: Name or code of the operational team responsible for handling this exception event.

attributes.name: claim_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this exception event qualifies for a cargo claim or insurance claim filing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this exception event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_notification_channel
attributes.description: Communication channel used to notify the customer about the exception event.

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the customer has been notified about this exception event.

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer was notified about the exception event.

attributes.name: delay_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of delay caused by this exception, measured in hours, used for performance reporting and claims calculation.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this exception has been escalated to higher management or specialized teams for resolution.

attributes.name: escalation_tier
attributes.description: Level of escalation indicating the organizational tier handling the exception resolution.

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exception was escalated to a higher tier or specialized team.

attributes.name: estimated_recovery_timestamp
attributes.description: Projected date and time when the shipment is expected to return to normal schedule after exception resolution.

attributes.name: exception_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the facility, terminal, or geographic location where the exception occurred.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations)

attributes.name: exception_location_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the location where the exception occurred.

attributes.name: exception_location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the location where the exception occurred.

attributes.name: exception_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, observations, and additional context about the exception event and its resolution.

attributes.name: exception_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the exception event, used for tracking and communication with stakeholders.

attributes.name: exception_raised_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exception was first detected and recorded in the system. Primary business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: exception_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the exception event indicating whether it is active, being worked on, or resolved.

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exception event indicating the nature of the deviation from planned shipment execution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DELAY|DAMAGE|LOST|CUSTOMS_HOLD|ADDRESS_ISSUE|WEATHER|MECHANICAL|REFUSED_DELIVERY|ATTEMPTED_DELIVERY|DOCUMENTATION_ISSUE|SECURITY_HOLD — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated or actual financial impact of the exception in the shipment currency, including potential claims, penalties, or recovery costs.

attributes.name: financial_impact_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the financial impact amount.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this exception event record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: preventable_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this exception could have been prevented through better planning, execution, or controls, used for continuous improvement analysis.

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this exception is a repeat occurrence for the same shipment or route, signaling systemic issues.

attributes.name: resolution_action_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the corrective action taken to resolve the exception.

attributes.name: resolution_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the actions taken to resolve the exception and restore normal shipment flow.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exception was successfully resolved and the shipment returned to normal execution.

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Entity or stakeholder determined to be responsible for the exception occurrence, used for accountability and claims processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CARRIER|SHIPPER|CONSIGNEE|CUSTOMS|WAREHOUSE|THIRD_PARTY|INTERNAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the underlying cause of the exception, used for analytics and process improvement.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the root cause analysis findings for this exception event.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Business impact severity of the exception, used for prioritization and escalation decisions.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this exception caused a breach of the committed service level agreement with the customer.

attributes.name: sla_breach_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of SLA commitment that was breached due to this exception.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System or platform that originated the exception event record.

attributes.name: source_system_reference_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this exception event in the originating source system, used for data lineage and reconciliation.

products.name: consignment_status
products.description: Lifecycle status history table tracking every status transition of a consignment from booking through delivery. Each record captures the previous status, new status, transition timestamp, triggered-by source (system/user/carrier EDI), operator ID, and any status notes. Provides a complete audit trail of the consignment lifecycle enabling SLA compliance analysis, dispute resolution, and operational reporting. Distinct from tracking_event which captures carrier scan events — this table captures business-level lifecycle state transitions.

attributes.name: consignment_status_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the consignment status transition record. Primary key for the consignment status history table.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or transportation provider responsible for the consignment at the time of this status transition. Relevant for carrier-driven status updates.

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent consignment whose status is being tracked. Links this status transition to the shipment consignment entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or operator who triggered the status change, if the transition was manual. Null for automated system-triggered transitions.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse, hub, or facility location where the status transition occurred. Captures the physical location context of the lifecycle event.

attributes.name: shipment_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shipment.shipment_leg. Business justification: Status transitions can be leg-specific (e.g., 'departed origin' marks end of leg 1, 'arrived at hub' marks end of leg 2) or consignment-level (e.g., 'booking confirmed', 'delivered'). Adding shipment_

attributes.name: customs_cleared_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether customs clearance was completed at this status transition. Relevant for cross-border shipments and international freight.

attributes.name: customs_reference_number
attributes.description: The customs declaration or clearance reference number associated with this status transition, if applicable. Links to customs brokerage and trade compliance records.

attributes.name: delay_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The duration in minutes by which the actual status transition was delayed compared to the planned timestamp. Positive values indicate delay, negative values indicate early arrival.

attributes.name: device_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the mobile device, scanner, or IoT sensor that captured or triggered the status transition. Used for device tracking and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: dwell_time_minutes
attributes.description: The duration in minutes that the consignment remained in the previous status before this transition. Measures processing time and identifies bottlenecks in the supply chain.

attributes.name: eta_updated_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) Updated Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the estimated time of arrival was recalculated or updated as a result of this status transition. Used to track predictive ETA accuracy.

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this status transition represents an exception or deviation from the normal consignment flow. True for exception events, false for standard lifecycle progression.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this status transition in the source system or carrier system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and EDI message correlation.

attributes.name: geolocation_latitude
attributes.description: The geographic latitude coordinate where the status transition occurred, captured from GPS or RFID tracking systems. Enables spatial analysis of consignment movements.

attributes.name: geolocation_longitude
attributes.description: The geographic longitude coordinate where the status transition occurred, captured from GPS or RFID tracking systems. Enables spatial analysis of consignment movements.

attributes.name: humidity_percentage
attributes.description: The relative humidity percentage recorded at the time of the status transition. Relevant for sensitive cargo requiring environmental monitoring.
attributes.references: IMDG Code International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code

attributes.name: milestone_code
attributes.description: Standardized milestone code representing the key checkpoint in the consignment lifecycle. Used for ETA/ETD tracking and SLA milestone compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BOOKING|PICKUP|ORIGIN_HUB|IN_TRANSIT|DESTINATION_HUB|OUT_FOR_DELIVERY|DELIVERED|POD — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: new_eta_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) Timestamp
attributes.description: The updated estimated time of arrival calculated at this status transition. Reflects the latest predictive delivery time based on current consignment progress.

attributes.name: new_status_code
attributes.description: The lifecycle status code of the consignment after this transition. Represents the current state following the status change event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BOOKED|PICKED_UP|IN_TRANSIT|AT_HUB|OUT_FOR_DELIVERY|DELIVERED|EXCEPTION|CANCELLED|RETURNED|ON_HOLD — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used to notify the customer or stakeholder about this status transition. Null if no notification was sent.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a customer notification (email, SMS, push) was sent for this status transition. Used to track communication compliance and customer experience.

attributes.name: photo_captured_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a photo was captured as proof of delivery or condition at this status transition. Used for ePOD and claims evidence.
attributes.references: ePOD Electronic Proof of Delivery Standards

attributes.name: planned_timestamp
attributes.description: The originally planned or scheduled date and time for this status transition to occur. Used to measure on-time performance by comparing against actual status_transition_timestamp.

attributes.name: previous_status_code
attributes.description: The lifecycle status code of the consignment immediately before this transition. Represents the prior state in the consignment workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BOOKED|PICKED_UP|IN_TRANSIT|AT_HUB|OUT_FOR_DELIVERY|DELIVERED|EXCEPTION|CANCELLED|RETURNED|ON_HOLD — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this status transition record was first created in the data platform. Represents the system audit timestamp for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this status transition record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks the most recent change for audit trail and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: route_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the consignment deviated from the planned route at this status transition. Used for exception management and route optimization analysis.

attributes.name: scan_type
attributes.description: The method or technology used to capture the status transition event. Indicates whether the update was via barcode scan, RFID read, manual entry, GPS tracking, or API integration.

attributes.name: signature_captured_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether an electronic proof of delivery signature was captured at this status transition. Typically true for DELIVERED status transitions.
attributes.references: ePOD Electronic Proof of Delivery Standards

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this status transition resulted in or indicates a breach of the committed service level agreement. Used for SLA compliance tracking and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this status transition record. Identifies the authoritative source for data lineage and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: status_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context about the status transition. May include operator remarks, exception details, or customer instructions.

attributes.name: status_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason or cause for the status transition. Provides context for why the consignment moved to the new status, especially for exceptions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NORMAL_FLOW|CUSTOMER_REQUEST|EXCEPTION_DELAY|WEATHER|CUSTOMS_HOLD|ADDRESS_CORRECTION|DAMAGED|REFUSED|SECURITY_HOLD — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: status_transition_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the consignment status changed from the previous status to the new status. Represents the real-world business event time of the lifecycle transition.

attributes.name: temperature_celsius
attributes.description: The ambient or cargo temperature in degrees Celsius recorded at the time of the status transition. Relevant for temperature-controlled shipments and cold chain compliance.
attributes.references: IMDG Code International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code

attributes.name: triggered_by_source
attributes.description: The originating system or channel that initiated the status transition. Identifies whether the change was automated (system/EDI), manual (user), or via integration (API/WMS).

products.name: shipment_package
products.description: Individual package/piece-level master record within a consignment. Captures package sequence number within the consignment, barcode/label number, package type (carton, pallet, drum, envelope, crate), actual weight, volumetric weight (DIM weight), dimensions (L×W×H in cm), declared contents description, fragile flag, temperature-sensitive flag, and current package status. Enables piece-level tracking, DIM weight billing reconciliation, and warehouse handling instructions. Sourced from Manhattan WMS scan data and Oracle TMS load manifests.

attributes.name: shipment_package_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual package or piece within a consignment. Primary key for the shipment package entity.

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment or consignment that this package belongs to. Links the package to its master shipment record.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the package was successfully delivered to the consignee. Used for proof of delivery (POD) and on-time delivery (OTD) performance measurement.

attributes.name: actual_weight_kg
attributes.description: Physical gross weight of the package measured in kilograms. Used for freight charge calculation, load planning, and carrier capacity management.

attributes.name: barcode_number
attributes.description: Unique barcode or label number assigned to the package for scanning and tracking throughout the logistics network. Used for piece-level visibility and warehouse operations.

attributes.name: chargeable_weight_kg
attributes.description: The greater of actual weight or volumetric weight, used as the basis for freight charge calculation. Determines the billable weight for rating and invoicing.

attributes.name: contents_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the declared contents within the package. Used for customs declarations, dangerous goods screening, and handling instructions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this package record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: current_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the current physical location of the package (warehouse, hub, terminal, or in-transit vehicle). Updated by scan events for real-time visibility.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the package contains dangerous goods (DG) requiring special handling, labeling, and regulatory compliance per IMDG or IATA DG regulations.
attributes.references: IMDG Code / IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: declared_value_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value declared by the shipper for the package contents. Used for insurance coverage, customs valuation, and liability limits.

attributes.name: declared_value_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the declared value amount. Enables multi-currency valuation and customs reporting.

attributes.name: delivery_signature_name
attributes.description: Name of the person who signed for the package upon delivery. Part of electronic proof of delivery (ePOD) record.

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_date
attributes.description: Predicted date when the package will be delivered to the final consignee. Used for customer notifications and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the type of exception or delay affecting the package (e.g., address incorrect, recipient unavailable, customs hold). Used for exception management and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the exception or issue affecting the package. Provides context for customer service and operations teams.

attributes.name: fragile_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the package contains fragile items requiring special handling care. Triggers warehouse handling instructions and carrier notifications.
attributes.references: ISO 780 Pictorial Marking for Handling of Goods

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Height dimension of the package in centimeters. Used for volumetric weight calculation, load optimization, and warehouse space planning.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System tariff classification code for the package contents. Used for customs clearance, duty calculation, and trade compliance reporting.

attributes.name: insurance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of insurance coverage purchased for the package. Used for claims processing and liability determination.

attributes.name: insurance_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the insurance coverage amount.

attributes.name: insurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipper has purchased additional insurance coverage for this package beyond standard carrier liability limits.

attributes.name: last_scan_location_code
attributes.description: Location code where the most recent scan event occurred. Used for tracking history and route verification.

attributes.name: last_scan_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent barcode scan event for this package. Provides real-time tracking visibility and exception detection.

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: Length dimension of the package in centimeters. Used for volumetric weight calculation, load optimization, and warehouse space planning.

attributes.name: max_stack_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight in kilograms that can be stacked on top of this package without causing damage. Used for warehouse stacking rules and load optimization.
attributes.references: ISO 780 Pictorial Marking for Handling of Goods

attributes.name: package_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the package in the logistics network. Tracks the package from booking through final delivery or exception resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: booked|picked_up|in_transit|at_hub|out_for_delivery|delivered|exception|returned|damaged|lost — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical packaging unit. Determines handling requirements, stacking rules, and warehouse slotting strategies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: carton|pallet|drum|envelope|crate|box|bag|bundle|container|skid — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pod_image_url
attributes.description: URL reference to the stored proof of delivery image (signature, photo, or scan). Used for delivery verification and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this package within the parent consignment (e.g., package 1 of 5). Used for piece count verification and delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this package data (Manhattan WMS for warehouse scans, Oracle TMS for load manifests, FourKites for tracking updates). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional handling instructions specific to this package (e.g., 'This Side Up', 'Keep Dry', 'Handle with Care'). Used by warehouse and delivery personnel.
attributes.references: ISO 780 Pictorial Marking for Handling of Goods

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the package can be stacked with other packages during storage and transportation. Affects warehouse slotting and load planning.
attributes.references: ISO 780 Pictorial Marking for Handling of Goods

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the package requires temperature-controlled transportation and storage (e.g., pharmaceuticals, perishables). Determines equipment assignment and routing.

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable temperature in Celsius for temperature-sensitive packages. Used for cold chain monitoring and compliance verification.

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable temperature in Celsius for temperature-sensitive packages. Used for cold chain monitoring and compliance verification.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for dangerous goods classification. Required for DG shipments to identify hazardous materials and handling requirements.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this package record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total cubic volume of the package in cubic meters (CBM). Calculated from length × width × height. Used for container load planning and warehouse capacity management.

attributes.name: volumetric_weight_kg
attributes.description: Dimensional weight (DIM weight) calculated from package dimensions using carrier-specific conversion factors (typically length × width × height / divisor). Used for billing reconciliation when volumetric weight exceeds actual weight.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: Width dimension of the package in centimeters. Used for volumetric weight calculation, load optimization, and warehouse space planning.

products.name: shipment_carrier_assignment
products.description: Records the assignment of a carrier (airline, ocean carrier, road haulier, rail operator) to a specific shipment leg. Captures carrier SCAC/IATA code, carrier name, service product code, booking reference number with the carrier, assigned vehicle/vessel/flight number, assignment date, assignment method (auto-optimized via SAP TM carrier selection / manual override), rate agreed, and assignment status (confirmed/tentative/cancelled). Enables carrier performance tracking, freight audit, and carrier spend analysis per shipment.

Operations must retain

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the carrier assignment. attributes.name: assignment_timestamp

attributes.name: booking_reference_number

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp

attributes.name: carrier_iata_code

attributes.description: IATA two or three-character airline designator code for air carriers.

attributes.name: carrier_performance_rating
attributes.description: Performance rating assigned to the carrier for this shipment leg, typically on a scale of 0.00 to 5.00. Used for carrier scorecard and future selection optimization.

attributes.name: carrier_scac_code

attributes.name: carrier_service_name

attributes.name: equipment_type

attributes.name: vessel_imo_number

attributes.name: vessel_name

attributes.name: voyage_number

products.name: delivery_instruction

attributes.name: delivery_instruction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the delivery instruction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: consignment_id

attributes.name: customer_contact_id

attributes.name: alternative_delivery_address_line1

attributes.name: alternative_delivery_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the alternative delivery address. May include apartment number, suite, floor, or building name.

attributes.name: alternative_delivery_city
attributes.description: City or locality of the alternative delivery address.

attributes.name: alternative_delivery_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the alternative delivery address.

attributes.name: alternative_delivery_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code of the alternative delivery address.

attributes.name: alternative_delivery_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the alternative delivery address.

attributes.name: authority_to_leave_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivery driver has authority to leave the shipment unattended at the delivery location without obtaining a signature. True if authority is granted, False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this delivery instruction record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: delivery_notification_preference
attributes.description: Preferred method for receiving delivery notifications. Specifies whether the consignee wants to be notified via SMS, email, phone call, mobile app push notification, or no notification.

attributes.name: id_verification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether government-issued identification must be verified at delivery. Typically required for age-restricted or high-value shipments.

attributes.name: instruction_effective_date

attributes.name: instruction_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this delivery instruction expires and is no longer valid. Nullable for instructions with no expiration.

attributes.name: instruction_priority

attributes.name: instruction_type

attributes.name: last_modified_by

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: minimum_age_requirement

attributes.name: preferred_time_window_start
attributes.description: The start of the preferred delivery time window specified by the consignee. Enables time-definite delivery services and appointment-based deliveries.

attributes.name: return_if_absent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment should be returned to the depot or origin if the consignee is not present. True if return is required, False if alternative delivery options should be attempted.

attributes.name: safe_place_description

attributes.name: signature_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signature is required upon delivery. True if signature is mandatory, False if delivery can be completed without signature.

attributes.name: signature_type

attributes.name: special_handling_notes

products.name: freight_manifest
products.description: Freight manifest record consolidating all consignments loaded onto a specific transport vehicle, vessel, or aircraft for a given departure. Captures manifest number, transport mode, vehicle/vessel/flight reference, origin facility, destination facility, departure date, total pieces, total weight, total CBM, number of consignments, dangerous goods indicator, temperature-controlled indicator, manifest status (open/closed/departed/arrived), and carrier seal number. Sourced from SAP TM and Oracle TMS load optimization outputs. Enables load reconciliation and carrier handover documentation.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the freight manifest record. Primary key.

attributes.name: carrier_id

attributes.name: consolidation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.consolidation. Business justification: Freight manifest is the physical execution artifact (vehicle/flight/vessel load) of a commercial consolidation in NVOCC and freight forwarding operations. Links manifest to its commercial consolidatio

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Freight manifests with manifest_cost_amount represent consolidated transport costs allocated to cost centers (by route, hub, carrier). FK enables transport cost allocation, budget tracking, and operat

attributes.name: fulfillment_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.center. Business justification: Freight manifests originating from or destined to fulfillment centers require this link for manifest routing, capacity planning, and cross-dock operations. Enables fulfillment center load planning and

attributes.name: primary_freight_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that created this manifest record in the TMS.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.transport_asset. Business justification: Freight manifests are loaded onto specific vehicles/containers for transport. Fundamental to freight operations for load planning, asset tracking, customs clearance, and manifest reconciliation. vehic

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Operations must store, version, and retrieve the formal manifest document ar

attributes.name: actual_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the manifest load arrived at the destination facility, captured from TMS or carrier systems.

attributes.name: actual_departure_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the manifest load departed from the origin facility, captured from TMS or carrier systems.

attributes.name: carbon_emissions_kg
attributes.description: Estimated or calculated carbon dioxide equivalent emissions (CO2e) for this manifest transport leg, supporting sustainability reporting per GHG Protocol and CORSIA.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this manifest crosses international borders and requires customs clearance at origin or destination.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this manifest contains any dangerous goods (hazmat) requiring special handling and documentation per IMDG or IATA DGR.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: delay_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total delay duration in minutes, calculated as the difference between planned and actual departure or arrival times.

attributes.name: delay_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for any departure or arrival delay (e.g., weather, customs hold, mechanical failure).

attributes.name: destination_facility_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the warehouse, terminal, port, or distribution center where the manifest load is destined.

attributes.name: destination_facility_name
attributes.description: Full name of the destination facility, terminal, or port where the manifest will be unloaded.

attributes.name: equipment_type_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the type of transport equipment used (e.g., 20ft container, 40ft container, reefer, flatbed, dry van) per ISO 6346 or industry standards.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: Airline flight number for air freight manifests, combining carrier code and flight number (e.g., AA1234).

attributes.name: gps_tracking_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time GPS tracking is enabled for this manifest via FourKites or other visibility platforms.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this manifest record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: load_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the load optimization plan generated by Oracle TMS or SAP TM that produced this manifest.

attributes.name: manifest_closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the manifest was closed and locked for departure, preventing further additions or changes.

attributes.name: manifest_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the manifest was marked as completed after successful delivery and unloading at destination.

attributes.name: manifest_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total transportation cost allocated to this manifest, including carrier charges, fuel surcharges, and accessorial fees.

attributes.name: manifest_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the manifest cost amount.

attributes.name: manifest_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this manifest record was first created in the TMS or WMS system.

attributes.name: manifest_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique manifest number assigned by the carrier or TMS for this consolidated load. Used for carrier handover documentation and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Services Conference Resolution, IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: manifest_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the manifest indicating its operational state from creation through completion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|open|closed|departed|in_transit|arrived|completed|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: origin_facility_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the warehouse, terminal, port, or distribution center where the manifest load originates.

attributes.name: origin_facility_name
attributes.description: Full name of the origin facility, terminal, or port where the manifest is loaded.

attributes.name: planned_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when the manifest load is expected to arrive at the destination facility.

attributes.name: planned_departure_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when the manifest load is planned to depart from the origin facility.

attributes.name: predicted_eta_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Predicted Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) Timestamp
attributes.description: Real-time predicted arrival timestamp generated by visibility platforms such as FourKites based on GPS tracking and predictive analytics.

attributes.name: route_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the planned transportation route or service lane assigned to this manifest by the TMS.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Unique seal number applied by the carrier to secure the container or trailer, used for tamper detection and security compliance (C-TPAT, AEO).

attributes.name: service_level_code
attributes.description: Code representing the service level commitment for this manifest (e.g., express, standard, economy) tied to SLA requirements.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this manifest includes temperature-sensitive cargo requiring refrigerated or climate-controlled transport.

attributes.name: total_chargeable_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total chargeable weight for billing purposes, calculated as the greater of actual weight or dimensional (DIM) weight, summed across all consignments.

attributes.name: total_consignments
attributes.description: Total number of individual consignments (AWBs, BOLs, HAWBs) consolidated into this manifest.

attributes.name: total_pieces
attributes.description: Total number of individual pieces, packages, or handling units loaded onto this manifest across all consignments.

attributes.name: total_volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volume of all consignments on this manifest, measured in cubic meters, used for load optimization and capacity planning.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of all consignments on this manifest, measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation for this manifest (air, ocean, road, rail, multimodal, or parcel express).

attributes.name: vessel_name
attributes.description: Name of the ocean vessel or aircraft carrying this manifest for sea or air freight.

attributes.name: voyage_number
attributes.description: Vessel voyage identifier for ocean freight manifests, assigned by the shipping line.

products.name: transit_hub_event
products.description: Records operational events at transit hubs and sorting facilities during a shipment's journey — including inbound scan, sortation, outbound loading, and transfer events. Captures hub facility code, event type (INBOUND_SCAN, SORTED, LOADED_OUTBOUND, TRANSFERRED, HELD, RETURNED_TO_SENDER), event timestamp, sort lane/belt assignment, outbound manifest reference, handling unit barcode, operator ID, and any hold reason code. Distinct from tracking_event (carrier-reported external events) — this captures internal hub operational processing events from WMS and sortation systems.

attributes.name: transit_hub_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transit hub event record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consignment (AWB/BOL/HAWB/MAWB) being processed. Links to the consignment entity for document traceability.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee or system operator identifier who performed or recorded the hub event. Used for accountability and labor tracking.

attributes.name: hub_gateway_id
