attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.hub_gateway. Business justification: Transit hub events by definition occur at specific hub/gateway facilities - fundamental for sort operations, hub throughput tracking, and network performance analysis. Normalizes hub_facility_code and

attributes.name: hub_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.network_node. Business justification: Hub events occur at specific network nodes (terminals, sort facilities). Essential for hub performance analysis, dwell time measurement, throughput tracking, and network optimization. Links operationa

attributes.name: outbound_freight_manifest_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shipment.freight_manifest. Business justification: Transit hub events record when consignments are loaded onto outbound vehicles. The product currently has outbound_manifest_number (STRING) which should be normalized to a FK. Adding outbound_freight_m

attributes.name: shipment_consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment being processed through the hub. Links this hub event to the parent shipment entity.

attributes.name: shipment_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shipment.shipment_leg. Business justification: Transit hub events (sorting, loading, unloading) occur as part of specific transport legs. A hub event at LHR during a multi-leg shipment belongs to the leg that passes through LHR. Nullable because s

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hub event record was first created in the data system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether customs clearance processing occurred at this hub during this event. True if customs processing, False otherwise.

attributes.name: customs_status
attributes.description: Status of customs clearance if customs_clearance_flag is True. CLEARED: customs released. PENDING: awaiting clearance. HELD: customs hold. INSPECTION_REQUIRED: physical inspection requested. Null if no customs processing.

attributes.name: damage_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the damage observed, entered by the operator. Null if no damage detected.

attributes.name: damage_detected_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether physical damage to the shipment or packaging was detected during this hub event. True if damage detected, False otherwise.

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the hub event, derived from event_timestamp for day-level reporting and partitioning. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the hub event occurred, captured from the WMS or sortation system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Type of hub operational event. INBOUND_SCAN: shipment scanned upon arrival at hub. SORTED: shipment processed through sortation system. LOADED_OUTBOUND: shipment loaded onto outbound vehicle. TRANSFERRED: shipment transferred to another carrier or facility. HELD: shipment placed on hold. RETURNED_TO_SENDER: shipment marked for return.

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this hub event represents an exception condition (hold, damage, delay) requiring intervention. True if exception, False if normal processing.

attributes.name: exception_severity
attributes.description: Severity level of the exception if exception_flag is True. LOW: minor delay. MEDIUM: requires attention within shift. HIGH: impacts SLA. CRITICAL: immediate escalation required. Null for non-exception events.

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate of the hub facility where the event occurred, for geospatial analysis and mapping.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate of the hub facility where the event occurred, for geospatial analysis and mapping.

attributes.name: handling_unit_barcode
attributes.description: Barcode or RFID tag identifier of the physical handling unit (parcel, pallet, container) scanned during the event. Used for item-level tracking within the hub.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the shipment is classified as dangerous goods or hazardous materials, requiring special handling during hub operations. True if hazmat, False otherwise.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why a shipment was placed on hold during a HELD event. Null for non-hold events. CUSTOMS_HOLD: awaiting customs clearance. DAMAGED: physical damage detected. ADDRESS_CORRECTION: address validation required. PAYMENT_REQUIRED: COD or duty payment pending. SECURITY_SCREENING: additional security checks. WEATHER_DELAY: weather-related hold.

attributes.name: hold_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context for the hold reason, entered by the operator.

attributes.name: humidity_percent
attributes.description: Relative humidity percentage recorded during the hub event, applicable for humidity-sensitive shipments.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the operator regarding this hub event, providing additional context not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the operator who performed the hub event, for human-readable audit trails.

attributes.name: outbound_vehicle_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the vehicle (truck, trailer, aircraft, container) onto which the shipment was loaded during LOADED_OUTBOUND event.

attributes.name: photo_captured_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether a photo or image of the shipment was captured during this hub event (e.g., for damage documentation, security, or quality control). True if photo captured, False otherwise.

attributes.name: photo_reference_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier or storage path reference for the photo captured during the hub event. Null if no photo captured.

attributes.name: processing_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Time in seconds taken to complete this hub event, measured from scan-in to scan-out or event completion. Used for labor productivity and throughput analysis.

attributes.name: security_screening_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the shipment underwent security screening (X-ray, physical inspection) during this hub event. True if screened, False otherwise.

attributes.name: security_screening_result
attributes.description: Result of the security screening if performed. PASSED: cleared for onward movement. FAILED: security concern identified. MANUAL_REVIEW: requires manual inspection. Null if not screened.

attributes.name: sort_destination_code
attributes.description: Destination facility or zone code assigned by the sortation system, indicating where the shipment should be routed next.

attributes.name: sort_lane_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the sortation lane, belt, or chute where the shipment was routed during the SORTED event. Null for non-sortation events.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that generated this hub event record. MANHATTAN_WMS: warehouse management system. SAP_TM: transportation management. SORTATION_SYSTEM: automated sortation equipment. HANDHELD_SCANNER: mobile scanning device. AUTOMATED_SORTER: high-speed sorter.

attributes.name: source_system_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction or event identifier from the source system, used for traceability and reconciliation back to the originating system.

attributes.name: special_handling_code
attributes.description: Code indicating special handling requirements for the shipment during hub operations. FRAGILE: handle with care. PERISHABLE: time/temperature sensitive. HIGH_VALUE: security escort required. LIVE_ANIMALS: live cargo. MEDICAL: medical supplies. PRIORITY: expedited processing.

attributes.name: temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Ambient or shipment temperature in degrees Celsius recorded during the hub event, applicable for temperature-controlled shipments.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN number identifying the hazardous material classification, applicable if hazmat_flag is True. Format: UN followed by 4 digits (e.g., UN1203).
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hub event record was last modified in the data system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Volume of the handling unit in cubic meters, captured during the hub event if dimensioning equipment is used.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 (Quantities and Units - Space and Time)

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Actual weight of the handling unit in kilograms, captured during the hub event if weigh-in-motion or scale scanning is performed.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 (Quantities and Units - Space and Time)

products.name: shipment_document
products.description: Registry of all transport and trade documents associated with a consignment beyond the primary AWB/BOL. Captures document type (commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, phytosanitary certificate, dangerous goods manifest, insurance certificate, letter of credit, export license, import permit), document reference number, issuing authority, issue date, expiry date, document file URI, upload source, and document status (pending/submitted/approved/rejected). Provides a complete document envelope for a shipment enabling customs compliance and carrier acceptance checks.

attributes.name: shipment_document_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shipment document record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Shipping documents (commercial invoices, certificates of origin, insurance certificates) often reference the governing trade agreement for customs compliance, preferential tariff claims, and regulator

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent consignment (shipment) to which this document is attached. Links the document to the primary shipment record.

attributes.name: declaration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customs declaration record to which this document is attached as supporting evidence. Nullable if not linked to a specific declaration.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that uploaded or submitted the document. Used for audit trail and accountability. Confidential as it may identify internal or customer personnel.

attributes.name: superseded_by_document_shipment_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment_document_id of the newer version that supersedes this document. Nullable if this is the current version.

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Business justification: Shipment_document tracks document associations for consignments but lacks FK to the actual document record. Real-world operations require retrieving document content for customs clearance, carrier han

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the document was approved or accepted by the reviewing authority (customs, carrier, compliance officer). Nullable if not yet approved. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the document meets all regulatory and carrier compliance requirements. True=compliant, False=non-compliant or pending review.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this shipment document record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: document_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document in the shipment workflow. Pending=awaiting upload or review, Submitted=sent to customs or carrier, Approved=accepted by authority, Rejected=not accepted, Expired=past validity date, Cancelled=voided by shipper or system.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document expires or is no longer valid for use in customs clearance or carrier acceptance. Nullable for documents without expiration. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: File format or MIME type of the stored document. PDF=Portable Document Format, JPEG/PNG/TIFF=image formats, XML=structured data, EDI=Electronic Data Interchange message.

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Size of the document file in bytes. Used for storage management and upload validation.

attributes.name: file_uri
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) or file path pointing to the stored digital copy of the document in the document management system or cloud storage. Confidential as it may expose internal storage architecture.

attributes.name: hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g., SHA-256) of the document file content, used for integrity verification and tamper detection.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document was officially issued or certified by the issuing authority. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: issuing_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization, government agency, or entity that issued or certified the document (e.g., Chamber of Commerce, Ministry of Agriculture, Insurance Company).
attributes.references: WCO Data Model, ISO 3166 Country Codes

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the document was issued.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the primary language in which the document is written (e.g., en=English, es=Spanish, zh=Chinese).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this shipment document record was last updated or modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this document is mandatory for the shipment to proceed (e.g., commercial invoice for customs clearance). True=mandatory, False=optional or supplementary.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: The unique reference or control number assigned to this document by the issuing authority or system. Used for tracking and retrieval.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for document rejection. INCOMPLETE=missing required fields, EXPIRED=document past validity, INVALID=does not meet regulatory requirements, MISMATCH=data does not match shipment details, ILLEGIBLE=poor quality scan, UNAUTHORIZED=issuer not recognized.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model, Internal Compliance Standard

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the reviewing authority detailing why the document was rejected and what corrective action is required.

attributes.name: rejection_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the document was rejected by the reviewing authority. Nullable if not rejected. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the document may be archived or purged according to regulatory retention policies (e.g., 7 years for customs records). Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model, SOX, GDPR Article 5, Internal Records Retention Policy

attributes.name: reviewed_by_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the customs office, carrier, or compliance authority that reviewed and approved or rejected the document.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the document was officially submitted to customs, carrier, or other external authority for review. Nullable if not yet submitted. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: translation_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the document requires translation into the destination country language for customs clearance or carrier acceptance. True=translation required, False=no translation needed.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model, Internal Compliance Standard

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Classification code identifying the type of document. CINV=Commercial Invoice, PLIST=Packing List, COO=Certificate of Origin, PHYTO=Phytosanitary Certificate, DGM=Dangerous Goods Manifest, INSC=Insurance Certificate. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CINV|PLIST|COO|PHYTO|DGM|INSC|LOC|EXPL|IMPP|CUST|HAWB|MAWB|BOL|AWB|POD|CMR|TIR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: WCO Data Model, IATA Cargo-IMP, IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: upload_source
attributes.description: The channel or system through which the document was uploaded or received. Shipper_portal=customer web portal, EDI=Electronic Data Interchange, API=Application Programming Interface integration, Email=email attachment, Manual=manual entry by operations, Carrier_system=received from carrier system.

attributes.name: upload_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the document was uploaded or received into the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the document if it has been revised or resubmitted. Starts at 1 for the original submission and increments with each revision.

products.name: temperature_log
products.description: IoT/sensor temperature monitoring log for cold-chain and temperature-controlled shipments. Captures sensor device ID, shipment/package reference, measurement timestamp, temperature reading (°C), humidity reading (%), set point temperature range (min/max), breach flag (true if outside acceptable range), breach duration in minutes, location at time of reading (GPS coordinates or facility code), and data source (IoT device/RFID/manual entry). Enables cold-chain compliance verification, pharmaceutical and perishable cargo integrity assurance, and insurance claim evidence.
products.reference: Cold Chain Temperature Log / IoT Sensor Data

attributes.name: temperature_log_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the temperature log record. Primary key for the temperature monitoring event.

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment being monitored for temperature compliance. Links this temperature reading to the specific shipment in cold-chain transit.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse operator, driver, or personnel responsible for the shipment at the time of temperature reading. Used for accountability and training purposes.

attributes.name: sensor_calibration_certificate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.certificate. Business justification: Temperature-controlled shipments (pharma, food, biologics) require sensor calibration certificates for GDP compliance, regulatory audits, and quality assurance. Real-world cold chain operations must l

attributes.name: shipment_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shipment.shipment_leg. Business justification: Temperature monitoring occurs during transport legs, with each leg potentially having different vehicle/container/carrier. Adding shipment_leg_id enables leg-level cold-chain compliance tracking and i

attributes.name: alert_recipient_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses or user IDs who were notified when a temperature breach alert was triggered. Used for audit trail and escalation tracking.

attributes.name: alert_triggered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this temperature reading triggered an automated alert to operations or customer service teams. True if alert was sent, false if no alert required.

attributes.name: breach_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Cumulative duration in minutes that the temperature has been outside the acceptable range during the current breach event. Used for compliance reporting and insurance claims.

attributes.name: breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the measured temperature falls outside the acceptable setpoint range (min/max). True if temperature is out of compliance, false if within acceptable range.

attributes.name: breach_severity_code
attributes.description: Classification of the temperature breach severity based on deviation magnitude and duration. Minor: slight deviation, Moderate: significant deviation, Critical: severe deviation requiring immediate action.

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: Category of temperature-sensitive cargo being monitored. Determines applicable regulatory requirements and acceptable temperature ranges for compliance verification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pharmaceutical|perishable_food|chemical|biological|vaccine|frozen_goods|chilled_goods — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: container_number
attributes.description: ISO container number for ocean or intermodal freight shipments. Links temperature readings to specific reefer containers for FCL and LCL cold-chain cargo.

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of any corrective action taken in response to a temperature breach event. Documents operational response for compliance reporting and insurance claims.

attributes.name: corrective_action_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when corrective action was initiated in response to a temperature breach. Used to calculate response time for SLA compliance and operational performance metrics.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Automated quality score (0.00 to 1.00) assessing the reliability of this temperature reading based on sensor calibration status, battery level, signal strength, and data completeness.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Origin system or method by which the temperature reading was captured. Distinguishes between automated IoT sensors, RFID tags, manual operator entry, and system integrations.

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: Unique code of the warehouse, terminal, or facility where the temperature reading was captured. Populated when location_type is facility-based, null for in-transit readings.

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate where the temperature reading was captured. Populated for in-transit readings from GPS-enabled sensors, null for facility-based readings.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate where the temperature reading was captured. Populated for in-transit readings from GPS-enabled sensors, null for facility-based readings.

attributes.name: humidity_percentage
attributes.description: Relative humidity percentage measured at the time of temperature reading. Critical for pharmaceutical shipments and moisture-sensitive cargo integrity.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Type of location where the temperature reading was captured. Distinguishes between facility-based readings and in-transit GPS-based readings.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the temperature reading was captured by the sensor device. Critical for cold-chain compliance verification and breach timeline analysis.

attributes.name: package_reference_number
attributes.description: Specific package or container identifier within the shipment being monitored. Enables granular tracking when a shipment contains multiple temperature-controlled units.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this temperature log record was first inserted into the data platform. Used for data lineage tracking and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this temperature reading meets all applicable regulatory requirements for the commodity type. True if compliant, false if non-compliant or requires review.

attributes.name: sensor_battery_level_percentage
attributes.description: Remaining battery charge percentage of the IoT sensor device at the time of reading. Used for predictive maintenance and data quality assurance to prevent sensor failures.

attributes.name: sensor_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date when the sensor device was last calibrated for accuracy. Critical for regulatory compliance and ensuring measurement reliability for pharmaceutical and perishable cargo.

attributes.name: sensor_device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the IoT sensor or RFID device that captured this temperature reading. Used for device calibration tracking and data quality assurance.

attributes.name: setpoint_max_celsius
attributes.description: Upper bound of the acceptable temperature range for this shipment as defined by the shipper or regulatory requirement. Used to determine temperature breach conditions.

attributes.name: setpoint_min_celsius
attributes.description: Lower bound of the acceptable temperature range for this shipment as defined by the shipper or regulatory requirement. Used to determine temperature breach conditions.

attributes.name: temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Measured temperature value in degrees Celsius at the time of reading. Core metric for cold-chain integrity verification for pharmaceutical and perishable cargo.

attributes.name: transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the temperature reading was transmitted from the sensor device to the central monitoring system. Used to calculate data latency and identify transmission delays.

attributes.name: vehicle_reference_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the transport vehicle (truck, aircraft, vessel) carrying the shipment at the time of temperature reading. Links temperature data to fleet management systems.

products.name: shipment_driver_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment of a driver to a consignment for a specific leg or segment of the shipment journey. It captures the driver scheduling, dispatch, and performance tracking for each driver-consignment pairing. Each record links one consignment to one driver with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific assignment, including planned and actual departure/return times, assignment status, driving hours, and distance traveled. Critical for driver scheduling, labor cost allocation, compliance monitoring, and operational performance analysis.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping logistics operations, consignments frequently require multiple drivers across their journey due to relay operations, handoffs between pickup/linehaul/delivery legs, and consolidated routing where drivers handle multiple consignments per shift. Conversely, each driver is assigned to multiple consignments throughout their shift or workday. The business actively manages these assignments as operational records with specific attributes like assignment type, planned/actual departure times, driving hours, and distance traveled.

attributes.name: shipment_driver_assignment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for shipment_driver_assignment

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the consignment record that this driver is assigned to handle for a specific leg or segment of the shipment journey.

attributes.name: driver_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this driver assignment record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: driver_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the driver profile record of the driver assigned to this consignment leg.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the planned route or route template used for this assignment leg. Links to route planning system. Used for route adherence analysis and optimization.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the vehicle asset used by the driver for this assignment. Links to the fleet vehicle master. Used for vehicle utilization tracking and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: actual_departure_datetime
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the driver departed with the consignment for this leg. Used for performance tracking and variance analysis against planned departure.

attributes.name: actual_return_datetime
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the driver completed this assignment leg and returned or handed off the consignment. Used for performance tracking and labor hour calculation.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this driver assignment: scheduled (planned but not yet dispatched), dispatched (driver notified and en route), in_transit (actively transporting), completed (leg finished successfully), cancelled (assignment cancelled before completion), failed (assignment could not be completed). Used for real-time operational visibility and exception management.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: The type of assignment or leg that this driver is responsible for: pickup (origin collection), linehaul (long-distance transport), delivery (final mile), relay (driver handoff point), handoff (transfer between drivers), consolidation (multi-pickup route). Defines the drivers role in the consignment lifecycle.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this driver assignment record was created in the system. Used for audit trail and operational reporting.

attributes.name: dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this assignment was dispatched to the driver (notification sent, assignment confirmed). Used for dispatch efficiency tracking and driver response time analysis.

attributes.name: distance_actual_km
attributes.description: Actual distance traveled by the driver in kilometers during this assignment leg. Captured from vehicle telematics or GPS tracking. Used for fuel cost allocation, route optimization analysis, and driver performance metrics.

attributes.name: driving_hours
attributes.description: Total hours the driver spent actively driving during this assignment leg. Used for labor cost allocation, compliance monitoring (hours of service regulations), and driver performance analysis. Calculated from telematics or driver logs.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this driver assignment record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: planned_departure_datetime
attributes.description: The scheduled date and time when the driver is planned to depart with the consignment for this leg. Used for dispatch planning and SLA management.

attributes.name: planned_return_datetime
attributes.description: The scheduled date and time when the driver is planned to return or complete this assignment leg. Used for route planning and driver availability forecasting.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that created this driver assignment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: manifest_line_item
products.description: This association product represents the operational loading record between a freight manifest and a consignment. It captures the physical loading event when a specific consignment is added to a specific manifest, including load sequencing, handling timestamps, piece counts, and weight at the time of loading. Each record links one freight manifest to one consignment with attributes that exist only in the context of this loading relationship. This is the legal line-item record required for customs documentation and carrier handover.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, a freight manifest consolidates multiple consignments onto a single transport asset (aircraft, vessel, truck), and a single consignment can be split across multiple manifests when it travels through multiple legs or is too large for a single load. The manifest line item is a legally required operational record that captures the loading event, including sequence, position, timestamps, and actual pieces/weight loaded. This is a core operational M:N relationship that logistics staff actively manage during manifest creation, load planning, and customs documentation.

attributes.name: manifest_line_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this manifest line item record. Primary key.

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the consignment that is loaded onto this manifest

attributes.name: freight_manifest_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manifest Line Item - Freight Manifest Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the freight manifest that this consignment is loaded onto

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this manifest line item record was first created in the TMS or WMS system.

attributes.name: handling_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes specific to the handling of this consignment on this manifest, such as special handling instructions, damage observations, or loading exceptions. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this manifest line item record was last modified.

attributes.name: line_item_status
attributes.description: Current status of this manifest line item indicating its operational state (planned, loaded, in_transit, unloaded, exception). Tracks the lifecycle of this specific consignment on this specific manifest.

attributes.name: load_position
attributes.description: Physical position or location where this consignment is loaded within the transport equipment (e.g., container position, pallet location, bay/row/tier). Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: loaded_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this specific consignment was physically loaded onto the manifest. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: manifest_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number of this consignment on the manifest, used for customs documentation and loading order reference. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: piece_count_on_manifest
attributes.description: Number of pieces from this consignment that were actually loaded onto this specific manifest. May differ from consignment.number_of_pieces if the consignment is split across multiple manifests. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: unloaded_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this specific consignment was physically unloaded from the manifest at the destination facility. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: weight_on_manifest_kg
attributes.description: Actual weight in kilograms of the pieces from this consignment loaded onto this specific manifest. May differ from consignment.declared_weight_kg if the consignment is split across multiple manifests. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

products.name: consignment_accessorial_application
products.description: This association product represents the application of accessorial charges to consignments in the logistics billing process. It captures the operational reality that a single consignment can incur multiple accessorial charges (residential delivery, liftgate, hazmat, redelivery, storage) and the same accessorial charge definition applies to many consignments. Each record links one consignment to one accessorial charge with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific application: the actual charge amount applied (which may differ from catalog due to negotiations), quantity of units charged, application timestamp, waiver status, and approval requirements. This is a core operational entity in the billing domain, actively managed by rating engines, billing systems, and customer service teams processing disputes and waivers.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, a single consignment routinely incurs multiple accessorial charges simultaneously (residential delivery surcharge + liftgate fee + signature required + hazmat handling for the same shipment), and each accessorial charge definition (e.g., 'Residential Delivery Surcharge') applies to thousands of consignments daily. The business actively manages these applications through rating engines, billing systems, customer service waiver processes, and dispute resolution workflows. This is not an analytical correlation but an operational entity that humans create (manual charge additions), update (waiver approvals), and query ('show me all accessorials applied to consignment AWB12345', 'which consignments had residential surcharges waived this month').

attributes.name: consignment_accessorial_application_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this specific application of an accessorial charge to a consignment. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: accessorial_charge_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consignment Accessorial Application - Accessorial Charge Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the accessorial charge definition from the master catalog. References the charge type, calculation basis, and standard rates.

attributes.name: billing_dispute_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer dispute or claims case ID if this charge has been disputed. Links to the claims management system for resolution tracking.

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the consignment that incurred this accessorial charge. References the core shipment booking record.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the invoice on which this accessorial charge appears. Null if the charge has not yet been invoiced or if it was waived before invoicing. Links to the billing domain invoice product.

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this accessorial charge application. Pending: calculated but not yet finalized. Applied: finalized and ready for invoicing. Invoiced: included on customer invoice. Waived: charge waived and not billed. Disputed: under customer dispute. Reversed: charge reversed due to billing error.

attributes.name: application_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this accessorial charge was applied to the consignment. Typically set by the rating engine during shipment rating or by billing systems during invoice generation. Critical for audit trails and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: applied_charge_amount
attributes.description: The actual charge amount applied to this consignment for this accessorial. May differ from the catalog charge_amount due to customer-specific contract rates, negotiated discounts, or manual adjustments. This is the billable amount.

attributes.name: auto_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accessorial charge was automatically applied by the rating engine based on business rules (true) or manually added by a billing analyst or customer service representative (false). Used for process improvement and automation metrics.

attributes.name: created_by_system
attributes.description: Source system that created this accessorial application record. Examples: 'SAP_TM_Rating_Engine', 'Oracle_TMS_Billing', 'Manual_Billing_Portal'. Used for data lineage and system integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this association record was created in the system. Standard audit field.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the applied_charge_amount. May differ from the catalog currency_code if currency conversion was applied based on consignment origin/destination.

attributes.name: disputed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has disputed this specific accessorial charge application. True means a dispute case has been opened. Used to track dispute rates by charge type and drive operational improvements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this association record was last modified. Updated when waiver status changes, disputes are filed, or amounts are adjusted. Standard audit field.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity or number of units to which the accessorial charge applies. For per-piece charges, this is the number of pieces. For per-kg charges, this is the weight. For flat fees, this is typically 1. Used in conjunction with calculation_basis from the charge definition.

attributes.name: waived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specific accessorial charge application has been waived (not billed to the customer). True means the charge was applied but then waived due to customer service recovery, contract terms, or billing disputes. Waived charges appear in operational reports but not on customer invoices.

attributes.name: waiver_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the waiver was approved. Used for audit compliance and management reporting on waiver patterns.

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the manager or customer service representative who approved the waiver of this charge. Required when waived_flag is true and waiver_approval_required is true in the charge definition.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason why this accessorial charge was waived. Examples: 'Customer service recovery', 'Contract exclusion', 'Billing dispute resolution', 'Operational error'. Required when waived_flag is true.

products.name: consignment_consolidation_entry
products.description: This association product represents the operational event of a consignment being physically loaded into a specific consolidation container or ULD. It captures the critical CFS warehouse operations data including the sequence in which cargo was loaded, precise entry and exit timestamps for deconsolidation planning, the number of handling units from this consignment in this specific consolidation, and the allocated weight for pro-rata freight charge calculation. Each record represents one consignment's participation in one consolidation, supporting NVOCC co-loading operations, CFS workflow management, and split-shipment tracking when a single consignment spans multiple consolidations.. Existence Justification: In LCL and freight forwarding operations, a single consignment can be physically split across multiple consolidations when it exceeds available capacity in one container/ULD, and each consolidation contains cargo from multiple different consignments. The business actively manages each consignment-consolidation pairing as a distinct operational event with specific loading sequence, entry/exit timestamps, and weight allocation for pro-rata freight billing. This is a core NVOCC business process managed by CFS operations teams.

attributes.name: consignment_consolidation_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this consignment-consolidation entry record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the consignment that is being consolidated. References the shipment domain's master consignment entity.

attributes.name: consolidation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the consolidation container or ULD into which the consignment is loaded. References the freight domain's consolidation entity.

attributes.name: consolidation_entry_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when this consignment was physically loaded into the consolidation container or ULD at the origin CFS facility. Used for cargo cut-off compliance tracking and operational audit trails.

attributes.name: deconsolidation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when this consignment was physically unloaded from the consolidation at the destination CFS facility. Used for dwell time calculation, onward delivery planning, and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this consignment within this specific consolidation: planned (scheduled but not yet loaded), loaded (physically in container), in_transit (departed origin), arrived (at destination port), deconsolidated (unloaded at destination CFS), delivered (handed over for final delivery).

attributes.name: handling_unit_count
attributes.description: Number of handling units (pieces, pallets, cartons) from this specific consignment that were loaded into this specific consolidation. Critical when a consignment is split across multiple consolidations or when only partial pieces are consolidated.

attributes.name: loading_remarks
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes recorded by CFS staff during loading operations, such as special handling performed, damage observed, or deviations from standard procedures.

attributes.name: sequence_in_consolidation
attributes.description: The sequential order in which this consignment was loaded into the consolidation. Critical for CFS operations to determine unloading order (LIFO/FIFO) and for deconsolidation planning at destination CFS.

attributes.name: split_shipment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consignment was split across multiple consolidations due to capacity constraints or operational requirements. True if the consignment appears in more than one consolidation.

attributes.name: volume_in_consolidation_cbm
attributes.description: The volume in cubic meters of this consignment's cargo allocated to this specific consolidation. Used for capacity utilization tracking and pro-rata cost allocation.

attributes.name: weight_in_consolidation_kg
attributes.description: The weight in kilograms of this consignment's cargo that was allocated to this specific consolidation. Essential for pro-rata freight charge allocation when a consignment is split across multiple consolidations, and for accurate consolidation weight reconciliation.

products.name: consignment_offset_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of carbon offset credits from specific offset programs to individual consignments. It captures the operational process of applying carbon offset credits to shipments, supporting both automatic portfolio-based allocation and customer-requested carbon-neutral shipping. Each record links one consignment to one carbon offset program with the quantity of CO2e offset, allocation method, timing, and certificate issuance status. This enables Transport Shipping to track blended offset portfolios per shipment and provide customers with verifiable carbon-neutral delivery.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping's carbon offset operations, consignments are offset through multiple programs simultaneously using a portfolio approach (e.g., aviation CORSIA-eligible credits plus voluntary Gold Standard reforestation credits to meet both compliance and marketing goals). Conversely, each offset program covers many consignments over time as credits are allocated and retired. The business actively manages these allocations: sustainability teams select program mixes, calculate offset quantities per consignment based on weight/distance/mode, track retirement status in external registries, and issue certificates to customers who purchase carbon-neutral shipping.

attributes.name: consignment_offset_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this consignment-offset program allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: carbon_offset_program_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consignment Offset Allocation - Carbon Offset Program Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the carbon offset program from which credits were allocated. Each allocation draws from exactly one program.

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the consignment that received carbon offset allocation. Each allocation applies to exactly one consignment.

attributes.name: allocation_cost_usd
attributes.description: The cost incurred by Transport Shipping for this offset allocation, calculated as offset_quantity_tco2e multiplied by the program price per tonne at allocation time. Used for financial reconciliation and P&L attribution.

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The date when the carbon offset credits were allocated to this consignment. Used for vintage tracking, compliance reporting, and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The method by which offset credits were allocated to this consignment: automatic_portfolio (system-driven blended allocation), customer_requested (customer purchased carbon-neutral shipping), manual_override (sustainability team adjustment), compliance_mandate (CORSIA or regulatory requirement).

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context about this allocation: reason for manual override, customer special requests, compliance requirements, or audit annotations.

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date
attributes.description: The date when the carbon offset certificate was issued to the customer for this allocation.

attributes.name: certificate_issued_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a carbon offset certificate has been issued to the customer for this allocation. Used to track customer-facing deliverables and prevent duplicate issuance.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: The unique certificate number issued to the customer for this carbon offset allocation, if applicable. Links to certificate generation system.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or system account that created this allocation record. Used for audit trails and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allocation record was created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_charge_usd
attributes.description: The amount charged to the customer for carbon-neutral shipping on this consignment, if customer_requested_flag is true. May differ from allocation_cost_usd due to pricing strategy.

attributes.name: customer_requested_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the customer explicitly requested and paid for carbon-neutral shipping for this consignment. Used for revenue attribution and customer reporting.

attributes.name: offset_quantity_tco2e
attributes.description: The quantity of carbon offset credits allocated from this program to this consignment, measured in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent. This is the core transactional attribute representing the actual offset applied.

attributes.name: registry_retirement_reference
attributes.description: The unique retirement transaction identifier from the external carbon offset registry (e.g., Verra, Gold Standard). Provides audit trail and verification link.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date when the allocated offset credits were permanently retired in the carbon offset registry. Used for compliance reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: retirement_status
attributes.description: The lifecycle status of the allocated offset credits: allocated (reserved for this consignment), retired (permanently retired in registry), pending_retirement (awaiting registry confirmation), cancelled (allocation reversed).

products.name: manifest_supplier_pickup
products.description: This association product represents the pickup event between a freight manifest and a supplier in milk run consolidation operations. It captures the operational details of collecting consignments from a specific supplier location as part of a multi-stop manifest route. Each record links one freight manifest to one supplier with pickup-specific attributes including sequence order, volume collected, and timestamp. This enables milk run route optimization, supplier performance tracking, and load reconciliation by origin point.. Existence Justification: In milk run consolidation operations, a single freight manifest collects shipments from multiple supplier locations along a planned route (e.g., automotive parts from 5 suppliers in one truck run). Conversely, a single supplier has shipments picked up across multiple manifests over time (different days, different routes, different service lanes). The business actively manages pickup sequences, tracks per-supplier volumes on each manifest, and measures on-time pickup performance at each supplier stop.

attributes.name: manifest_supplier_pickup_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this manifest-supplier pickup record. Primary key.

attributes.name: freight_manifest_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manifest Supplier Pickup - Freight Manifest Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the freight manifest that includes this supplier pickup stop

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the supplier location where pickup occurred

attributes.name: consignment_count
attributes.description: Number of individual consignments (shipments) collected from this supplier for this manifest. Used for load reconciliation and supplier performance metrics.

attributes.name: pickup_sequence
attributes.description: The ordinal position of this supplier in the milk run route sequence (1st stop, 2nd stop, etc.). Critical for route optimization and driver instructions.

attributes.name: pickup_status
attributes.description: Current status of the pickup at this supplier location (scheduled, in_transit, completed, missed, cancelled). Tracks execution state for operational visibility.

attributes.name: pickup_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the driver completed pickup at this supplier location. Used for on-time pickup performance tracking and route execution analysis.

attributes.name: planned_pickup_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time for pickup at this supplier location as planned by the TMS route optimizer. Used to measure pickup punctuality.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volume in cubic meters of all consignments picked up from this supplier for this manifest. Used for vehicle capacity utilization analysis.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight in kilograms of all consignments picked up from this supplier for this manifest. Contributes to manifest total weight and vehicle load planning.

domains.name: customer
domains.description: Single source of truth for all customer identity, account hierarchy, and relationship data across B2B enterprise accounts, B2C individual shippers, consignees, and 3PL/4PL partners. Manages customer profiles, account segmentation, contact management, SLA entitlements, service preferences, and CRM-sourced opportunity and service case data from Salesforce.

products.name: customer_account
products.description: Master record for all customer accounts in the logistics network, covering B2B enterprise shippers, B2C individual senders, consignees, and 3PL/4PL partners. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Account object. Stores account identity, legal entity name, tax registration (VAT/GST/EIN), classification (B2B/B2C/3PL/4PL), industry vertical, credit status, account tier, onboarding date, account manager assignment, and operational flags such as DDP eligibility, AEO certification status, and active/suspended/closed lifecycle state.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer account record in the Transport Shipping logistics platform. Primary key for the customer_account data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Strategic customer accounts often have dedicated account management teams whose costs must be tracked to specific cost centers for customer profitability analysis and cost-to-serve calculations. Enabl

attributes.name: importer_trade_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: Customer accounts act as importers/exporters in customs declarations. Required for: customs clearance, compliance program enrollment (AEO/CTPAT), denied party screening, and regulatory reporting. Core

attributes.name: parent_account_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent customer account record, enabling hierarchical B2B enterprise account structures (e.g., subsidiary accounts rolling up to a global parent). Null for top-level accounts. Supports consolidated billing and group-level SLA management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; ISO 20022 Party Hierarchy

attributes.name: preferred_lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.lane. Business justification: Strategic customers negotiate preferred lanes for their shipments. Drives TMS routing decisions, contract-specific lane assignments, and dedicated capacity allocation. Essential for customer-specific

attributes.name: preferred_service_corridor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.service_corridor. Business justification: Enterprise customers negotiate corridor-level service agreements for regional trade lanes. Required for corridor capacity reservations, multi-leg service commitments, and strategic account corridor pe

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Customer accounts must be assigned to profit centers for P&L reporting and segment performance analysis. Logistics companies track revenue and EBITDA by service line, geography, and customer segment—a

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Normalizes the customer segmentation classification. Currently customer_account has account_segment as a STRING (likely storing segment_code). Adding customer_segment_id FK allows proper referential i

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric account number assigned to the customer at onboarding. Printed on invoices, Air Waybills (AWBs), and Bills of Lading (BOLs) as the billing reference. Unique across the logistics network.

attributes.name: account_source
attributes.description: Channel or method through which the customer account was originally created: Salesforce CRM opportunity conversion, web portal self-registration, EDI partner onboarding, manual entry by operations team, data migration from legacy system, or partner referral.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Source; Transport Shipping Onboarding Policy

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the customer account. 'active' indicates the account is in good standing and can generate shipments; 'suspended' indicates a temporary hold (e.g., credit breach); 'closed' indicates the account has been permanently deactivated; 'pending' indicates onboarding in progress; 'prospect' indicates a pre-onboarding opportunity from Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Status; SOX Section 404 Customer Master Controls

attributes.name: account_tier
attributes.description: Commercial segmentation tier assigned to the customer account based on revenue contribution, shipment volume, and strategic value. Determines priority handling, dedicated account management, and access to premium services such as guaranteed capacity and priority customs clearance.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Commercial Segmentation Policy; Salesforce CRM Account Rating

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classifies the customer account into its primary commercial relationship category: B2B (enterprise shipper), B2C (individual sender), 3PL (Third-Party Logistics provider), 4PL (Fourth-Party Logistics provider), CONSIGNEE (receiving party), or BROKER (customs/freight broker). Drives SLA entitlements, pricing tiers, and service eligibility.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Account Classification Policy; IATA Ground Handling Manual

attributes.name: aeo_certificate_number
attributes.description: Official AEO certificate number issued by the customs authority to the customer. Required for customs declaration pre-population in Descartes Customs GTM and for claiming AEO mutual recognition benefits on cross-border shipments. Null if aeo_certified is False.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework; EU AEO Programme; Descartes Customs GTM

attributes.name: aeo_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer holds a valid Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) certification issued by a customs authority. AEO-certified customers benefit from expedited customs clearance, reduced inspection rates, and mutual recognition benefits under WCO SAFE Framework agreements.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework of Standards; EU AEO Programme (Regulation EC 648/2005); C-TPAT Program

attributes.name: api_integration_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Application Programming Interface (API) Integration Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account has an active API integration for real-time shipment booking, tracking, and rate queries via Transport Shipping's logistics platform. API-enabled accounts can connect their ERP or e-commerce systems directly.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping API Integration Policy; IATA ONE Record Standard

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the customer's registered billing address (street number and name). Used for invoice generation, tax compliance, and financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City component of the customer's registered billing address. Used for tax jurisdiction determination, freight rate zone assignment, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the customer's registered billing address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Drives VAT/GST applicability, customs compliance rules, trade sanctions screening, and currency assignment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WCO Data Model; IATA Area Codes

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the customer's registered billing address. Used for freight rate zone calculation, tax jurisdiction mapping, and address validation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the customer account was permanently closed. Null for active accounts. Used for churn analysis, regulatory data retention scheduling, and financial period-end reconciliation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 Right to Erasure; SOX Data Retention Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the customer account record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Sourced from Salesforce CRM Account CreatedDate. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and GDPR processing records.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 Records of Processing; ISO 8601; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: credit_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the credit limit and outstanding balance are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency accounts.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding accounts receivable balance permitted for this customer account in the account's billing currency. Enforced by SAP S/4HANA Finance credit management module. Exceeding this limit triggers automatic shipment booking blocks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Credit Management; IFRS 9; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: credit_status
attributes.description: Current credit standing of the customer account as assessed by the Finance team in SAP S/4HANA. 'approved' allows standard credit terms; 'on_hold' blocks new shipment bookings pending payment; 'suspended' indicates credit facility withdrawn; 'under_review' indicates active credit reassessment; 'cash_only' requires prepayment for all services.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Credit Management; SOX Section 404; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: crm_account_code
attributes.description: External account identifier sourced from Salesforce CRM Account object. Used to trace the master record back to the system of record and support bi-directional synchronisation with Salesforce.

attributes.name: ctpat_member
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (C-TPAT) Member Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is a validated member of the US Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (C-TPAT) program. C-TPAT membership enables expedited US Customs and Border Protection processing and reduced examination rates for US-bound shipments.
attributes.references: C-TPAT Program (US CBP); ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Management

attributes.name: ddp_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account is approved for Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) shipments, where Transport Shipping assumes responsibility for import duties and taxes on behalf of the customer. Requires credit approval and customs power of attorney on file.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020 DDP; Descartes Customs GTM; C-TPAT Program Requirements

attributes.name: denied_party_screen_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent denied party and sanctions screening was performed for this customer account in Descartes Customs GTM. Used to enforce periodic re-screening compliance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: US OFAC; EU Sanctions Regulation; Descartes Customs GTM Screening Log

attributes.name: denied_party_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account has passed the most recent denied party and sanctions screening check in Descartes Customs GTM. Must be True before any shipment booking is permitted. Automatically reset to False when screening expires or a watchlist update occurs.
attributes.references: US OFAC Sanctions List; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; UN Security Council Sanctions; Descartes Customs GTM; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Dun & Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number uniquely identifying the customer's legal business entity globally. Used for credit risk assessment, supplier onboarding, and enterprise account hierarchy resolution.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Standard; ISO 6523 Organisation Identifier

attributes.name: edi_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account is configured for Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) integration for automated shipment booking, Advanced Shipping Notices (ASN), and status updates. EDI-capable accounts bypass manual data entry workflows.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo-XML Standards; UN/EDIFACT; ANSI X12 EDI Standards

attributes.name: eori_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) Number
attributes.description: Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number assigned by EU customs authorities to the customer for cross-border trade within the European Union. Required on all EU import/export customs declarations filed via Descartes Customs GTM.
attributes.references: EU Customs Code (Regulation EU 952/2013); WCO Data Model; Descartes Customs GTM

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: The primary industry sector of the customer's business (e.g., Automotive, Retail, Pharmaceutical, Technology, Perishables, Energy). Used for industry-specific SLA configuration, dangerous goods handling rules, and targeted sales analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Automotive|Retail|Pharmaceutical|Technology|Perishables|Energy|Aerospace|Consumer Goods|Industrial|Healthcare — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Classification; IMDG Code Chapter 1; ISO 3166 Industry Codes

attributes.name: kyc_verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the KYC verification was last completed for this customer account. Used to enforce periodic KYC renewal cycles and regulatory audit compliance.
attributes.references: FATF AML/CFT Recommendations; EU AML Directives; US Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: kyc_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account has completed Know Your Customer (KYC) identity verification as required by anti-money laundering (AML) regulations and Transport Shipping's customer onboarding policy. Required for high-value accounts and cross-border trade.
attributes.references: FATF AML/CFT Recommendations; EU 4th/5th AML Directive; US Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the customer account record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Sourced from Salesforce CRM Account LastModifiedDate. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Silver Layer lakehouse pipeline.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; ISO 8601; Databricks Delta Lake CDC Pattern

attributes.name: last_shipment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent shipment booked or executed under this customer account. Used for dormancy detection, account health monitoring, and proactive retention outreach by the account management team.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Account Health KPI Framework

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the customer entity as recorded with the relevant national business registry. Used for customs declarations, trade compliance screening, and financial invoicing. For B2C individuals this is the full personal name.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; WCO Data Model; FATF AML Guidelines

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the customer account was formally activated and approved for shipment booking. Marks the start of the commercial relationship. Used for customer tenure analysis, anniversary-based tier reviews, and SLA effective date calculations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Created Date; ISO 8601 Date Format

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code assigned to the customer account (e.g., NET30, NET60, COD, PREPAID). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance customer master. Determines invoice due dates and early payment discount eligibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NET30|NET60|NET90|COD|PREPAID|EOM|NET15 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Payment Terms; IFRS 15; Incoterms 2020

attributes.name: preferred_incoterms_code
attributes.description: Customer's default International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code governing risk and cost transfer in shipments (e.g., DDP, FOB, CIF, EXW). Pre-populated on new shipment bookings and freight orders in SAP TM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WCO Data Model; IATA Cargo Tariff Rules

attributes.name: preferred_service_mode
attributes.description: Customer's preferred primary freight transport mode: air (express/freight), ocean (FCL/LCL), road (FTL/LTL), rail, or multimodal. Used by SAP TM for default carrier and route selection and by Blue Yonder for demand forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transport Mode Configuration; IATA; IMO; EU Regulation 2015/757

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the account's main operational contact. Used for shipment notifications, Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) alerts, invoice delivery, and service case communications via Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 & Article 6; CAN-SPAM Act; CASL

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary operational contact person at the customer account. Used for shipment documentation, customs declarations, and account management correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; WCO Data Model Party Name

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the account's main operational contact in E.164 international format. Used for last-mile delivery coordination, exception management, and Proof of Delivery (POD) confirmation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ITU-T E.164 Numbering Plan

attributes.name: salesforce_owner_code
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM User ID of the account owner record. Retained for bi-directional synchronisation and audit traceability back to the Salesforce system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; GDPR Article 30 Records of Processing

attributes.name: sla_tier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the contracted Service Level Agreement (SLA) tier applicable to this customer account. Determines On-Time Delivery (OTD) targets, exception escalation thresholds, and guaranteed transit time commitments. Linked to the SLA entitlement configuration in SAP TM.
attributes.references: SAP TM SLA Configuration; IATA Service Level Standards; Transport Shipping SLA Policy

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax Identification Number (TIN) assigned by the national tax authority (e.g., IRS EIN for US entities). Used for financial reporting, 1099/W-9 compliance, and customs importer of record identification.
attributes.references: IRS EIN Requirements; SOX Section 302; WCO Importer of Record Standards

attributes.name: trading_name
attributes.description: Operating or 'doing business as' (DBA) name used commercially by the customer, which may differ from the registered legal name. Used in customer-facing communications and shipment documentation.

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Value Added Tax (VAT) / Goods and Services Tax (GST) Registration Number
attributes.description: Customer's VAT or GST registration number issued by the relevant tax authority. Required for cross-border invoicing, customs declarations, and EU VAT compliance. Null for B2C customers or entities in non-VAT jurisdictions.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; WCO Data Model; IATA Resolution 010a

products.name: contact
products.description: Individual contact persons associated with customer accounts, including shipping coordinators, procurement managers, finance contacts, and authorized signatories. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Contact object. Captures full name, job title, department, communication preferences, language, time zone, and contact role (e.g., billing contact, operational contact, escalation contact).

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the contact person record in the Transport Shipping data platform. Primary key for the contact entity.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent customer account this contact is associated with. Links the contact to the B2B enterprise account, B2C shipper, or 3PL/4PL partner account in the customer domain.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal Transport Shipping account manager or owner responsible for managing the relationship with this contact. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Owner field. Used for CRM opportunity tracking and service case assignment.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Owner; CRM Best Practices

attributes.name: reports_to_contact_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the contact's managerial or supervisory contact within the same account. Mirrors the Salesforce CRM 'Reports To' relationship. Enables organizational hierarchy navigation for escalation routing and account planning.

attributes.name: contact_description
attributes.description: Free-text notes or description about the contact person, capturing additional context such as areas of responsibility, special handling instructions, relationship history, or account-specific notes entered by the account management team in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: contact_role
attributes.description: Functional role the contact plays in the customer relationship with Transport Shipping. Determines routing of communications, invoices, and service cases. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing|operational|escalation|authorized_signatory|procurement|customs|compliance|executive — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Role; IATA Ground Handling Agreement

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record. Active contacts receive communications and are eligible for service interactions. Inactive contacts have left the organization or are no longer relevant. Do_not_contact respects opt-out or legal restrictions per GDPR.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact record indicating its priority and purpose within the account relationship. Primary contacts receive all standard communications; emergency contacts are activated for critical shipment exceptions or SLA breaches.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
