attributes.description: Air Waybill (AWB) number linked to this service case when the case relates to an air freight shipment. Follows IATA AWB format: 3-digit airline prefix followed by 8-digit serial number. Enables direct cross-reference to air freight documentation.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a — Air Waybill; IATA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading (BOL) number linked to this service case when the case relates to an ocean or road freight shipment. Enables cross-reference to freight forwarding documentation and carrier records.
attributes.references: Federal Maritime Commission (FMC) — Bill of Lading Requirements; IMO

attributes.name: case_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the service case record was first created in Salesforce CRM. This is the principal business event timestamp representing when the customer interaction was formally logged. Used as the baseline for all SLA (Service Level Agreement) calculations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (CreatedDate); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: case_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the customer's issue, complaint, or inquiry as captured at case creation. May include shipment details, service failure context, or customer-provided evidence.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Description); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable case reference number assigned by Salesforce CRM at case creation. Used in all customer-facing communications and SLA tracking. Format: CS- followed by 8–12 digits.

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the service case lifecycle. Drives operational queues, SLA breach monitoring, and customer communication triggers. Transitions: new → in_progress → pending_customer | escalated → resolved → closed.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Status); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: case_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service case by the nature of the customer interaction. Drives routing, SLA assignment, and reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shipment_inquiry|service_failure|complaint|claims_initiation|billing_dispute|general_support|customs_query|returns_rma — promote to reference product if additional types are added]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Type); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: claim_reference_number
attributes.description: The externally visible claim reference number from the claims domain, populated when claims_initiated is True. Provides a soft cross-reference to the cargo claim record without enforcing a hard FK at this stage. Distinct from service_case_id — the claim domain manages financial liability.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; Federal Maritime Commission (FMC); ISO 9001

attributes.name: claims_initiated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service case has triggered the initiation of a formal cargo claim in the claims domain. True when the case type is claims_initiation and a claim record has been created. Provides the handoff signal between customer service workflow and financial liability management.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; Federal Maritime Commission (FMC); IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the service case was formally closed after customer confirmation or automatic closure policy. Distinct from resolved_timestamp — a case may be resolved but remain open pending customer acknowledgement.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (ClosedDate); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: customer_feedback_notes
attributes.description: Free-text verbatim feedback provided by the customer as part of the post-case satisfaction survey. Complements the numeric CSAT score with qualitative insight for service improvement analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (CSAT Comments); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction rating provided by the customer upon case closure, typically on a 1–5 scale. Sourced from Salesforce CRM post-case survey. Key KPI (Key Performance Indicator) for service quality measurement and agent performance management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (CSAT); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the shipment destination location referenced in this service case. Used for cross-border service failure analysis, last-mile delivery issue routing, and trade compliance case categorization.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; WCO (World Customs Organization); IMO

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: The highest escalation tier reached by this case. Populated when is_escalated is True. Used for escalation pattern analysis and workforce capacity planning. None indicates no escalation occurred.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Escalation Rules; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or structured reason provided by the agent when escalating the case. Documents the business justification for escalation, such as SLA breach risk, high-value customer, or regulatory sensitivity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case History; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the most recent escalation event was triggered for this case. Null if the case has never been escalated. Used for escalation response time analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case History; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: first_response_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the first substantive agent response was sent to the customer after case creation. Used to calculate SLA (Service Level Agreement) first-response compliance and OTD (On-Time Delivery) of service commitments.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Milestone (First Response); SLA governance

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: The Incoterms (International Commercial Terms) code applicable to the shipment referenced in this service case. Determines liability boundaries between shipper and consignee, which is critical for claims initiation routing and resolution authority. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_escalated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service case has been formally escalated to a senior agent, team lead, or management tier at any point in its lifecycle. True if any escalation event has occurred.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (IsEscalated); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the service case record was most recently updated in the source system (Salesforce CRM). Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail maintenance in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (LastModifiedDate); GDPR Article 5 (data accuracy); SOX

attributes.name: last_reopened_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the case was most recently reopened after a prior resolution or closure. Null if the case has never been reopened. Used alongside reopen_count for resolution quality analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case History; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: origin_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel through which the customer submitted this service case. Used for channel analytics, staffing optimization, and omnichannel service reporting. EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) channel applies to B2B automated case submissions.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Origin); IATA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the shipment origin location referenced in this service case. Used for cross-border service failure analysis, customs-related case routing, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; WCO (World Customs Organization); IMO

attributes.name: pod_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the requested Proof of Delivery (POD) or Electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) document has been successfully retrieved and attached to this case. Used to track case resolution blockers.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; US DOT; IATA

attributes.name: pod_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Proof of Delivery (POD) or Electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) document has been requested as part of resolving this service case. Common for delivery dispute and non-receipt inquiry cases.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; US DOT; IATA

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the service case, determining response time targets and escalation thresholds per the customer SLA entitlement. Critical cases typically involve time-sensitive freight or enterprise account failures.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Priority); SLA (Service Level Agreement) governance

attributes.name: reopen_count
attributes.description: Number of times this service case has been reopened after being marked as resolved or closed. A non-zero value indicates resolution quality issues. Used for first-contact resolution (FCR) KPI (Key Performance Indicator) reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case History; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: resolution_code
attributes.description: Standardized code describing the action taken to resolve the service case. Distinct from root cause — this captures what was done, not why it happened. Used for resolution effectiveness analytics and SLA compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reshipped|refunded|credited|apology_issued|information_provided|escalated_to_claim|no_action_required|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Resolution); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the specific resolution actions taken, agent findings, and any commitments made to the customer. Captured at case closure and retained for audit and quality review.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Resolution); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the service case was first marked as resolved. Used to calculate total resolution time, SLA (Service Level Agreement) resolution compliance, and agent productivity metrics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Milestone (Resolution); SLA governance; ISO 9001

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the underlying root cause identified during case investigation. Critical for operational improvement, KPI (Key Performance Indicator) reporting, and recurring failure analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: carrier_delay|customs_hold|documentation_error|damage_in_transit|lost_shipment|billing_error|system_error|weather_event|address_issue|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; Salesforce CRM — Case Object (custom root cause field)

attributes.name: service_mode
attributes.description: The transport mode or service type associated with the shipment or service failure referenced in this case. Drives routing to specialized service teams (e.g., air freight team vs. last-mile delivery team).
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; US DOT; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Management

attributes.name: sla_first_response_breached
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) First Response Breach Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the first response SLA (Service Level Agreement) target was breached for this case. True if the first_response_timestamp exceeded the sla_response_target_hours from case creation. Key KPI (Key Performance Indicator) for customer service quality reporting.
attributes.references: SLA governance; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: sla_resolution_breached
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Breach Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the resolution SLA (Service Level Agreement) target was breached for this case. True if the resolved_timestamp exceeded the sla_resolution_target_hours from case creation. Drives escalation workflows and executive service quality dashboards.
attributes.references: SLA governance; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: sla_resolution_target_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Target Hours
attributes.description: The contracted or policy-defined maximum number of hours within which the case must be fully resolved, as defined by the applicable SLA (Service Level Agreement) for this account segment and priority combination.
attributes.references: SLA (Service Level Agreement) governance; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: sla_response_target_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Target Hours
attributes.description: The contracted or policy-defined maximum number of hours within which the first agent response must be delivered to the customer, as defined by the applicable SLA (Service Level Agreement) for this account segment and priority combination.
attributes.references: SLA (Service Level Agreement) governance; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: source_system_case_code
attributes.description: The native case identifier from Salesforce CRM (e.g., Salesforce Case ID / 18-character Salesforce record ID). Retained for lineage traceability, reconciliation with the source system, and EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) integration cross-referencing.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Id); SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title of the service case as entered by the customer or agent. Used for case list views, search, and initial triage. Typically 255 characters or fewer.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Customer-facing parcel or shipment tracking number associated with this service case. Used for last-mile delivery inquiries, POD (Proof of Delivery) disputes, and express parcel service failures.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; US DOT Shipment Tracking Standards

products.name: onboarding
products.description: Tracks the end-to-end customer onboarding lifecycle from initial account creation through activation, including KYC/AML verification, credit assessment, system provisioning (TMS/WMS access, EDI setup), and training completion. Captures onboarding stage, assigned onboarding manager, checklist item statuses, go-live date, and onboarding channel (digital self-serve vs. managed). Ensures compliance with regulatory due diligence requirements.

attributes.name: onboarding_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the customer onboarding record. Primary key for the onboarding data product.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master service agreement or contract established for the customer during or prior to onboarding. Links the onboarding record to the governing commercial contract.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Customer onboarding activities (setup, training, system integration, compliance verification) incur costs that must be tracked to cost centers for customer acquisition cost (CAC) analysis and onboardi

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account being onboarded. Links the onboarding lifecycle record to the master customer entity.

attributes.name: edi_partner_id
attributes.description: The EDI interchange identifier assigned to the customer for electronic message exchange. Used as the sender/receiver qualifier in EDI transactions (e.g., ISA segment in ANSI X12 or UNB segment in EDIFACT).

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal employee or team member assigned as the primary onboarding manager responsible for guiding the customer through the onboarding lifecycle. Applicable for managed onboarding channel.

attributes.name: importer_trade_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: Customer onboarding includes trade party registration for customs purposes. Required for: importer of record setup, EORI/tax ID validation, AEO/CTPAT pre-certification checks, and ensuring customer ca

attributes.name: primary_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact. Business justification: Onboarding processes require tracking primary customer contact for implementation coordination, training scheduling, system provisioning, and go-live communication. Essential for customer onboarding w

attributes.name: rate_card_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rate and pricing profile configured for the customer in the TMS rating engine during onboarding. Determines applicable tariffs, surcharges (BAF, GRI, THC), and discount structures.
attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; Oracle TMS; Pricing and Rating Domain

attributes.name: salesforce_opportunity_id
attributes.description: External identifier from Salesforce CRM linking this onboarding record to the originating sales opportunity that triggered the onboarding process.

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Business justification: Customer onboarding requires collection and verification of KYC documents (business registration certificates, tax IDs, AEO certifications). Compliance teams must track which specific documents were s

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Logistics-specific classification of the customer account role within the supply chain. Determines applicable service offerings, EDI message sets, and regulatory compliance requirements. Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) and freight forwarder types trigger additional regulatory checks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shipper|consignee|freight_forwarder|nvocc|broker|carrier|agent — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: actual_go_live_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the customer was activated and went live on Transport Shipping systems. Compared against target_go_live_date to measure onboarding cycle time adherence and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: aml_status
attributes.description: Status of the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) screening check performed during onboarding. Includes sanctions list screening, denied party checks, and financial crime risk assessment. A flagged or rejected status blocks account activation.
attributes.references: FATF AML Guidelines; C-TPAT; Descartes Customs Denied Party Screening; WCO

attributes.name: api_integration_status
attributes.description: Status of the API integration setup for customers using direct API connectivity to Transport Shipping platforms for booking, tracking, and rate queries. Distinct from EDI for customers using REST/SOAP API channels.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the customer onboarding was initiated and managed. Distinguishes between digital self-serve (customer-led portal) and managed (assigned onboarding manager) approaches, supporting channel performance analytics.

attributes.name: checklist_completion_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of onboarding checklist items that have been completed. Provides a single numeric indicator of overall onboarding progress for dashboards and SLA monitoring. Calculated from checklist item statuses in the onboarding checklist sub-entity.

attributes.name: completed_checklist_items
attributes.description: Number of onboarding checklist items that have been marked as completed. Used alongside total_checklist_items to track onboarding progress and identify bottlenecks.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the onboarding record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail anchor for the onboarding lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: credit_assessment_status
attributes.description: Status of the credit risk assessment conducted during customer onboarding. Determines credit terms, payment conditions, and credit limit to be assigned. Conditionally approved may indicate a reduced credit limit or requirement for prepayment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Credit Management; SOX; IFRS

attributes.name: credit_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the credit limit and financial terms assigned during onboarding (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: The approved credit limit (in the account currency) assigned to the customer following credit assessment. Governs the maximum outstanding receivables balance permitted before shipment holds are triggered.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance AR; SOX; IFRS 9

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Business segment classification of the customer being onboarded. Determines the onboarding workflow, compliance requirements, and SLA entitlements applicable. Segments include B2B enterprise, B2B SME, B2C individual, 3PL/4PL partners, and government accounts.

attributes.name: customs_registration_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires customs brokerage registration and trade compliance setup as part of onboarding. Triggers Descartes Customs configuration, HS code profile setup, and AEO/C-TPAT compliance checks.
attributes.references: WCO; Descartes Customs; C-TPAT; AEO Program; US DOT

attributes.name: customs_setup_status
attributes.description: Status of the customs and trade compliance configuration in Descartes Customs for the customer. Includes denied party screening profile, tariff classification preferences, and import/export license registration.
attributes.references: WCO; Descartes Customs; C-TPAT; AEO Program; IMDG Code

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has been certified and approved to ship dangerous goods (DG) through Transport Shipping. Triggers IMDG/ICAO DG compliance checks and special handling configuration during onboarding.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA DGR; IMO

attributes.name: data_consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer provided explicit consent for data processing. Required for GDPR compliance audit trail and consent management.

attributes.name: data_processing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has provided explicit consent for processing of their personal and business data in accordance with GDPR and applicable data protection regulations. Must be TRUE before account activation.

attributes.name: edi_setup_status
attributes.description: Status of the Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) integration setup for the customer. EDI enables automated exchange of shipment orders, ASNs, invoices, and status messages between the customer's systems and Transport Shipping platforms.
attributes.references: IATA EDI Standards; UN/EDIFACT; ANSI X12; ISO 9001

attributes.name: initiation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer onboarding process was formally initiated, typically coinciding with account creation or CRM opportunity conversion. Used as the start anchor for SLA and cycle time calculations.

attributes.name: kyc_aml_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which both the Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) verification processes were successfully completed and approved for this customer onboarding.
attributes.references: FATF AML Guidelines; C-TPAT; AEO Program

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Know Your Customer (KYC) identity verification process for the customer. Mandatory regulatory due diligence step before account activation. Tracks progression from pending submission through review, approval, or rejection.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; C-TPAT; AEO Program; WCO SAFE Framework; FATF AML Guidelines

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the onboarding record. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the assigned onboarding manager. Retained for operational reference and reporting without requiring a join to the HR system.

attributes.name: on_hold_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the onboarding process has been placed on hold. Used for exception management, escalation tracking, and reporting on onboarding bottlenecks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kyc_aml_pending|credit_review|document_missing|customer_unresponsive|system_issue|legal_review|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: onboarding_status
attributes.description: Overall lifecycle status of the onboarding record, distinct from the granular stage. Indicates whether the onboarding is actively progressing, completed, paused, or terminated.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary country of business registration for the customer being onboarded. Used for regulatory jurisdiction determination, trade compliance, and AML risk profiling.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code assigned to the customer account during onboarding (e.g., NET30, NET60, COD, PREPAID). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance and governs invoice due date calculations.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally communicable reference number assigned to the onboarding case. Used in customer communications and cross-system tracking (e.g., ONB-2024-000123).

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing regulatory due diligence observations, compliance exceptions, or special conditions noted during the onboarding process. Supports audit trail requirements under C-TPAT, AEO, and GDPR accountability obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; C-TPAT; AEO Program; WCO; SOX

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for onboarding rejection or cancellation. Populated when onboarding_status is rejected or cancelled. Supports compliance audit trails and customer communication.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; C-TPAT; AEO Program; ISO 9001

attributes.name: service_scope
attributes.description: Description of the logistics service lines in scope for the customer onboarding (e.g., express parcel, air freight, ocean FCL/LCL, road FTL/LTL, warehousing, customs brokerage, e-commerce fulfillment). Determines which system modules and compliance checks are activated.
attributes.references: SAP TM; Oracle TMS; Manhattan WMS; Descartes Customs

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: The SLA tier assigned to the customer during onboarding, determining the service performance commitments, response times, and KPI targets applicable to the account. Drives SLA entitlement configuration in TMS and CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP TM; ISO 9001; SLA Management

attributes.name: stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the end-to-end customer onboarding lifecycle. Tracks progression from initial account creation through KYC/AML, credit assessment, system provisioning, training, and final activation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initiated|kyc_aml_review|credit_assessment|system_provisioning|training|go_live_pending|active|on_hold|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; C-TPAT; AEO Program

attributes.name: target_go_live_date
attributes.description: The planned date by which the customer is expected to be fully activated and operationally live on Transport Shipping systems. Used for SLA tracking and resource planning.

attributes.name: tms_provisioning_status
attributes.description: Status of the customer account provisioning in the Transportation Management System (TMS — SAP TM or Oracle TMS). Tracks whether the customer has been set up for shipment booking, freight order management, and rate access.

attributes.name: total_checklist_items
attributes.description: Total number of onboarding checklist items assigned to this customer onboarding record. Used as the denominator for checklist completion percentage and for workload tracking.

attributes.name: training_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer completed all required onboarding training modules. Used to confirm readiness for go-live and to satisfy compliance documentation requirements.

attributes.name: training_status
attributes.description: Status of the customer training program completion during onboarding. Training covers platform usage, booking procedures, compliance requirements, and service-specific processes. Waived status applies for experienced customers or self-serve digital onboarding.

attributes.name: wms_provisioning_status
attributes.description: Status of the customer account provisioning in the Warehouse Management System (WMS — Manhattan WMS). Applicable for customers requiring warehousing, distribution, or e-commerce fulfillment services.

products.name: credit_profile
products.description: Financial credit standing and payment terms for customer accounts, governing credit limit, payment terms (net 30/60/90), credit rating, credit hold status, outstanding balance thresholds, and currency of credit. Captures credit review dates, credit agency references, and approved credit limit history. Used by billing and finance domains to enforce payment controls and by operations to gate shipment release on credit-held accounts.

attributes.name: credit_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer credit profile record in the Transport Shipping lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: credit_analyst_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Credit limit decisions require assignment to credit analysts for risk assessment and approval workflow. Regulatory requirement for financial controls and audit trail in freight forwarding operations.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for which this credit profile is maintained. Links to the customer master record.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Credit profiles reference specific GL accounts (receivables control accounts) in the ledger for credit limit enforcement and exposure tracking. Credit controllers need to know which ledger account to

attributes.name: approved_credit_limit
attributes.description: The formally approved credit limit as of the most recent credit review, which may differ from the currently active credit_limit if a pending change is awaiting activation. Maintains the audit trail of the last approved value.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance – Credit Management (FD32); SOX Section 404; IFRS 9

attributes.name: available_credit
attributes.description: Remaining credit headroom calculated as credit_limit minus outstanding_balance minus open_order_exposure. Stored as a business-critical operational field (not a derived KPI) because it is directly consumed by SAP TM shipment release checks and Oracle TMS load authorization gates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance – Credit Management (FD32); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: billing_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which invoices are issued to this customer. May differ from credit_currency when the customer operates in a different functional currency. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance customer master.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Finance – Customer Master; IFRS 21 (Foreign Currency Transactions)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit profile record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail start point required for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 8601

attributes.name: credit_agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the external credit reference agency that provided the credit rating or score (e.g., Dun & Bradstreet, Experian, Equifax, Coface, Euler Hermes). Required for audit trail and credit review documentation.
attributes.references: IFRS 9; SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Finance – Credit Management

attributes.name: credit_agency_reference
attributes.description: Unique reference number or DUNS number assigned by the external credit agency for this customer. Used to cross-reference credit bureau reports and validate the source of the credit assessment.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet D-U-N-S Number Standard; IFRS 9; SOX

attributes.name: credit_control_area
attributes.description: SAP organizational unit (credit control area code) within which this customer's credit limit is managed. Defines the scope of credit monitoring and aligns with the company code structure in SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance – Credit Management (FD32); SOX

attributes.name: credit_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the credit limit, outstanding balance, and exposure amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with the customer's billing currency in SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: credit_hold_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the credit hold was most recently applied to this account. Used for aging analysis of holds and SLA tracking for hold resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance – Credit Management; SOX

attributes.name: credit_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer account is currently under a credit hold, blocking the release of new shipments and freight orders in SAP TM and Oracle TMS. True = hold active; False = no hold. Operationally critical for shipment gating.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance – Credit Management (FD32); SAP TM Shipment Release; SOX

attributes.name: credit_hold_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the credit hold was applied. Used by finance and operations teams to prioritize resolution actions and communicate with customers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: overdue_invoices|credit_limit_exceeded|payment_dispute|bankruptcy_risk|manual_hold|compliance_review|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance – Credit Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: credit_hold_released_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the most recent credit hold was lifted, allowing shipment release to resume. Null if the hold is still active. Used for hold duration analytics and finance KPI reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance – Credit Management; SOX

attributes.name: credit_insurance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer's credit exposure is covered by a trade credit insurance policy (e.g., Euler Hermes, Coface, Atradius). True = insured; False = uninsured. Affects net credit risk exposure and provisioning under IFRS 9.
attributes.references: IFRS 9; Euler Hermes / Coface Trade Credit Insurance; SOX

attributes.name: credit_insurance_policy_ref
attributes.description: Reference number of the trade credit insurance policy covering this customer's receivables. Populated only when credit_insurance_flag is True. Used for claims processing and insurer reporting.
attributes.references: Euler Hermes / Coface Trade Credit Insurance; IFRS 9; SOX

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum approved credit exposure (in the credit currency) that Transport Shipping will extend to this customer at any point in time. Enforced by SAP S/4HANA Finance credit management to gate shipment release and invoice issuance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance – Credit Management (FD32); IFRS 9; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: credit_limit_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the finance officer or credit manager who formally approved the current credit limit. Required for SOX audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Finance – Credit Management; IFRS 9

attributes.name: credit_limit_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the approved credit limit currently utilized, calculated as (outstanding_balance + open_order_exposure) / credit_limit × 100. Stored as a business-critical operational field consumed by SAP TM shipment release checks and finance dashboards — not a derived analytics KPI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance – Credit Management (FD32); SOX; IFRS 9

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: External or internal credit rating assigned to the customer, using a standardized rating scale (e.g., S&P/Moody's-aligned: AAA through D, or NR for Not Rated). Drives credit limit approval tiers and risk-based pricing decisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D|NR — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: S&P Global Ratings; Moody's Rating Scale; IFRS 9 (Expected Credit Loss); SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Numeric credit score assigned by an external credit agency or internal scoring model, typically on a scale of 0–1000 or 300–850 depending on the agency. Used alongside credit_rating for granular risk segmentation and credit limit setting.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet PAYDEX; Experian Business Credit Score; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: credit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the credit profile. 'on_hold' triggers shipment release blocks in SAP TM and Oracle TMS, preventing new freight orders from being executed until the hold is lifted by the finance team.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance – Credit Management (FD32); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: days_sales_outstanding
attributes.description: Average number of days taken by this customer to pay invoices, calculated from SAP S/4HANA Finance AR data. A key credit risk indicator stored as a business field (not a computed KPI) because it is sourced directly from the credit management system and used in credit limit decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance – Accounts Receivable; IFRS 9; SOX

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which the customer must pay to qualify for the early payment discount. Paired with early_payment_discount_pct to define the discount window.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance – Payment Terms (OBB8); IFRS 15

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered to the customer for early payment of invoices within a specified discount period (e.g., 2% if paid within 10 days). Defined in SAP S/4HANA Finance payment terms configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance – Payment Terms (OBB8); IFRS 15

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which the current credit terms (limit, payment terms, rating) became effective for this customer. Supports bi-temporal data modeling and credit history tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance – Credit Management; IFRS 9; SOX

attributes.name: effective_until
