attributes.name: partner_trading_name
attributes.description: Commercial or brand name under which the partner operates, which may differ from the legal name. Used in operational communications, shipment documentation, and customer-facing reporting.

attributes.name: partner_type
attributes.description: Classification of the logistics partner by operational role. 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) provides outsourced logistics services; 4PL (Fourth-Party Logistics) manages the entire supply chain; NVOCC (Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier) issues house bills of lading; freight_broker arranges carrier capacity; customs_broker handles trade compliance; co_loader shares container capacity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 3PL|4PL|NVOCC|freight_broker|customs_broker|co_loader — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FMC (Federal Maritime Commission) NVOCC Regulations; IATA Ground Handling Agreement

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the agreed payment terms for financial settlements with this partner (e.g., NET30, NET60, COD). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance vendor master and Coupa procurement system. Governs AP payment scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Payment Terms Configuration; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Composite performance score for the partner on a 0.00–5.00 scale, derived from KPI (Key Performance Indicator) measurements including OTD (On-Time Delivery), OTIF (On-Time In-Full), claims ratio, and SLA compliance. Updated periodically from operational data. Used for carrier/partner selection scoring in SAP TM.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IATA Ground Handling Agreement Performance Standards

attributes.name: performance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal performance review conducted for this partner relationship. Used to schedule periodic KPI assessments and SLA compliance audits per contractual obligations.

attributes.name: preferred_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the preferred settlement currency used in financial transactions with this partner (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used in SAP S/4HANA Finance for AP/AR processing and GRI (General Rate Increase) charge calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary operational contact at the partner organization. Used for shipment notifications, exception alerts, EDI setup coordination, and SLA escalation communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis for Processing)

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary operational contact person at the partner organization responsible for day-to-day coordination of logistics activities under this relationship.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: International phone number of the primary operational contact at the partner organization in E.164 format. Used for urgent shipment exception management and last-mile coordination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ITU-T E.164 International Numbering Plan

attributes.name: relationship_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the partner relationship, used in EDI communications, contract references, and partner-facing correspondence. Sourced from Salesforce CRM or SAP TM partner master.
attributes.references: EDI X12 / UN/EDIFACT Partner Identification Standards

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the partner relationship. Active indicates the partnership is operational; suspended indicates temporary halt pending resolution; terminated indicates the relationship has ended; pending indicates onboarding in progress; under_review indicates compliance or performance review is underway.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; C-TPAT Partner Vetting Requirements

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days before the effective_until_date that a renewal notice must be issued to the partner. Drives automated alerts in Salesforce CRM and Coupa procurement workflows to initiate contract renewal negotiations.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; Coupa Contract Management

attributes.name: salesforce_relationship_code
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM record identifier for this partner relationship, enabling bi-directional synchronization between the data lakehouse silver layer and the CRM system of record for opportunity tracking and service case management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Platform API; Salesforce Object Reference

attributes.name: sla_tier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the SLA (Service Level Agreement) tier applicable to this partner relationship, defining response times, transit time commitments, and escalation thresholds. Sourced from the contract and agreement domain and enforced in SAP TM charge calculation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; IATA Service Level Standards

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the partner relationship was formally terminated. Distinct from effective_until_date which is the planned expiry. Populated when relationship_status transitions to 'terminated'. Used for audit trails and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 Contract Documentation; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the termination of the partner relationship. Used for partner lifecycle analytics, compliance audit trails, and procurement risk reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: contract_expiry|performance_failure|compliance_breach|mutual_agreement|insolvency|regulatory_action — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ISO 9001 Clause 10.2 Nonconformity and Corrective Action

attributes.name: transport_modes_authorized
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited set of transport modes the partner is authorized to handle under this relationship. Aligns with IATA (air), IMO (ocean), and DOT (road/rail) regulatory frameworks. Used in SAP TM carrier selection and Oracle TMS load optimization.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Services Conference Resolutions; IMO SOLAS Convention; US DOT Regulations

products.name: lead
products.description: Prospective customer lead records sourced from Salesforce CRM representing unqualified inbound inquiries, marketing-generated prospects, and referral leads prior to account creation. Captures lead source, company name, estimated shipping volume, service interest, lead status, qualification score, assigned sales development representative, and conversion date to opportunity or account. Supports top-of-funnel commercial pipeline management.

attributes.name: lead_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the prospective customer lead record in the Transport Shipping data platform. Primary key for the lead entity.

attributes.name: assigned_sdr_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Assigned Sales Development Representative (SDR) Employee ID
attributes.description: Internal employee identifier of the Sales Development Representative (SDR) assigned to work and qualify this lead. Used for workload balancing, performance tracking, and commission attribution.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; Salesforce CRM Lead Owner; Transport Shipping Sales Operations Policy

attributes.name: converted_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM Opportunity object ID created upon lead conversion. Enables traceability from top-of-funnel lead to mid-funnel opportunity for pipeline attribution and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Opportunity Object; Transport Shipping Commercial Pipeline SOP

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account record created upon successful lead conversion. Null if the lead has not yet been converted to an account.

attributes.name: referral_network_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.network_partner. Business justification: Lead source attribution for partner referrals enables commission tracking, partner ROI analysis, and lead quality assessment by referral source. Replaces denormalized referral_partner_name with struct

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the marketing campaign that generated or influenced this lead. Used for campaign attribution, marketing ROI analysis, and multi-touch attribution modelling.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Campaign Object; Transport Shipping Marketing Attribution Framework

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the prospective company's primary business location. Used for territory management, last-mile delivery service matching, and regional sales assignment.

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.description: Legal or trading name of the prospective company associated with the lead. Represents the target organisation being pursued for a logistics services relationship prior to formal account creation.

attributes.name: conversion_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the lead was converted to an opportunity or customer account. Null if not yet converted. Used for conversion velocity analysis and sales cycle benchmarking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Conversion; Transport Shipping Sales KPI Framework

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary country of the prospective company. Used for geographic pipeline analysis, territory assignment, and cross-border service matching.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; Salesforce CRM Lead Object

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lead record was first created in Salesforce CRM and ingested into the Transport Shipping data platform. Used for lead age calculation, SLA tracking, and pipeline velocity reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Transport Shipping Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: crm_lead_code
attributes.description: External lead identifier sourced from Salesforce CRM (Lead object ID, e.g., 00Q...). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse and Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Salesforce Platform API

attributes.name: denied_party_screen_date
attributes.description: Date on which the denied party and sanctions screening was last performed for this lead. Used to determine whether a re-screen is required based on screening policy refresh intervals.
attributes.references: Descartes Customs; C-TPAT; AEO Programme; OFAC; WCO

attributes.name: denied_party_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead company and contact have been screened against denied party and sanctions lists (e.g., OFAC SDN, EU Consolidated List, UN Sanctions). True = screening completed. Required for trade compliance prior to commercial engagement.
attributes.references: Descartes Customs; C-TPAT; AEO Programme; WCO; US DOT; OFAC

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary destination country for the prospect's shipments. Used for lane analysis, import compliance pre-assessment, and last-mile service availability checks.

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead contact has opted out of or must be excluded from all sales and marketing communications. True = do not contact. Mandatory for GDPR and CAN-SPAM compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 and Article 17; CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce CRM Lead Object

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary business email address of the lead contact. Used for sales development representative (SDR) outreach, marketing automation, and lead nurturing campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Lead Object; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: estimated_annual_revenue_usd
attributes.description: Estimated annual logistics spend or revenue opportunity associated with the lead, expressed in US Dollars. Used for deal sizing, prioritisation, and pipeline value reporting. Currency is standardised to USD for global comparability.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Commercial Pipeline Policy; IFRS 15

attributes.name: estimated_monthly_shipments
attributes.description: Prospect's self-reported or SDR-estimated number of shipments per month. Used for revenue potential sizing, capacity planning discussions, and lead qualification scoring.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Lead Qualification Framework; Salesforce CRM Lead Object

attributes.name: estimated_teu_volume
attributes.description: Prospect's estimated annual ocean freight volume expressed in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEUs). Relevant for ocean freight forwarding leads; used for capacity planning and rate negotiation preparation.
attributes.references: IMO; Federal Maritime Commission (FMC); Transport Shipping Ocean Freight SOP

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: First (given) name of the primary contact person associated with the lead. Used for personalised sales outreach and CRM communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Lead Object

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Date
attributes.description: Date on which the lead contact provided GDPR consent for data processing. Used for consent lifecycle management and regulatory audit trails under GDPR Article 7.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Salesforce CRM Consent Management

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_given
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead contact has provided explicit GDPR consent for Transport Shipping to process their personal data for sales and marketing purposes. True = consent given. Required for EU/EEA leads under GDPR Article 6.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 7; Salesforce CRM Consent Management

attributes.name: incoterms_preference
attributes.description: Prospect's preferred International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) for freight transactions, indicating the desired division of risk and cost between shipper and consignee. Informs commercial proposal structuring and pricing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WTO; Transport Shipping Pricing Policy

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: Industry sector of the prospective company (e.g., retail, automotive, pharmaceuticals, e-commerce, manufacturing). Used for vertical-specific sales plays, service matching, and pipeline segmentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; NAICS Industry Classification

attributes.name: is_converted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lead has been successfully converted to a Salesforce opportunity or a Transport Shipping customer account. True = converted; False = not yet converted.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Conversion; Transport Shipping Commercial Pipeline SOP

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Professional title or role of the lead contact within their organisation (e.g., Head of Logistics, Supply Chain Director). Informs sales approach and decision-maker identification.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sales activity (call, email, meeting) logged against this lead in Salesforce CRM. Used for lead staleness detection, SDR follow-up scheduling, and pipeline hygiene reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Activity; Transport Shipping Sales Operations Policy

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the lead record in the source Salesforce CRM system. Used for incremental data ingestion, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Transport Shipping Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Last (family) name of the primary contact person associated with the lead. Combined with first_name to form the full contact identity for sales engagement.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Lead Object

attributes.name: lead_source
attributes.description: Channel or origin through which the lead was generated. Used for marketing attribution, ROI analysis, and channel effectiveness reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inbound_web|marketing_campaign|referral|trade_show|partner|cold_outbound|social_media — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Source; Transport Shipping Marketing Attribution Framework

attributes.name: lead_status
attributes.description: Current stage of the lead in the top-of-funnel commercial pipeline. Drives workflow routing, SDR task assignment, and pipeline reporting. Values: new (just created), working (SDR actively engaging), nurturing (long-term follow-up), qualified (meets ICP criteria), unqualified (disqualified), converted (promoted to opportunity or account).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Status; Transport Shipping Commercial Pipeline SOP

attributes.name: lead_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the lead by business model and relationship type. Distinguishes B2B enterprise accounts, small-to-medium enterprises (SMEs), individual B2C shippers, and third-party logistics (3PL) or fourth-party logistics (4PL) partner prospects.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Object; Transport Shipping Customer Segmentation Policy

attributes.name: next_followup_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next SDR follow-up action on this lead. Used for task management, pipeline cadence enforcement, and SDR productivity reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Task; Transport Shipping Sales Cadence Policy

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes captured by the SDR during lead qualification activities, including call summaries, prospect requirements, and contextual information not captured in structured fields. Classified confidential due to potential inclusion of commercially sensitive prospect information.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Description; Transport Shipping Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary origin country for the prospect's shipments. Used for lane analysis, customs compliance pre-assessment, and network capacity matching.

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary business phone number of the lead contact in E.164 international format. Used for direct sales calls and qualification conversations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Lead Object; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: qualification_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to qualify and score the lead (e.g., BANT — Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline; MEDDIC; SPIN; manual SDR assessment; AI-assisted scoring). Provides context for interpreting the qualification score.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Sales Qualification Framework; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: qualification_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 0–100) assigned to the lead based on qualification criteria such as budget, authority, need, and timeline (BANT). Drives prioritisation of SDR effort and pipeline forecasting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead Scoring; Transport Shipping Sales Qualification Framework

attributes.name: requires_customs_brokerage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect requires customs brokerage and trade compliance services as part of their logistics solution. True = customs brokerage required. Informs cross-sell opportunity identification and Descartes Customs onboarding pre-qualification.
attributes.references: WCO; Descartes Customs; C-TPAT; AEO Programme

attributes.name: requires_warehousing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prospect requires warehousing and distribution services (e.g., contract warehousing, distribution centre management). True = warehousing required. Informs cross-sell opportunity identification and Manhattan WMS capacity planning.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Service Catalogue; Manhattan WMS

attributes.name: sales_territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the geographic or segment-based sales territory to which this lead is assigned. Supports territory-based pipeline reporting, quota management, and SDR routing.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Sales Territory Management Policy; Salesforce CRM Territory Management

attributes.name: salesforce_owner_code
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM User ID of the record owner for this lead. Used for CRM-side ownership tracking and synchronisation with the lakehouse assigned SDR.

attributes.name: service_interest
attributes.description: Primary logistics service category the lead has expressed interest in. Drives routing to the appropriate product sales specialist and informs service-level proposal preparation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: express_parcel|freight_forwarding|supply_chain_mgmt|customs_brokerage|warehouse_distribution|ecommerce_fulfillment|last_mile|contract_logistics|cross_border — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Service Catalogue; Salesforce CRM Lead Object

attributes.name: sla_tier_interest
attributes.description: Prospect's indicated interest in a specific Service Level Agreement (SLA) tier. Used to align commercial proposals with the appropriate service tier and pricing band during the qualification process.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping SLA Framework; Salesforce CRM Lead Object

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the prospective company's primary business location. Supports sub-national territory management and regulatory jurisdiction identification.

attributes.name: transport_mode_interest
attributes.description: Preferred or required freight transport mode indicated by the lead. Informs freight forwarding product alignment (air freight, ocean freight, road, rail, or multimodal) and capacity planning discussions.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; Transport Shipping Service Catalogue

attributes.name: unqualified_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the lead was marked as unqualified. Populated when lead_status = 'unqualified'. Used for pipeline quality analysis and SDR coaching. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: no_budget|no_authority|no_need|wrong_geography|competitor_selected|no_response|duplicate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Sales Qualification Framework; Salesforce CRM Lead Object

products.name: customer_volume_commitment
products.description: Records of customer-committed shipping volume agreements specifying minimum volume thresholds (TEU, kg, shipment count) by service line, lane, or mode over a defined period. Captures committed volume, actual volume-to-date, variance, measurement period, and penalty/incentive terms for under/over-performance. Distinct from the contract domain's formal agreement — this entity tracks the operational volume performance against commitments.

attributes.name: customer_volume_commitment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer volume commitment record in the Transport Shipping lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal contract or agreement under which this volume commitment is governed. Links to the contract domain for legal terms.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Volume commitments drive revenue budgets and must be reconciled against budget targets for variance analysis and incentive/penalty calculations. Logistics companies use volume commitments to forecast

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: Volume commitments are typically carrier-specific (e.g., '50K TEU/year with Maersk on Asia-EU'). Procurement teams negotiate carrier-specific rates tied to volume; tracking actual vs. committed volume

attributes.name: crm_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM Opportunity record ID that originated or is associated with this volume commitment. Enables traceability from sales pipeline to operational commitment.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that has entered into this volume commitment agreement.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee responsible for managing this volume commitment and the customer relationship. Sourced from Workday HCM.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.lane. Business justification: Volume commitments are lane-specific contractual obligations. Required for lane capacity planning, commitment tracking, volume variance analysis, penalty/incentive calculation, and contract compliance

attributes.name: target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_target. Business justification: High-volume customer contracts include contractual sustainability targets (e.g., 'reduce carbon intensity 15% over term'), linking commercial volume commitments to measurable environmental performance

attributes.name: accrued_incentive_amount
attributes.description: Rebate or incentive amount accrued to date in the current measurement period based on current volume over-performance. Used for financial provisioning in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Expressed in currency_code.

attributes.name: accrued_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Financial penalty amount accrued to date in the current measurement period based on current volume shortfall. Used for financial provisioning in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Expressed in currency_code.

attributes.name: actual_volume_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative actual volume shipped by the customer within the current measurement period as of the last data refresh. Expressed in volume_unit. Sourced from Oracle TMS shipment execution records.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Transportation Management System; SAP TM

attributes.name: alert_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Volume attainment percentage below which a performance alert is triggered for proactive account management intervention. Typically set above the penalty threshold to allow corrective action.

attributes.name: auto_renew
attributes.description: Indicates whether this volume commitment automatically renews for the next period upon expiry without requiring a new negotiation cycle.

attributes.name: commitment_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the volume commitment agreement, e.g., 'FY2025 Asia-Pacific Ocean FCL Annual Commitment'. Used for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: commitment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or comments regarding this volume commitment, such as negotiation context, special conditions, or account manager observations.

attributes.name: commitment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this volume commitment, used in customer communications, invoices, and operational reporting. Sourced from SAP TM freight agreement numbering.

attributes.name: commitment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the volume commitment. Draft: under negotiation; Active: binding and in measurement period; Suspended: temporarily paused; Completed: measurement period ended; Cancelled: terminated before completion.

attributes.name: committed_volume
attributes.description: Minimum volume threshold the customer has contractually committed to ship within the measurement period, expressed in volume_unit. This is the baseline against which actual performance is measured.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Agreement; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this volume commitment record was first created in the system. Audit trail field aligned with SOX and GDPR data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this commitment record (penalty_cap_amount, accrued_penalty_amount, accrued_incentive_amount).

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the destination of shipments covered by this commitment. Combined with origin_country_code defines the trade lane.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this volume commitment becomes binding and volume measurement begins. Aligns with the contract period start.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP TM Transportation Management

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date on which this volume commitment expires and measurement ceases. Nullable for open-ended rolling commitments.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP TM Transportation Management

attributes.name: exclusion_conditions
attributes.description: Free-text description of conditions under which volume shortfalls are excluded from penalty assessment, such as force majeure events, port strikes, natural disasters, or regulatory embargoes.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days after the measurement period end date during which the customer may still ship volume that counts toward the commitment, before penalty assessment is finalized.

attributes.name: incentive_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial incentive or rebate clause is active for this commitment when the customer meets or exceeds the target volume.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: incentive_rate_pct
attributes.description: Rebate or discount rate applied to the qualifying volume to calculate the incentive amount. Expressed as a percentage of the contracted rate per unit.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA Finance; SAP TM

attributes.name: incentive_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Minimum volume attainment percentage at or above which the incentive or rebate clause is triggered. For example, 100.00 means incentives apply when the customer meets 100% of committed volume.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal performance review of this volume commitment with the customer. Used to track review cadence compliance.

attributes.name: load_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Load Type (Full Container Load / Less Than Container Load / Full Truckload / Less Than Truckload)
attributes.description: Shipment load type classification for this commitment. FCL (Full Container Load), LCL (Less Than Container Load), FTL (Full Truckload), LTL (Less Than Truckload), parcel, or bulk. Determines how committed volume is measured and rated.

attributes.name: measurement_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the current active measurement period. Used to determine the window for volume accumulation and variance calculation.

attributes.name: measurement_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the current active measurement period (e.g., Q1 start, month start). Distinct from effective_from_date which is the overall commitment start.

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: Frequency at which committed volume performance is measured and evaluated against thresholds. Determines the cadence for penalty and incentive calculations.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal performance review of this volume commitment with the customer.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the origin of shipments covered by this commitment. Used for lane-level volume tracking and trade compliance reporting.

attributes.name: penalty_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial penalty clause is active for this commitment when the customer fails to meet the committed volume threshold.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: penalty_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum financial penalty amount that can be charged to the customer in a single measurement period, regardless of the shortfall volume. Expressed in currency_code.

attributes.name: penalty_rate_pct
attributes.description: Rate applied to the shortfall volume to calculate the financial penalty amount. Expressed as a percentage of the contracted rate per unit.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA Finance; SAP TM

attributes.name: penalty_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Minimum volume attainment percentage below which the penalty clause is triggered. For example, 80.00 means penalties apply if the customer ships less than 80% of committed volume.

attributes.name: performance_alert_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether a volume under-performance alert has been triggered for this commitment in the current measurement period, prompting account manager intervention.

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the volume commitment performance is formally reviewed with the customer. May differ from measurement_period_type (e.g., measured monthly but reviewed quarterly).

attributes.name: rollover_shortfall_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether any volume shortfall from the current measurement period can be carried forward and offset against the next period's commitment before penalties are assessed.

attributes.name: service_line
attributes.description: Specific service product line covered by this commitment, e.g., Express Parcel, Freight Forwarding, E-Commerce Fulfillment, Contract Logistics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: express_parcel|freight_forwarding|ecommerce_fulfillment|contract_logistics|customs_brokerage|last_mile|supply_chain_mgmt — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: service_mode
attributes.description: Transport mode to which this volume commitment applies. Determines the unit of measure and applicable rate structures (e.g., ocean uses TEU, air uses kg).
attributes.references: IATA, IMO, ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Management

attributes.name: target_volume
attributes.description: Aspirational or stretch volume target above the committed minimum, used for incentive tier calculations. May equal committed_volume if no stretch tier is defined.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this volume commitment record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: volume_attainment_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of committed volume achieved to date within the measurement period (actual_volume_to_date / committed_volume * 100). Used for performance dashboards and penalty/incentive trigger evaluation.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; KPI reporting

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Volume Unit of Measure (TEU / Kilogram / Cubic Meter / Shipment Count)
attributes.description: Unit of measure used to quantify committed and actual volumes. TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit) for ocean FCL; kg for air freight; CBM (Cubic Meter) for LCL/road; shipment_count for parcel/express; ton for bulk.

attributes.name: volume_variance
attributes.description: Difference between actual_volume_to_date and committed_volume (actual minus committed). Negative value indicates under-performance; positive indicates over-performance. Expressed in volume_unit.

products.name: ecommerce_seller
products.description: Profile for e-commerce merchant customers utilizing Transport Shipping's fulfillment and last-mile delivery services. Captures marketplace platform integrations (Shopify, Amazon, eBay), seller SKU catalog size, average daily order volume, return rate, preferred fulfillment center assignments, D2D service configurations, and COD settlement preferences. Supports the e-commerce fulfillment business line with seller-specific operational parameters.

attributes.name: ecommerce_seller_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the e-commerce seller profile within Transport Shipping's fulfillment platform. Primary key for this entity. Role: MASTER_PARTY.

attributes.name: account_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Transport Shipping employee responsible for managing the seller relationship, sourced from Workday HCM. Used for account ownership reporting and escalation routing.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Management Standards; Workday HCM

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the governing commercial contract or service agreement under which the seller's fulfillment and last-mile delivery services are provided.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Contract Management Standards; IFRS 15

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent customer account record in the customer domain, linking the e-commerce seller to their enterprise account profile managed in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: primary_ecommerce_preferred_fulfillment_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the seller's primary preferred fulfillment center for inventory storage and order processing. Used by Manhattan WMS for default inbound routing and order assignment.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: E-commerce sellers are assigned to profit centers (typically e-commerce fulfillment division) for separate P&L tracking of this high-growth service line. Logistics companies report e-commerce revenue

attributes.name: rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.rate_card. Business justification: E-commerce sellers are assigned specific rate cards for fulfillment pricing (often volume-tiered or marketplace-specific). Essential for D2D/last-mile pricing, COD fee calculation, and seller billing.

attributes.name: route_delivery_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route_delivery_zone. Business justification: E-commerce sellers have defined serviceable delivery zones for coverage management. Powers seller coverage area validation, zone-based service eligibility checks, delivery promise calculation, and mar

attributes.name: shipper_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.shipper_profile. Business justification: Ecommerce sellers are operational shippers requiring link to shipper_profile for shipment origination, pickup coordination, customs documentation, and service preferences. Critical for e-commerce fulf

attributes.name: api_integration_type
attributes.description: Method by which the seller's marketplace platform is integrated with Transport Shipping's order management and fulfillment systems for automated order ingestion and status updates.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Integration Architecture Standards; EDI X12

attributes.name: asn_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the seller is required to submit an Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) prior to inbound inventory delivery to the fulfillment center. Enforced by Manhattan WMS receiving workflows.
attributes.references: Manhattan WMS Integration Standards; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: avg_daily_order_volume
attributes.description: Seller-declared or contractually agreed average number of orders processed per day. Used for fulfillment center capacity allocation, labor planning, and SLA configuration. Not a calculated metric — this is the agreed baseline figure from the seller's onboarding profile.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Fulfillment Capacity Planning Standards

attributes.name: billing_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for invoicing the seller for fulfillment and last-mile delivery services. Aligns with the seller's contract currency in SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA Finance Standards

attributes.name: cod_currency_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cash on Delivery (COD) Settlement Currency Code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for COD collection and remittance to the seller. Determines the currency in which COD amounts are collected from consignees and settled.

attributes.name: cod_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cash on Delivery (COD) Service Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Cash on Delivery (COD) payment collection is enabled for this seller's shipments. Activates COD settlement workflows and remittance reporting in the finance system.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping COD Service Standards; PCI DSS

attributes.name: cod_settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which collected Cash on Delivery (COD) amounts are remitted to the seller. Drives the COD settlement batch schedule in SAP S/4HANA Finance accounts payable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance COD Settlement Standards; PCI DSS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the e-commerce seller profile record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX Section 404; Transport Shipping Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: crm_seller_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this seller record as maintained in Salesforce CRM, used for cross-system reconciliation between the data lakehouse and the CRM system of record.

attributes.name: cross_border_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the seller is configured for cross-border shipping services, enabling customs brokerage workflows in Descartes Customs and international carrier selection in SAP TM.
attributes.references: WCO Customs Data Model; C-TPAT; AEO Program

attributes.name: customs_registration_number
attributes.description: Seller's customs registration or importer/exporter code as issued by the relevant customs authority. Required for cross-border shipment declarations processed through Descartes Customs.
attributes.references: WCO Customs Data Model; Descartes Customs Standards; C-TPAT

attributes.name: d2d_service_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the seller has Door-to-Door (D2D) end-to-end fulfillment service configured, covering pickup from seller's origin through last-mile delivery to end consumer.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping D2D Service Configuration Standards

attributes.name: denied_party_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the seller has been screened against denied party and sanctions lists via Descartes Customs. Required for cross-border shipment authorization and trade compliance.
attributes.references: Descartes Customs Standards; C-TPAT; US DOT; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: epod_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) capture is mandatory for all outbound deliveries for this seller. Drives last-mile delivery driver workflow configuration in FourKites.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping ePOD Standards; FourKites Integration Standards

attributes.name: hazmat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the seller is certified to ship hazardous materials, enabling dangerous goods handling workflows compliant with IMDG Code and ICAO Technical Instructions.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: hs_code_default
attributes.description: Default Harmonized System (HS) Code representing the seller's primary product category for customs tariff classification. Used as a fallback in Descartes Customs when SKU-level HS codes are not available.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System Nomenclature; IATA Tariff Coordination

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: Default International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code governing the transfer of risk and responsibility for the seller's cross-border shipments. Aligns with ICC Incoterms 2020 rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement

attributes.name: inventory_method
attributes.description: Inventory rotation method applied to the seller's stock in the fulfillment center. First In First Out (FIFO) and First Expired First Out (FEFO) are most common for e-commerce fulfillment in Manhattan WMS.
attributes.references: Manhattan WMS Inventory Management Standards; ISO 9001

attributes.name: kyc_verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the seller's KYC verification was last completed or renewed. Used for compliance audit trails and periodic re-verification scheduling.
attributes.references: C-TPAT; AEO Program; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: kyc_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the seller has completed Know Your Customer (KYC) verification as required for onboarding and cross-border trade compliance. Mandatory for DDP and COD service activation.
attributes.references: C-TPAT; AEO Program; GDPR Article 5; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the e-commerce seller profile record was last updated. Used for change data capture, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX Section 404; Transport Shipping Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: marketplace_platform
attributes.description: Primary e-commerce marketplace or platform through which the seller operates and from which orders are ingested into Transport Shipping's fulfillment system via API or EDI integration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shopify|amazon|ebay|woocommerce|magento|tiktok_shop|lazada|zalando|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: marketplace_seller_code
attributes.description: The seller's unique identifier as assigned by their primary marketplace platform (e.g., Amazon Seller ID, Shopify Shop ID). Used for API-based order ingestion and reconciliation.

attributes.name: offboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the e-commerce seller was offboarded or their account was closed. Null for active sellers. Used for churn analysis and contract closure reporting.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the e-commerce seller was formally onboarded onto Transport Shipping's fulfillment platform and became operationally active. Used for tenure analysis and cohort reporting.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the seller's primary country of origin for shipments. Used for customs declaration routing in Descartes Customs and lane-based pricing.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; WCO Customs Data Model; Descartes Customs Standards

attributes.name: otd_target_pct
attributes.description: Contractually agreed On-Time Delivery (OTD) target percentage for this seller's shipments. Used as the baseline for SLA compliance measurement and KPI reporting.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code applicable to the seller's invoices for fulfillment services (e.g., NET30, NET60, PREPAID). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance customer master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Payment Terms Standards; IFRS 15

attributes.name: peak_daily_order_volume
attributes.description: Seller-declared maximum daily order volume during peak periods (e.g., promotional events, holiday seasons). Used for surge capacity planning and contingency fulfillment resource allocation.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Fulfillment Capacity Planning Standards

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for operational communications with the seller, including shipment notifications, exception alerts, and settlement reports. Sourced from Salesforce CRM account contact.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary operational contact person at the seller organization, used for account management and escalation communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the seller's operational contact, formatted in E.164 international standard. Used for exception management and last-mile delivery coordination.

attributes.name: return_rate_pct
attributes.description: Seller-declared or contractually agreed return rate expressed as a percentage of total orders. Drives Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) processing capacity allocation and reverse logistics planning at fulfillment centers.

attributes.name: seller_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier assigned to the seller for use in operational systems including the Warehouse Management System (WMS), Transportation Management System (TMS), and Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) integrations.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Internal Data Standards; EDI X12

attributes.name: seller_name
attributes.description: Legal or registered trading name of the e-commerce seller as used on marketplace platforms and fulfillment agreements. Serves as the primary human-readable identity label for the seller.

attributes.name: seller_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the e-commerce seller account. Drives operational eligibility for order intake, fulfillment center assignment, and last-mile delivery service activation.

attributes.name: seller_type
attributes.description: Classification of the seller by their business model and relationship type with Transport Shipping. Determines applicable service configurations, pricing tiers, and fulfillment workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marketplace_seller|direct_brand|dropshipper|3pl_client|4pl_client|cross_border — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: service_mode
attributes.description: Default delivery service mode configured for this seller's outbound shipments, determining transit time commitments and carrier selection logic in SAP TM and Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: SAP TM Configuration Standards; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: sku_catalog_size
attributes.description: Total number of active Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) in the seller's product catalog managed within Transport Shipping's fulfillment network. Used for warehouse slotting optimization in Manhattan WMS and capacity planning.
attributes.references: Manhattan WMS Integration Standards; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: sla_tier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Service Level Agreement (SLA) tier applicable to this seller, governing On-Time Delivery (OTD) targets, exception response times, and penalty/incentive structures.

products.name: carbon_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment contract between customer_account and carbon_offset_program. It captures the commercial agreement by which a customer participates in one or more carbon offset programs to meet their sustainability commitments. Each record links one customer_account to one carbon_offset_program with attributes that define the terms of participation, allocation rules, pricing, and operational flags specific to that customer-program combination.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping's sustainability operations, customers actively enroll in multiple carbon offset programs simultaneously to diversify their sustainability portfolios, meet different certification requirements (CORSIA, CDP, SBTi), and offer flexibility in offset sourcing. Each carbon offset program serves multiple customers with individualized contractual terms, allocation percentages, pricing tiers, and operational configurations. The enrollment itself is a managed business entity with specific attributes (enrollment dates, allocation rules, minimum commitments, auto-offset flags) that belong neither to the customer account nor to the program, but to the relationship between them.

attributes.name: carbon_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer carbon offset program enrollment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: carbon_offset_program_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Carbon Enrollment - Carbon Offset Program Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the carbon offset program in which the customer is enrolled

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Carbon Enrollment - Customer Account Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer account that is enrolled in the carbon offset program

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the customer's total carbon offset portfolio allocated to this specific program. Used to diversify sustainability portfolios across multiple program types (e.g., 50% forestry, 30% renewable energy, 20% direct air capture). Sum of allocation_percentage across all active enrollments for a customer should equal 100%.

attributes.name: auto_offset_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether automatic carbon offset retirement is enabled for this customer-program enrollment. When true, Transport Shipping automatically retires offset credits from this program based on the customer's shipment emissions and allocation rules. When false, offsets are retired manually or on-demand.

attributes.name: certification_requirements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sustainability certifications or reporting frameworks that this enrollment is intended to satisfy for the customer (e.g., CORSIA, CDP, SBTi, ISO 14064). Used to ensure program selection aligns with customer compliance needs.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The expiration or termination date of the contractual agreement for this enrollment. Null indicates an open-ended or evergreen enrollment. Used to manage contract renewals and program transitions.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The effective start date of the contractual agreement between the customer and Transport Shipping for participation in this carbon offset program. May differ from enrollment_date if the contract is signed in advance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this enrollment record was created in the database.

attributes.name: customer_program_code
attributes.description: Optional customer-specific reference code or identifier for this enrollment, used for the customer's internal tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the customer was enrolled in this specific carbon offset program. Marks the start of the customer's participation in this program.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the customer's enrollment in this carbon offset program. Active indicates the enrollment is operational and offsets can be procured/retired. Suspended indicates temporary pause. Expired indicates contract_end_date has passed. Cancelled indicates customer-initiated termination.

attributes.name: last_retirement_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent carbon offset credit retirement transaction for this customer-program enrollment. Null if no retirements have occurred yet.

attributes.name: minimum_monthly_offset_tonnes
attributes.description: The minimum quantity of carbon offset credits (in tonnes CO2e) that the customer has committed to procure or retire from this program on a monthly basis. Used for capacity planning and procurement workflows.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional notes, special terms, or operational instructions specific to this customer-program enrollment.

attributes.name: pricing_tier
attributes.description: The pricing tier applicable to this customer for this specific carbon offset program. Determines the per-tonne price the customer pays, which may differ from the program's base price_per_tonne_co2e based on volume commitments or enterprise agreements. Values: Standard, Volume, Enterprise, Custom.

attributes.name: total_tonnes_retired
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of carbon offset credits (in tonnes CO2e) that have been retired from this program on behalf of this customer since enrollment. Used for sustainability reporting and customer dashboards.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this enrollment record was last modified.

products.name: customer_program_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment relationship between customer accounts and trade compliance programs. It captures the participation of a customer account in a specific compliance program (C-TPAT, AEO, ISO 28000, etc.) with program-specific enrollment dates, certification tiers, audit schedules, renewal cycles, and performance metrics. Each record links one customer account to one compliance program with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship.. Existence Justification: In the logistics industry, customer accounts (B2B shippers, 3PL partners, etc.) actively enroll in multiple trade compliance programs simultaneously across different jurisdictions (e.g., C-TPAT in the US, AEO in the EU, ISO 28000 internationally). Each enrollment is a distinct operational relationship with its own lifecycle: enrollment date, certification tier, audit schedule, renewal cycle, performance metrics, and potential suspension/revocation. The business actively manages these enrollments as distinct entities, tracking program-specific compliance obligations and benefits for each customer-program combination.

attributes.name: customer_program_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for customer_program_enrollment

attributes.name: compliance_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the compliance program in which the customer is enrolled

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer account enrolled in the compliance program

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Required audit frequency for this customer account under this specific program enrollment. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning as relationship data. Values: annual, biennial, triennial, quarterly, on_demand.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or authorization number issued to this customer account for this specific program enrollment. Different from the program-level certificate number in compliance_program.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the customer accounts certification or membership in this specific program. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning as relationship data. Values: active, pending, suspended, revoked, expired, under_review.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this enrollment record was created in the data platform.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer account was enrolled or approved for participation in this specific compliance program. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning as relationship data.

attributes.name: enrollment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing enrollment-specific details, special conditions, or historical context for this customer accounts participation in this specific program.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this customer accounts enrollment or certification in this specific program expires and requires renewal. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning as relationship data.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance audit conducted for this customer account under this specific program enrollment.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance audit for this customer account under this specific program enrollment.

attributes.name: performance_score
attributes.description: Quantitative performance or compliance score assigned to this customer account for this specific program enrollment, used to track program-specific performance metrics as mentioned in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: program_enrollment_reference
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer account compliance program enrollment record

attributes.name: program_tier
attributes.description: The tier or level of certification achieved by this customer account within this specific program (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3 for C-TPAT; different programs have different tier structures). Explicitly identified in detection reasoning as relationship data.

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the renewal or recertification process for this customer accounts enrollment in this specific program. Values: not_due, pending_submission, submitted, approved, rejected, overdue.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or narrative explaining why this customer accounts enrollment in this specific program was suspended or revoked, if applicable. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning as relationship data. Null for active enrollments.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this enrollment record was last updated in the data platform.

products.name: customer_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the operational allocation agreement between a customer account and a fulfillment center. It captures the business rules governing which customers can use which fulfillment centers, including service commitments, volume agreements, routing priorities, and pricing terms. Each record links one customer account to one fulfillment center with attributes that exist only in the context of this allocation relationship.. Existence Justification: In e-commerce fulfillment operations, customer accounts routinely use multiple fulfillment centers for geographic coverage, inventory distribution, and redundancy, while each fulfillment center serves multiple customer accounts. The business actively manages these allocation relationships with specific operational parameters: routing priority rules determine which center fulfills which orders, volume commitments govern capacity planning, customer-specific SLA terms define service expectations, and negotiated pricing varies by customer-center combination. This is not a derived analytical correlation but an operational business entity that fulfillment planners and account managers create, update, and query daily for order routing, capacity management, and billing purposes.

attributes.name: customer_allocation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for customer_allocation

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the user who created this allocation record, typically a fulfillment operations planner or account manager.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer account that is allocated to use this fulfillment center

attributes.name: fulfillment_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the fulfillment center that is allocated to serve this customer account

attributes.name: last_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the user who most recently modified this allocation record.

attributes.name: allocation_reference
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this customer-fulfillment center allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this allocation. Active allocations are used for order routing; suspended allocations are temporarily disabled; expired allocations are past their effective_until_date; pending allocations are not yet effective.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the cost_per_unit is denominated.

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Negotiated cost per unit (or per order) for fulfillment services provided by this center to this customer. Pricing may vary by customer tier, volume commitment, and facility type.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation record was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this customer-fulfillment center allocation becomes active and can be used for order routing and fulfillment operations.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this customer-fulfillment center allocation expires or is terminated. Null indicates an open-ended allocation with no planned end date.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this allocation record.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for this allocation when a customer has multiple fulfillment centers available. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for order routing. Used by order management system to determine optimal fulfillment location.

attributes.name: service_level_agreement
attributes.description: Service level agreement terms specific to this customer-fulfillment center allocation, defining committed processing times, shipping cutoffs, and delivery performance targets for orders fulfilled from this center for this customer.

attributes.name: volume_commitment
attributes.description: Contractual volume commitment (in units or orders per period) that the customer has agreed to route through this fulfillment center. Used for capacity planning and pricing tier determination.

products.name: sustainability_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation contract between customer_account and sustainability_initiative. It captures the formal partnership arrangement where enterprise customers co-invest in or pilot green logistics initiatives. Each record links one customer_account to one sustainability_initiative with attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship, including commitment levels, co-investment amounts, expected benefits, and participation status.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping's green logistics program, large enterprise customers (B2B shippers, 3PL partners) actively participate in multiple sustainability initiatives as co-investors, pilot participants, or strategic partners. Each initiative (fleet electrification, SAF adoption, packaging optimization) has multiple customer participants. The business manages these participation agreements as formal partnerships with individual commitment levels, co-investment amounts, benefit-sharing terms, and reporting obligations.

attributes.name: sustainability_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer sustainability participation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Sustainability Participation - Customer Account Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer account participating in the sustainability initiative

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Sustainability Participation - Sustainability Initiative Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sustainability initiative in which the customer is participating

attributes.name: account_manager_notes

attributes.name: benefit_sharing_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the initiative's total CO2e reduction or cost savings that is attributed to this customer for their ESG reporting and carbon accounting purposes

attributes.name: co_investment_amount
attributes.description: Financial contribution amount committed or paid by the customer toward the sustainability initiative CAPEX or OPEX

attributes.name: co_investment_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the co-investment amount

attributes.name: commitment_level
attributes.description: Classification of the customer's level of engagement in the sustainability initiative: pilot (trial participant), partner (operational participant), co-investor (financial contributor), sponsor (strategic funder)

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number of the legal contract or partnership agreement governing this customer's participation in the sustainability initiative

attributes.name: expected_benefit_tco2e
attributes.description: Estimated annual CO2 equivalent emissions reduction (in metric tonnes) that the customer expects to achieve through participation in this initiative, used for customer-specific ESG reporting

attributes.name: participation_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer formally joined or committed to participate in the sustainability initiative

attributes.name: participation_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer's participation in the sustainability initiative ended or is planned to end. Null for ongoing participations.

attributes.name: participation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer's active participation in the sustainability initiative commenced

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the customer's participation in the sustainability initiative: active (currently participating), suspended (temporarily paused), completed (participation ended successfully), withdrawn (customer exited early)

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Agreed frequency at which sustainability performance updates and benefit realization reports are provided to the participating customer

products.name: account_team_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment relationship between customer accounts and employees who serve on the account team. It captures the multi-person coverage model where customer accounts are managed by teams of employees in different roles (account manager, sales engineer, operations coordinator, customer service rep, credit analyst). Each record links one customer account to one employee with role, tenure, authorization level, and primary contact designation that exist only in the context of this assignment.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping logistics operations, large customer accounts are managed by multi-person account teams rather than single points of contact. A customer account has multiple employees serving in different roles (account manager, sales engineer, operations coordinator, customer service reps, credit analyst, customs broker), and each employee covers multiple customer accounts in their portfolio. The business actively manages these team assignments with role designations, authorization levels, effective dates, and primary contact flags.

attributes.name: account_team_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this account team assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: customer_account_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer account being covered by this team assignment

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the employee assigned to this account team role

attributes.name: assignment_status

attributes.name: authorization_level
attributes.description: Level of authorization this employee has for actions on this customer account (pricing approvals, credit holds, service exceptions, etc.)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this assignment record was created in the data platform.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date when this employee was assigned to this account team role. Used for tracking assignment history and tenure.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date when this employee assignment ended or will end. Null for active assignments. Used for tracking assignment history and transitions.

attributes.name: primary_contact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this employee is the primary point of contact for this customer account. Used for routing inquiries and escalations.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Type of relationship or touchpoint between the employee and customer account. Identifies the nature of the business interaction.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Specific role the employee plays on this account team (Primary account owner, Secondary support, Backup coverage, Technical specialist, etc.)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: zone_service_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the negotiated service-level contract between customer_account and delivery_zone. It captures zone-specific service commitments, pricing overrides, and surcharge waivers that enterprise customers negotiate for specific geographic zones. Each record links one customer_account to one delivery_zone with contractual terms that exist only in the context of this customer-zone relationship.. Existence Justification: Enterprise logistics customers negotiate zone-specific service level agreements that override standard zone characteristics. A single customer account has custom terms (surcharge waivers, guaranteed transit times, rate discounts) for multiple delivery zones based on their shipping volume and strategic importance. Each delivery zone serves multiple customers, each with their own negotiated terms. This is an operational contract management process, not an analytical correlation.

products.name: zone_rate
products.description: This association product represents the negotiated rate and service agreement between a customer account and a delivery zone. It captures customer-specific pricing, surcharges, service levels, and coverage terms for last-mile delivery within each zone. Each record links one customer_account to one route_delivery_zone with pricing and service attributes that exist only in the context of this customer-zone relationship. This is the SSOT for zone-based pricing calculations, service promise validation, and customer-specific surcharge applicability used by rating engines, fulfillment systems, and customer service.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, enterprise customers negotiate zone-specific rates and service levels across multiple delivery zones based on their shipping volume and geographic footprint. Each customer-zone combination has unique pricing (zone_rate), surcharge waivers, guaranteed transit times, and service level commitments that cannot be stored on either the customer account (which has many zones) or the delivery zone (which serves many customers with different rates). This is an operational contract management entity actively maintained by account managers and pricing teams.

products.name: opportunity_team_member
products.description: This association product represents the role-based participation of employees in sales opportunities. It captures the multi-disciplinary team structure required to pursue, qualify, and close complex logistics deals. Each record links one opportunity to one employee with their specific role, contribution level, and commission allocation. Supports deal team management, workload balancing, and commission calculation.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping's sales operations, complex logistics opportunities require multi-disciplinary teams including account executives, sales engineers, solution architects, pricing analysts, legal counsel, and operations specialists. A single opportunity involves multiple employees in different roles working concurrently, and each employee works multiple opportunities simultaneously. The business actively manages these 'Opportunity Teams' or 'Deal Teams' with specific role assignments, effort allocation, and commission splits.

domains.name: freight
domains.description: Manages freight forwarding operations and order lifecycle across air, ocean, road, and rail modes including FTL, LTL, FCL, LCL, and TEU-based container movements. Owns freight bookings, consolidations, load plans, carrier assignments, NVOCC arrangements, intermodal transfers, CFS and ICD operations, and mode-specific charge components such as BAF, GRI, and THC. Integrates with SAP TM and Oracle TMS.

products.name: freight_order

Captures the full order lifecycle from booking acceptance through final delivery, including mode type (FTL, LTL, FCL, LCL), service level, origin/destination locations, commodity details, weight, volume (CBM), dimensional weight, incoterms reference, special handling requirements, and current order status. Acts as the primary anchor entity linking transport documents, charges, milestones, and exceptions. Sourced from SAP TM freight order management module.

attributes.references: IATA Special Handling Codes; IMO IMDG Code; SAP TM

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Temperature control requirement for the shipment. Applicable for pharmaceutical, perishable, and cold-chain freight. Drives equipment selection, carrier qualification, and GDP (Good Distribution Practice) compliance.
attributes.references: IATA CEIV Pharma; WHO GDP Guidelines; SAP TM

attributes.name: teu_count
attributes.description: Number of TEUs (Twenty-foot Equivalent Units) allocated to this freight order for ocean container movements. Applicable for FCL and LCL ocean shipments. Used for vessel capacity planning, GRI application, and port statistics reporting.

attributes.name: total_order_amount
