attributes.description: Total billable amount for this freight order including base freight charges, all surcharges, and applicable taxes. Represents the net total for invoicing and revenue recognition. Equals freight_charge_amount plus total_surcharge_amount plus applicable taxes.
attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS 15; SOX

attributes.name: total_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate of all applicable surcharges for this freight order including BAF (Bunker Adjustment Factor), GRI (General Rate Increase), THC (Terminal Handling Charge), fuel surcharge, and security surcharge. Stored as a total to support charge breakdown analysis.
attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; Oracle TMS Freight Audit; IMO; IATA

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transport for this freight order. Determines applicable regulatory frameworks (IATA for air, IMO for ocean), charge components (BAF, GRI, THC for ocean; fuel surcharge for air), and documentation requirements (AWB for air, BOL for ocean).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the freight order record in the source system. Used for change detection, incremental loads, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volume of the shipment in cubic meters (CBM). Used alongside gross weight for dimensional weight (DIM weight) calculation, LCL rating, and container utilization planning.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; SAP TM Charge Calculation

products.name: booking
products.description: Transactional record of a freight booking request submitted by a shipper or freight forwarder. Captures booking reference number, requested pickup and delivery dates, ETD, ETA, carrier nomination, space reservation confirmation, booking channel (EDI, API, manual), booking status, and acceptance/rejection details. Represents the commercial commitment to move cargo before a freight order is fully executed. Integrates with Oracle TMS shipment execution module.

attributes.name: booking_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the freight booking record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the booking data product.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Bookings reference customer agreements for rate validation and capacity allocation. Business process: contract rate lookup at booking time, volume commitment tracking, service level verification again

attributes.name: ams_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.ams_filing. Business justification: Air/ocean bookings require AMS (Automated Manifest System) filing for CBP advance screening. Links booking to manifest filing for hold resolution and cargo release coordination.

attributes.name: booking_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the network node entity representing the pickup or origin point for this booking (e.g., shipper warehouse, Container Freight Station (CFS), Inland Container Depot (ICD), or airport/seaport terminal).

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the nominated carrier (airline, ocean carrier, trucking company, or rail operator) assigned to execute this booking. Populated upon carrier nomination or space reservation confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP TM Carrier Selection Module; Oracle TMS Shipment Execution

attributes.name: carrier_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier_service. Business justification: Bookings reference specific carrier service offerings (e.g., Maersk AE7 weekly string, Lufthansa express flight service) with defined schedules and transit times. Sales and operations teams book capac

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Bookings represent revenue commitments and must be assigned to legal entity for accrual accounting, revenue forecasting, and financial planning. Essential when bookings are made across multiple legal

attributes.name: consignee_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consignee profile entity representing the party designated to receive the cargo at the destination.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Identifies employee who created booking. Essential for sales commission tracking, customer service accountability, and booking quality metrics. Standard practice in logistics to track booking originat

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account (shipper or freight forwarder) that submitted this booking request. Supports PARTY_REFERENCE requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: customer_carbon_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.customer_carbon_report. Business justification: Booking-level carbon estimates feed into customer carbon reports for forward-looking emissions forecasting and proactive carbon management in customer sustainability planning.

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.declaration. Business justification: Bookings for international shipments require pre-clearance customs declarations in many jurisdictions. Links booking to advance filing requirements and enables customs status visibility during space c

attributes.name: destination_node_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the network node entity representing the delivery or destination point for this booking (e.g., consignee warehouse, CFS, ICD, or airport/seaport terminal).

attributes.name: document_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_package. Business justification: Bookings accumulate document packages during pre-shipment phase. Operational workflow to track customer document submission status before cargo acceptance - prevents shipment delays due to missing doc

attributes.name: freight_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.freight_order. Business justification: A booking is a freight forwarding request that, when confirmed, generates a freight_order. This FK tracks the quote-to-order conversion lifecycle. Nullable until booking is confirmed and order is crea

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.order. Business justification: Pre-booking freight capacity for known e-commerce order volumes in integrated supply chains. Real business process: merchants book freight space in advance for anticipated fulfillment orders, enabling

attributes.name: isf_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.isf_filing. Business justification: Ocean bookings to USA require ISF (Importer Security Filing) 24 hours before vessel loading. Direct link enables compliance verification, penalty avoidance, and automated filing status tracking.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Reference to the route lane entity defining the origin-destination corridor for this booking. Used for rate lookup, capacity planning, and SLA determination.

attributes.name: origin_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to warehouse.facility. Business justification: Bookings for LCL/air cargo often originate from warehouse consolidation facilities (CFS). Tracking origin_facility_id enables facility-level capacity planning, dwell time analysis, and cargo handoff r

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.freight_quote. Business justification: A booking may be created based on a freight quote. This FK tracks the quote-to-booking lineage. Nullable for direct bookings not based on a quote. No reverse FK exists, no bidirectional violation.

attributes.name: request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_request. Business justification: Bookings generate document requests to customers for required shipping documents (commercial invoice, packing list, certificates). Pre-shipment operational workflow to ensure document completeness bef

attributes.name: shipment_carbon_footprint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.shipment_carbon_footprint. Business justification: Bookings generate estimated carbon footprint at quote/booking stage for customer decision-making on green service tiers and carbon-neutral shipping product selection before order execution.

attributes.name: shipper_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipper profile entity capturing the party responsible for tendering the cargo for transport. Distinct from the billing customer account.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.transport_asset. Business justification: Bookings reserve capacity on specific transport assets (aircraft, vessels). Required for asset capacity planning, schedule optimization, and booking-to-execution reconciliation. Standard capacity mana

attributes.name: booking_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world event timestamp recording when the booking request was formally submitted by the shipper or freight forwarder. Distinct from system audit timestamps. Used for SLA measurement and capacity allocation.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Shipment Execution Module; IATA Cargo Standards

attributes.name: booking_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the freight booking. Tracks progression from initial submission through carrier confirmation or rejection to execution. 'executed' indicates a freight order has been raised against this booking.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Shipment Execution Module; SAP TM Freight Order Management

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this booking was cancelled by the shipper or operations team. Null if the booking has not been cancelled. Used for cancellation fee assessment, capacity release, and booking lifecycle analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Shipment Execution Module; SAP S/4HANA Finance Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description provided when a booking is cancelled. Used for root cause analysis, carrier penalty assessment, and demand forecasting model calibration in Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Shipment Execution Module; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: cargo_description
attributes.description: General description of the goods to be transported as declared by the shipper. Used for customs pre-screening, dangerous goods assessment, and carrier acceptance checks. Aligns with commodity description fields in AWB and BOL documents.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System; IATA Cargo Standards; IMO IMDG Code; US CBP AMS/ISF Requirements

attributes.name: carrier_booking_ref
attributes.description: The booking confirmation reference number issued by the carrier upon space reservation acceptance. For ocean shipments this is the carrier's booking number; for air it may be the airline's booking code. Used for cross-referencing with carrier systems.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Freight Audit; IATA Cargo Standards; FMC Regulations

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the booking request was submitted. Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) and Application Programming Interface (API) indicate automated integrations; web_portal and manual indicate human-initiated entries. Used for channel analytics and SLA differentiation.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Shipment Execution Module; IATA EDI Standards (CARGO-IMP)

attributes.name: chargeable_weight_kg
attributes.description: The weight basis used for freight charge calculation, being the higher of actual gross weight and Dimensional Weight (DIM weight). Calculated per IATA volumetric conversion factor for air freight or carrier-specific rules for other modes.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Standards; SAP TM Charge Calculation; Oracle TMS Freight Audit

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: ISO container type code for ocean freight bookings (e.g., 20GP = 20-foot General Purpose, 40HC = 40-foot High Cube, 20RF = 20-foot Refrigerated). Null for non-ocean or non-containerized shipments. Drives Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit (TEU) calculation and Terminal Handling Charge (THC) assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 20GP|40GP|40HC|45HC|20RF|40RF|20OT|40OT — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 668 Container Type Codes; IMO SOLAS Convention; FMC Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this booking record was first persisted in the system of record. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and SOX compliance reporting.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the estimated freight charge and surcharge amounts on this booking (e.g., USD, EUR, SGD). Required for multi-currency financial reporting under IFRS.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS Financial Reporting Standards; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: dangerous_goods
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cargo contains dangerous goods or hazardous materials requiring special handling, documentation, and regulatory compliance. True triggers IMDG Code compliance checks for ocean, ICAO Technical Instructions for air, and ADR for road transport.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR); US DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: estimated_freight_charge
attributes.description: Estimated base freight charge for this booking in the billing currency, calculated at time of booking based on applicable rate tariff, chargeable weight, and lane. Excludes surcharges (BAF, GRI, THC). Used for shipper quotation and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; Oracle TMS Freight Audit; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: eta
attributes.description: Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) — the planned arrival timestamp of the vessel, aircraft, truck, or train at the destination port or terminal. Used for consignee notification, customs pre-arrival filing, and delivery scheduling.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Standards; IMO FAL Convention; FourKites Predictive ETA; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: etd
attributes.description: Estimated Time of Departure (ETD) — the planned departure timestamp of the vessel, aircraft, truck, or train carrying this booking's cargo from the origin port or terminal. Used for schedule coordination, documentation cutoff management, and carrier slot reservation.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Standards; IMO FAL Convention; Oracle TMS Shipment Execution

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Indicates who is responsible for paying the freight charges: prepaid (shipper pays), collect (consignee pays), or third_party (a nominated third party pays). Drives accounts receivable routing and invoice generation in SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; SAP S/4HANA Finance AR Module; IATA Cargo Standards

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the cargo in kilograms as declared by the shipper at time of booking. Used for freight charge calculation, carrier capacity planning, and dangerous goods compliance. Basis for chargeable weight comparison against DIM weight.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Standards; IMO SOLAS VGM Requirements; Oracle TMS Load Optimization

attributes.name: hawb_number
attributes.description: House Air Waybill (HAWB) number issued by the freight forwarder or NVOCC for air freight consolidations. Issued under the MAWB when Transport Shipping acts as consolidator. Null for direct carrier bookings or non-air modes.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Standards; IATA Resolution 600b; US CBP AMS Requirements

attributes.name: hbl_number
attributes.description: House Bill of Lading (HBL) number issued by the freight forwarder or NVOCC for ocean LCL consolidations or NVOCC arrangements. Issued under the MBL. Null for FCL direct carrier bookings or non-ocean modes.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; FMC NVOCC Regulations; US CBP ISF Requirements

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System (HS) Code assigned to the primary commodity in this booking per the World Customs Organization (WCO) classification. Used for customs duty calculation, trade compliance screening, and export/import licensing checks via Descartes Customs.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System Nomenclature; US CBP Tariff Schedule; Descartes Global Trade Management

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) agreed between buyer and seller governing the transfer of risk, cost responsibility, and delivery obligations. Determines freight charge allocation (prepaid vs collect), insurance responsibility, and customs clearance party. Published by the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement; Descartes Customs Compliance

attributes.name: mawb_number
attributes.description: Master Air Waybill (MAWB) number issued by the airline or ground handling agent for air freight bookings. Follows IATA 3-digit airline prefix plus 8-digit serial number format. Null for non-air transport modes. Used for cargo tracking and customs filing.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Standards; IATA Resolution 600a; US CBP AMS Requirements

attributes.name: mbl_number
attributes.description: Master Bill of Lading (MBL) number issued by the ocean carrier for ocean freight bookings. Serves as the primary transport document and title of goods for ocean shipments. Null for non-ocean transport modes.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; FMC Regulations; US CBP ISF Requirements; UCP 600 (Documentary Credits)

attributes.name: nvocc_arrangement
attributes.business_glossary_term: Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) Arrangement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this booking is executed under a Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) arrangement, where Transport Shipping acts as a carrier to the shipper but contracts with an actual vessel operator. Relevant for FMC tariff filing and House Bill of Lading (HBL) issuance.
attributes.references: FMC NVOCC Regulations; 46 USC Chapter 405; SAP TM Freight Order Management

attributes.name: piece_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual pieces, packages, or handling units included in this booking. Used for cargo receipt verification, load planning, and Proof of Delivery (POD) reconciliation.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Standards; Oracle TMS Shipment Execution; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric booking reference number assigned at the time of booking submission. Communicated to the shipper and used across EDI, API, and manual channels for tracking and correspondence. Maps to Oracle TMS booking reference field.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Shipment Execution Module; IATA Cargo Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided when a booking is rejected by the carrier or internal operations team. Populated only when booking_status is 'rejected'. Used for exception management and carrier performance analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Shipment Execution Module; SAP TM Freight Order Management

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the shipper requests cargo to be delivered to the consignee at the destination. Basis for SLA commitment and On-Time Delivery (OTD) performance measurement.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Shipment Execution Module; SAP TM SLA Management

attributes.name: requested_pickup_date
attributes.description: The date on which the shipper requests cargo to be collected from the origin location. Used for capacity planning, driver/vehicle scheduling, and SLA commitment calculation.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Shipment Execution Module; SAP TM Route Planning

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the freight service requested. For road: Full Truckload (FTL) or Less Than Truckload (LTL). For ocean: Full Container Load (FCL) or Less Than Container Load (LCL). For air: express, standard, or economy. Drives pricing, capacity allocation, and consolidation logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FTL|LTL|FCL|LCL|express|standard|economy|charter|bulk|breakbulk — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; Oracle TMS Load Optimization; IATA Cargo Standards; FMC Regulations

attributes.name: space_confirmation_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the carrier confirmed space reservation for this booking. Null if space has not yet been confirmed. Used for SLA tracking and booking lead-time analytics.

attributes.name: space_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has confirmed space reservation for this booking. True when the carrier has issued a booking confirmation; False when the booking is pending carrier acceptance or has been rejected.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Shipment Execution Module; IATA Cargo Standards

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special handling, stowage, or operational instructions provided by the shipper at time of booking (e.g., fragile, keep upright, top-load only, no stacking). Communicated to warehouse and carrier operations teams.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Shipment Execution Module; IATA Cargo Standards

attributes.name: temp_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable temperature in degrees Celsius for temperature-controlled cargo. Null when temperature_controlled is False. Used for reefer container set-point configuration and cold chain compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: IATA Perishable Cargo Regulations; GDP Guidelines (WHO); ISO 23412 Cold Chain

attributes.name: temp_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable temperature in degrees Celsius for temperature-controlled cargo. Null when temperature_controlled is False. Used for reefer container set-point configuration and cold chain compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: IATA Perishable Cargo Regulations; GDP Guidelines (WHO); ISO 23412 Cold Chain

attributes.name: temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this booking requires temperature-controlled (reefer/cold chain) transport and storage. True triggers assignment of refrigerated containers (RF) or temperature-controlled vehicles and monitoring requirements.
attributes.references: IATA Perishable Cargo Regulations; GDP Guidelines (WHO); Oracle TMS Shipment Execution

attributes.name: teu_count
attributes.description: Number of Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEUs) represented by this booking. A 20-foot container = 1 TEU; a 40-foot container = 2 TEUs. Used for ocean capacity planning, vessel utilization reporting, and GRI/BAF charge calculation.
attributes.references: IMO Container Standards; FMC Regulations; SAP TM Charge Calculation

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transport for this freight booking. Determines applicable regulatory frameworks (IATA for air, IMO for ocean), charge components (BAF for ocean, fuel surcharge for air), and document requirements (AWB for air, BOL for ocean).
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Standards; IMO SOLAS Convention; US DOT Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this booking record was most recently modified in the system of record. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volume of the cargo in Cubic Meters (CBM) as declared by the shipper. Used for Dimensional Weight (DIM weight) calculation, container utilization planning, and LCL consolidation rating.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Standards; Oracle TMS Load Optimization; SAP TM Charge Calculation

products.name: air_waybill
products.description: Master document for air freight shipments serving as the contract of carriage between shipper and airline/freight forwarder. Stores MAWB and HAWB numbers, IATA airline codes, origin and destination airport codes, flight details, commodity description, HS codes, declared value, chargeable weight, freight charges, special handling codes (e.g., DGR, PER, VAL), and consignee/shipper details. Governed by IATA regulations. Sourced from SAP TM air freight module.

attributes.name: air_waybill_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the air waybill record in the Transport Shipping data platform. Primary key for the air_waybill product in the freight domain.

attributes.name: ams_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.ams_filing. Business justification: Air waybills drive AMS filing requirements for air cargo. Direct link enables manifest accuracy verification, CBP hold tracking, and automated filing reconciliation.

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.carrier_agreement. Business justification: Air waybills execute under carrier agreements governing air freight rates and liability. Business process: carrier rate application, liability limit enforcement, operational SLA tracking for air trans

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.declaration. Business justification: Air waybills are the transport document for customs declarations in air freight. Links AWB to entry filing, duty assessment, and customs release for delivery authorization.

attributes.name: freight_audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.freight_audit. Business justification: Air waybills are audited against carrier invoices for AWB-specific charge validation. AWB-to-audit link enables air freight rate compliance verification and accessorial charge validation.

attributes.name: freight_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.freight_order. Business justification: An air waybill is the master transport document for air freight shipments, serving as the execution document for a freight order (air mode). One AWB documents one freight order. No reverse FK exists,

attributes.name: green_shipment_certificate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.green_shipment_certificate. Business justification: Air waybills commonly receive green certificates when SAF (Sustainable Aviation Fuel) or carbon offsets are applied, supporting CORSIA compliance and customer green logistics programs.

attributes.name: handling_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to warehouse.facility. Business justification: Air cargo AWBs often pass through warehouse facilities for break-bulk, customs clearance, and final-mile staging. Tracking handling_facility_id enables facility-level AWB volume reporting, dwell time

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Air waybills represent completed air freight services requiring customer invoicing. AWB-to-invoice link enables service document reconciliation with billing, critical for freight audit and dispute res

attributes.name: primary_air_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipper (exporter/sender) party account responsible for tendering the cargo. Links to the shipper profile in the customer domain. Represents the PARTY_REFERENCE for this transaction.

attributes.name: shipment_carbon_footprint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.shipment_carbon_footprint. Business justification: Air shipments require specific carbon footprint calculations for CORSIA compliance reporting, customer carbon reports, and SAF (Sustainable Aviation Fuel) allocation tracking in aviation sustainabilit

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.transport_asset. Business justification: Air waybills document cargo transported on specific aircraft (modeled as transport_assets). Required for flight manifest reconciliation, aircraft utilization analysis, and cargo-to-flight traceability

attributes.name: actual_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time the cargo arrived at the destination airport. Used for OTD (On-Time Delivery) KPI calculation, SLA compliance reporting, and claims assessment.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Tracking and Tracing; ISO 9001

attributes.name: awb_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the air waybill. DRAFT: document being prepared; ISSUED: AWB formally issued and accepted by carrier; ACCEPTED: cargo accepted at origin; IN_TRANSIT: cargo in movement; ARRIVED: cargo arrived at destination airport; DELIVERED: cargo delivered to consignee; CANCELLED: AWB voided. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|ISSUED|ACCEPTED|IN_TRANSIT|ARRIVED|DELIVERED|CANCELLED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Tracking and Tracing; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: awb_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents a Master Air Waybill (MAWB) issued by the airline, a House Air Waybill (HAWB) issued by the freight forwarder, or a DIRECT AWB for a single-shipper direct airline shipment.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Full legal or trade name of the airline carrier responsible for transporting the cargo (e.g., Emirates SkyCargo, Lufthansa Cargo AG). Denormalized from the carrier master for operational reporting and document generation.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Airline Coding Directory

attributes.name: chargeable_weight_kg
attributes.description: The weight used for freight charge calculation, being the higher of the actual gross weight and the dimensional (DIM) weight. Calculated per IATA volumetric factor (typically 1:6000 cm³/kg for air freight). Core field for revenue calculation.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Rate Construction Manual

attributes.name: charges_collect_or_prepaid
attributes.description: Indicates whether freight charges are to be paid by the shipper at origin (PREPAID) or by the consignee at destination (COLLECT). Determines billing party and accounts receivable assignment.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Air Waybill Handbook

attributes.name: commodity_description
attributes.description: Plain-language description of the goods being shipped as declared by the shipper on the AWB (e.g., 'Electronic Components', 'Pharmaceutical Products'). Required for customs clearance, dangerous goods assessment, and cargo acceptance.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; WCO Data Model; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the air waybill record was first created in the source system (SAP TM). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this AWB are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, AED). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and CASS settlement.

attributes.name: declared_value_for_carriage
attributes.description: The value of the shipment declared by the shipper for the purpose of determining the carrier's liability in case of loss or damage. May be 'NVD' (No Value Declared) in which case this field is null. Governs maximum liability per IATA conditions of contract.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; Montreal Convention 1999; IATA Conditions of Contract

attributes.name: declared_value_for_customs
attributes.description: The customs value of the shipment declared by the shipper for import duty and tax assessment at the destination country. Used by Descartes Customs for duty calculation and customs entry filing.
attributes.references: WCO Customs Valuation Agreement; WTO Agreement on Customs Valuation; Descartes Customs GTM

attributes.name: destination_airport_code
attributes.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for the final destination airport where the cargo is to be delivered to the consignee (e.g., LAX, SIN, LHR). Used for routing, customs filing, and rate determination.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Coding Directory; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: eta
attributes.description: Estimated date and time of arrival of the carrying aircraft at the destination airport. Used for consignee notification, customs pre-arrival filing, and OTD performance measurement. Updated dynamically from FourKites.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform

attributes.name: etd
attributes.description: Estimated date and time of departure of the carrying aircraft from the origin airport. Used for shipment tracking, customer notifications, and SLA monitoring via FourKites.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform

attributes.name: first_transit_airport_code
attributes.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for the first intermediate transit/transfer point in the routing, if applicable. Null for direct flights. Used for multi-leg routing documentation on the AWB.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Air Waybill Handbook

attributes.name: flight_date
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date of the primary carrying flight. Used for booking confirmation, capacity planning, and ETD/ETA calculations.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: The IATA flight designator code for the primary carrying flight (e.g., EK9301, LH8400). Used for shipment tracking, flight manifest reconciliation, and on-time performance reporting.

attributes.name: freight_charge_amount
attributes.description: Total base freight charge for the shipment calculated as chargeable weight multiplied by the rate per kg, in the billing currency. Represents the primary revenue line for the air freight service. Used for revenue recognition per IFRS 15.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA Finance Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total actual gross weight of the shipment in kilograms as declared by the shipper, including packaging and pallets. Used for load planning, aircraft weight and balance, and freight charge calculation.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; ICAO Annex 18; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: hawb_number
attributes.description: The House Air Waybill number issued by the freight forwarder or NVOCC to the individual shipper when consolidating multiple shipments under a single MAWB. Null when the AWB is a direct shipment not consolidated under a master. Sourced from SAP TM air freight module.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Cargo Services Conference Resolutions Manual

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: The Harmonized System commodity classification code assigned to the cargo, used for customs tariff determination, trade statistics, and import/export compliance. Minimum 6 digits per WCO standard; may be extended to 8 or 10 digits for national tariff schedules.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System Convention; Descartes Customs GTM; WTO

attributes.name: iata_airline_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Airline Numeric Code
attributes.description: The 3-digit IATA numeric airline prefix code identifying the issuing carrier (e.g., 176 for Emirates, 057 for Lufthansa Cargo). Forms the first segment of the MAWB number and identifies the contracting airline.
attributes.references: IATA Airline Coding Directory; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: The ICC Incoterms 2020 code defining the division of costs, risks, and responsibilities between shipper and consignee (e.g., EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP). Determines freight charge responsibility and customs clearance obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WCO Data Model; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: is_dangerous_goods
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the shipment contains dangerous goods as classified under IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR) and ICAO Technical Instructions. When true, additional DGR documentation and handling procedures are mandatory.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR); ICAO Technical Instructions for the Safe Transport of Dangerous Goods by Air; IMDG Code

attributes.name: isf_filing_number
attributes.description: The US Customs and Border Protection Importer Security Filing (ISF, also known as 10+2) reference number. Required for ocean and air cargo imports into the United States for advance security screening.
attributes.references: US CBP ISF Regulations (19 CFR 149); C-TPAT; US DOT

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the air waybill was formally issued and signed, representing the principal business event timestamp for this contract of carriage. Corresponds to the execution date of the freight contract between shipper and carrier.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Air Waybill Handbook

attributes.name: issue_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the air waybill was issued in SAP TM. Provides sub-day precision for operational sequencing and SLA measurement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; SAP TM Air Freight Module

attributes.name: mawb_number
attributes.description: The Master Air Waybill number issued by the airline or ground handling agent, formatted as the 3-digit IATA airline prefix followed by an 8-digit serial number (e.g., 176-12345678). Serves as the primary contract of carriage between the shipper and the airline. Sourced from SAP TM air freight module.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Air Waybill Handbook

attributes.name: notify_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the party to be notified upon arrival of the cargo at the destination airport, typically the customs broker or local agent. May differ from the consignee. Required for customs and airline notification purposes.

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for the airport of departure where the cargo is tendered to the airline (e.g., DXB, FRA, JFK). Used for routing, rate determination, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Coding Directory; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the goods were manufactured or produced. Required for customs declarations, preferential tariff determination, and trade compliance screening.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; WCO Rules of Origin; Descartes Customs GTM

attributes.name: other_charges_amount
attributes.description: Total of all ancillary charges beyond the base freight charge, including fuel surcharges, security surcharges, terminal handling charges (THC), and special handling fees. Aggregated from the charges breakdown for billing purposes.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Cargo Accounts Settlement Systems (CASS)

attributes.name: pieces_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual pieces, packages, or handling units included in this shipment as declared on the AWB. Used for cargo acceptance, loading, and delivery verification.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Air Waybill Handbook

attributes.name: pod_signatory_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who signed for receipt of the cargo at delivery, as captured on the electronic or paper proof of delivery (ePOD). Used for delivery confirmation and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Tracking and Tracing; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: pod_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cargo was confirmed as delivered to the consignee and proof of delivery (POD) was captured. Used for OTD measurement, SLA compliance, and triggering final invoice settlement.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Tracking and Tracing; ISO 9001; FourKites ePOD

attributes.name: rate_class
attributes.description: IATA rate class code indicating the type of rate applied to this shipment (e.g., N=Normal, Q=Quantity, M=Minimum, B=Basic, C=Specific Commodity, E=Express, R=Reduced, S=Surcharge, U=Unit Load Device, X=Express). Determines the applicable tariff structure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: N|Q|M|B|C|E|R|S|U|X — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Tariff Coordinating Conference Resolutions; IATA Rate Construction Manual

attributes.name: rate_per_kg
attributes.description: The agreed freight rate applied per kilogram of chargeable weight for this shipment, in the billing currency. Commercially sensitive pricing data used for revenue recognition and freight audit.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Rate Construction Manual; IFRS 15

attributes.name: second_transit_airport_code
attributes.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for the second intermediate transit/transfer point in the routing, if applicable. Null for direct or single-transit flights. Supports complex multi-leg air freight routing.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Air Waybill Handbook

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The service level or product type for this air freight shipment (e.g., EXPRESS for next-flight-out priority, STANDARD for regular scheduled service, DEFERRED for economy/consolidation, CHARTER for full aircraft charter, COURIER for express parcel). Determines SLA commitments and pricing tier.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; SAP TM Air Freight Module

attributes.name: special_handling_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA Special Handling Codes (SHC) applicable to this shipment (e.g., DGR=Dangerous Goods, PER=Perishables, VAL=Valuables, HUM=Human Remains, AVI=Live Animals, COL=Cold Chain). Drives handling instructions, storage requirements, and regulatory compliance checks.
attributes.references: IATA Special Handling Codes; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; IATA Live Animals Regulations; IATA Perishable Cargo Regulations

attributes.name: total_charge_amount
attributes.description: Grand total of all charges on the AWB including base freight charge and all other charges (surcharges, fees, taxes). Represents the total amount due from the shipper or consignee. Used for invoice generation and accounts receivable.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA CASS; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: The 4-digit United Nations identification number for dangerous goods (e.g., UN1263 for paint, UN3480 for lithium ion batteries). Mandatory when is_dangerous_goods is true. Used for emergency response, handling, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; ICAO Technical Instructions; UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the air waybill record in the source system. Used for change detection, incremental loads, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volumetric measurement of the shipment in cubic meters (CBM). Used to calculate dimensional weight (DIM weight) and determine the chargeable weight when volume weight exceeds actual weight.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Rate Construction Manual

products.name: bill_of_lading
products.description: Master document for ocean freight shipments serving as the contract of carriage, receipt of goods, and document of title. Stores MBL and HBL numbers, vessel name, voyage number, port of loading (POL), port of discharge (POD), place of delivery, container numbers, seal numbers, commodity description, number of packages, gross weight, CBM, freight terms (prepaid/collect), and NVOCC details. Governed by FMC and IMO regulations. Sourced from SAP TM ocean freight module.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the bill of lading record in the Transport Shipping lakehouse. Primary key for the bill_of_lading data product. TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: carbon_offset_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_offset_transaction. Business justification: Ocean freight carbon offset purchases are linked to specific BOLs for customer carbon-neutral shipping programs and voluntary emissions reduction initiatives in maritime logistics.

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.carrier_agreement. Business justification: Bills of lading execute under ocean carrier master agreements. Business process: contracted ocean freight rate application, carrier liability terms enforcement, service commitment verification for oce

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the NVOCC or freight forwarder acting as the contractual carrier on the house bill of lading. The NVOCC issues the HBL to the shipper and holds the MBL from the ocean carrier. Relevant for FMC-regulated NVOCC arrangements.
attributes.references: FMC 46 CFR Part 515; Shipping Act of 1984 (US); FIATA

attributes.name: consignee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consignee (importer/receiver) party to whom the cargo is consigned. Links to the consignee_profile in the customer domain.
attributes.references: FMC 46 CFR Part 515; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: container_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.container_unit. Business justification: Bills of lading document cargo in specific containers. Fundamental ocean freight relationship for container tracking, cargo accountability, and container utilization. Replaces denormalized container_n

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.declaration. Business justification: Bills of lading are the primary transport document referenced in ocean customs declarations. Links BOL to entry filing for duty calculation and cargo release.

attributes.name: freight_audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.freight_audit. Business justification: Ocean BOLs are audited for rate compliance and container/weight-based charge validation. BOL-to-audit link supports ocean freight audit process and THC/BAF/GRI verification.

attributes.name: freight_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.freight_order. Business justification: A bill of lading is the master transport document for ocean freight shipments, serving as the execution document for a freight order (ocean mode). One BOL documents one freight order. No reverse FK ex

attributes.name: green_shipment_certificate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.green_shipment_certificate. Business justification: Ocean BOLs receive green certificates for carbon-neutral shipping programs, providing customers with verified proof of emissions offsetting for Scope 3 Category 4 reporting.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Ocean freight BOLs trigger customer invoicing upon service completion. BOL-to-invoice link is essential for ocean freight billing reconciliation and supports proof-of-service validation in billing dis

attributes.name: isf_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.isf_filing. Business justification: BOL numbers are mandatory ISF filing data elements. Direct link enables ISF compliance verification, amendment tracking, and penalty risk management for ocean shipments.

attributes.name: shipment_carbon_footprint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.shipment_carbon_footprint. Business justification: Ocean freight carbon footprinting per BOL is required for customer ESG disclosure, Scope 3 Category 4 emissions tracking, and IMO/EU MRV regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: shipper_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipper (exporter/consignor) party responsible for tendering the cargo. Links to the shipper_profile in the customer domain. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE minimum category.
attributes.references: FMC 46 CFR Part 515; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: trade_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party to be notified upon arrival of the vessel at the port of discharge. Typically the customs broker or freight forwarder. Links to the customer domain.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_date
attributes.description: Actual date the vessel arrived at the port of discharge. Used for transit time calculation, demurrage and detention computation, customs import filing, and on-time delivery (OTD) KPI reporting.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; FMC 46 CFR Part 515; SAP TM

attributes.name: actual_departure_date
attributes.description: Actual date the vessel departed from the port of loading. Used for transit time calculation, carrier performance measurement, and customs export record finalization.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; FMC 46 CFR Part 515; SAP TM

attributes.name: ams_filing_number
attributes.description: US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Automated Manifest System (AMS) filing reference number. Required for all ocean shipments destined for or transiting through US ports. Must be filed 24 hours prior to vessel loading under the 24-Hour Advance Manifest Rule.
attributes.references: AMS 19 CFR 4.7; CBP 24-Hour Advance Manifest Rule; C-TPAT Program

attributes.name: bol_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the bill of lading document. Draft indicates pre-issuance; issued means the original has been released to the shipper; released indicates cargo release authorized; surrendered means original returned to carrier; amended reflects post-issuance corrections; cancelled indicates the BOL is void. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS minimum category.
attributes.references: FMC 46 CFR Part 515; FIATA BOL Standard; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: bol_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bill of lading indicating whether it is a master (MBL), house (HBL), seaway, straight (non-negotiable), to-order (negotiable), or surrendered BOL. Determines negotiability and title transfer rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: master|house|seaway|straight|order|surrender — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: FMC 46 CFR Part 515; IMO FAL Convention; UCP 600 (ICC)

attributes.name: carrier_scac
attributes.description: Four-letter Standard Carrier Alpha Code (SCAC) identifying the ocean carrier (vessel operating common carrier) that issued the master bill of lading. Used for AMS filing, EDI transactions, and carrier performance tracking.
attributes.references: NMFTA SCAC Directory; AMS 19 CFR 4.7; FMC 46 CFR Part 515

attributes.name: commodity_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the goods as declared by the shipper on the bill of lading. Must accurately describe the nature of the cargo for customs classification, dangerous goods identification, and cargo insurance purposes. Carrier may use 'Said to Contain' (STC) qualifier.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; WCO Harmonized System; IMDG Code; Hague-Visby Rules Article III

attributes.name: container_count
attributes.description: Total number of containers covered by this bill of lading. Used for capacity planning, terminal handling charge (THC) calculation, and TEU-based reporting.
attributes.references: FMC 46 CFR Part 515; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the bill of lading record was first created in the SAP TM ocean freight module and ingested into the Transport Shipping lakehouse silver layer. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED minimum category.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP TM; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Confidentiality)

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the cargo is destined. Used for import customs declarations, denied party screening, and trade compliance checks via Descartes Customs.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; WCO Harmonized System; Descartes Global Trade Management

attributes.name: eta
attributes.description: Estimated date and time the vessel is scheduled to arrive at the port of discharge. Used for consignee notification, customs pre-arrival filing, port berth planning, and on-time delivery (OTD) performance measurement. Updated dynamically via FourKites predictive ETA.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; SAP TM; FourKites Real-Time Visibility; AMS 19 CFR 4.7

attributes.name: etd
attributes.description: Estimated date and time the vessel is scheduled to depart from the port of loading. Used for cargo cut-off planning, shipper notification, and SLA monitoring. Sourced from SAP TM ocean freight module and updated via FourKites real-time visibility.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; SAP TM; FourKites Real-Time Visibility

attributes.name: freight_amount
attributes.description: Base ocean freight charge amount as stated on the bill of lading, before surcharges. Expressed in the currency indicated by freight_currency_code. Used for freight invoice reconciliation, revenue recognition in SAP S/4HANA Finance, and freight audit in Oracle TMS. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET minimum category (base amount component).
attributes.references: FMC 46 CFR Part 515; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Finance; Oracle TMS Freight Audit

attributes.name: freight_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the freight charges are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY). Required for multi-currency freight invoice processing and foreign exchange revaluation in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET minimum category (currency code component).
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 21 (Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates); SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: freight_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Total surcharge amount applied to the base freight, including Bunker Adjustment Factor (BAF), General Rate Increase (GRI), Terminal Handling Charge (THC), and other accessorial charges. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET minimum category (adjustment component).
attributes.references: FMC 46 CFR Part 515; SAP TM Charge Calculation; Oracle TMS Freight Audit

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Indicates who is responsible for paying the ocean freight charges: prepaid (shipper pays), collect (consignee pays), or third party (a nominated third party pays). Drives accounts receivable and accounts payable processing in SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: FMC 46 CFR Part 515; FIATA BOL Standard; SAP TM Charge Calculation

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the cargo including packaging, as declared by the shipper, expressed in kilograms. Used for vessel stability calculations, freight charge computation, customs declarations, and dangerous goods compliance under IMDG Code.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter VI; IMDG Code; Hague-Visby Rules; FMC 46 CFR Part 515

attributes.name: hbl_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier issued by the NVOCC or freight forwarder to the shipper for the house bill of lading. Represents the contract of carriage between the forwarder and the shipper. Distinct from the MBL number issued by the ocean carrier.
attributes.references: FMC 46 CFR Part 515; FIATA BOL Standard

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System commodity classification code for the primary commodity on this bill of lading. Minimum 6 digits at international level; may be extended to 8 or 10 digits for national tariff schedules. Used for customs duty calculation, trade statistics, and export control screening.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System Convention; WTO Customs Valuation Agreement; Descartes Customs GTM

attributes.name: imdg_class
attributes.description: IMDG hazard class of the dangerous goods (e.g., Class 1 Explosives, Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Class 6.1 Toxic Substances). Populated only when is_hazardous is true. Drives stowage segregation, emergency procedures, and port authority notifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1|2|3|4|5|6|7|8|9 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IMDG Code (IMO); SOLAS Chapter VII; US DOT 49 CFR 172

attributes.name: imo_number
attributes.description: Unique 7-digit IMO vessel identification number assigned by IHS Markit on behalf of IMO. Provides a permanent, globally unique identifier for the vessel independent of name changes or flag changes. Used for regulatory compliance and vessel tracking.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.1078(28); SOLAS Chapter XI-1 Regulation 3

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: ICC Incoterms 2020 code defining the division of costs, risks, and responsibilities between the shipper and consignee. Determines freight payment obligations, insurance responsibility, and customs clearance duties. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; UCP 600 (ICC); WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement

attributes.name: is_hazardous
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the cargo contains dangerous goods as classified under the IMDG Code. When true, additional IMDG declarations, special stowage requirements, and emergency response information are mandatory.
attributes.references: IMDG Code (IMO); SOLAS Chapter VII; 49 CFR (US DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations)

attributes.name: is_negotiable
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the bill of lading is negotiable (to-order) or non-negotiable (straight/waybill). A negotiable BOL serves as a document of title and can be transferred by endorsement; a non-negotiable BOL cannot be used to transfer title.
attributes.references: UCP 600 Article 20 (ICC); Hague-Visby Rules; FMC 46 CFR Part 515

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bill of lading was officially issued by the carrier or NVOCC. This is the principal real-world business event date for the BOL document and is used for letter of credit compliance, customs filing deadlines, and freight payment terms. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP minimum category.
attributes.references: UCP 600 Article 20 (ICC); FMC 46 CFR Part 515; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: mbl_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier issued by the ocean carrier (vessel operating common carrier) for the master bill of lading. Serves as the primary contract of carriage reference between the carrier and the NVOCC or freight forwarder. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER minimum category.
attributes.references: FMC 46 CFR Part 515; IMO FAL Convention; FIATA BOL Standard

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the cargo originates. Used for customs declarations, trade compliance screening, rules of origin determination, and preferential tariff eligibility.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; WCO Harmonized System; WTO Rules of Origin Agreement

attributes.name: original_bol_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Number of Original Bills of Lading
attributes.description: Number of original signed copies of the bill of lading issued to the shipper (typically 3). All originals must be surrendered to the carrier for cargo release when the BOL is negotiable. Used for document control and letter of credit compliance.
attributes.references: UCP 600 Article 20 (ICC); Hague-Visby Rules; FIATA BOL Standard

attributes.name: package_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual packages, pieces, or units of cargo covered by this bill of lading as declared by the shipper. Used for cargo receipt verification, customs declarations, and cargo claims assessment.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; Hague-Visby Rules Article III; FMC 46 CFR Part 515

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Description of the type of packaging used for the cargo (e.g., cartons, pallets, drums, crates, bags). Used for cargo handling instructions, stowage planning, and customs declarations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: carton|pallet|drum|crate|bag|bundle|roll|cylinder — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UN/EDIFACT UNECE Recommendation 21 (Package Type Codes); IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: place_of_delivery
attributes.description: Final destination where the carrier delivers the cargo to the consignee, which may differ from the port of discharge (e.g., an inland CFS, ICD, or door delivery address). Defines the end of the carrier's responsibility under the contract of carriage.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; FIATA BOL Standard; Hague-Visby Rules

attributes.name: place_of_issue
attributes.description: City and country where the bill of lading was issued by the carrier or NVOCC. Required for letter of credit compliance and legal jurisdiction determination in case of disputes.
attributes.references: UCP 600 Article 20 (ICC); FMC 46 CFR Part 515; FIATA BOL Standard

attributes.name: place_of_receipt
attributes.description: Location where the carrier takes custody of the cargo, which may differ from the port of loading (e.g., an inland container depot (ICD) or container freight station (CFS)). Defines the start of the carrier's responsibility under the contract of carriage.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; FIATA BOL Standard; Hague-Visby Rules

attributes.name: port_of_discharge
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the port where the cargo is discharged from the ocean vessel. Represents the destination port for the ocean leg. Used for customs import filing, terminal handling charge (THC) calculation, and delivery planning.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (UNECE Recommendation 16); IMO FAL Convention; AMS 19 CFR 4.7

attributes.name: port_of_loading
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the port where the cargo is loaded onto the ocean vessel. Represents the origin port for the ocean leg of the shipment. Used for freight rate calculation, customs export filing, and carrier scheduling.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (UNECE Recommendation 16); IMO FAL Convention; FMC 46 CFR Part 515

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ocean freight service: Full Container Load (FCL), Less than Container Load (LCL), Roll-on/Roll-off (RORO), bulk, or break-bulk. Determines container allocation, consolidation requirements, and applicable tariff structures.
attributes.references: FMC 46 CFR Part 515; IMO FAL Convention; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: shipper_reference
attributes.description: Shipper's own internal reference number or purchase order number associated with this shipment. Printed on the bill of lading for cross-referencing with the shipper's ERP or order management system. Facilitates EDI reconciliation.
attributes.references: FIATA BOL Standard; EDI X12 315/322; UN/EDIFACT IFTMIN

attributes.name: teu_count
attributes.description: Total number of Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEUs) represented by the containers on this bill of lading. A 20-foot container = 1 TEU; a 40-foot container = 2 TEUs. Used for vessel capacity utilization, port statistics, and freight revenue reporting.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; FMC 46 CFR Part 515; ISO 668 (Container Dimensions)

attributes.name: total_freight_amount
attributes.description: Total freight charges payable as stated on the bill of lading, being the sum of the base freight amount and all applicable surcharges. Used for freight invoice generation, letter of credit compliance, and revenue reporting. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET minimum category (net total component).
attributes.references: FMC 46 CFR Part 515; IFRS 15; UCP 600 Article 20 (ICC); SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN number identifying the specific dangerous substance or article as assigned by the UN Committee of Experts on the Transport of Dangerous Goods. Populated only when is_hazardous is true. Required on shipping documents and package markings.
attributes.references: IMDG Code (IMO); UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods; US DOT 49 CFR 172

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the bill of lading record was last modified in the source system or the lakehouse. Used for incremental data loading, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED minimum category.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP TM; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Confidentiality)

attributes.name: vessel_name
attributes.description: Name of the ocean-going vessel (ship) carrying the cargo as recorded on the bill of lading. Used for shipment tracking, customs filing (AMS/ISF), and port authority notifications.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Convention; AMS 19 CFR 4.7; ISF 19 CFR 149

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volume of the cargo expressed in cubic meters (CBM). Used for LCL freight rate calculation, container utilization assessment, and dimensional weight (DIM weight) comparison for rating purposes.
attributes.references: FMC 46 CFR Part 515; FIATA BOL Standard; SAP TM Charge Calculation

attributes.name: voyage_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned voyage or trip number identifying the specific sailing of the vessel. Combined with vessel name, uniquely identifies the ocean leg for scheduling, tracking, and customs manifest filing purposes.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; AMS 19 CFR 4.7; IMDG Code

products.name: consolidation
products.description: Represents an LCL or groupage consolidation where multiple shippers' cargo is grouped into a single FCL container or air ULD for cost-efficient transport. Captures consolidation reference, mode (ocean LCL, air groupage), origin and destination CFS facilities, consolidation status, cargo cut-off date/time, departure date, total CBM utilized, total weight, number of constituent shipments, and assigned carrier. Central to NVOCC co-loading operations and CFS management workflows.

attributes.name: consolidation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the consolidation. Primary key for the consolidation entity.

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.carrier_agreement. Business justification: Consolidations operate under carrier master agreements for capacity and rates. Business process: contracted consolidation rate application, capacity utilization tracking against carrier commitments, N

attributes.name: consolidation_carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the ocean carrier, airline, or surface carrier assigned to transport the consolidation. For NVOCC operations, this is the underlying vessel or flight operator.
attributes.references: FMC NVOCC Regulations, IATA Cargo Agency Program

attributes.name: consolidation_nvocc_operator_carrier_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) Operator Identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the NVOCC or freight forwarder operating the consolidation. For direct carrier consolidations, this may be null.
attributes.references: FMC NVOCC Licensing Requirements, Ocean Shipping Reform Act

attributes.name: container_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.container_unit. Business justification: Ocean consolidations are stuffed into specific containers. Critical for container-level consolidation tracking and CFS operations. Replaces denormalized container_number string with proper FK to conta

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Consolidation operations (CFS handling, groupage services) incur direct labor, facility, and equipment costs that must be allocated to specific cost centers for operational cost management and service

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.declaration. Business justification: Consolidated shipments require master customs declarations covering all house shipments. Links consolidation to entry filing for deconsolidation authorization and duty assessment.

attributes.name: destination_cfs_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Destination Container Freight Station (CFS) Facility Identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the destination CFS or ICD facility where the consolidation will be deconsolidated and cargo distributed. Links to warehouse or facility master data.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework, C-TPAT Security Criteria

attributes.name: document_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_package. Business justification: Consolidations require complete document packages for deconsolidation and customs clearance. NVOCC operational requirement to maintain consolidated documentation set for all shipments within the conso

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.lane. Business justification: Consolidations are planned and executed on specific contracted lanes between origin and destination ports. Master routing decisions, carrier selection, transit time commitments, and cost allocation al

attributes.name: origin_cfs_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Origin Container Freight Station (CFS) Facility Identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the origin CFS or ICD facility where cargo is received and consolidated. Links to warehouse or facility master data.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework, C-TPAT Security Criteria

attributes.name: origin_hub_gateway_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.hub_gateway. Business justification: Consolidations are built at specific hub/gateway facilities (CFS, container terminals, air cargo terminals). Operations track which hub handled consolidation for dwell time analysis, handling cost all

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Identifier of a co-loading partner sharing space in this consolidation. Null if no co-loading arrangement exists.
attributes.references: NVOCC Co-Loading Agreements, FMC Service Contract Requirements

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Consolidation services are often separate profit centers or contribute to specific segment P&L. Required for segment reporting, service line profitability analysis, and strategic decisions on consolid

attributes.name: rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.rate_card. Business justification: Consolidation services (LCL, groupage) are priced using specialized consolidation rate cards. Rate_card_id links the consolidation to the applicable rate card, enables consolidation pricing validation

attributes.name: saf_procurement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.saf_procurement. Business justification: SAF (Sustainable Aviation Fuel) procurement is allocated to specific air consolidations for CORSIA compliance, customer green product delivery, and book-and-claim certificate tracking in aviation.

attributes.name: trade_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.trade_document. Business justification: Consolidations require consolidated trade documentation (manifests, consolidated invoices) for customs clearance. NVOCC regulatory requirement for presenting unified trade documentation at destination

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.transport_asset. Business justification: Consolidations are transported on specific assets (aircraft for air consolidations, trucks for LCL). Essential for consolidation execution tracking, asset utilization, and operational coordination. St

attributes.name: actual_arrival_datetime
attributes.description: Actual arrival date and time when the carrier arrived at the destination port.
attributes.references: IATA Flight Operations, IMO Port State Control

attributes.name: actual_departure_datetime
attributes.description: Actual departure date and time when the carrier departed the origin port. ETD (Estimated Time of Departure) becomes actual once confirmed.
attributes.references: IATA Flight Operations, IMO Ship Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: cargo_cutoff_datetime
attributes.description: Latest date and time by which cargo must be received at the origin CFS facility to be included in this consolidation.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Operations Manual, Ocean Carrier Service Contracts

attributes.name: carrier_booking_reference
attributes.description: Booking or reservation number provided by the carrier for the consolidation space allocation.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Services Conference, IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: consolidation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consolidation from planning through deconsolidation at destination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|booking_open|cargo_receiving|closed|departed|in_transit|arrived|deconsolidated — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: consolidation_type
attributes.description: Type of consolidation based on transport mode. Ocean LCL (Less Than Container Load) groups multiple shippers cargo into a single FCL container. Air groupage consolidates shipments into a single ULD (Unit Load Device). Road and rail groupage combine multiple LTL shipments.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Services Conference Resolutions, IMO Container Conventions

attributes.name: container_size_type
attributes.description: ISO container size and type code for ocean consolidations. 20GP = 20-foot General Purpose, 40GP = 40-foot General Purpose, 40HC = 40-foot High Cube, 45HC = 45-foot High Cube. Null for non-containerized modes.

attributes.name: contains_dangerous_goods
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consolidation contains any dangerous goods (hazardous materials) requiring special handling and documentation per IMDG or IATA DGR.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: contains_temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consolidation contains temperature-sensitive cargo requiring reefer container or climate-controlled handling.
attributes.references: IATA Perishable Cargo Regulations, IMO Reefer Container Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the consolidation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deconsolidation_complete_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when all cargo was deconsolidated and available for onward delivery or pickup.
attributes.references: CFS Operations Best Practices, Manhattan WMS Process Standards

attributes.name: deconsolidation_start_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when deconsolidation operations began at the destination CFS facility.
attributes.references: CFS Operations Best Practices, Manhattan WMS Process Standards

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_datetime
attributes.description: Estimated arrival date and time at the destination port. Updated based on carrier tracking and real-time visibility data.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Tracking, IMO Ship Reporting Systems, FourKites Visibility Standards

attributes.name: freight_charge_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for freight charges (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: Incoterms 2020 rule governing the transfer of costs and risks between shipper and consignee for the consolidation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the consolidation record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes and special instructions for the consolidation, including handling requirements, stowage instructions, or exception documentation.
attributes.references: CFS Operations Manual, IATA Cargo Handling Manual

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number for the consolidation, used in operational communications and documentation.

attributes.name: scheduled_departure_datetime
attributes.description: Scheduled departure date and time of the carrier vessel, flight, or vehicle transporting the consolidation from origin port.
attributes.references: IATA Flight Schedules, IMO Ship Reporting Systems

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Service level commitment for the consolidation, determining transit time and handling priority.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Service Levels, Ocean Carrier Service Contracts

attributes.name: total_chargeable_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total chargeable weight for the consolidation, calculated as the greater of gross weight or volumetric weight (volume * dimensional weight factor). Used for freight charge calculation.

attributes.name: total_freight_charge_amount
attributes.description: Total freight charges for the consolidation, including base ocean or air freight, BAF (Bunker Adjustment Factor), GRI (General Rate Increase), THC (Terminal Handling Charge), and other surcharges.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Tariffs, Ocean Carrier Service Contracts, FMC Tariff Filing Requirements

attributes.name: total_gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of all cargo in the consolidation, measured in kilograms.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a, IMO SOLAS Verified Gross Mass Requirements

attributes.name: total_piece_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual pieces or packages across all shipments in the consolidation.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Services Conference, IMO Cargo Stowage and Securing Code

attributes.name: total_shipment_count
