attributes.description: Number of individual shipper shipments (house shipments) consolidated into this master consolidation.
attributes.references: NVOCC Best Practices, IATA Cargo Operations Manual

attributes.name: total_volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volume of all cargo in the consolidation, measured in cubic meters. Critical for LCL and air groupage space utilization.
attributes.references: IATA Volumetric Weight Standards, Ocean Freight Measurement Standards

attributes.name: uld_number
attributes.description: IATA ULD identifier for air groupage consolidations. Format: 3-letter ULD type code + 5-digit serial + 2-letter owner code. Null for non-air consolidations.

attributes.name: utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of container or ULD capacity utilized by the consolidation, calculated as (actual volume / maximum capacity) * 100. Key metric for consolidation efficiency.
attributes.references: Freight Forwarding Best Practices, NVOCC Operations KPIs

products.name: load_plan
products.description: Operational plan defining how cargo is loaded onto a transport unit (vessel, aircraft, truck, railcar). Captures load plan reference, transport unit identifier, planned vs actual load sequence, cargo placement instructions, weight distribution, center of gravity calculations, hazmat segregation requirements, load status, and planner details. Integrates with Oracle TMS load optimization module. Critical for FTL road and ocean vessel operations.

attributes.name: load_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the load plan record. Primary key.

attributes.name: air_waybill_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.air_waybill. Business justification: For air freight, a load plan defines how cargo is loaded onto an aircraft or ULD, and references the air waybill. One load_plan for one AWB. Nullable when load plan is for ocean or other modes.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.bill_of_lading. Business justification: For ocean freight, a load plan defines how cargo is loaded into a container or vessel, and references the bill of lading. One load_plan for one BOL. Nullable when load plan is for air or other modes.

attributes.name: consolidation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.consolidation. Business justification: A load plan can be created for a consolidation (defining how consolidated cargo is loaded into a container or ULD). One load_plan for one consolidation. This is an alternative to load_plan → freight_o

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Load planning operations are performed by specific cost centers (planning teams, facilities). Labor and system costs must be allocated to cost centers for operational efficiency analysis and cost cent

attributes.name: freight_manifest_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shipment.freight_manifest. Business justification: Load plan is the pre-execution planning artifact; freight manifest is the actual executed load. In real operations, approved load plans are executed as manifests. Enables plan-to-execution traceabilit

attributes.name: freight_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent freight order for which this load plan is created. Links to the freight order entity.

attributes.name: primary_load_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or system user who created or approved the load plan. Links to workforce/user management system.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to warehouse.storage_location. Business justification: Load plans specify staging locations within warehouses where cargo is assembled before container/vehicle loading. Tracking staging_location_id enables warehouse space utilization analysis, load sequen

attributes.name: tertiary_load_planner_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the transport unit (vessel, aircraft, truck, railcar, container) onto which cargo is being loaded. May be vessel IMO number, aircraft registration, truck license plate, or container number.
attributes.references: IMO Ship Identification Number Scheme, IATA Aircraft Registration

attributes.name: actual_load_completion_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when loading operations were completed. Critical for on-time performance tracking and operational efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: actual_load_start_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when loading operations commenced. Used for performance measurement and variance analysis against planned time.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the load plan was formally approved for execution. Marks transition from planning to operational phase.

attributes.name: cargo_placement_instructions
attributes.description: Detailed instructions for cargo placement within the transport unit, including stacking rules, orientation requirements, and securing methods.
attributes.references: IMO Cargo Stowage and Securing Code

attributes.name: center_of_gravity_x
attributes.description: Calculated X-coordinate of the load center of gravity relative to transport unit reference point. Critical for vessel and aircraft stability.
attributes.references: IMO Cargo Stowage and Securing Code, IATA Load Planning Manual

attributes.name: center_of_gravity_y
attributes.description: Calculated Y-coordinate of the load center of gravity relative to transport unit reference point. Critical for vessel and aircraft stability.
attributes.references: IMO Cargo Stowage and Securing Code, IATA Load Planning Manual

attributes.name: center_of_gravity_z
attributes.description: Calculated Z-coordinate (vertical) of the load center of gravity relative to transport unit reference point. Critical for vessel and aircraft stability.
attributes.references: IMO Cargo Stowage and Securing Code, IATA Load Planning Manual

attributes.name: contains_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether the load plan includes hazardous materials requiring special handling and segregation. Triggers additional compliance checks.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations, 49 CFR Hazmat

attributes.name: contains_temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the load plan includes temperature-sensitive cargo requiring refrigerated or climate-controlled transport.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the load plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: UN hazard class of dangerous goods included in the load plan. Determines segregation requirements and handling procedures. Pipe-separated list if multiple classes present.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: hazmat_segregation_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether hazmat segregation requirements have been verified and approved by qualified personnel. Mandatory for hazmat loads.
attributes.references: IMDG Code Segregation Tables, IATA DGR Compatibility Groups

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the load plan record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: load_optimization_method
attributes.description: Method used to create the load plan. Automated plans use TMS optimization algorithms, manual plans are created by planners, hybrid combines both.

attributes.name: load_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the load plan. Tracks progression from initial planning through execution completion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|planned|approved|in_progress|completed|cancelled|on_hold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: load_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order in which cargo items are to be loaded onto the transport unit. Critical for LIFO/FIFO optimization and unloading efficiency.

attributes.name: loading_dock_bay
attributes.description: Specific dock, bay, or gate number where loading operations are performed. Used for operational coordination and resource allocation.

attributes.name: loading_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the facility or terminal where loading operations take place. May be UN/LOCODE, IATA airport code, or internal facility code.

attributes.name: max_volume_capacity_cbm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Volume Capacity in Cubic Meters (CBM)
attributes.description: Maximum volume capacity of the transport unit in cubic meters. Physical constraint for load planning.

attributes.name: max_weight_capacity_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight capacity of the transport unit in kilograms. Regulatory limit that must not be exceeded.
attributes.references: IMO Load Line Convention, IATA Aircraft Loading Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the load plan, including special circumstances, deviations from standard procedures, or operational alerts.

attributes.name: planned_load_completion_time
attributes.description: Scheduled timestamp when loading operations are expected to be completed. Used for departure scheduling and SLA management.

attributes.name: planned_load_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when loading operations are planned to begin. Used for resource planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: planned_load_start_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when loading operations are scheduled to commence. Critical for dock scheduling and labor planning.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number for the load plan, used for external communication and documentation. Typically follows format LP-XXXXXXXX.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Service level for the load plan. FTL (Full Truckload), LTL (Less Than Truckload), FCL (Full Container Load), LCL (Less Than Container Load), or express/standard/economy for air and parcel. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FTL|LTL|FCL|LCL|express|standard|economy — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Service Codes, FMC Service Contract Guidelines

attributes.name: special_handling_requirements
attributes.description: Any special handling requirements for the load, such as fragile cargo, high-value goods, live animals, or oversized items requiring special equipment.
attributes.references: IATA Live Animals Regulations, IATA Perishable Cargo Regulations

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum temperature requirement in Celsius for temperature-controlled cargo in this load plan. Must be maintained throughout transport.

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum temperature requirement in Celsius for temperature-controlled cargo in this load plan. Must be maintained throughout transport.

attributes.name: total_actual_volume_cbm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Actual Volume in Cubic Meters (CBM)
attributes.description: Total actual volume of all cargo loaded, measured in cubic meters. Captured post-loading for utilization analysis.

attributes.name: total_actual_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total actual weight of all cargo loaded, measured in kilograms. Captured post-loading for verification and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Container Weight Verification, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: total_planned_volume_cbm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Planned Volume in Cubic Meters (CBM)
attributes.description: Total planned volume of all cargo to be loaded, measured in cubic meters. Used for space utilization and capacity planning.

attributes.name: total_planned_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total planned weight of all cargo to be loaded, measured in kilograms. Used for weight distribution calculations and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Container Weight Verification, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation for this load plan. Determines operational procedures, documentation requirements, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: transport_unit_type
attributes.description: Type of transport unit for which the load plan is created. Determines applicable loading rules and constraints.
attributes.references: ISO 6346 Container Type Codes, IATA ULD Type Codes

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the load plan. Incremented when significant changes are made to the plan after initial creation.

attributes.name: volume_utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of volume capacity utilized by the planned load. Key performance indicator for space optimization efficiency.

attributes.name: weight_utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of weight capacity utilized by the planned load. Key performance indicator for load optimization efficiency.

products.name: freight_carrier_assignment
products.description: Records the assignment of a carrier (airline, ocean carrier, road haulier, rail operator) to a specific freight order or consolidation. Captures carrier SCAC/IATA code, service type, assigned lane, contracted rate reference, assignment date, confirmation status, carrier booking reference, and any carrier-specific instructions. Supports carrier selection logic from SAP TM and freight audit in Oracle TMS. Distinct from the contract domain which owns the carrier agreement terms.

attributes.name: freight_carrier_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the carrier assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: accounts_payable_id

attributes.name: air_waybill_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.air_waybill. Business justification: Carrier assignment for air freight is documented in the air waybill. One carrier assignment per AWB (typically). Nullable when carrier assignment is for ocean or other modes.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.bill_of_lading. Business justification: Carrier assignment for ocean freight is documented in the bill of lading. One carrier assignment per BOL (typically). Nullable when carrier assignment is for air or other modes.

attributes.name: booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.booking. Business justification: Carrier can be assigned at booking stage (space confirmation with carrier). Many carrier assignments for one booking (if booking is modified or reassigned). Nullable when carrier assignment is for con

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.carrier_agreement. Business justification: Carrier assignments reference specific carrier agreements for rate and service terms. attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier (airline, ocean carrier, road haulier, rail operator) assigned to this freight order. Links to the carrier master entity.

attributes.name: carrier_payable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.carrier_payable. Business justification: Carrier assignments drive carrier payables (AP for carrier services). Assignment-to-payable link enables carrier cost tracking, rate validation, and carrier invoice reconciliation against contracted a

attributes.description: Reference to the freight order or consolidation to which this carrier is assigned. Links to the freight order entity managed in SAP TM or Oracle TMS.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Reference to the assigned transportation lane (origin-destination pair) for this carrier assignment. Links to the lane master entity in the route domain.

attributes.name: primary_freight_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or system account that created this carrier assignment. Links to the workforce or system user entity.

attributes.name: supplier_emissions_disclosure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.supplier_emissions_disclosure. Business justification: Carrier emissions data is required for Scope 3 Category 4 reporting, carrier sustainability scorecarding in procurement decisions, and CDP Supply Chain disclosure programs.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.transport_asset. Business justification: When carrier executes using own fleet modeled in system, links assignment to specific asset. Supports own-fleet vs subcontractor analysis and asset-level cost allocation. Operational tracking for inte

attributes.name: accessorial_charges_amount
attributes.description: Total accessorial charges for additional services such as liftgate, inside delivery, detention, demurrage, Terminal Handling Charge (THC), or special equipment.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: Date when the carrier was assigned to the freight order. Represents the business event date of carrier selection.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the carrier assignment in its lifecycle: pending carrier confirmation, confirmed by carrier, rejected by carrier, cancelled by shipper, or expired due to timeout.

attributes.name: assignment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the carrier assignment was created in the system. Supports audit trail and carrier selection analytics.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for cancellation if the carrier assignment was cancelled. Includes carrier rejection reason, shipper cancellation reason, or system timeout. Null if not cancelled.

attributes.name: carrier_booking_reference
attributes.description: Booking reference number or confirmation code provided by the carrier upon acceptance. Used for tracking and coordination with carrier systems.

attributes.name: carrier_iata_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Carrier Code
attributes.description: IATA two-letter or three-character airline designator code for air carriers. Used for air waybill (AWB) and flight operations.

attributes.name: carrier_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions or requirements specific to this carrier assignment, such as handling requirements, delivery windows, contact information, or operational constraints.

attributes.name: carrier_scac_code
attributes.description: Standard Carrier Alpha Code uniquely identifying the carrier in North American freight operations. 2-4 uppercase letters assigned by the National Motor Freight Traffic Association (NMFTA).

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date when the carrier confirmed acceptance of the freight assignment. Null if not yet confirmed.

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the carrier confirmed the assignment. Used for Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking and carrier performance measurement.

attributes.name: container_count
attributes.description: Number of containers assigned to this carrier for ocean or intermodal freight. Applicable for Full Container Load (FCL) and Less Than Container Load (LCL) shipments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the freight charge amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: customs_broker_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this carrier assignment requires customs brokerage services for cross-border shipments. Integrates with Descartes Customs system.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of equipment or container assigned by the carrier, such as 20ft dry container, 40ft high cube, refrigerated container (reefer), flatbed trailer, or tanker.

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_date
attributes.description: Estimated date when the carrier will deliver the freight to the destination. Used for customer communication and Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking.

attributes.name: estimated_pickup_date
attributes.description: Estimated date when the carrier will pick up the freight from the origin location. Used for planning and coordination.

attributes.name: freight_charge_amount

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_amount

attributes.name: hazmat_certified

attributes.name: incoterm

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: selection_criteria
attributes.description: Business criteria or rules applied during carrier selection, such as lowest cost, fastest transit, preferred carrier, service level, or capacity availability.

attributes.name: selection_method

attributes.name: service_type

attributes.name: temperature_controlled

products.name: document_attachment
products.description: This association product represents the attachment relationship between freight orders and trade documents in international logistics operations. It captures the specific documents required for each freight order, tracking submission status, acceptance by customs/authorities, version control, and rejection handling. Each record links one freight order to one trade document with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific attachment relationship, enabling full traceability of document compliance per shipment.. Existence Justification: In international freight forwarding operations, a single freight order requires multiple trade documents (commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, phytosanitary certificates, etc.) to satisfy customs and regulatory requirements across origin and destination countries. Conversely, in consolidation scenarios, a single trade document (such as a consolidated commercial invoice or master packing list) can cover multiple freight orders being shipped together. The business actively manages the attachment relationship, tracking submission dates, acceptance status by customs authorities, rejection reasons, and version control for each document-order pairing.

products.name: shipment_agent_service
products.description: This association product represents the service engagement between a freight order and an agent in the Transport Shipping partner network. It captures the operational assignment of agents to specific shipments for services such as origin handling, destination delivery, customs clearance, or transit coordination. Each record links one freight_order to one agent with attributes that define the scope, compensation, and territorial responsibility for that specific engagement.. Existence Justification: In international freight forwarding operations, a single shipment routinely requires multiple agents across different territories and service functions—an origin agent for pickup and export documentation, a destination agent for import clearance and final delivery, and potentially transit agents for customs or intermediate handling. Conversely, each agent in the network handles hundreds or thousands of shipments. The business actively manages these agent assignments with specific service scopes, territorial responsibilities, commission rates, and handling fees that vary by shipment characteristics and lane requirements.

products.name: carbon_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation event between freight_order and carbon_offset_program. It captures the operational process of allocating carbon offset credits from specific programs to individual freight orders to neutralize their carbon footprint. Each record links one freight_order to one carbon_offset_program with attributes that exist only in the context of this allocation transaction, including the quantity of CO2e credits allocated, allocation timestamp, allocation method, customer opt-in status, and program tier selection.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping's sustainability operations, a single freight order can have its carbon footprint offset by drawing credits from multiple carbon offset programs (e.g., splitting between a reforestation program and a renewable energy program to meet total offset requirements or customer preferences). Conversely, a single carbon offset program's inventory serves as a credit pool allocated across many freight orders over time. The allocation process is an operational business activity managed by the sustainability team, with each allocation carrying specific transactional data including quantity allocated, allocation date, method, customer opt-in status, program tier, cost, and retirement certificate details.

products.name: storage_location

Tracks location code, zone assignment, zone type (receiving, bulk, pick-face, staging, dispatch, cold-chain, hazmat, quarantine, returns, VAS), aisle, rack, level, bin, location type, weight/volume capacity, temperature class, hazmat suitability, automation type, and current occupancy status. After merge with zone, also carries zone-level attributes (floor area, height, temperature range). Enables slotting optimization, directed putaway, and compliance segregation.

attributes.name: storage_location_id

attributes.name: facility_id

attributes.name: height_cm

attributes.name: length_cm

attributes.name: location_barcode
attributes.description: Scannable barcode identifier for the storage location used by handheld Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) devices and mobile scanning equipment during warehouse operations.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Human-readable unique code identifying the storage location within the warehouse. Used for directed putaway and picking operations in Manhattan Warehouse Management System (WMS).

attributes.name: location_status

attributes.name: quarantine_flag

attributes.name: returns_processing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is designated for processing customer returns and Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) inventory.

attributes.name: weight_capacity_kg

attributes.name: width_cm

SSOT for item identity within the warehouse domain.

attributes.name: height_cm

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.description: The maximum number of units that can be safely stacked vertically. Null if not stackable or no limit.

attributes.name: pick_type
attributes.description: The standard picking method or unit used for order fulfillment of this SKU (each-pick, case-pick, pallet-pick, or bulk).

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level classification category for this SKU used for inventory segmentation, slotting optimization, and reporting.

attributes.name: product_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory classification within the product category for granular inventory management and analytics.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The inventory quantity threshold that triggers replenishment or reorder action for this SKU.

attributes.name: rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SKU is tagged with RFID technology for automated tracking and inventory visibility.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: The RFID tag identifier or Electronic Product Code (EPC) associated with this SKU for automated identification.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 18000 RFID Standards, GS1 EPC Standards

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum buffer inventory quantity maintained to prevent stockouts and ensure service level for this SKU.

attributes.name: serial_tracking_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SKU requires individual serial number tracking at the unit level for high-value or regulated items.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The number of days from receipt or manufacture date that the SKU remains usable or saleable before expiration. Null for non-perishable items.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying this SKU across all warehouse operations and systems. Used for scanning, picking, and inventory transactions.

attributes.name: sku_description
attributes.description: Detailed human-readable description of the product or item represented by this SKU, including key characteristics and specifications.

attributes.name: sku_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SKU indicating whether it is available for warehouse operations, discontinued, or pending activation.

attributes.name: stackable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SKU can be safely stacked vertically in storage and transport.

attributes.name: storage_class
attributes.description: The warehouse storage class or zone assignment for this SKU based on handling requirements, velocity, and physical characteristics (e.g., fast-pick, bulk, secure, hazmat).

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: The maximum allowable storage temperature in Celsius for temperature-controlled SKUs. Null for ambient items.

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: The minimum allowable storage temperature in Celsius for temperature-controlled SKUs. Null for ambient items.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: The temperature control requirement for storing and handling this SKU, determining warehouse zone assignment.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: The four-digit UN number identifying the hazardous substance if applicable, used for compliance with international dangerous goods regulations.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The standard unit of measure used for inventory counting, picking, and tracking of this SKU.

attributes.name: velocity_code
attributes.description: The movement velocity classification indicating how frequently this SKU is picked or shipped (fast, medium, slow movers).

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: The code or identifier of the primary vendor or supplier for this SKU, used for procurement and replenishment.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: The total volume of the SKU in cubic meters, calculated or measured for warehouse space utilization and freight planning.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: The actual gross weight of the SKU in kilograms, used for handling, labor planning, and freight calculations.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: The width dimension of the SKU in centimeters, used for slotting optimization and space planning.

Core operational record powering WMS inventory control and order fulfillment allocation.

attributes.name: inventory_position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory position record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Inventory positions in 3PL warehouses are owned by customer accounts (shippers/sellers). Replaces denormalized owner_code string with proper FK. Essential for customer-specific inventory reporting, bi

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or distribution center where the inventory is held.

attributes.name: ftz_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.ftz_inventory. Business justification: Inventory stored in Foreign Trade Zones must be tracked in FTZ inventory records for CBP compliance. Links warehouse position to FTZ admission for duty deferral tracking, zone lot management, and week

attributes.name: invoice_id

attributes.name: asn_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Advanced Shipping Notice that announced the arrival of this inventory. Links received inventory to inbound shipment documentation.

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity available for allocation to new orders. Calculated as on-hand minus reserved, quarantine, hold, damaged, and expired quantities.

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Standard or actual cost per unit of the inventory item. Used for inventory valuation, cost of goods sold calculations, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166 country code indicating where the product was manufactured or produced. Required for customs declarations and trade compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory position record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost per unit value. Standard codes include USD, EUR, GBP, CNY, JPY.

attributes.name: damaged_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity identified as physically damaged or defective. Typically segregated for disposal, return to vendor, or salvage processing.

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: fifo_sequence_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: First In First Out (FIFO) Sequence Number
attributes.description: Sequential number assigned based on receipt date to enforce FIFO picking logic. Lower numbers are picked first to ensure oldest inventory is consumed before newer stock.

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the inventory item is classified as hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and transportation compliance.
attributes.references: IMDG Code International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code

attributes.name: hold_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity placed on administrative hold due to customer disputes, regulatory issues, or business decisions. Not available for allocation.

attributes.name: hs_code

attributes.name: in_transit_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity currently being moved within the facility between storage locations. Temporarily unavailable during putaway or replenishment operations.

attributes.name: inventory_status

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date when the inventory position was last physically counted during cycle count operations. Used to schedule next count and track inventory accuracy.

attributes.name: last_movement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent inventory transaction affecting this position (receipt, pick, adjustment, transfer). Used for slow-moving inventory analysis.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: lifo_sequence_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last In First Out (LIFO) Sequence Number
attributes.description: Sequential number assigned based on receipt date to enforce LIFO picking logic. Higher numbers are picked first to ensure newest inventory is consumed before older stock.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot identifier for traceability and quality control. Used for FIFO/LIFO inventory management and product recalls.

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date when the product was manufactured or produced. Used for traceability, quality control, and shelf-life calculations.

attributes.name: on_hand_quantity
attributes.description: Total physical quantity of the SKU present at the storage location, regardless of availability status. Includes available, reserved, quarantine, hold, and damaged quantities.

attributes.name: pick_face_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this inventory position is in an active pick face location (forward pick area) versus reserve storage. Pick face locations are optimized for high-velocity picking.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the purchase order under which this inventory was procured. Used for receiving verification and supplier reconciliation.

attributes.name: putaway_zone
attributes.description: Warehouse zone designation where the inventory was placed during putaway operations. Used for slotting optimization and pick path planning.

attributes.name: quarantine_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity held for quality inspection or pending release approval. Not available for order fulfillment until cleared.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when the inventory was received into the facility. Used for FIFO/LIFO sequencing and aging analysis.

attributes.name: replenishment_trigger_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity threshold that triggers automatic replenishment from reserve storage to pick face. Used to maintain optimal pick face inventory levels.

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity committed to existing orders or work orders but not yet picked. Reduces available quantity for new allocations.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for individual item-level tracking. Used for high-value or serialized inventory items.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Unique product identifier used for inventory tracking and order fulfillment. The SKU code that identifies the specific product variant.

attributes.name: supplier_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier who provided this inventory. Used for supplier performance tracking and quality traceability.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the inventory requires temperature-controlled storage (refrigerated or frozen). Drives storage zone assignment and handling requirements.

attributes.name: temperature_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable storage temperature for temperature-controlled inventory. Used to monitor cold chain compliance.

attributes.name: temperature_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable storage temperature for temperature-controlled inventory. Used to monitor cold chain compliance.

attributes.name: temperature_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for temperature range values. Standard units are celsius or fahrenheit.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials. Required for dangerous goods shipping compliance under IMDG, IATA, and DOT regulations.
attributes.references: IMDG Code International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which inventory quantities are tracked and reported. Standard units include each (individual items), case (inner pack), pallet (shipping unit), carton, box, or generic unit.

attributes.name: volume_per_unit
attributes.description: Physical volume or cubic measurement of a single unit of the SKU. Used for warehouse space planning, slotting optimization, and freight rating.
attributes.references: IATA International Air Transport Association Standards

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the volume per unit value. Standard units include CBM (cubic meter), CFT (cubic foot), liter, gallon.

attributes.name: weight_per_unit
attributes.description: Physical weight of a single unit of the SKU. Used for dimensional weight calculations, freight rating, and capacity planning.
attributes.references: IATA International Air Transport Association Standards

attributes.name: weight_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the weight per unit value. Standard units include kg (kilogram), lb (pound), g (gram), oz (ounce), ton (short ton), mt (metric ton).

Essential for carrier coordination, customs clearance, and proof-of-ship

attributes.description: Total cost of the inventory movement (quantity_moved × cost_per_unit). Used for inventory valuation and financial reporting. Currency is USD unless otherwise specified in warehouse configuration.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: UN number for hazardous materials classification. Required for dangerous goods handling, storage, and transportation compliance.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity moved. Aligns with SKU base unit or alternate handling units. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pallet|kg|lb|liter|gallon — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volume of the inventory moved, measured in cubic meters. Used for warehouse space utilization and slotting optimization.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of the inventory moved, measured in kilograms. Used for capacity planning, freight calculation, and dimensional weight analysis.

products.name: cycle_count
products.description: Cycle count program record representing a scheduled or ad-hoc physical inventory count event for a defined set of storage locations or SKUs within a facility. Captures count program name, count type (full, cycle, spot, ABC-velocity), facility, zone scope, scheduled date, count start timestamp, count end timestamp, total locations counted, total SKUs counted, variance quantity, variance value, count status (scheduled, in-progress, completed, approved), and approver. Supports inventory accuracy KPI and regulatory stock reconciliation.
products.reference: Cycle Count / Physical Inventory Count (Manhattan WMS)

attributes.name: cycle_count_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cycle count event. Primary key.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the approver. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: counter_team_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the team or crew assigned to perform the physical count. Used for labor productivity tracking.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or distribution center where the cycle count is performed.

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to warehouse.zone. Business justification: cycle_count has zone_code (STRING) indicating which zone is being counted. Adding a proper zone_id FK enables JOIN to zone master for zone details. zone_code removed as it can be retrieved via the FK

attributes.name: accuracy_percentage
attributes.description: Inventory accuracy percentage for this count event. Calculated as (locations with zero variance / total locations counted) * 100. Key performance indicator for warehouse operations.

attributes.name: adjustment_posted
attributes.description: Indicates whether inventory adjustments resulting from count variances have been posted to the WMS and financial systems.

attributes.name: adjustment_posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when inventory adjustments were posted to the system. Used for financial reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: aisle_range_end
attributes.description: Ending aisle identifier for the count scope. Used to define physical location boundaries.

attributes.name: aisle_range_start
attributes.description: Starting aisle identifier for the count scope. Used to define physical location boundaries.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count results were approved by the authorized approver.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the warehouse manager or supervisor who approved the cycle count results and variances.

attributes.name: count_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the physical count activity was completed. Marks the end of the count execution window.

attributes.name: count_method
attributes.description: Method used to perform the physical count. Manual = paper-based or visual; RFID = radio frequency identification; Barcode Scan = handheld scanner; Automated = robotic or sensor-based.

attributes.name: count_program_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the cycle count program or event. Externally-known code used for tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: count_program_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the cycle count program or event.

attributes.name: count_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or trigger for the cycle count. Examples: scheduled rotation, exception investigation, audit requirement, pre-physical inventory, post-receiving verification.

attributes.name: count_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the physical count activity began. Marks the beginning of the count execution window.

attributes.name: count_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cycle count event. Scheduled = planned but not started; In-Progress = counting underway; Completed = count finished awaiting approval; Approved = variances reviewed and accepted; Cancelled = count aborted; On-Hold = temporarily suspended.

attributes.name: count_type
attributes.description: Classification of the count event. Full = complete facility inventory; Cycle = scheduled rotating count; Spot = ad-hoc targeted count; ABC-Velocity = frequency-based on SKU velocity; Blind = count without system quantity reference; Location-Directed = system-assigned location count.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: fifo_lifo_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: First In First Out (FIFO) / Last In First Out (LIFO) Method
attributes.description: Inventory valuation method applied during count variance adjustment. FIFO = First In First Out; LIFO = Last In First Out; FEFO = First Expired First Out; Not Applicable = no specific method.

attributes.name: hazmat_count_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cycle count includes hazardous materials requiring special handling and compliance procedures.
attributes.references: IMDG Code International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code

attributes.name: labor_hours_actual
attributes.description: Actual labor hours spent performing the cycle count. Used for labor productivity analysis and cost allocation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count record was last updated. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the cycle count event. May include variance explanations, operational issues, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for the cycle count event. Critical = immediate count required; High = urgent; Medium = standard; Low = routine.

attributes.name: recount_count
attributes.description: Number of times this cycle count has been recounted. Used to track count quality and identify problematic locations or SKUs.

attributes.name: recount_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a recount is required due to significant variances or count discrepancies exceeding tolerance thresholds.

attributes.name: regulatory_audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cycle count is part of a regulatory audit or compliance requirement (e.g., customs bonded warehouse audit, ISO certification audit).

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the cycle count event to be executed. Used for count program planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cycle count includes temperature-controlled or cold storage inventory.

attributes.name: total_locations_counted
attributes.description: Total number of storage locations physically counted during this cycle count event.

attributes.name: total_skus_counted
attributes.description: Total number of unique SKUs physically counted during this cycle count event.

attributes.name: total_units_counted
attributes.description: Total quantity of inventory units physically counted across all SKUs and locations.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: Net difference between physical count quantity and system quantity (physical minus system). Positive indicates overage; negative indicates shortage.

attributes.name: variance_tolerance_percentage
attributes.description: Acceptable variance threshold percentage for this count event. Variances exceeding this threshold trigger recount or approval workflows.

attributes.name: variance_value_usd
attributes.description: Financial value of the inventory variance in USD. Calculated as variance quantity multiplied by unit cost. Used for financial reconciliation and inventory accuracy KPI.

attributes.name: wms_batch_reference
attributes.description: Batch identifier from the source WMS system. Used for traceability and integration with Manhattan WMS.

products.name: cycle_count_line
products.description: Line-level result of a cycle count for each storage location and SKU combination counted. Records location, SKU, lot number, system quantity (book stock), counted quantity, variance quantity, variance percentage, recount flag, recount quantity, adjuster ID, adjustment timestamp, and approval status. Drives inventory adjustment postings and discrepancy investigation workflows.

attributes.name: cycle_count_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cycle count line record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee identifier of the supervisor or manager who approved or rejected the cycle count variance. Nullable if not yet approved.

attributes.name: cycle_count_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent cycle count header that this line belongs to. Links to the cycle count batch or session.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or distribution center where the cycle count was performed.

attributes.name: inventory_movement_id
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier of the inventory adjustment posting in the WMS. Nullable if adjustment not yet posted.

attributes.name: primary_cycle_counter_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee identifier of the warehouse associate who performed the initial count. Links to workforce management system.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to warehouse.sku. Business justification: Cycle count lines MUST reference the authoritative SKU master for accurate inventory reconciliation. Currently cycle_count_line has sku_code STRING field but lacks proper FK to sku.sku_id. Adding sku_

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to warehouse.storage_location. Business justification: Cycle count lines MUST reference the authoritative storage location master. Currently cycle_count_line has storage_location_code STRING field but lacks proper FK to storage_location.storage_location_i

attributes.name: adjustment_posted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inventory adjustment has been posted to the WMS and financial systems. True if posted, False if pending.

attributes.name: adjustment_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the inventory adjustment was posted to the system. Nullable if adjustment not yet posted.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the cycle count line. Indicates whether the count variance has been reviewed and approved for inventory adjustment posting.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the cycle count line was approved or rejected. Nullable if not yet approved.

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The unit cost of the SKU at the time of the cycle count. Used to calculate the financial impact of the variance. Sourced from inventory valuation system.

attributes.name: count_status
attributes.description: Current status of this cycle count line in the workflow. Tracks progression from initial count through approval and adjustment.

attributes.name: count_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the initial physical count was performed. Business event timestamp for the count activity.

attributes.name: counted_quantity
attributes.description: The actual physical quantity counted by the warehouse associate during the cycle count.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cycle count line record was first created in the system. Audit trail timestamp.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost and variance value amounts. Typically USD for US operations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-before date of the lot counted. Used for FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management. Nullable for non-perishable items.

attributes.name: inventory_condition_code
attributes.description: The condition or quality status of the inventory counted. Determines whether inventory is available for sale or fulfillment.

attributes.name: investigation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this variance requires formal investigation due to high value, high percentage, or recurring pattern. True if investigation is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the variance investigation workflow. Tracks progression from initiation through resolution.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cycle count line record was last updated. Audit trail timestamp for tracking changes.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the cycle count header. Used for ordering and referencing specific count lines.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The lot or batch number of the inventory counted. Used for traceability and FIFO/LIFO inventory management. Nullable for non-lot-tracked items.

attributes.name: recount_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity recorded during the recount verification. Nullable if no recount was performed.

attributes.name: recount_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line requires a recount due to variance exceeding threshold or other business rules. True if recount is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: recount_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the recount verification was performed. Nullable if no recount was performed.

attributes.name: recount_variance_quantity
attributes.description: The variance between recount quantity and system quantity. Nullable if no recount was performed.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: The serial number of the specific unit counted. Used for serialized inventory tracking. Nullable for non-serialized items.

attributes.name: system_quantity
attributes.description: The book stock quantity recorded in the WMS system before the physical count. Also known as expected quantity or on-hand quantity.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantities recorded. Common values: EA (Each), CS (Case), PL (Pallet), BX (Box), KG (Kilogram), LB (Pound), LT (Liter), GL (Gallon). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|BX|KG|LB|LT|GL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Manhattan WMS Item Master UOM Standards

attributes.name: variance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes explaining the variance, investigation findings, or corrective actions taken. Used for audit trail and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of system quantity. Calculated as (variance_quantity / system_quantity) * 100. Used for threshold-based recount triggers.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between counted quantity and system quantity. Calculated as counted_quantity minus system_quantity. Positive indicates overage, negative indicates shortage.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: The root cause category assigned to explain the inventory variance. Used for discrepancy investigation and process improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: damage|theft|miscount|system_error|receiving_error|picking_error|putaway_error|shrinkage|obsolescence|unknown|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variance_value_amount
attributes.description: The financial value of the variance, calculated as variance_quantity multiplied by cost_per_unit. Used for financial reporting and variance analysis.

products.name: replenishment_order
products.description: Replenishment task order directing the movement of stock from reserve/bulk storage to active pick-face locations to maintain minimum pick-face inventory levels. Captures replenishment order number, trigger type (min-max, demand-driven, wave-triggered), source location, destination pick-face location, SKU, replenishment quantity, priority, creation timestamp, assignment timestamp, completion timestamp, and status. Ensures pick-face availability and prevents stockout-driven pick failures.

attributes.name: replenishment_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the replenishment order. Primary key for the replenishment order entity.

attributes.name: destination_location_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the active pick-face location to which inventory will be moved to maintain picking availability.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse worker or operator assigned to execute the replenishment task.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse facility where the replenishment is being executed.

attributes.name: primary_replenishment_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the reserve or bulk storage location from which inventory will be moved.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to warehouse.sku. Business justification: Replenishment orders MUST reference the authoritative SKU master. Currently replenishment_order has sku_code STRING field but lacks proper FK to sku.sku_id. Adding sku_id enables JOIN to sku master fo

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the picking wave that triggered this replenishment order, if applicable. Used for wave-triggered replenishment strategies.

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse zone where the replenishment activity is taking place, used for zone-based labor assignment and performance tracking.

attributes.name: actual_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The actual time in minutes taken to complete the replenishment task, calculated from started to completed timestamp.

attributes.name: actual_quantity_moved
attributes.description: The actual quantity of inventory units successfully moved upon completion. May differ from planned replenishment quantity due to inventory availability or operational constraints.

attributes.name: assigned_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the replenishment order was assigned to a warehouse worker or automated system.

attributes.name: batch_reference
attributes.description: Identifier for a batch of replenishment orders grouped together for efficient execution by a single worker or equipment unit.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the replenishment order was cancelled, if applicable.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the replenishment order was successfully completed and inventory moved to the destination location.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the replenishment order was created by the warehouse management system.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: The type of material handling equipment required or used to execute the replenishment task.

attributes.name: estimated_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The estimated time in minutes to complete the replenishment task based on labor standards and distance calculations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-before date of the inventory being replenished, critical for First Expired First Out (FEFO) replenishment strategies.

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the replenishment order failed to complete successfully, if applicable. May include reasons such as insufficient source inventory, location blocked, equipment failure.

attributes.name: fifo_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence indicating the FIFO priority of the inventory being replenished, ensuring oldest inventory is moved to pick-face first.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the replenishment involves hazardous materials requiring certified workers and special safety protocols.
attributes.references: IMDG Code - International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the replenishment order record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The inventory lot or batch number being replenished, used for lot-controlled inventory tracking and First In First Out (FIFO) compliance.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique replenishment order number used for tracking and reference in warehouse operations.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the replenishment order indicating its progress through the warehouse workflow.

attributes.name: pick_face_max_quantity
attributes.description: The maximum inventory capacity for the destination pick-face location used to calculate optimal replenishment quantity.

attributes.name: pick_face_min_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum inventory level threshold for the destination pick-face location that triggered the replenishment order.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for the replenishment order where lower numbers indicate higher urgency. Used for task sequencing and labor assignment.

attributes.name: replenishment_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of inventory units to be moved from source to destination location.

attributes.name: started_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when physical execution of the replenishment task began.

attributes.name: system_generated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the replenishment order was automatically generated by the warehouse management system based on business rules or manually created by an operator.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the replenishment involves temperature-controlled inventory requiring special handling and equipment.

attributes.name: travel_distance_meters
attributes.description: The calculated travel distance in meters between source and destination locations used for labor planning and productivity measurement.

attributes.name: trigger_type
attributes.description: The business rule or event that initiated the replenishment order. Min-max indicates inventory fell below minimum threshold, demand-driven indicates anticipated pick demand, wave-triggered indicates wave planning requirement, manual indicates operator-initiated, scheduled indicates time-based replenishment.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the replenishment quantity.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between planned replenishment quantity and actual quantity moved. Positive values indicate over-replenishment, negative values indicate under-replenishment.

Supports e-commerce reverse logistics and claims processing.

products.name: facility_carrier_service
products.description: This association product represents the operational service contract between a warehouse facility and a carrier partner. It captures facility-specific pickup schedules, dock assignments, volume commitments, and rate agreements that exist only in the context of this facility-carrier relationship. Each record links one facility to one carrier with attributes that govern the operational service terms at that specific facility location.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping logistics operations, facilities contract with multiple carriers simultaneously for redundancy, service coverage, and mode diversity (LTL, parcel, air freight). Each carrier serves multiple facilities across the network. The facility-carrier relationship is an operational service agreement that carries facility-specific terms including pickup schedules, dock assignments, volume commitments, and rate agreements that differ by facility location.

products.name: supply_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the commercial sourcing relationship between a SKU and a supplier. It captures the supplier-specific terms, pricing, lead times, and performance metrics for each SKU-supplier combination. Each record links one SKU to one supplier with attributes that exist only in the context of this sourcing relationship, enabling multi-sourcing strategies and supplier performance management.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, SKUs are routinely sourced from multiple suppliers as part of a multi-sourcing risk mitigation strategy, and each supplier provides hundreds or thousands of different SKUs. Each SKU-supplier combination has unique commercial terms including supplier-specific part numbers, negotiated unit costs, lead times, minimum order quantities, and quality performance ratings. This is an operational relationship actively managed by procurement teams.

products.name: facility_partner_agreement

products.name: facility_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between facility and agreement. It captures the facility-specific service terms, capacity allocation, billing arrangements, and SLA commitments that exist when a warehouse facility operates under a commercial agreement. In 3PL operations, this enables multi-tenant warehousing where a single facility serves multiple customer contracts simultaneously, and network contracts where a single master agreement spans multiple facilities. Each record links one facility to one agreement with attributes that define the operational and commercial parameters unique to that facility-agreement pairing.. Existence Justification: In 3PL logistics operations, facilities routinely operate under multiple customer agreements simultaneously (multi-tenant warehousing), and master agreements frequently span multiple facilities (network contracts). The business actively manages facility-agreement pairings as operational entities, tracking facility-specific capacity allocations, billing rate overrides, service periods, and SLA tiers that vary by customer within the same facility and by facility within the same agreement.
