attributes.name: handling_instructions
attributes.description: Special handling instructions for this unit such as fragile, this-side-up, keep dry, or forklift-only requirements, communicated to warehouse operatives during movement tasks.

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: UN hazardous material classification code (e.g., Class 1-9) for the contents of this handling unit, determining storage segregation rules and transport documentation requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1|2|3|4|5|6|7|8|9 — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: External height dimension of the handling unit in centimeters, used for stacking calculations, rack storage assignment, and vehicle loading constraints.

attributes.name: is_hazardous
attributes.description: Indicates whether the handling unit contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, storage segregation, and regulatory documentation per IMDG/ADR/IATA DGR.

attributes.name: is_mixed_sku
attributes.description: Indicates whether this handling unit contains multiple different SKUs (mixed) versus a single SKU (homogeneous), affecting picking strategy and inventory allocation logic.

attributes.name: is_returnable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this handling unit (e.g., pallet, tote) is a returnable/reusable asset that must be tracked for reverse logistics and asset pool management.

attributes.name: is_stackable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this handling unit can be safely stacked upon by other units during storage or transport, affecting warehouse slotting and load planning decisions.

attributes.name: item_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual items or SKUs contained within this handling unit, used for inventory reconciliation and pick verification.

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date when this handling unit was last included in a cycle count or physical inventory audit, supporting inventory accuracy KPIs and audit scheduling.

attributes.name: last_movement_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent physical movement of this handling unit within the warehouse (putaway, replenishment, pick, or relocation), used for dwell time analysis.

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: External length dimension of the handling unit in centimeters, used for slotting optimization, truck/container load planning, and storage capacity calculations.

attributes.name: load_unit_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the outbound load or shipment this handling unit is assigned to for dispatch, linking warehouse operations to transportation execution.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot or batch number of the goods contained in this handling unit, enabling FIFO/FEFO inventory management and product recall traceability.

attributes.name: max_stack_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight in kilograms that can be placed on top of this handling unit when stacked, ensuring safe storage and preventing product damage.

attributes.name: max_temperature_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for temperature-sensitive contents, used for cold chain compliance monitoring and alert thresholds.

attributes.name: min_temperature_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for temperature-sensitive contents, used for cold chain compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this handling unit record, supporting audit trail and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of the contents only (excluding packaging) in kilograms. Critical for customs declarations, freight billing, and inventory weight tracking.

attributes.name: packaging_material
attributes.description: The primary material composition of the handling unit, relevant for weight calculations, sustainability reporting, customs declarations, and ISPM-15 phytosanitary compliance for wood packaging.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number associated with the inbound receipt of this handling unit, enabling three-way matching between PO, ASN, and physical receipt.

attributes.name: quality_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this handling unit is currently under quality hold, preventing it from being allocated to outbound orders until inspection or disposition is completed.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when this handling unit was received into the warehouse through inbound receiving, establishing the FIFO aging baseline for inventory rotation.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Security seal number applied to the handling unit for tamper-evidence during transit, required for customs bonded movements and high-value shipments.

attributes.name: sscc
attributes.description: The 18-digit GS1 Serial Shipping Container Code that uniquely identifies this handling unit across the global supply chain for tracking and traceability.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the handling unit indicating its availability and condition within warehouse operations.

attributes.name: tare_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of the empty handling unit (packaging only, without contents) in kilograms. Used to calculate net weight of goods and for verified gross mass calculations.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: Required temperature storage condition for the handling unit contents, determining cold chain assignment and warehouse zone placement.

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical packaging type of the handling unit, determining storage requirements, handling equipment needs, and slotting optimization rules.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volumetric measurement of the handling unit in cubic meters, used for freight rate calculations, container utilization planning, and warehouse space allocation.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: External width dimension of the handling unit in centimeters, used for slotting optimization and load planning.

domains.name: fleet
domains.description: Fleet and transport asset management covering the full lifecycle of owned and leased vehicles, aircraft, vessels, and containers. Owns asset master data, GPS telematics, RFID tagging, maintenance scheduling, fuel consumption, driver assignment, regulatory compliance (DOT, ICAO), CAPEX/OPEX asset tracking, and fleet utilization KPIs. Integrates with TMS for route execution and IoT sensor data for real-time visibility.
domains.references: US DOT FMCSA, ICAO Annex 6, ISO 28000

products.name: transport_asset
products.description: Master record for all owned and leased transport assets in the fleet including vehicles (trucks, vans, motorcycles), aircraft, vessels, and rail units. Captures asset identity, classification, registration, ownership type (owned/leased/chartered), acquisition date, CAPEX value, current operational status, assigned depot/hub, telematics device ID, RFID tag, DOT/ICAO registration numbers, payload capacity, dimensional specs (CBM, DIM weight), fuel type, engine specs, and full lifecycle state (active, in-maintenance, decommissioned). This is the SSOT for all fleet asset master data.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the transport asset. Primary key for the transport asset master record.

attributes.name: asset_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.asset_type. Business justification: transport_asset currently has asset_type (STRING) and asset_subtype (STRING) storing the asset classification as free text. The asset_type reference table provides the authoritative taxonomy with asse

attributes.name: assigned_depot_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the depot, hub, or facility where the transport asset is currently based or assigned for operational purposes.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Fleet assets incur operational expenses (fuel, maintenance, insurance, depreciation) that must be allocated to cost centers for budget tracking, variance analysis, and departmental P&L reporting - fun

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Transport assets generate revenue through freight assignments and must be tracked by profit center for segment profitability analysis, EBITDA reporting, and service line performance measurement - core

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Capital expenditure (CAPEX) value of the transport asset at the time of acquisition. Recorded in the organization's base currency for financial reporting and depreciation calculation.
attributes.references: IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards), SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the transport asset was acquired, purchased, or leased by the organization. Used for depreciation and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: asset_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the transport asset for operational identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique asset identification number or registration code assigned to the transport asset. Used for tracking, compliance, and operational reference.

attributes.name: co2_emission_rate_g_per_km
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) Emission Rate (Grams per Kilometer)
attributes.description: Carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e) emission rate in grams per kilometer. Used for greenhouse gas (GHG) reporting and sustainability KPI (Key Performance Indicator) tracking.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS), CORSIA (Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the transport asset record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the acquisition cost and financial values associated with the transport asset.

attributes.name: current_location
attributes.description: Real-time or last known location of the transport asset. Updated via GPS telematics or manual check-in for visibility and tracking.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date when the transport asset was retired from active service or decommissioned. Marks the end of the asset's operational lifecycle.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date when the transport asset was sold, scrapped, or otherwise disposed of. Used for final financial accounting and asset register closure.

attributes.name: disposal_value
attributes.description: Salvage or resale value realized when the transport asset was disposed of. Used for capital expenditure (CAPEX) recovery tracking and financial reporting.

attributes.name: emission_standard
attributes.description: Environmental emission standard or certification that the transport asset complies with (e.g., Euro 6, EPA Tier 4). Required for regulatory compliance and sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS), US Department of Transportation (DOT)

attributes.name: engine_power_kw
attributes.description: Engine power output measured in kilowatts. Indicates performance capability and operational efficiency of the transport asset.

attributes.name: engine_type
attributes.description: Engine model or type specification for the transport asset. Used for maintenance planning, parts sourcing, and performance tracking.

attributes.name: fuel_capacity_liters
attributes.description: Maximum fuel tank capacity in liters. Used for range calculation and refueling planning.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel or energy source used by the transport asset. Determines refueling infrastructure requirements and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: diesel|gasoline|electric|hybrid|cng|lng|jet_fuel|marine_fuel — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS), CORSIA (Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation)

attributes.name: height_meters
attributes.description: Physical height of the transport asset in meters. Critical for bridge clearance, tunnel access, and loading dock compatibility.

attributes.name: home_location
attributes.description: Primary base location or home terminal for the transport asset. Used for route planning and operational assignment.

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current insurance policy for the transport asset expires. Used for compliance tracking and renewal scheduling.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number covering the transport asset for liability, damage, and loss. Required for risk management and claims processing.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent scheduled or unscheduled maintenance was performed on the transport asset. Used for maintenance interval tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the transport asset record was last updated in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: length_meters
attributes.description: Physical length of the transport asset in meters. Used for parking allocation, route clearance, and infrastructure compatibility.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or builder of the transport asset. Used for warranty tracking, parts sourcing, and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model designation or series name for the transport asset. Identifies specific design and capability specifications.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next preventive maintenance service on the transport asset. Critical for operational planning and compliance with safety regulations.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT), International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO)

attributes.name: odometer_reading
attributes.description: Current odometer or mileage reading for road vehicles, or equivalent usage metric (flight hours for aircraft, engine hours for vessels). Used for maintenance scheduling and utilization tracking.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transport asset indicating availability for operations, maintenance, or retirement status.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership or control arrangement for the transport asset. Determines financial treatment and operational flexibility.

attributes.name: payload_capacity_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight capacity in kilograms that the transport asset can carry. Critical for load planning and compliance with weight regulations.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT), International Maritime Organization (IMO)

attributes.name: registration_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the transport asset is registered. Determines applicable regulatory jurisdiction and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 Country Codes, International Maritime Organization (IMO)

attributes.name: registration_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current registration or license for the transport asset expires. Used for compliance tracking and renewal scheduling.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT), International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO)

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Government-issued registration or license plate number for the transport asset. Required for legal operation and regulatory compliance (DOT, ICAO, IMO).
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT), International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), International Maritime Organization (IMO)

attributes.name: rfid_tag
attributes.description: RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) tag identifier attached to the transport asset for automated identification, access control, and yard management.

attributes.name: telematics_device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the GPS (Global Positioning System) telematics device installed on the transport asset for real-time tracking, route monitoring, and IoT (Internet of Things) sensor data collection.

attributes.name: teu_capacity
attributes.description: Container capacity measured in TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit) for vessels and rail units. Standard measure for container shipping capacity.

attributes.name: utilization_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of time the transport asset is actively deployed in operations versus idle or available time. Key performance indicator (KPI) for fleet efficiency and return on investment (ROI).

attributes.name: vin_serial_number
attributes.description: Unique vehicle identification number (VIN) for road vehicles or manufacturer serial number for aircraft, vessels, and rail units. Used for registration, insurance, and theft prevention.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT), International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO)

attributes.name: volume_capacity_cbm
attributes.description: Maximum volumetric capacity in cubic meters (CBM) that the transport asset can accommodate. Used for space optimization and dimensional weight (DIM weight) calculations.

attributes.name: width_meters
attributes.description: Physical width of the transport asset in meters. Used for route clearance and infrastructure compatibility assessment.

attributes.name: year_of_manufacture
attributes.description: Calendar year when the transport asset was manufactured or built. Used for age-based maintenance scheduling and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT), International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO)

products.name: container_unit
products.description: Master record for intermodal containers and unit load devices (ULDs) managed within the fleet. Tracks container number (ISO 6346), TEU size classification (20ft, 40ft, 45ft), container type (dry, reefer, open-top, flat-rack, tank), tare weight, max gross weight, CSC certification expiry, current location (port/depot/vessel), availability status, lease agreement reference, and last inspection date. Distinct from transport_asset as containers are cargo-carrying units with their own ISO standards and lifecycle separate from traction units.

attributes.name: container_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the container unit. Primary key for the container_unit data product.

attributes.name: asset_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.asset_type. Business justification: container_unit currently has container_type (STRING) storing the container classification as free text. Containers are a category of fleet assets and should reference the asset_type taxonomy. The asse

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Container units are capital assets with maintenance, storage, and handling costs that must be allocated to cost centers for operational expense tracking and budget management in container logistics op

attributes.name: current_depot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.depot. Business justification: Containers have a current location (current_location_type, current_location_code). When a container is at a fleet depot, this FK provides a structured link. Nullable because containers can be at ports

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Containers generate revenue through leasing, per-diem charges, and freight assignments; profit center tracking enables container fleet profitability analysis and lease-vs-own financial decision-making

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total cost paid to acquire the container, including purchase price or initial lease payment. Used for CAPEX tracking, asset valuation, and return on investment analysis.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 - Leases; Internal Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date the container was acquired by the company (purchase or lease commencement). Used for asset tracking, depreciation schedules, and fleet age analysis.

attributes.name: availability_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the container. Available for booking, in use on a shipment, in transit empty, under repair/maintenance, retired from service, or lost/missing. Critical for inventory management and booking systems.

attributes.name: condition_grade
attributes.description: Physical condition assessment of the container. Grade A (excellent, cargo-worthy), B (good, minor wear), C (fair, requires monitoring), D (poor, repair needed), Scrap (end of life). Determines suitability for cargo types and repair priority.
attributes.references: Institute of International Container Lessors (IICL) - Container Inspection Criteria

attributes.name: container_number
attributes.description: Unique container identification number following ISO 6346 standard format (4 letter owner code + 6 digit serial number + 1 check digit). This is the globally recognized identifier for the container unit.
attributes.references: ISO 6346 - Freight containers - Coding, identification and marking

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this container unit record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: csc_certification_date
attributes.description: Date the current CSC safety certification was issued. Used to track certification validity and schedule re-inspection.
attributes.references: IMO - International Convention for Safe Containers (CSC)

attributes.name: csc_certification_number
attributes.description: Unique certification number issued under the International Convention for Safe Containers (CSC). Certifies the container meets structural safety standards for international transport.
attributes.references: IMO - International Convention for Safe Containers (CSC)

attributes.name: csc_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the CSC safety certification. Containers must be re-inspected and re-certified before this date to remain in service. Non-compliance prevents international movement.
attributes.references: IMO - International Convention for Safe Containers (CSC)

attributes.name: current_book_value
attributes.description: Current accounting book value of the container after depreciation. Updated periodically based on depreciation schedule. Used for financial reporting and asset disposal decisions.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 - Leases; IAS 16 - Property, Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: current_location_code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the specific facility, terminal, depot, or geographic location where the container is currently positioned. May be UN/LOCODE for ports or internal facility codes.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: current_location_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the containers current location. Used for geographic fleet distribution analysis and repositioning planning.

attributes.name: current_location_type
attributes.description: Type of facility or mode where the container is currently located. Depot (storage yard), port (marine terminal), vessel (on ship), rail yard, customer site, or in transit between locations.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date the container was disposed of (sold, scrapped, or otherwise removed from company ownership). Null if still owned. Used for asset lifecycle closure and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: food_grade_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the container is certified for transporting food products, meeting hygiene and contamination prevention standards. True if food-grade certified, false otherwise.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); EU Regulation (EC) No 852/2004 on the hygiene of foodstuffs

attributes.name: gps_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the container is equipped with GPS tracking device for real-time location monitoring. True if GPS-enabled, false otherwise.
attributes.references: Internal IoT (Internet of Things) Fleet Tracking System

attributes.name: hazmat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the container is certified to carry hazardous materials (dangerous goods) per IMDG Code and ICAO Technical Instructions. True if certified, false otherwise.
attributes.references: IMO - International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code; ICAO - Technical Instructions for the Safe Transport of Dangerous Goods by Air

attributes.name: height_ft
attributes.description: External height of the container in feet. Standard height is 8.5 feet; high-cube containers are 9.5 feet. Determines stacking compatibility and clearance requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Series 1 freight containers - Classification, dimensions and ratings

attributes.name: internal_volume_cbm
attributes.description: Internal cargo capacity of the container in cubic meters (CBM). Used for volumetric load planning and dimensional weight calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Series 1 freight containers - Classification, dimensions and ratings

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inspection of the container. Inspections verify structural integrity, door seals, flooring, and compliance with safety standards.
attributes.references: IICL - Container Inspection Criteria; Internal Maintenance Policy

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent maintenance or repair work performed on the container. Tracks maintenance history and informs future service intervals.

attributes.name: last_movement_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent movement or position update for the container. Used for tracking, dwell time calculation, and real-time visibility.
attributes.references: Internal TMS (Transportation Management System); FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform

attributes.name: lease_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the lease agreement if the container is leased. Links to contract terms, lessor details, and financial obligations. Null for owned containers.

attributes.name: length_ft
attributes.description: External length of the container in feet. Standard sizes are 10, 20, 40, 45, 48, or 53 feet. Critical for transport planning, stacking, and terminal slot allocation.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Series 1 freight containers - Classification, dimensions and ratings

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date the container was manufactured. Used to calculate asset age, depreciation, and remaining useful life for maintenance and replacement planning.
attributes.references: ISO 6346 - Freight containers - Coding, identification and marking

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured the container. Used for quality tracking, warranty claims, and supplier performance analysis.

attributes.name: max_gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum permissible combined weight of the container and its cargo in kilograms. Enforced for safety, regulatory compliance (SOLAS VGM), and transport mode restrictions.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Series 1 freight containers - Classification, dimensions and ratings; SOLAS Convention Verified Gross Mass (VGM)

attributes.name: max_payload_kg
attributes.description: Maximum cargo weight the container can carry, calculated as max gross weight minus tare weight. Used for load planning and customer quoting.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Series 1 freight containers - Classification, dimensions and ratings

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory inspection. Used for preventive maintenance planning and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: IICL - Container Inspection Criteria; Internal Maintenance Policy

attributes.name: owner_code
attributes.description: Four-letter code identifying the container owner or operator, as registered with the Bureau International des Containers (BIC). First three letters identify the owner; fourth letter is the equipment category (U for freight container).
attributes.references: ISO 6346 - Freight containers - Coding, identification and marking; BIC (Bureau International des Containers)

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the container is owned by the carrier, leased from a lessor, owned by a customer (SOC - Shipper Owned Container), or part of a shared pool arrangement. Impacts cost allocation, maintenance responsibility, and repositioning strategy.

attributes.name: reefer_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the container has refrigeration capability for temperature-controlled cargo. True for reefer containers, false for dry and other non-refrigerated types.
attributes.references: ISO 1496-2 - Series 1 freight containers - Specification and testing - Part 2: Thermal containers

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date the container was retired from active service. Null if the container is still in service. Used for fleet lifecycle management and disposal tracking.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the RFID tag attached to the container for automated tracking at gates, terminals, and checkpoints. Null if container is not RFID-tagged.
attributes.references: ISO 17363 - Supply chain applications of RFID - Freight containers; ISO 17365 - Supply chain applications of RFID - Transport units

attributes.name: tare_weight_kg
attributes.description: Empty weight of the container in kilograms, excluding cargo. Used to calculate net cargo weight and verify compliance with gross weight limits.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Series 1 freight containers - Classification, dimensions and ratings

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum temperature the container can maintain in Celsius. Applicable only to refrigerated (reefer) containers. Null for non-reefer units.
attributes.references: ISO 1496-2 - Series 1 freight containers - Specification and testing - Part 2: Thermal containers

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum temperature the container can maintain in Celsius. Applicable only to refrigerated (reefer) containers. Null for non-reefer units.
attributes.references: ISO 1496-2 - Series 1 freight containers - Specification and testing - Part 2: Thermal containers

attributes.name: teu_size
attributes.description: Container size expressed in TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit). Standard values: 1.0 for 20ft, 2.0 for 40ft, 2.25 for 45ft. Used for capacity planning and vessel/terminal utilization calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Series 1 freight containers - Classification, dimensions and ratings

attributes.name: total_distance_km
attributes.description: Cumulative distance the container has traveled in kilometers since acquisition. Used for wear analysis, maintenance scheduling, and asset performance evaluation.
attributes.references: Internal Fleet Management System; GPS Telematics

attributes.name: total_trips_completed
attributes.description: Cumulative count of completed shipment trips (loaded movements) the container has performed since acquisition. Used for utilization analysis and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this container unit record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: width_ft
attributes.description: External width of the container in feet. Standard width is 8.0 feet; high-cube and specialized containers may be 8.5 feet.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Series 1 freight containers - Classification, dimensions and ratings

products.name: asset_assignment
products.description: Transactional record capturing the assignment of a transport asset (vehicle, aircraft, vessel) to a specific route, freight order, driver, or operational depot for a defined period. Tracks assignment type (route execution, depot standby, charter, maintenance hold), assigned driver/crew reference, origin depot, destination, planned start/end datetime, actual start/end datetime, TMS freight order reference, and assignment status. Enables fleet utilization tracking and TMS-to-fleet reconciliation.

attributes.name: asset_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset assignment record. Primary key for the asset assignment transaction.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Asset assignments execute contracted service commitments. Operations teams validate assignment compliance with customer/carrier agreements for rate validation, SLA tracking, and billing reconciliation

attributes.name: assignment_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Each asset assignment incurs direct costs (fuel, tolls, driver labor) that must be allocated to a cost center for activity-based costing, route profitability analysis, and operational budget control.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: Asset assignments frequently use external carriers for line-haul or last-mile segments. Carrier selection, performance tracking, cost allocation, and SLA compliance depend on this link. Essential for

attributes.name: charge_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.charge_event. Business justification: Asset assignments are primary service delivery events generating billable charges in logistics. Real business process: shipment-based charge generation. Enables linking operational assignments to bill

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.declaration. Business justification: Asset assignments (trips/jobs) involving cross-border freight require customs declarations. Links operational dispatch to regulatory compliance, supports driver briefings on customs requirements, and

attributes.name: destination_depot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the depot, terminal, or facility where the assignment is scheduled to end. The ending location for the asset assignment. Null for open-ended assignments such as depot standby. Links to warehouse or facility master data.

attributes.name: driver_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the driver or crew member assigned to operate the asset during this assignment. Null for uncrewed assignments such as container assignments or depot standby. Links to workforce driver master data.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) - Driver Qualification Files

attributes.name: freight_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the TMS freight order that this asset is assigned to execute. Null for non-route assignments such as depot standby or maintenance hold. Enables TMS-to-fleet reconciliation.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Asset assignments (trips/jobs) generate billable services that result in customer invoices. Real business process: trip-based billing for transport services. Enables linking completed assignments to t

attributes.name: origin_depot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the depot, terminal, or facility where the assignment originates. The starting location for the asset assignment. Links to warehouse or facility master data.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the planned route that the asset is assigned to execute. Applicable for route execution assignments. Links to route master data for origin, destination, and waypoints.

attributes.name: primary_asset_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or automated process that created this assignment record. Used for audit trail and accountability. Links to user management or workforce systems.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.risk_assessment. Business justification: High-risk asset assignments (hazmat transport, cross-border operations, oversized loads) require pre-assignment risk assessments for route approval, driver qualification verification, and emergency re

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transport asset (vehicle, aircraft, vessel, container) being assigned. Links to the fleet asset master data.

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Business justification: Asset assignments reference shipping documents (BOL, AWB), route plans, and assignment authorizations. products.name: asset_inspection
products.description: Transactional record for all formal regulatory and operational inspections conducted on fleet assets. Captures asset reference, inspection type (DOT roadside inspection, ICAO airworthiness check, IMO vessel survey, pre-trip inspection, annual safety inspection, C-TPAT security inspection), inspection date, inspector name/authority, inspection outcome (pass, fail, conditional), defects identified, corrective actions required, reinspection due date, and regulatory certificate issued. Distinct from maintenance_order — inspections are compliance events that may or may not trigger maintenance work.
products.reference: DOT Inspection Report / ICAO Airworthiness Certificate

attributes.name: asset_inspection_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset inspection record. Primary key.

attributes.name: customs_compliance_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.compliance_program. Business justification: Asset inspections (security seals, container integrity, GPS functionality) are mandatory for customs compliance programs (C-TPAT, AEO). Inspection certificates must be maintained as evidence of progra

attributes.name: depot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.depot. Business justification: Inspections are often conducted at fleet depots/workshops. Adding depot_id allows tracking which depot performed the inspection. Nullable because inspections can also occur at external regulatory auth

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fleet asset (vehicle, aircraft, vessel, container) that was inspected.

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Business justification: Inspections produce regulatory certificates, compliance reports, and inspection records that must be linked to the inspection event for regulatory filings and compliance verification. Required for DOT

attributes.name: certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the issued regulatory certificate expires, triggering the need for a subsequent inspection to maintain compliance.
attributes.references: DOT Inspection Intervals, ICAO Continuing Airworthiness Requirements

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date
attributes.description: The date the regulatory certificate or compliance document was officially issued following successful inspection.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the regulatory certificate or compliance document issued. Used for regulatory reporting and audit verification.
attributes.references: DOT Certificate Numbering, ICAO Certificate Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_deadline
attributes.description: The date by which all required corrective actions must be completed to maintain regulatory compliance and operational status.
attributes.references: DOT Compliance Timelines, ICAO Corrective Action Requirements

attributes.name: corrective_actions_required
attributes.description: Detailed description of corrective actions, repairs, or remediation work required to address identified defects and achieve compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inspection record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: critical_defects_count
attributes.description: Number of critical or safety-related defects that require immediate corrective action and may result in asset being placed out of service.
attributes.references: DOT Out-of-Service Criteria, ICAO Safety Management Standards

attributes.name: defects_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of all defects, non-conformances, and observations identified during the inspection. Includes severity classification and affected components.

attributes.name: defects_identified_count
attributes.description: Total number of defects, non-conformances, or discrepancies identified during the inspection. Zero indicates no issues found.

attributes.name: inspection_checklist_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the standardized inspection checklist or procedure document used to conduct this inspection.

attributes.name: inspection_cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for conducting the inspection, including labor, materials, third-party fees, and administrative overhead.

attributes.name: inspection_cost_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the inspection cost amount.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the inspection was conducted. This is the principal business event timestamp for regulatory compliance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date Format, DOT Inspection Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: inspection_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the digital inspection report, certificate scan, or supporting documentation stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: inspection_end_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the inspection was completed. Used to calculate inspection duration and resource utilization.

attributes.name: inspection_location
attributes.description: Physical location where the inspection was performed (e.g., depot name, roadside checkpoint, port facility, maintenance hangar).

attributes.name: inspection_location_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the jurisdiction where the inspection took place. Critical for determining applicable regulatory framework.

attributes.name: inspection_notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes, observations, or comments recorded by the inspector that provide context beyond structured fields.

attributes.name: inspection_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier or reference number for this inspection event, often used for regulatory reporting and audit trails.
attributes.references: DOT Inspection Standards, ICAO Annex 8, IMO Resolution A.1120(30)

attributes.name: inspection_outcome
attributes.description: Overall result of the inspection. Pass indicates full compliance; fail indicates critical defects requiring immediate action; conditional pass indicates minor defects with corrective action required within a specified timeframe.
attributes.references: DOT Out-of-Service Criteria, ICAO Airworthiness Standards, IMO Port State Control Guidelines

attributes.name: inspection_start_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the inspection commenced. Used for operational tracking and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the inspection event. Tracks progression from scheduling through completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Category of inspection conducted. Determines the regulatory framework, scope, and compliance requirements applicable to this inspection event.
attributes.value_regex: DOT roadside inspection|ICAO airworthiness check|IMO vessel survey|pre-trip inspection|annual safety inspection|C-TPAT security inspection
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA Regulations, ICAO Annex 8, IMO SOLAS Convention, C-TPAT Security Criteria

attributes.name: inspector_authority
attributes.description: The organization or regulatory body under whose authority the inspection was conducted (e.g., DOT, ICAO, IMO, internal fleet safety team, third-party auditor).
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA, ICAO, IMO, C-TPAT Program Guidelines

attributes.name: inspector_certification_number
attributes.description: Official certification or license number of the inspector, required for regulatory inspections to validate inspector qualifications.
attributes.references: DOT Inspector Certification, ICAO Licensing Standards

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who conducted the inspection. May be an internal employee or external regulatory authority representative.
attributes.references: Internal HR Standards, DOT Inspector Certification Requirements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inspection record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next scheduled inspection of this type must be conducted to maintain regulatory compliance and operational certification.
attributes.references: DOT Inspection Intervals, ICAO Continuing Airworthiness, IMO Survey Schedules

attributes.name: odometer_reading_at_inspection
attributes.description: Odometer or usage meter reading (kilometers, miles, flight hours, engine hours) recorded at the time of inspection. Used for maintenance interval tracking.

attributes.name: out_of_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset was placed out of service as a result of this inspection due to critical safety defects or regulatory non-compliance.
attributes.references: DOT Out-of-Service Order Criteria, ICAO Airworthiness Directives

attributes.name: out_of_service_start_date
attributes.description: The date the asset was officially placed out of service following the inspection. Null if asset was not taken out of service.

attributes.name: regulatory_certificate_issued
attributes.description: Name or type of regulatory certificate, permit, or compliance document issued as a result of passing this inspection (e.g., DOT Annual Inspection Certificate, ICAO Certificate of Airworthiness, IMO Safety Equipment Certificate).
attributes.references: DOT Certification Standards, ICAO Annex 8, IMO SOLAS Convention

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for any regulatory filing, report, or submission made to authorities as a result of this inspection (e.g., DOT inspection report number, ICAO occurrence report).
attributes.references: DOT Reporting Requirements, ICAO Safety Reporting Standards

attributes.name: reinspection_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the reinspection must be conducted to verify corrective action completion. Null if no reinspection is required.

attributes.name: reinspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up reinspection is required to verify that corrective actions have been completed and defects resolved.

products.name: asset_licence
products.description: Master record tracking all regulatory licences, permits, certificates, and registrations associated with individual fleet assets. Captures asset reference, licence/permit type (vehicle registration, operating licence, airworthiness certificate, vessel class certificate, dangerous goods transport permit, oversize/overweight permit, cross-border transit permit), issuing authority, issue date, expiry date, licence number, jurisdiction/country, renewal reminder days, and current validity status. Ensures DOT, ICAO, IMO, and national transport authority compliance across the global fleet.
products.reference: DOT Operating Authority / ICAO Certificate of Airworthiness

attributes.name: asset_licence_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset licence record. Primary key.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fleet asset (vehicle, aircraft, vessel, container) to which this licence applies.

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Business justification: Asset licenses reference supporting documents including license applications, renewal certificates, and regulatory approval letters. Essential for license compliance tracking and renewal management in

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this licence record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the scanned or digital copy of the physical licence certificate or permit document stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the licence becomes legally valid and enforceable. May differ from issue_date if there is a grace period or delayed activation.

attributes.name: endorsements
attributes.description: Additional endorsements, restrictions, or special conditions attached to the licence (e.g., hazmat endorsement, night flight restriction, coastal waters only). Free-text field for regulatory notes.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the licence or permit expires and is no longer valid. Null for licences with indefinite validity or those that do not expire.

attributes.name: inspection_authority
attributes.description: Name of the agency or third-party organization authorized to conduct inspections for this licence (e.g., FAA Designated Airworthiness Representative, Port State Control Inspector).

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a physical inspection or audit by the regulatory authority is required as part of the licence issuance or renewal process. True = inspection required; False = no inspection required.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the licence or permit was officially issued by the regulatory authority. Marks the start of the licence validity period.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body, government agency, or certification authority that issued the licence or permit (e.g., Federal Aviation Administration, Department of Motor Vehicles, Port State Control).

attributes.name: issuing_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction that issued the licence (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, CHN).

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Specific jurisdiction, state, province, or region within the issuing country where the licence is valid (e.g., California, Ontario, Bavaria). Null if the licence is valid nationwide.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory inspection or audit conducted for this licence. Null if no inspection has been performed.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this licence record. Tracks data modification history for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: licence_category
attributes.description: Sub-classification or category code within the licence type (e.g., for vehicle registration: commercial, private, heavy goods; for airworthiness: transport category, restricted category).

attributes.name: licence_class
attributes.description: Class designation within the licence category, defining specific operational limits or capabilities (e.g., Class 1 for heavy trucks, Class A for multi-engine aircraft).

attributes.name: licence_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fee paid to the issuing authority for the issuance or renewal of this licence. Excludes taxes and processing charges.

attributes.name: licence_fee_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the licence fee amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: licence_number
attributes.description: The official licence, permit, or certificate number issued by the regulatory authority. This is the externally-known unique identifier for the licence.

attributes.name: licence_type
attributes.description: Classification of the licence or permit. Defines the regulatory purpose and scope of the licence (e.g., vehicle registration for road use, airworthiness certificate for aircraft operation, dangerous goods permit for hazardous cargo transport). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vehicle_registration|operating_licence|airworthiness_certificate|vessel_class_certificate|dangerous_goods_permit|oversize_overweight_permit|cross_border_transit_permit|emission_certificate|insurance_certificate|roadworthiness_certificate — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory inspection or audit required to maintain licence validity. Null if no future inspection is scheduled.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special conditions, or operational notes related to this licence (e.g., pending appeal, conditional approval, temporary exemption granted).

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Payment transaction reference or receipt number for the licence fee payment. Used for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation of the specific regulation, statute, or legal framework under which this licence is issued (e.g., 49 CFR Part 383, ICAO Annex 8, SOLAS Chapter II-1).

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the licence renewal process must be initiated to avoid lapse. Typically set ahead of expiry_date to allow processing time.

attributes.name: renewal_reminder_days
attributes.description: Number of days before expiry_date when automated renewal reminders should be triggered to fleet managers and compliance officers.

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the fleet manager, compliance officer, or department responsible for managing and renewing this licence.

attributes.name: validity_status
attributes.description: Current validity state of the licence. Indicates whether the asset is legally compliant to operate under this licence. Valid = currently active and compliant; Expired = past expiry date; Suspended = temporarily invalid; Revoked = permanently cancelled; Pending Renewal = renewal application submitted; Pending Approval = initial application under review.

products.name: incident
products.description: Transactional record capturing all fleet-related incidents including road accidents, near-misses, cargo damage events, vehicle breakdowns, and security incidents. Tracks incident datetime, location (GPS coordinates and address), asset reference, driver reference, incident type, severity classification, third-party involvement flag, police report number, injuries reported, estimated asset damage cost, cargo damage reference, insurance claim reference, root cause classification, and corrective action status. Feeds the claim domain for cargo insurance processing and supports DOT accident reporting obligations.
products.reference: DOT Accident Report / IATA Safety Occurrence Report

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fleet incident record. Primary key.

attributes.name: asset_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.asset_assignment. Business justification: Incidents occur during specific operational assignments (asset_assignment represents a vehicle assigned to a freight order/route). Linking incident to asset_assignment provides full operational contex

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: Incidents involving contracted carrier assets or drivers require carrier linkage for liability determination, insurance claims processing, carrier performance impact assessment, and regulatory reporti

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment being transported at the time of the incident (if applicable). Links to cargo damage claims.

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.declaration. Business justification: Incidents during cross-border transport (accidents, cargo damage, theft) must be reported in relation to customs declarations for insurance claims, duty adjustments, and regulatory investigations. Req

attributes.name: driver_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the driver or operator assigned to the asset at the time of the incident.

attributes.name: geofence_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.geofence_zone. Business justification: Incidents have location coordinates (latitude/longitude). Linking to geofence_zone identifies which monitored zone the incident occurred in, supporting zone-based safety analysis, regulatory complianc

attributes.name: hse_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.hse_incident. Business justification: Fleet incidents (vehicle accidents, collisions, cargo damage) are a specialized subset of HSE incidents. Linking enables unified incident management, root cause analysis, and regulatory reporting (OSH

attributes.name: insurance_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance claim filed for this incident (if applicable). Links to the claim domain for processing.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transport asset (vehicle, aircraft, vessel, container) involved in the incident.

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Business justification: Incidents generate police reports, insurance claim documents, investigation reports, and DOT regulatory filings. Critical for incident management, insurance claims processing, and regulatory complianc

attributes.name: trip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.trip. Business justification: Incidents (accidents, near-misses, cargo damage) occur during specific trips. Adding trip_id links the incident to the trip record for trip-level safety analysis and reporting. Nullable for incidents

attributes.name: asset_damage_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the asset damage estimated cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: asset_damage_estimated_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost of damage to the transport asset (vehicle, aircraft, vessel, container) in the incident currency. Includes repair or replacement costs.

attributes.name: cargo_damage_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cargo damage estimated cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: cargo_damage_estimated_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost of damage to cargo or goods in the incident currency. Used for cargo claim processing.

attributes.name: cargo_damage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether cargo or goods being transported were damaged in the incident. True if cargo damaged, False otherwise.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of corrective actions taken or planned to prevent recurrence, including training, maintenance, policy changes, or process improvements.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective actions are required to prevent recurrence of similar incidents. True if corrective actions required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: corrective_action_status
attributes.description: Current status of corrective actions identified for this incident. Not_required: no actions needed. Pending: actions identified but not started. In_progress: actions being implemented. Completed: all actions finished. Overdue: actions past due date.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this incident record was first created in the fleet management system.

attributes.name: datetime
attributes.description: The date and time when the incident occurred in the field. This is the real-world event timestamp, distinct from when the incident was reported or recorded in the system.

attributes.name: dot_report_submitted_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: DOT (Department of Transportation) Report Submitted Date
attributes.description: Date when the DOT accident report was submitted to the regulatory authority (if applicable).
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) 49 CFR Part 390

attributes.name: dot_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this incident meets the US Department of Transportation (DOT) criteria for mandatory accident reporting. True if DOT reportable, False otherwise.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) 49 CFR Part 390

attributes.name: fatality_count
attributes.description: Total number of fatalities resulting from the incident.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) Accident Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: incident_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique incident reference number used for tracking and reporting. Format: INC-XXXXXXXXXX.

attributes.name: incident_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the incident record. Reported: initial notification received. Under_investigation: active investigation in progress. Pending_review: investigation complete, awaiting management review. Closed: incident resolved and closed. Reopened: closed incident reopened for additional investigation.

attributes.name: incident_type
attributes.description: Classification of the incident: accident (collision or crash), near_miss (potential accident avoided), breakdown (mechanical failure), cargo_damage (damage to goods), security_incident (unauthorized access or threat), theft (asset or cargo stolen).

attributes.name: injuries_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any injuries (to driver, passengers, or third parties) were reported as a result of the incident. True if injuries reported, False otherwise.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) Accident Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: injury_count
attributes.description: Total number of individuals injured in the incident, including driver, passengers, and third parties.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) Accident Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: investigation_assigned_to
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the safety officer, manager, or team assigned to investigate this incident.

attributes.name: investigation_completed_date
attributes.description: Date when the incident investigation was completed and findings documented.

attributes.name: location_address
attributes.description: Human-readable street address or location description where the incident occurred. May include route number, mile marker, or landmark.

attributes.name: location_city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the incident occurred.

attributes.name: location_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the incident occurred (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: location_latitude
attributes.description: GPS (Global Positioning System) latitude coordinate of the incident location in decimal degrees. Range: -90 to +90.

attributes.name: location_longitude
attributes.description: GPS (Global Positioning System) longitude coordinate of the incident location in decimal degrees. Range: -180 to +180.

attributes.name: location_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the incident location.

attributes.name: location_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the incident occurred.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, witness statements, or supplementary information about the incident.

attributes.name: police_department
attributes.description: Name of the law enforcement agency or police department that responded to the incident.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) Accident Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: police_report_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a police report was filed for this incident. True if police report filed, False otherwise.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) Accident Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: police_report_number
attributes.description: Official police report or case number assigned by law enforcement agency (if applicable).
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) Accident Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: reported_datetime
attributes.description: The date and time when the incident was first reported to the fleet management system or control center.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the root cause of the incident. Driver_error: human error by driver. Mechanical_failure: asset malfunction. Road_conditions: poor road surface or infrastructure. Weather: adverse weather conditions. Third_party_fault: caused by external party. Cargo_shift: improper cargo loading or securing. Unknown: cause not yet determined. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: driver_error|mechanical_failure|road_conditions|weather|third_party_fault|cargo_shift|unknown — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the root cause analysis findings and contributing factors to the incident.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the incident based on impact to personnel, asset, cargo, and operations. Minor: no injuries, minimal damage. Moderate: minor injuries, moderate damage. Major: serious injuries, significant damage. Critical: fatalities or catastrophic damage.

attributes.name: third_party_contact
attributes.description: Contact phone number or email address for the third party involved in the incident.

attributes.name: third_party_insurance_provider
attributes.description: Name of the insurance company covering the third party involved in the incident.

attributes.name: third_party_involved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a third party (another vehicle, pedestrian, property owner, or external entity) was involved in the incident. True if third party involved, False otherwise.

attributes.name: third_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the third party individual or organization involved in the incident (if applicable).

attributes.name: third_party_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number of the third party involved in the incident.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this incident record was last modified or updated.

products.name: asset_utilisation
products.description: Periodic operational record (daily/weekly snapshot) capturing fleet utilisation metrics for each transport asset. Tracks asset reference, reporting period (date), total available hours, total operational hours, total idle hours, total downtime hours (maintenance + breakdown), distance travelled (km/miles), load factor (actual payload vs capacity), number of trips completed, fuel efficiency (litres per 100km or MPG), and utilisation rate percentage. This is an operational Silver Layer record — NOT an analytics aggregate — representing the daily operational state of each asset for fleet management decisions.

attributes.name: asset_utilisation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset utilisation record. Primary key for this operational snapshot.

attributes.name: assigned_depot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the depot, terminal, or home location where the asset is based during the reporting period.

attributes.name: driver_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary driver or operator assigned to the asset during the reporting period. Links to workforce management for driver assignment tracking.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary route or network lane the asset operated on during the reporting period. Links to route and network domain for route execution analysis.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transport asset (vehicle, aircraft, vessel, container) for which utilisation is being tracked.

attributes.name: actual_payload_kg
attributes.description: Total actual payload weight carried by the asset during the reporting period, measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: co2_emissions_kg
attributes.description: Total greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions produced by the asset during the reporting period, measured in kilograms of carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e). Critical for sustainability reporting and compliance with EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) and Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA).

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Regulatory compliance status of the asset during the reporting period. Indicates whether the asset met Department of Transportation (DOT), International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), International Maritime Organization (IMO), or other applicable regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for revenue and cost amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: distance_travelled_km
attributes.description: Total distance travelled by the asset during the reporting period, measured in kilometers. Captured from GPS (Global Positioning System) telematics or odometer readings.

attributes.name: distance_travelled_miles
attributes.description: Total distance travelled by the asset during the reporting period, measured in miles. Provided for regions using imperial units.

attributes.name: fuel_consumed_liters
attributes.description: Total fuel consumed by the asset during the reporting period, measured in liters.

attributes.name: fuel_efficiency_liters_per_100km
attributes.description: Fuel efficiency metric representing liters consumed per 100 kilometers travelled. Key operational expense (OPEX) and sustainability metric.

attributes.name: fuel_efficiency_mpg
attributes.description: Fuel efficiency metric representing miles per gallon (MPG). Provided for regions using imperial units.

attributes.name: load_factor_percent
attributes.description: Percentage representing the ratio of actual payload to maximum payload capacity. Key performance indicator (KPI) for asset efficiency.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, exceptions, or contextual information about the asset utilisation during the reporting period.

attributes.name: number_of_trips
attributes.description: Total count of completed trips or delivery runs performed by the asset during the reporting period.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of trips completed on time during the reporting period. Key service level agreement (SLA) metric for customer satisfaction.

attributes.name: operating_cost
attributes.description: Total operating expenditure (OPEX) incurred by the asset during the reporting period, including fuel, maintenance, tolls, and driver costs.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the asset during the reporting period. Indicates whether the asset was actively deployed, idle, under maintenance, experiencing breakdown, retired, or reserved.

attributes.name: payload_capacity_kg
attributes.description: Maximum payload capacity of the asset in kilograms. Used to calculate load factor.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: The granularity of the reporting period: daily, weekly, or monthly snapshot.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this utilisation record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this utilisation record was last modified. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: reporting_period_date
attributes.description: The date for which this utilisation snapshot is recorded. Represents the business event date for daily or weekly operational reporting.

attributes.name: revenue_generated
attributes.description: Total revenue generated by the asset during the reporting period. Used for profitability and return on investment (ROI) analysis.

attributes.name: safety_incidents_count
attributes.description: Total number of safety incidents or accidents involving the asset during the reporting period. Critical for risk management and insurance reporting.

attributes.name: telematics_data_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality score (0-100) representing the completeness and accuracy of GPS (Global Positioning System) telematics and Internet of Things (IoT) sensor data captured during the reporting period. Used to assess data reliability for analytics.

attributes.name: total_available_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the asset was available for operational use during the reporting period, excluding scheduled downtime.

attributes.name: total_breakdown_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the asset was unavailable due to unplanned breakdowns or failures during the reporting period.

attributes.name: total_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the asset was out of service during the reporting period, combining maintenance and breakdown hours.

attributes.name: total_idle_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the asset was idle (available but not in use) during the reporting period.

attributes.name: total_maintenance_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the asset was undergoing scheduled or preventive maintenance during the reporting period.

attributes.name: total_operational_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the asset was actively in operation (moving, transporting cargo, or performing its primary function) during the reporting period.

attributes.name: utilisation_rate_percent
attributes.description: Overall utilisation rate calculated as the ratio of operational hours to available hours, expressed as a percentage. Primary KPI for fleet management decisions.

attributes.name: volume_capacity_cbm
attributes.description: Maximum volume capacity of the asset in cubic meters (CBM). Used to calculate volume utilisation rate.

attributes.name: volume_utilised_cbm
attributes.description: Total cargo volume utilised during the reporting period, measured in cubic meters (CBM). Relevant for container and warehouse assets.

products.name: asset_acquisition
products.description: Master record capturing the full CAPEX lifecycle of fleet asset acquisitions including new purchases, finance leases, and operating leases. Tracks asset reference, acquisition type (outright purchase, finance lease, operating lease, hire purchase), supplier/lessor reference (links to procurement domain), acquisition date, contract start/end date, purchase price or lease value, residual value, depreciation method, depreciation rate, accumulated depreciation, net book value, CAPEX budget code (links to finance domain), and disposal/return date. Supports SAP S/4HANA Finance fixed asset accounting and IFRS 16 lease accounting.
products.reference: IFRS 16 Lease Accounting / SAP Fixed Asset Module

attributes.name: asset_acquisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset acquisition record. Primary key for the asset acquisition data product.

attributes.name: acquisition_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Asset purchases and leases are governed by acquisition contracts. Finance and fleet management link assets to governing purchase/lease agreements for depreciation schedules, payment tracking, lease li

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Capital expenditure approval workflows require tracking which employee authorized asset purchases/leases for financial controls, audit trails, and delegation-of-authority compliance. Text field 'appro

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Links fleet operational asset records to finance fixed asset register for capitalization, depreciation calculation, asset accounting, and financial statement reporting - required for IFRS/GAAP complia

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.network_partner. Business justification: Asset suppliers (leasing companies, OEMs, brokers) are network partners. Enables integrated partner performance tracking across procurement and operations, supports vendor consolidation analysis, and

attributes.name: primary_asset_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor from whom the asset was purchased. Links to procurement domain supplier master data.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transport asset being acquired. Links to the transport_asset master record in the fleet domain.

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Business justification: Asset acquisitions generate purchase contracts, lease agreements, invoices, and financing documents that must be retained for financial audit and asset accounting.
