Required for IFRS 16 lease accountin

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: The total depreciation expense accumulated since acquisition date. Updated periodically based on depreciation method and rate.

attributes.name: acquisition_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the acquisition was approved by the appropriate authority (e.g., CAPEX committee, CFO). Used for governance and audit trails.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the asset was acquired or the purchase transaction was completed. Used as the basis for depreciation calculation and fixed asset accounting.

attributes.name: acquisition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the acquisition transaction. Captures special terms, conditions, or contextual information.

attributes.name: acquisition_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number for the acquisition transaction. Used for tracking and reporting purposes across finance and procurement systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Fixed Asset Accounting

attributes.name: acquisition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the acquisition transaction. Tracks progression from planning through completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: acquisition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the acquisition method. Determines accounting treatment under IFRS 16 and impacts CAPEX vs OPEX classification.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: The fixed asset class or category for accounting purposes (e.g., vehicles, aircraft, vessels, containers). Used for financial reporting and asset grouping.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Fixed Asset Accounting

attributes.name: capex_budget_code
attributes.description: The budget code or cost center code to which this CAPEX acquisition is allocated. Links to finance domain budget and cost center master data.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The scheduled end date of the lease or hire purchase contract. Null for outright purchases. Used to calculate lease term and residual value obligations.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: The unique reference number of the lease or purchase contract. Used for contract management and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The effective start date of the lease or purchase contract. For leases, this is the commencement date under IFRS 16.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this acquisition record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this acquisition record (purchase_price, lease_value, residual_value, etc.).

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used to depreciate the asset over its useful life. Determines how the asset value is expensed over time for financial reporting.

attributes.name: depreciation_rate_percent
attributes.description: The annual depreciation rate expressed as a percentage. Used in conjunction with depreciation_method to calculate periodic depreciation expense.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the asset was disposed of, sold, or returned to the lessor. Marks the end of the asset's lifecycle in the fleet.

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: The method by which the asset was disposed of at the end of its lifecycle. Impacts accounting treatment and gain/loss calculation.

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: The amount received from the sale or disposal of the asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal for financial reporting.

attributes.name: down_payment
attributes.description: The initial down payment or deposit made at the time of acquisition. Reduces the financed amount or lease liability.

attributes.name: financing_institution
attributes.description: The name of the bank or financial institution providing financing for the acquisition. Applicable for financed purchases and leases.

attributes.name: gain_loss_on_disposal
attributes.description: The calculated gain or loss on asset disposal, computed as disposal_proceeds minus net_book_value at disposal date. Impacts P&L reporting.

attributes.name: ifrs16_lease_liability
attributes.description: The calculated lease liability under IFRS 16, representing the present value of future lease payments. Recorded on the balance sheet for finance and operating leases.

attributes.name: ifrs16_right_of_use_asset
attributes.description: The calculated right-of-use asset value under IFRS 16 for lease accounting. Represents the lessee's right to use the leased asset over the lease term.

attributes.name: interest_rate_percent
attributes.description: The annual interest rate applied to the lease or financing agreement. Used for lease liability calculation under IFRS 16.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this acquisition record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: lease_value
attributes.description: The total value of the lease agreement, including all lease payments over the lease term. Used for IFRS 16 right-of-use asset and lease liability calculation.

attributes.name: monthly_lease_payment
attributes.description: The recurring monthly payment amount for leased assets. Used for OPEX tracking and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: The current book value of the asset calculated as purchase_price minus accumulated_depreciation. Represents the asset's carrying value on the balance sheet.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number issued to the supplier or lessor for this acquisition. Links to procurement domain purchase order records.

attributes.name: purchase_price
attributes.description: The total purchase price paid for the asset in the case of outright purchase. Represents the CAPEX investment and forms the basis for fixed asset capitalization.

attributes.name: residual_value
attributes.description: The estimated value of the asset at the end of its useful life or lease term. Used for depreciation calculation and lease accounting under IFRS 16.

attributes.name: tax_depreciation_method
attributes.description: The depreciation method used for tax reporting purposes, which may differ from the book depreciation method. Used for tax compliance and deferred tax calculation.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: The estimated useful life of the asset in years. Used to calculate depreciation and determine the asset's economic lifespan for fleet planning.

attributes.name: warranty_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the manufacturer or supplier warranty coverage expires. Triggers transition to self-funded maintenance.

attributes.name: warranty_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the manufacturer or supplier warranty coverage begins. Used for maintenance planning and cost management.

products.name: asset_disposal
products.description: Transactional record capturing the end-of-life disposal, sale, or return of fleet assets. Tracks asset reference, disposal type (sale, scrap, lease return, write-off, donation), disposal date, disposal proceeds, book value at disposal, gain/loss on disposal, disposal reason, buyer/recipient reference, deregistration date, regulatory decommissioning certificate reference, and environmental disposal compliance flag (e.g., hazardous materials handling). Closes the CAPEX lifecycle initiated in asset_acquisition and triggers finance domain journal entries.
products.reference: IFRS Fixed Asset Disposal / SAP Asset Retirement

attributes.name: asset_disposal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset disposal transaction. Primary key for the asset disposal record.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Asset disposal approval workflows require tracking which employee authorized disposal for financial controls, environmental compliance, and audit trails. Text field 'approved_by' should be replaced wi

attributes.name: disposal_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Asset disposals may be governed by lease return agreements or sale contracts. Finance tracks disposal proceeds against contract terms, residual value commitments, and early termination penalties. Esse

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Disposal transactions must update the fixed asset register to calculate gain/loss on disposal, remove accumulated depreciation, and adjust book value - required for accurate financial statements and t

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fleet asset being disposed. Links to the transport asset master record.

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Business justification: Asset disposals require decommissioning certificates, environmental compliance documents, sale agreements, and deregistration confirmations. Essential for disposal audit trails and environmental compl

attributes.name: waste_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.waste_record. Business justification: Asset decommissioning generates hazardous and recyclable waste requiring regulatory compliance tracking. Links disposal events to waste management records for environmental reporting, circular economy

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation charged against the asset from acquisition through disposal date. Removed from the balance sheet upon disposal.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the disposal transaction was formally approved by authorized management. Part of the disposal workflow audit trail.

attributes.name: book_value_at_disposal
attributes.description: The net book value (original cost minus accumulated depreciation) of the asset at the time of disposal. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal.

attributes.name: buyer_recipient_name
attributes.description: Name of the party acquiring the asset (for sales or trade-ins), receiving the donation, or processing the scrap. Null for write-offs.

attributes.name: buyer_recipient_reference
attributes.description: External identifier or account number for the buyer, recipient, or scrap processor. Used for contract and payment tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the disposal record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this disposal transaction.

attributes.name: decommissioning_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the official certificate or document confirming regulatory decommissioning and compliance with disposal regulations.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: deregistration_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body or government agency that processed the asset deregistration (e.g., FAA, DVLA, national maritime authority).

attributes.name: deregistration_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was officially deregistered from regulatory authorities (e.g., DOT for vehicles, ICAO for aircraft, IMO for vessels). Required for compliance closure.

attributes.name: disposal_costs
attributes.description: Total costs incurred to execute the disposal including transportation, decommissioning, environmental remediation, and administrative fees.

attributes.name: disposal_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166 country code where the disposal transaction occurred. Required for cross-border regulatory compliance and tax reporting.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: The date when the asset disposal transaction was executed and ownership transferred or asset decommissioned. Principal business event timestamp for the disposal.

attributes.name: disposal_location
attributes.description: Physical location or facility where the disposal transaction took place (e.g., depot, scrap yard, auction house, buyer premises).

attributes.name: disposal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special circumstances, or operational details related to the disposal transaction.

attributes.name: disposal_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the disposal transaction. Used for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: The gross amount received from the disposal transaction before any deductions. Zero for scrapping, write-offs, or donations.

attributes.name: disposal_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for disposing of the asset. May include end of useful life, excessive maintenance costs, fleet optimization, regulatory non-compliance, or accident damage.

attributes.name: disposal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the disposal transaction. Tracks the disposal workflow from initiation through completion.

attributes.name: disposal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the disposal method. Determines the financial treatment and regulatory requirements for the asset disposal.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases, IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the disposal was executed in compliance with environmental regulations including hazardous materials handling, waste disposal, and emissions standards. True if compliant, False if non-compliant or pending verification.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, EU ETS, CORSIA

attributes.name: environmental_disposal_method
attributes.description: Description of the environmentally-compliant disposal method used (e.g., certified recycling, authorized scrap yard, hazardous waste facility, parts recovery).

attributes.name: finance_journal_entry_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the general ledger journal entry created to record the disposal transaction, gain/loss, and asset removal from the balance sheet.
attributes.references: IFRS, IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment, SOX

attributes.name: gain_loss_on_disposal
attributes.description: Financial result of the disposal calculated as net disposal proceeds minus book value at disposal. Positive values represent gains, negative values represent losses.

attributes.name: hazardous_materials_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the disposed asset contained hazardous materials requiring special handling (e.g., fuel, batteries, refrigerants, asbestos). True if hazardous materials were present.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods, ISO 14001

attributes.name: insurance_claim_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any insurance claim associated with the disposal (e.g., for accident damage, theft, or total loss). Null if no insurance claim involved.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the disposal record was last modified. Tracks changes throughout the disposal workflow from initiation to completion.

attributes.name: net_disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Net amount realized from disposal after deducting disposal costs from gross proceeds. Used for gain/loss calculation.

attributes.name: odometer_reading_at_disposal
attributes.description: Final odometer or usage meter reading at the time of disposal. Used for lifecycle analysis and residual value assessment. Applicable to vehicles and mobile equipment.

products.name: rfid_scan
products.description: Transactional record capturing RFID tag scan events for fleet assets and containers as they pass through depots, warehouses, ports, and checkpoints. Tracks asset/container reference, RFID tag ID, scan datetime, scan location (depot, gate, dock door, checkpoint), reader device ID, scan direction (inbound/outbound), and associated shipment or freight order reference. Enables real-time asset location tracking, gate automation, and chain-of-custody verification across the logistics network.

attributes.name: rfid_scan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the RFID scan event record.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: RFID scans at carrier handover points (terminals, cross-docks) must track which carrier took custody. Essential for chain-of-custody verification, exception management (missing scans, delays), carrier

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment associated with this RFID scan event. Links the scan to the active shipment being tracked through the network.

attributes.name: container_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.container_unit. Business justification: RFID scans track containers passing through readers. rfid_scan has container_number (STRING) which is denormalized. Adding container_unit_id FK normalizes this relationship and allows direct join to c

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.declaration. Business justification: RFID scans track container/asset movements through customs-controlled zones (ports, border crossings, FTZs). Essential for automated customs clearance, chain-of-custody verification, and supporting el

attributes.name: depot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific facility, depot, warehouse, port, or checkpoint where the scan occurred. Links to the location master data.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the operator or personnel who initiated or supervised the scan event. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: freight_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the freight order associated with this RFID scan event. Links the scan to the freight booking or order being executed.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transport asset (vehicle, aircraft, vessel, container) that was scanned. Links to the fleet transport asset master data.

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Business justification: RFID scans at checkpoints trigger document generation including gate receipts, custody transfer documents, and checkpoint confirmations. Required for chain of custody documentation and checkpoint veri

attributes.name: antenna_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific antenna on the reader device that captured the scan. Used for precise location tracking within the scan zone.

attributes.name: awb_number
attributes.description: Air Waybill number associated with the scanned asset if applicable. Used for air freight tracking and documentation.

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number associated with the scanned asset if applicable. Used for ocean and ground freight documentation.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_verified
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the chain of custody was verified and validated at this scan point. Used for high-value or regulated cargo.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this RFID scan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this scan triggered an exception or alert condition (e.g., unexpected location, unauthorized movement, missing expected scan).

attributes.name: exception_reason
attributes.description: Description of the exception or alert condition if the exception flag is true. Provides context for investigation and resolution.

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate of the scan location. Provides geographic positioning for mobile or field-based RFID readers.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate of the scan location. Provides geographic positioning for mobile or field-based RFID readers.

attributes.name: humidity_percent
attributes.description: Relative humidity percentage recorded at the time of scan. Used for environmental monitoring of sensitive cargo.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the RFID scan event. Used for capturing additional context, observations, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: processing_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the RFID scan record in the data pipeline. Tracks the lifecycle of the scan event from capture to integration.

attributes.name: read_count
attributes.description: Number of times the RFID tag was read during this scan event. Multiple reads may occur as the asset passes through the reader field.

attributes.name: reader_device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the RFID reader device that captured the scan. Used for device tracking, maintenance, and audit purposes.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the RFID tag that was scanned. Typically an Electronic Product Code (EPC) or proprietary tag identifier encoded in the RFID chip.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 18000-6C, GS1 EPC Tag Data Standard

attributes.name: scan_direction
attributes.description: Direction of asset movement at the time of scan. Indicates whether the asset is entering (inbound), leaving (outbound), or being transferred internally within the facility.

attributes.name: scan_event_type
attributes.description: Type of business event that triggered the RFID scan. Categorizes the purpose and context of the scan within the logistics workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gate_entry|gate_exit|dock_arrival|dock_departure|checkpoint_pass|inventory_count|exception_scan — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: scan_location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the facility or checkpoint where the RFID scan occurred.

attributes.name: scan_location_type
attributes.description: Type of facility or checkpoint where the RFID scan occurred. Categorizes the scanning location within the logistics network. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: depot|warehouse|port|gate|checkpoint|dock_door|terminal|hub|cross_dock|customs — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: scan_source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system that generated the RFID scan record (e.g., WMS, TMS, gate automation system, IoT platform).

attributes.name: scan_status
attributes.description: Status of the RFID scan operation. Indicates whether the scan was successfully captured and processed or encountered issues.

attributes.name: scan_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the RFID tag was scanned by the reader device. Represents the real-world event time of the scan occurrence.

attributes.name: scan_zone
attributes.description: Specific zone, gate number, dock door, or checkpoint identifier within the facility where the scan occurred (e.g., Gate 5, Dock Door 12, Zone A).

attributes.name: signal_strength_dbm
attributes.description: Radio frequency signal strength measured in decibels-milliwatts (dBm) at the time of scan. Used for quality assessment and reader optimization.

attributes.name: temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Ambient temperature in Celsius recorded by the RFID reader or associated sensor at the time of scan. Used for cold chain monitoring and environmental compliance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this RFID scan record was last modified or updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the RFID scan record was validated and confirmed by the system. Used for data quality and audit purposes.

products.name: tyre_record
products.description: Master record tracking the lifecycle of individual tyres fitted to road fleet vehicles. Captures tyre serial number, manufacturer, size specification, tyre position on vehicle (axle/position code), fitment date, removal date, tread depth at fitment, current tread depth, mileage at fitment, total mileage accumulated, condition status (serviceable, worn, damaged, retreaded), retreading history, and disposal reason. Enables tyre cost management, safety compliance (minimum tread depth regulations), and predictive replacement scheduling.

attributes.name: tyre_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tyre record. Primary key for the tyre lifecycle tracking entity.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle or transport asset to which this tyre is or was fitted.

attributes.name: waste_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.waste_record. Business justification: End-of-life tyre disposal is a regulated waste stream requiring tracking for environmental compliance and circular economy reporting. Links tyre lifecycle records to waste management for ESG disclosur

attributes.name: condition_status
attributes.description: Current operational condition of the tyre: serviceable=fit for continued use, worn=approaching replacement threshold, damaged=requires repair or replacement, retreaded=has undergone retreading process, condemned=unsafe and must be disposed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tyre record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the purchase cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: current_tread_depth_mm
attributes.description: Most recent tread depth measurement in millimeters. Updated during periodic inspections. Legal minimum is typically 1.6mm for passenger vehicles and 1.0mm for commercial vehicles in most jurisdictions.
attributes.references: DOT Tire Safety Standards, EU Regulation 661/2009

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date when the tyre was permanently disposed of or scrapped. Marks the end of the tyres total lifecycle.

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Method used to dispose of the tyre: recycling=processed for material recovery, landfill=disposed in landfill, energy_recovery=used as fuel in cement kilns or energy plants, resale=sold as used tyre.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, EU Waste Framework Directive

attributes.name: disposal_reason
attributes.description: Reason code indicating why the tyre was removed from service and disposed: end_of_life=normal wear completion, damage=physical damage beyond repair, safety_failure=failed safety inspection, irregular_wear=abnormal wear pattern, sidewall_damage=sidewall structural failure, puncture=irreparable puncture.

attributes.name: fitment_date
attributes.description: Date when the tyre was fitted or installed onto the vehicle. Marks the start of the tyres active service lifecycle on this asset.

attributes.name: fitment_odometer_reading
attributes.description: Vehicle odometer reading in kilometers at the time of tyre fitment. Used to calculate tyre mileage and wear rate.

attributes.name: initial_tread_depth_mm
attributes.description: Tread depth in millimeters measured at the time of fitment. For new tyres, typically 16-18mm for commercial vehicles; for retreaded tyres, typically 12-14mm.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent tyre inspection when tread depth, pressure, and condition were assessed.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tyre record was most recently updated in the system.

attributes.name: last_retread_date
attributes.description: Date when the tyre was most recently retreaded. Nullable if the tyre has never been retreaded.
attributes.references: Tire Retread & Repair Information Bureau (TRIB) Standards

attributes.name: last_rotation_date
attributes.description: Date when the tyre was last rotated to a different position on the vehicle.

attributes.name: load_index
attributes.description: Numerical code indicating the maximum load capacity the tyre can safely carry at the speed indicated by its speed rating.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the tyre manufacturer or brand (e.g., Michelin, Bridgestone, Goodyear, Continental).

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: Manufacturer model or product line designation for the tyre (e.g., X Multi Energy D, R-Drive, Fuel Max).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations, maintenance notes, or special handling instructions related to this tyre.

attributes.name: position_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the physical position of the tyre on the vehicle: FL=Front Left, FR=Front Right, RL1=Rear Left Outer, RL2=Rear Left Inner, RR1=Rear Right Outer, RR2=Rear Right Inner, SPARE=Spare Tyre.

attributes.name: pressure_rating_psi
attributes.description: Manufacturer-recommended tyre inflation pressure in pounds per square inch (PSI) for optimal performance and safety.
attributes.references: Manufacturer Specifications, DOT Tire Safety Standards

attributes.name: purchase_cost
attributes.description: Original purchase cost of the tyre in the specified currency. Used for CAPEX tracking and cost-per-kilometer analysis.

attributes.name: purchase_date
attributes.description: Date when the tyre was purchased or acquired by the fleet operator.

attributes.name: removal_date
attributes.description: Date when the tyre was removed from the vehicle. Nullable until removal occurs. Marks the end of the tyres active service lifecycle on this asset.

attributes.name: removal_odometer_reading
attributes.description: Vehicle odometer reading in kilometers at the time of tyre removal. Used to calculate total tyre mileage and cost per kilometer.

attributes.name: retread_count
attributes.description: Number of times this tyre casing has been retreaded. Commercial truck tyres can typically be retreaded 2-3 times if the casing remains structurally sound.
attributes.references: Tire Retread & Repair Information Bureau (TRIB) Standards

attributes.name: retread_vendor
attributes.description: Name of the vendor or facility that performed the most recent retreading service.

attributes.name: rfid_tag
attributes.description: Unique RFID tag identifier embedded in or attached to the tyre for automated tracking and inventory management.

attributes.name: rotation_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential counter tracking how many times this tyre has been rotated to different positions on the vehicle to promote even wear.

attributes.name: season_type
attributes.description: Seasonal classification of the tyre indicating optimal operating temperature range and weather conditions.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique manufacturer-issued serial number or DOT code identifying the individual tyre unit. Used for warranty claims, recall tracking, and lifecycle traceability.

attributes.name: size_specification
attributes.description: Standard tyre size designation indicating width, aspect ratio, and rim diameter (e.g., 315/80R22.5 for commercial truck tyres).
attributes.references: ETRTO (European Tyre and Rim Technical Organisation) Standards

attributes.name: speed_rating
attributes.description: Letter code indicating the maximum speed capability of the tyre (e.g., J=100 km/h, L=120 km/h for commercial vehicles).

attributes.name: supplier_name
attributes.description: Name of the supplier or vendor from whom the tyre was purchased.

attributes.name: tread_pattern
attributes.description: Tread pattern type or code indicating the design optimized for specific road conditions and applications (e.g., highway, regional, on/off-road).

attributes.name: tyre_mileage_km
attributes.description: Total distance in kilometers accumulated by this tyre during its service on the vehicle. Calculated as removal_odometer_reading minus fitment_odometer_reading.

attributes.name: tyre_type
attributes.description: Construction type of the tyre indicating internal structure and performance characteristics.

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturers warranty coverage for this tyre expires. Nullable if no warranty applies.

products.name: hos_log
products.description: Transactional record capturing electronic logging device (ELD) hours-of-service data for commercial vehicle drivers in compliance with DOT FMCSA regulations. Tracks driver reference, asset reference, log date, duty status segments (off-duty, sleeper berth, driving, on-duty not driving), driving hours for the day, cumulative 70-hour/8-day cycle hours, break periods, violation flags (HOS breach), ELD device ID, and carrier USDOT number. Mandatory for DOT FMCSA compliance for all commercial motor vehicle operations in the US.
products.reference: DOT FMCSA ELD Mandate / 49 CFR Part 395

attributes.name: hos_log_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hours-of-service log record. Primary key.

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.declaration. Business justification: Hours-of-service logs for cross-border drivers may be required as supporting documentation for customs declarations, especially for high-value or time-sensitive shipments. Provides proof-of-transit ti

attributes.name: fatigue_risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.fatigue_risk_assessment. Business justification: HOS logs are primary data source for fatigue risk assessments. Real-world process: ELD data (driving hours, rest breaks, violations) feeds fatigue scoring algorithms; assessments reference specific HO

attributes.name: fleet_driver_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.fleet_driver_assignment. Business justification: HOS log entries are generated during specific driver-asset assignments. Linking to fleet_driver_assignment provides the full context of which driver was assigned to which asset for which run when the

attributes.name: primary_hos_driver_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commercial driver who generated this HOS log entry.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commercial motor vehicle (truck, tractor, or other CMV) operated during this log period.

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Business justification: Hours-of-service logs are regulatory documents that must be retained for FMCSA compliance and DOT audits. Essential for driver duty status documentation and regulatory compliance verification.

attributes.name: trip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.trip. Business justification: HOS log entries record driver duty status during trips. Linking to trip provides the operational trip context for each HOS record. hos_log has shipment_reference_number (STRING) but no structured trip

attributes.name: break_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver has taken the required 30-minute break within the first 8 hours of driving. True if compliant, False if violation detected.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the motor carrier responsible for this HOS log entry.

attributes.name: carrier_usdot_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carrier United States Department of Transportation (USDOT) Number
attributes.description: The USDOT number assigned to the motor carrier operating the commercial vehicle. Mandatory for all interstate carriers.

attributes.name: certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver has certified this log as accurate and complete. True if certified, False if pending certification.

attributes.name: certification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the driver certified this log entry, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this HOS log record was first created in the system, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: cycle_hours_60_7
attributes.description: Cumulative on-duty hours over the preceding 7 days (rolling 7-day period). Used to enforce the 60-hour/7-day cycle limit for carriers operating every day of the week.

attributes.name: cycle_hours_70_8
attributes.description: Cumulative on-duty hours over the preceding 7 days (rolling 8-day period). Used to enforce the 70-hour/8-day cycle limit for carriers not operating every day of the week.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Indicates how this log entry was created: automatic (captured by ELD), manual (entered by driver), edited (modified after initial capture).

attributes.name: destination_location
attributes.description: The ending location (city, state, or facility) where the driver concluded the duty period covered by this log.

attributes.name: distance_driven_miles
attributes.description: The total distance driven in miles during the driving duty status segment.

attributes.name: driving_hours_day
attributes.description: Total hours spent in driving status for the current log date. Used to enforce the 11-hour daily driving limit.

attributes.name: duty_status
attributes.description: The driver's current duty status as defined by FMCSA regulations: off_duty (not working), sleeper_berth (resting in sleeper), driving (operating CMV), on_duty_not_driving (working but not driving).

attributes.name: duty_status_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total duration in minutes that the driver remained in this duty status segment.

attributes.name: duty_status_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the driver exited the current duty status, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format. Null if status is still active.

attributes.name: duty_status_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the driver entered the current duty status, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: edit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this log entry has been edited after initial creation. True if edited, False if original.

attributes.name: edit_reason
attributes.description: The reason provided by the driver or dispatcher for editing this log entry, as required by FMCSA regulations.

attributes.name: edit_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this log entry was last edited, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: eld_device_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the ELD hardware device that captured this log entry. Required for FMCSA ELD mandate compliance.

attributes.name: eld_firmware_version
attributes.description: The firmware version of the ELD device at the time this log was recorded. Used for audit and compliance verification.

attributes.name: eld_manufacturer
attributes.description: The name of the manufacturer of the ELD device used to record this log.

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: The GPS latitude coordinate of the vehicle at the time of this duty status change, in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: The GPS longitude coordinate of the vehicle at the time of this duty status change, in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: last_break_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the driver last took a qualifying break (off-duty or sleeper berth of at least 30 minutes), in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this HOS log record was last modified in the system, in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format.

attributes.name: log_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which this hours-of-service log applies, in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: odometer_end
attributes.description: The vehicle odometer reading in miles at the end of the duty status segment.

attributes.name: odometer_start
attributes.description: The vehicle odometer reading in miles at the start of the duty status segment.

attributes.name: on_duty_hours_day
attributes.description: Total hours spent on duty (driving + on-duty not driving) for the current log date. Used to enforce the 14-hour on-duty limit.

attributes.name: origin_location
attributes.description: The starting location (city, state, or facility) where the driver began the duty period covered by this log.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this HOS log record in the system.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the driver or dispatcher regarding this log entry, such as reasons for edits or special circumstances.

attributes.name: shipment_reference_number
attributes.description: The shipment or load number associated with this duty period, linking the HOS log to freight operations.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: The identification number of the trailer being hauled during this duty period, if applicable.

attributes.name: violation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any HOS violation occurred during this log period. True if violation detected, False if compliant.

attributes.name: violation_severity
attributes.description: The severity classification of the HOS violation for compliance reporting and enforcement prioritization.

attributes.name: violation_type
attributes.description: The specific type of HOS violation detected: 11_hour_driving (exceeded 11-hour driving limit), 14_hour_on_duty (exceeded 14-hour on-duty window), 70_hour_8_day (exceeded 70-hour/8-day cycle), 60_hour_7_day (exceeded 60-hour/7-day cycle), 30_min_break (failed to take required break), 10_hour_off_duty (insufficient off-duty time before shift).

products.name: depot
products.description: Master record for all fleet depots, vehicle yards, maintenance workshops, and staging areas that serve as home bases or operational hubs for fleet assets. Captures depot name, depot code, depot type (vehicle depot, maintenance workshop, fuel station, container yard, ICD), address, GPS coordinates, country, region, capacity (number of vehicles/containers), available maintenance bays, fuel types available, operating hours, and managing business unit. Provides the geographic and operational context for asset assignment and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: depot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fleet depot. Primary key for the fleet depot entity.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the depot location including street number and name.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as building name, suite number, or floor.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the depot is located.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the depot was officially commissioned and began operational service for fleet management activities.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the depot used for operational communications and administrative correspondence.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the depot used for operational coordination and emergency communications.

attributes.name: container_capacity_teu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Container Capacity in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU)
attributes.description: Maximum container storage capacity expressed in TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Units), applicable for container yards and ICDs.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country where the depot is located.

attributes.name: covered_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total covered or indoor area of the depot measured in square meters, including maintenance workshops, warehouses, and covered parking structures.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this depot record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customs_bonded_facility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this depot is a customs-bonded facility authorized to store goods under customs supervision without immediate duty payment. Applicable for ICDs and container yards handling international freight.
attributes.references: WCO Revised Kyoto Convention, US CBP Bonded Warehouse Regulations

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the depot was or is planned to be decommissioned and removed from active operational service.

attributes.name: depot_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the depot used across operational systems and documentation. Typically a short alphanumeric code assigned by the business.

attributes.name: depot_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the fleet depot, vehicle yard, maintenance workshop, or staging area.

attributes.name: depot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the depot based on its primary operational function. Vehicle depot for fleet parking and assignment, maintenance workshop for repairs and servicing, fuel station for refueling operations, container yard for container storage, inland container depot (ICD) for customs clearance and container handling, or staging area for temporary asset holding.

attributes.name: electric_charging_stations
attributes.description: Number of electric vehicle charging stations available at this depot for electric and hybrid fleet assets.

attributes.name: environmental_certification
attributes.description: Environmental management system certification held by the depot (e.g., ISO 14001, LEED certification) demonstrating compliance with sustainability and environmental protection standards.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, LEED Green Building Certification

attributes.name: ftz_designation
attributes.description: Free Trade Zone designation or license number if this depot operates within or as an FTZ, allowing duty-deferred or duty-exempt storage and processing of goods.
attributes.references: WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement, US FTZ Board Regulations

attributes.name: fuel_types_available
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fuel types available at this depot for refueling operations (e.g., diesel, petrol, CNG, LNG, electric charging).

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the depot is certified and equipped to handle, store, and process hazardous materials in compliance with IMDG, IATA Dangerous Goods, and DOT regulations.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods, 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent safety, compliance, or operational inspection conducted at this depot by internal auditors or regulatory authorities.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security, Internal Audit Standard

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this depot record was most recently updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the depot location in decimal degrees format, used for GPS tracking, route planning, and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: lease_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current lease agreement for this depot expires, applicable only for leased facilities. Used for lease renewal planning and CAPEX forecasting.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the depot location in decimal degrees format, used for GPS tracking, route planning, and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: maintenance_bays
attributes.description: Number of maintenance bays or service stations available at this depot for vehicle and equipment servicing and repairs.

attributes.name: managing_business_unit
attributes.description: Name or code of the business unit, division, or department responsible for managing and operating this depot.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory safety, compliance, or operational inspection of the depot facility.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security, Internal Audit Standard

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional operational notes, special instructions, facility constraints, or other relevant information about the depot that does not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: operates_24_7_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the depot operates continuously 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. True for round-the-clock operations, False for limited operating hours.

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.description: Daily end time of depot operations in HH:MM format (24-hour clock). Used for scheduling asset assignments and maintenance activities.

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.description: Daily start time of depot operations in HH:MM format (24-hour clock). Used for scheduling asset assignments and maintenance activities.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the depot indicating whether it is actively serving fleet operations, temporarily unavailable, or permanently closed.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership or operational arrangement for the depot facility. Owned indicates company-owned property, leased indicates rental arrangement, operated under contract indicates third-party management, joint venture indicates shared ownership.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases, Internal Asset Management Standard

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the depot address used for mail delivery and geographic sorting.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Business-defined geographic region or territory to which this depot belongs for organizational reporting and management purposes.

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Classification of physical security measures and access controls implemented at the depot. Relevant for high-value asset storage and compliance with C-TPAT and AEO security requirements.
attributes.references: C-TPAT Security Criteria, AEO Security Standards

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the depot is located.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the depot location used for scheduling maintenance windows, operating hours, and coordinating cross-regional operations.

attributes.name: total_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total land area of the depot facility measured in square meters, including parking areas, buildings, maintenance bays, and storage yards.

attributes.name: vehicle_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of vehicles (trucks, vans, cars) that can be parked or stored at this depot simultaneously.

products.name: asset_type
products.description: Reference data defining the classification taxonomy for all fleet asset types used by Transport Shipping. Captures asset type code, asset category (road vehicle, aircraft, vessel, rail unit, container, ULD), sub-category (rigid truck, articulated truck, cargo aircraft, container ship, flatcar), IATA/IMO/DOT classification code, standard payload capacity, standard CBM capacity, fuel type standard, applicable regulatory framework (DOT, ICAO, IMO), and typical maintenance interval. Provides standardized classification used across transport_asset, maintenance_schedule, and asset_acquisition.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset type classification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Master data governance for asset type definitions requires tracking which employee created asset classifications for data quality accountability, regulatory compliance (IATA/IMO/DOT codes), and audit

attributes.name: asset_category

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: road_vehicle|aircraft|vessel|rail_unit|container|uld|handling_equipment — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: asset_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory within the asset category (e.g., rigid truck, articulated truck, cargo aircraft, container ship, flatcar, dry container, reefer container). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rigid_truck|articulated_truck|van|cargo_aircraft|passenger_aircraft|container_ship|bulk_carrier|tanker|flatcar|boxcar|dry_container|reefer_container|tank_container|flat_rack|open_top|pallet|igloo_uld|forklift|reach_stacker — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: asset_type_description

attributes.name: asset_type_status

attributes.name: average_acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Average acquisition cost for this asset type in the base currency, used for budgeting and Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) planning.

attributes.name: certification_interval_months
attributes.description: Standard interval in months between required certifications for this asset type (e.g., 60 months for CSC container certification).

attributes.name: certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset type requires periodic regulatory certification (e.g., CSC for containers, airworthiness for aircraft).

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the average acquisition cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset type record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Standard depreciation method applied to this asset type for financial reporting: straight-line, declining balance, units of production, or not applicable.

attributes.name: dot_classification_code
attributes.description: US DOT standard classification code for road vehicles and rail units, used for regulatory compliance and safety reporting.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this asset type classification became effective and available for use in asset master data.

attributes.name: emission_standard

products.name: driver_licence_type

products.name: geofence_zone
products.description: Master record defining geographic boundary zones used for fleet telematics monitoring, compliance enforcement, and operational control. Captures zone name, zone type (depot perimeter, restricted area, customs zone, FTZ, low-emission zone, speed restriction zone, curfew zone), polygon boundary coordinates (GeoJSON), applicable asset types, speed limit within zone, entry/exit alert rules, regulatory basis (e.g., EU LEZ regulations, port authority rules), and active status. Drives geofence entry/exit events in telematics_event and supports route compliance monitoring.
products.reference: FourKites Geofence Configuration / EU LEZ Regulations

attributes.name: geofence_zone_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the geofence zone. Primary key for the geofence zone master record.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility or depot associated with this geofence zone. Used for depot perimeter zones and facility-based monitoring. Null for non-facility zones.

attributes.name: hazard_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.hazard_register. Business justification: Geofence zones with hazmat restrictions, speed limits, emission standards, or access controls are defined by hazard assessments. Real-world process: hazard register identifies risk (e.g., school zone,

attributes.name: parent_zone_geofence_zone_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent geofence zone if this zone is nested within a larger zone. Supports hierarchical zone structures. Null for top-level zones.

attributes.name: access_restriction_level
attributes.description: Level of access control enforced for this zone. Values: unrestricted (open access), authorized_only (requires authorization), permit_required (requires permit or credential), prohibited (no entry allowed).
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Management, C-TPAT Security Criteria

attributes.name: active_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the geofence zone. Values: active (zone is operational and monitored), inactive (zone is not currently enforced), suspended (temporarily disabled), planned (zone defined but not yet active).

attributes.name: applicable_asset_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of transport asset types to which this geofence zone applies. Examples: 'truck', 'van', 'container', 'vessel', 'aircraft'. Used to filter zone monitoring by asset category.

attributes.name: boundary_geometry
attributes.description: Geographic boundary definition of the zone stored as GeoJSON polygon coordinates. Contains latitude/longitude coordinate pairs defining the zone perimeter for geospatial matching against GPS telematics data.

attributes.name: center_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the zone's geographic center point in decimal degrees. Used for proximity calculations and zone visualization.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 Standard Representation of Geographic Point Location

attributes.name: center_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the zone's geographic center point in decimal degrees. Used for proximity calculations and zone visualization.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 Standard Representation of Geographic Point Location

attributes.name: city_name
attributes.description: Name of the city or municipality where the zone is located. Used for geographic reporting and operational planning.

attributes.name: coordinate_system
attributes.description: Geographic coordinate reference system used for boundary geometry. Standard values: WGS84 (World Geodetic System 1984 - global standard), NAD83 (North American Datum 1983), ETRS89 (European Terrestrial Reference System 1989).
attributes.references: ISO 19111 Spatial Referencing by Coordinates, EPSG Geodetic Parameter Dataset

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the zone is located. Examples: USA, GBR, DEU, CHN. Used for jurisdictional compliance and reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this geofence zone record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: curfew_end_time
attributes.description: Time of day when curfew restrictions end within the zone. Format: HH:MM (24-hour). Null if no curfew applies.

attributes.name: curfew_start_time
attributes.description: Time of day when curfew restrictions begin within the zone. Format: HH:MM (24-hour). Null if no curfew applies.

attributes.name: dwell_time_threshold_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum permitted dwell time within the zone in minutes before an alert is triggered. Used for monitoring loading/unloading efficiency and unauthorized stops. Null if no dwell time restriction applies.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the geofence zone becomes or became active and enforceable. Used for historical tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: emission_standard_required
attributes.description: Minimum vehicle emission standard required for entry into the zone. Values: EURO_3, EURO_4, EURO_5, EURO_6 (European standards), EPA_2007, EPA_2010 (US EPA standards). Used for low emission zone compliance.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System, CORSIA, EPA Clean Air Act

attributes.name: entry_alert_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time alerts should be generated when an asset enters this zone. True triggers telematics event notifications for zone entry.

attributes.name: exit_alert_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time alerts should be generated when an asset exits this zone. True triggers telematics event notifications for zone exit.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the geofence zone is scheduled to expire or be deactivated. Null for permanent zones. Used for temporary zone management.

attributes.name: hazmat_classes_prohibited
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of UN hazmat classes prohibited in this zone. Examples: '1' (explosives), '2.1' (flammable gases), '7' (radioactive materials). Null if no hazmat restrictions apply.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, IMDG Code

attributes.name: hazmat_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transport of hazardous materials is restricted or prohibited within this zone. True means hazmat restrictions apply.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods, DOT Hazmat Regulations

attributes.name: height_limit_meters
attributes.description: Maximum vehicle height permitted within the zone in meters. Used for tunnel and bridge clearance compliance. Null if no height restriction applies.
attributes.references: UNECE Vienna Convention on Road Traffic

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this geofence zone record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this geofence zone record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special instructions, or context about the geofence zone. Used for documentation and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: operational_hours
attributes.description: Operating hours or time windows when the zone restrictions are active. Format: 'Mon-Fri 06:00-22:00' or '24/7'. Used for time-based compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code associated with the zone location. Used for address-based routing and regional analysis.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority level for monitoring and alert escalation. Values: critical (immediate action required), high (urgent attention), medium (standard monitoring), low (informational only).

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the governing body or authority that enforces regulations for this zone. Examples: 'Port Authority of New York and New Jersey', 'Transport for London', 'US Customs and Border Protection', 'ICAO'.
attributes.references: WCO Framework of Standards, IMO, IATA, ICAO, DOT

attributes.name: regulatory_basis
attributes.description: Legal or regulatory framework that mandates or governs this geofence zone. Examples: 'EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR)', 'IMO SOLAS Chapter XI-2', 'US DOT FMCSA Hours of Service', 'London LEZ Regulations 2008'. Used for compliance tracking and audit trails.
attributes.references: WCO Framework of Standards, IMO SOLAS, EU LEZ Regulations, DOT FMCSA Regulations

attributes.name: speed_limit_kmh
attributes.description: Maximum permitted speed within the zone in kilometers per hour. Used for speed compliance monitoring and driver safety alerts. Null if no speed restriction applies.
attributes.references: UNECE Vienna Convention on Road Traffic

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: State or province code within the country where the zone is located. Examples: 'CA' (California), 'NY' (New York), 'ON' (Ontario). Used for regional compliance and reporting.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the zone location. Examples: 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Shanghai'. Used for timestamp normalization and scheduling.

attributes.name: weight_limit_kg
attributes.description: Maximum gross vehicle weight permitted within the zone in kilograms. Used for bridge and road weight restriction compliance. Null if no weight restriction applies.
attributes.references: UNECE Vienna Convention on Road Traffic

attributes.name: zone_area_sqkm
attributes.description: Total geographic area covered by the zone in square kilometers. Calculated from boundary geometry for reporting and capacity planning.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the geofence zone used in operational systems and reporting. Alphanumeric code following organizational naming standards.

attributes.name: zone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the geofence zone for display and operational reference. Examples: 'JFK Airport Perimeter', 'London Low Emission Zone', 'Port of Rotterdam Customs Area'.

attributes.name: zone_radius_meters
attributes.description: Approximate radius of the zone in meters from the center point. Used for circular geofence zones or as a reference dimension for polygon zones.

attributes.name: zone_subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing additional granularity for the zone type. Examples: 'ULEZ' (Ultra Low Emission Zone), 'CAZ' (Clean Air Zone), 'AEO Facility', 'Bonded Warehouse'.
attributes.references: WCO Framework of Standards, EU LEZ Regulations

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the geofence zone by operational purpose. Values: depot_perimeter (facility boundary), restricted_area (access-controlled zone), customs_zone (customs inspection area), ftz (Free Trade Zone), low_emission_zone (environmental compliance zone), speed_restriction_zone (speed limit enforcement area). attributes.references: ISO 19115 Geographic Information Metadata, WCO Framework of Standards, EU LEZ Regulations

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this geofence zone record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: asset_cost_record
products.description: Transactional record capturing all OPEX cost events associated with individual fleet assets beyond fuel (which is tracked in fuel_transaction). Covers maintenance costs, tyre replacements, insurance premiums, road tolls, port/terminal handling charges (THC), parking fees, cleaning costs, and miscellaneous operational expenses. Tracks asset reference, cost category, cost date, amount, currency, cost centre reference (links to finance domain), supplier invoice reference (links to procurement domain), and GL account code. Enables per-asset total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis and OPEX budget tracking.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Asset OPEX / TCO Tracking

attributes.name: cost_amount

attributes.name: cost_date

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: engine_hours
attributes.description: The cumulative engine operating hours of the asset at the time the cost was incurred. Relevant for aircraft, vessels, and heavy equipment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments about this cost record for audit trail and context.

attributes.name: odometer_reading
attributes.description: The odometer or mileage reading of the asset at the time the cost was incurred, in kilometers. Used for cost-per-km analysis.

attributes.name: payment_date

attributes.name: payment_reference

attributes.name: payment_status

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number authorizing this expenditure, if applicable. Links to procurement domain.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of items or units associated with this cost (e.g., number of tyres replaced, hours of labor, liters of cleaning fluid).

attributes.name: service_location

attributes.name: service_location_country

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: warranty_claim_flag

attributes.name: warranty_claim_number
attributes.description: The warranty claim reference number if this cost is being recovered under manufacturer or supplier warranty.

products.name: reefer_monitoring
products.description: Transactional record capturing continuous temperature and humidity monitoring data for refrigerated (reefer) containers and temperature-controlled vehicles. Tracks container/asset reference, monitoring datetime, set point temperature, actual temperature (multiple sensor zones), humidity reading, CO2 level (for modified atmosphere containers), power source status (plugged-in/genset/battery), alarm flag, alarm type (temperature excursion, power failure, door open), and shipper notification sent flag. Critical for pharmaceutical, perishable food, and cold-chain logistics compliance.

attributes.name: container_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the refrigerated container unit being monitored. Links to the container master data.

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Essential for cold chain documentation, FDA compliance, and temp

attributes.name: alarm_flag

attributes.name: alarm_severity

attributes.name: alarm_type

attributes.name: ambient_temperature_c

attributes.name: battery_level_percent

attributes.name: cargo_type

attributes.name: co2_level_ppm

attributes.name: communication_method

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Assessment of whether this monitoring record meets cold-chain compliance requirements. Used for regulatory reporting and quality assurance.

attributes.name: compressor_running_flag

attributes.name: data_quality_flag

attributes.name: gps_latitude

attributes.name: gps_longitude

attributes.name: humidity_percent

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp

attributes.name: monitoring_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the temperature and environmental readings were captured by the monitoring system. Critical for cold-chain compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when shipper notification was sent. Used to measure notification response time and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: o2_level_percent
attributes.description: Oxygen concentration percentage. Monitored in controlled atmosphere containers to extend shelf life of fresh produce.

attributes.name: power_source_status
attributes.description: Current power source supplying the refrigeration unit. Critical for identifying power interruptions that could compromise cargo.

attributes.name: power_voltage

attributes.name: regulatory_regime

attributes.name: return_air_temperature_c
