attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Discount applied to the toll charge due to fleet agreements, transponder usage, or volume commitments.

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date when the dispute was raised with the toll operator, in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the toll charge is under dispute with the toll operator (True/False).

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Reason for disputing the toll charge, such as incorrect vehicle classification, duplicate charge, or system error.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for toll expenses, used for financial accounting and reporting in the ERP system.

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the toll record was ingested into the data platform, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the toll invoice was issued by the operator, in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the toll point, supporting geospatial analysis and route optimization.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the toll point, supporting geospatial analysis and route optimization.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the toll transaction, such as special circumstances, manual adjustments, or audit findings.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date when payment was made to the toll operator, in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is due to the toll operator, in yyyy-MM-dd format.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method used to pay the toll: electronic transponder, cash, credit card, fleet account, or invoice billing.

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Payment reference number or transaction ID from the accounts payable system, linking the toll charge to the payment record.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of the toll charge: pending, paid, disputed, overdue, waived, or refunded.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or toll operator platform from which the toll record was ingested (e.g., E-ZPass, Telepass, TMS integration).

attributes.name: surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Additional surcharge applied to the toll, such as peak-hour surcharge, heavy vehicle surcharge, or environmental levy.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Value-added tax (VAT), goods and services tax (GST), or other applicable taxes on the toll charge.

attributes.name: toll_amount
attributes.description: Base toll charge amount before any adjustments, discounts, or surcharges.

attributes.name: toll_city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the toll was incurred, particularly relevant for urban congestion charges.

attributes.name: toll_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the toll was incurred, supporting multi-country fleet operations and tax reporting.

attributes.name: toll_invoice_number
attributes.description: Invoice number issued by the toll operator for account-based or post-paid toll transactions, used for accounts payable reconciliation.

attributes.name: toll_location_code
attributes.description: Standardized code or identifier for the toll location used for reporting and cost analysis by route segment.

attributes.name: toll_location_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific toll location, road segment, bridge, tunnel, port gate, or congestion zone where the charge was incurred.

attributes.name: toll_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the toll point: road toll, bridge toll, tunnel toll, port access charge, congestion charge zone, or border crossing fee.

attributes.name: toll_operator_code
attributes.description: Standardized code or identifier for the toll operator used for accounts payable processing and vendor reconciliation.

attributes.name: toll_operator_name
attributes.description: Name of the toll authority, road operator, port authority, or congestion charge agency that levied the charge.

attributes.name: toll_plaza_lane
attributes.description: Specific lane number or identifier at the toll plaza where the transaction occurred, used for audit and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: toll_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the toll was incurred, used for regional cost analysis and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: toll_transaction_number
attributes.description: External transaction identifier provided by the toll operator or payment system for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: total_toll_amount
attributes.description: Net total toll charge including base toll, surcharges, discounts, and taxes. This is the final amount payable to the toll operator.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the toll transaction occurred, recorded in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). This is the principal business event time for the toll charge.

attributes.name: transponder_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the electronic toll collection transponder or RFID tag used for automatic toll payment.

attributes.name: vehicle_class
attributes.description: Toll operator's classification of the vehicle (e.g., Class 2, Class 5, heavy goods vehicle) used to determine the toll rate.

products.name: asset_insurance
products.description: Master record tracking insurance policies covering fleet assets against physical damage, third-party liability, cargo liability, and business interruption. Captures asset reference (or fleet-wide policy flag), insurer name, policy number, policy type (comprehensive, third-party liability, cargo, hull — for aircraft/vessels), coverage start/end date, insured value, premium amount, deductible amount, currency, policy renewal date, broker reference, and claims history count. Distinct from the claim domain which manages individual claim events — this is the policy master record.
products.reference: Fleet Insurance Policy / Marine Hull Policy

attributes.name: asset_insurance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset insurance policy record. Primary key for the asset insurance master data.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: Insurance policies for carrier-operated assets (especially leased or subcontracted) must track carrier for coverage verification, claims processing, and liability determination. Critical for risk mana

attributes.name: container_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific container unit covered by this insurance policy. Null if this is a fleet-wide blanket policy or covers non-container assets.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Insurance premiums are operating expenses that must be allocated to cost centers for budget management; removes denormalized cost_center_code in favor of proper FK for financial reporting.

attributes.name: insurance_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Insurance policies ARE contracts. Risk management links insurance coverage to governing insurance agreement for premium tracking, claims management, coverage verification, and regulatory compliance. E

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific transport asset covered by this insurance policy. Null if this is a fleet-wide blanket policy not tied to a single asset.

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Business justification: Insurance policies are legal documents that must be linked to insured assets for claims processing, compliance verification, and certificate of insurance issuance. Critical for insurance management an

attributes.name: aggregate_limit
attributes.description: The maximum total amount the insurer will pay for all claims during the policy period. Once reached, no further claims are covered until renewal.

attributes.name: broker_name
attributes.description: The name of the insurance broker or intermediary who arranged the policy, if applicable.

attributes.name: broker_reference
attributes.description: The brokers internal reference number for this policy. Used for coordination with the broker on claims and renewals.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date when the policy was cancelled, if applicable. Null for active policies.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The reason for policy cancellation, if applicable. Examples: non-payment of premium, asset disposal, insurer cancellation, policyholder request, regulatory non-compliance.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: The certificate of insurance number issued as proof of coverage. Often required for regulatory compliance and customer contracts.

attributes.name: claims_history_count
attributes.description: The total number of claims filed against this policy since inception. Used for risk assessment and premium calculation at renewal.

attributes.name: coverage_end_date
attributes.description: The date when insurance coverage expires. Claims occurring after this date are not covered unless the policy is renewed.

attributes.name: coverage_limit
attributes.description: The maximum amount the insurer will pay per claim or per policy period. May differ from insured value for liability policies.

attributes.name: coverage_start_date
attributes.description: The date when insurance coverage becomes effective. Claims occurring before this date are not covered.

attributes.name: coverage_territory
attributes.description: The geographic scope of coverage. May be global, regional (e.g., Europe, North America), or country-specific. Defines where claims are valid.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this insurance policy record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this policy (insured value, premium, deductible).

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: The amount the policyholder must pay out-of-pocket before the insurance coverage applies. Also known as excess in some jurisdictions.

attributes.name: endorsements
attributes.description: Additional coverage endorsements or riders attached to the base policy. Examples: hazmat coverage, refrigerated cargo, high-value goods, war risk, terrorism coverage.

attributes.name: exclusions
attributes.description: Specific exclusions or limitations in coverage. Examples: acts of war, nuclear incidents, intentional damage, wear and tear, specific geographic regions.

attributes.name: fleet_wide_policy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a blanket policy covering the entire fleet (True) or a policy specific to individual assets (False). Fleet-wide policies have null asset references.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code for recording insurance premium expenses and claim recoveries in the financial system.

attributes.name: insured_value
attributes.description: The declared value of the asset or fleet covered by the policy. This is the maximum amount the insurer will pay for a total loss.

attributes.name: insurer_code
attributes.description: Internal or industry-standard code identifying the insurance provider. Used for standardized reporting and system integration.

attributes.name: insurer_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the insurance company providing the coverage.

attributes.name: last_claim_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent claim filed under this policy. Used for risk assessment and claims-free discount eligibility.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this insurance policy record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional policy details, special conditions, renewal negotiations, or other relevant information not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: policy_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the stored policy document (contract, terms and conditions). May be a document management system identifier or file path.

attributes.name: policy_issue_date
attributes.description: The date when the insurance policy was officially issued by the insurer. May differ from coverage start date.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The unique policy number assigned by the insurer. This is the externally-known identifier for the insurance contract.

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the insurance policy. Active policies provide coverage; expired policies have passed their end date; cancelled policies were terminated early; pending renewal policies are awaiting renewal processing; suspended policies are temporarily inactive; lapsed policies were not renewed.

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: The type of insurance coverage provided. Comprehensive covers all risks; third-party liability covers damage to others; cargo liability covers goods in transit; hull covers aircraft/vessel structure; physical damage covers vehicle damage; business interruption covers operational losses.

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: The total premium amount paid or payable for this insurance policy. This is the cost of the insurance coverage.

attributes.name: premium_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which premium payments are made. Annual policies are paid once per year; semi-annual twice per year; quarterly four times per year; monthly twelve times per year.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The regulatory body requiring this insurance coverage, if applicable. Examples: DOT (Department of Transportation), ICAO (International Civil Aviation Organization), IMO (International Maritime Organization), FMC (Federal Maritime Commission).
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT), International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), International Maritime Organization (IMO), Federal Maritime Commission (FMC)

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy meets mandatory regulatory insurance requirements (True) or is voluntary additional coverage (False). Relevant for DOT, ICAO, IMO compliance.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT), International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), International Maritime Organization (IMO)

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for policy renewal. Used for planning and ensuring continuous coverage without gaps.

attributes.name: total_claims_paid
attributes.description: The cumulative amount paid by the insurer for all claims under this policy. Used for loss ratio analysis and renewal pricing.

attributes.name: underwriter_name
attributes.description: The name of the underwriter at the insurance company who assessed and approved this policy.

products.name: driver_performance
products.description: Periodic operational record (per trip or per day) capturing driver behaviour and performance metrics derived from telematics and HOS data. Tracks driver reference, asset reference, evaluation period, total distance driven, harsh braking events count, harsh acceleration events count, speeding events count, idling time (minutes), fuel efficiency (actual vs benchmark), HOS compliance flag, geofence violation count, mobile phone usage events (where detectable), and overall safety score. Supports driver coaching programmes, incentive schemes, and DOT safety compliance management.
products.reference: DOT Safety Management System / Fleet Telematics Scorecard

attributes.name: driver_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the driver performance record. Primary key for this periodic operational record capturing driver behavior and performance metrics.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: Driver performance for contracted carrier drivers must link to carrier for benchmarking, SLA compliance verification, and carrier scorecard aggregation. Supports carrier selection decisions, contract

attributes.name: driver_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the driver being evaluated. Links to the driver profile master data.

attributes.name: driver_safety_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.driver_safety_event. Business justification: Driver performance evaluations aggregate safety events (harsh braking, speeding, seatbelt violations) for coaching, incentive programs, and disciplinary actions. Real-world process: telematics events

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supervisor or fleet manager who reviewed and approved this performance record.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route_plan. Business justification: Driver performance metrics (safety scores, fuel efficiency, on-time delivery) are evaluated against specific route plans to measure adherence, identify deviations, and target coaching interventions.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary vehicle or asset operated by the driver during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: trip_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific trip or assignment if this performance record is trip-based rather than daily aggregated.

attributes.name: co2_emissions_kg
attributes.description: Estimated CO2 emissions in kilograms produced during the evaluation period, calculated from fuel consumption and vehicle emission factors.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS), CORSIA

attributes.name: coaching_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drivers performance during this period triggers a requirement for coaching or corrective training. True = coaching needed, False = no coaching required.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this performance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_feedback_score
attributes.description: Average customer satisfaction score for deliveries completed during the evaluation period, typically on a scale of 1-5 or 1-10.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality score reflecting the completeness and reliability of telematics data for this evaluation period. Lower scores may indicate GPS signal loss, device malfunction, or data gaps.

attributes.name: eco_driving_score
attributes.description: Score reflecting the drivers fuel-efficient and environmentally conscious driving behavior, based on factors such as smooth acceleration, optimal speed, and reduced idling.
attributes.references: ISO 28000, CORSIA Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance evaluation period. For single-day records this equals the start date; for multi-day aggregations this captures the period end.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance evaluation period. For trip-based records this is the trip start date; for daily records this is the calendar date.

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the performance evaluation record in the review and approval workflow.

attributes.name: evaluation_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the performance record: trip-level, daily aggregation, weekly summary, or monthly rollup.

attributes.name: fatigue_alert_count
attributes.description: Number of driver fatigue alerts triggered by telematics or in-cab monitoring systems during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: forward_collision_warning_count
attributes.description: Number of forward collision warnings issued by ADAS during the evaluation period, indicating potential rear-end collision risk.

attributes.name: fuel_consumed_liters
attributes.description: Total fuel consumed in liters during the evaluation period, captured from telematics or fuel management systems.

attributes.name: fuel_efficiency_actual_km_per_liter
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fuel Efficiency Actual Kilometers Per Liter (KM/L)
attributes.description: Actual fuel efficiency achieved by the driver during the evaluation period, calculated as total distance divided by fuel consumed.

attributes.name: fuel_efficiency_benchmark_km_per_liter
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fuel Efficiency Benchmark Kilometers Per Liter (KM/L)
attributes.description: Expected or benchmark fuel efficiency for the vehicle type and route conditions, used to compare against actual performance.

attributes.name: fuel_efficiency_variance_percent
attributes.description: Percentage variance between actual and benchmark fuel efficiency. Positive values indicate better-than-expected performance; negative values indicate underperformance.

attributes.name: geofence_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of times the driver entered or exited restricted geofenced areas without authorization during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: harsh_acceleration_events_count
attributes.description: Number of harsh acceleration events detected by telematics during the evaluation period. Harsh acceleration is typically defined as acceleration exceeding a threshold (e.g., +0.3g).

attributes.name: harsh_braking_events_count
attributes.description: Number of harsh braking events detected by telematics during the evaluation period. Harsh braking is typically defined as deceleration exceeding a threshold (e.g., -0.3g).

attributes.name: hos_available_drive_time_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hours of Service (HOS) Available Drive Time Hours
attributes.description: Remaining available driving hours at the end of the evaluation period, based on HOS regulations and the drivers duty cycle.

attributes.name: hos_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver remained compliant with Hours of Service regulations during the evaluation period. True = compliant, False = violation detected.
attributes.references: US DOT Hours of Service (HOS) Regulations, FMCSA Part 395

attributes.name: hos_violation_type
attributes.description: Type of HOS violation if hos_compliance_flag is False. Captures the specific regulation breached (e.g., 11-hour driving limit, 14-hour duty limit, mandatory break).

attributes.name: idling_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes the vehicle engine was running while stationary (idling). Excessive idling impacts fuel efficiency and emissions.

attributes.name: incentive_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver qualifies for performance-based incentives or bonuses based on this evaluation periods metrics. True = eligible, False = not eligible.

attributes.name: incident_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any safety incidents, accidents, or near-misses were reported during the evaluation period. True = incident occurred, False = no incidents.

attributes.name: incident_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the most serious incident during the evaluation period, if any incident occurred.

attributes.name: lane_departure_count
attributes.description: Number of unintentional lane departure events detected by advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this performance record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: mobile_phone_usage_events_count
attributes.description: Number of mobile phone usage events detected while the vehicle was in motion, where telematics systems support this detection capability.

attributes.name: night_driving_hours
attributes.description: Total hours driven during night-time hours (typically defined as 10 PM to 6 AM), which may carry higher risk and fatigue factors.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the drivers performance during this evaluation period, including coaching feedback or incident details.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether deliveries during the evaluation period met the scheduled time windows. True = on-time, False = late.

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the performance record was reviewed and approved by the supervisor.

attributes.name: route_deviation_count
attributes.description: Number of times the driver deviated from the planned or optimized route during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: safety_rating
attributes.description: Categorical safety rating derived from the safety score, used for driver coaching and incentive programs.

attributes.name: safety_score
attributes.description: Composite safety score calculated from weighted factors including harsh events, speeding, HOS compliance, and other safety metrics. Typically scored 0-100, with higher scores indicating safer driving.

attributes.name: seatbelt_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of instances where the driver operated the vehicle without wearing a seatbelt, detected via telematics sensors.
attributes.references: US DOT Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS)

attributes.name: speeding_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes the driver spent exceeding speed limits during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: speeding_events_count
attributes.description: Number of speeding violations detected during the evaluation period, where vehicle speed exceeded posted speed limits or company policy thresholds.
attributes.references: US DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA)

attributes.name: telematics_device_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the telematics device that captured the performance data for this evaluation period.

attributes.name: total_distance_km
attributes.description: Total distance driven by the driver during the evaluation period, measured in kilometers. Derived from telematics odometer readings.

attributes.name: total_driving_time_hours
attributes.description: Total hours the driver spent actively driving (ignition on, vehicle in motion) during the evaluation period.
attributes.references: US DOT Hours of Service (HOS) Regulations

products.name: asset_position
products.description: Near-real-time master record holding the CURRENT known position and status of each fleet asset, updated from telematics_event stream via FourKites. Captures asset reference, last known GPS coordinates, last update timestamp, current speed, current heading, current geofence zone, current assignment reference, estimated arrival datetime (ETA) at next waypoint, asset operational status (in-transit, idle, at-depot, in-maintenance, out-of-contact), and data source (GPS, RFID, manual update). Serves as the live fleet visibility layer for TMS dispatchers and customer-facing shipment tracking.
products.reference: FourKites Real-Time Visibility / GPS Fleet Tracking

attributes.name: asset_position_id

attributes.name: asset_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active asset assignment or trip the asset is currently executing.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: Real-time asset positions for carrier-operated assets must track carrier for visibility dashboards, exception management (geofence violations, delays), customer communication, and carrier performance

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment currently being transported by this asset, enabling customer-facing tracking.

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.declaration. Business justification: Real-time asset positions verify cross-border movements and support customs declarations with GPS-based proof-of-transit. Critical for automated border crossings, trusted trader programs, and customs

attributes.name: driver_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the driver currently operating or assigned to this asset.

attributes.name: freight_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the freight order or transport order the asset is currently fulfilling.

attributes.name: geofence_zone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geofence zone the asset is currently within, used for location-based alerts and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the next planned stop or waypoint on the asset's route.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the planned route the asset is currently following.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fleet asset (vehicle, aircraft, vessel, container) whose position is being tracked.

attributes.name: altitude_m
attributes.description: Altitude of the asset above sea level in meters, relevant for aircraft and mountainous terrain tracking.

attributes.name: asset_number

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fleet asset type being tracked. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: truck|trailer|van|aircraft|vessel|container|railcar|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: battery_voltage
attributes.description: Current battery voltage of the asset or telematics device, used for health monitoring and maintenance alerts.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the asset is currently located, critical for customs and cross-border compliance.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of the quality and reliability of this position record, used to filter or weight data in analytics.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or method by which this position data was captured (GPS telematics, RFID scan, manual update, AIS for vessels, ADS-B for aircraft). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gps|rfid|manual|ais|ads-b|cellular|wifi — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: distance_to_next_waypoint_km
attributes.description: Remaining distance in kilometers from current position to the next waypoint.

attributes.name: eta_next_waypoint
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) Next Waypoint
attributes.description: Predicted arrival date and time at the next waypoint, calculated from current position, speed, and route. Critical for customer notifications and SLA monitoring.

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position triggered any exception or alert condition (geofence breach, delay, route deviation, out-of-contact).

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exception or alert triggered by this position (e.g., geofence-exit, delay, route-deviation, speed-violation, temperature-excursion). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: geofence-exit|geofence-entry|delay|route-deviation|speed-violation|temperature-excursion|unauthorized-stop|out-of-contact|harsh-braking|harsh-acceleration — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fuel_level_percent
attributes.description: Current fuel level as a percentage of tank capacity, used for refueling planning and range estimation.

attributes.name: gps_accuracy_m
attributes.description: Accuracy radius of the GPS position fix in meters, indicating the reliability of the location data.

attributes.name: gps_satellite_count
attributes.description: Number of GPS satellites used to calculate the current position, affecting accuracy and reliability.

attributes.name: heading_degrees
attributes.description: Current compass heading or direction of travel in degrees (0-360), where 0/360 is North, 90 is East, 180 is South, 270 is West.

attributes.name: ignition_state
attributes.description: Current state of the vehicle ignition, indicating whether the engine is running.

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this position record was ingested into the lakehouse platform, used for data lineage and latency monitoring.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this position record was last modified or refreshed in the system.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the asset's current position in decimal degrees (WGS84).

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Business code identifying the specific facility, depot, or site where the asset is currently located.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the current location type where the asset is positioned. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: depot|warehouse|customer-site|port|airport|border-crossing|rest-area|in-transit|unknown — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the asset's current position in decimal degrees (WGS84).

attributes.name: next_waypoint_name
attributes.description: Name of the next planned stop or destination for operational display.

attributes.name: odometer_km
attributes.description: Cumulative odometer reading in kilometers at the time of this position capture, used for maintenance scheduling and utilization tracking.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the asset indicating its activity and availability. Critical for fleet visibility and dispatch decisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in-transit|idle|at-depot|in-maintenance|out-of-contact|loading|unloading — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: position_age_minutes
attributes.description: Number of minutes elapsed since this position was captured, indicating data freshness for real-time visibility.

attributes.name: position_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this position was recorded or last updated. This is the principal business event timestamp representing when the asset was at this location.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier associated with the asset for automated scanning and tracking at checkpoints.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that provided this position data (e.g., FourKites, Samsara, Geotab).

attributes.name: speed_kmh
attributes.description: Current speed of the asset in kilometers per hour at the time of position capture.

attributes.name: telematics_device_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the telematics or GPS tracking device that captured this position data.

attributes.name: temperature_c
attributes.description: Current cargo or ambient temperature in Celsius for temperature-controlled assets (reefer containers, refrigerated trucks).

products.name: depot_initiative_implementation
products.description: This association product represents the implementation of a sustainability initiative at a specific fleet depot. It captures the site-specific execution details, investment allocation, and emissions reduction performance for each depot-initiative combination. Each record links one fleet depot to one sustainability initiative with attributes that exist only in the context of this site-level implementation, enabling capital planning, ROI tracking, and sustainability target monitoring at the depot level.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, sustainability initiatives such as solar panel installation, LED lighting retrofit, EV charging infrastructure deployment, and waste reduction programs are implemented across multiple depot sites, with each depot hosting multiple concurrent initiatives. The business actively manages site-specific implementation records to track rollout progress, allocate capital investment by location, measure site-level emissions reductions, and report on sustainability target achievement at the depot level for ESG compliance and capital planning.

attributes.name: depot_initiative_implementation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this depot-initiative implementation record. Primary key.

products.name: depot_certification
products.description: This association product represents the certification relationship between fleet depots and compliance programs. It captures facility-specific certification status, audit history, and security assessments for each depot under each compliance program (C-TPAT, AEO, bonded warehouse status). Each record links one fleet depot to one compliance program with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific certification relationship.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, fleet depots (terminals, warehouses, maintenance facilities) are independently certified under multiple compliance programs simultaneously - a single depot may hold C-TPAT facility security certification, AEO site certification, and bonded warehouse status concurrently. Conversely, each compliance program certifies many facilities across the network. Each depot-program certification is managed independently with its own audit schedule, certification dates, security assessments, and compliance status.

attributes.name: depot_certification_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the depot certification association record

attributes.name: compliance_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the compliance program under which the depot is certified

attributes.name: depot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the fleet depot being certified

attributes.name: fleet_depot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to fleet_depot

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance audit conducted at this specific depot for this program. Each depot-program combination has its own audit schedule.

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: Numerical score or rating assigned to this depot during the most recent audit for this compliance program. Measures facility-specific compliance performance.

attributes.name: certification_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing facility-specific conditions, exceptions, or observations related to this depot's certification under this program.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current status of this specific depot's certification under this compliance program. Tracks the lifecycle state of the facility-specific certification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification relationship record was created in the system.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this depot's certification under this program expires. Facility-specific expiry may differ from program-level expiry based on audit cycles.

attributes.name: facility_certification_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific depot received certification under this compliance program. Distinct from the program's general issue_date as each facility is certified individually.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification relationship record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance audit at this depot for this program.

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Security classification assigned to this depot under this specific compliance program. Different programs may assign different security levels to the same facility.

products.name: driver_certification
products.description: This association product represents the certification relationship between driver_profile and compliance_program. It captures the driver-specific certification status, training completion, and background check requirements for each customs compliance program (C-TPAT, AEO, FAST). Each record links one driver to one compliance program with certification dates, status, and expiry tracking that exist only in the context of this driver-program relationship.. Existence Justification: In cross-border logistics operations, drivers must be individually certified under multiple customs compliance programs (C-TPAT, AEO, FAST) to operate specific routes, and each program certifies many drivers with program-specific training, background checks, and expiry dates. Fleet managers actively manage these driver-program certifications to ensure route assignment compliance, tracking certification status, training completion, and renewal cycles per driver per program.

attributes.name: driver_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this driver-program certification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: compliance_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to customs.compliance_program. Identifies which compliance program this certification is for.

attributes.name: driver_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to fleet.driver_profile. Identifies which driver holds this certification.

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date when the background check specific to this compliance program was completed for this driver. Distinct from the general background check in driver_profile as each program may have unique vetting requirements.

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Result status of the program-specific background check. Cleared: passed all program requirements. Pending: under review. Failed: did not meet program criteria. Expired: check is outdated per program rules.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the driver was certified or approved under this specific compliance program. Represents when the driver met all program requirements.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the driver's certification under this program. Active: driver is certified and compliant. Expired: certification lapsed. Suspended: temporarily invalid. Pending: application submitted. Revoked: certification withdrawn.

attributes.name: certifying_officer
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the compliance officer or fleet manager who approved this driver certification under this program.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the IATA dangerous goods certification. Null if driver does not hold this certification. [Moved from driver_profile: This attribute represents the expiry date of the IATA dangerous goods certificate. It should move to driver_certification as expiry_date where certificate_type='Dangerous Goods', enabling unified certificate lifecycle management.]
attributes.references: ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver holds IATA dangerous goods training certification for air cargo handling and transport. True if certified, False otherwise. [Moved from driver_profile: This flag indicates whether a driver holds an IATA dangerous goods certificate. This should be represented as a record in driver_certification where certificate_type='Dangerous Goods' with certification_status='Active' rather than as a boolean flag.]
attributes.references: ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this driver's certification under this specific program expires and must be renewed. May differ from the program's overall expiry date as driver certifications often have individual renewal cycles.

attributes.name: hazmat_endorsement_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the hazmat endorsement. Null if driver does not hold hazmat endorsement. [Moved from driver_profile: This attribute represents the expiry date of the hazmat certificate. It should move to driver_certification as expiry_date where certificate_type='Hazmat Endorsement', consistent with the normalized certificate tracking model.]

attributes.name: hazmat_endorsement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver holds a valid hazmat endorsement allowing them to transport dangerous goods by road. True if endorsed, False otherwise. [Moved from driver_profile: This flag indicates whether a driver holds a hazmat certificate. This should be represented as a record in driver_certification where certificate_type='Hazmat Endorsement' with certification_status='Active' rather than as a boolean flag on the driver profile.]
attributes.references: US DOT FMCSA 49 CFR Part 383, IMDG Code

attributes.name: last_safety_training_date
attributes.description: Date the driver last completed mandatory safety training. Used to ensure compliance with periodic training requirements. [Moved from driver_profile: This represents the completion date of safety training, which results in a training certificate. It should move to driver_certification as training_completion_date where certificate_type='Safety Training Certificate'.]
attributes.references: US DOT FMCSA 49 CFR Part 380, ISO 28000

attributes.name: medical_certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the driver's DOT medical examiner certificate (US) or equivalent medical fitness certificate required for commercial vehicle operation. Drivers must maintain valid medical certification to operate. [Moved from driver_profile: This attribute represents the expiry date of a specific certificate (DOT medical certificate) held by a driver. It should move to the driver_certification association as expiry_date where certificate_type='Medical Certificate'. This allows tracking of multiple certificate types with their individual expiry dates in a normalized structure.]

attributes.name: next_safety_training_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the driver must complete their next mandatory safety training to maintain compliance. [Moved from driver_profile: This represents when the next safety training is due, which is effectively the renewal date for the safety training certificate. It should move to driver_certification as next_renewal_due_date where certificate_type='Safety Training Certificate'.]
attributes.references: US DOT FMCSA 49 CFR Part 380, ISO 28000

attributes.name: next_training_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the driver must complete recurrent training for this compliance program to maintain certification status.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding this specific driver-program certification, including any special conditions, restrictions, or audit findings.

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the driver completed all mandatory training requirements specific to this compliance program (e.g., C-TPAT security awareness, AEO procedures).

products.name: driver_engagement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual engagement between a driver and a carrier partner in the Transport Shipping network. It captures the business relationship when drivers work as owner-operators or independent contractors for multiple carrier partners simultaneously or sequentially. Each record links one driver_profile to one carrier with engagement terms, performance tracking, and compliance status that exist only in the context of this specific driver-carrier relationship.. Existence Justification: In the logistics industry, particularly in gig economy and contractor models, drivers frequently work as owner-operators or independent contractors who can be simultaneously engaged with multiple carrier partners (e.g., a driver working for both FedEx Ground and regional carriers, or platform drivers on multiple apps). Each carrier engagement has its own contract terms, commission rates, performance tracking, and compliance requirements. Carriers manage rosters of many drivers. This is a true operational many-to-many relationship where the business actively manages driver-carrier engagements as distinct business entities.

attributes.name: driver_engagement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this driver-carrier engagement record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the carrier partner in the network domain. Identifies which carrier partner the driver is engaged with.

attributes.name: driver_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the driver profile in the fleet domain. Identifies which driver is engaged in this carrier relationship.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this driver-carrier engagement is currently active. True: driver is actively working for this carrier. False: engagement has ended or is suspended. Used for quick filtering of current engagements.

attributes.name: carrier_specific_training_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver has completed mandatory training specific to this carrier's operations, systems, and procedures. Many carriers require proprietary training beyond general licensing.

attributes.name: carrier_specific_training_date
attributes.description: Date when the driver completed carrier-specific training for this engagement. Null if training not yet completed.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Percentage commission rate paid to the driver for deliveries or routes completed under this carrier engagement. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 15.50 for 15.5%). Varies by carrier and driver negotiation.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the driver for this specific carrier engagement. Tracks whether driver has completed carrier-specific training, insurance requirements, and regulatory certifications required by this carrier. Compliant: all requirements met. Pending-documents: awaiting documentation. Suspended: temporarily not eligible for assignments. Non-compliant: missing critical requirements.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the legal contract or agreement document governing this driver-carrier engagement. Links to contract management system or document repository.

attributes.name: driver_engagement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the engagement relationship. Exclusive: driver works only for this carrier. Non-exclusive: driver can work for multiple carriers simultaneously. Platform: gig-economy platform engagement. Seasonal: temporary engagement for peak periods. Project-based: engagement for specific routes or projects.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the driver-carrier engagement ended or is scheduled to end. Null for active ongoing engagements. Critical for tracking engagement history and sequential carrier relationships.

attributes.name: last_assignment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent route or shipment assignment given to this driver by this carrier. Used to track engagement activity and identify dormant relationships.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Performance classification of the driver within this specific carrier engagement. Platinum: top performer with premium rates. Gold: above-average performance. Silver: standard performance. Bronze: below expectations. Probationary: new or under review. Performance tier may differ across carriers for the same driver.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the driver began working for or was contracted by this carrier partner. Tracks the beginning of the engagement relationship.

attributes.name: total_assignments_completed
attributes.description: Cumulative count of route assignments or deliveries completed by this driver for this specific carrier. Performance metric tracked per engagement.

products.name: fleet_training_completion
products.description: This association product represents the completion event between driver_profile and safety_training. It captures the operational record of a driver completing a specific safety training course, including assessment results, certification details, and compliance status. Each record links one driver to one training course completion instance with attributes that exist only in the context of this completion relationship.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping operations, drivers complete multiple safety training courses throughout their careers (defensive driving, hazmat handling, first aid, emergency response, fatigue management), and each training course is completed by many different drivers. The business actively manages training completion records as operational entities, tracking completion dates, assessment scores, certificate numbers, expiry dates, and compliance status for each driver-course combination. Safety officers query training matrices, schedule recertifications, and generate compliance reports based on these completion records.

attributes.name: fleet_training_completion_id
attributes.description: Primary key for fleet_training_completion

attributes.name: driver_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the driver who completed the training

attributes.name: training_completion_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this training completion record. Primary key.

attributes.name: training_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the safety training course that was completed

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: Percentage score achieved by the driver on the competency assessment for this training course. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: attendance_hours
attributes.description: Actual hours the driver attended the training session. May differ from standard duration_hours if partial attendance or extended session.

attributes.name: certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date the training certificate expires and recertification is required. Calculated based on completion_date plus certification_validity_months from the training course. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or credential number issued upon successful completion of the training course. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date the driver successfully completed the safety training course. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of this training completion record. Current: certificate is valid. Expiring Soon: within 30 days of expiry. Expired: past expiry date. Pending Recertification: refresher training scheduled. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this training completion record was created in the safety management system.

attributes.name: instructor_name
attributes.description: Name of the instructor or facilitator who delivered this training session to the driver.

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Final outcome of the training assessment. Pass: met passing score. Fail: did not meet passing score. Incomplete: training started but not finished. Waived: requirement waived by authority.

attributes.name: recertification_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the driver must complete refresher training to maintain compliance. Calculated from completion_date plus refresher_frequency_months.

attributes.name: training_location
attributes.description: Physical location, facility, or online platform where the training was delivered (e.g., depot code, training center, LMS platform).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this training completion record was last updated.

domains.name: customs
domains.description: Manages end-to-end customs brokerage and trade compliance for cross-border shipments. Owns HS Code classification, import/export declarations, ISF and AMS filings, denied party screening, C-TPAT and AEO program compliance, duty and tax calculation, FTZ management, tariff management, and Incoterms-based liability determination. Powered by Descartes Customs GTM and aligned to WCO, WTO, and national customs authority requirements.

products.name: declaration
products.description: Core master record for import and export customs declarations filed with national customs authorities. Captures declaration type (import/export/transit/re-export), declaration number, associated shipment reference, declarant identity, country of origin, country of destination, port of entry/exit, Incoterms, declaration status (draft/submitted/under_review/released/rejected), filing date, release date, and regulatory authority reference. Sourced from Descartes Customs GTM and aligned to WCO SAD (Single Administrative Document) standards.

attributes.name: declaration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customs declaration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Customs declarations operate under master service agreements that govern clearance terms, billing rates, SLA commitments, and Incoterms obligations. Brokers and importers track which agreement applies

attributes.name: carrier_id

attributes.name: exporter_supplier_id

attributes.name: filing_employee_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: Importer in customs declaration is a trade party. Adding importer_trade_party_id FK to trade_party.trade_party_id normalizes the importer reference. Cardinality: N:1 (many declarations can have the sa

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Customs declarations trigger billable charges for clearance services, duty/tax handling, and broker fees. Invoice links declaration to customer billing for these services—core revenue recognition even

attributes.name: lane_id

attributes.name: port_of_entry_network_node_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.network_node. Business justification: Port of entry is a physical network node where customs clearance occurs. Required for customs processing location tracking, facility capacity planning, and clearance time analysis by node. Replaces de

attributes.name: aeo_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the importer or declarant holds AEO status, which provides trade facilitation benefits and reduced customs controls in the EU and other jurisdictions.
attributes.references: EU AEO Program / WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Reason for amending the declaration after initial submission (e.g., corrected HS code, updated value, additional documentation). Null if declaration was not amended.

attributes.name: certificate_of_origin_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the certificate of origin document supporting preferential duty treatment or country-of-origin claims. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: country_of_destination
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the final destination country where the goods will be consumed or used.

attributes.name: country_of_export
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country from which the goods are being exported.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the goods were manufactured, produced, or substantially transformed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this declaration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: ctpat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the importer or declarant is C-TPAT certified, which may expedite customs clearance and reduce inspections.

attributes.name: customs_authority
attributes.description: Name of the national customs authority or agency to which the declaration was filed (e.g., US CBP, UK HMRC, EU Member State Customs).

attributes.name: customs_office_code
attributes.description: Official code of the specific customs office or location where the declaration was processed.

attributes.name: customs_procedure_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the customs procedure or regime applied to the goods (e.g., free circulation, temporary admission, inward processing, customs warehousing).
attributes.references: WCO Revised Kyoto Convention / EU Union Customs Code

attributes.name: declarant_identifier
attributes.description: Official identifier of the declarant assigned by customs authority (e.g., customs broker license number, SCAC code, or national business registration number).

attributes.name: declarant_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the party (customs broker, freight forwarder, or direct importer/exporter) filing the declaration with customs authorities.

attributes.name: declaration_number

attributes.name: declaration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the customs declaration: draft (being prepared), submitted (filed with customs), under_review (customs examination in progress), released (cleared for movement), rejected (not accepted by customs), cancelled (withdrawn), or amended (modified after submission). attributes.name: declared_value_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the total declared value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: denied_party_screening_status

attributes.name: duty_tax_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for duty and tax amounts (typically the currency of the importing country).

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the customs declaration was officially submitted to the customs authority.

attributes.name: filing_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the customs declaration was submitted to the customs authority, including timezone.

attributes.name: ftz_entry_number
attributes.description: Entry number assigned when goods are admitted into a Free Trade Zone or Foreign Trade Zone. Null if goods are not entering an FTZ.

attributes.name: incoterms

attributes.name: inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether customs authority has flagged this declaration for physical inspection or examination of goods.

attributes.name: inspection_type
