attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this declaration record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which duties and taxes are paid: cash, check, wire transfer, ACH, credit card, customs bond (for bonded warehouse or continuous bond), deferred payment (for approved traders), or duty drawback (refund claim). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cash|check|wire_transfer|ach|credit_card|customs_bond|deferred_payment|duty_drawback — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: port_of_exit
attributes.description: Name or code of the port, airport, or border crossing where goods exit the country of export.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by customs authority for rejecting the declaration (e.g., incorrect HS code, missing documentation, valuation discrepancy). Null if declaration was not rejected.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date when customs authority released the goods for movement after clearance. Null if not yet released.

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when customs authority released the goods, including timezone. Null if not yet released.

attributes.name: total_declared_value
attributes.description: Total customs value of all goods declared on this declaration, used as the basis for duty and tax calculation.

attributes.name: total_duty_amount
attributes.description: Total customs duty assessed on the declared goods. Null if not yet calculated or if duty-free.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System / National Tariff Schedule

attributes.name: total_tax_amount
attributes.description: Total taxes (VAT, GST, excise, etc.) assessed on the declared goods. Null if not yet calculated or if tax-exempt.

attributes.name: trade_agreement
attributes.description: Name or code of the preferential trade agreement under which reduced or zero duty rates are claimed (e.g., USMCA, EU-UK TCA, CPTPP). Null if no preference claimed.

products.name: declaration_line
products.description: Line-level detail within a customs declaration representing each distinct commodity or tariff line item. Captures HS code, commodity description, country of origin, quantity, unit of measure, gross weight, net weight, CBM, declared value, currency, duty rate applied, duty amount, VAT/tax amount, statistical value, and preference claim indicator. Each declaration may contain multiple lines corresponding to different goods classifications. Aligned to WCO tariff nomenclature and national customs tariff schedules.

attributes.name: declaration_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customs declaration line item. Primary key for the declaration line entity.

attributes.name: commodity_rate_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.commodity_rate_class. Business justification: Each declaration line needs commodity rate classification to determine freight class, apply correct pricing multipliers, and calculate chargeable weight. Essential for accurate freight pricing and bil

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent customs declaration header. Links this line item to its parent declaration document.

attributes.name: hs_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.hs_classification. Business justification: Each declaration line declares goods under a specific HS classification. Linking to hs_classification provides traceability to the classification decision. Not removing hs_code as it's a point-in-time

attributes.name: license_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.license_permit. Business justification: Declaration lines for controlled goods reference a license/permit. Currently has license_number as denormalized string. Adding FK to license_permit normalizes this and enables tracking of license util

attributes.name: origin_determination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.origin_determination. Business justification: Each declaration line declares a country of origin. Linking to origin_determination provides the supporting determination for the declared origin, especially important for preferential tariff claims.

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.po_line. Business justification: Customs declaration lines map to PO line items for item-level duty tracking and compliance audit. Brokers trace declaration lines to PO lines for valuation verification, HS code validation, and transf

attributes.name: shipment_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shipment.shipment_package. Business justification: Multi-SKU shipments require line-level mapping between customs declaration lines and physical packages for inspection, examination, and selective release. Enables package-level customs status tracking

attributes.name: tariff_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.tariff_rate. Business justification: Each declaration line has an hs_code and duty_rate_percent. Linking to tariff_rate provides the authoritative rate reference. Not removing duty_rate_percent as it's a point-in-time transactional value

attributes.name: antidumping_case_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the antidumping or countervailing duty investigation or order. Null if not subject to trade remedy measures.

attributes.name: antidumping_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is subject to antidumping or countervailing duties. True if subject to trade remedy measures, false otherwise.
attributes.references: WTO Antidumping Agreement, National Trade Remedy Authority

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Commercial brand or trademark name of the goods. Used for intellectual property enforcement and product identification.

attributes.name: certificate_of_origin_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the certificate of origin document supporting the country of origin claim and preferential treatment. Required when preference is claimed.

attributes.name: commodity_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the goods being declared. Includes material composition, intended use, brand, model, and other identifying characteristics required by customs authorities.

attributes.name: container_number
attributes.description: ISO 6346 container identification number for containerized shipments. Format: four letters followed by seven digits. Null for non-containerized cargo.

attributes.name: country_of_origin_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code representing the country where the goods were manufactured, produced, or substantially transformed. Used for preferential tariff determination and trade agreement eligibility.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this declaration line record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customs_value_amount
attributes.description: Declared customs value of the goods for duty calculation purposes. Represents the transaction value or adjusted value per WCO Valuation Agreement (GATT Article VII).
attributes.references: WCO Valuation Agreement, GATT Article VII

attributes.name: customs_value_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the customs value amount. Indicates the currency in which the goods value is declared.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item contains dangerous goods requiring special handling and documentation per IMDG Code or IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations. True if dangerous goods, false otherwise.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: duty_amount
attributes.description: Calculated customs duty amount payable on this line item. Computed as customs value multiplied by duty rate, subject to any preferential treatment or exemptions.

attributes.name: duty_rate_percent
attributes.description: Applicable customs duty rate expressed as a percentage of the customs value. Determined by HS code classification and country of origin.

attributes.name: excise_tax_amount
attributes.description: Calculated excise tax amount payable on this line item for goods subject to special excise duties (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, fuel). Zero if not applicable.

attributes.name: ftz_entry_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the FTZ admission or bonded warehouse entry. Null if not admitted to FTZ.

attributes.name: ftz_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is admitted into a free trade zone or bonded warehouse with duty suspension. True if FTZ admission, false otherwise.
attributes.references: Revised Kyoto Convention, National FTZ Regulations

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of the goods including all packaging materials, expressed in kilograms. Used for freight calculation and customs valuation.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System tariff classification code for the commodity. Six to ten digit code used for customs duty determination and trade statistics. Aligned to WCO Harmonized System nomenclature.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: Three-letter Incoterms code defining the delivery terms and liability split between buyer and seller. Used for customs valuation adjustments and freight cost allocation.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the customs declaration. Determines the ordering of line items within the parent declaration.

attributes.name: manufacturer_address
attributes.description: Full address of the manufacturer or producer of the goods. Required for origin verification and product safety traceability.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer or producer of the goods. Required for certain product categories and origin verification purposes.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model number or part number for the goods. Used for product identification and classification verification.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this declaration line record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking for compliance purposes.

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of the goods excluding all packaging materials, expressed in kilograms. Used for duty calculation and statistical purposes.

attributes.name: package_count
attributes.description: Number of packages or shipping units containing the goods on this line item. Used for cargo handling and inspection planning.

attributes.name: package_type_code
attributes.description: Two-letter UN/CEFACT code identifying the type of packaging. Examples: CT=carton, PL=pallet, DR=drum, BX=box. Aligned to UN/CEFACT Recommendation 21.

attributes.name: preference_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether preferential tariff treatment is claimed for this line item under a free trade agreement or trade preference program. True if preference is claimed, false otherwise.
attributes.references: WCO Rules of Origin, FTA Regulations

attributes.name: preference_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific trade agreement or preference program under which preferential treatment is claimed. Examples include USMCA, EU-GSP, CPTPP. Null if no preference is claimed.
attributes.references: WTO Trade Agreements, National FTA Regulations

attributes.name: prohibited_restricted_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item contains goods subject to import prohibitions or restrictions (e.g., endangered species, hazardous materials, dual-use goods). True if restricted, false otherwise.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of goods declared on this line item, expressed in the unit of measure specified. Used for duty calculation and statistical reporting.

attributes.name: quota_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is subject to a tariff rate quota or quantitative import restriction. True if quota applies, false otherwise.
attributes.references: WTO Agreement on Agriculture, National Quota Regulations

attributes.name: quota_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the quota allocation or license under which this line item is imported. Null if no quota applies.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number or identification number for serialized goods. Required for high-value items, controlled goods, and warranty tracking.

attributes.name: statistical_value_amount
attributes.description: Value of the goods for trade statistics purposes, typically converted to the importing country's currency. Used for balance of payments and trade flow analysis.

attributes.name: statistical_value_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the statistical value amount. Typically the local currency of the importing country.

attributes.name: total_tax_amount
attributes.description: Total of all taxes and duties payable on this line item. Sum of duty amount, VAT amount, excise tax amount, and any other applicable charges.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN number identifying dangerous goods for transport and customs purposes. Format: UN followed by four digits. Null if not dangerous goods.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure code for the declared quantity. Examples include KGM (kilogram), MTR (meter), PCE (piece), LTR (liter). Aligned to UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20.

attributes.name: valuation_method_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the WCO valuation method used to determine customs value. Values: 1=Transaction Value, 2=Identical Goods, 3=Similar Goods, 4=Deductive Value, 5=Computed Value, 6=Fall-back Method.

attributes.name: vat_amount
attributes.description: Calculated value-added tax or goods and services tax amount payable on this line item. Computed based on the taxable base (customs value plus duty) and applicable VAT rate.

attributes.name: vat_rate_percent
attributes.description: Applicable value-added tax or goods and services tax rate expressed as a percentage. Applied to the sum of customs value and duty amount.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volume of the goods expressed in cubic meters. Used for freight calculation and warehouse space planning.

products.name: hs_classification
products.description: Master record for HS Code (Harmonized System Code) classification assignments made for specific goods traded by customers. Captures the assigned HS code at 6-digit (WCO), 8-digit (EU CN), and 10-digit (national tariff) levels, commodity description, classification ruling reference, classification method (automated/manual/ruling), classifier identity, classification date, validity period, country-specific applicability, and binding ruling indicator. Managed by customs brokers in Descartes Customs GTM. SSOT for tariff classification within the enterprise.

attributes.name: hs_classification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the HS Code classification record. Primary key for the HS classification master data.

attributes.name: classifier_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: HS classification performed by licensed customs brokers or trade compliance specialists (employees). Required for binding rulings, audit trail, and regulatory compliance. Classifier_name is denormaliz

attributes.name: commodity_rate_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.commodity_rate_class. Business justification: HS codes map to freight rate classes for pricing purposes. Logistics operators maintain HS-to-rate-class mappings to automate freight class assignment and ensure consistent pricing across shipments wi

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for whom this HS classification was created. Links the classification to the trading party.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: HS classification teams maintain supplier-specific product classifications for binding rulings and consistent tariff application across shipments. Classification records reference supplier part catalo

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_agreement. Business justification: HS classifications can reference a specific trade agreement for preferential duty treatment. Adding trade_agreement_id FK to trade_agreement.trade_agreement_id establishes which FTA/trade agreement ap

attributes.name: binding_ruling_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the binding tariff ruling expires and is no longer valid for use. Nullable if the ruling has no expiration or is valid indefinitely.

attributes.name: binding_ruling_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this classification is based on a binding tariff ruling issued by a customs authority. Binding rulings provide legal certainty and protection from reclassification penalties.

attributes.name: binding_ruling_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the binding tariff ruling was officially issued by the customs authority. Determines the start of the ruling validity period.

attributes.name: binding_ruling_issuing_authority
attributes.description: The name of the customs authority or government agency that issued the binding tariff ruling. Examples include US CBP, HMRC, EU Commission.

attributes.name: binding_ruling_reference
attributes.description: The official reference number or identifier of the binding tariff ruling issued by the customs authority. Used to cite the ruling in customs declarations and audits.

attributes.name: classification_confidence_score
attributes.description: A numerical score (0-100) representing the confidence level in the assigned HS Code classification. Used for automated classifications to flag low-confidence assignments for manual review.

attributes.name: classification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the HS Code classification was assigned or approved. Used to determine applicability of tariff rates and trade regulations in effect at that time.

attributes.name: classification_method
attributes.description: The method by which the HS Code classification was determined. Automated indicates system-driven classification; manual indicates customs broker review; binding ruling indicates official customs authority determination; third party ruling indicates external consultant classification; customer declared indicates shipper-provided classification.

attributes.name: classification_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from the classifier explaining the rationale for the HS Code assignment, including references to tariff schedule notes, explanatory notes, or ruling precedents.

attributes.name: classification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the HS classification record. Tracks whether the classification is in draft, under review, approved for use, rejected, expired, or superseded by a newer classification.

attributes.name: classifier_license_number
attributes.description: Professional license or certification number of the customs broker who performed the classification. Required for regulatory compliance and audit purposes in jurisdictions that mandate licensed brokers.

attributes.name: commodity_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the goods being classified. Includes material composition, intended use, manufacturing process, and other characteristics relevant to tariff classification.

attributes.name: country_of_classification
attributes.description: The 3-letter ISO country code indicating the jurisdiction for which this HS classification applies. HS codes may vary by country at the 8-digit and 10-digit levels.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this HS classification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the classified goods are classified as dangerous goods under IMDG, IATA DGR, or other hazardous materials regulations. Affects handling, packaging, and transport requirements.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: The 3-letter ISO country code indicating the country to which the goods are being shipped. Destination country determines applicable import duties and regulations.

attributes.name: duty_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The applicable customs duty rate as a percentage of the goods value, based on the assigned HS Code and destination country. Used for landed cost calculation and duty estimation.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this HS classification becomes valid and can be used for customs declarations. Supports time-bound classification validity periods.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this HS classification remains valid. Nullable for open-ended classifications. Used to manage classification expiration and renewal cycles.

attributes.name: excise_tax_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether excise taxes apply to the classified goods in addition to customs duties. Common for alcohol, tobacco, fuel, and luxury goods.

attributes.name: export_control_classification_number
attributes.description: The ECCN assigned to the goods for export control purposes. Used to determine whether an export license is required under dual-use or military export regulations.
attributes.references: US Export Administration Regulations (EAR), Wassenaar Arrangement

attributes.name: hs_code_10_digit
attributes.description: The 10-digit national tariff code used by specific countries (e.g., USA HTS code). Provides the most granular level of commodity classification for duty and tax calculation.

attributes.name: hs_code_6_digit
attributes.description: The 6-digit HS Code as defined by the World Customs Organization (WCO). This is the internationally standardized classification code used globally for customs tariff purposes.

attributes.name: hs_code_8_digit
attributes.description: The 8-digit HS Code used in the European Union Combined Nomenclature (CN). Extends the 6-digit WCO code with two additional digits for EU-specific classification.

attributes.name: import_license_required_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether an import license or permit is required for the classified goods in the destination country. Used to trigger license application workflows.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this HS classification record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking purposes.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which this HS classification was last reviewed or validated by a customs broker or trade compliance specialist. Used to track classification currency and trigger re-review cycles.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified this HS classification record. Used for accountability and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next review or re-validation of this HS classification. Nullable if no review is scheduled. Used to manage proactive classification maintenance.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: The 3-letter ISO country code indicating the country where the goods were manufactured or produced. Country of origin affects duty rates and eligibility for preferential trade agreements.
attributes.references: WCO Rules of Origin, ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3

attributes.name: preferential_duty_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The reduced duty rate applicable under a Free Trade Agreement (FTA) or preferential trade program. Nullable if no preferential treatment applies.
attributes.references: WTO Preferential Trade Agreements, National FTA Schedules

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: The high-level product category or commodity group to which the classified goods belong. Used for reporting and analytics on classification patterns by product type.

attributes.name: product_sku
attributes.description: The customer or internal SKU code for the specific product or commodity to which this HS classification applies. Links the classification to inventory and order management systems.

attributes.name: record_version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number incremented each time the classification record is modified. Used for optimistic locking and change history tracking.

attributes.name: restricted_goods_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the classified goods are subject to import or export restrictions, embargoes, or sanctions. Triggers compliance screening and approval workflows.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Programs, UN Security Council Resolutions

attributes.name: review_required_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this classification requires periodic review or re-validation. Set to true for complex classifications, borderline cases, or when tariff schedules are updated.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system from which this HS classification record originated. Typically Descartes Customs GTM or another trade management system.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this classification record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: The four-digit UN number assigned to dangerous goods for identification in transport. Format is UN followed by four digits (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline).
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: vat_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The applicable VAT or Goods and Services Tax (GST) rate as a percentage, based on the HS Code and destination country. Used for total landed cost calculation.

products.name: tariff_rate
products.description: Reference data for duty and tax rates applicable to specific HS codes by country pair and trade agreement. Captures HS code, importing country, exporting country, applicable trade agreement (e.g., USMCA, EU-UK TCA, RCEP), MFN (Most Favoured Nation) duty rate, preferential duty rate, anti-dumping duty rate, countervailing duty rate, VAT/GST rate, excise rate, effective date, expiry date, and rate source authority. Enables automated duty calculation in declarations. Aligned to WTO tariff schedules and national customs authority publications.
products.reference: WTO Tariff Schedule / National Customs Tariff

attributes.name: tariff_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tariff rate record.

attributes.name: pricing_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.tariff. Business justification: Customs tariff rates reference pricing tariff structures for duty-inclusive freight quotes and landed cost calculations. Enables integrated quoting where freight and duty costs are presented together

attributes.name: superseded_by_tariff_rate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tariff_rate_id that replaces this record when status is superseded. Enables rate history tracking.

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: FK to customs.trade_agreement

attributes.name: verified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tariff rates require periodic verification by qualified trade compliance analysts (employees). Critical for duty calculation accuracy and regulatory compliance. Verified_by is denormalized employee id

attributes.name: anti_dumping_duty_rate
attributes.description: Additional duty imposed on imports sold below fair market value to protect domestic industry. Expressed as a percentage or specific amount per unit.

attributes.name: countervailing_duty_rate
attributes.description: Additional duty imposed to offset foreign government subsidies that distort trade. Expressed as a percentage or specific amount per unit.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Subsidies and Countervailing Measures Agreement

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tariff rate record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for monetary duty amounts and specific duty calculations.

attributes.name: duty_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the duty: ad valorem (percentage of value), specific (fixed amount per unit), compound (combination), or mixed.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this tariff rate becomes applicable and enforceable for customs declarations.

attributes.name: excise_duty_rate
attributes.description: Special tax levied on specific goods such as alcohol, tobacco, fuel, or luxury items. Expressed as a percentage or specific amount per unit.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this tariff rate ceases to be valid. Null indicates an open-ended rate with no scheduled expiration.

attributes.name: exporting_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the origin country from which goods are being exported.

attributes.name: gst_rate
attributes.description: The goods and services tax rate applicable in jurisdictions using GST instead of VAT. Expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: The Harmonized System code classifying the commodity for customs purposes. Six to ten digit code used globally for tariff classification.

attributes.name: importing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the destination country where goods are being imported.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tariff rate record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when this tariff rate was last verified against official customs authority publications to ensure accuracy.

attributes.name: mfn_duty_rate
attributes.description: The standard duty rate applied to imports from WTO member countries in the absence of a preferential trade agreement. Expressed as a percentage or specific rate.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or operational guidance related to the application of this tariff rate.

attributes.name: origin_criteria
attributes.description: Rules of origin requirements that must be met to qualify for preferential duty rates under the trade agreement (e.g., regional value content, tariff shift, specific process).

attributes.name: preferential_duty_rate
attributes.description: Reduced duty rate available under a specific trade agreement when origin and compliance criteria are met. Expressed as a percentage or specific rate.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Regional Trade Agreements

attributes.name: publication_reference
attributes.description: Official document reference, gazette number, or regulation identifier where this tariff rate was published.

attributes.name: quota_order_number
attributes.description: Official quota order number or TRQ identifier when tariff_quota_flag is true. Used to track quota utilization.
attributes.references: National Customs Authority Quota Management System

attributes.name: rate_source_authority
attributes.description: The official government or regulatory body that published this tariff rate (e.g., US Customs and Border Protection, HMRC, European Commission DG TAXUD).

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tariff rate type for operational and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: seasonal_period
attributes.description: Description of the seasonal period when this rate applies (e.g., January-March, Summer, Harvest Season). Populated when seasonal_rate_flag is true.

attributes.name: seasonal_rate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tariff rate varies by season or time of year (common for agricultural products).

attributes.name: special_conditions
attributes.description: Additional conditions, restrictions, or requirements that apply to this tariff rate (e.g., licensing requirements, certification needs, end-use restrictions).

attributes.name: specific_duty_amount
attributes.description: Fixed duty amount per unit of measure when specific or compound duty calculation method applies.

attributes.name: suspension_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether duty collection is temporarily suspended for this HS code and country pair (autonomous suspension).

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for duty suspension when suspension_flag is true (e.g., economic interest, shortage of domestic supply, industrial development).

attributes.name: tariff_quota_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate is subject to a tariff rate quota (TRQ) limiting the quantity eligible for preferential rates.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Tariff Rate Quota Administration

attributes.name: tariff_rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tariff rate record in the system.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for specific duty calculations (e.g., kilogram, liter, piece, square meter). Applicable when duty_calculation_method is specific or compound.

attributes.name: vat_rate
attributes.description: The value-added tax or goods and services tax rate applicable to the imported goods in the destination country. Expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this tariff rate record to track changes over time for the same HS code and country pair combination.

products.name: duty_assessment
products.description: Transactional record of duty and tax calculations performed for a customs declaration or shipment. Captures total customs duty, anti-dumping duty, countervailing duty, VAT/GST, excise tax, port handling levies, total tax liability, currency, exchange rate applied, calculation basis (CIF/FOB/DDP), assessment date, assessment status (estimated/assessed/final/disputed), and payment due date. Supports duty payment reconciliation and landed cost computation. Generated by Descartes Customs GTM duty calculation engine.
products.reference: WCO Revenue Package / National Customs Duty Assessment

attributes.name: duty_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the duty assessment record. Primary key for the duty assessment transaction.

attributes.name: accounts_payable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_payable. Business justification: Assessed customs duties become payables to customs authorities. Essential for cash management, payment run processing, aging analysis, and reconciliation of duty payments against assessments.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed customs broker who prepared and filed the customs declaration and calculated the duty assessment.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Duty assessments must reference the governing service agreement to determine duty payment responsibility (importer vs carrier vs 3PL), apply contracted duty management services, validate Incoterms cos

attributes.name: assessed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Duty assessments performed by customs officers or licensed brokers (employees). Regulatory requirement for accountability, audit trail, and dispute resolution. Tracks who calculated and approved the a

attributes.name: billing_invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice_line. Business justification: Each duty assessment (duties, taxes, fees paid on customer's behalf) generates specific invoice line items for charge-back. Essential for reconciling customs payments to customer invoices and revenue

attributes.name: carbon_offset_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_offset_transaction. Business justification: EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) requires linking customs duty assessments to carbon offset purchases for embedded emissions in imported goods. Real process: CBAM certificate surrender at

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment associated with this duty assessment. Links to the freight shipment being cleared through customs.

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customs declaration for which this duty assessment was performed. Links to the parent customs entry filing.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Duty assessments generate GL postings for duty expense and payables. Critical for financial close process, duty accrual reconciliation, and audit trail linking customs transactions to financial record

attributes.name: original_assessment_duty_assessment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original duty assessment record if this is an adjusted or corrected assessment. Creates audit trail for assessment changes. Null for original assessments.

attributes.name: pricing_charge_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.charge_code. Business justification: Duty assessments generate billable charges that must map to pricing charge codes for invoicing and revenue recognition. Required for integrating customs duty costs into customer billing and financial

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Duty assessments track supplier/exporter for landed cost calculation by supplier. Procurement teams analyze total cost of ownership including duties, requiring supplier linkage for cost allocation and

attributes.name: tariff_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.tariff_rate. Business justification: Duty assessment calculates duties based on a specific tariff rate. Currently has tariff_code and duty_rate_percentage as denormalized values. Linking to tariff_rate provides the authoritative rate sou

attributes.name: trade_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party legally responsible for paying the assessed duties and taxes. The importer of record as declared on the customs entry.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Reason for adjusting the duty assessment after initial calculation. May include post-entry amendment, reconciliation, or customs authority correction. Null if no adjustment made.

attributes.name: anti_dumping_duty_amount
attributes.description: Anti-dumping duty assessed when goods are imported at below fair market value. Additional duty imposed to protect domestic industry from unfair trade practices.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the duty assessment was calculated and issued by the customs authority or broker system. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the duty assessment was calculated. Automated = system-calculated; Manual = customs officer review; Hybrid = system with officer override; Post_audit = retrospective assessment after release.

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the duty assessment. Externally visible reference number used in customs documentation and payment processing.

attributes.name: assessment_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the system that generated the duty assessment calculation. Typically the customs broker GTM system or customs authority automated system.

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the duty assessment. Estimated = preliminary calculation; Assessed = official customs authority calculation; Final = confirmed and payable; Disputed = under review or appeal; Adjusted = modified after initial assessment; Cancelled = voided assessment.

attributes.name: assessment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the duty assessment calculation was executed. Used for audit trail and calculation sequencing.

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: Incoterms basis used for duty calculation. CIF = Cost Insurance Freight; FOB = Free on Board; DDP = Delivered Duty Paid; DAP = Delivered at Place; EXW = Ex Works; FCA = Free Carrier. Determines which costs are included in the customs value.

attributes.name: countervailing_duty_amount
attributes.description: Countervailing duty assessed to offset foreign government subsidies. Additional duty imposed when imported goods benefit from subsidies in the country of origin.
attributes.references: WTO Subsidies and Countervailing Measures Agreement

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166 country code representing the country where the goods were manufactured or substantially transformed. Determines applicable duty rates and trade preferences.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this duty assessment record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this assessment. Indicates the currency in which duties and taxes are denominated.

attributes.name: customs_duty_amount
attributes.description: Total customs duty assessed on the imported or exported goods. Standard ad valorem or specific duty based on HS Code classification and tariff schedule.

attributes.name: customs_value_amount
attributes.description: Total customs value of the goods used as the basis for duty calculation. Represents the transaction value adjusted per WCO valuation rules.

attributes.name: dispute_filed_date
attributes.description: Date when a formal dispute or protest was filed with the customs authority regarding this assessment. Null if no dispute filed.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Reason for disputing the duty assessment if status is disputed. May include classification disagreement, valuation dispute, or rate application error. Null if not disputed.

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Type of customs entry for which duty is assessed. Consumption = immediate release for domestic use; Warehouse = bonded storage; Temporary = temporary import; FTZ = Free Trade Zone; Carnet = temporary admission under ATA Carnet.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert invoice currency to local currency for duty calculation. Rate published by customs authority or central bank on the assessment date.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_date
attributes.description: Date for which the exchange rate was published and applied. Typically the date of export, entry filing, or customs authority determination.

attributes.name: excise_tax_amount
attributes.description: Excise tax assessed on specific categories of goods such as alcohol, tobacco, fuel, or luxury items. Product-specific indirect tax.

attributes.name: harbor_maintenance_fee
attributes.description: Fee assessed on cargo loaded or unloaded at US ports. Used to fund harbor maintenance and dredging operations.
attributes.references: US Customs and Border Protection - HMF Regulations

attributes.name: import_export_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this duty assessment is for an import or export transaction. Most assessments are for imports; some jurisdictions assess export duties.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this duty assessment record was last updated. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: merchandise_processing_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged by customs authority for processing the import entry. Administrative charge for customs clearance services.
attributes.references: US Customs and Border Protection - MPF Regulations

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the duty assessment. May include special instructions, calculation explanations, or customs officer remarks.

attributes.name: other_fees_amount
attributes.description: Sum of miscellaneous customs-related fees not captured in standard categories. May include inspection fees, storage fees, or special handling charges.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date when the duties and taxes were paid to the customs authority. Null if payment status is unpaid.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the assessed duties and taxes must be paid to the customs authority. Failure to pay by this date may result in penalties, interest, or cargo holds.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number or transaction identifier for the duty payment. Links to the payment transaction in the financial system or customs payment portal.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of the assessed duties and taxes. Unpaid = not yet paid; Paid = fully settled; Partial = partially paid; Overdue = past due date; Waived = exempted from payment.

attributes.name: port_of_entry_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the customs port or border crossing where the goods entered the country and duty was assessed. UN/LOCODE or national port code.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: preferential_duty_rate
attributes.description: Reduced duty rate percentage applied under a preferential tariff program or free trade agreement. Lower than the standard Most Favored Nation (MFN) rate.

attributes.name: preferential_tariff_program
attributes.description: Free trade agreement or preferential tariff program applied to reduce or eliminate duty. Examples: USMCA, EU-UK TCA, CPTPP, GSP. Empty if no preference claimed.

attributes.name: tariff_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System classification code used to determine applicable duty rates. Six to ten digit code identifying the product category for tariff purposes.

attributes.name: total_duty_tax_amount
attributes.description: Total liability including all duties, taxes, and fees assessed on this customs entry. Sum of customs duty, anti-dumping duty, countervailing duty, VAT, excise tax, and all fees.

attributes.name: vat_amount
attributes.description: Value-Added Tax or Goods and Services Tax (GST) assessed on the imported goods. Consumption tax collected at the point of import.

products.name: isf_filing
products.description: Importer Security Filing (ISF) record submitted to US CBP for ocean shipments bound for the United States, as mandated under 19 CFR Part 149. Captures ISF transaction number, filing type (ISF-10 or ISF-5), importer of record, consignee, seller, buyer, ship-to party, manufacturer/supplier, country of origin, HTSUS code, container stuffing location, consolidator, vessel name, voyage number, bill of lading number, filing date, CBP response status, and penalty risk flag. Sourced from Descartes Customs GTM AMS/ISF module.
products.reference: US CBP ISF Rule (10+2) — 19 CFR Part 149

attributes.name: isf_filing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ISF filing record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: ISF filings are performed under master service agreements that define filing responsibilities, timing SLAs, penalty allocation for late/inaccurate filings, and service fees. Linking ISF to agreement e

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: ISF (Importer Security Filing) requires carrier identification for CBP 10+2 compliance. Linking to carrier master data ensures accurate SCAC/IATA code validation, vessel/voyage tracking, and regulator

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shipment.consignment. Business justification: ISF (10+2) filing is mandatory for ocean shipments to US 24 hours before loading. CBP compliance, penalty avoidance, and shipment release all require linking ISF to the consignment. Critical for US im

attributes.name: filed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: ISF filings must be submitted by licensed customs brokers (employees). CBP regulatory requirement for ocean shipments. Tracks individual broker accountability. Customs_broker_name is denormalized empl

attributes.name: importer_trade_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: Importer of record in ISF filing is a trade party. Adding importer_trade_party_id FK to trade_party.trade_party_id normalizes the importer reference. Cardinality: N:1 (many ISF filings can have the sa

attributes.name: manufacturer_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: ISF 10+2 filings require manufacturer/supplier details for CBP compliance. Customs brokers pull supplier master data (name, address, country) from procurement systems for accurate ISF submission and i

attributes.name: port_of_unlading_network_node_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Port Of Unlading Network Node Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.network_node. Business justification: ISF 10+2 rule requires specifying the port where cargo will be unladed. CBP uses this for vessel arrival coordination and security screening. Critical for ISF compliance validation and arrival plannin

attributes.name: actual_arrival_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the vessel arrived at the US port of unlading.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Number of times this ISF filing has been amended after initial submission. ISF data must be updated if changes occur before cargo arrival.

attributes.name: bond_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customs bond that guarantees payment of duties, taxes, and penalties for this ISF filing.

attributes.name: bond_type
attributes.description: Type of customs bond covering this ISF filing. Single transaction bond covers one shipment. Continuous bond covers multiple shipments over a year.

attributes.name: buyer_address
attributes.description: Full address of the buyer, including street, city, state/province, postal code, and country.

attributes.name: buyer_name
attributes.description: Name of the last known entity to whom the goods are sold or agreed to be sold. If the goods are to be imported otherwise than in pursuance of a purchase, the name of the owner. This is one of the 10 required data elements for ISF-10.

attributes.name: cbp_rejection_reason
attributes.business_glossary_term: US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Rejection Reason
attributes.description: Detailed reason provided by CBP for rejecting the ISF filing. May include error codes, missing data elements, or compliance violations.

attributes.name: cbp_response_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Response Date
attributes.description: Date and time when CBP responded to the ISF filing with acceptance, rejection, or request for amendment.

attributes.name: cbp_response_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Response Status
attributes.description: Status of CBP's response to the ISF filing. Accepted indicates the filing meets all requirements. Rejected indicates the filing contains errors or missing data. Amendment required indicates CBP requires corrections. Pending review indicates CBP has not yet completed their review.

attributes.name: consignee_address
attributes.description: Full address of the consignee, including street, city, state/province, postal code, and country.

attributes.name: consignee_name
attributes.description: Name of the party to whom the goods are being shipped. This is one of the 10 required data elements for ISF-10.

attributes.name: consolidator_address
attributes.description: Full address of the consolidator, including street, city, state/province, postal code, and country.

attributes.name: consolidator_name
attributes.description: Name of the party who stuffed the container or arranged for the stuffing of the container. This is one of the 10 required data elements for ISF-10.

attributes.name: container_stuffing_location
attributes.description: Physical location where the container was stuffed (loaded). Must include the name and address of the facility. This is one of the 10 required data elements for ISF-10.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Country where the goods were manufactured, produced, or grown, as determined by the applicable rules of origin. Represented as a 3-letter ISO country code. This is one of the 10 required data elements for ISF-10.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ISF filing record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customs_broker_license_number
attributes.description: CBP-issued license number of the customs broker who filed the ISF.

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_date
attributes.description: Estimated date when the vessel is expected to arrive at the US port of unlading.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the ISF was submitted to US Customs and Border Protection (CBP). Must be submitted at least 24 hours before cargo is laden aboard the vessel at the foreign port.

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ISF filing. Draft indicates the filing is being prepared. Submitted indicates the filing has been sent to CBP. Accepted indicates CBP has accepted the filing. Rejected indicates CBP has rejected the filing due to errors or missing data. Amended indicates the filing has been updated after initial submission. Withdrawn indicates the filing has been cancelled.

attributes.name: filing_type
attributes.description: Type of ISF filing. ISF-10 is for standard ocean shipments (10 data elements required). ISF-5 is for specific scenarios such as FROB (Foreign Remaining On Board), IE (Immediate Exportation), or TE (Transportation and Exportation) shipments (5 data elements required).

attributes.name: htsus_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS) Code
attributes.description: The 6-digit or 10-digit Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification code for the commodity. Used to determine duty rates and trade compliance requirements. This is one of the 10 required data elements for ISF-10.

attributes.name: isf_transaction_number
attributes.description: Unique transaction number assigned by US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) upon successful ISF submission. This is the official CBP reference number for the filing.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the most recent amendment to this ISF filing was submitted to CBP.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ISF filing record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary penalty amount assessed by CBP for ISF violations. Penalties can range from $5,000 to $10,000 per violation depending on severity and whether the violation was timely, accurate, or complete.

attributes.name: penalty_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why a penalty was assessed by CBP. May include late filing, inaccurate data, missing data elements, or failure to update.

attributes.name: penalty_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ISF filing is at risk of CBP penalties due to late filing, inaccurate data, or non-compliance. True indicates penalty risk exists. False indicates no known penalty risk.

attributes.name: port_of_lading
attributes.description: Foreign port where the cargo was laden aboard the vessel. Represented as a 5-character UN/LOCODE.

attributes.name: seller_address
attributes.description: Full address of the seller, including street, city, state/province, postal code, and country.

attributes.name: seller_name
attributes.description: Name of the last known entity by whom the goods are sold or agreed to be sold. If the goods are to be imported otherwise than in pursuance of a purchase, the name of the owner. This is one of the 10 required data elements for ISF-10.

attributes.name: ship_to_party_address
attributes.description: Full address of the ship-to party, including street, city, state/province, postal code, and country.

attributes.name: ship_to_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the first deliver-to party scheduled to physically receive the goods after the goods have been released from customs custody. This is one of the 10 required data elements for ISF-10.

attributes.name: vessel_name
attributes.description: Name of the ocean vessel carrying the cargo to the United States. Required for CBP to identify the specific voyage.

attributes.name: voyage_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specific voyage of the vessel. Assigned by the carrier.

products.name: ams_filing
products.description: Automated Manifest System (AMS) filing record submitted to US CBP for advance cargo reporting on ocean (AMS), air (AMS Air), and rail/truck (ABI) shipments. Captures AMS transaction number, transport mode, carrier SCAC/IATA code, vessel/flight/conveyance identifier, voyage/flight number, port of lading, port of unlading, estimated arrival date, master bill of lading number, house bill of lading number, commodity description, piece count, weight, filing status, CBP hold indicator, and exam type (VACIS/CET/tailgate). Sourced from Descartes Customs GTM AMS module.
products.reference: US CBP Automated Manifest System (AMS) — 19 CFR Part 4

attributes.name: ams_filing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the AMS filing record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: AMS filings operate under service agreements that govern filing obligations, timing commitments, cost allocation, and penalty terms. Linking AMS to agreement supports SLA compliance tracking, penalty

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: AMS (Automated Manifest System) filings require carrier identification for CBP advance manifest compliance. Carrier FK enables validation of SCAC/IATA codes, vessel/flight details, and supports regula

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shipment.consignment. Business justification: AMS filing is required for air/ocean cargo to US for security screening. CBP hold resolution, exam coordination, and release authorization depend on linking AMS to consignment. Mandatory for US-bound

attributes.name: filed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: AMS filings submitted by licensed customs brokers (employees). CBP regulatory requirement for manifest data. Critical for tracking individual broker performance and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: importer_trade_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: Importer of record in AMS filing is a trade party. Adding importer_trade_party_id FK to trade_party.trade_party_id normalizes the importer reference. Cardinality: N:1 (many AMS filings can have the sa

attributes.name: port_of_unlading_network_node_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Port Of Unlading Network Node Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.network_node. Business justification: AMS advance manifest submissions must specify unlading port for CBP security screening. Required for manifest compliance validation and arrival port coordination. Replaces denormalized port_of_unladin

attributes.name: shipper_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: AMS cargo manifest filings identify shipper (often supplier) for CBP advance screening. Carriers reference supplier master for accurate shipper details in manifest submissions, enabling denied party s

attributes.name: actual_arrival_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the conveyance arrived at the US port of unlading. Updated after arrival occurs.

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential number tracking amendments to the original AMS filing. Zero for original filing, incremented for each amendment.

attributes.name: ams_transaction_number
attributes.description: The unique transaction number assigned by US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) upon successful AMS filing submission. This is the official CBP reference for the manifest filing.

attributes.name: bond_number
attributes.description: The customs bond number guaranteeing payment of duties and compliance with CBP regulations.

attributes.name: bond_type
attributes.description: The type of customs bond covering this shipment. Single transaction bond or continuous bond for regular importers.

attributes.name: broker_filer_code
attributes.description: The CBP-assigned filer code identifying the licensed customs broker who submitted this AMS filing on behalf of the importer.

attributes.name: cbp_hold_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Hold Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether CBP has placed a hold on this shipment for inspection or further review. True if hold is active.

attributes.name: commodity_description
attributes.description: A detailed description of the cargo being shipped. Must be sufficiently detailed for CBP to assess admissibility and security risk.

attributes.name: consignee_address
attributes.description: The full US address of the consignee. Required for AMS filing and delivery.

attributes.name: consignee_name
attributes.description: The name of the party receiving the goods (the importer or buyer). Required for AMS filing.

attributes.name: container_count
attributes.description: The number of containers (TEU/FEU) associated with this AMS filing for ocean shipments.

attributes.name: conveyance_name
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the conveyance (truck, rail car, barge) for rail and truck AMS filings.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO country code identifying where the goods were manufactured or produced. Used for duty assessment and trade compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this AMS filing record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_date
attributes.description: The estimated date when the conveyance is expected to arrive at the US port of unlading. Critical for AMS filing timing requirements.

attributes.name: exam_location
attributes.description: The facility or terminal where the CBP examination will take place or has taken place.

attributes.name: exam_type
attributes.description: The type of physical examination ordered by CBP. VACIS = Vehicle and Cargo Inspection System (non-intrusive imaging), CET = Container Examination Team (physical inspection), tailgate = partial inspection, intensive = full unload and inspection.

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the AMS filing. Tracks progression from draft through submission, acceptance, or rejection by CBP.

attributes.name: filing_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the AMS filing was submitted to US CBP. This is the official filing timestamp for compliance purposes.

attributes.name: filing_type
attributes.description: The transport mode for which this AMS filing was submitted. Ocean filings use AMS Ocean, air filings use AMS Air, and rail/truck use ABI (Automated Broker Interface).

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: The airline flight number for air shipments. Identifies the specific flight carrying the cargo.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: The 6 to 10-digit Harmonized Tariff Schedule code classifying the commodity for customs and duty purposes.

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: The Incoterm governing the transfer of risk and responsibility between shipper and consignee. Determines liability and cost allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: isf_number
attributes.description: The ISF (10+2) filing number associated with this ocean shipment. ISF must be filed 24 hours before vessel loading.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this AMS filing record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notify_party_name
attributes.description: The name of the party to be notified upon arrival of the cargo. Often the consignee or their customs broker.

attributes.name: piece_count
attributes.description: The total number of pieces or packages in the shipment covered by this AMS filing.

attributes.name: port_of_lading_code
attributes.description: The five-character UN/LOCODE identifying the foreign port where the cargo was loaded onto the conveyance.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: The reason code or message provided by CBP when an AMS filing is rejected. Used to correct and resubmit.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: The date when CBP released the cargo for delivery after completing all inspections and clearance procedures.

attributes.name: vessel_imo_number
attributes.description: The seven-digit IMO ship identification number, a unique permanent identifier for the vessel.

attributes.name: vessel_name
attributes.description: The name of the ocean vessel carrying the cargo. Required for ocean AMS filings.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: The total volume of the cargo in cubic meters. Used for capacity planning and dimensional weight calculations.

attributes.name: voyage_number
attributes.description: The carrier-assigned voyage or trip number for ocean shipments. Identifies the specific sailing.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: The total gross weight of the cargo in kilograms. Required for AMS filing.

products.name: denied_party_screening
products.description: Transactional record of denied party and restricted entity screening checks performed against shipment parties (shipper, consignee, notify party, manufacturer, broker). Captures screening run date and time, screened party name and address, screening list sources checked (OFAC SDN, BIS Entity List, EU Consolidated List, UN Sanctions, C-TPAT denied parties), match status (clear/potential_match/confirmed_match), match score, analyst review outcome, override justification, and regulatory hold flag. Powered by Descartes Customs GTM denied party screening module. Critical for trade compliance and AEO/C-TPAT program adherence.
products.reference: OFAC SDN List / BIS Entity List / EU Consolidated Sanctions List

attributes.name: denied_party_screening_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the denied party screening record. Primary key.

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment being screened for denied party compliance.

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.declaration. Business justification: Denied party screening is performed as part of customs declaration processing. The declaration has denied_party_screening_status indicating this relationship. Adding a FK from screening to declaration

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the compliance analyst who reviewed the screening result.

attributes.name: screened_trade_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: The denied_party_screening table has denormalized party attributes (name, address, city, state, postal_code, country_code, tax_number) that correspond to trade_party master data. Linking to trade_part

attributes.name: analyst_review_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the compliance analyst review for potential or confirmed matches (approved, rejected, escalated, pending review).

attributes.name: analyst_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether manual analyst review is required for this screening result (true for potential matches, false for clear results).

attributes.name: analyst_review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the compliance analyst completed their review of the screening result.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this screening record to the complete audit trail for regulatory reporting and compliance verification.

attributes.name: compliance_program
attributes.description: Trade compliance program under which this screening was performed (C-TPAT, AEO, Partners in Protection, Customs Self Assessment, Secure Exports Scheme).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this screening record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Level of escalation for high-risk matches requiring senior management or legal review (none, tier 1, tier 2, tier 3, executive).

attributes.name: false_positive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the match was determined to be a false positive after analyst review.

attributes.name: hold_release_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the regulatory hold was released and the shipment was cleared for processing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this screening record was last updated.

attributes.name: match_score
attributes.description: Numerical confidence score (0.00 to 100.00) indicating the strength of the match between the screened party and denied party list entries.

attributes.name: match_status
attributes.description: Result of the screening check indicating whether the party matched any denied party list (clear, potential match, confirmed match, false positive).

attributes.name: matched_entity_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the matched entity on the denied party list (e.g., OFAC SDN number).

attributes.name: matched_entity_name
attributes.description: Name of the denied party entity from the sanctions list that matched the screened party.

attributes.name: matched_entity_program
attributes.description: Sanctions program or regulatory program associated with the matched denied party (e.g., Iran Sanctions, Counter-Terrorism, Narcotics Trafficking).

attributes.name: matched_list_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific denied party list where a match was found (e.g., OFAC SDN, BIS Entity List).

attributes.name: override_justification
attributes.description: Detailed justification provided by the compliance analyst for overriding a potential or confirmed match and approving the shipment.

attributes.name: party_type
attributes.description: Type of shipment party being screened (shipper, consignee, notify party, manufacturer, broker, carrier, freight forwarder). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shipper|consignee|notify_party|manufacturer|broker|carrier|freight_forwarder — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment is placed on regulatory hold due to denied party screening results, preventing further processing until cleared.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Overall risk score (0.00 to 100.00) assigned to this screening result based on match quality, party type, and destination country risk.

attributes.name: screening_engine_version
attributes.description: Version number of the denied party screening engine used to perform this check.

attributes.name: screening_list_sources
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of denied party and restricted entity lists checked during this screening (OFAC SDN, BIS Entity List, EU Consolidated List, UN Sanctions, C-TPAT denied parties, HMT Sanctions, DFAT Sanctions, etc.).
attributes.references: OFAC, BIS, EU, UN, C-TPAT Standards

attributes.name: screening_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments recorded during the screening process or analyst review.

attributes.name: screening_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number for this screening transaction, used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: screening_rule_set_version
