attributes.description: Description of the audit methodology or framework applied, such as risk-based sampling, full population review, process walkthrough, or specific regulatory audit protocol. Defines the approach used to conduct the assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: audit_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the compliance audit for tracking and reporting purposes. Used in communications with customs authorities and internal stakeholders.

attributes.name: audit_period_end_date
attributes.description: The ending date of the time period being audited. Defines the end of the lookback window for transactions, declarations, and compliance activities under review.

attributes.name: audit_period_start_date
attributes.description: The beginning date of the time period being audited. Defines the start of the lookback window for transactions, declarations, and compliance activities under review.

attributes.name: audit_report_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the formal audit report document containing detailed findings, evidence, and recommendations. Links to document management system or repository.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: audit_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the audit scope including specific customs processes, declarations, shipment lanes, time periods, or compliance programs being audited. Defines the boundaries and focus areas of the audit engagement.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: audit_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the audit fieldwork or assessment activities officially began. Used for tracking audit duration and scheduling.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the compliance audit. Planned indicates scheduled but not started, in_progress indicates active fieldwork, completed indicates findings issued but corrective actions pending, closed indicates all corrective actions completed and audit finalized.

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit based on the conducting party and scope. Internal audits are self-assessments, external audits are conducted by third parties or regulatory bodies such as CBP (Customs and Border Protection), AEO (Authorized Economic Operator), C-TPAT (Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism), or WCO (World Customs Organization).
attributes.references: C-TPAT Minimum Security Criteria, AEO Authorization Guidelines

attributes.name: auditor_certification
attributes.description: Professional certifications or qualifications held by the lead auditor, such as Certified Customs Specialist (CCS), Licensed Customs Broker, ISO 19011 Lead Auditor, or other relevant trade compliance credentials.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: auditor_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization or entity that the auditor represents. May be internal department name, external consulting firm, or regulatory authority such as CBP, AEO certification body, or customs administration.
attributes.references: C-TPAT Security Profile, AEO Authorization Guidelines

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Name or code of the business unit, division, or operational entity that was the subject of the compliance audit. Used for organizational segmentation and reporting.

attributes.name: compliance_rating
attributes.description: Overall compliance rating assigned to the audited entity or process based on the audit findings. Excellent indicates no significant findings, satisfactory indicates minor findings only, needs_improvement indicates major findings requiring corrective action, unsatisfactory indicates critical findings, and non_compliant indicates severe violations requiring immediate remediation.
attributes.references: C-TPAT Security Profile, AEO Authorization Guidelines

attributes.name: compliance_score
attributes.description: Numerical compliance score expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00) representing the overall compliance performance based on audit criteria. Higher scores indicate better compliance posture.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which all corrective actions must be completed and verified. Used for tracking compliance with audit remediation timelines and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: C-TPAT Minimum Security Criteria, AEO Authorization Guidelines

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number for the corrective action plan developed in response to audit findings. Links the audit to the remediation activities and follow-up tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, C-TPAT Minimum Security Criteria

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who created this compliance audit record. Used for accountability and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act for Financial Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance audit record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act for Financial Reporting

attributes.name: critical_findings_count
attributes.description: Total number of critical severity findings identified during the audit. Critical findings represent major compliance violations with significant regulatory risk, potential penalties, or program suspension implications.
attributes.references: C-TPAT Minimum Security Criteria, AEO Authorization Guidelines

attributes.name: facility_location
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the specific facility, warehouse, or operational location where the audit was conducted. Used for site-specific compliance tracking.

attributes.name: follow_up_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date for the follow-up audit to verify corrective action implementation. Null if no follow-up audit is required.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: follow_up_audit_required
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a follow-up audit is required to verify implementation of corrective actions. True indicates follow-up audit is mandatory, false indicates no follow-up required.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this compliance audit record. Used for accountability and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act for Financial Reporting

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance audit record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act for Financial Reporting

attributes.name: major_findings_count
attributes.description: Total number of major severity findings identified during the audit. Major findings represent significant compliance gaps that require corrective action but do not pose immediate program suspension risk.
attributes.references: C-TPAT Minimum Security Criteria, AEO Authorization Guidelines

attributes.name: minor_findings_count
attributes.description: Total number of minor severity findings identified during the audit. Minor findings represent opportunities for improvement or minor procedural deviations that do not pose significant compliance risk.

attributes.name: population_size
attributes.description: Total number of transactions, declarations, or records in the population from which the audit sample was drawn. Used for calculating sampling rates and extrapolating findings.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: program_certification_impacted
attributes.description: Name of the trade compliance program or certification whose status may be impacted by the audit findings, such as C-TPAT, AEO, or other trusted trader programs. Used to track program-specific compliance obligations.
attributes.references: C-TPAT Security Profile, AEO Authorization Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the customs or regulatory authority with jurisdiction over the audit, such as U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), European Commission, or national customs administration. Identifies the governing body for compliance requirements.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or contextual information related to the audit that does not fit into structured fields. Used for capturing qualitative insights and special circumstances.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Overall risk level assigned to the audited entity or process based on the audit findings and compliance posture. Used for prioritizing remediation efforts and resource allocation.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework of Standards, ISO 31000 Risk Management

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of transactions, declarations, or records sampled and reviewed during the audit. Used for statistical analysis and audit scope documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: total_findings_count
attributes.description: Total number of all findings identified during the audit across all severity levels. Represents the aggregate count of critical, major, and minor findings.
attributes.references: ISO 19011 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: trade_lane
attributes.description: Specific trade lane or shipping corridor that was the focus of the audit, such as US-China, EU-Asia, or Intra-EU. Used for lane-specific compliance analysis.

attributes.name: c_tpat_certified_indicator

attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the shipper or consignee holds C-TPAT certification, which may expedite hold resolution. True if certified, False otherwise.
attributes.references: US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) C-TPAT Program

attributes.name: country_of_examination_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the examination took place (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this customs hold record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the customer was notified about the customs hold. True if notification was sent, False otherwise.

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer was notified about the customs hold.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the hold in hours, calculated from hold placed timestamp to actual release timestamp. Used for Service Level Agreement (SLA) impact analysis.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Numeric indicator of escalation level for complex or disputed holds. 0 = no escalation, 1 = first-level escalation, 2 = management escalation, 3 = executive escalation.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the hold was escalated to a higher level of review or management intervention.

attributes.name: examination_findings
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the examination findings, including any discrepancies, violations, or compliance issues discovered during the inspection.

attributes.name: examination_location
attributes.description: Physical location where the examination was conducted (e.g., port facility, Container Freight Station (CFS), bonded warehouse, Inland Container Depot (ICD)).

attributes.name: examination_result_code
attributes.description: Outcome of the customs examination. CLEARED = no issues found, DISCREPANCY_FOUND = documentation or commodity discrepancies identified, VIOLATION_DETECTED = regulatory violation discovered, ADDITIONAL_DUTY_ASSESSED = additional duties or taxes levied, SEIZURE = goods seized, PENALTY_ISSUED = monetary penalty imposed.

attributes.name: examination_type_code
attributes.description: Type of physical or documentary examination conducted. VACIS = Vehicle and Cargo Inspection System (non-intrusive imaging), CET = Container Examination Team (physical inspection), INTENSIVE = full intensive examination, TAILGATE = tailgate inspection, DOCUMENT_ONLY = documentary review only, NO_EXAM = hold released without examination.
attributes.references: US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Examination Standards

attributes.name: expected_release_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date when the hold is expected to be resolved and the shipment released, based on examination schedule and processing timelines.

attributes.name: hold_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier or reference number assigned to this customs hold by the issuing authority or internal system.

attributes.name: hold_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the customs hold. ACTIVE = hold is in effect, PENDING_RELEASE = awaiting clearance, RELEASED = hold has been lifted, ESCALATED = requires higher-level review, CANCELLED = hold was cancelled or withdrawn.

attributes.name: issuing_authority_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the customs authority or regulatory agency that placed the hold (e.g., CBP, USDA, FDA, port authority, internal compliance team).

attributes.name: issuing_authority_name
attributes.description: Full name of the customs authority or regulatory agency that issued the hold.

attributes.name: issuing_officer_badge_number
attributes.description: Badge or identification number of the customs officer who placed the hold.

attributes.name: issuing_officer_name
attributes.description: Name of the customs officer or inspector who placed the hold.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this customs hold record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary penalty amount imposed due to violations or non-compliance discovered during the hold examination, in the currency specified by penalty_currency_code.

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the penalty amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: placed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customs hold was officially placed on the shipment. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the specific reason for the hold (e.g., random inspection, high-risk commodity, incomplete documentation, valuation discrepancy, denied party screening hit).

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why the customs hold was placed, including any specific regulatory concerns or compliance issues identified.

attributes.name: resolution_action_code
attributes.description: Code representing the action taken to resolve the hold (e.g., documentation provided, duty paid, goods returned, goods destroyed, appeal filed).

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes describing how the hold was resolved, including any corrective actions taken, documentation submitted, or negotiations with customs authorities.

attributes.name: responsible_party_code
attributes.description: Code identifying which party is responsible for resolving the hold. SHIPPER = shipper responsible, CONSIGNEE = consignee responsible, BROKER = customs broker responsible, CARRIER = carrier responsible, INTERNAL = internal compliance team responsible.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Automated risk score assigned to the shipment that triggered the hold, typically from customs risk management systems. Higher scores indicate higher risk.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: sla_breach_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the hold caused a breach of the shipment Service Level Agreement (SLA) for on-time delivery. True if SLA was breached, False otherwise.

attributes.name: total_financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Total financial impact of the hold including additional duties, penalties, storage fees, and other charges, in the currency specified by total_financial_impact_currency_code.

attributes.name: total_financial_impact_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the total financial impact amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the customs hold type. CBP_EXAM = Customs and Border Protection examination, USDA_INSPECTION = United States Department of Agriculture inspection, FDA_INSPECTION = Food and Drug Administration inspection, SECURITY_HOLD = security-related detention, COMPLIANCE_REVIEW = internal compliance review, DOCUMENTATION_REVIEW = documentation verification hold.
attributes.references: US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Hold Classification

products.name: ruling_request
products.description: Master record for binding and advance ruling requests submitted to customs authorities for tariff classification, valuation, or origin determination. Captures ruling type (classification/valuation/origin/marking), requesting party, submission date, ruling authority (CBP/HMRC/EU customs authority), commodity description, proposed HS code, ruling number issued, ruling outcome, effective date, expiry date, and appeal status. Binding rulings provide legal certainty for duty calculations and are managed as authoritative reference within Descartes Customs GTM.
products.reference: WCO Customs Valuation Agreement / CBP Binding Ruling Program (19 CFR Part 177)

attributes.name: ruling_request_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customs ruling request record.

attributes.name: hs_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.hs_classification. Business justification: Ruling requests are submitted to customs authorities for tariff classification decisions. The ruling results in an approved HS code which corresponds to an hs_classification record. Linking ruling_req

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Customs ruling requests (classification, valuation, origin rulings) are billable advisory services. Links ruling request to invoice for professional services billing—standard practice for trade adviso

attributes.name: manufacturer_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Customs ruling requests reference manufacturer/supplier for product-specific classification or valuation rulings. Brokers submit rulings with supplier technical specifications and production details f

attributes.name: requesting_party_trade_party_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requesting Party Trade Party Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: Requesting party in ruling request is a trade party. Adding requesting_party_trade_party_id FK to trade_party.trade_party_id normalizes the requesting party reference. Cardinality: N:1 (many ruling re

attributes.name: submitted_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Ruling requests submitted by licensed customs brokers or trade compliance specialists (employees). Regulatory requirement for binding rulings. Tracks who prepared and submitted the request.

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date
attributes.description: Date the appeal authority issued a final decision on the appeal, if applicable. Null if no appeal decision has been rendered.

attributes.name: appeal_filing_date
attributes.description: Date an appeal was filed against the ruling decision, if applicable. Null if no appeal has been filed.

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Status of any appeal filed against the ruling decision. Tracks whether the requesting party or other interested parties have challenged the ruling and the outcome of that appeal process.

attributes.name: approved_hs_code
attributes.description: The official HS Code determined and approved by the customs authority in the ruling decision. This becomes the binding classification for future declarations involving the same commodity.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Convention

attributes.name: binding_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the ruling is legally binding on the customs authority for future declarations involving the same commodity and circumstances.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Brand or trademark name of the commodity covered by the ruling, if applicable. May be relevant for classification and valuation determinations.

attributes.name: commodity_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the goods or commodity for which the ruling is requested. Must include sufficient detail for the customs authority to make an informed classification, valuation, or origin determination.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Convention

attributes.name: country_of_origin_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the country of origin for the commodity as determined or confirmed by the ruling. Critical for preferential trade agreement eligibility and duty calculation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ruling request record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customs_office_code
attributes.description: Specific customs office or port code where the ruling request was filed or that has jurisdiction over the request.

attributes.name: duty_rate_percent
attributes.description: Applicable duty rate percentage determined by the ruling based on the approved HS Code and origin determination. Used for calculating import duties on future shipments.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the ruling becomes legally effective and binding for customs declarations. May differ from the decision date if the authority specifies a future effective date.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the ruling expires and is no longer valid for use in customs declarations. Binding rulings typically have a fixed validity period (e.g., 3-5 years depending on jurisdiction).

attributes.name: importer_identifier
attributes.description: Official customs identifier for the importer of record such as Importer Number, EORI, or Tax ID.

attributes.name: importer_name
attributes.description: Name of the importer of record who will use the ruling for customs declarations. May differ from the requesting party if a broker or consultant submitted on behalf of the importer.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: Incoterms code applicable to the transaction or commodity covered by the ruling. Relevant for valuation rulings as Incoterms determine which costs are included in customs value.
attributes.references: ICC (International Chamber of Commerce) Incoterms Standards

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model number or product code for the commodity. Helps ensure the ruling is applied only to the specific product variant covered by the decision.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ruling request record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: preference_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the ruling confirms eligibility for preferential duty treatment under a trade agreement.

attributes.name: proposed_hs_code
attributes.description: The HS Code proposed by the requesting party for tariff classification of the commodity. This is the applicant's suggested classification subject to customs authority review and approval.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Convention

attributes.name: public_availability_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the ruling is publicly available in the customs authority's ruling database or if it is confidential to the requesting party.

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date the ruling was revoked or invalidated by the customs authority, if applicable. Null if the ruling remains valid or expired naturally.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the ruling was revoked, such as changes in law, discovery of incorrect information, or changes in product specifications.

attributes.name: ruling_authority_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the customs authority responsible for issuing the ruling. Examples include CBP (US Customs and Border Protection), HMRC (UK), EU member state customs authorities, or other national customs agencies.

attributes.name: ruling_authority_name
attributes.description: Full name of the customs authority or agency that issued or is reviewing the ruling request.

attributes.name: ruling_decision_date
attributes.description: Date the customs authority issued the final ruling decision. Marks the official determination and start of the ruling's validity period.

attributes.name: ruling_number
attributes.description: Official ruling number issued by the customs authority upon approval. Serves as the external reference identifier for the binding or advance ruling decision.

attributes.name: ruling_outcome
attributes.description: Final decision outcome of the ruling request. Indicates whether the customs authority approved the request as submitted, approved with modifications to the proposed classification or determination, denied the request, or if the applicant withdrew it.

attributes.name: ruling_rationale
attributes.description: Detailed explanation provided by the customs authority for the ruling decision, including legal basis, classification reasoning, and interpretation of applicable regulations.

attributes.name: ruling_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ruling request. Tracks progression from initial draft through submission, authority review, final decision, and post-decision states including expiration and appeals. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|denied|withdrawn|expired|appealed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ruling_type
attributes.description: Type of ruling requested from the customs authority. Classification rulings determine HS Code assignment, valuation rulings establish customs value methodology, origin rulings confirm country of origin for preferential treatment, marking rulings clarify labeling requirements, binding rulings provide legal certainty, and advance rulings are issued before importation.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Convention

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date the ruling request was officially submitted to the customs authority. Marks the start of the formal review process and is used to calculate processing timelines and expiration dates.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the ruling request was submitted to the customs authority, including time zone information. Used for audit trails and compliance verification.

attributes.name: supporting_documentation
attributes.description: List or description of supporting documents submitted with the ruling request such as product samples, technical drawings, certificates of origin, manufacturing process descriptions, or laboratory test results.

attributes.name: technical_specifications
attributes.description: Detailed technical specifications of the commodity including materials, dimensions, composition, functionality, and other characteristics relevant to classification or origin determination.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Convention

attributes.name: trade_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the preferential trade agreement under which the ruling is requested or granted, such as USMCA, EU-UK TCA, CPTPP, or other free trade agreements.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Agreement Registry

attributes.name: validity_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months the ruling remains valid from the effective date. Standard validity periods vary by jurisdiction and ruling type.

attributes.name: valuation_method_code
attributes.description: Code representing the customs valuation method approved in the ruling, based on WTO Valuation Agreement methods (transaction value, identical goods, similar goods, deductive, computed, fallback).
attributes.references: WTO (World Trade Organization) Customs Valuation Agreement

products.name: origin_determination
products.description: Master record for country of origin determinations made for specific goods, supporting preferential tariff claims and trade agreement benefits. Captures determination method (wholly obtained/substantial transformation/tariff shift/value added content), applicable trade agreement, origin criterion met, supporting documentation type (certificate of origin/EUR.1/Form A/REX declaration), determination date, validity period, issuing authority, and preferential rate claimed. Distinct from hs_classification — origin_determination establishes WHERE goods were made, not WHAT they are.
products.reference: WTO Rules of Origin Agreement / WCO Kyoto Convention

attributes.name: origin_determination_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the origin determination record.

attributes.name: hs_classification_id

attributes.name: importer_trade_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: Importer in origin determination is a trade party. Adding importer_trade_party_id FK to trade_party.trade_party_id normalizes the importer reference. Cardinality: N:1 (many origin determinations can h

attributes.name: manufacturer_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Origin determinations require manufacturer/supplier details for regional value content calculations and tariff shift analysis. Origin analysts verify supplier production locations and material sourcin

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_agreement. Business justification: Origin determinations are made in the context of specific trade agreements to qualify for preferential tariff treatment. Adding trade_agreement_id FK to trade_agreement.trade_agreement_id establishes

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the origin determination was approved for use.

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the supervisor or manager who approved the origin determination.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the certificate of origin or other supporting document.

attributes.name: commodity_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the goods for which country of origin is being determined.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Facilitation Agreement

attributes.name: country_of_origin_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code representing the determined country of origin for the goods.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this origin determination record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: determination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the origin determination was made.

attributes.name: determination_method
attributes.description: The method used to determine country of origin: wholly obtained (goods entirely produced in one country), substantial transformation (goods undergo significant processing), tariff shift (change in HS classification), value added content (percentage of value added in origin country), change in tariff classification, or regional value content (for trade agreement purposes).
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Rules of Origin

attributes.name: determination_number
attributes.description: Business reference number assigned to this origin determination for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: determination_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the origin determination: draft (being prepared), pending review (submitted for validation), approved (validated and active), rejected (not accepted), expired (validity period ended), or superseded (replaced by newer determination).

attributes.name: determined_by_user
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the customs specialist or trade compliance officer who made the origin determination.

attributes.name: duty_savings_amount
attributes.description: Estimated or actual duty savings realized by claiming preferential origin under the trade agreement.

attributes.name: duty_savings_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the duty savings amount.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this origin determination is valid and can be used for preferential tariff claims.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date until which this origin determination remains valid. Nullable for determinations without expiration.

attributes.name: exporter_identifier
attributes.description: Tax ID, customs registration number, or other official identifier of the exporter.

attributes.name: exporter_name
attributes.description: Name of the exporting party who prepared or provided the origin documentation.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: The HS Code of the goods for which origin is being determined. Links the origin determination to the commodity classification.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government agency, chamber of commerce, or authorized body that issued the certificate of origin or validated the origin determination.

attributes.name: issuing_authority_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the country where the issuing authority is located.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this origin determination record was last updated.

attributes.name: materials_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for materials values.

attributes.name: non_originating_materials_value
attributes.description: Total value of non-originating materials used in production, relevant for regional value content calculations.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Rules of Origin

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or justification supporting the origin determination decision.

attributes.name: origin_criterion_met
attributes.description: Specific origin criterion satisfied under the applicable trade agreement (e.g., Criterion A: wholly obtained, Criterion B: produced exclusively from originating materials, Criterion C: tariff shift rule met).
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Rules of Origin

attributes.name: originating_materials_value
attributes.description: Total value of originating materials used in production, relevant for regional value content calculations.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Rules of Origin

attributes.name: preferential_tariff_rate_percent
attributes.description: The preferential duty rate (as percentage) claimed under the applicable trade agreement based on this origin determination.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Tariff Analysis Online

attributes.name: production_location
attributes.description: Specific facility, plant, or location where the goods were produced or substantially transformed.

attributes.name: regional_value_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of regional value content calculated for trade agreement compliance, representing the proportion of value added within the trade agreement region.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Rules of Origin

attributes.name: rvc_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate regional value content: transaction value (based on sale price), net cost (based on production costs), build-up (sum of originating materials and costs), or build-down (subtract non-originating materials from total value).
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Rules of Origin

attributes.name: standard_tariff_rate_percent
attributes.description: The standard (Most Favored Nation) duty rate that would apply without preferential origin, for comparison purposes.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Tariff Analysis Online

attributes.name: supporting_document_type
attributes.description: Type of documentation supporting the origin determination: certificate of origin (traditional paper certificate), EUR.1 (EU preferential certificate), Form A (GSP certificate), REX declaration (Registered Exporter system), USMCA certification, manufacturer affidavit, supplier declaration, or origin declaration on commercial invoice. attributes.name: tariff_shift_rule_met
attributes.description: Description of the specific tariff shift rule satisfied (e.g., change from any other chapter, change from any other heading, change from any other subheading).

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customs authority verified or audited this origin determination.

attributes.name: verification_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number assigned by customs authority during verification or audit of the origin determination.

attributes.name: verified_by_customs_authority
attributes.description: Indicates whether this origin determination has been verified or audited by the destination country customs authority.

products.name: certificate_of_origin
products.description: Transactional record for certificates of origin issued or managed for export shipments, supporting preferential duty claims at destination. Managed in Descartes Customs GTM and linked to export declarations.

attributes.name: tax_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.tax_account. Business justification: Origin certificates support preferential tariff treatment, affecting duty rates and tax accounts. Required for duty savings validation, tax reporting, and audit support for preferential tariff claims.

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_agreement. Business justification: Certificates of origin are issued under specific trade agreements to claim preferential tariff treatment. The certificate has trade_agreement_code as a denormalized string. Adding FK to trade_agreemen

attributes.name: verified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: COO verification performed by trade compliance officers (employees). Regulatory requirement for preferential tariff claims. Tracks who verified the certificate authenticity and origin criteria.

attributes.name: awb_number
attributes.description: Air waybill number for air freight shipments covered by this certificate. Nullable if shipment is not by air.

attributes.name: bol_number
