attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certificate of origin record was last updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: origin_criterion
attributes.description: Specific rule or criterion under which the goods qualify for origin status, such as wholly obtained, substantial transformation, regional value content percentage, or change in tariff classification. Format and content vary by trade agreement.
attributes.references: WTO Rules of Origin, USMCA Chapter 4, EU-UK Trade Agreement, RCEP Chapter 3

attributes.name: package_count
attributes.description: Total number of packages or shipping units covered by this certificate.

attributes.name: package_type_code
attributes.description: UN/CEFACT Recommendation 21 code indicating the type of packaging, such as CT (carton), PX (pallet), DR (drum), BX (box).

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the certificate of origin, such as back-to-back certificate references, third-country invoicing details, or clarifications on origin criteria.

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date when the certificate was revoked by the issuing authority. Nullable if certificate has not been revoked.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model, WTO Rules of Origin

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason for certificate revocation, such as fraudulent information, incorrect origin determination, or exporter request. Nullable if certificate has not been revoked.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model, WTO Rules of Origin

attributes.name: shipment_reference
attributes.description: Reference number linking this certificate to the associated export shipment, such as internal shipment ID or booking reference.

attributes.name: total_gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of all goods covered by this certificate, including packaging, measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: total_net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total net weight of all goods covered by this certificate, excluding packaging, measured in kilograms.

products.name: incoterms_assignment
products.description: Reference and association record capturing the Incoterms rule assigned to a shipment or trade transaction, governing the allocation of costs, risks, and responsibilities between buyer and seller. Captures Incoterms version (2020/2010), rule code (EXW/FCA/CPT/CIP/DAP/DPP/DDP/FAS/FOB/CFR/CIF), named place or port, risk transfer point, cost responsibility boundary, insurance obligation party, customs clearance responsibility (import/export), and effective date. Supports liability determination and duty basis calculation (CIF vs FOB).

attributes.name: incoterms_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Incoterms assignment record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment to which this Incoterms rule is assigned. Links the Incoterms assignment to the specific shipment transaction.

attributes.name: freight_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the freight order associated with this Incoterms assignment. Used when Incoterms are assigned at the freight order level rather than individual shipment level.

attributes.name: incoterms_charge_allocation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.incoterms_charge_allocation. Business justification: Incoterms assignments must reference charge allocation rules to determine cost responsibility (seller vs buyer) for freight, insurance, customs, and handling charges. Core pricing logic for internatio

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.lane. Business justification: Incoterms define cost/risk transfer points that align with transport lanes. Required for freight costing by lane, liability determination, and route planning based on trade terms. Lane determines appl

attributes.name: primary_incoterms_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created this Incoterms assignment. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: trade_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broader trade transaction or commercial invoice to which this Incoterms assignment applies. Supports cross-border trade compliance tracking.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Facilitation Standards

attributes.name: assigned_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this Incoterms assignment was created in the system. Provides audit trail for compliance and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the Incoterms assignment. Used for external communication and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: assignment_source
attributes.description: Indicates the source document or process from which this Incoterms assignment was derived. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the Incoterms assignment. Indicates whether the assignment is currently in force, has been replaced by a newer assignment, was cancelled, or has been completed.

attributes.name: buyer_cost_responsibility
attributes.description: Detailed enumeration of costs that the buyer is responsible for under the assigned Incoterms rule. Complements seller cost responsibility to provide full cost allocation picture.

attributes.name: buyer_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the buyer party in the transaction governed by this Incoterms assignment. Provides business context for liability and cost allocation.

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: General classification of the commodity being shipped under this Incoterms assignment. Certain commodities may have preferred or restricted Incoterms rules.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the sales contract or purchase order that specifies the Incoterms rule for this transaction. Provides traceability to the commercial agreement.

attributes.name: cost_responsibility_boundary
attributes.description: Description of the point up to which the seller bears transportation and logistics costs. Defines the financial split between buyer and seller for freight, handling, and related charges.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the shipment governed by this Incoterms assignment contains dangerous goods. Dangerous goods may affect Incoterms selection and insurance requirements.
attributes.references: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: duty_basis_calculation_method
attributes.description: Indicates the valuation basis used for customs duty calculation. CIF-based Incoterms include cost, insurance, and freight in the customs value; FOB-based rules include only the goods value. Critical for accurate duty and tax assessment.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Valuation Agreement, World Customs Organization (WCO) Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this Incoterms assignment becomes effective and governs the transaction. Typically aligns with the contract date or shipment booking date.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this Incoterms assignment ceases to be effective. Nullable for assignments that remain valid indefinitely or until shipment completion.

attributes.name: export_customs_clearance_party
attributes.description: Indicates which party is responsible for completing export customs clearance formalities and paying export duties and taxes. Under most Incoterms rules, the seller handles export clearance.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Standards, International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) Incoterms 2020

attributes.name: import_customs_clearance_party
attributes.description: Indicates which party is responsible for completing import customs clearance formalities and paying import duties and taxes. Only under DDP does the seller handle import clearance; under all other rules, the buyer is responsible.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Standards, International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) Incoterms 2020

attributes.name: incoterms_rule_code
attributes.description: The three-letter code representing the specific Incoterms rule assigned to the transaction. Defines the allocation of costs, risks, and responsibilities between buyer and seller. Examples: EXW (Ex Works), FOB (Free on Board), CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_rule_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the Incoterms rule. Provides human-readable context for the rule code (e.g., 'Free on Board', 'Delivered Duty Paid').

attributes.name: incoterms_version
attributes.description: The version year of the Incoterms rules being applied. Determines which rule set and interpretations govern the transaction. Most common versions are 2020 and 2010.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) Incoterms Standards

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_level
attributes.description: The minimum insurance coverage level required under the Incoterms rule. For CIP, Institute Cargo Clauses (A) or equivalent is required; for CIF, Institute Cargo Clauses (C) or equivalent minimum coverage applies.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) Incoterms 2020, Institute Cargo Clauses

attributes.name: insurance_obligation_party
attributes.description: Indicates which party (seller or buyer) is obligated to procure cargo insurance under the assigned Incoterms rule. For CIP and CIF, the seller must insure; for most other rules, insurance is optional or buyer's responsibility.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this Incoterms assignment record was last modified. Provides audit trail for compliance and change management.

attributes.name: named_place
attributes.description: The specific location or port designated in the Incoterms rule where risk and cost transfer occurs. This is the critical point that defines obligations (e.g., 'Port of Shanghai', 'Warehouse in Hamburg', 'Customer facility in Chicago').

attributes.name: named_place_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the country where the named place is located. Supports geographic analysis and customs compliance.

attributes.name: named_place_type
attributes.description: Classification of the named place location type. Indicates whether the named place is a seaport, airport, inland terminal, warehouse, or customer facility.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, clarifications, or special conditions related to this Incoterms assignment. Supports documentation of exceptions or unique circumstances.

attributes.name: risk_transfer_point
attributes.description: Detailed description of the exact point at which risk transfers from seller to buyer under the assigned Incoterms rule. Critical for liability determination and insurance coverage decisions.

attributes.name: seller_cost_responsibility
attributes.description: Detailed enumeration of costs that the seller is responsible for under the assigned Incoterms rule. May include export packing, loading, main carriage, insurance, unloading, and import duties depending on the rule.

attributes.name: seller_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the seller party in the transaction governed by this Incoterms assignment. Provides business context for liability and cost allocation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system from which this Incoterms assignment record originated (e.g., 'Descartes Customs', 'SAP TM', 'Oracle TMS'). Supports data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this record in the source operational system. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse and source systems.

attributes.name: special_handling_requirements
attributes.description: Any special handling, storage, or transport requirements that may affect the application of the Incoterms rule (e.g., temperature control, hazmat handling, security requirements).

attributes.name: trade_lane
attributes.description: The origin-destination trade lane for this transaction (e.g., 'Asia-Europe', 'Transpacific Eastbound'). Supports analysis of Incoterms usage patterns by trade corridor.

attributes.name: transport_mode_applicability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assigned Incoterms rule can be used for any mode of transport or is restricted to sea and inland waterway transport only. Rules like FOB, CFR, CIF, FAS are sea/waterway only; rules like EXW, FCA, CPT, CIP, DAP, DPU, DDP apply to any mode.

products.name: dg_declaration
products.description: Transactional record for dangerous goods (DG) declarations accompanying shipments containing hazardous materials, as required by IMDG Code (ocean), ICAO Technical Instructions (air), and ADR/RID (road/rail). Captures UN number, proper shipping name, hazard class and division, packing group, subsidiary hazard, net quantity, gross quantity, packaging type, emergency contact, shipper certification, transport mode, and regulatory compliance status. Managed in Descartes Customs GTM and linked to the parent declaration and shipment. Critical for customs clearance of restricted commodities.
products.reference: IMDG Code (IMO) / ICAO Technical Instructions / ADR (UN ECE)

attributes.name: dg_declaration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dangerous goods declaration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: billing_invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice_line. Business justification: Dangerous goods declaration preparation is a specialized billable service requiring certified expertise. Links DG declaration to invoice line for hazmat handling fee billing—standard surcharge in dang

attributes.name: certified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: DG declarations certified by IATA-certified dangerous goods specialists (employees). IATA/ICAO regulatory requirement. Tracks certification authority and ensures only qualified personnel handle danger

attributes.name: certifying_dg_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.dg_certification. Business justification: IATA/IMDG regulations require DG declarations to be prepared or reviewed by certified dangerous goods personnel. Logistics operators must validate certification status before accepting DG shipments. R

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shipment.consignment. Business justification: Dangerous goods declarations are filed per shipment containing hazmat. Regulatory compliance (IATA/IMDG), carrier acceptance, and customs clearance all require linking DG declaration to consignment. M

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent customs declaration to which this dangerous goods declaration is attached.

attributes.name: pricing_surcharge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.surcharge. Business justification: Dangerous goods declarations trigger hazmat surcharges based on UN number, hazard class, and packaging. Required for applying regulatory-mandated dangerous goods pricing and ensuring compliance with I

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Business justification: Dangerous goods declarations must link to the specific transport document (AWB/BOL) they accompany - IATA/IMDG regulatory requirement for hazmat shipment documentation and carrier acceptance.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the dangerous goods declaration was approved by the reviewing authority.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that approved the dangerous goods declaration.

attributes.name: competent_authority_approval
attributes.description: Approval number issued by the competent authority for dangerous goods requiring special authorization.
attributes.references: National competent authorities, IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this dangerous goods declaration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the person or organization to contact in case of emergency involving the dangerous goods.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions, ADR, RID

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: 24-hour emergency telephone number for immediate response in case of incident involving the dangerous goods.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions, ADR, RID

attributes.name: excepted_quantity_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dangerous goods are shipped in excepted quantities, subject to minimal regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: exemption_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any regulatory exemption or special approval granted for the transport of these dangerous goods.
attributes.references: National competent authorities, IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: filing_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the dangerous goods declaration was filed with the customs authority or carrier.

attributes.name: flash_point_celsius
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which the dangerous goods give off sufficient vapor to form an ignitable mixture with air, measured in degrees Celsius.

attributes.name: gross_quantity
attributes.description: Gross quantity of the dangerous goods including packaging, expressed in the unit of measure specified.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: Primary hazard class of the dangerous goods (1=Explosives, 2=Gases, 3=Flammable Liquids, 4=Flammable Solids, 5=Oxidizing Substances, 6=Toxic Substances, 7=Radioactive Material, 8=Corrosive Substances, 9=Miscellaneous). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1|2|3|4|5|6|7|8|9 — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: hazard_division
attributes.description: Subdivision within the hazard class providing more specific categorization of the dangerous goods (e.g., 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2).
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this dangerous goods declaration record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: limited_quantity_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dangerous goods are shipped in limited quantities, allowing for relaxed packaging and labeling requirements.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: marine_pollutant_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dangerous goods are classified as a marine pollutant under IMDG Code.

attributes.name: net_quantity
attributes.description: Net quantity of the dangerous goods excluding packaging, expressed in the unit of measure specified.

attributes.name: package_count
attributes.description: Number of packages containing the dangerous goods in this declaration.

attributes.name: packaging_instruction
attributes.description: Specific packaging instruction number from the applicable dangerous goods regulation (e.g., P001, IBC01, LP01).

attributes.name: packaging_type_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the type of packaging used for the dangerous goods (e.g., drum, box, cylinder).
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: Degree of danger presented by the substance (I=Great Danger, II=Medium Danger, III=Minor Danger).
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: proper_shipping_name
attributes.description: Official name of the dangerous goods as specified in the UN Model Regulations, used for identification and documentation.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the net and gross quantities (e.g., kilograms, liters).
attributes.references: ISO 80000, IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the dangerous goods declaration meets all applicable regulatory requirements for the transport mode and jurisdictions involved.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions, ADR, RID, WCO, national customs authorities

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the dangerous goods declaration was rejected, if applicable.

attributes.name: segregation_group
attributes.description: Segregation group code indicating compatibility and stowage requirements for the dangerous goods in relation to other cargo.

attributes.name: shipper_address
attributes.description: Full address of the shipper or consignor of the dangerous goods.

attributes.name: shipper_certification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the shipper certified the dangerous goods declaration.

attributes.name: shipper_certification_signature
attributes.description: Name or digital signature of the authorized person who certified the dangerous goods declaration on behalf of the shipper.

attributes.name: shipper_certification_statement
attributes.description: Certification statement signed by the shipper declaring that the dangerous goods are properly classified, packaged, marked, and labeled, and in proper condition for transport.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions, ADR, RID

attributes.name: shipper_name
attributes.description: Name of the shipper or consignor responsible for the dangerous goods shipment.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this dangerous goods declaration record originated (e.g., Descartes Customs GTM).

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this dangerous goods declaration in the source operational system.

attributes.name: special_provision_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of special provision codes applicable to the dangerous goods, indicating exceptions or additional requirements.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions, ADR, RID

attributes.name: stowage_category
attributes.description: Stowage category for ocean transport indicating where the dangerous goods may be stowed on the vessel (A=on deck or under deck, B=on deck only, C=away from living quarters, D=on deck only away from living quarters, E=on deck only in open cargo space).

attributes.name: subsidiary_hazard
attributes.description: Secondary hazard class or division if the dangerous goods present more than one type of hazard.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: technical_name
attributes.description: Chemical or technical name of the dangerous goods, required when the proper shipping name is a generic or N.O.S. (Not Otherwise Specified) entry.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation for the dangerous goods shipment, determining applicable regulatory framework.
attributes.references: IMDG Code (ocean), ICAO Technical Instructions (air), ADR (road), RID (rail)

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number assigned to the hazardous substance or article, prefixed with UN.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

products.name: valuation
products.description: Master record for customs valuation determinations applied to imported goods, establishing the dutiable value basis for duty calculation. Captures valuation method (transaction value/identical goods/similar goods/deductive/computed/fallback — WTO Customs Valuation Agreement Articles 1-7), declared transaction value, freight charges, insurance charges, royalties, assists, CIF value, FOB value, customs value accepted, currency, exchange rate, valuation date, and any adjustments made by customs authority. Distinct from duty_assessment — valuation establishes the BASE, assessment applies the RATE.
products.reference: WTO Customs Valuation Agreement (CVA) / WCO Valuation Compendium

attributes.name: valuation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customs valuation determination record. Primary key.

attributes.name: carbon_offset_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_offset_transaction. Business justification: Customs valuation includes CBAM charges (carbon border adjustment) that are offset through carbon credit purchases. Real process: CBAM certificate procurement and surrender linked to customs value adj

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent customs declaration for which this valuation determination was performed.

attributes.name: declaration_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific declaration line item being valued. Valuation is performed at the line level for each imported good.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customs officer who reviewed and approved the valuation determination.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Customs valuation adjustments trigger GL postings for duty expense corrections. Essential for audit trail, financial statement accuracy, and reconciliation of customs value to landed cost accounting.

attributes.name: valuation_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created this valuation determination record.

attributes.name: valuation_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that last modified this valuation determination record.

attributes.name: adjustments_amount
attributes.description: Net adjustments made by customs authority to the declared valuation. Positive for additions, negative for reductions. Reflects customs examination findings.

attributes.name: assists_value_amount
attributes.description: Value of goods and services supplied by the buyer free of charge or at reduced cost for use in production and sale for export of the imported goods (materials, tools, dies, molds, engineering, development work). Must be added to transaction value per Article 8.1(b).

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: Incoterms basis used for customs valuation: CIF (Cost Insurance Freight), FOB (Free On Board), DAP (Delivered At Place), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid), EXW (Ex Works), FCA (Free Carrier). Determines which costs are included in dutiable value.

attributes.name: cif_value_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost Insurance and Freight (CIF) Value Amount
attributes.description: Total CIF (Cost, Insurance, Freight) value: transaction value plus freight, insurance, and loading charges to the port of importation. Standard basis for customs valuation in many jurisdictions.

attributes.name: commissions_brokerage_amount
attributes.description: Buying commissions and brokerage fees (except buying commissions) included in the transaction value. Selling commissions are not added per Article 8.1(a).

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: Automated or analyst-assigned confidence score (0-100) indicating the reliability and completeness of the valuation determination. Higher scores indicate greater confidence in the declared values and method.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this valuation determination record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this valuation record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CNY).

attributes.name: customs_authority_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the customs authority or office that reviewed and accepted this valuation determination.

attributes.name: customs_query_raised_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customs authority raised a query or requested additional documentation regarding this valuation determination.

attributes.name: customs_value_accepted_amount
attributes.description: Final customs value accepted by the customs authority for duty calculation purposes. This is the definitive dutiable value base after all adjustments, additions, and deductions.

attributes.name: declared_transaction_value_amount
attributes.description: The price actually paid or payable for the imported goods when sold for export to the country of importation, as declared by the importer. This is the starting point for Method 1 (Transaction Value) valuation.

attributes.name: deductions_amount
attributes.description: Total value of allowable deductions from the declared transaction value (e.g., post-importation costs, construction/installation charges incurred after importation). Reduces the customs value base.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert foreign currency transaction values to the importing country's currency for duty calculation. Rate as of the valuation date.
attributes.references: National Customs Authority Exchange Rate Policy

attributes.name: exchange_rate_source
attributes.description: Authority or system that provided the exchange rate (e.g., Central Bank, Customs Authority Official Rate, Commercial Bank Rate).

attributes.name: fob_value_amount
attributes.description: FOB (Free On Board) value: transaction value at the point of export, excluding international freight and insurance. Used as alternative valuation basis in some jurisdictions.

attributes.name: freight_charges_amount
attributes.description: Cost of transportation of the imported goods to the port or place of importation. Added to transaction value to determine customs value under CIF (Cost, Insurance, Freight) basis.

attributes.name: insurance_charges_amount
attributes.description: Cost of insurance for the imported goods during international transport. Added to transaction value to determine customs value under CIF basis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this valuation determination record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: loading_handling_charges_amount
attributes.description: Costs associated with loading, unloading, and handling the goods up to the place of importation. Included in customs value calculation per Article 8.

attributes.name: method_code
attributes.description: The WCO Customs Valuation Agreement method applied: METHOD_1 (Transaction Value - Article 1), METHOD_2 (Identical Goods - Article 2), METHOD_3 (Similar Goods - Article 3), METHOD_4 (Deductive Value - Article 5), METHOD_5 (Computed Value - Article 6), METHOD_6 (Fallback - Article 7). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: METHOD_1|METHOD_2|METHOD_3|METHOD_4|METHOD_5|METHOD_6 — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments regarding the valuation determination, including justification for method selection, explanation of adjustments, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: packing_costs_amount
attributes.description: Cost of containers and packing materials, whether for labor or materials, treated as part of the imported goods. Included in customs value per Article 8.1(a).

attributes.name: proceeds_resale_amount
attributes.description: Value of any part of the proceeds of subsequent resale, disposal, or use of the imported goods that accrues directly or indirectly to the seller. Must be added to transaction value per Article 8.1(d).

attributes.name: query_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which any customs query regarding this valuation was resolved and the valuation was finalized.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for this valuation determination, used for tracking and audit purposes across systems and with customs authorities.

attributes.name: relationship_buyer_seller_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Relationship Between Buyer and Seller Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a relationship exists between the buyer and seller that might influence the transaction value. If true, customs may examine whether the relationship influenced the price.

attributes.name: resale_disposal_restriction_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the buyer's resale, disposal, or use of the goods is restricted (other than restrictions imposed by law, geographic limitations, or restrictions that do not substantially affect value). May affect acceptability of transaction value.

attributes.name: risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this valuation has been flagged for risk review due to unusual values, method selection, or discrepancies with historical data.

attributes.name: royalties_license_fees_amount
attributes.description: Royalties and license fees related to the imported goods that the buyer must pay as a condition of sale, directly or indirectly. Must be added to transaction value per Article 8.1(c).

attributes.name: ruling_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the advance valuation ruling expires and is no longer valid for customs valuation purposes.

attributes.name: ruling_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the advance valuation ruling was issued by the customs authority.

attributes.name: ruling_issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the customs authority or office that issued the advance valuation ruling.

attributes.name: ruling_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any advance valuation ruling or binding valuation decision issued by the customs authority for this commodity or transaction type.

attributes.name: sale_condition_restrictions_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sale or price is subject to conditions or considerations for which a value cannot be determined. If true, transaction value method may not be acceptable.

attributes.name: supporting_documents_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifiers or file paths to supporting documentation for this valuation (invoices, contracts, price lists, technical specifications, test reports, certificates).

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customs valuation was determined. Typically the date of importation or the date the goods are entered for customs purposes. Determines applicable exchange rates and tariff schedules.

attributes.name: valuation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the valuation determination: draft (prepared but not submitted), submitted (sent to customs), accepted (approved by customs authority), adjusted (modified by customs), rejected (not accepted), under_review (pending customs examination).

products.name: license_permit
products.description: Master record for import and export licenses, permits, and authorizations required for controlled, restricted, or regulated goods. Captures license type (import license/export license/dual-use export authorization/CITES permit/phytosanitary certificate/FDA prior notice), issuing authority, license number, commodity covered, HS code, authorized quantity, authorized value, country of origin/destination, issue date, expiry date, utilization balance, and license status (active/exhausted/suspended/revoked). Managed in Descartes Customs GTM trade compliance module.
products.reference: WTO Import Licensing Agreement / National Export Control Regulations / CITES

attributes.name: license_permit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the import/export license or permit record. Primary key for the license_permit product.

attributes.name: accessorial_charge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.accessorial_charge. Business justification: Import/export licenses incur processing, filing, and compliance verification fees. Required for billing customers for license-related services and tracking regulatory compliance costs in controlled go

attributes.name: applicant_trade_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: Applicant for license/permit is a trade party. Adding applicant_trade_party_id FK to trade_party.trade_party_id normalizes the applicant reference. Cardinality: N:1 (many license/permit applications c

attributes.name: authorized_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Import/export licenses specify authorized suppliers or beneficiaries for controlled goods. Compliance teams validate shipments against licensed supplier lists, requiring supplier master linkage for li

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shipment.consignment. Business justification: Import/export licenses are required for controlled goods (dual-use, restricted commodities). License utilization tracking, quota consumption, and shipment release authorization require linking permit

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Import licenses for capital equipment link to asset capitalization. Essential for capex tracking, asset acquisition compliance, and audit trail linking import permits to capitalized assets.

attributes.name: reviewed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Import/export licenses reviewed by trade compliance officers (employees). Regulatory requirement for controlled goods. Tracks who verified license validity and utilization before shipment release.

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: Date on which the license or permit application was submitted to the issuing authority. Used for tracking processing times and compliance with advance filing requirements.

attributes.name: authorized_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity of goods authorized for import or export under this license or permit. Measured in the unit specified in authorized_unit_of_measure.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Import Licensing Procedures Agreement

attributes.name: authorized_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the authorized quantity (e.g., kilograms, pieces, liters, cubic meters). Aligns with customs declaration unit standards.

attributes.name: authorized_value_amount
attributes.description: Maximum monetary value of goods authorized for import or export under this license or permit. Expressed in the currency specified in authorized_value_currency_code.

attributes.name: authorized_value_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the authorized value amount.

attributes.name: commodity_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the goods, products, or materials covered by this license or permit. Provides human-readable context for the authorized commodity.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this license or permit record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the goods covered by this license are classified as dangerous goods (hazmat) requiring special handling and documentation. True if dangerous goods, false otherwise.
attributes.references: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code, ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the final destination country for export licenses or the importing country for import licenses. Determines jurisdiction-specific licensing requirements.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the license or permit becomes valid and can be used for customs declarations. May differ from issue_date if there is a waiting period.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Import Licensing Procedures Agreement

attributes.name: end_use_description
attributes.description: Description of the intended end use or purpose of the goods covered by this license. Required for certain controlled items and dual-use export authorizations to ensure compliance with end-use restrictions.

attributes.name: end_user_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the final end user or consignee of the goods covered by this license. Required for export control compliance and denied party screening.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the license or permit expires and can no longer be used for customs declarations. After this date, the authorization is no longer valid unless renewed.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Import Licensing Procedures Agreement

attributes.name: export_control_classification_number
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the export control classification for dual-use or controlled technology items. Used for compliance with export control regulations and dual-use export authorizations.
attributes.references: US Export Administration Regulations (EAR), Wassenaar Arrangement

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System commodity classification code (6, 8, or 10 digits) that identifies the specific goods covered by this license or permit. Used for tariff classification and trade compliance.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: Three-letter Incoterms code defining the delivery terms and liability allocation for the goods covered by this license. Determines responsibility for customs clearance and duty payment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the license or permit was officially issued by the regulatory authority. Marks the beginning of the authorization period.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government agency, regulatory body, or customs authority that issued the license or permit. Examples include national customs administrations, agriculture departments, or trade ministries.

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the jurisdiction that issued the license or permit.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this license or permit record was most recently updated in the data platform. Used for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: Official license or permit number issued by the regulatory authority. This is the externally-known unique identifier used for customs declarations and trade compliance filings.

attributes.name: license_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the license or permit. Indicates whether the authorization is valid and available for use in customs declarations.

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Classification of the license or permit based on regulatory purpose. Determines the type of authorization granted for controlled, restricted, or regulated goods movement.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Import Licensing Procedures Agreement

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, clarifications, or internal annotations related to this license or permit. Used for operational context and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the country where the goods covered by this license were manufactured, produced, or substantially transformed. Used for preferential trade agreement eligibility and origin-based licensing requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, World Customs Organization (WCO) Rules of Origin

attributes.name: previous_license_number
attributes.description: License number of the previous authorization if this is a renewal. Provides audit trail and continuity for renewed licenses.

attributes.name: quota_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this license or permit is subject to a tariff rate quota (TRQ) or quantitative import/export restriction. True if quota applies, false otherwise.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Agriculture

attributes.name: quota_order_number
attributes.description: Official quota order number or tariff rate quota (TRQ) reference assigned by the customs authority. Used to track utilization against quota limits.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Agriculture

attributes.name: remaining_quantity
attributes.description: Available balance of quantity that can still be utilized under this license or permit. Calculated as authorized_quantity minus utilized_quantity.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Import Licensing Procedures Agreement

attributes.name: remaining_value_amount
attributes.description: Available balance of monetary value that can still be utilized under this license or permit. Calculated as authorized_value_amount minus utilized_value_amount.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Import Licensing Procedures Agreement

attributes.name: renewal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this license or permit is a renewal of a previously expired authorization. True if renewal, false if original issuance.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Import Licensing Procedures Agreement

attributes.name: restricted_goods_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the goods covered by this license are classified as restricted or controlled items requiring special authorization. True if restricted, false otherwise.

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the license or permit was permanently revoked by the issuing authority. Indicates when the authorization was terminated prior to its natural expiry date.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or regulatory justification for the revocation of this license or permit. Provides context for compliance enforcement and audit trail.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this license or permit record was extracted. Typically Descartes Customs GTM trade compliance module or equivalent customs management system.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this license or permit record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation with upstream systems.

attributes.name: special_conditions
attributes.description: Additional terms, restrictions, or conditions imposed by the issuing authority on the use of this license or permit. May include handling requirements, reporting obligations, or geographic restrictions.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Import Licensing Procedures Agreement

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date on which the license or permit was suspended by the issuing authority. Indicates when the authorization was temporarily invalidated due to compliance issues or regulatory action.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or regulatory justification for the suspension of this license or permit. Provides context for compliance review and remediation.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN number identifying the dangerous goods classification if dangerous_goods_indicator is true. Used for hazmat compliance and transport safety.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: utilized_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of goods that have been imported or exported against this license or permit to date. Measured in the same unit as authorized_quantity.

attributes.name: utilized_value_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative monetary value of goods that have been imported or exported against this license or permit to date. Expressed in the same currency as authorized_value_amount.

products.name: drawback_claim
products.description: Transactional record for duty drawback claims filed to recover customs duties paid on imported goods that are subsequently exported or destroyed. Captures drawback type (manufacturing/unused merchandise/rejected merchandise), claim number, filing date, original import entry number, export entry number, imported commodity, exported commodity, HS codes, duty paid amount, drawback amount claimed, approved drawback amount, claim status (filed/under_review/approved/paid/denied), and payment date. Managed per CBP drawback regulations (19 CFR Part 191) and equivalent national programs.
products.reference: US CBP Duty Drawback (19 CFR Part 191) / National Duty Relief Programs

attributes.name: drawback_claim_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the duty drawback claim record. Primary key.

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounts_receivable. Business justification: Approved drawback claims become receivables from customs authorities. Critical for cash forecasting, aging analysis, and reconciliation of duty refunds against claims filed.

attributes.name: claimant_trade_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: Claimant in drawback claim is a trade party. Adding claimant_trade_party_id FK to trade_party.trade_party_id normalizes the claimant reference. Cardinality: N:1 (many drawback claims can have the same

attributes.name: export_consignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shipment.consignment. Business justification: Drawback claims recover duties on exported goods. Claims require proof of export via consignment documentation. Linking claim to export consignment enables automated duty recovery, audit trail, and cl

attributes.name: import_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.declaration. Business justification: Drawback claims reference the original import declaration to prove duty was paid. Adding import_declaration_id FK to declaration.declaration_id establishes this relationship. Cardinality: N:1 (many dr

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Drawback claim filing services are billable, and successful claims may trigger revenue-share invoicing. Links claim to invoice for drawback service fee billing—standard practice in duty recovery opera

attributes.name: prepared_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Drawback claims prepared by licensed customs brokers (employees). CBP regulatory requirement for duty recovery. Tracks individual accountability for claim accuracy and supporting documentation.

attributes.name: accelerated_payment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the claim qualifies for accelerated payment processing under CBP's accelerated drawback program.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Number of times the drawback claim has been amended or resubmitted after initial filing.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date the customs authority officially approved the drawback claim for payment.

attributes.name: approved_drawback_amount
attributes.description: Final drawback amount approved by customs authority for payment after review and validation.

attributes.name: broker_license_number
attributes.description: Official license number of the customs broker authorized to file drawback claims.

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Official claim number assigned by customs authority (e.g., CBP) for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the drawback claim in the customs authority review and payment process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|filed|under_review|approved|paid|denied|withdrawn — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this drawback claim record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in the drawback claim.

attributes.name: customs_broker_name
attributes.description: Name of the licensed customs broker or agent who prepared and filed the drawback claim on behalf of the claimant.

attributes.name: customs_office_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the customs office or port where the drawback claim was filed and is being processed.

attributes.name: denial_date
attributes.description: Date the customs authority officially denied the drawback claim.

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by customs authority if the drawback claim was denied, including regulatory citation and corrective action required.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3-letter country code for the final destination of the exported goods.

attributes.name: destruction_date
attributes.description: Date the goods were destroyed under customs supervision if destruction method was used instead of export.

attributes.name: destruction_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the goods were destroyed under customs supervision rather than exported, qualifying for drawback under destruction provisions.

attributes.name: drawback_amount_claimed
attributes.description: Total drawback amount being claimed for recovery, calculated per drawback regulations (typically 99% of duty paid).

attributes.name: drawback_type
attributes.description: Type of drawback claim being filed: manufacturing drawback (goods used in manufacturing exported products), unused merchandise drawback (imported goods exported without use), rejected merchandise drawback (defective goods returned/destroyed), or substitution drawback variants.

attributes.name: duty_paid_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of customs duty originally paid on the imported goods at time of import entry.

attributes.name: exported_commodity_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the exported goods or manufactured articles qualifying for drawback.

attributes.name: exported_hs_code
attributes.description: HS tariff classification code for the exported merchandise at time of export.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date the drawback claim was officially filed with the customs authority.

attributes.name: filing_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the drawback claim was submitted to the customs authority system.

attributes.name: imported_commodity_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the imported goods on which duty was originally paid.

attributes.name: imported_hs_code
attributes.description: HS tariff classification code for the imported merchandise at time of import entry.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment or correction to the drawback claim.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this drawback claim record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: manufacturing_process_description
attributes.description: Description of the manufacturing process applied to imported goods to create the exported article (required for manufacturing drawback claims).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the drawback claim processing.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date the approved drawback amount was paid to the claimant by the customs authority.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the drawback refund was paid to the claimant (ACH, wire transfer, check, or offset against other duties owed).

attributes.name: quantity_exported
attributes.description: Quantity of goods exported or destroyed that qualifies for drawback recovery.

attributes.name: quantity_imported
attributes.description: Quantity of goods originally imported on which duty was paid.

attributes.name: review_officer_name
attributes.description: Name of the customs officer assigned to review and validate the drawback claim.

attributes.name: substitution_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a substitution drawback claim where commercially interchangeable merchandise was substituted for the imported goods.

attributes.name: supporting_documents_submitted
attributes.description: List or summary of supporting documentation submitted with the claim (import entry, export documentation, manufacturing records, certificates of delivery, etc.).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the imported and exported quantities (e.g., KG, LBS, PCS, LTR).

products.name: trade_agreement
products.description: Reference master for free trade agreements (FTAs), preferential trade arrangements, and customs unions applicable to Transport Shipping's trade lanes. Captures agreement name, agreement type (FTA/customs union/GSP/EBA/bilateral), participating countries, effective date, expiry date, key provisions (tariff elimination schedule, rules of origin criteria, cumulation rules), administering authority, and agreement status (in_force/under_renegotiation/suspended). Enables automated preferential duty rate lookup and origin criterion validation in Descartes Customs GTM.
products.reference: WTO Regional Trade Agreements Database / UNCTAD TRAINS

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the trade agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: commercial_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Commercial service agreements often reference trade agreements (USMCA, EU FTAs) to validate preferential rate eligibility, origin compliance requirements, and duty drawback programs. Linking trade agr

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the trade compliance analyst or customs broker who last verified the accuracy of this trade agreement record.

attributes.name: administering_authority
attributes.description: Name of the international body, secretariat, or national agency responsible for administering and monitoring compliance with the trade agreement (e.g., WTO Secretariat, European Commission DG Trade, USTR).

attributes.name: agreement_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code or abbreviation for the trade agreement (e.g., USMCA, CPTPP, EU-UK_TCA). Used for system lookups and operational references.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Agreement Database

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the trade agreement as published by the administering authority (e.g., United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement, Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership).
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Regional Trade Agreements Information System

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the trade agreement. FTA (Free Trade Agreement) = reciprocal tariff elimination; Customs Union = common external tariff; GSP (Generalized System of Preferences) = unilateral preference; EBA (Everything But Arms) = duty-free for LDCs; Bilateral = two parties; Multilateral = three or more parties.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System Convention

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal amendments, protocols, or annexes that have modified the original trade agreement since its entry into force. Used to track agreement evolution.
attributes.references: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties

attributes.name: authority_website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL of the administering authority where the full text of the agreement, tariff schedules, and implementation guidance are published.
attributes.references: Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) RFC 3986 - URI Syntax

attributes.name: certificate_of_origin_format
attributes.description: Standardized format or form type required for the Certificate of Origin under this agreement (e.g., Form A for GSP, EUR.1 for EU agreements, self-certification for USMCA).
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Certificate of Origin Standards

attributes.name: certificate_of_origin_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Certificate of Origin document must be presented to customs authorities to claim preferential duty rates under this agreement. True = COO required; False = self-certification or no certification required.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Certificate of Origin Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trade agreement record was first created in the lakehouse. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cumulation_rules
attributes.description: Type of origin cumulation permitted under the agreement. Bilateral = materials from partner country count as originating; Diagonal = materials from multiple FTA partners cumulate; Full = all processing in partner countries cumulates; None = no cumulation allowed.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or database from which this trade agreement record was ingested (e.g., Descartes Customs GTM, WTO RTA Database, internal trade compliance repository).

attributes.name: digital_trade_provisions
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes provisions on e-commerce, cross-border data flows, digital services, and prohibition of data localization requirements. True = digital trade provisions included; False = no digital trade provisions.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Work Programme on Electronic Commerce

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: Summary of the dispute settlement procedures established by the agreement for resolving conflicts between member countries regarding interpretation or implementation (e.g., arbitration panels, joint committees).
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Dispute Settlement Understanding

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the trade agreement entered into force and became legally binding. Used to determine applicability of preferential duty rates.
attributes.references: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) - Date Recognition

attributes.name: environmental_provisions
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes commitments on environmental protection, sustainable development, and enforcement of environmental laws. True = environmental provisions included; False = no environmental provisions.
attributes.references: United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the trade agreement ceases to be in force. Nullable for open-ended agreements without a fixed termination date.
attributes.references: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) - Date Recognition

attributes.name: government_procurement_provisions
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement opens government procurement markets to suppliers from member countries on a non-discriminatory basis. True = procurement provisions included; False = no procurement provisions.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Government Procurement (GPA)

attributes.name: intellectual_property_provisions
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes chapters or provisions on intellectual property rights protection, enforcement, and cooperation. True = IP provisions included; False = no IP provisions.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS)

attributes.name: investment_provisions
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes provisions on foreign direct investment protection, investor-state dispute settlement, and national treatment for investors. True = investment provisions included; False = no investment provisions.
attributes.references: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) Investment Policy Framework

attributes.name: labor_standards_provisions
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes enforceable labor rights and working conditions standards aligned with International Labour Organization (ILO) conventions. True = labor provisions included; False = no labor provisions.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent amendment, protocol, or annex to the trade agreement entered into force.
attributes.references: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trade agreement record was most recently updated in the lakehouse. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal review or assessment of the trade agreement by member countries or the administering authority.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Policy Review Mechanism

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when the trade agreement details were last verified against official sources by Transport Shipping's trade compliance team. Used to ensure data accuracy for preferential duty rate calculations.

attributes.name: mutual_recognition_agreements
attributes.description: Description of any mutual recognition agreements for conformity assessment, product standards, professional qualifications, or Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) programs included in or linked to the trade agreement.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Technical Barriers to Trade (TBT)

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review or renegotiation of the trade agreement. Used for compliance planning and tariff rate updates in Descartes Customs GTM.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Policy Review Mechanism

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, implementation guidance, or special considerations relevant to Transport Shipping's use of this trade agreement in customs declarations and duty calculations.

attributes.name: participating_countries
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes representing all member countries or customs territories party to the agreement (e.g., USA,CAN,MEX for USMCA).

attributes.name: product_coverage_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of goods and services covered by the trade agreement. All Goods = comprehensive coverage; Industrial Goods Only = excludes agriculture; Agricultural Excluded = industrial focus; Services Included = covers trade in services; Limited Product List = specific HS Codes only.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATS)

attributes.name: publication_reference
attributes.description: Official publication citation or document reference number for the trade agreement text (e.g., treaty series number, official journal citation, UN registration number).

attributes.name: quota_provisions
attributes.description: Description of any tariff-rate quotas (TRQs) or quantitative restrictions included in the agreement. Specifies product categories subject to quota limits and the preferential in-quota duty rates.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Agriculture - Tariff Rate Quotas

attributes.name: review_cycle_years
attributes.description: Number of years between scheduled reviews or renegotiations of the trade agreement by member countries. Used to track when agreement terms may be updated or modernized.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Policy Review Mechanism

attributes.name: rules_of_origin_criteria
attributes.description: Summary of the origin determination rules required to qualify for preferential treatment under this agreement (e.g., change in tariff classification, regional value content percentage, specific processing requirements). Full rules are maintained in tariff_rate product.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Revised Kyoto Convention - Origin Rules

attributes.name: safeguard_measures
attributes.description: Summary of bilateral safeguard provisions that allow temporary suspension or modification of preferential treatment if imports cause or threaten serious injury to domestic industry.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Safeguards

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: Date when the trade agreement was formally signed by participating parties, prior to ratification and entry into force.
attributes.references: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties

attributes.name: superseded_by_agreement_code
attributes.description: Agreement code of the successor trade agreement that replaced this agreement, if applicable. Used to maintain historical lineage when agreements are renegotiated or replaced (e.g., NAFTA superseded by USMCA).
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Regional Trade Agreements Information System

attributes.name: tariff_elimination_schedule
attributes.description: Classification of the duty reduction timeline under the agreement. Immediate = zero duty on entry into force; Staged = phased reduction over specified years; Partial = some products excluded; Product Specific = varies by HS Code.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT)

attributes.name: trade_agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the trade agreement. In Force = active and applicable; Under Negotiation = being drafted; Signed Not Ratified = awaiting legislative approval; Suspended = temporarily inactive; Terminated = ended by parties; Expired = reached end date.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Monitoring Database

attributes.name: trade_facilitation_provisions
attributes.description: Description of customs procedures simplification, advance rulings, single window systems, and other trade facilitation commitments included in the agreement to reduce border clearance times and costs.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Facilitation Agreement

attributes.name: wto_notification_number
attributes.description: WTO Regional Trade Agreement notification number assigned when the agreement was notified to the WTO under GATT Article XXIV or GATS Article V (e.g., WT/REG123/N/1).
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Regional Trade Agreements Database

products.name: customs_event
products.description: Transactional event log capturing all significant customs lifecycle milestones for a declaration or filing — submission, acceptance, examination notification, release, amendment, rejection, appeal, and closure. Captures event type, event timestamp, event source (customs authority EDI/Descartes GTM/manual), event description, responsible party, and resulting declaration status change. Provides a complete audit trail of customs processing history for compliance reporting, SLA measurement, and dispute resolution. Distinct from customs_hold which captures only examination/detention events.
products.reference: WCO Customs Data Model — Declaration Status Events

attributes.name: customs_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customs event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment associated with this customs event. Enables cross-domain traceability between customs and shipment operations.

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customs declaration that this event pertains to. Links the event to the parent declaration lifecycle.

attributes.name: recorded_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Customs events recorded by operations staff (employees). Audit trail requirement for status changes, holds, releases. Tracks who performed the action for accountability and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: amendment_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating the order of amendments to the customs declaration. Used to track the version history when this event represents an amendment.

attributes.name: appeal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this event represents an appeal or dispute of a previous customs decision. True if this is an appeal event, false otherwise.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model, National Customs Appeal Procedures

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the appeal process, if applicable. Indicates whether the appeal was approved, denied, partially approved, or is still pending.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model, National Customs Appeal Procedures

attributes.name: compliance_program_code

products.name: program_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between compliance_program and company_code. It captures the enrollment of legal entities in trade compliance programs (C-TPAT, AEO, ISO 28000) with entity-specific certification status, audit schedules, and compliance metrics. Each record links one compliance_program to one company_code with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific enrollment.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping's global logistics operations, a single compliance program (e.g., C-TPAT, AEO) can cover multiple legal entities across different countries, and each legal entity typically participates in multiple compliance programs based on their operational jurisdictions and trade lanes. The business actively manages these enrollments as distinct operational records, tracking entity-specific certification status, audit schedules, compliance scores, and responsible employees for each program-entity combination.

products.name: trade_agreement_utilization
products.description: This association product represents the operational utilization relationship between customer accounts and trade agreements in the Transport Shipping logistics network. It captures the active use of preferential trade agreements by customer accounts across their trade lanes, tracking duty savings realized, certificate of origin issuance, preference claim history, and eligibility status. Each record links one customer account to one trade agreement with metrics and operational data that exist only in the context of this specific account-agreement utilization relationship.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping logistics operations, customer accounts actively utilize multiple trade agreements across their diverse trade lanes (e.g., a global shipper uses USMCA for US-Mexico shipments, CPTPP for Asia-Pacific routes, and EU-UK TCA for European lanes). Conversely, each trade agreement is utilized by multiple customer accounts. The business actively manages this many-to-many relationship through customs operations, tracking duty savings, preference utilization rates, certificate of origin issuance, and compliance status for each unique customer-agreement combination.
