attributes.name: plan_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific route plan leg affected by this exception. A route plan may have multiple legs; this identifies the precise leg in deviation.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: service_corridor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service corridor (defined lane or trade lane) affected by this exception. Enables corridor-level exception rate analytics and supports Blue Yonder network optimization and lane performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: spot_quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.spot_quote. Business justification: Route exceptions on spot quote shipments. Spot_quote_id links exception to quoted movement, enabling spot quote exception tracking, quoted service level breach analysis, and spot quote reliability mea

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.transport_asset. Business justification: Route exceptions (delays, breakdowns, accidents) often involve specific assets; linking enables root cause analysis, maintenance correlation, asset reliability scoring, and performance impact assessme

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Business justification: Route exceptions trigger document amendments, claims documentation, and exception reports. Real business process: exception resolution requires documentary evidence (damage reports, delay certificates

attributes.name: actual_etd
attributes.description: The actual or revised Estimated Time of Departure (ETD) for the affected route leg after the exception was raised. Compared against planned_etd to quantify departure delay.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: affected_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the route exception occurred. Used for geographic exception analytics, regulatory reporting, and cross-border compliance tracking.

attributes.name: awb_number
attributes.description: Air Waybill (AWB) number associated with the affected air freight shipment, if applicable. Follows IATA AWB format (airline prefix-serial number). Null for non-air transport modes.
attributes.references: IATA International Air Transport Association; ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading (BOL) or Master Bill of Lading (MBL) number for the affected ocean or road freight shipment. Null for air transport mode. Supports customs and trade compliance cross-referencing.
attributes.references: IMO International Maritime Organization; FMC Federal Maritime Commission; WCO

attributes.name: cost_usd
attributes.description: Estimated or actual incremental cost incurred as a result of the route exception, expressed in US Dollars (USD). Includes carrier surcharges, expedite fees, re-routing costs, and storage charges. Used for P&L impact analysis and OPEX reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS International Financial Reporting Standards; SOX

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when the route exception record was first persisted in the data platform. May differ from raised_timestamp if there is a lag between detection and system entry.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer was formally notified of the route exception. Null if customer_notified_flag is false. Used for SLA compliance and customer service reporting.

attributes.name: customer_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the affected customer has been formally notified of the route exception and its impact on their shipment. Supports customer communication compliance and Salesforce CRM case management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; FourKites Customer Visibility; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the affected shipment contains dangerous goods (DG) subject to IMDG Code or ICAO Technical Instructions. Triggers enhanced exception handling protocols and regulatory notification requirements.
attributes.references: IMDG Code International Maritime Dangerous Goods; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA DGR

attributes.name: delay_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Quantified delay in minutes resulting from the route exception, calculated as the difference between revised ETA and planned ETA. Core metric for SLA breach assessment and On-Time Delivery (OTD) performance reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Freight Audit; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: destination_location_code
attributes.description: IATA airport code, UN/LOCODE, or internal hub code identifying the planned destination point of the affected route leg. Paired with origin_location_code to define the affected Origin-Destination (O-D) lane.
attributes.references: IATA International Air Transport Association; UN/LOCODE Standard

attributes.name: edi_transaction_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transaction (e.g., EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status Message) from the carrier that reported this exception. Null if exception source is not carrier_edi.
attributes.references: EDI Electronic Data Interchange Standards; ANSI X12; EDIFACT

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Tier of escalation reached for this route exception, indicating the management level engaged in resolution. Null if no escalation occurred.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Exception Management; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the route exception was escalated to a higher tier of management or operations due to unresolved status or critical severity. Null if the exception was not escalated.

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the specific circumstances of the route exception, including root cause details, operational context, and any relevant external factors (e.g., port strike, adverse weather, mechanical breakdown).

attributes.name: exception_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the route exception, used in carrier communications, Oracle TMS exception queues, and customer visibility portals. Format: REXC-{YYYY}-{sequence}.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Exception Management; SAP TM Freight Order Management

attributes.name: exception_source
attributes.description: System or channel through which the route exception was detected and raised. FourKites provides real-time GPS-based detection; carrier EDI provides carrier-reported events; manual indicates operations team entry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fourkites|carrier_edi|manual|sap_tm|oracle_tms|iot_sensor|blue_yonder — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) Standards; SAP TM

attributes.name: exception_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the route exception record within the exception management workflow. Drives operational queues in Oracle TMS and FourKites visibility dashboards.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Exception Management; FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exception category describing the nature of the deviation from the route plan. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: delay|missed_connection|carrier_substitution|route_diversion|customs_hold|weather_disruption|capacity_shortfall — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Exception Management; SAP TM Transportation Management; ISO 28000

attributes.name: fourkites_event_code
attributes.description: External event identifier from the FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform that triggered or corresponds to this route exception. Enables bi-directional traceability between the lakehouse exception record and the FourKites source event.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; API Integration Standards

attributes.name: origin_location_code
attributes.description: IATA airport code, UN/LOCODE, or internal hub code identifying the planned origin point of the affected route leg. Used for lane-level exception analytics and network performance reporting.
attributes.references: IATA International Air Transport Association; UN/LOCODE Standard

attributes.name: planned_eta
attributes.description: The originally planned Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) at the destination of the affected route leg. Baseline for SLA breach determination and On-Time Delivery (OTD) KPI calculation.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; FourKites; IATA; IMO

attributes.name: planned_etd
attributes.description: The originally planned Estimated Time of Departure (ETD) for the affected route leg as defined in the route plan. Baseline for delay calculation and SLA compliance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; IATA; IMO

attributes.name: raised_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the route exception was first detected and raised in the system. This is the principal business event timestamp representing when the deviation from plan was identified.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Exception Management; FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform

attributes.name: recovery_cost_usd
attributes.description: Cost incurred to execute the resolution action for the route exception, expressed in US Dollars (USD). Distinct from exception_cost_usd which captures the impact cost; this captures the remediation spend.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS; Oracle TMS Freight Audit

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this exception is a recurrence of a previously recorded exception on the same route leg or lane within a defined lookback period. Supports chronic exception identification and network reliability improvement.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Exception Management; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action taken to resolve the route exception (e.g., carrier substitution to alternate provider, route diversion via alternate hub, expedited re-booking, customs documentation resubmission). Sourced from Oracle TMS resolution workflow.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Exception Management; SAP TM Transportation Management

attributes.name: resolution_action_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the resolution action taken, enabling structured analytics on exception resolution patterns and carrier/network performance improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Exception Management; SAP TM

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the route exception was formally resolved and closed in the exception management system. Used to calculate Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) and SLA compliance for exception handling.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Exception Management; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: revised_eta
attributes.description: The updated Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) calculated after the exception was raised, reflecting the impact of the deviation. Sourced from FourKites predictive ETA engine or carrier-reported updates.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; Oracle TMS Predictive ETA

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized root cause classification code assigned during exception investigation (e.g., CARRIER_CAPACITY, PORT_CONGESTION, WEATHER, DOCUMENTATION, MECHANICAL). Supports structured root cause analysis and continuous improvement programs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: carrier_capacity|port_congestion|weather|documentation|mechanical|customs_delay|infrastructure|demand_surge — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; Oracle TMS Exception Management

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Operational severity rating of the route exception indicating business impact level. Critical exceptions trigger immediate escalation; high exceptions require same-day resolution per SLA standards.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Exception Management; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the route exception has caused or is projected to cause a breach of the applicable Service Level Agreement (SLA) for the affected shipment or freight order. Drives customer notification and penalty calculation workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS; SAP TM; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing granular detail within the exception type (e.g., under 'delay': port_congestion, mechanical_failure, driver_shortage; under 'customs_hold': documentation_error, inspection_hold). Supports root-cause analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Exception Management; Descartes Customs Global Trade Management

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transport for the affected route leg at the time of the exception. Determines applicable regulatory frameworks (IATA for air, IMO for ocean, DOT for road/rail) and exception handling procedures.
attributes.references: IATA International Air Transport Association; IMO International Maritime Organization; US DOT

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording the most recent modification to the route exception record, including status changes, resolution updates, and escalation events. Supports change tracking and SLA compliance auditing.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

products.name: carrier_schedule
products.description: Published carrier schedule for a specific lane or corridor leg, capturing carrier reference, service name, origin node, destination node, transport mode, vessel/flight/train service identifier, departure day(s) of week, departure time, arrival day(s) of week, arrival time, frequency, transit time (hours), capacity (TEU/kg/CBM), cut-off time (cargo receipt deadline), effective date range, and schedule status. Sourced from carrier EDI feeds and used by SAP TM for departure planning and Oracle TMS for load optimization.

attributes.name: carrier_schedule_id

attributes.name: carrier_service_id

attributes.description: Reference to the network node (port, airport, hub, depot, ICD, CFS) at which this schedule arrives. Used for ETA/ETD management and last-mile delivery zone assignment.
attributes.references: SAP TM Network Design; IMO; IATA

attributes.name: emissions_factor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.emissions_factor. attributes.name: primary_carrier_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the network node (port, airport, hub, depot, ICD, CFS) from which this schedule departs. Supports hub-and-spoke topology and FourKites real-time visibility integration.

attributes.name: tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.tariff. Business justification: Carrier schedules reference tariffs for published rates. Tariff_id links schedule to pricing, enabling schedule-based tariff rate lookup, carrier schedule costing, and published rate validation agains

attributes.name: alliance_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the ocean carrier alliance (e.g., '2M', 'THE Alliance', 'Ocean Alliance') or air cargo alliance to which this schedule belongs. Used for slot-sharing and co-loading capacity management in Blue Yonder and Oracle TMS.

attributes.name: arrival_days_of_week
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO weekday numbers (1=Monday through 7=Sunday) on which this schedule arrives at the destination node. May differ from departure days for multi-day transits. Used for ETA calculation and last-mile delivery zone scheduling.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Weekday Numbering; SAP TM ETA Management

attributes.name: arrival_time
attributes.description: Scheduled local arrival time at the destination node in HH:mm (24-hour) format. Combined with arrival_days_of_week to determine the Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) for delivery planning and SLA entitlement matching.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; SAP TM ETA Management; FourKites

attributes.name: arrival_timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the destination node (e.g., 'Europe/Rotterdam', 'Asia/Tokyo'). Required to convert local arrival time to UTC for cross-border ETA management and FourKites real-time visibility integration.

attributes.name: capacity_teu
attributes.description: Maximum container capacity of this schedule expressed in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU). Applicable for ocean FCL/LCL services. Null for non-ocean modes. Used for load optimization in Oracle TMS and capacity planning in Blue Yonder.

attributes.name: capacity_volume_cbm
attributes.description: Maximum volumetric capacity in Cubic Meters (CBM) for this schedule. Used alongside DIM Weight (Dimensional Weight) calculations for air freight and LTL/LCL load optimization in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; SAP TM Charge Calculation

attributes.name: capacity_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum payload weight capacity in kilograms for this schedule. Applicable across all transport modes (air, ocean, road, rail). Used for load optimization in Oracle TMS and freight order management in SAP TM.
attributes.references: IATA Weight and Balance; IMO; US DOT; SAP TM Charge Calculation

attributes.name: co2e_emission_factor
attributes.description: Carrier-published or calculated Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) emission factor for this schedule in kg CO2e per tonne-km. Used for GHG (Greenhouse Gas) reporting, EU ETS compliance, CORSIA carbon offsetting calculations, and sustainability analytics.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS); CORSIA (Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation); GHG Protocol; IMO DCS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier schedule record was first ingested into the Transport Shipping lakehouse Silver layer. Audit trail field for data lineage and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: cutoff_hours_before_departure
attributes.description: Cargo receipt deadline expressed as the number of hours before scheduled departure by which cargo must be tendered to the carrier at the origin node. Used by SAP TM for freight order management and Oracle TMS for shipment execution planning.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Cut-Off Standards; IMO; SAP TM Freight Order Management

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this carrier schedule accepts dangerous goods (DG) shipments (True) or not (False). Drives compliance routing in Descartes Customs and shipment eligibility checks against IMDG Code (ocean) and ICAO Technical Instructions (air).
attributes.references: IMDG Code (International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code); ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA DGR

attributes.name: departure_days_of_week
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO weekday numbers (1=Monday through 7=Sunday) on which this schedule departs (e.g., '1,3,5' for Mon/Wed/Fri). Used by SAP TM for departure planning and Blue Yonder for network optimization.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Weekday Numbering; SAP TM Departure Planning

attributes.name: departure_time
attributes.description: Scheduled local departure time at the origin node in HH:mm (24-hour) format. Combined with departure_days_of_week to determine the Estimated Time of Departure (ETD) for shipment planning in SAP TM and Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; SAP TM ETD Management

attributes.name: departure_timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the origin node (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Asia/Shanghai'). Required to convert local departure time to UTC for cross-border schedule coordination and FourKites predictive ETA calculation.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination node (e.g., 'GBR', 'SGP', 'BRA'). Used for import customs declaration routing in Descartes Customs, denied party screening, and WTO trade compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WCO; WTO; Descartes Customs

attributes.name: destination_port_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Destination Port / Airport Code (UN/LOCODE or IATA)
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE (5-character) for ocean/road/rail destinations or IATA 3-letter airport code for air destinations. Denormalised from the destination network node for EDI messaging, customs filing, and carrier schedule matching.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE; IATA Airport Codes; Descartes Customs

attributes.name: doc_cutoff_hours_before_departure
attributes.description: Deadline for submission of shipping documents (AWB, BOL, customs declarations) expressed as hours before scheduled departure. Required for Descartes Customs AMS/ISF filing compliance and carrier EDI submission.

attributes.name: edi_source_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the EDI feed or carrier data exchange channel from which this schedule record was sourced (e.g., EDIFACT IFTMCS, ANSI X12 204, carrier API). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer ingestion audit in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: EDIFACT IFTMCS; ANSI X12; IATA Cargo-XML

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this carrier schedule is valid and available for booking. Used for schedule versioning, seasonal service management, and SAP TM departure planning.
attributes.references: SAP TM Schedule Management; IATA Season Codes

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Calendar date after which this carrier schedule is no longer valid. Null indicates an open-ended schedule with no defined end date. Used for schedule lifecycle management and carrier contract alignment.
attributes.references: SAP TM Schedule Management; IATA Season Codes

attributes.name: frequency_per_week

attributes.references: IMO MARPOL Annex VI; EU ETS; CORSIA; IATA SAF Framework

attributes.name: is_direct_service

attributes.name: origin_country_code

attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WCO; C-TPAT; AEO (Authorized Economic Operator)

attributes.name: origin_port_code

attributes.description: UN/LOCODE (5-character) for ocean/road/rail origins or IATA 3-letter airport code for air origins. Denormalised from the origin network node for EDI messaging, AMS filing, and carrier schedule matching without requiring a node lookup.

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the carrier published or last updated this schedule via EDI feed. Represents the principal business event time for this record. Used for schedule freshness validation and EDI reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: ref
attributes.description: Carrier's own internal reference or booking system identifier for this schedule, as received via EDI. Enables round-trip reconciliation with the carrier's system and supports freight audit in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: EDIFACT IFTMCS; Oracle TMS Freight Audit

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Externally-known carrier schedule reference number or code as published by the carrier via EDI feed. Used as the business identifier for matching against carrier EDI messages (e.g., EDIFACT IFTMCS) and for reconciliation in SAP TM and Oracle TMS.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the carrier schedule record. ACTIVE: available for booking and departure planning. SUSPENDED: temporarily unavailable (e.g., port congestion, force majeure). CANCELLED: permanently discontinued. DRAFT: pending carrier confirmation. EXPIRED: past effective_until_date.
attributes.references: SAP TM Schedule Lifecycle; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number for this carrier schedule record, incremented each time the carrier publishes an updated schedule via EDI. Supports schedule change management and historical comparison in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: EDIFACT IFTMCS Version Control; SAP TM Schedule Management

attributes.name: temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule provides temperature-controlled (reefer/cold chain) capacity (True) or ambient-only service (False). Used for perishable cargo eligibility and specialized equipment allocation in SAP TM.
attributes.references: IATA Perishable Cargo Regulations; IMO Reefer Standards; ISO 9001

attributes.name: transit_time_hours
attributes.description: Standard published transit time in hours from origin node departure to destination node arrival for this schedule. Used as the baseline for SLA (Service Level Agreement) commitments, OTD (On-Time Delivery) KPI measurement, and Blue Yonder network optimization.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transit Time Standards; Oracle TMS; ISO 9001

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transport for this carrier schedule. Drives carrier selection logic in SAP TM, load optimization in Oracle TMS, and customs declaration routing in Descartes Customs.

attributes.name: transshipment_port_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the primary transshipment hub for indirect services (is_direct_service = False). Used for multi-leg ETA calculation, customs transit declaration in Descartes Customs, and FourKites milestone tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier schedule record was last modified in the Transport Shipping lakehouse Silver layer. Used for incremental processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: vgm_cutoff_hours_before_departure
attributes.business_glossary_term: Verified Gross Mass (VGM) Cut-Off Time (Hours Before Departure)
attributes.description: Deadline for submission of Verified Gross Mass (VGM) declaration expressed as hours before scheduled departure. Mandatory for ocean shipments under SOLAS Amendment 2016. Null for non-ocean modes.

attributes.name: voyage_rotation_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned voyage or rotation number for ocean services, or equivalent rotation identifier for air/rail. Used for Bill of Lading (BOL) and Master Bill of Lading (MBL) cross-referencing and port authority reporting.

products.name: lane_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between lane and employee. It captures the operational assignment of employees (lane managers, analysts, coordinators) to specific origin-destination lanes for management, optimization, and compliance oversight. Each record links one lane to one employee with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship, including assignment period, role type, primary/backup designation, performance metrics, and required certifications.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping operations, lane management requires specialized workforce assignments where multiple employees (lane managers, analysts, coordinators, customs specialists, hazmat coordinators) are simultaneously assigned to manage a single lane, and each employee manages multiple lanes across the network. This is an operational assignment process, not a reference or analytical correlation - the business actively creates, tracks, and manages these assignments with specific roles, performance metrics, certification requirements, and time periods.

attributes.name: lane_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the lane assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the employee assigned to manage this lane

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the lane being managed in this assignment

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee's assignment to this lane ended or is scheduled to end. Null indicates an active ongoing assignment.

attributes.name: assignment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee's assignment to manage this lane became effective. Used for historical tracking and workforce planning.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this assignment. Active assignments are operational; suspended assignments are temporarily paused; completed assignments ended normally; terminated assignments ended prematurely.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee's lane-specific certification expires. Used for compliance monitoring and renewal alerts.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Status of required certifications for managing this lane (e.g., customs broker license for cross-border lanes, hazmat certification for DG-permitted lanes, IATA certification for air lanes). Values: certified, pending, expired, not_required.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this assignment record was created.

attributes.name: performance_score
attributes.description: Performance rating for this employee's management of this specific lane, typically measured on metrics like on-time performance, cost optimization, compliance adherence, and customer satisfaction. Scale 0-100.

attributes.name: primary_backup_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this employee is the primary responsible party for this lane or serves as a backup. Used for escalation routing and succession planning.

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: The specific role or function the employee performs for this lane (e.g., lane_manager, lane_analyst, lane_coordinator, customs_specialist, hazmat_coordinator). Different roles have different responsibilities and certification requirements.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this assignment record was last updated.

attributes.name: workload_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the employee's total workload allocated to this lane. Used for capacity planning and workload balancing across multiple lane assignments. Scale 0-100.

products.name: lane_fulfillment_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the operational allocation between transport lanes and fulfillment centers in the Transport Shipping network. It captures capacity planning, network optimization, and routing decisions that determine which fulfillment centers can ship via which lanes. Each record links one lane to one fulfillment center with allocation percentages, priority rankings, volume commitments, and effective date ranges that exist only in the context of this network allocation relationship.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping network operations, fulfillment centers can ship via multiple lanes to reach different destinations with different service levels and carriers, while lanes can be served by multiple fulfillment centers to provide network redundancy, capacity balancing, and geographic coverage. The business actively manages these allocations through network planning processes that assign allocation percentages, priority rankings, volume commitments, and capacity limits to each center-lane pairing for routing optimization and capacity planning.

attributes.name: lane_fulfillment_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the lane-fulfillment center allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: fulfillment_center_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lane Fulfillment Allocation - Fulfillment Center Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the fulfillment center facility

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the origin-destination lane in the transport network

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of lane capacity allocated to this fulfillment center for network load balancing and capacity planning. Used in routing optimization algorithms to distribute shipment volume across multiple centers serving the same lane.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this lane-fulfillment center allocation: active (in use), suspended (temporarily disabled), expired (past effective_to_date), planned (future allocation not yet effective).

attributes.name: capacity_allocation
attributes.description: Maximum capacity (in CBM or weight units) allocated to this fulfillment center on this lane. Used to enforce capacity constraints during shipment routing and prevent overallocation.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation record was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this lane-fulfillment center allocation becomes operationally effective. Supports temporal network configuration changes and seasonal capacity adjustments.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this lane-fulfillment center allocation expires or is superseded. Null indicates an open-ended allocation. Supports temporal network configuration management.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User or system identifier that last modified this allocation record.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation record was last updated.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Priority ranking of this fulfillment center for the lane, where lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used when multiple centers can serve the same lane to determine preferred routing sequence during shipment planning.

attributes.name: volume_commitment
attributes.description: Committed shipment volume (in CBM or weight units) that this fulfillment center is expected to route through this lane during the effective period. Used for capacity planning and carrier contract negotiations.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or system identifier that created this allocation record.

products.name: lane_surcharge_application
products.description: This association product represents the application of a specific surcharge to a specific lane. It captures the effective pricing rules, calculation parameters, and temporal validity for each surcharge-lane combination. Each record links one surcharge definition to one lane with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship, enabling dynamic surcharge management across the lane network.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, surcharges are applied to multiple lanes (e.g., a fuel surcharge applies across all Asia-Pacific lanes, a peak season surcharge applies to high-volume lanes during Q4), and each lane has multiple surcharges applied simultaneously (fuel, security, terminal handling, war risk). The business actively manages these applications with lane-specific effective dates, amounts, and calculation parameters that differ from the global surcharge definitions.

attributes.name: lane_surcharge_application_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this specific surcharge application to a lane. Primary key.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to route.lane identifying which lane this surcharge applies to

attributes.name: pricing_surcharge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to pricing.surcharge identifying which surcharge is being applied

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this surcharge application to the lane. Allows temporary suspension of surcharges on specific lanes without removing the configuration.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The calculation method used for this specific lane-surcharge combination, which may differ from the default surcharge calculation method to accommodate lane-specific pricing rules.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this surcharge application record was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this surcharge application expires for the specific lane. Null indicates open-ended application.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this surcharge application becomes active for the specific lane. Allows lane-specific surcharge timing that may differ from the global surcharge definition dates.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User or system identifier that last modified this surcharge application record.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this surcharge application record.

attributes.name: maximum_charge_amount
attributes.description: Lane-specific maximum surcharge amount that caps the calculation result for this particular lane.

attributes.name: minimum_charge_amount
attributes.description: Lane-specific minimum surcharge amount that overrides the global surcharge minimum for this particular lane.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for why this lane has different surcharge parameters than the global surcharge definition (e.g., competitive pressure, regulatory requirement, contract exception).

attributes.name: surcharge_amount
attributes.description: The specific surcharge amount applicable to this lane, which may override or supplement the base surcharge definition amount based on lane-specific factors.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or system identifier that created this surcharge application record.

products.name: schedule_dg_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory compliance requirement between carrier schedules and dangerous goods certifications. It captures which DG certifications are required for a specific carrier schedule based on the dangerous goods classes being transported, verification of certification validity at time of schedule execution, and compliance status. Each record links one carrier schedule to one required DG certification with attributes that exist only in the context of this regulatory compliance relationship.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, carrier schedules (flights, vessel voyages, rail services) that transport dangerous goods must comply with multiple regulatory certifications depending on the DG classes being carried. A single schedule may require multiple certifications (e.g., IATA DGR for air, IMDG for ocean, covering different DG classes), and each certification applies to multiple schedules across the network. The business actively manages this compliance relationship, tracking which certifications are required per schedule, verification dates, compliance status, and exemptions.

attributes.name: schedule_dg_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this schedule-certification requirement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: carrier_schedule_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Schedule Dg Requirement - Carrier Schedule Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the carrier schedule that requires dangerous goods certification

attributes.name: dg_certification_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Schedule Dg Requirement - Dg Certification Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the dangerous goods certification required for this schedule

attributes.name: certification_required_date
attributes.description: The date from which this certification became required for this carrier schedule, typically driven by regulatory changes or schedule modifications to carry new DG classes.

attributes.name: certification_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was last verified as valid and applicable for this schedule, typically performed before schedule execution or during compliance audits.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of this certification requirement for the schedule. COMPLIANT: certification is valid and verified; NON_COMPLIANT: certification missing, expired, or insufficient; PENDING_VERIFICATION: awaiting verification; EXEMPTION_GRANTED: regulatory exemption applies; EXPIRED: certification has expired.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this requirement record was created in the system.

attributes.name: dg_class_applicable
attributes.description: The specific UN dangerous goods class (e.g., 3, 4.1, 8) that this certification requirement addresses for this schedule. A schedule carrying multiple DG classes will have multiple requirement records.
attributes.references: UN Model Regulations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: exemption_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the regulatory exemption document if an exemption from standard DG certification requirements has been granted for this schedule-certification combination. Null if no exemption applies.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance audit that reviewed this schedule-certification requirement, typically performed by safety or quality assurance teams.

attributes.name: next_verification_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next verification of this certification for this schedule must be completed to maintain compliance status.

attributes.name: requirement_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this requirement record. ACTIVE: currently required; INACTIVE: no longer required (schedule changed, DG class no longer carried); SUPERSEDED: replaced by updated requirement.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this requirement record was last updated.

products.name: lane_compliance_certification
products.description: This association product represents the certification relationship between compliance programs and transport lanes. It captures which trusted trader programs (C-TPAT, AEO, ISO 28000) provide operational benefits on specific origin-destination lanes, including reduced examination rates, expedited customs release, and priority processing eligibility. Each record links one compliance program certification to one lane with attributes that exist only in the context of this lane-specific program application.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping logistics operations, a single compliance program (e.g., C-TPAT, AEO) applies to multiple origin-destination lanes where the certified entity operates, and conversely, a single lane benefits from multiple compliance programs when different parties (importer's AEO, carrier's C-TPAT, facility's ISO 28000) hold certifications. The business actively manages lane-specific program benefits including reduced examination rates, expedited release eligibility, and priority processing, which vary by lane risk profile, border crossing points, and customs authority agreements.

attributes.name: lane_compliance_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this lane-specific compliance program certification record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: compliance_program_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lane Compliance Certification - Compliance Program Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the trade compliance program or trusted trader certification (C-TPAT, AEO, ISO 28000) that provides benefits on this lane

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the origin-destination lane where this compliance program certification provides operational benefits

attributes.name: certification_level
attributes.description: Tier or level of certification benefits applicable to this specific lane under the program (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Gold, Silver). May differ from the overall program membership tier based on lane-specific risk assessment or volume thresholds.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this lane compliance certification record was created in the system

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the compliance program benefits become effective and operational on this lane. May differ from enrollment_date due to approval processing or phased rollout.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date on which the compliance program benefits expire or require renewal for this lane. Tracks lane-specific certification expiry which may differ from overall program expiry based on lane risk reassessment cycles.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific lane was enrolled or registered under the compliance program for benefit eligibility. Tracks when the lane became eligible for program benefits.

attributes.name: expedited_release_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether shipments on this lane under this compliance program are eligible for expedited customs clearance and release procedures. Lane-specific eligibility based on border crossing points and customs authority agreements.

attributes.name: lane_eligibility_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the compliance program benefits on this specific lane. Active means benefits are currently applicable; Suspended/Revoked means benefits temporarily or permanently unavailable on this lane due to compliance issues or program changes.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance audit or validation review conducted specifically for this lane under this program. Tracks lane-level compliance verification separate from overall program audits.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance review or recertification assessment for this lane under this program. Lane-specific review cycle based on risk profile and shipment volume.

attributes.name: priority_processing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether shipments on this lane under this compliance program receive priority processing during customs clearance, border inspection, and release workflows. Lane-specific benefit based on border facility capabilities.

attributes.name: reduced_examination_rate
attributes.description: Percentage reduction in physical customs examination rate granted for shipments on this lane under this compliance program (e.g., 75.00 means 75% reduction from standard examination rate). Lane-specific benefit that varies by origin-destination corridor risk profile.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this lane compliance certification record was last modified

products.name: lane_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the operational qualification and assignment eligibility relationship between driver_profile and lane. It captures which drivers are certified, authorized, and performance-tracked for specific origin-destination lanes based on licensing, endorsements, territorial knowledge, and compliance requirements. Each record links one driver to one lane with qualification metadata, historical performance metrics, and assignment tracking used by dispatch planning and fleet compliance systems.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping operations, drivers must be specifically qualified and authorized to operate on particular lanes based on licensing requirements (hazmat endorsements for DG lanes, cross-border documentation for international lanes, territorial knowledge), and each lane requires a pool of multiple qualified drivers to ensure coverage, capacity, and compliance. Fleet dispatch systems actively manage driver-lane qualifications as operational records, tracking certification dates, performance history per lane, trip counts, and assignment eligibility. This is not a derived correlation but an actively managed operational relationship with its own lifecycle.

attributes.name: lane_qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this driver-lane qualification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: driver_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the driver profile record. Identifies which driver holds this lane qualification.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the lane record. Identifies which origin-destination lane this qualification applies to.

attributes.name: authorized_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the fleet manager or compliance officer who authorized this driver for this lane. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: certification_required
attributes.description: Specific certification, endorsement, or license category required for this driver to operate on this lane (e.g., Hazmat, Cross-Border, DG Air, Oversize). Maps to driver_profile license_categories and endorsement flags.

attributes.name: last_assignment_date
attributes.description: Date this driver was most recently assigned to a shipment or route on this lane. Used for recency tracking and load balancing in dispatch planning.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing lane-specific restrictions, territorial knowledge, customer preferences, or special handling instructions for this driver on this lane.

attributes.name: performance_score
attributes.description: Composite performance score (0-100) for this driver on this specific lane, calculated from on-time delivery rate, incident count, customer feedback, and compliance violations. Used by dispatch optimization algorithms.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date the driver was certified or authorized to operate on this specific lane. Used for compliance audit trails and qualification history tracking.

attributes.name: qualification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date this lane-specific qualification expires and must be renewed or recertified. Null if qualification does not expire. Used for compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this lane qualification. Active: driver is currently authorized. Suspended: temporarily not authorized. Expired: qualification lapsed. Revoked: authorization removed.

attributes.name: trip_count
attributes.description: Total number of completed trips this driver has executed on this specific lane. Used for experience tracking, performance analysis, and dispatch prioritization.

products.name: lane_facility_service
products.description: This association product represents the operational service configuration between a transport lane and a warehouse facility. It captures the business rules governing which facilities serve as origin, destination, or intermediate nodes for specific lanes, including priority rankings for multi-facility routing, capacity allocation percentages, and service level commitments. Each record links one facility to one lane with attributes that exist only in the context of this lane-facility service relationship, supporting network optimization, capacity planning, and route assignment decisions.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping's logistics network, facilities and lanes have a genuine many-to-many operational relationship. A single facility (warehouse/DC) serves as origin, destination, or intermediate node for multiple lanes (e.g., LAX facility serves LAX-JFK, LAX-ORD, LAX-SEA lanes). Conversely, a single lane connects multiple facilities in hub-and-spoke or multi-stop routing scenarios (e.g., the Asia-Europe lane may route through Singapore hub, Dubai hub, and Amsterdam hub facilities). The business actively manages lane-facility service configurations with priority rankings, capacity allocations, and facility-specific SLA commitments for network optimization.

attributes.name: lane_facility_service_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this lane-facility service configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the warehouse or distribution center facility that serves this lane

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the origin-destination lane being served by this facility

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of lane capacity allocated to this facility in multi-facility routing scenarios. Used for load balancing and capacity planning. Sum of allocation_percentage across all active facilities for a lane should equal 100.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this lane-facility service configuration record was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this facility begins serving this lane. Used for time-based routing rules and historical tracking of network configuration changes.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this facility stops serving this lane. Null indicates the configuration is currently active. Used for network reconfiguration and facility closure scenarios.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane-facility service configuration is currently active and available for routing decisions. Derived from effective_from_date and effective_to_date but maintained for query performance.

attributes.name: max_daily_volume_units
attributes.description: Maximum number of units (pallets, cartons, or SKUs) this facility can process per day for this specific lane. Used for capacity-constrained routing and load optimization. May be lower than facility.max_daily_outbound_volume_units due to lane-specific constraints.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Priority ranking of this facility for this lane when multiple facilities can serve the same lane. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used by routing algorithms to select optimal facility for shipment assignment.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Role of this facility in serving this lane: origin (shipment pickup point), destination (final delivery point), intermediate (consolidation/deconsolidation), hub (transshipment node), cross_dock (no storage, direct transfer).

attributes.name: sla_transit_days
attributes.description: Committed transit time in calendar days for shipments on this lane when processed through this specific facility. May differ from lane.standard_transit_days based on facility-specific processing capabilities and location.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this lane-facility service configuration record was last modified.

products.name: lane_budget_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of budget resources to specific transport lanes for capacity planning and operational expenditure control. It captures the financial commitment and capacity allocation decisions made during fiscal planning cycles. Each record links one lane to one budget line with allocation amounts, capacity commitments, fiscal periods, and allocation types that exist only in the context of this lane-budget relationship.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, a single transport lane (e.g., Shanghai-Rotterdam ocean freight) receives budget allocations from multiple budget lines (operational OPEX, capacity expansion CAPEX, contingency reserves) across different fiscal periods and commitment types. Conversely, a single budget line (e.g., Asia-Pacific Express OPEX Q2 2024) funds multiple lanes across the network based on strategic priorities, volume forecasts, and capacity requirements. The business actively manages these allocations as discrete planning decisions with specific amounts, capacity commitments, fiscal periods, and allocation types.

attributes.name: lane_budget_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the lane-budget allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: allocated_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or budget planner who created this lane-budget allocation.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the budget line providing funding for this lane

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the origin-destination lane receiving budget allocation

attributes.name: allocated_capacity_teu
attributes.description: The capacity commitment in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU) allocated to this lane from this budget. Relevant for ocean freight lanes with containerized capacity planning.

attributes.name: allocated_spend_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount allocated from this budget line to this specific lane for the fiscal period. Used for lane-level budget tracking and variance analysis.

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget allocation was formally created and recorded in the system.

attributes.name: allocation_effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this budget allocation becomes active and available for lane operations.

attributes.name: allocation_effective_to
attributes.description: The date on which this budget allocation expires or is closed. Nullable for open-ended allocations.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total budget line allocated to this specific lane. Used for proportional budget distribution analysis across multiple lanes.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this lane-budget allocation indicating approval and consumption state.

attributes.name: commitment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget allocation by commitment purpose: operational (day-to-day lane operations), capacity (volume/TEU commitments), contingency (risk buffer), strategic (network expansion), or maintenance (lane infrastructure upkeep).

attributes.name: consumed_amount
attributes.description: The actual expenditure consumed from this allocation to date. Used for lane-level budget variance tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the allocation amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Inherited from the budget but captured at allocation level for multi-currency lane operations.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period within the year for which this allocation applies (Q1-Q4 for quarterly, M01-M12 for monthly, FY for full year). Allows tracking of allocation timing and period-specific commitments.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between allocated and consumed amounts for this lane-budget allocation. Positive indicates under-spend, negative indicates over-spend.

products.name: lane_safety_program_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the mandatory safety program requirements and compliance tracking for specific transport lanes. It captures which safety programs are required for operation on each lane, the risk tier classification of the lane within that program, compliance status, and audit history. Each record links one lane to one safety program with attributes that exist only in the context of this lane-program relationship.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping logistics operations, lanes have varying operational risk profiles based on factors like hazmat transport, cross-border complexity, terrain, and mode. Multiple safety programs (ISO 45001, OSHA VPP, driver fatigue management, DG handling, border security) apply to each lane based on its characteristics, and each safety program covers multiple lanes across the network. The business actively manages which programs are mandatory per lane, tracks lane-specific risk tiers within each program, monitors compliance status, and conducts lane-program-specific audits.

attributes.name: lane_safety_program_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this lane-safety program requirement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lane Safety Program Requirement - Lane Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the lane that has safety program requirements

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lane Safety Program Requirement - Safety Program Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the safety program that applies to this lane

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee responsible for ensuring compliance of this lane with this safety program.

attributes.name: safety_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to safety.safety_program.safety_program_id

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of this lane with respect to this safety program. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this safety program requirement became effective for this lane.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date on which this safety program requirement ceases to apply to this lane. Null for ongoing requirements.

attributes.name: exemption_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body or internal authority that granted the exemption. Null if no exemption applies.

attributes.name: exemption_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the exemption expires and the lane must become compliant. Null if no exemption or exemption is permanent.

attributes.name: exemption_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason if this lane has been granted an exemption from this safety program requirement. Null if no exemption applies.

attributes.name: lane_risk_tier
attributes.description: Risk tier classification of this specific lane within the context of this safety program (e.g., HIGH for hazmat lanes under DG safety program, MEDIUM for cross-border lanes under border security program). Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance audit for this lane under this safety program. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: mandatory_for_lane_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this safety program is mandatory for operational approval of this lane, or optional/recommended. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance audit of this lane under this safety program.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.description: Number of integration errors or failed synchronization attempts in the last 24 hours. Used for health monitoring and alerting.

attributes.name: integration_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or label for this integration channel, used for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: integration_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the integration channel. Determines whether messages are processed or queued.

attributes.name: integration_type
attributes.description: Technical protocol or method used for data exchange with the merchant platform. Determines message format and connectivity requirements.
attributes.references: EDI X12 Standard, REST API Best Practices

attributes.name: last_error_code
attributes.description: Error code or identifier for the most recent integration failure. Used for diagnostics and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: last_error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error message or description for the most recent integration failure. Provides context for troubleshooting.

attributes.name: last_error_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the most recent integration error or failure occurred.

attributes.name: last_successful_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful data synchronization or message exchange through this integration channel.

attributes.name: last_sync_attempt_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent synchronization attempt, regardless of success or failure. Used for monitoring and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this integration configuration record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: max_retry_attempts
attributes.description: Maximum number of automatic retry attempts for failed synchronization before escalating to manual intervention.

attributes.name: message_format
attributes.description: Data serialization format used for message payloads exchanged through this integration channel.
attributes.references: JSON RFC 8259, XML W3C Standard, EDI X12 Standard

attributes.name: message_format_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the message format specification or schema being used (e.g., 1.0, 4010 for EDI X12).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special configuration details, or operational instructions related to this integration channel.

attributes.name: polling_frequency_minutes
attributes.description: Interval in minutes at which the system polls or checks the integration endpoint for new messages or data. Null for push-based integrations.

attributes.name: rate_limit_requests_per_minute
attributes.description: Maximum number of API requests or message transmissions allowed per minute. Prevents overloading the merchant platform.

attributes.name: retry_policy
attributes.description: Strategy for retrying failed integration attempts. Defines timing and behavior for automatic retry logic.

attributes.name: sftp_directory_path
attributes.business_glossary_term: Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) Directory Path
attributes.description: Remote directory path on SFTP server where files are exchanged (inbound and outbound).

attributes.name: sftp_host
attributes.description: SFTP server hostname or IP address for file-based integration. Applicable when integration_type is SFTP.

attributes.name: sftp_port
attributes.description: TCP port number for SFTP connection. Standard port is 22.

attributes.name: success_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of successful synchronization attempts over a defined measurement period. Key performance indicator for integration reliability.

attributes.name: supported_transaction_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of business transaction types supported by this integration (e.g., ORDER_INGEST, ASN_OUTBOUND, SHIPMENT_STATUS, INVENTORY_SYNC, RMA_NOTIFICATION).

attributes.name: timeout_threshold_seconds
attributes.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a response from the integration endpoint before timing out and marking the attempt as failed.

attributes.name: webhook_callback_url
attributes.description: URL endpoint on the fulfillment platform that receives push notifications from the merchant system. Applicable when integration_type is WEBHOOK.

products.name: consignee
products.description: Master record for the end recipient (consignee) of a fulfillment delivery. Captures consignee name, structured delivery address (street, city, state, postal code, country ISO), address validation status and geocode, address type (residential, commercial, locker, PUDO point), contact phone, contact email, delivery preferences (leave at door, signature required, neighbor, time-slot preference), failed delivery history flag, and blacklist flag. Distinct from the customer domain's account/profile — the consignee is the physical delivery recipient, not necessarily the ordering customer or merchant.

attributes.name: consignee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the consignee record. Primary key.

attributes.name: consignee_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.consignee_profile. Business justification: Links fulfillment-side delivery recipient entity to customer's consignee master profile. Essential for delivery planning, address validation, delivery preference enforcement, denied-party screening, a

attributes.name: access_code
attributes.description: Security access code or gate code required to enter the delivery location (e.g., building entry code, gated community code).

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consignee record is currently active and available for use in fulfillment operations. True if active, false if deactivated or archived.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for delivery location. Includes street number, street name, and building identifier.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as apartment number, suite, floor, building name, or care-of information.

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery address type: residential home, commercial business, automated locker, PUDO (Pick-Up Drop-Off) point, CFS (Container Freight Station), or ICD (Inland Container Depot).

attributes.name: address_validation_status
attributes.description: Status of address validation process: validated (confirmed accurate), unvalidated (not yet checked), corrected (modified by validation service), or failed (could not be validated).

attributes.name: alternate_contact_phone
attributes.description: Secondary contact phone number for the consignee. Used when primary contact is unavailable or for escalation during delivery attempts.

attributes.name: blacklist_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consignee is blacklisted due to fraud, repeated delivery failures, abusive behavior, or security concerns. True if blacklisted, false otherwise.

attributes.name: blacklist_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the consignee was blacklisted (e.g., fraud, repeated refusal to accept delivery, security threat, denied party screening match).

attributes.name: business_hours_end
attributes.description: End time of business hours for commercial consignees in HH:MM format (24-hour clock). Used for scheduling delivery attempts during operating hours.

attributes.name: business_hours_start
attributes.description: Start time of business hours for commercial consignees in HH:MM format (24-hour clock). Used for scheduling delivery attempts during operating hours.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name for the delivery address.

attributes.name: cod_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consignee is eligible to receive COD (Cash on Delivery) shipments. True if COD is permitted, false if COD is restricted due to payment history or risk assessment.

attributes.name: cod_payment_method_preference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cash on Delivery (COD) Payment Method Preference
attributes.description: Preferred payment method for COD (Cash on Delivery) collections: cash, card (credit/debit), mobile_payment (digital wallet), or bank_transfer.

attributes.name: consignee_name
attributes.description: Full legal name or business name of the delivery recipient (consignee). May be an individual person or a company name.

attributes.name: consignee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the consignee entity type: individual person, business organization, government entity, or non-governmental organization.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the consignee. Used for delivery notifications, ePOD (Electronic Proof of Delivery) transmission, and customer communication.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the consignee. Used for delivery coordination, notifications, and exception handling.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the delivery address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, CHN).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consignee record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: customs_id_number
attributes.description: Customs-specific identifier for the consignee (e.g., importer of record number, customs registration number). Used for cross-border shipments and customs declarations.

attributes.name: delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text special instructions for the delivery agent regarding access, location, handling, or recipient preferences (e.g., ring doorbell twice, use side entrance, fragile items).

attributes.name: delivery_preference_leave_at_door
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignee permits unattended delivery at the door. True if leave-at-door is acceptable, false if recipient presence is required.

attributes.name: delivery_preference_neighbor_delivery
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignee permits delivery to a neighbor if the primary recipient is unavailable. True if neighbor delivery is acceptable.

attributes.name: delivery_preference_safe_place
attributes.description: Free-text instructions specifying a safe place to leave the parcel if the consignee is not present (e.g., back porch, garage, with building concierge).

attributes.name: delivery_preference_signature_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignee requires a signature for delivery confirmation. True if signature is mandatory, false if signature can be waived.

attributes.name: delivery_time_window_preference
attributes.description: Preferred time window for delivery attempts: morning (before noon), afternoon (noon to 5pm), evening (after 5pm), business_hours (9am-5pm weekdays), or anytime (no preference).

attributes.name: denied_party_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of screening against denied party lists (e.g., OFAC, EU sanctions, UN sanctions): cleared (no match), flagged (potential match requiring review), pending (screening in progress), or not_screened.
attributes.references: OFAC, EU Sanctions, UN Security Council, C-TPAT

attributes.name: failed_delivery_count
attributes.description: Total number of failed delivery attempts recorded for this consignee address across all historical shipments. Used for delivery risk scoring.

attributes.name: failed_delivery_history_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consignee has a history of failed delivery attempts. True if previous deliveries have failed, false otherwise. Used for risk assessment and route planning.

attributes.name: geocode_accuracy
attributes.description: Precision level of the geocoded coordinates: rooftop (exact building), street (street-level), postal_code (postal code centroid), city (city centroid), or region (regional approximation).

attributes.name: geocode_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the delivery address in decimal degrees. Used for route optimization and GPS (Global Positioning System) navigation.

attributes.name: geocode_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the delivery address in decimal degrees. Used for route optimization and GPS (Global Positioning System) navigation.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO language code for the consignee's preferred communication language (e.g., en, es, fr, de, zh). Used for delivery notifications and customer communications.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consignee record was most recently modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notification_preference_email
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignee has opted in to receive delivery notifications via email. True if email notifications are enabled.

attributes.name: notification_preference_push
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignee has opted in to receive delivery notifications via mobile app push notifications. True if push notifications are enabled.

attributes.name: notification_preference_sms
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignee has opted in to receive delivery notifications via SMS text message. True if SMS notifications are enabled.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code for the delivery address. Format varies by country (e.g., 5-digit US ZIP, alphanumeric UK postcode).

attributes.name: residential_commercial_indicator
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery location as residential (home address), commercial (business address), or mixed_use (building with both residential and commercial units). Affects delivery routing and surcharges.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this consignee record (e.g., SAP_TM, ORACLE_TMS, MANHATTAN_WMS, SALESFORCE_CRM, ECOMMERCE_API).

attributes.name: special_handling_requirements
attributes.description: Free-text description of any special handling requirements for deliveries to this consignee (e.g., temperature-sensitive, fragile, hazardous materials, security protocols).
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions, ADR

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region for the delivery address. Format varies by country (e.g., two-letter US state codes, full province names).

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number for the consignee (e.g., EIN, VAT number, GST number). Required for customs clearance and DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) shipments.

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the consignee location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Shanghai). Used for accurate delivery time window calculations and notifications.

products.name: center

Captures facility code, facility name, address, facility type (owned, 3PL, 4PL, cross-dock, dark store), total floor area (sqm), storage capacity (CBM and pallet positions), WMS system instance, operating hours, supported service types, last-mile zone coverage, and operational status. Distinct from warehouse domain's general warehouse master — this entity is scoped to fulfillment-specific facilities.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Primary key for center

attributes.name: cost_center_id
