attributes.description: FK to warehouse.facility.facility_id — MUST-HAVE: Links fulfillment centers to the warehouse facility master. Required for inventory visibility, capacity planning, and operational reporting across fulfillment and warehouse domains.

attributes.name: facility_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier for the facility manager responsible for the operational management of this fulfillment center.

attributes.name: hub_gateway_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.hub_gateway. Business justification: Fulfillment centers connect to network hubs/gateways for linehaul operations. Business process: network planning, hub-to-spoke routing, capacity allocation, inter-facility transfer planning. Removes d

attributes.name: mro_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Fulfillment centers procure MRO supplies, equipment, and consumables from suppliers. Tracks primary supplier relationship for facility operations, enabling spend analysis and supplier performance mana

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.network_node. Business justification: Fulfillment centers are network nodes in the routing topology. Enables facility integration into network design, routing optimization, and capacity planning. Standard practice in integrated logistics

attributes.name: operator_tpl_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.tpl_provider. Business justification: Fulfillment centers may be operated by 3PL providers. Business process: 3PL facility management, operational oversight, cost center allocation. Role-prefixed as centers may have multiple 3PL relations

attributes.name: address_line1

attributes.name: address_line2

attributes.name: annual_throughput_capacity_units

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Classification of the degree of automation deployed in the fulfillment center operations, ranging from manual labor-intensive to fully robotic systems.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the fulfillment center is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for operational communications with the fulfillment center. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the fulfillment center facility. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country where the fulfillment center is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment center record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customs_bonded_warehouse_flag

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fulfillment center based on ownership and operational model. Owned = company-operated, 3PL = Third-Party Logistics provider, 4PL = Fourth-Party Logistics provider, cross_dock = transshipment facility, dark_store = retail-to-fulfillment conversion, micro_fulfillment = urban compact facility.

attributes.name: ftz_designation
attributes.description: Free Trade Zone designation or license number if the fulfillment center operates within an FTZ, enabling duty deferral and trade facilitation benefits.

attributes.name: go_live_date
attributes.description: Date when the fulfillment center commenced operational activities and began processing orders.

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fulfillment center is certified to handle and store hazardous materials according to IMDG, IATA, and local regulations.

attributes.name: labor_workforce_size
attributes.description: Total workforce size at the fulfillment center measured in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) employees, including permanent and temporary staff.

attributes.name: last_mile_zone_coverage
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of last-mile delivery zone codes or postal code prefixes that this fulfillment center serves, defining its geographic service area for direct delivery.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment center record was last modified, used for audit trail and change tracking purposes.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the fulfillment center location in decimal degrees, used for routing, distance calculations, and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: lease_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the lease agreement for the fulfillment center facility expires, applicable for leased or 3PL/4PL facilities. Null for owned facilities.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the fulfillment center location in decimal degrees, used for routing, distance calculations, and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: operating_days_per_week
attributes.description: Number of days per week the fulfillment center operates, typically ranging from 5 (weekdays only) to 7 (continuous operations).

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.description: Daily operating hours end time for the fulfillment center in HH:MM format (24-hour clock), representing when the facility ceases operations.

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.description: Daily operating hours start time for the fulfillment center in HH:MM format (24-hour clock), representing when the facility begins operations.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fulfillment center indicating whether it is operational and available for order fulfillment activities.

attributes.name: pallet_positions
attributes.description: Total number of pallet storage positions available in the fulfillment center, representing discrete storage locations for palletized inventory.

attributes.name: peak_daily_order_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of orders the fulfillment center can process in a single day during peak periods, used for capacity planning and load balancing.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the fulfillment center address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: quality_certification

attributes.name: security_certification
attributes.description: Security certifications held by the fulfillment center (e.g., C-TPAT, AEO, ISO 28000), demonstrating compliance with supply chain security standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: c_tpat|aeo|iso_28000|tapa_a|tapa_b|tapa_c|pip — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source operational system from which this fulfillment center master record originated (e.g., Manhattan WMS, SAP TM).

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the fulfillment center is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_cbm
attributes.description: Total volumetric storage capacity of the fulfillment center measured in cubic meters (CBM), representing the three-dimensional space available for inventory storage.

attributes.name: supported_service_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of service types supported by this fulfillment center (e.g., standard_delivery, express_delivery, same_day, next_day, cod, returns_processing). attributes.name: sustainability_certification

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fulfillment center has temperature-controlled storage zones for perishable or temperature-sensitive goods.

attributes.name: total_floor_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total floor area of the fulfillment center facility measured in square meters, representing the physical footprint available for operations.

attributes.name: wms_instance_code
attributes.description: Unique instance identifier for the WMS deployment at this facility, used for system integration and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: wms_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the WMS system instance deployed at this fulfillment center. Used to route integration messages and identify the source system for inventory and order data.

products.name: fulfillment_delivery_zone

attributes.name: fulfillment_delivery_zone_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the delivery zone record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Delivery zones may have dedicated cost centers for zone-specific operations and cost tracking. Zone-level P&L analysis, service pricing optimization, and cost-to-serve modeling require linking zones t

attributes.name: hub_fulfillment_center_id

attributes.name: lane_rate_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.lane_rate_zone. Business justification: Delivery zones map to pricing rate zones for zone-based tariff application. Business process: zone-based rating applies distance/geography-based pricing to delivery zones for accurate freight costing.

attributes.name: route_delivery_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route_delivery_zone. Business justification: Fulfillment delivery zones map to route delivery zones for service coverage alignment and SLA management. Enables zone harmonization across fulfillment and routing systems, critical for multi-system l

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery zone record is active in the system. Inactive zones are retained for historical reference.

attributes.name: average_delivery_attempts
attributes.description: Historical average number of delivery attempts required to successfully complete deliveries in this zone. Used for operational planning.

attributes.name: carrier_coverage_level
attributes.description: Level of carrier network coverage available in this zone. Affects service availability and delivery reliability.

attributes.name: city_name
attributes.description: Primary city or municipality name associated with this delivery zone.

attributes.name: cod_service_available_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cash on Delivery (COD) Service Available Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Cash on Delivery (COD) service is available for deliveries in this zone based on carrier capabilities and risk assessment.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country in which this delivery zone is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery zone record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_cutoff_time
attributes.description: Local time cutoff for same-day or next-day delivery eligibility in this zone. Format HH:MM in 24-hour notation.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this delivery zone configuration ceases to be effective. Null indicates no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this delivery zone configuration becomes effective for operational use.

attributes.name: epod_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) capture is mandatory for deliveries in this zone.

attributes.name: express_transit_days
attributes.description: Number of business days for express delivery service to this zone from the fulfillment center. Used for expedited SLA promise calculation.

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether fuel surcharge (Bunker Adjustment Factor - BAF) applies to shipments in this zone.

attributes.name: holiday_delivery_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether delivery service is available on public holidays in this zone.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery zone record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: max_parcel_dimensions_cm
attributes.description: Maximum parcel dimensions (length x width x height) in centimeters that can be delivered to this zone. Format: LxWxH.

attributes.name: max_parcel_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum parcel weight in kilograms that can be delivered to this zone based on carrier and infrastructure constraints.

attributes.name: next_day_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this zone is eligible for next-day delivery service based on cutoff times and carrier network coverage.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special instructions, constraints, or operational considerations for this delivery zone.

attributes.name: postal_code_range_end
attributes.description: Ending postal code of the range covered by this delivery zone. Used for zone lookup during order processing.

attributes.name: postal_code_range_start
attributes.description: Starting postal code of the range covered by this delivery zone. Used for zone lookup during order processing.

attributes.name: primary_carrier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary carrier assigned to service this delivery zone. Used in carrier selection logic.

attributes.name: remote_area_surcharge_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a remote area surcharge applies to deliveries in this zone due to distance or accessibility constraints.

attributes.name: residential_surcharge_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether residential delivery surcharge applies to addresses in this zone.

attributes.name: restricted_goods_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether restricted or regulated goods (e.g., hazardous materials, alcohol, pharmaceuticals) can be delivered to this zone based on local regulations.

attributes.name: same_day_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this zone is eligible for same-day delivery service based on proximity to fulfillment centers and carrier availability.

attributes.name: secondary_carrier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the backup carrier for this delivery zone when primary carrier is unavailable or at capacity.

attributes.name: serviceable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery zone is currently serviceable for deliveries. False indicates zone is temporarily or permanently out of service.

attributes.name: signature_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether recipient signature is required for deliveries in this zone as a default service requirement.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this delivery zone data originated (e.g., SAP TM, Oracle TMS, Manhattan WMS).

attributes.name: standard_transit_days
attributes.description: Number of business days for standard delivery service to this zone from the fulfillment center. Used for Service Level Agreement (SLA) promise calculation.

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: State or province code within the country. Format varies by country (e.g., US state codes, Canadian province codes).

attributes.name: time_zone_code
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for this delivery zone. Used for scheduling delivery windows and cutoff time calculations.

attributes.name: weekend_delivery_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Saturday and Sunday delivery service is available in this zone.

attributes.name: zone_centroid_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the geographic centroid of the delivery zone. Used for distance calculations and route optimization.

attributes.name: zone_centroid_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the geographic centroid of the delivery zone. Used for distance calculations and route optimization.

attributes.name: zone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the delivery zone for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: zone_priority_rank
attributes.description: Priority ranking of this zone for resource allocation and route sequencing. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery zone based on geographic and population density characteristics. Determines service level and surcharge applicability.

products.name: wave

attributes.name: wave_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the warehouse wave release record. Primary key.

attributes.name: actual_parcels_shipped

attributes.name: assigned_labor_pool_code

attributes.name: assigned_zone_code

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code

attributes.name: carrier_service_type

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when all orders in the wave were fully picked, packed, and manifested. Used for cycle time and throughput KPI calculation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this wave record was first created in the WMS. Audit field for data lineage and wave planning analysis.

attributes.name: cutoff_timestamp

attributes.name: efficiency_percent
attributes.description: Calculated efficiency percentage of wave execution based on planned vs actual cycle time and labor utilization. Used for continuous improvement and wave planning optimization.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this wave record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and data freshness verification.

attributes.name: manifest_generated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the carrier shipping manifest was generated for parcels in this wave. Critical for carrier pickup coordination and EDI transmission.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or special instructions for wave execution, such as handling requirements, priority rationale, or coordination notes.

attributes.name: pack_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the last packing task in this wave was completed. Used for pack cycle time and throughput KPI calculation.

attributes.name: pack_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the first packing task in this wave was started. Used for packing station utilization and cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: pick_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the last pick task in this wave was completed. Used for pick cycle time and throughput KPI calculation.

attributes.name: pick_method
attributes.description: Picking methodology applied for this wave: discrete (order-by-order), batch (multiple orders picked together), cluster (cart-based multi-order), zone (zone-to-zone handoff), or wave (coordinated multi-zone).

attributes.name: pick_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the first pick task in this wave was started by warehouse staff. Used for labor productivity and cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: planned_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time for wave execution to begin. Used for labor planning and capacity scheduling.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for wave execution sequencing. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for SLA-driven wave scheduling.

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wave was released to the warehouse floor for pick-pack-ship execution. Key event timestamp for throughput analysis.

attributes.name: short_pick_count
attributes.description: Count of order lines that could not be fully picked due to inventory shortage or location discrepancies. Key metric for inventory accuracy and fulfillment quality.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) whether this wave breached its cutoff timestamp or target ship date, resulting in SLA violations for included orders.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source WMS or fulfillment system that generated this wave record (e.g., Manhattan WMS, SAP EWM). Used for multi-system integration and data lineage.

attributes.name: target_ship_date
attributes.description: Target date by which all parcels in this wave must be shipped to meet customer delivery commitments and SLA windows.

attributes.name: total_order_lines
attributes.description: Total count of individual order line items (SKUs) across all orders in the wave. Used for pick task volume estimation.

attributes.name: total_orders
attributes.description: Total count of fulfillment orders included in this wave release. Core metric for wave size and labor allocation.

attributes.name: total_parcels_expected
attributes.description: Expected total count of shipping parcels or packages to be generated from this wave. Used for packing station capacity planning and carrier manifest preparation.

attributes.name: total_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of individual units (eaches) to be picked across all orders in the wave. Key metric for labor productivity and pick rate calculation.

attributes.name: total_volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total cubic volume in cubic meters (CBM) of all items in the wave. Used for space utilization planning and packing optimization.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight in kilograms of all items in the wave. Used for labor planning, equipment selection, and carrier capacity allocation.

attributes.name: wave_number
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique wave number or code for tracking and reference within the fulfillment center.

attributes.name: wave_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the wave: planned (scheduled but not released), released (active for picking), in-progress (picking underway), completed (all orders picked and packed), cancelled (wave aborted), or on-hold (temporarily suspended).

attributes.name: wave_type
attributes.description: Classification of the wave strategy: single-order (discrete pick), multi-order (batch pick), batch (grouped orders), zone (zone-based picking), replenishment (inventory replenishment), or cross-dock (direct transfer).

products.name: merchant_compliance_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment relationship between merchants and customs compliance programs. It captures the participation of merchant partners in trade compliance certification programs (C-TPAT, AEO, Trusted Trader) with enrollment-specific attributes including certification status, audit history, compliance scores, and program-specific benefits. Each record links one merchant to one compliance program with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship.. Existence Justification: In the logistics industry, merchant partners commonly participate in multiple customs compliance programs simultaneously across different jurisdictions (e.g., a merchant may hold C-TPAT certification in the US, AEO status in the EU, and participate in a national Trusted Trader program in Asia). Each compliance program has multiple merchant participants. The business actively manages these enrollments, tracking certification status, audit schedules, compliance scores, and program-specific benefits for each merchant-program combination to determine eligibility for preferential customs treatment and risk-based processing.

attributes.name: merchant_compliance_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this merchant-program enrollment record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: compliance_program_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Merchant Compliance Enrollment - Compliance Program Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the compliance program in which the merchant is enrolled

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the merchant partner enrolled in the compliance program

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which this merchant is audited for compliance within this specific program. Identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: benefits_active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this merchant is currently receiving the preferential treatment benefits (reduced examination rates, expedited release) associated with this program enrollment.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this merchant's certification in this specific program expires and requires renewal.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the merchant's certification within this specific program (pending, active, suspended, expired, revoked, under_review). Identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: compliance_score
attributes.description: Numerical compliance score or rating assigned to this merchant for this specific program based on audit results and ongoing compliance monitoring. Identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the merchant was enrolled or registered in this specific compliance program. Identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: enrollment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding this specific merchant-program enrollment including special conditions, audit findings, or compliance issues.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance audit conducted for this merchant within this specific program. Identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: merchant_certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or membership number issued to this merchant for this specific program enrollment.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance audit for this merchant within this specific program.

attributes.name: program_tier
attributes.description: The tier or level at which this merchant participates in this specific program (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3 for C-TPAT; different programs have different tier structures). Identified in detection phase relationship data.

products.name: merchant_carrier_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual agreement between a merchant and a carrier partner. It captures merchant-specific carrier account numbers, authorized service levels, negotiated rate cards, and contract periods that exist only in the context of this merchant-carrier relationship. Each record links one merchant to one carrier with relationship-specific attributes that enable merchant carrier selection, rate management, and performance tracking.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping logistics operations, merchants maintain contractual agreements with multiple carrier partners to ensure redundancy, enable rate shopping, and support diverse service level requirements across different shipping lanes and product types. Conversely, each carrier serves multiple merchant clients under separate contractual terms. The business actively manages these merchant-carrier agreements as operational entities, tracking merchant-specific carrier account numbers, authorized service levels, negotiated rate cards, contract periods, and performance tiers.

attributes.name: merchant_carrier_agreement_id

attributes.name: carrier_id

attributes.name: merchant_id

attributes.name: account_number

attributes.name: created_date

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this merchant-carrier agreement became effective and the merchant was authorized to use this carrier.

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: last_modified_date

attributes.name: merchant_carrier_agreement_status

attributes.name: performance_tier

attributes.name: service_levels_authorized

products.name: fulfillment_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the contractual allocation of fulfillment center capacity to specific commercial agreements. It captures the service scope, capacity commitment, and priority level for each agreement-center pairing. Each record links one fulfillment center to one agreement with attributes that exist only in the context of this capacity allocation relationship.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping's logistics operations, fulfillment centers operate as multi-tenant facilities serving multiple customer agreements simultaneously (e-commerce clients, 3PL contracts, enterprise fulfillment agreements). Conversely, large commercial agreements typically utilize multiple fulfillment centers to achieve geographic coverage, redundancy, and capacity scaling. The business actively manages these allocations by assigning capacity percentages, defining service scopes per center-agreement pair, and setting priority levels for order routing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_date

products.name: fulfillment_program_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment relationship between fulfillment centers and safety programs. It captures the formal participation of a fulfillment center in a specific safety program, including compliance tracking, audit results, certification levels, and coordinator assignments. Each record links one fulfillment center to one safety program with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping logistics operations, fulfillment centers participate in multiple safety programs simultaneously (OSHA VPP, ISO 45001, hazmat handling certifications, driver safety programs), and each safety program covers multiple facilities across the network. Safety managers actively manage these enrollments as operational entities, tracking compliance status, conducting facility-specific audits, assigning local coordinators, and monitoring certification levels for each facility-program combination. This is not a reference relationship but an actively managed business process with substantial relationship-specific data.

attributes.name: fulfillment_program_enrollment_id

products.name: service
products.description: This association product represents the operational service agreement between a fulfillment center and a carrier partner. It captures center-specific pickup schedules, service day configurations, and capacity allocations that exist only in the context of this facility-carrier relationship. Each record links one fulfillment center to one carrier with operational parameters that govern how that carrier serves that specific facility.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping logistics operations, fulfillment centers are served by multiple carrier partners simultaneously for redundancy, capacity, and service coverage, and each carrier serves multiple fulfillment centers across the network. The business actively manages center-specific service agreements that define pickup schedules, cutoff times, service days, and capacity allocations that vary by facility-carrier combination. These operational parameters cannot be stored on either the center or carrier entity alone because they exist only in the context of the specific facility-carrier relationship.

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: pickup_cutoff_time

attributes.name: priority_rank

attributes.name: service_status

products.name: merchant_safety_certification
products.description: This association product represents the compliance certification relationship between merchant partners and safety training courses required for handling dangerous goods shipments. It captures the completion status, certification validity, and recertification scheduling for each merchant-training combination. Each record links one merchant to one safety training course with attributes that exist only in the context of this compliance relationship.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping logistics operations, merchants who ship dangerous goods (lithium batteries, hazmat, etc.) must maintain multiple safety training certifications mandated by different regulatory bodies (IATA DGR, DOT, ADR). Each training course applies to multiple merchants based on their product mix and shipping lanes. The compliance team actively manages this many-to-many relationship by tracking completion dates, certificate numbers, recertification schedules, and cost allocation for each merchant-training combination, generating training matrix reports for regulatory audits.

domains.name: contract

Manages SLA thresholds, OTD/OTIF KPI commitments, Incoterms (DDP, DAP, FOB, CIF, EXW), rate validity periods, volume commitments, penalty/incentive clauses, contract terms, renewals, and compliance tracking. Captures party role (buyer, seller, carrier, broker, guarantor, co-signatory), party type (corporate, individual), legal entity name, registration number, signatory name, signatory title, and date of signature. Supports multi-party contract structures.

attributes.name: contract_party_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract party association record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent contract or agreement to which this party is associated.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master party entity (customer, carrier, vendor, broker, guarantor) participating in this contract.

attributes.name: aeo_number

attributes.name: compliance_certification
attributes.description: Compliance certifications held by this party relevant to the contract (e.g., C-TPAT, AEO, ISO 28000, IATA certification).
attributes.references: C-TPAT (Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism), AEO (Authorized Economic Operator Program)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract party association record was first created in the system (format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: ctpat_number
attributes.description: C-TPAT certification number if the party is certified under the U.S. Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism program.

attributes.name: customs_broker_license
attributes.description: Customs broker license number if the party is authorized to conduct customs clearance activities.

attributes.name: edi_identifier
attributes.description: EDI identifier or interchange ID for electronic communication with this party (e.g., GS1 GLN, DUNS number).
attributes.references: EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) Standards, GS1 Global Location Number

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this party's participation in the contract becomes effective (format: yyyy-MM-dd).

attributes.name: effective_to_date

attributes.name: guarantor_flag

attributes.name: iata_code

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number

attributes.name: insurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is required to maintain insurance coverage as a condition of the contract (True/False).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract party association record was last updated (format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the party as registered with governing authorities, used for contract execution and compliance.

attributes.name: liability_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum liability amount for this party under the contract terms, if applicable.

attributes.name: liability_currency_code

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding this party's role, responsibilities, or special conditions in the contract.

attributes.name: notification_preference
attributes.description: Preferred method for contract-related notifications and communications (email, phone, postal mail, EDI, API).

attributes.description: NVOCC license number issued by the Federal Maritime Commission if the party operates as a non-vessel operating common carrier.

products.name: agreement_supplier_service
products.description: This association product represents the service assignment contract between a commercial agreement and a supplier. It captures the specific terms, rates, commitments, and SLAs that apply when a particular supplier provides services under a specific agreement. Each record links one agreement to one supplier with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship, enabling multi-vendor service delivery models where a single customer agreement is fulfilled by multiple carriers, brokers, warehouse providers, or other logistics service providers.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, a single customer service agreement frequently requires multiple suppliers to fulfill different service components: a primary ocean carrier, a backup carrier for capacity overflow, a customs broker for clearance, a warehouse provider for storage, and last-mile delivery partners. Conversely, a single supplier (e.g., a major carrier like Maersk or DHL) serves hundreds of different customer agreements with varying rates, SLAs, and volume commitments specific to each agreement-supplier pairing. This is an operational M:N relationship that contract managers actively maintain.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the commercial agreement under which the supplier provides services

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this supplier assignment. Controls whether the supplier is actively fulfilling services under this agreement.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this supplier begins providing services under this agreement. May differ from the master agreement effective date if suppliers are added mid-term.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this supplier stops providing services under this agreement. Nullable for open-ended assignments. May differ from master agreement expiry if suppliers rotate.

products.name: carrier_document_specification
products.description: This association product represents the contractual specification between carrier_agreement and document_template. It captures carrier-specific document requirements, template version mandates, EDI mapping configurations, and customization permissions that exist only in the context of a specific carrier agreement. Each record links one carrier agreement to one document template with attributes governing how that template must be used for that carrier relationship.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, carrier agreements specify multiple document templates with carrier-specific requirements (BOL format, MAWB layout, delivery receipt format, customs documentation), and each document template is reused across multiple carrier agreements. The business actively manages these specifications as contractual requirements, tracking which template versions are mandated, when they become effective, what EDI mappings apply, and whether carrier customization is permitted. This is an operational relationship that humans create during contract negotiation and update when carriers change their document requirements.

products.name: compliance_documentation_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the documentation requirement relationship between compliance obligations and document types. It captures which document types are required to satisfy specific compliance obligations, including whether the document is mandatory, retention period overrides, verification schedules, and compliance status tracking. Each record links one compliance obligation to one document type with attributes that exist only in the context of this regulatory documentation requirement.. Existence Justification: In transport shipping logistics, compliance obligations (C-TPAT, AEO, IATA dangerous goods, GDPR, customs) require multiple specific document types to demonstrate compliance, and each document type can satisfy multiple different compliance obligations across contracts. For example, a security certification document may satisfy both C-TPAT and AEO obligations, while a single GDPR compliance obligation requires consent forms, privacy notices, and data processing agreements. The business actively manages these documentation requirements with obligation-specific retention periods, verification schedules, and compliance status tracking.

products.name: agreement_compliance_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the qualification relationship between compliance programs and commercial agreements. It captures which trusted trader programs (C-TPAT, AEO, etc.) qualify specific service agreements for customs benefits, including program-specific benefit tiers, qualification dates, and verification status. Each record links one compliance_program to one agreement with attributes that exist only in the context of this qualification relationship.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping logistics operations, a single compliance program (such as AEO or C-TPAT) can qualify multiple commercial service agreements for customs benefits, and a single agreement can legitimately reference multiple compliance programs simultaneously to cover different trade lanes (e.g., AEO for EU shipments, C-TPAT for US shipments under the same master agreement). The business actively manages these qualifications with program-specific benefit tiers, verification statuses, and effective dates that vary by agreement.

attributes.description: The value of the cargo as declared by the shipper on the Air Waybill (AWB) or Bill of Lading (BOL). Used when ad valorem liability basis applies or when declared value exceeds the convention limit.

attributes.name: cargo_declared_value_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cargo declared value. Required for multi-currency settlement and insurer correspondence.

attributes.name: cargo_weight_kg
attributes.description: Gross weight of the cargo in kilograms as recorded on the transport document (AWB or BOL). Used to calculate the per-kg liability limit under applicable conventions.

attributes.name: carrier_liability_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of total loss or damage attributed to the carrier's fault or negligence, expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00. Used in proportional settlement calculations.

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cargo claim type that this liability determination addresses. Determines applicable convention provisions and liability cap calculations.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; CMR Convention Articles 17-23; Hague-Visby Rules; IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: consignee_liability_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of total loss or damage attributed to the consignee's contributory negligence or fault (e.g., failure to mitigate, improper handling at destination). Complements carrier and shipper liability percentages.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 17(5); Montreal Convention Article 20

attributes.name: contributory_negligence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether contributory negligence by the shipper or consignee has been identified and factored into the liability determination, reducing the carrier's proportional liability.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 17(5); Montreal Convention Article 20; COGSA Section 4(2)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this liability determination record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cargo involved in the claim is classified as dangerous goods, triggering additional liability provisions under IMDG Code or ICAO Technical Instructions.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; IMO

attributes.name: delay_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours by which the shipment was delayed beyond the agreed or scheduled delivery time. Applicable for delay claims under Montreal Convention Article 19 and CMR Convention Article 23(5).
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999 Article 19; CMR Convention Article 23(5); Oracle TMS Shipment Execution

attributes.name: determination_date
attributes.description: The business event date on which the formal liability assessment was completed and the determination was issued. Distinct from the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; COGSA

attributes.name: determination_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number for this liability determination, used in insurer correspondence, legal filings, and settlement documentation. Format: LD-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Internal Claims Management Standard; IATA Resolution 600a; CMR Convention Article 23

attributes.name: determination_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the liability determination record. Drives workflow routing for settlement calculation and insurer correspondence.
attributes.references: Internal Claims Lifecycle Standard; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: dispute_raised_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal dispute against this liability determination was raised. Used to track statutory limitation periods under applicable conventions.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 32; Montreal Convention Article 35; COGSA Section 3(6); Hague-Visby Rules Article III Rule 6

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the grounds on which the liability determination has been disputed by the claimant or carrier. Populated when determination_status is 'disputed'.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 32; Montreal Convention Article 35; COGSA Section 3(6); ISO 9001

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: The Incoterms code applicable to the shipment, determining the point at which risk transfers from seller to buyer. Influences the liability determination by establishing which party bears risk at the time of loss or damage. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WTO; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; COGSA

attributes.name: legal_basis_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the legal and factual basis for the liability determination, including specific convention articles, exclusions applied (e.g., act of God, inherent vice, shipper fault), and supporting evidence references.
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; COGSA; IMO; WTO

attributes.name: liability_basis
attributes.description: The unit basis on which the carrier liability limit is calculated — per kilogram, per package, per unit, or based on declared/ad valorem value. Drives the settlement calculation formula.
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999 Article 22; Hague-Visby Rules Article IV bis; CMR Convention Article 23; COGSA Section 4(5)

attributes.name: liability_convention
attributes.description: The international legal convention or regulatory framework applied to determine carrier liability limits for this claim. Governs the applicable liability cap per kg or per package. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Warsaw-Montreal|CMR|Hague-Visby|COGSA|CIM-COTIF|Montreal-1999|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999; CMR Convention 1956; Hague-Visby Rules 1968; COGSA 1936; CIM-COTIF 1999; IMO

attributes.name: liability_exclusion_type
attributes.description: Category of liability exclusion applied to reduce or eliminate carrier liability under the applicable convention. Drives the legal basis narrative and settlement outcome.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 17(2); Hague-Visby Rules Article IV Rule 2; COGSA Section 4(2); Montreal Convention Article 18(2)

attributes.name: liability_limit_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the liability limit per unit is expressed. Typically SDR (Special Drawing Rights) for international conventions, or USD for COGSA.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IATA Montreal Convention 1999; IMF Special Drawing Rights; COGSA

attributes.name: liability_limit_per_unit
attributes.description: The maximum carrier liability amount per unit (kg or package) as prescribed by the applicable convention. For Montreal Convention air freight: 22 SDR/kg. For Hague-Visby ocean: 666.67 SDR/package or 2 SDR/kg. Used in settlement calculation.
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999 Article 22; Hague-Visby Rules Article IV bis Rule 5; CMR Convention Article 23(3); COGSA Section 4(5)

attributes.name: limitation_period_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the statutory limitation period for legal action expires under the applicable convention. Montreal Convention: 2 years; CMR: 1 year (3 for wilful misconduct); Hague-Visby: 1 year.
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999 Article 35; CMR Convention Article 32; Hague-Visby Rules Article III Rule 6; COGSA Section 3(6)

attributes.name: maximum_liability_amount
attributes.description: The calculated maximum monetary amount the carrier is liable for under the applicable convention, derived from liability_limit_per_unit multiplied by the applicable weight or package count. Cap for settlement calculation.
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999 Article 22; Hague-Visby Rules Article IV bis Rule 5; CMR Convention Article 23; COGSA Section 4(5)

attributes.name: maximum_liability_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the maximum liability amount is expressed for settlement purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IATA Montreal Convention 1999; IMF Special Drawing Rights

attributes.name: negligence_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the contributory negligence factors identified for the shipper or consignee, including evidence basis (e.g., improper packaging, misdeclared weight, inadequate labelling).
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 17(5); Montreal Convention Article 20; ISO 9001

attributes.name: package_count
attributes.description: Number of packages or units in the shipment as declared on the transport document. Used to calculate per-package liability limits under Hague-Visby Rules and COGSA.
attributes.references: Hague-Visby Rules Article IV bis Rule 5; COGSA Section 4(5); CMR Convention Article 23

attributes.name: reserve_amount
attributes.description: The financial reserve amount set aside in the general ledger for this liability determination, representing the estimated carrier liability exposure. Feeds SAP S/4HANA Finance reserve accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance GL; IFRS 17; SOX Section 404; IFRS 9

attributes.name: reserve_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the claims reserve amount. Required for multi-currency financial reporting and IFRS compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 17; SAP S/4HANA Finance; SOX

attributes.name: settlement_recommendation_amount
attributes.description: The recommended monetary settlement amount derived from this liability determination, factoring in the maximum liability cap, carrier liability percentage, and contributory negligence. Input to the settlement calculation process.
attributes.references: Internal Claims Settlement Policy; IFRS 17; SAP S/4HANA Finance AR

attributes.name: settlement_recommendation_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the settlement recommendation amount.

attributes.name: shipper_liability_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of total loss or damage attributed to the shipper's contributory negligence or fault (e.g., improper packaging, misdeclaration). Complements carrier_liability_pct.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 17(5); Montreal Convention Article 20; Hague-Visby Rules Article IV Rule 2

attributes.name: subrogation_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount the insurer is seeking to recover from the carrier through subrogation after having settled the claim with the insured party.
attributes.references: Internal Claims Management Standard; IFRS 17; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: subrogation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurer has exercised or intends to exercise subrogation rights against the carrier following settlement of the cargo claim.
attributes.references: Internal Claims Management Standard; IFRS 17; ISO 28000

attributes.name: survey_report_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the independent cargo survey report that assessed the extent of loss or damage. Provides evidentiary basis for the liability determination.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; IATA Resolution 600a; CMR Convention Article 8; Hague-Visby Rules Article III Rule 6

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transport applicable to the shipment leg on which the loss, damage, or delay occurred. Determines which liability convention and limit applies.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; US DOT; CMR Convention; CIM-COTIF; ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: claimed_amount
attributes.description: Original amount claimed by the claimant as submitted in the claim registration. Used to calculate settlement ratio and measure liability exposure versus actual payout for analytics and reserve adequacy assessment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_flag

attributes.name: deductible_amount

attributes.name: dispute_reason

attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; ISO 9001

attributes.name: exchange_rate

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Net settlement amount converted to the company's functional reporting currency using the exchange rate at settlement date. Used for financial consolidation, P&L reporting, and reserve release accounting in SAP S/4HANA Finance.

attributes.name: insurer_correspondence_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or file number assigned by the cargo insurer for their internal tracking of this claim settlement. Used for insurer correspondence, recovery claims, and co-insurance coordination.

attributes.name: insurer_recovery_amount

attributes.name: liability_limit_currency

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the settlement payment was actually disbursed to the claimant. May differ from settlement_date (agreement date) due to payment processing lead times. Used for cash flow reporting and SLA measurement.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the settlement amount is disbursed to the claimant. Bank transfer is the standard for large settlements; credit note offsets against outstanding freight invoices; cheque for legacy or specific jurisdictions.

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Bank payment reference, cheque number, or transaction ID from the payment system confirming disbursement of the settlement amount to the claimant. Used for payment reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA Finance AP.

attributes.name: reserve_amount

attributes.name: reserve_release_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the financial reserve released back to the P&L upon settlement of the claim. Equals the difference between the reserve amount and the net settlement amount. Interfaces with SAP S/4HANA Finance for reserve accounting journal entries.
attributes.references: IFRS 9; IAS 37 Provisions; SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the settlement was formally agreed and accepted by all parties. Represents the principal real-world business event date for this transaction. Satisfies the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 29; CMR Convention Article 32; IFRS 9

attributes.name: settlement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the settlement transaction. Used in correspondence with claimants, insurers, and finance teams. Satisfies the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the claim settlement workflow. Tracks progression from initial draft through approval, payment, and closure. Satisfies the LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: settlement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the settlement by nature of resolution. Full settlement closes the claim entirely; partial settlement covers a portion; ex gratia is a goodwill payment without liability admission; subrogation involves insurer recovery; credit note offsets against future billing.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Convention on Limitation of Liability

attributes.name: sla_settlement_target_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Settlement Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Days
attributes.description: Target number of calendar days within which the claim settlement must be completed from claim registration date, as defined in the applicable SLA or service contract. Used for KPI and OTD performance measurement.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; IATA Service Standards; CMR Convention Article 32

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this settlement record originated. SAP S/4HANA Finance is the primary system for reserve accounting and payment processing; Salesforce CRM for claim case management. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: subrogation_amount
attributes.description: Amount pursued or recovered through subrogation against a third-party carrier, vendor, or responsible party after Transport Shipping has paid the claimant. Distinct from insurer recovery; represents direct third-party liability recovery.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 37; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO Convention

attributes.name: subrogation_initiated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a subrogation action has been initiated against a third-party carrier, vendor, or responsible party following payment of the settlement to the claimant.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 37; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO Convention on Limitation of Liability

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transport under which the cargo claim arose. Determines the applicable international liability convention and maximum compensation limits (e.g., IATA Warsaw-Montreal for air, Hague-Visby for ocean, CMR for road).
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; IMO IMDG Code

products.name: status_history
products.description: Lifecycle tracking entity recording every status transition of a cargo claim from registration through closure. Captures status code, transition timestamp, responsible party, reason code, and notes for each state change (e.g., Registered → Under Investigation → Survey Commissioned → Liability Determined → Settlement Offered → Settled/Rejected/Subrogated). Enables SLA monitoring and regulatory audit trails.

attributes.name: status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each claim status history record. Primary key of the claim_status_history entity.

attributes.name: cargo_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent cargo claim record for which this status transition is being recorded. Links each history entry to its owning claim.

attributes.name: claim_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific individual or organizational unit responsible for actioning this status transition. References the workforce or party entity depending on responsible_party_type.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: corrective_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.corrective_action. Business justification: Claim status transitions may trigger or reference corrective actions (repeated claims from same facility trigger process improvements, high-value claims require preventive measures). Essential for con

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cargo insurer involved at this stage of the claim lifecycle. Populated when the transition involves insurer correspondence, liability determination, or settlement negotiation.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO Liability Frameworks

attributes.name: surveyor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the independent cargo surveyor or survey firm appointed to assess loss or damage at this stage of the claim lifecycle. Populated when responsible_party_type is SURVEYOR.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IMO Guidelines on Cargo Claims

attributes.name: awb_number
attributes.description: Air Waybill number associated with the shipment underlying this claim. Denormalized for audit trail completeness and to support regulatory reporting under IATA frameworks without requiring joins to the shipment domain.

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number associated with the ocean or road shipment underlying this claim. Denormalized for audit trail completeness and regulatory reporting under IMO and CMR frameworks.
attributes.references: IMO Hague-Visby Rules; CMR Convention; Federal Maritime Commission (FMC) Regulations

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier of the cargo claim (e.g., CLM-2024-00012345). Denormalized here to support audit trail queries without joining to the parent claim table.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IMO Guidelines on Cargo Claims

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this claim status history record was first created in the system. Represents the audit creation timestamp, distinct from the business event transition_timestamp. Used for data lineage and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: credit_note_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the credit note issued to the claimant as part of the settlement at this status transition. Links to the billing system credit note for financial reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA Finance.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cargo claim involves dangerous goods, triggering additional regulatory handling requirements under IMDG Code or ICAO Technical Instructions. Affects claim processing procedures and liability frameworks.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: days_in_previous_status
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the claim remained in the from_status_code before transitioning. Calculated at the time of transition and stored for SLA monitoring, aging analysis, and claims processing efficiency KPIs.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: delay_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim is a delay claim (as opposed to loss or damage), which has distinct liability limits and processing rules under the Warsaw-Montreal Convention and CMR Convention.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 19; CMR Convention Article 23

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition was triggered by or resulted in an escalation of the claim to a higher authority (e.g., senior claims manager, legal counsel, or executive review). Used for management reporting and SLA breach tracking.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for escalation when escalation_flag is True. Documents the specific circumstances requiring senior review or intervention.

attributes.name: from_status_code
attributes.description: The claim lifecycle status code immediately before this transition occurred (e.g., REGISTERED, UNDER_INVESTIGATION, SURVEY_COMMISSIONED, LIABILITY_DETERMINED, SETTLEMENT_OFFERED, SETTLED, REJECTED, SUBROGATED, CLOSED, WITHDRAWN). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: REGISTERED|UNDER_INVESTIGATION|SURVEY_COMMISSIONED|LIABILITY_DETERMINED|SETTLEMENT_OFFERED|SETTLED|REJECTED|SUBROGATED|CLOSED|WITHDRAWN — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Liability Frameworks

attributes.name: insurer_reference_number
attributes.description: The cargo insurer's own reference or file number for this claim, as communicated during insurer correspondence. Used to cross-reference claim records between Transport Shipping and the insurer's system.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO Liability Frameworks

attributes.name: liability_convention_code
attributes.description: The international liability convention governing this claim at the time of this status transition (e.g., WARSAW_MONTREAL for air freight, CMR for road, HAGUE_VISBY for ocean, CIM for rail). Determines liability limits and procedural requirements.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Hague-Visby Rules; CIM Convention

attributes.name: liability_determination_code
attributes.description: The outcome of the liability assessment at this status transition (FULL_LIABILITY, PARTIAL_LIABILITY, NO_LIABILITY, SHARED_LIABILITY, PENDING). Populated when to_status_code is LIABILITY_DETERMINED. Governs settlement calculation and reserve accounting.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Hague-Visby Rules

attributes.name: liability_limit_amount
attributes.description: The maximum monetary liability applicable to this claim under the governing convention or contract at the time of liability determination. Expressed in settlement_currency_code. Used for settlement calculation and reserve accounting in SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 22; CMR Convention Article 23; IMO Hague-Visby Rules

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General free-text notes recorded by the claims handler at the time of this status transition. Captures additional context, instructions, or observations not covered by structured fields. Supports audit trail and claims review processes.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition triggers a mandatory regulatory notification obligation (e.g., dangerous goods incident reporting to IMO/IATA, customs authority notification under C-TPAT or AEO programs). Drives compliance workflow automation.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions; C-TPAT; AEO Program; WCO Framework

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required regulatory notification has been dispatched following this status transition. Used in conjunction with regulatory_notification_required_flag to track compliance obligations and identify outstanding notifications.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions; C-TPAT; AEO Program

attributes.name: reserve_amount
attributes.description: The financial reserve amount set aside in the general ledger for this claim at this status transition point. Updated at each significant status change (e.g., when liability is determined or settlement is offered). Feeds SAP S/4HANA Finance reserve accounting.
attributes.references: IFRS 37 Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Full name or organizational name of the party responsible for this status transition. Denormalized for audit trail completeness and regulatory reporting without requiring joins.

attributes.name: responsible_party_type
attributes.description: Category of the party responsible for initiating or actioning this status transition (e.g., CLAIMS_HANDLER, SURVEYOR, INSURER, LEGAL_COUNSEL, CUSTOMER, SYSTEM for automated transitions).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the settlement offer amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Applicable when settlement_offer_amount is populated.

attributes.name: settlement_offer_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the settlement offer made to the claimant at this status transition. Populated when to_status_code is SETTLEMENT_OFFERED. Expressed in the currency defined by settlement_currency_code.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IFRS 37 Provisions

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the status transition occurred after the sla_target_resolution_date, constituting an SLA breach. True if the transition_timestamp exceeded the target date; False otherwise. Used for SLA KPI reporting and escalation tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: sla_target_resolution_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Resolution Date
attributes.description: The contractual or regulatory target date by which the claim must be resolved or advanced to the next status, based on the applicable SLA for this claim type and transport mode. Used for SLA breach monitoring and KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this status transition record (e.g., SALESFORCE_CRM for customer-facing claim cases, SAP_S4HANA for finance-driven transitions, ORACLE_TMS for transport-triggered events, MANUAL for manually entered transitions).

attributes.name: source_system_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The unique transaction or record identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce Case ID, SAP document number) that triggered this status transition. Enables traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: subrogation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition initiates or is associated with a subrogation process, where Transport Shipping or the insurer pursues recovery from a third party responsible for the loss or damage.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Liability Frameworks

attributes.name: subrogation_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number assigned to the subrogation recovery action initiated at this status transition. Populated when subrogation_flag is True and to_status_code is SUBROGATED.

attributes.name: survey_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the cargo survey report commissioned or received during this status transition. Applicable when to_status_code is SURVEY_COMMISSIONED or when survey findings trigger a transition. Links to the cargo survey report document.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IMO Guidelines on Cargo Claims

attributes.name: to_status_code
attributes.description: The claim lifecycle status code immediately after this transition occurred (e.g., REGISTERED, UNDER_INVESTIGATION, SURVEY_COMMISSIONED, LIABILITY_DETERMINED, SETTLEMENT_OFFERED, SETTLED, REJECTED, SUBROGATED, CLOSED, WITHDRAWN). This is the new current state of the claim following this event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: REGISTERED|UNDER_INVESTIGATION|SURVEY_COMMISSIONED|LIABILITY_DETERMINED|SETTLEMENT_OFFERED|SETTLED|REJECTED|SUBROGATED|CLOSED|WITHDRAWN — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Liability Frameworks

attributes.name: transition_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the status transition occurred (e.g., SURVEY_REQUESTED, DOCS_RECEIVED, LIABILITY_ACCEPTED, LIABILITY_DENIED, SETTLEMENT_AGREED, INSURER_DECLINED, SUBROGATION_INITIATED, CLAIMANT_WITHDREW). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SURVEY_REQUESTED|DOCS_RECEIVED|LIABILITY_ACCEPTED|LIABILITY_DENIED|SETTLEMENT_AGREED|INSURER_DECLINED|SUBROGATION_INITIATED|CLAIMANT_WITHDREW — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transition_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context or explanation for the status transition, supplementing the structured transition_reason_code. Used by claims handlers to document specific circumstances, exceptions, or instructions.

attributes.name: transition_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone offset) at which the claim status transitioned from the from_status_code to the to_status_code. This is the principal business event time for this history record and is used for SLA monitoring and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transport associated with the underlying cargo claim (AIR, OCEAN, ROAD, RAIL, MULTIMODAL). Determines the applicable liability convention (e.g., Warsaw-Montreal for air, CMR for road, Hague-Visby for ocean).
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Hague-Visby Rules; IMDG Code

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this claim status history record was last modified. Supports data lineage tracking and identifies records that have been amended post-creation (e.g., corrections to reason codes or notes).
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

products.name: subrogation_case
products.description: Master record managing the subrogation process where the insurer or carrier pursues recovery from a liable third party (sub-carrier, port operator, customs authority, freight handler) after settling a cargo claim. Captures subrogation target party, recovery amount sought, legal proceedings status, and case closure outcome. Includes individual recovery action tracking: demand letters, legal filings, arbitration proceedings, settlement negotiations, amounts demanded vs. recovered, and action outcomes. Aligned to international subrogation rights under CMR, Warsaw-Montreal, Hague-Visby, and marine insurance law. Supports recovery P&L tracking and third-party liability management.

attributes.name: subrogation_case_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the subrogation case record. Primary key for the subrogation_case data product within the claim domain.

attributes.name: air_waybill_id

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.bill_of_lading. Business justification: Ocean cargo subrogation requires B/L reference to identify liable carrier and apply liability limits. Replaces denormalized bol_number with proper FK for carrier identification, Hague-Visby rules enfo

attributes.name: booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.booking. Business justification: Subrogation may reference booking when contractual breach occurs pre-shipment (space confirmation failure causing consequential loss). Supports booking-level recovery action and pre-shipment contractu

attributes.description: Reference to the originating cargo claim record that triggered this subrogation case. Links the subrogation recovery process back to the settled claim.

attributes.name: cargo_survey_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: Subrogation cases primarily target carriers as respondent parties for recovery; carrier identification is essential for legal proceedings, demand letters, arbitration, and recovery tracking. Required

attributes.name: claim_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the third-party entity against whom subrogation recovery is being pursued — may be a sub-carrier, port operator, customs authority, freight handler, or warehouse operator.

attributes.description: Reference to the shipment record associated with the cargo loss event underlying this subrogation case. Links to shipment tracking and transport documentation.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Legal costs and recovery administration costs must be allocated to cost centers for budget tracking, variance analysis, and cost management. Enables monitoring of subrogation program efficiency.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Subrogation cases involve customer accounts as beneficiaries of recovery actions. Enables customer-level recovery tracking, financial reporting of subrogation proceeds, and customer communication on r

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.declaration. Business justification: Subrogation recovery actions require customs declarations to prove cargo value, establish duty paid (recoverable in total loss), and verify customs compliance status of the liable party. Critical evid

attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; Workday HCM

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to warehouse.facility. Business justification: Subrogation recovery actions against third parties (equipment suppliers, contractors, carriers) for warehouse incidents require facility context for evidence documentation, jurisdiction determination,

attributes.name: freight_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.freight_order. Business justification: Subrogation cases pursue recovery against carriers/parties responsible for specific freight orders. Essential for identifying liable carrier, calculating recovery amount based on freight charges, and
