attributes.description: Classification of the appeal based on the nature of the dispute. Distinguishes between appeals against full rejections, partial settlements, liability determinations, quantum assessments, delay claims, or dangerous goods claims. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: full_rejection_appeal|partial_settlement_appeal|liability_dispute|quantum_dispute|delay_claim_appeal|dangerous_goods_appeal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMDG Code

attributes.name: arbitration_reference
attributes.description: External reference number assigned by the arbitration body or court if the appeal has been referred to formal dispute resolution proceedings. Populated when review_outcome is 'referred_to_arbitration'.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention Article 33; WTO Dispute Resolution

attributes.name: awb_number
attributes.description: Air Waybill number associated with the underlying air freight shipment subject to the appeal. Applicable for air transport mode appeals. Format follows IATA AWB numbering standard: airline prefix (3 digits) followed by 8-digit serial number.

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number associated with the underlying ocean or road freight shipment subject to the appeal. Applicable for ocean (MBL/HBL) and road (CMR consignment note) transport mode appeals.
attributes.references: Hague-Visby Rules; CMR Convention; FMC Regulations

attributes.name: claimant_reference
attributes.description: The claimant's own internal reference number for the appeal, as provided in their submission. Used to cross-reference with the claimant's records and facilitate correspondence via Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: claimed_appeal_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount the claimant is seeking through the appeal process. Represents the claimant's revised or full demand as stated in the appeal submission.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IFRS 4

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date on which the appeal was formally closed, either following a final decision, withdrawal by the claimant, or referral to external arbitration. Marks the end of the appeal lifecycle.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention Article 32; ISO 9001

attributes.name: communication_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the appeal was submitted and through which correspondence with the claimant is conducted. Supports multi-channel dispute resolution workflows including EDI-based submissions from freight forwarders.
attributes.references: IATA EDI Standards; ISO 9001; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which the claim appeal record was first created in the system. Audit trail field aligned to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Sourced from Salesforce CRM case creation event.

attributes.name: credit_note_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the credit note issued by the billing function following a successful appeal outcome. Links the appeal resolution to the financial credit note for accounts receivable reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: SOX; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Finance AR Module

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the underlying shipment involved dangerous goods, triggering additional regulatory compliance requirements under IMDG Code or ICAO Technical Instructions for the appeal assessment.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA DGR

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appeal has been escalated beyond the standard review process, such as referral to senior management, legal counsel, external arbitration, or a regulatory body.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; WTO Dispute Resolution

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason the appeal was escalated beyond the standard review process. Populated only when escalation_flag is True.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; ISO 9001

attributes.name: evidence_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the additional evidence submitted by the claimant in support of the appeal. Includes document types such as cargo survey reports, commercial invoices, packing lists, photographs, expert opinions, or ePOD records.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; CMR Convention Article 9; ISO 9001

attributes.name: evidence_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the additional evidence package submitted by the claimant was formally received and acknowledged by the claims team. Used to track SLA compliance for evidence review.

attributes.name: evidence_submitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claimant has submitted additional supporting evidence (e.g., survey reports, photographs, invoices, expert assessments) as part of the appeal. True when evidence package has been received.

attributes.name: finance_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount reserved in the financial accounts (SAP S/4HANA Finance) against this appeal for potential liability exposure. Used for reserve accounting and financial reporting under IFRS 4 and SOX requirements.
attributes.references: IFRS 4 Insurance Contracts; SOX; SAP S/4HANA Finance Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: grounds_for_appeal
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the claimant's stated reasons for contesting the initial claim decision. Captures the legal, factual, or procedural basis for the appeal as submitted by the claimant.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; CMR Convention Article 32; ISO 9001

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Internal working notes recorded by the claims reviewer during the appeal assessment process. Not shared with the claimant. Contains observations, legal analysis references, and inter-departmental communications.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 9001; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which the claim appeal record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: liability_convention
attributes.description: The international liability framework governing the appeal. Determines applicable liability limits, time bars, and procedural rights. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: montreal_convention|warsaw_convention|cmr_convention|hague_visby_rules|cotif_cim|uncitral — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; COTIF-CIM; IMO

attributes.name: original_claim_decision
attributes.description: The decision outcome of the initial claim that is being appealed. Indicates whether the original claim was fully rejected, partially settled, or settled at a disputed amount.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority classification assigned to the appeal based on claim value, claimant tier, regulatory sensitivity, or reputational risk. Drives resource allocation and review sequencing within the claims team.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; Internal SLA Policy

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory body (e.g., IATA, IMO, national transport authority) has been notified of the appeal, as required for high-value claims, dangerous goods incidents, or cross-border disputes.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO; US DOT; ICAO; WCO

attributes.name: review_outcome
attributes.description: The formal decision reached by the reviewer upon completion of the appeal assessment. Determines whether the original claim decision is overturned, partially revised, maintained, or escalated to arbitration.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention Article 32; ISO 9001

attributes.name: review_outcome_rationale
attributes.description: Detailed written justification provided by the reviewer explaining the basis for the appeal decision. Documents the legal, factual, and evidentiary reasoning applied in reaching the outcome.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; SOX; ISO 9001

attributes.name: review_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal review of the appeal was initiated by the assigned reviewer. Used to measure review cycle time against SLA targets.

attributes.name: revised_settlement_amount
attributes.description: The revised monetary settlement amount agreed or awarded following the appeal review. Populated only when the appeal outcome results in an uphold or partial uphold. Null if appeal is rejected or pending.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IFRS 4; SOX

attributes.name: settlement_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts on this appeal record (original settlement, claimed amount, revised settlement). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: sla_breached_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appeal review process exceeded the defined SLA due date without a final decision being communicated. True when the closure date or current date exceeds the SLA due date.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; ISO 9001; Internal SLA Policy

attributes.name: sla_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Appeal SLA (Service Level Agreement) Due Date
attributes.description: The contractual or regulatory deadline by which the appeal must be reviewed and a decision communicated to the claimant. Derived from the appeal lodgement date and applicable SLA or statutory time bar.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; CMR Convention Article 32; ISO 9001; Internal SLA Policy

attributes.name: statutory_time_bar_date
attributes.description: The legally mandated deadline by which the appeal must be filed or resolved under the applicable liability convention (e.g., 2-year limit under Montreal Convention, 1-year under CMR). Failure to act before this date extinguishes the claimant's rights.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 35; CMR Convention Article 32; Hague-Visby Rules Article III Rule 6

attributes.name: subrogation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appeal involves a subrogation claim, where the insurer is pursuing recovery from a third party (e.g., carrier, freight forwarder) after having compensated the insured claimant.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IFRS 4 Insurance Contracts

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transport applicable to the underlying shipment for which the claim appeal has been raised. Determines the applicable liability convention (IATA Montreal for air, CMR for road, Hague-Visby for ocean).
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; IMO

products.name: surveyor
products.description: Master entity representing accredited external cargo surveyors and loss adjusters engaged by Transport Shipping to assess cargo damage and loss. Captures surveyor company name, individual surveyor contacts, accreditation body (e.g., RICS, BIMCO, IUMI), certification numbers, specializations (marine cargo, air cargo, road freight, dangerous goods, refrigerated cargo), geographic coverage zones, standard engagement rates, turnaround SLAs, and historical performance metrics (survey quality scores, turnaround compliance). Used for surveyor selection, engagement management, and quality monitoring.

attributes.name: surveyor_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the accredited cargo surveyor or loss adjuster entity. Primary key for the surveyor master record.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: Some surveyors are carrier-appointed or carrier-affiliated; tracking this relationship is essential for independence assessment and conflict-of-interest management in joint surveys. Required for surve

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking the surveyor to their corresponding vendor/supplier master record in the procurement system (Coupa) and accounts payable module (SAP S/4HANA Finance). Enables invoice processing and payment for survey fees.
attributes.references: SOX; IFRS; Coupa Procurement and Spend Management

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: Name of the professional body or industry association that has accredited or certified the surveyor (e.g., RICS - Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors, BIMCO - Baltic and International Maritime Council, IUMI - International Union of Marine Insurance, IICL - Institute of International Container Lessors). Validates professional standing for engagement eligibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RICS|BIMCO|IUMI|IICL|ACII|CILA|AIMU|Lloyd's — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IMO; IATA; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: accreditation_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the surveyor's professional accreditation or certification expires. Used to trigger renewal reminders and to block engagement of lapsed surveyors.

attributes.name: accreditation_number
attributes.description: Official certificate or membership number issued by the accreditation body confirming the surveyor's professional standing and authorization to conduct cargo surveys.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IUMI Standards

attributes.name: bank_account_reference
attributes.description: Internal reference code pointing to the surveyor's registered bank account details held in the secure payment vault of SAP S/4HANA Finance. Not the raw account number — a tokenized reference for payment processing.

attributes.name: blacklist_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason a surveyor has been blacklisted or suspended from the approved panel (e.g., fraudulent report, conflict of interest, repeated SLA breaches, lapsed accreditation). Populated only when status is 'blacklisted' or 'suspended'.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Internally assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the surveyor company within Transport Shipping systems. Used for cross-system referencing and EDI transactions.

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.description: Legal registered name of the surveying firm or loss adjusting company engaged by Transport Shipping to conduct cargo damage and loss assessments.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address of the surveyor company contact used for engagement notifications, survey report submissions, and claim correspondence.

attributes.name: contact_person_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary individual contact at the surveyor company responsible for coordinating survey engagements with Transport Shipping.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the surveyor company contact, including international dialing code, used for urgent claim engagement and coordination.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the surveyor master record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for record provenance and data governance compliance.

attributes.name: customs_compliance_cleared
attributes.description: Indicates whether the surveyor has been screened and cleared under customs compliance programs (e.g., C-TPAT, AEO) allowing them to operate in bonded warehouses, free trade zones, and customs-controlled areas.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the surveyor holds valid certification to assess dangerous goods cargo incidents. Required for engagement on claims involving IMDG or ICAO dangerous goods shipments.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IMO

attributes.name: engagement_rate_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the surveyor's standard engagement rates are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency claim cost accounting in SAP S/4HANA Finance.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage_zones
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or regional zone identifiers representing the geographic areas where the surveyor is operationally available to conduct surveys. Used for proximity-based surveyor selection.

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City of the surveyor company's registered headquarters. Used in conjunction with country code for geographic routing and reporting.

attributes.name: headquarters_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the surveyor company's registered headquarters location. Used for jurisdictional compliance, tax treatment, and primary contact routing.

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: Hourly billing rate for the surveyor's time, expressed in the engagement rate currency. Applied for complex or extended surveys that exceed the standard flat-rate scope.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Maximum coverage amount of the surveyor's professional indemnity insurance policy, expressed in the engagement rate currency. Used to validate adequacy of coverage relative to claim values assigned.

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the surveyor's professional indemnity insurance policy. Surveyors with expired insurance must be suspended from the panel until renewed coverage is confirmed.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surveyor Professional Indemnity Insurance Policy Number
attributes.description: Policy number of the surveyor's professional indemnity (errors and omissions) insurance. Required to validate that the surveyor carries adequate liability coverage before engagement on high-value claims.

attributes.name: last_engagement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent survey engagement completed by this surveyor for Transport Shipping. Used to identify dormant panel members and to assess recency of operational experience.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes and remarks about the surveyor, including special engagement instructions, regional limitations, preferred contact protocols, or historical context relevant to claim handlers.

attributes.name: panel_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the surveyor was formally approved and added to Transport Shipping's approved surveyor panel following vetting and accreditation verification.

attributes.name: panel_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic performance and compliance review of the surveyor's panel membership. Supports ongoing quality monitoring and accreditation renewal tracking.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Agreed payment terms for survey fee invoices, indicating the number of days from invoice date within which payment is due. Aligned to Coupa procurement and SAP S/4HANA accounts payable configuration.

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or 639-2 language code representing the surveyor's preferred language for survey reports, correspondence, and engagement communications (e.g., en, fr, de, zh, es).

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Composite quality score (0.00–100.00) derived from internal assessments of the surveyor's report accuracy, completeness, and professional standards. Updated after each engagement review cycle. Used for panel ranking and surveyor selection.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; KPI framework

attributes.name: refrigerated_cargo_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the surveyor is certified and experienced to assess temperature-controlled and refrigerated cargo damage claims, including cold chain integrity assessments.

attributes.name: report_language_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of ISO 639-1 language codes in which the surveyor is capable of producing survey reports. Supports multi-jurisdictional claim handling where local language reports are required by customs or courts.

attributes.name: sla_attendance_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Survey Attendance Service Level Agreement (SLA) Hours
attributes.description: Contractually agreed maximum number of hours within which the surveyor must physically attend the cargo location after being engaged. Critical for time-sensitive perishable or dangerous goods claims.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IMDG Code

attributes.name: sla_turnaround_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Survey Report Turnaround Service Level Agreement (SLA) Hours
attributes.description: Contractually agreed maximum number of hours within which the surveyor must deliver a completed survey report from the time of engagement notification. Used for SLA monitoring and performance scoring.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: specialization_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of specialization codes indicating the cargo types and transport modes the surveyor is qualified to assess (e.g., MARINE_CARGO|AIR_CARGO|ROAD_FREIGHT|DANGEROUS_GOODS|REFRIGERATED|BULK|BREAKBULK|CONTAINER). Used for automated surveyor matching to claim type. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MARINE_CARGO|AIR_CARGO|ROAD_FREIGHT|RAIL_FREIGHT|DANGEROUS_GOODS|REFRIGERATED|BULK|BREAKBULK — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO IMDG Code; CMR Convention

attributes.name: standard_survey_rate
attributes.description: Standard fee charged by the surveyor per survey engagement, expressed in the engagement rate currency. Used as the baseline for claim cost estimation and insurer reimbursement calculations.

attributes.name: surveyor_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the surveyor in Transport Shipping's approved panel. Active surveyors are eligible for engagement; suspended or blacklisted surveyors are blocked from new assignments pending review.

attributes.name: surveyor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the surveyor entity indicating whether it is an individual independent surveyor, a specialist surveying firm, a loss adjuster, or a marine average adjuster. Drives engagement workflow and rate card selection.

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification or VAT registration number of the surveyor company. Required for invoice validation, withholding tax determination, and regulatory tax reporting.
attributes.references: SOX; IFRS; WTO; Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: total_engagements
attributes.description: Cumulative count of survey engagements completed by this surveyor for Transport Shipping since panel onboarding. Used for experience weighting in surveyor selection and volume-based rate negotiation.

attributes.name: transport_mode_coverage
attributes.description: Primary transport mode(s) the surveyor is authorized and experienced to cover for cargo damage assessments. Aligned to Transport Shipping's freight forwarding modes: air, ocean, road, rail, or multimodal.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO; CMR Convention

attributes.name: travel_expense_policy
attributes.description: Policy governing how travel and out-of-pocket expenses are handled for the surveyor engagement: included in the standard rate, separately reimbursable, subject to a cap, or not applicable for local surveyors.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; Coupa Procurement and Spend Management

attributes.name: turnaround_compliance_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Turnaround Service Level Agreement (SLA) Compliance Rate
attributes.description: Percentage (0.00–100.00) of survey engagements where the surveyor delivered the report within the contracted SLA turnaround hours. Calculated over the trailing 12-month period. Key performance indicator for panel management.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the surveyor master record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture, data lineage tracking, and audit compliance.

domains.name: billing
domains.description: SSOT for all revenue transactions, invoicing, freight audit and payment, payment processing, and accounts receivable across all service lines. Owns customer invoices, carrier payables, COD collections, credit notes, dispute resolution, charge-back management, and revenue recognition aligned to IFRS 15. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA Finance and Coupa for end-to-end procure-to-pay and order-to-cash cycles.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Master billing document issued to customers for logistics services rendered across all service lines (express parcel, freight forwarding, customs brokerage, warehousing, e-commerce fulfillment). Captures invoice header data including invoice number, invoice date, due date, billing period, currency, total amount, tax amount, discount amount, invoice status (draft, issued, sent, partially_paid, paid, overdue, disputed, cancelled, written_off), invoice type (standard, proforma, credit_note, debit_note, consolidated, recurring), payment terms (NET30, NET60, COD, prepaid), IFRS 15 revenue recognition status, SAP S/4HANA document reference, and originating service line. SSOT for all customer-facing billing documents.

attributes.name: agreement_id

The consolidated_invoice product has constituent_invoice_references as a STRING field, but proper normalization requires a FK on invoice poin

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Additional adjustments applied to the invoice. Includes surcharges, fuel adjustment factors (BAF), currency adjustment factors, and other miscellaneous charges or credits.

attributes.name: amount_outstanding

attributes.name: amount_paid

attributes.name: bill_to_address_line1

attributes.name: bill_to_address_line2

attributes.name: bill_to_city
attributes.description: City of the billing party address.

attributes.name: bill_to_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the billing party address. Used for tax jurisdiction determination and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: bill_to_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the party being invoiced. May differ from service recipient in third-party billing scenarios.

attributes.name: bill_to_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the billing party address.

attributes.name: bill_to_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the billing party address.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period covered by this invoice. Relevant for consolidated and recurring invoices that cover a range of services.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period covered by this invoice. Relevant for consolidated and recurring invoices that cover a range of services.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that created this invoice record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: delivery_method

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the invoice. Includes volume discounts, promotional discounts, early payment discounts, and contractual discounts.

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date the customer raised a dispute on this invoice. Used for dispute aging and resolution tracking.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by customer for disputing the invoice. Populated when invoice_status is disputed. Used for dispute resolution and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is expected from the customer. Calculated based on invoice date and payment terms. Used for accounts receivable aging and collections management.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was posted to the general ledger in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Used for financial period closing and accounting reconciliation.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was issued to the customer. Principal business event timestamp for the invoice transaction. Used for revenue recognition, aging analysis, and payment term calculation.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique invoice document number issued to customer. Business identifier for the invoice transaction. Used for customer communication, payment reference, and audit trail.

attributes.name: invoice_status

products.name: billing_account
products.description: Billing account master record defining the billing relationship and financial terms between Transport Shipping and a customer entity. Distinct from the customer identity record (owned by the customer domain), this entity captures billing-specific attributes: billing account number, billing currency, payment terms (NET30, NET60, prepaid, COD), credit limit, credit status (active, suspended, on_hold, blacklisted), billing cycle (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, on-demand), invoice delivery method (email, EDI, portal, post), tax registration number (VAT/GST), tax exemption status, billing address, preferred payment method, dunning profile, and SAP S/4HANA customer account code. SSOT for billing configuration per customer.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing account. Primary key for the billing account entity.

attributes.name: created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system process that created this billing account record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer entity that owns this billing account. Links to the customer master record in the customer domain.

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_cycle. Business justification: Account currently has billing_cycle as STRING. This should be normalized to reference billing.billing_cycle master table. The billing_cycle_id FK allows joining to get cycle configuration (frequency,

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee responsible for managing this billing account relationship, typically a sales or customer success manager for strategic accounts.

attributes.name: parent_billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent billing account if this account is part of a hierarchical billing structure. Used for consolidated invoicing and corporate account management.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_term. Business justification: Account currently has payment_terms as STRING. This should be normalized to reference billing.payment_term master table. The payment_term_id FK allows joining to get code, name, net_days, discount ter

attributes.name: updated_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system process that last modified this billing account record. Used for audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the billing account, typically reflecting the customer legal entity or division name for this billing relationship.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Customer Account Master

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique billing account number used in invoices, statements, and customer communications. This is the business identifier for the billing relationship.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Customer Account Master

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing account. Active accounts can transact and be invoiced. Suspended accounts have temporary restrictions due to payment issues. On-hold accounts are pending review. Closed accounts are terminated. Blacklisted accounts are permanently blocked due to fraud or severe non-compliance.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing account based on customer segment and billing complexity. Corporate accounts typically have negotiated terms, individual accounts are retail customers, government accounts follow public sector procurement rules, and partner accounts are for strategic alliances.

attributes.name: auto_pay_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic payment processing is enabled for this account. When true, invoices are automatically charged to the preferred payment method on the due date.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the billing address where invoices and statements are sent. Typically contains street number and street name.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing address for additional address details such as suite, floor, building, or department name.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City or municipality name for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the billing address. Determines tax jurisdiction and regulatory compliance requirements.

attributes.name: billing_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which this account is billed. All invoices and payments for this account are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code for the billing address. Format varies by country.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region code for the billing address. Format varies by country (e.g., two-letter US state codes, Canadian province codes).

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP business area code representing the service line or division (e.g., express parcel, freight forwarding, contract logistics) for internal P&L (Profit and Loss) reporting.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity within Transport Shipping that owns this billing relationship. Used for financial consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: consolidated_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account participates in consolidated billing where multiple accounts or locations are invoiced together under a master account.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding receivable balance allowed for this billing account before credit hold is triggered. Expressed in the billing currency. Zero or null indicates no credit extended (prepay only).

attributes.name: credit_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent credit review for this account. Credit reviews are performed periodically to assess credit limit adequacy and risk exposure.

attributes.name: credit_status
attributes.description: Current credit approval status for this billing account. Approved accounts have active credit lines. Pending accounts are under credit review. Suspended accounts have temporary credit holds. Revoked accounts have lost credit privileges and must prepay.

attributes.name: dunning_block_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated dunning (collections reminders) is blocked for this account. True when account is in dispute resolution, under special payment arrangement, or managed by dedicated account manager.

attributes.name: dunning_profile
attributes.description: Collections strategy profile defining the escalation sequence and tone for overdue payment reminders. Standard for typical accounts. Aggressive for high-risk accounts. Gentle for strategic customers. VIP for top-tier accounts with relationship managers. Legal for accounts in litigation.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this billing account was closed or terminated. Null for active accounts. Once set, no new transactions can be posted to this account.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this billing account became active and eligible for transactions and invoicing. Marks the beginning of the billing relationship.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Default general ledger account code in the chart of accounts to which revenue from this billing account is posted. Typically an accounts receivable control account.

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Primary method by which invoices are delivered to the customer. Email for electronic PDF delivery. EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) for automated system-to-system transmission. Portal for customer self-service download. Post for physical mail. Fax for legacy customers.

attributes.name: invoice_email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address to which electronic invoices are sent. May differ from the customer contact email if invoices go to accounts payable department.

attributes.name: last_invoice_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent invoice generated for this billing account. Used for billing cycle tracking and customer service inquiries.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment received from this billing account. Used for credit monitoring and collections management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional billing account information, special instructions, payment arrangements, or historical context not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: paperless_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted for paperless billing. When true, all invoices and statements are delivered electronically only, with no postal mail.

attributes.name: preferred_payment_method
attributes.description: Customer preferred payment instrument. ACH (Automated Clearing House) for US bank transfers. Wire transfer for international payments. Credit card for smaller accounts. Check for traditional payment. Direct debit for automated recurring payments.

attributes.name: sap_customer_account_code
attributes.description: Customer account number in SAP S/4HANA Finance system. Used for integration and reconciliation between lakehouse and ERP system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Customer Account Master

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the tax exemption certificate on file, if applicable. Required for audit trail when tax exemption status is exempt or partially exempt.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing account is subject to standard taxation, fully exempt (e.g., government entities, non-profits), or partially exempt for specific service types.

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: Customer tax registration identifier such as VAT (Value Added Tax) number in EU, GST (Goods and Services Tax) number in other jurisdictions, or EIN (Employer Identification Number) in US. Used for tax compliance and invoice generation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing account record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

products.name: tax_schedule
products.description: Reference master defining applicable tax rules, rates, and jurisdictions for logistics billing. Captures tax schedule code, tax type (VAT, GST, WHT, customs duty, excise, service tax), jurisdiction (country, state/province, free trade zone), tax rate percentage, tax basis (freight value, declared value, CIF value, DDP value), applicable service types, exemption categories, effective date, expiry date, regulatory authority reference, and SAP S/4HANA tax condition type. Supports multi-jurisdictional tax compliance for cross-border shipments and ensures correct tax calculation on customer invoices.

attributes.name: tax_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax schedule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: tax_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.tax_account. Business justification: Tax schedules define rates and jurisdictions that map to specific GL tax accounts. Finance tax reporting, VAT returns, and customs duty filings require linking tax accounts to the billing tax schedule

attributes.name: applicable_service_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of service types to which this tax schedule applies (e.g., express_parcel, air_freight, ocean_freight, road_freight, rail_freight, warehousing, customs_brokerage, last_mile_delivery).
attributes.references: IATA (International Air Transport Association), IMO (International Maritime Organization)

attributes.name: compound_tax_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax is calculated on top of other taxes (compound/cascading tax). True if compound tax applies, False if calculated on base amount only.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code in which the minimum and maximum taxable amounts are denominated.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the goods destination, relevant for destination-based tax calculations. Nullable if not destination-dependent.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this tax schedule becomes active and applicable to transactions. Must be on or before the transaction date for the schedule to apply.

attributes.name: exemption_category
attributes.description: Category or code identifying the type of tax exemption that may apply (e.g., diplomatic, humanitarian, re-export, AEO certified, C-TPAT certified). Nullable if no exemption applies.
attributes.references: WCO (World Customs Organization), C-TPAT (Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism), AEO (Authorized Economic Operator)

attributes.name: exemption_certificate_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tax exemption certificate must be provided to apply this schedule. True if certificate is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this tax schedule ceases to be applicable. Nullable for schedules with indefinite validity.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code to which tax amounts calculated using this schedule are posted in the financial system.
attributes.references: IFRS, SAP S/4HANA Finance, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: hs_code_range_end
attributes.description: Ending HS Code in the range of commodity codes to which this tax schedule applies. Nullable if not commodity-specific.

attributes.name: hs_code_range_start
attributes.description: Starting HS Code in the range of commodity codes to which this tax schedule applies. Nullable if not commodity-specific.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the tax jurisdiction country where this tax schedule applies.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional subdivision within the country where this tax schedule applies. Nullable for country-level taxes.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_zone_type
attributes.description: Type of economic or customs zone. FTZ (Free Trade Zone), ICD (Inland Container Depot), CFS (Container Freight Station), or special economic zone with distinct tax treatment.
attributes.references: WCO (World Customs Organization), FMC (Federal Maritime Commission)

attributes.name: maximum_taxable_amount
attributes.description: Maximum transaction amount threshold above which this tax schedule does not apply or a different schedule takes effect. Nullable if no maximum threshold exists.

attributes.name: minimum_taxable_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transaction amount threshold below which this tax schedule does not apply. Nullable if no minimum threshold exists.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special instructions, or clarifications regarding the application of this tax schedule.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the goods origin, relevant for preferential tax treatment under trade agreements. Nullable if not origin-dependent.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, WCO Rules of Origin

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank used to determine precedence when multiple tax schedules could apply to the same transaction. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government or regulatory body that mandates this tax schedule (e.g., IRS, HMRC, GST Council, Customs Authority).
attributes.references: WCO (World Customs Organization), Local Tax Authority

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: Official reference number, gazette notification, or legal citation from the regulatory authority that establishes this tax schedule.

attributes.name: reverse_charge_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether reverse charge mechanism applies, where the recipient of goods or services is responsible for tax payment instead of the supplier. True if reverse charge applies, False otherwise.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive, Local Tax Authority Regulations

attributes.name: sap_tax_code
attributes.description: SAP tax code identifier used in SAP S/4HANA for GL posting and tax reporting. Links to SAP tax determination logic.

attributes.name: sap_tax_condition_type
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA tax condition type code used for integration with the financial system. Maps this tax schedule to SAP pricing and billing configuration.

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the tax schedule used in billing and invoicing systems. Externally known reference code.

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the tax schedule for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: tax_basis
attributes.description: The valuation basis on which the tax is calculated. CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid), FOB (Free on Board), EXW (Ex Works), or other Incoterms-based valuation.

attributes.name: tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The applicable tax rate expressed as a percentage (e.g., 15.0000 for 15%). Supports up to four decimal places for precision in multi-jurisdictional tax calculations.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_category
attributes.description: Category used for grouping tax amounts in statutory tax returns and regulatory reports (e.g., domestic sales, export sales, import duties, inter-state supplies).
attributes.references: IFRS 15, Local Tax Authority Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: tax_schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax schedule. Active schedules are in use, inactive are retired, pending are awaiting approval, superseded have been replaced by newer schedules.

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax applied. VAT (Value Added Tax), GST (Goods and Services Tax), WHT (Withholding Tax), customs duty, excise tax, or service tax.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 (Revenue from Contracts with Customers), WCO (World Customs Organization), WTO (World Trade Organization)

attributes.name: trade_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the bilateral or multilateral trade agreement under which preferential tax rates or exemptions apply (e.g., USMCA, EU-UK TCA, RCEP). Nullable if no trade agreement applies.
attributes.references: WTO (World Trade Organization), Regional Trade Agreements

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last updated this tax schedule record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax schedule record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule represents a withholding tax that must be deducted at source. True if withholding tax applies, False otherwise.
attributes.references: OECD Model Tax Convention, Local Tax Authority Regulations

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this tax schedule record in the system.

products.name: payment_term
products.description: Reference master defining standard payment terms offered to customers and applied to carrier payables. Captures payment term code, payment term description (NET30, NET60, NET90, COD, prepaid, 2/10 NET30), number of days, early payment discount percentage, early payment discount days, late payment penalty rate, applicable customer segments, applicable service lines, currency restrictions, and SAP S/4HANA payment term key. Provides standardized payment term taxonomy used across invoice issuance, contract agreements, and carrier payable management.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment term. Primary key.

attributes.name: applicable_customer_segments
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of customer segments to which this payment term is applicable (e.g., enterprise, SMB, government, retail). Used to enforce eligibility rules during contract setup and invoicing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: enterprise|smb|government|retail|ecommerce|3pl|freight_forwarder — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: applicable_service_lines
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of service lines to which this payment term applies (e.g., express_parcel, freight_forwarding, warehousing, customs_brokerage, ecommerce_fulfillment). Ensures payment terms align with service-specific billing policies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: express_parcel|freight_forwarding|warehousing|customs_brokerage|ecommerce_fulfillment|contract_logistics|last_mile — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the finance manager or credit manager who approved this payment term for use. Null if approval is not required or pending. Supports governance and compliance.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment term was approved for use. Null if approval is not required or pending. Supports governance and compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: auto_dunning_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated dunning (collections reminder) processes are enabled for invoices using this payment term. True for standard credit terms. False for prepaid or special arrangement terms.

attributes.name: cod_collection_method
attributes.description: Specifies the acceptable payment collection method for COD (Cash on Delivery) terms. Applicable only when type is cash_on_delivery. Not_applicable for non-COD terms.

attributes.name: coupa_payment_term_code
attributes.description: Payment term code used in Coupa Procurement and Spend Management system for carrier payables and supplier invoice processing. Ensures alignment between customer receivables and carrier payables payment terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment term record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_restrictions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 4217 three-letter currency codes for which this payment term is valid (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null or empty if the term applies to all currencies. Used to enforce currency-specific payment policies.

attributes.name: default_for_customer_segment
attributes.description: Customer segment for which this payment term is the default option during contract setup or customer onboarding. Null if not a default term. Streamlines contract creation workflows.

attributes.name: default_for_service_line
attributes.description: Service line for which this payment term is the default option during contract setup or service agreement creation. Null if not a default term. Ensures service-specific billing alignment.

attributes.name: dunning_start_days_after_due
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dunning Start Days After Due Date
attributes.description: Number of days after the invoice due date when automated dunning (collections reminder) process begins. Null if auto_dunning_enabled_flag is false.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which payment must be made to qualify for the early payment discount (e.g., 10 for 2/10 NET30 terms). Null if no early payment discount applies.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered if payment is made within the early payment discount period (e.g., 2.00 for 2% discount in 2/10 NET30 terms). Null if no early payment discount applies.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this payment term is no longer valid for new contracts or invoices. Null for open-ended terms. Used to phase out deprecated payment terms while preserving historical data.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this payment term becomes valid and available for use in contracts and invoicing. Supports time-based payment term changes and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code in SAP S/4HANA Finance to which revenue or payables using this payment term are posted. Supports financial reporting and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of additional days after the net due date before late payment penalties are applied. Provides a buffer period for customers. Zero or null if no grace period is offered.

attributes.name: installment_count
attributes.description: Number of installment payments allowed under this payment term. Applicable for installment-based payment terms. Null or 1 for single-payment terms.

attributes.name: installment_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between each installment payment. Applicable for installment-based payment terms. Null for single-payment terms.

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_rate
attributes.description: Percentage penalty or interest rate applied to overdue balances after the net payment due date. Expressed as an annual percentage rate (APR) or per-period rate. Null if no late payment penalty applies.

attributes.name: maximum_credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding accounts receivable balance allowed for customers using this payment term. Enforces credit exposure limits. Null if no limit applies (e.g., for prepaid or COD terms).

attributes.name: minimum_credit_score_required
attributes.description: Minimum credit risk score a customer must have to be eligible for this payment term. Used to enforce credit policy and reduce bad debt risk. Null if no minimum score is required.

attributes.name: net_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date by which full payment is due. Standard payment window for the term (e.g., 30 for NET30, 60 for NET60). Zero for immediate payment terms like COD or PREPAID.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or exceptions related to this payment term. Used by finance and credit teams for context and clarification.

attributes.name: payment_term_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the payment term (e.g., NET30, NET60, NET90, COD, PREPAID, 2_10_NET30). Used as the business identifier across invoicing, contracts, and carrier payable management.

attributes.name: payment_term_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the payment term, including conditions, discount eligibility, and any special instructions. Provides clarity for finance teams and customers.

attributes.name: payment_term_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the payment term (e.g., Net 30 Days, Cash on Delivery, Prepaid, 2% 10 Net 30). Human-readable label used in customer-facing documents and internal reports.

attributes.name: payment_term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment term. Active terms are available for use in new contracts and invoices. Inactive or deprecated terms are retained for historical reference but not available for new transactions.

attributes.name: payment_term_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment term based on its structure and purpose. Determines how the term is applied in billing and collections workflows.

attributes.name: prepayment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether full payment must be received before service delivery or shipment. True for prepaid terms. False for post-service payment terms.

attributes.name: requires_credit_approval_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assignment of this payment term to a customer requires credit manager approval. True for extended terms (e.g., NET90) or high-risk terms. False for standard or prepaid terms.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Specifies the IFRS 15 revenue recognition method associated with this payment term. Point_in_time for immediate recognition (e.g., COD, prepaid). Over_time or deferred for extended terms. Guides accounting treatment.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: sap_payment_term_key
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric key used in SAP S/4HANA Finance to represent this payment term. Enables seamless integration with SAP AR, AP, and revenue recognition modules.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last updated this payment term record. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment term record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Total number of active customer accounts, contracts, or invoices currently using this payment term. Provides insight into term popularity and impact of changes. Updated periodically via batch process.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this payment term record in the system. Supports audit trail and accountability.

products.name: dunning_record
products.description: Dunning and collections activity record tracking the systematic follow-up process for overdue customer invoices. Captures dunning reference, billing account reference, overdue invoice references, total overdue amount, dunning level (1st reminder, 2nd reminder, final notice, legal notice, collections referral), dunning date, communication channel (email, letter, phone, EDI), response received flag, customer response type (payment promise, dispute raised, no response), promised payment date, promised payment amount, escalation flag, collections agency referral date, and write-off recommendation flag. Supports DSO reduction and bad debt management.

attributes.name: dunning_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dunning and collections activity record.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer billing account subject to dunning activity.

attributes.name: billing_dispute_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dispute case if the customer raised a dispute in response to the dunning notice.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal collections specialist or team member assigned to this dunning case.

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to a payment plan arrangement established as a result of this dunning action.

attributes.name: receivable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.receivable. Business justification: Dunning activities are collections follow-up for overdue receivables. Each dunning record targets a specific receivable balance for a customer. One receivable can have multiple dunning records as esca

attributes.name: recipient_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact. Business justification: Dunning communications are sent to specific customer contacts. Tracking the recipient contact enables follow-up, communication history tracking, and escalation workflows. Removes denormalized recipien

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit or division responsible for this dunning activity.

attributes.name: collections_agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the external collections agency to which the account was referred.

attributes.name: collections_agency_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the overdue account has been referred to an external collections agency.

attributes.name: collections_referral_date
attributes.description: Date when the account was referred to the external collections agency.

attributes.name: communication_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the dunning notice was communicated to the customer.

attributes.name: communication_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the dunning communication was sent to the customer.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity or company code within the enterprise responsible for this dunning action.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this dunning record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the overdue amount.

attributes.name: customer_response_type
attributes.description: Classification of the customer's response to the dunning notice.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of days the oldest invoice has been overdue at the time of dunning action.

attributes.name: dunning_date
attributes.description: Date when the dunning action was initiated or the reminder was sent to the customer.

attributes.name: dunning_fee_amount
attributes.description: Additional fee charged to the customer for the dunning and collection activity.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Escalation level of the dunning process indicating the severity and stage of collection activity.

attributes.name: dunning_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number for this dunning action, used for tracking and customer communication.

attributes.name: dunning_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dunning record indicating the state of the collection activity.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the dunning case was escalated to the next level or external collections.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dunning record has been escalated to a higher collection level or external agency.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for tracking dunning-related financial activity.

attributes.name: interest_charge_amount
attributes.description: Late payment interest charges applied to the overdue amount.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, customer interactions, or special circumstances related to this dunning action.

attributes.name: oldest_invoice_date
attributes.description: Date of the oldest unpaid invoice included in this dunning action, used to calculate aging.

attributes.name: promised_payment_amount
attributes.description: Amount the customer has committed to pay in response to the dunning notice.

attributes.name: promised_payment_date
attributes.description: Date by which the customer has committed to make payment.

attributes.name: response_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer responded to the dunning notice.

attributes.name: response_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has responded to the dunning notice.

attributes.name: sap_dunning_run_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP S/4HANA Finance dunning run that generated this dunning record.

attributes.name: service_line
attributes.description: Primary service line associated with the overdue invoices in this dunning action. products.name: dunning_invoice_coverage
products.description: This association product represents the inclusion of specific invoices in dunning and collections activity events. It captures which overdue invoices were included in each dunning action, at what escalation level, with what customer response, and what the invoice status was at the time of dunning. Each record links one dunning_record to one invoice with attributes that exist only in the context of this dunning event coverage.. Existence Justification: In logistics billing operations, dunning is performed at the account level, meaning one dunning action covers ALL overdue invoices for a customer at that point in time. Conversely, a single invoice can be included in multiple dunning cycles over time as it remains unpaid and escalates through dunning levels (1st reminder, 2nd reminder, final notice, legal notice, collections referral). The collections team actively manages which invoices are in which dunning cycles, tracking invoice-specific responses, amounts, and escalation levels.

Enables contract-specific resource allocation, as

attributes.name: assignment_reason

attributes.name: assignment_status

attributes.name: assignment_type

attributes.name: business_title

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: customs_broker_license_required_flag

attributes.name: default_expense_cost_center

attributes.name: dot_safety_sensitive_flag

attributes.name: driver_qualification_required_flag

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: fte_percentage

attributes.name: hazmat_certification_required_flag

attributes.name: job_family

attributes.name: job_level

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation grade or band assigned to this position, defining the salary range and benefits eligibility. Business-confidential for compensation planning.

attributes.name: pay_rate_type

attributes.name: probation_end_date

attributes.name: remote_work_eligible_flag

attributes.name: scheduled_weekly_hours

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: succession_plan_flag

attributes.name: travel_requirement_percentage

attributes.name: union_code

attributes.name: work_shift
attributes.description: Designated shift pattern for this assignment (e.g., Day Shift, Night Shift, Rotating, Split Shift) used for warehouse and fleet operations scheduling.

attributes.name: worker_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the worker type for this assignment (e.g., Employee, Contingent Worker, Contractor, Consultant) used for workforce segmentation and reporting.

attributes.name: payroll_record_id

attributes.name: compensation_plan_id

This provides auditability and ensures payroll amounts can be reconciled to approved compe

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee for whom this payroll record was generated. Links to the employee master data.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id

attributes.name: payroll_run_id

attributes.name: payroll_supplier_id

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: Total allowances paid, including transportation, housing, meal, mobile, or other employee allowances.

attributes.name: base_salary_amount
attributes.description: The regular base salary or wage component of gross pay for the pay period.

attributes.name: benefit_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Total employee-paid benefit deductions including health insurance, dental, vision, life insurance, and retirement contributions.

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Total bonus payments included in this payroll record, such as performance bonuses, retention bonuses, or spot awards.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Total commission earnings for sales or performance-based roles during the pay period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll record.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The department or business unit to which the employee belongs for organizational reporting.

attributes.name: employer_benefit_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Total employer contributions to employee benefits including retirement matching, health insurance subsidies, and other employer-paid benefits.

attributes.name: employer_tax_amount
attributes.description: Total employer-paid payroll taxes including employer portion of social security, medicare, unemployment, and other statutory taxes.

attributes.name: federal_tax_amount
attributes.description: Federal income tax withheld from gross pay for the pay period.

attributes.name: garnishment_amount
attributes.description: Total wage garnishments for child support, tax levies, or court-ordered deductions.

attributes.name: gross_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total gross earnings before any deductions, including base salary, overtime, bonuses, and allowances.

attributes.name: health_insurance_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Employee-paid portion of health insurance premiums deducted from gross pay.

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: The job classification or role code of the employee during the pay period, used for labor analytics and compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: local_tax_amount
attributes.description: Local or municipal income tax withheld from gross pay for the pay period.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: The work location or facility code where the employee performed work during the pay period.

attributes.name: medicare_tax_amount
attributes.description: Medicare tax withheld from gross pay for the pay period.

attributes.name: net_pay_amount
attributes.description: Final take-home pay after all deductions, representing the amount paid to the employee.

attributes.name: other_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Miscellaneous deductions not categorized elsewhere, such as union dues, loan repayments, or voluntary contributions.

attributes.name: overtime_amount
attributes.description: Total overtime pay earned during the pay period, including standard and premium overtime rates.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total number of overtime hours worked during the pay period.

attributes.name: pay_date
attributes.description: The date on which payment was issued or scheduled to be issued to the employee.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employee is paid (e.g., weekly, biweekly, monthly).

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the pay period covered by this payroll record.

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the pay period covered by this payroll record.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which net pay is disbursed to the employee.

attributes.name: payroll_approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the payroll administrator who approved this payroll record for payment.

attributes.name: payroll_approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll record was approved for payment.

attributes.name: payroll_processed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll record was calculated and finalized in the payroll system.

attributes.name: payroll_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the payroll record in the payroll lifecycle.

attributes.name: pto_hours_used
attributes.description: Number of paid time off hours taken during the pay period, including vacation, sick leave, and personal days.

attributes.name: pto_payout_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of PTO hours paid out during the pay period, either as part of regular pay or upon termination.

attributes.name: regular_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of regular (non-overtime) hours worked during the pay period.

attributes.name: retirement_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Employee contribution to retirement plans such as 401(k), 403(b), or pension plans.

attributes.name: shift_differential_amount
attributes.description: Additional pay for working non-standard shifts (night shift, weekend shift) in warehouse or freight operations.

attributes.name: social_security_tax_amount
attributes.description: Social security tax (FICA) withheld from gross pay for the pay period.

attributes.name: state_tax_amount
attributes.description: State income tax withheld from gross pay for the pay period.

attributes.name: tax_withholding_amount
attributes.description: Total tax withholdings including federal, state, local, and social security taxes.

attributes.name: total_deductions_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all deductions from gross pay, including taxes, benefits, garnishments, and other withholdings.

attributes.name: total_labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: Fully-loaded labor cost including gross pay, employer taxes, and employer benefit contributions for cost allocation and P&L reporting.

attributes.name: compensation_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the compensation plan record. Primary key.

Linking enables sustainability-linked compensation administration, carbon credit allocation to employee performance,

attributes.name: tertiary_compensation_modified_by_user_employee_id

attributes.name: commission_eligible_flag

attributes.name: commission_rate_percentage

attributes.name: compensation_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the compensation plan assignment. Active plans are in effect; inactive/terminated plans are historical.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: flsa_classification

attributes.name: grade_band

attributes.name: job_code

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: mileage_reimbursement_rate
attributes.description: Reimbursement rate per mile or kilometer for drivers using personal vehicles or for mileage-based compensation. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: overtime_rate_multiplier
