attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency of payroll disbursement for this plan: weekly, biweekly (every two weeks), semimonthly (twice per month), or monthly.

attributes.name: pay_range_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum compensation amount for the grade band or plan. Ceiling for the role without promotion.

attributes.name: pay_range_midpoint
attributes.description: Midpoint compensation amount for the grade band or plan. Target for fully competent performance in role.

attributes.name: pay_range_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum compensation amount for the grade band or plan. Used for pay equity analysis and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: per_diem_amount
attributes.description: Daily allowance for meals and incidental expenses during business travel. Common for drivers and field staff. Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) Per Diem Rates

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the compensation plan structure. Externally-known unique code used in payroll and HR systems.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the compensation plan (e.g., 'Driver Base + Mileage', 'Warehouse Hourly Shift', 'Executive Salary Band 5').

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the compensation structure: salary (fixed annual), hourly (time-based), commission (performance-based), piece_rate (per-unit), or hybrid (combination).

attributes.name: reason_for_change
attributes.description: Business justification for creating or modifying this compensation plan (e.g., 'Annual merit increase', 'Promotion to supervisor', 'Market adjustment').

attributes.name: retirement_contribution_percentage
attributes.description: Employer contribution to retirement plan as a percentage of base salary (e.g., 5.00 for 5% match). Null if no employer contribution.

attributes.name: shift_differential_amount
attributes.description: Additional hourly pay for non-standard shifts (e.g., night shift, weekend shift). Null if no differential applies.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system of record for this compensation plan (e.g., 'WORKDAY_HCM', 'SAP_HR'). Used for data lineage and integration.

attributes.name: stock_option_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for equity compensation (stock options, RSUs) under this plan. True if eligible, False otherwise.

attributes.name: target_bonus_percentage
attributes.description: Target annual bonus as a percentage of base salary (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). Null if not bonus-eligible.

attributes.name: union_affiliation_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union affiliation for this compensation plan. Null for non-union employees. Used for collective bargaining agreement (CBA) compliance.

products.name: benefit_enrollment
products.description: Records of employee enrollment in benefit programs including health insurance, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement plans (401k/pension), and employee assistance programs. Captures enrollment dates, coverage tier, dependent details, contribution amounts, and benefit plan type. Sourced from Workday HCM Benefits.

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit enrollment record. Primary key for the benefit enrollment entity.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit plan in which the employee is enrolled. Links to the benefit plan master record.

attributes.name: benefits_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Benefits administered by third-party suppliers (insurance carriers, benefits administrators, wellness program providers). Enables benefits supplier tracking, vendor-specific enrollment management, ben

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee enrolling in the benefit program. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: annual_election_amount
attributes.description: Total annual amount elected by the employee for contribution-based benefits such as Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) or Health Savings Accounts (HSA). Represents the employees annual commitment for the plan year.

attributes.name: beneficiary_designation
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the primary beneficiary designated to receive benefits in the event of employee death. Applicable to life insurance and retirement plans. May contain multiple beneficiaries with percentage allocations.

attributes.name: benefit_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the benefit program type. Health includes medical insurance; dental includes dental insurance; vision includes vision insurance; life insurance includes basic and supplemental life coverage; disability includes short-term and long-term disability; retirement includes 401k and pension plans; flexible spending includes FSA and HSA accounts; employee assistance includes EAP programs; wellness includes gym memberships and wellness programs; supplemental includes additional voluntary benefits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: health|dental|vision|life_insurance|disability|retirement|flexible_spending|employee_assistance|wellness|supplemental — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: carrier_confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit carrier confirmed receipt and acceptance of the enrollment. Null if carrier has not yet confirmed. Used for reconciliation and issue resolution.

attributes.name: carrier_group_number
attributes.description: Group policy number assigned by the benefit carrier to identify the employer group plan. All employees under the same plan share this group number. Used for carrier billing and administration.

attributes.name: carrier_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy or member identification number assigned by the benefit carrier or insurance provider. Used for claims processing, provider verification, and coordination of benefits. Format varies by carrier.

attributes.name: carrier_submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment was transmitted to the benefit carrier for processing. Used to track enrollment processing timelines and ensure timely coverage activation.

attributes.name: cobra_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage upon termination of employment. True for health, dental, and vision plans; false for life insurance and retirement plans. Determined by plan type and company size.

attributes.name: cobra_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) End Date
attributes.description: Date when COBRA continuation coverage ends. Typically 18 months after start date for termination events, 36 months for certain qualifying events. Null for active COBRA enrollments.

attributes.name: cobra_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Start Date
attributes.description: Date when COBRA continuation coverage begins following a qualifying event such as termination of employment. Null for active employees. Typically the day after employment termination or loss of eligibility.

attributes.name: contribution_basis
attributes.description: Tax treatment of employee contributions. Pre-tax indicates contributions reduce taxable income (Section 125 plans); post-tax indicates contributions are made with after-tax dollars; employer paid indicates no employee contribution required.

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which employee and employer contributions are deducted and remitted. Aligns with company payroll schedule. Weekly indicates 52 pay periods; biweekly indicates 26 pay periods; semimonthly indicates 24 pay periods; monthly indicates 12 pay periods; annual indicates single annual payment.

attributes.name: coverage_amount
attributes.description: Face value or benefit amount of the coverage for life insurance and disability plans. Represents the maximum benefit payable. For health plans, may represent out-of-pocket maximum or deductible amount. Null for plans without defined coverage amounts.

attributes.name: coverage_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit coverage begins and the employee is eligible to use the benefit. Typically the first day of the month following enrollment or the hire date for new employees.

attributes.name: coverage_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit coverage ends. Null for active enrollments. Populated upon termination, cancellation, or when employee opts out during open enrollment.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Level of coverage elected by the employee. Employee only covers the employee; employee spouse covers employee and spouse or domestic partner; employee children covers employee and dependent children; employee family covers employee, spouse, and dependent children.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was first created in Workday HCM Benefits system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount the employee must pay out-of-pocket before insurance coverage begins paying claims. Applicable to health, dental, and vision plans. Amount varies by coverage tier and plan design.

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of dependents covered under this enrollment. Zero for employee-only coverage. Used for premium calculation and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Amount the employee contributes per pay period toward the benefit premium or plan cost. Deducted from employee paycheck on a pre-tax or post-tax basis depending on plan type.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Amount the employer contributes per pay period toward the benefit premium or plan cost. Represents company subsidy of employee benefit coverage.

attributes.name: enrollment_confirmation_sent_date
attributes.description: Date when enrollment confirmation documentation was sent to the employee. Used for compliance tracking and audit trail. Confirmation includes coverage details, premium amounts, and effective dates.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee submitted the enrollment election. May differ from coverage effective date due to waiting periods or enrollment processing time.

attributes.name: enrollment_method
attributes.description: Channel through which the employee completed the benefit enrollment. Online self service indicates Workday portal; HR representative indicates assisted enrollment; benefits fair indicates enrollment at company event; phone indicates call center enrollment; paper form indicates manual form submission; auto enrollment indicates system-generated default enrollment.

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique enrollment reference number generated by Workday HCM Benefits module. Used for tracking and communication with employees and benefit providers.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit enrollment. Active indicates coverage is in effect; pending indicates awaiting approval or effective date; terminated indicates coverage has ended; suspended indicates temporary hold; waived indicates employee declined coverage; cancelled indicates enrollment was voided.

attributes.name: enrollment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the enrollment event that triggered this benefit enrollment. New hire indicates initial enrollment upon joining; annual open indicates enrollment during open enrollment period; qualifying life event indicates enrollment due to marriage, birth, adoption, or other qualifying event; mid year change indicates voluntary change outside open enrollment; rehire indicates enrollment upon return to company; status change indicates enrollment due to FTE or role change.

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee must provide medical evidence of insurability for coverage approval. True for supplemental life insurance above guaranteed issue amounts or late enrollments; false for standard enrollments within guaranteed issue limits.

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_status
attributes.description: Current status of evidence of insurability review by the insurance carrier. Not required indicates no EOI needed; pending indicates under carrier review; approved indicates coverage approved; denied indicates coverage denied due to health conditions.

attributes.name: hsa_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this health plan enrollment qualifies the employee for a Health Savings Account. True for high-deductible health plans (HDHP) meeting IRS requirements; false for traditional health plans.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was last updated in Workday HCM Benefits system. Captures any changes to enrollment status, contribution amounts, coverage tier, or other enrollment attributes.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum amount the employee will pay in a plan year for covered services. Once reached, the plan pays 100% of covered expenses. Applicable to health plans. Required disclosure under Affordable Care Act (ACA).

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: Calendar year or fiscal year for which this enrollment is effective. Used for annual benefit plan administration, open enrollment tracking, and compliance reporting. Format YYYY.

attributes.name: qualifying_event_date
attributes.description: Date when the qualifying life event occurred. Used to validate enrollment timing and compliance with 30-day or 60-day election windows required by IRS and HIPAA regulations. Null for non-QLE enrollments.

attributes.name: qualifying_event_type
attributes.description: Type of qualifying life event that permitted mid-year enrollment change outside of open enrollment period. Marriage, divorce, birth, adoption, death of dependent, loss of other coverage, or change in employment status. Null for enrollments during open enrollment or new hire periods. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marriage|divorce|birth|adoption|death|loss_of_coverage|employment_change — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this enrollment record originated. Typically Workday HCM Benefits module. Used for data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this enrollment record in the source system (Workday HCM). Used for reconciliation, data synchronization, and traceability back to the operational system of record.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for termination of benefit enrollment. Employment termination indicates employee left company; employee waiver indicates employee opted out; plan discontinuation indicates employer ended plan; ineligibility indicates employee no longer meets eligibility criteria; non-payment indicates failure to pay premiums; COBRA expiration indicates end of continuation coverage period. Null for active enrollments.

attributes.name: tobacco_user_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is a tobacco user. Used for premium rating and wellness program eligibility. True indicates tobacco use; false indicates non-tobacco user. Self-reported by employee during enrollment.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by employee for declining or waiving benefit coverage. Covered elsewhere indicates coverage through spouse or other source; cost indicates employee cannot afford premium; not needed indicates employee does not require coverage; other indicates alternative reason. Null for active enrollments.

attributes.name: wellness_program_participant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is enrolled in the company wellness program associated with this benefit. True indicates active participation; false indicates not enrolled. May affect premium rates or provide incentive credits.

products.name: driver_qualification
products.description: DOT-compliant driver qualification records for all commercial vehicle operators, capturing CDL class, endorsements (hazmat, tanker, doubles/triples), medical examiner certificate, MVR review status, drug and alcohol testing compliance, hours-of-service eligibility, and qualification expiry dates. Critical for DOT FMCSA compliance and operational dispatch eligibility. Supports fleet and last-mile delivery domains.

attributes.name: driver_qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the driver qualification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record in the workforce system. Links this qualification record to the driver's core HR profile.

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.fuel_consumption_record. Business justification: Driver qualification and training directly impact fuel efficiency. Linking enables eco-driving performance analysis, driver-level emissions KPIs, and targeted training for high-consumption drivers in

attributes.name: alcohol_test_last_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent alcohol test administered to the driver. Testing is required post-accident, reasonable suspicion, and return-to-duty.

attributes.name: alcohol_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the most recent alcohol test. A positive result (BAC 0.04% or higher) or refusal disqualifies the driver.

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent background check conducted on the driver, including criminal history and employment verification.

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Result of the most recent background check. Certain criminal offenses disqualify drivers from operating commercial vehicles.

attributes.name: cdl_class
attributes.description: The class of CDL held by the driver, determining the types of vehicles they are authorized to operate. Class A for combination vehicles, Class B for heavy straight vehicles, Class C for vehicles carrying hazardous materials or 16+ passengers.

attributes.name: cdl_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date the CDL expires and must be renewed. Critical for maintaining operational dispatch eligibility.

attributes.name: cdl_issue_date
attributes.description: Date the current CDL was issued by the licensing authority.

attributes.name: cdl_number
attributes.description: The unique CDL number issued by the state licensing authority. Required for all commercial vehicle operators.

attributes.name: cdl_state_issued
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the CDL was issued. Drivers may only hold one CDL at a time per federal law.

attributes.name: clearinghouse_query_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug and Alcohol Clearinghouse Query Date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent query to the FMCSA Drug and Alcohol Clearinghouse. Employers must conduct pre-employment queries and annual queries for all CDL drivers.

attributes.name: clearinghouse_status
attributes.description: Current status in the FMCSA Drug and Alcohol Clearinghouse. Indicates whether any drug or alcohol violations are on record that would prohibit the driver from performing safety-sensitive functions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this qualification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: disqualification_end_date
attributes.description: Date the disqualification period ends and the driver may be eligible for reinstatement, if applicable. Null for permanent disqualifications.

attributes.name: disqualification_reason
attributes.description: Detailed reason if the driver is disqualified from operating commercial vehicles. Includes regulatory citation and specific violation or condition.

attributes.name: disqualification_start_date
attributes.description: Date the disqualification period began, if applicable.

attributes.name: drug_test_last_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent drug test administered to the driver. FMCSA requires pre-employment, random, post-accident, reasonable suspicion, and return-to-duty testing.

attributes.name: drug_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the most recent drug test. A positive result or refusal to test disqualifies the driver from safety-sensitive functions.

attributes.name: endorsement_doubles_triples
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver holds a valid doubles/triples endorsement (T) for towing multiple trailers.

attributes.name: endorsement_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver holds a valid HAZMAT endorsement (H) allowing transport of hazardous materials as defined by IMDG and DOT regulations.
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA 49 CFR Part 383.93, IMDG Code

attributes.name: endorsement_passenger
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver holds a valid passenger endorsement (P) for operating vehicles designed to transport 16 or more passengers.

attributes.name: endorsement_tanker
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver holds a valid tanker endorsement (N) for operating tank vehicles.

attributes.name: hos_eligibility_status
attributes.description: Current eligibility status for dispatch based on Hours of Service compliance. Indicates whether the driver has available hours under 11-hour driving and 14-hour on-duty limits.

attributes.name: hos_violation_count_12m
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hours of Service (HOS) Violation Count (12 Months)
attributes.description: Number of HOS violations recorded in the past 12 months. Used for compliance monitoring and driver performance evaluation.

attributes.name: medical_certificate_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date the medical examiner's certificate expires. Drivers must maintain a current medical certificate to remain qualified. Typically valid for 12-24 months.

attributes.name: medical_certificate_issue_date
attributes.description: Date the medical examiner's certificate was issued following the driver's physical examination.

attributes.name: medical_certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the driver's medical examiner's certificate issued by a certified medical examiner on the National Registry.

attributes.name: medical_examiner_name
attributes.description: Name of the certified medical examiner who performed the physical examination and issued the certificate.

attributes.name: medical_examiner_registry_number
attributes.description: The unique registry number of the medical examiner on the FMCSA National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners.

attributes.name: medical_variance_exemption
attributes.description: Type of medical variance or exemption granted by FMCSA if the driver does not meet standard physical qualification requirements but has been granted an exemption.

attributes.name: mvr_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent Motor Vehicle Record review conducted by the employer. FMCSA requires annual MVR reviews for all drivers.

attributes.name: mvr_status
attributes.description: Current status of the driver's MVR based on the most recent review. Indicates whether any violations or disqualifying offenses are present.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next comprehensive qualification review. Used for proactive compliance management and renewal planning.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding the driver's qualification status, special conditions, accommodations, or compliance actions. Used for internal tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: qualification_file_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver's qualification file contains all required documents per FMCSA regulations (application, MVR, medical certificate, road test, etc.).

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the driver's qualification. Determines dispatch eligibility and compliance standing.

attributes.name: road_test_date
attributes.description: Date the driver successfully completed the employer's road test demonstrating ability to operate the type of commercial vehicle they will drive.

attributes.name: road_test_examiner
attributes.description: Name of the qualified examiner who administered and certified the driver's road test.

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date the driver completed Entry-Level Driver Training requirements for their CDL class and endorsements, if applicable.

attributes.name: training_provider
attributes.description: Name of the FMCSA-registered training provider that delivered the Entry-Level Driver Training.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last updated this qualification record. Supports compliance audit and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this qualification record was last modified. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

Mandatory under DOT FMCSA 49 CFR Part 395 for all CMV operators. Feeds driver dispatch eligibility checks and supports DOT audit compliance. Integrates with fleet telematics and GPS systems.

attributes.name: hours_of_service_log_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hours of service log record. Primary key for the HOS log entry.

attributes.name: fatigue_risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.fatigue_risk_assessment. Business justification: Fatigue risk assessments analyze HOS log patterns to verify compliance and identify fatigue trends. DOT regulations require correlation between duty hours and fatigue assessments. Enables automated fl

attributes.name: primary_hours_driver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commercial driver employee who generated this HOS record. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: tertiary_hours_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user (driver or supervisor) who made edits to this log entry. Required for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commercial motor vehicle operated during this duty period. Links to the fleet vehicle master record.

attributes.name: annotation_text
attributes.description: Free-text annotation or comment added by the driver to explain special circumstances, duty status changes, or other relevant information for this log entry.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: The certification status of this HOS log. Certified: driver has reviewed and certified the log as accurate. Uncertified: log has not been certified by driver. Rejected: log was rejected by driver or supervisor. Pending: awaiting driver certification.

attributes.name: certification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the driver certified this HOS log as accurate and complete. Required within 13 days of the log date per DOT regulations.

attributes.name: cycle_hours_accumulated
attributes.description: Cumulative on-duty hours for the current 7-day or 8-day cycle. Used to enforce the 60-hour/7-day or 70-hour/8-day limits per DOT regulations.

attributes.name: cycle_type
attributes.description: The regulatory cycle the driver is operating under. 60-hour/7-day cycle for drivers who do not operate every day of the week. 70-hour/8-day cycle for drivers who operate every day of the week.

attributes.name: dispatch_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver is eligible for new dispatch assignments based on current HOS status. True if eligible, False if driver has insufficient hours remaining.

attributes.name: distance_traveled
attributes.description: Total distance traveled in miles or kilometers during this duty status segment. Calculated from odometer readings or GPS tracking.

attributes.name: distance_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for distance values recorded in this log entry. Typically miles for US operations, kilometers for international operations.

attributes.name: driving_hours_accumulated
attributes.description: Cumulative driving hours for the current duty period up to and including this log entry. Used to enforce the 11-hour driving limit per DOT regulations.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: The total duration in hours that the driver spent in this duty status segment. Calculated as the difference between start and end timestamps.

attributes.name: duty_status
attributes.description: The driver's duty status for this log segment. Off Duty: driver is relieved from work and all responsibility for performing work. Sleeper Berth: driver is resting in the sleeper berth of the vehicle. Driving: driver is operating the commercial motor vehicle. On Duty Not Driving: driver is performing work other than driving (loading, inspections, paperwork, etc.).

attributes.name: duty_status_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the driver ended this duty status segment and transitioned to a different status.

attributes.name: duty_status_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the driver began this duty status segment. Captured automatically by Electronic Logging Device (ELD) or manually recorded.

attributes.name: edit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this log entry has been edited or modified after initial creation. True if edited, False if original. All edits must be tracked per DOT requirements.

attributes.name: edit_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the driver or supervisor for why this log entry was edited. Required for audit trail and DOT compliance.

attributes.name: edited_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this log entry was last edited. Part of the required audit trail for DOT compliance.

attributes.name: eld_device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the Electronic Logging Device that captured this record. Required for ELD compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: eld_registration_number
attributes.description: The FMCSA registration identifier for the ELD device. Required for DOT compliance verification.

attributes.name: home_terminal_time_zone
attributes.description: The time zone of the driver's home terminal. HOS calculations are based on home terminal time per DOT regulations.

attributes.name: hours_remaining_in_cycle
attributes.description: Calculated number of hours remaining in the current 60/70-hour cycle before the driver must take a 34-hour restart. Used for weekly dispatch planning.

attributes.name: hours_remaining_on_duty
attributes.description: Calculated number of on-duty hours remaining before the driver reaches the 14-hour on-duty limit. Used for dispatch planning and route optimization.

attributes.name: hours_remaining_to_drive
attributes.description: Calculated number of driving hours remaining before the driver reaches the 11-hour driving limit. Used for dispatch planning and load assignment.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the location where the duty status change occurred. Typically includes city and state or nearest landmark.

attributes.name: location_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate where the duty status change occurred. Captured automatically by Electronic Logging Device (ELD) GPS system.

attributes.name: location_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate where the duty status change occurred. Captured automatically by Electronic Logging Device (ELD) GPS system.

attributes.name: log_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which this hours of service record applies. Represents the 24-hour duty period starting at midnight in the driver's home terminal time zone.

attributes.name: log_entry_method
attributes.description: The method by which this HOS record was created. Automatic ELD: captured automatically by electronic logging device. Manual ELD: driver manually entered via ELD interface. Paper Log: transcribed from paper logbook for legacy compliance.

attributes.name: odometer_reading_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Odometer Reading at Duty Status End
attributes.description: Vehicle odometer reading in miles or kilometers at the end of this duty status segment. Used to calculate distance traveled during the segment.

attributes.name: odometer_reading_start
attributes.business_glossary_term: Odometer Reading at Duty Status Start
attributes.description: Vehicle odometer reading in miles or kilometers at the start of this duty status segment. Used for distance verification and compliance auditing.

attributes.name: on_duty_hours_accumulated
attributes.description: Cumulative on-duty hours (driving plus on-duty not driving) for the current duty period. Used to enforce the 14-hour on-duty limit per DOT regulations.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this HOS log record was first created in the database. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this HOS log record was last updated in the database. Tracks all modifications for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: rest_break_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the driver has taken the required 30-minute rest break within the first 8 hours of driving. True if compliant, False if violation.

attributes.name: shipment_number
attributes.description: The shipment or load number associated with this duty period. Links HOS records to freight operations for dispatch and billing purposes.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: Identification number of the trailer being hauled during this duty status segment. Required for DOT compliance and asset tracking.

attributes.name: violation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this log entry resulted in a violation of DOT hours of service regulations. True if a violation occurred, False otherwise.

attributes.name: violation_severity
attributes.description: The severity classification of the HOS violation for compliance reporting and driver safety scoring. Critical violations may result in immediate out-of-service orders.

attributes.name: violation_type
attributes.description: The specific type of HOS violation that occurred. Driving Limit: exceeded 11-hour driving limit. On Duty Limit: exceeded 14-hour on-duty limit. Cycle Limit: exceeded 60/70-hour cycle limit. Rest Break: failed to take required 30-minute break. Sleeper Berth: improper use of sleeper berth provision. None: no violation.

products.name: drug_alcohol_test
products.description: DOT-mandated drug and alcohol testing records for safety-sensitive transportation employees including pre-employment, random, post-accident, reasonable suspicion, and return-to-duty tests. Captures test type, test date, specimen type, result (negative/positive/refused), MRO verification status, and SAP referral if applicable. Critical for DOT FMCSA, FAA, and FTA compliance programs.
products.reference: DOT 49 CFR Part 40 Drug & Alcohol Testing

attributes.name: drug_alcohol_test_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the drug and alcohol test record. Primary key for the drug_alcohol_test product.
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA Part 382, FAA Part 120, FTA Part 655

attributes.name: driver_safety_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.driver_safety_program. Business justification: Drug/alcohol testing is administered under driver safety programs (random pool management, post-accident protocols, reasonable suspicion). DOT compliance requires program-level tracking of testing rat

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who underwent the drug and alcohol test. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: random_pool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the random testing pool from which the employee was selected for a random test. Used to track compliance with DOT minimum random testing rate requirements (50% for drugs, 10% for alcohol).

attributes.name: accident_date
attributes.description: Date of the qualifying accident that triggered a post-accident test. DOT requires post-accident testing for accidents involving fatality, bodily injury requiring immediate medical treatment, or disabling damage to a vehicle requiring tow-away.

attributes.name: accident_report_number
attributes.description: Official accident or incident report number associated with a post-accident test. Links the test record to the accident investigation file.

attributes.name: alcohol_concentration
attributes.description: Measured blood alcohol concentration (BAC) level expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.040 for 0.04%). DOT prohibits safety-sensitive duties at 0.04% or higher. Null if alcohol test was not performed or result was refused/cancelled.

attributes.name: alcohol_result
attributes.description: Specific result of the alcohol component of the test. Separated from drug result for tests that include both categories.

attributes.name: cdl_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is required to hold a valid Commercial Driver License (CDL) for the position being tested. CDL holders are subject to FMCSA drug and alcohol testing regulations.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_number
attributes.description: Unique chain of custody form number that tracks the specimen from collection through laboratory analysis. Critical for maintaining specimen integrity and legal defensibility of test results.

attributes.name: collection_site_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the collection site. Used for vendor management and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: collection_site_name
attributes.description: Name of the facility or location where the specimen was collected. May be an on-site clinic, third-party collection facility, or mobile testing unit.

attributes.name: collector_name
attributes.description: Name of the trained specimen collector who performed the collection. Required for chain of custody documentation.

attributes.name: compliance_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the test was conducted. Used for annual DOT compliance reporting and random testing rate calculations.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center to which the testing expense is allocated. Used for financial tracking and departmental cost allocation of drug and alcohol testing programs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this drug and alcohol test record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: drug_result
attributes.description: Specific result of the drug component of the test. Separated from alcohol result for tests that include both categories.

attributes.name: job_function_tested
attributes.description: Specific safety-sensitive job function for which the employee was tested (e.g., commercial driver, aircraft pilot, flight attendant, aircraft maintenance technician, warehouse forklift operator). Used for compliance reporting by job category.

attributes.name: laboratory_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the HHS-certified laboratory. Used for vendor management and quality assurance.
attributes.references: HHS Mandatory Guidelines for Federal Workplace Drug Testing Programs

attributes.name: laboratory_name
attributes.description: Name of the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) certified laboratory that analyzed the specimen.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or automated process that last modified this test record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this drug and alcohol test record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record changes. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: mro_name
attributes.description: Name of the licensed physician Medical Review Officer who reviewed and verified the test result. MRO is responsible for determining if there is a legitimate medical explanation for a positive result.

attributes.name: mro_verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the MRO completed verification of the test result and communicated the final determination to the employer.

attributes.name: mro_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the MRO verification process. Verified indicates MRO has completed review; pending indicates review is in progress; unable to contact indicates employee did not respond to MRO contact attempts; cancelled by MRO indicates test was invalidated during MRO review.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special circumstances related to the test. May include procedural deviations, employee statements, or follow-up actions required.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Drug and Alcohol Testing Module

attributes.name: random_selection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee was randomly selected for testing. Used to verify unannounced nature of random tests and compliance with selection procedures.

attributes.name: reasonable_suspicion_basis
attributes.description: Documented observations and specific, contemporaneous, articulable facts that led a trained supervisor to require a reasonable suspicion test. May include appearance, behavior, speech, or body odor consistent with substance use.

attributes.name: record_retention_date
attributes.description: Date through which this test record must be retained to meet DOT recordkeeping requirements. DOT requires retention of positive and refusal records for 5 years; negative records for 1 year; records of employee refusals to test for 5 years.

attributes.name: refusal_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason for a refused test result. May include failure to provide sufficient specimen, failure to remain at collection site, adulterating or substituting specimen, failure to cooperate with testing process, or explicit refusal. A refusal is treated as a positive result under DOT regulations.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Department of Transportation (DOT) operating administration under whose regulations this test was conducted. FMCSA for commercial motor vehicle drivers; FAA for aviation personnel; FTA for transit employees; PHMSA for pipeline workers; FRA for railroad employees; USCG for maritime workers.
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA Part 382, FAA Part 120, FTA Part 655

attributes.name: safety_sensitive_position
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee holds a DOT-defined safety-sensitive position at the time of testing. Only safety-sensitive employees are subject to DOT drug and alcohol testing requirements.

attributes.name: sap_evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the SAP evaluation and treatment process. Not required for negative tests; pending indicates referral made but evaluation not started; in progress indicates employee is undergoing treatment; completed indicates SAP has cleared employee for return-to-duty testing; non-compliant indicates employee failed to complete SAP requirements.

attributes.name: sap_name
attributes.description: Name of the qualified Substance Abuse Professional (licensed physician, social worker, psychologist, or addiction counselor) to whom the employee was referred for evaluation and treatment.

attributes.name: sap_referral_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee was referred to a Substance Abuse Professional following a positive or refused test result.

attributes.name: sap_referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee must be referred to a Substance Abuse Professional for evaluation and treatment. Required for all positive, refused, and adulterated test results before the employee can return to safety-sensitive duties.

attributes.name: specimen_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the specimen by the collection site or laboratory. Used to maintain chain of custody and link test results to the employee while preserving confidentiality.

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Type of biological specimen collected for testing. Urine is standard for drug tests; breath is standard for alcohol tests; blood, saliva, and hair may be used in specific circumstances or for extended detection windows.

attributes.name: substances_detected
attributes.description: List of specific controlled substances or drug classes detected in a positive drug test (e.g., marijuana, cocaine, opiates, amphetamines, phencyclidine). Null for negative or alcohol-only tests.

attributes.name: supervisor_name
attributes.description: Name of the trained supervisor who made the reasonable suspicion determination and directed the employee to testing. Supervisor must have completed DOT-required reasonable suspicion training.

attributes.name: test_category
attributes.description: Category of substance tested: drug only, alcohol only, or both drug and alcohol in a combined testing event.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date on which the drug and alcohol test specimen was collected. This is the principal business event date for the test record.

attributes.name: test_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique test number or specimen identifier assigned by the testing facility or Medical Review Officer (MRO). Used for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: test_result
attributes.description: Final result of the drug and alcohol test. Negative indicates no prohibited substances detected; positive indicates presence of prohibited substances above cutoff levels; refused indicates employee declined to provide specimen; cancelled indicates test was invalidated due to procedural error; invalid indicates specimen could not be analyzed.

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the test record. Tracks the test from scheduling through final verification and record completion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|specimen collected|in transit|at laboratory|under review|verified|completed|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Drug and Alcohol Testing Module

attributes.name: test_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the specimen collection occurred. Used for post-accident testing timeline compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: Type of drug and alcohol test conducted. Pre-employment tests are conducted before hire; random tests are unannounced selections from the pool; post-accident tests follow qualifying incidents; reasonable suspicion tests are based on observed behavior; return-to-duty tests are required before returning after a positive result; follow-up tests are part of a monitoring program.

attributes.name: testing_vendor_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the third-party vendor or consortium that manages the drug and alcohol testing program. Used for vendor performance tracking and invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or automated process that created this test record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: location
products.description: Master record of all physical work locations where Transport Shipping employees are deployed, including warehouses, distribution centers, freight stations, CFS facilities, ICD depots, airport cargo terminals, and corporate offices. Captures location code, address, country, timezone, facility type, and operational capacity. Used for shift scheduling, labor allocation, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the workforce location record. Primary key.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Workforce locations operate under legal entities for statutory compliance. Payroll tax jurisdiction, labor law compliance, and entity-level headcount reporting require linking locations to their compa

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the location manager or site supervisor responsible for this workforce location. Links to employee master data in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the workforce location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, building, or unit information. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: building_square_footage
attributes.description: Total building area in square feet. Used for facilities cost allocation, space utilization analysis, and capacity planning.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Business unit or division code that owns this location (e.g., 'EXPRESS', 'FREIGHT', 'ECOM'). Used for organizational hierarchy and reporting.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the workforce location is situated.

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of compliance frameworks applicable to this location (e.g., 'ISO 28000, C-TPAT, AEO, SOX'). Drives audit requirements and certification tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center code associated with this location for labor cost allocation and P&L reporting. Links to SAP S/4HANA Finance.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'MEX'). Determines regulatory jurisdiction and labor law compliance requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this workforce location record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: current_headcount
attributes.description: Current number of employees assigned to this workforce location. Updated periodically from Workday HCM.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this workforce location ceased operations or was decommissioned. Null for currently active locations.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this workforce location became operational and available for employee assignment and shift scheduling.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email contact for the workforce location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: external_location_code
attributes.description: External system identifier for this location from source systems (e.g., Workday HCM location ID, SAP TM plant code). Used for cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM, SAP TM Integration Specification

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical facility type. CFS = Container Freight Station, ICD = Inland Container Depot. Determines operational capabilities and regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: warehouse|distribution_center|freight_station|cfs|icd|airport_cargo_terminal|corporate_office|cross_dock — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_safety_sensitive_site
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location handles safety-sensitive operations requiring DOT/ICAO certifications, dangerous goods handling, or enhanced safety protocols.
attributes.references: US DOT Safety Regulations, ICAO Annex 18

attributes.name: is_union_location
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location has unionized workforce. Determines applicable labor agreements, shift rules, and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees. Used for route optimization, fleet management, and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: lease_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the lease agreement for this location expires. Null for owned properties. Used for real estate planning and renewal tracking.

attributes.name: lease_or_owned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location is owned by the company, leased, or subleased. Impacts financial reporting and CAPEX/OPEX allocation.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases, Internal Real Estate Policy

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the workforce location, used across operational systems for shift scheduling, labor allocation, and payroll processing. Typically follows company-specific alphanumeric format.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context about the workforce location, its operational scope, and special characteristics.

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the workforce location (e.g., 'Chicago O'Hare Cargo Terminal', 'Newark Distribution Center').

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the workforce location. Active locations are available for shift scheduling and labor allocation.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees. Used for route optimization, fleet management, and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that last modified this workforce location record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this workforce location record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: operates_24_7
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location operates continuously (24 hours, 7 days per week). Impacts shift scheduling, labor planning, and operational support requirements.

attributes.name: operational_capacity_fte
attributes.description: Maximum workforce capacity at this location measured in Full-Time Equivalents. Used for labor planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: parking_capacity
attributes.description: Number of parking spaces available at this location for employee and visitor vehicles. Used for facilities planning and employee amenities assessment.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the workforce location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the workforce location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic or operational region code (e.g., 'NORAM', 'EMEA', 'APAC', 'LATAM'). Used for regional workforce planning and performance analysis.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Primary regulatory jurisdiction governing labor law, safety, and employment compliance at this location (e.g., 'US DOT', 'EU GDPR', 'ICAO'). Determines applicable compliance frameworks.

attributes.name: requires_security_clearance
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees at this location require security clearance (e.g., C-TPAT, AEO, airside access). Determines background check and certification requirements.

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: Standard shift pattern or rotation schedule used at this location (e.g., '3-shift rotation', '4-on-4-off', 'day shift only'). Guides workforce scheduling in Manhattan WMS.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or short name for the location used in operational displays and reports (e.g., 'ORD Cargo', 'EWR DC').

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code for state, province, or region (e.g., 'IL', 'CA', 'ON').

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the location (e.g., 'America/Chicago', 'Europe/London'). Critical for shift scheduling and labor hour calculations across distributed operations.

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union representing workers at this location, if applicable. Used for contract management and labor relations.

attributes.name: warehouse_management_system
attributes.description: Name and version of the WMS deployed at this location (e.g., 'Manhattan WMS v2022', 'SAP EWM'). Used for system integration and labor tracking.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that created this workforce location record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: labor_contract
products.description: Individual and collective labor agreement records governing employment terms for Transport Shipping workers, including union collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), individual employment contracts, and agency worker agreements. Captures contract type, effective dates, notice period, probation terms, applicable CBA reference, jurisdiction, and key entitlements (overtime rules, shift premiums, redundancy terms). Distinct from commercial contracts owned by the contract domain.

attributes.name: labor_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the labor contract record. Primary key for the labor contract entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee to whom this labor contract applies. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking to the standardized job profile that defines role responsibilities, competencies, and requirements for this contract.

attributes.name: annual_leave_days
attributes.description: Number of paid annual leave (vacation) days per year granted under this contract. May increase with tenure.

attributes.name: base_salary_amount
attributes.description: Annual base salary amount specified in the labor contract. Excludes bonuses, commissions, allowances, and other variable compensation.

attributes.name: bonus_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for performance-based or discretionary bonuses under this contract.

attributes.name: cba_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the applicable collective bargaining agreement if this contract is governed by a union CBA. Null for non-union individual contracts.
attributes.references: ILO Convention 98 - Right to Organise and Collective Bargaining

attributes.name: contract_duration_months
attributes.description: Total duration of the contract in months. Applicable primarily to fixed-term contracts. Null for permanent or open-ended contracts.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the labor contract. Used for reference in legal documents, HR systems, and employee communications.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the labor contract. Indicates whether the contract is in draft, active, suspended, terminated, expired, or renewed state.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the labor contract. Distinguishes between individual employment contracts, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), agency worker agreements, and other contract forms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual_employment|collective_bargaining_agreement|agency_worker|fixed_term|permanent|temporary|seasonal|apprenticeship — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this labor contract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this contract (base salary, hourly rate, allowances).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the labor contract expires or terminates. Nullable for open-ended permanent contracts. For fixed-term contracts, represents the contract expiration date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the labor contract becomes legally binding and employment terms take effect. Marks the beginning of the contract period.

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: Classification under the US Fair Labor Standards Act indicating whether the employee is exempt or non-exempt from overtime pay requirements. Applicable to US-based contracts.

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: Full-time equivalent allocation for this contract, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0000 for full-time, 0.5000 for half-time). Used for workforce planning and budgeting.

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: Legal framework or specific statute governing the employment relationship. May reference national labor codes, state employment acts, or international conventions.

attributes.name: hazmat_premium_amount
attributes.description: Additional compensation for employees handling hazardous materials or dangerous goods. Applicable to drivers, warehouse workers, and freight handlers with HAZMAT endorsements.

attributes.name: health_insurance_coverage
attributes.description: Level of health insurance coverage provided under this contract. Indicates whether coverage extends to employee only, employee and spouse, or full family.

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: Hourly wage rate for hourly-paid employees. Null for salaried employees. Used to calculate regular pay and overtime.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title as stated in the labor contract. May differ from operational role titles used in day-to-day management.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the legal jurisdiction governing this labor contract. Determines applicable labor laws and regulations.

products.name: initiative_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between employees and sustainability initiatives within Transport Shipping's green logistics program. It captures the operational assignment of employees to decarbonisation projects and fleet electrification initiatives, tracking their specific roles, time allocation, and individual contribution metrics. Each record links one employee to one sustainability initiative with attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship, enabling portfolio management of green initiative staffing and ROI tracking for human capital investment in ESG programs.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping's sustainability program, employees participate in multiple green logistics initiatives simultaneously (e.g., a logistics manager may contribute to both fleet electrification and route optimization projects), and each sustainability initiative requires cross-functional teams with multiple employees in various roles (sponsor, technical lead, contributor, champion). The business actively manages these participation relationships as operational records, tracking role assignments, time allocation, contribution hours, individual KPI targets, and achievement metrics for each employee-initiative pairing.

attributes.name: initiative_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee-initiative participation record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the employee participating in the sustainability initiative. References the core employee master record from Workday HCM.

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sustainability initiative in which the employee is participating. References the master record for green logistics initiatives and decarbonisation projects.

attributes.name: achievement_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the assigned KPI target that the employee has achieved (0-100+). Used for performance evaluation, incentive calculation, and tracking individual contribution to sustainability goals. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: contribution_hours
attributes.description: Total hours the employee has contributed or is allocated to contribute to the sustainability initiative. Used for resource planning, cost allocation, and measuring human capital investment in ESG projects. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the participation record was created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: kpi_target_assigned
attributes.description: Specific key performance indicator or target assigned to this employee for this initiative (e.g., '500 tCO2e reduction', '10 EV deployments', '15% modal shift'). Enables individual accountability and performance tracking within the initiative. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: participation_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee's participation in the sustainability initiative ended or is planned to end. Null for ongoing participation. Enables tracking of participation history and resource allocation over time. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: participation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee began participating in or was assigned to the sustainability initiative. Used for tracking participation duration and historical staffing analysis. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the employee's participation in the initiative (active, on_hold, completed, withdrawn). Tracks the lifecycle of the participation relationship and enables filtering for active vs. historical assignments.

attributes.name: responsibility_level
attributes.description: Level of responsibility or accountability the employee has for the initiative (e.g., primary, secondary, advisory, support). Distinguishes between core team members and supporting contributors. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: role_in_initiative
attributes.description: The specific role the employee plays in the sustainability initiative (e.g., sponsor, contributor, champion, technical lead, analyst, coordinator). Defines the nature of their participation and level of accountability. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: time_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the employee's working time allocated to this sustainability initiative (0-100). Used for capacity planning, workload balancing, and ensuring employees are not over-committed across multiple initiatives.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the participation record was last updated. Used for audit trail and tracking changes to participation details.

products.name: workforce_training_completion
products.description: This association product represents the completion event between employee and safety_training. It captures the operational record of each instance when an employee completes a safety training course, including assessment results, certification details, and compliance tracking. Each record links one employee to one safety_training with attributes that exist only in the context of this completion relationship.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping operations, employees complete multiple safety training courses throughout their employment (hazmat, forklift certification, DOT compliance, first aid, emergency response), and each safety training course is completed by many employees across the workforce. The business actively manages training completions as operational records with completion dates, assessment scores, certificate numbers, expiry dates, and compliance status tracking. This is a recognized business process called 'training completion' or 'certification management' that safety teams query, monitor, and report on for regulatory compliance and operational readiness.

products.name: target_accountability
products.description: This association product represents the accountability assignment between organizational units and sustainability targets within Transport Shipping's ESG governance framework. It captures the distributed responsibility model where corporate sustainability commitments cascade to multiple business units with defined accountability levels, budget allocations, and reporting responsibilities. Each record links one org_unit to one sustainability_target with attributes that exist only in the context of this accountability relationship, enabling tracking of which units are responsible for which portions of each target and how progress is measured and reported.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping's ESG governance model, corporate sustainability targets (e.g., 50% emissions reduction by 2030, 100% renewable energy by 2040) cascade to multiple organizational units with distributed accountability. A single target like 'Net Zero by 2050' is allocated across freight operations, warehouse operations, fleet management, and corporate functions, each with defined allocation percentages, budget splits, and reporting responsibilities. Conversely, a single organizational unit like 'European Freight Operations' holds accountability for multiple targets simultaneously (emissions reduction, waste diversion, renewable energy adoption, sustainable packaging). This is an operational M:N relationship where the business actively manages accountability assignments, tracks progress by unit-target combination, and escalates when units fall behind their allocated portions.

attributes.name: target_accountability_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this accountability assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the organizational unit that holds accountability for this sustainability target

attributes.name: target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sustainability target for which accountability is assigned

attributes.name: accountability_level
attributes.description: The level of accountability this organizational unit holds for the target. Primary indicates direct ownership and decision-making authority. Secondary indicates shared responsibility with reporting obligations. Contributing indicates supporting role. Monitoring indicates oversight or tracking responsibility without operational accountability.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: The date when this accountability assignment was formally established and communicated to the organizational unit. Used for tracking when responsibility was delegated.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this accountability assignment. Active assignments are in force. Pending assignments are approved but not yet effective. Suspended assignments are temporarily on hold. Completed assignments have fulfilled their target. Cancelled assignments were terminated before completion.

attributes.name: budget_allocation
attributes.description: The budget amount in USD allocated to this organizational unit specifically for achieving their portion of this sustainability target. Used for tracking investment in emissions reduction projects, renewable energy initiatives, waste reduction programs, etc.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accountability assignment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this organizational unit's accountability for this target ends. Null for ongoing accountability. Populated when accountability is transferred to another unit or when the target is achieved or retired.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this organizational unit's accountability for this target becomes active. May differ from assignment_date if accountability is assigned in advance of the effective period.

attributes.name: escalation_threshold
attributes.description: The percentage variance from target trajectory that triggers escalation to executive leadership. For example, if set to 10.00, any deviation of 10% or more from the planned progress path requires escalation and corrective action planning.

attributes.name: milestone_ownership
attributes.description: Indicates whether this organizational unit owns specific interim milestones for this target. Full ownership means the unit is responsible for achieving defined milestones. Partial means shared milestone responsibility. None means the unit contributes to the overall target but does not own specific milestones.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this accountability assignment record was last modified.

attributes.name: reporting_responsibility
attributes.description: The frequency and nature of reporting obligations this organizational unit has for progress against this target. Defines whether the unit must submit monthly progress reports, quarterly updates, annual summaries, or ad-hoc reports as requested.

attributes.name: responsible_executive
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the executive within this organizational unit who holds ultimate accountability for this target assignment. Used for escalation and executive reporting.

attributes.name: target_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the overall sustainability target allocated to this organizational unit. Used when a corporate target is split across multiple business units (e.g., 40% of emissions reduction target assigned to freight operations, 30% to warehouse operations, 30% to fleet). Sum of allocations across all org units for a given target should equal 100%.
