attributes.name: error_count
attributes.description: Number of calculation or validation errors encountered during payroll run processing. Zero indicates a clean run; non-zero requires review before approval.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month or quarter) to which this payroll run is attributed. Supports period-close reporting and labor cost accrual processes.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which this payroll run is attributed for financial reporting purposes. May differ from calendar year depending on company fiscal calendar.

attributes.name: garnishment_count
attributes.description: Number of active wage garnishment orders processed in this payroll run. Includes court-ordered child support, tax levies, and creditor garnishments requiring compliance tracking.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which payroll journal entries were posted to the general ledger. Used for financial period alignment and accounting reconciliation.

attributes.name: gross_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total gross compensation amount for all employees included in this payroll run before any deductions or withholdings. Includes base pay, overtime, shift differentials, and allowances.

attributes.name: is_final_run
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the final payroll run for the pay period. False for preliminary/preview runs used for validation before the confirmed disbursement run.

attributes.name: is_retroactive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payroll run includes retroactive pay adjustments for prior periods. True when back-dated compensation changes (e.g., rate increases, reclassifications) are processed.

attributes.name: net_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total net pay disbursed to all employees in this payroll run after all deductions. Represents the actual cash outflow for employee compensation.

attributes.name: overtime_hours_total
attributes.description: Aggregate overtime hours across all employees in this payroll run. Critical for DOT hours-of-service compliance monitoring for drivers and warehouse labor cost analysis.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which this payroll run cycle occurs. Determines the cadence of compensation disbursement for the associated pay group.

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the pay period covered by this payroll run. Defines the end of the earnings accumulation window.

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: First day of the pay period covered by this payroll run. Defines the beginning of the earnings accumulation window.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which employee payments are disbursed (direct deposit or check date). This is the constructive receipt date for tax purposes.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Primary disbursement method used for this payroll run. Mixed indicates the run contains multiple payment methods across employees.

attributes.name: processing_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payroll run calculation processing completed. Used with start timestamp to measure processing duration and identify performance issues.

attributes.name: processing_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payroll run calculation processing began. Used for SLA monitoring and payroll operations performance tracking.

attributes.name: regular_hours_total
attributes.description: Aggregate regular (non-overtime) hours worked across all employees in this payroll run. Used for FTE planning and labor utilization analysis.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why a payroll run was reversed, if applicable. Captures the business justification for voiding a previously completed run (e.g., calculation error, duplicate processing).

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for the payroll run, used in communications and audit trails. Typically follows a structured format including year and sequence.

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payroll run indicating its nature. Regular runs are scheduled cycles; supplemental covers additional payments; off-cycle handles ad-hoc processing; correction adjusts prior errors; bonus processes incentive payments; final handles employee separations.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the payroll run in its processing lifecycle. Draft indicates setup; in_progress means calculations are running; completed means processing finished; posted means entries sent to GL; reversed indicates full reversal; cancelled means run was abandoned.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific tax jurisdiction (state, province, or local) applicable to this payroll run. Supports multi-jurisdiction payroll processing for distributed logistics operations.

attributes.name: total_deductions_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate amount of all employee deductions in this payroll run including tax withholdings, benefit premiums, retirement contributions, garnishments, and voluntary deductions.

attributes.name: total_labor_cost
attributes.description: Fully-loaded labor cost for this payroll run including gross pay, employer taxes, and employer benefit contributions. Used for labor cost allocation across freight and fulfillment operations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this payroll run record. Tracks when status changes, amount updates, or other modifications occurred.

attributes.name: warning_count
attributes.description: Number of non-blocking warnings generated during payroll run processing. Warnings flag potential issues (e.g., unusual overtime, missing time entries) that do not prevent completion.

attributes.name: reversal_payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on payroll_run (reversal_payroll_run_id)

attributes.name: credit_hours

attributes.name: enrolled_count

attributes.name: language

attributes.name: materials_provided

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold

attributes.name: recurrence_interval_months

attributes.name: regulatory_body

attributes.name: scheduled_end_timestamp

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp

attributes.name: session_code

attributes.name: session_description

attributes.name: session_type

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the training session indicating its progress from scheduling through completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: target_job_family

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the training session location or virtual meeting, ensuring correct scheduling across global operations.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Human-readable title or name of the training session describing the subject matter covered.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the training content, allowing tracking of curriculum updates and ensuring participants receive current material.

attributes.name: virtual_meeting_url
attributes.description: Web URL for joining the training session when delivered virtually, applicable for remote and blended delivery modes.

attributes.name: rescheduled_training_session_id

attributes.description: Primary key for training_course

attributes.name: applicable_job_family

attributes.name: category

attributes.name: certification_body

attributes.name: competency_area

attributes.name: compliance_requirement_flag

attributes.name: content_owner

attributes.name: cost_currency_code

attributes.name: country_applicability

attributes.name: course_code

attributes.name: course_description

attributes.name: course_type

attributes.name: created_date

attributes.name: credit_hours

attributes.name: delivery_method

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: enrollment_open_flag

attributes.name: hazmat_certification_flag

attributes.name: language_code

attributes.name: last_review_date

attributes.name: lms_course_url

attributes.name: renewal_grace_period_days

attributes.name: safety_critical_flag

attributes.name: skill_level

attributes.name: validity_period_months

attributes.name: version_number

attributes.name: benefits_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees in this pay group are eligible for company-sponsored benefits (health insurance, retirement plans, etc.).

attributes.name: code

attributes.name: collective_bargaining_agreement_ref

attributes.name: cost_center_code

attributes.name: minimum_wage_rate

domains.name: finance
domains.description: SSOT for enterprise financial management including general ledger, cost center accounting, P&L reporting, CAPEX/OPEX budgeting, EBITDA tracking, intercompany settlements, tax filings, audit trails, and regulatory financial reporting. Owns chart of accounts, journal entries, and financial controls aligned to IFRS and SOX requirements. Powered by SAP S/4HANA Finance and interfaces with billing, contract, and procurement domains.

products.name: ledger
products.description: General ledger master entity representing the chart of accounts and ledger structure for Transport Shipping. Serves as the SSOT for all GL account definitions, account hierarchies, cost element classifications, and financial reporting structures aligned to IFRS and SOX requirements. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance GL module.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger account. Primary key for the ledger entity. Serves as the system-generated surrogate key for all GL account records in the chart of accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance GL Master Data

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: ledger has gl_account_number (STRING) and account attributes but no FK to chart_of_accounts master. The ledger entity represents GL account balances and MUST reference the chart_of_accounts master. Th

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity or company code that owns this GL account. In SAP S/4HANA, the company code represents the smallest organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up for external reporting. Links the account to a specific legal entity for statutory reporting and audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure, IFRS Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: account_description_long
attributes.description: Extended free-text description providing detailed explanation of the account's purpose, usage guidelines, and posting rules. Supports user training, audit documentation, and chart of accounts governance. Complements the short account_name with comprehensive business context.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA GL Account Master, Financial Accounting Documentation Standards

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account. Active accounts accept postings; inactive accounts are closed to new transactions but retain historical balances; blocked accounts are temporarily suspended; pending_closure accounts are scheduled for archival. Controls whether journal entries can be posted to this account.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA GL Account Master, SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: alternative_account_number
attributes.description: Secondary or legacy account number used for migration, external reporting, or integration with non-SAP systems. Maintains cross-reference to previous chart of accounts structures or statutory reporting account codes. Facilitates data migration, historical comparisons, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts Migration, Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: blocked_for_posting_flag
attributes.description: Temporary block indicator that prevents all postings to this account regardless of user authorization. True when account is under investigation, audit review, or pending correction; false for normal operations. Provides emergency control to freeze account activity during exception handling or compliance reviews.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA GL Account Master, SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: budget_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to budget availability checking before posting. True for CAPEX and OPEX accounts with approved budgets; false for revenue and balance sheet accounts. Enforces budgetary controls and prevents overspending against approved financial plans.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Funds Management, Public Sector Budgetary Controls

attributes.name: business_area_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a business area (division/segment) assignment is mandatory when posting to this account. True for accounts requiring cross-company-code segment reporting; false for accounts not subject to divisional analysis. Supports matrix reporting and segment disclosure per IFRS 8.
attributes.references: IFRS 8 Operating Segments, SAP S/4HANA Business Area Configuration

attributes.name: cash_flow_category
attributes.description: Classification for cash flow statement presentation per IFRS IAS 7. Determines whether cash movements in this account are reported as operating activities (e.g., freight revenue, fuel expense), investing activities (e.g., CAPEX, asset disposals), or financing activities (e.g., debt, equity). Not_applicable for non-cash accounts.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows, GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: consolidation_account_number
attributes.description: The mapped account number in the group chart of accounts used for corporate consolidation and group reporting. Enables translation from local entity chart of accounts to standardized group reporting structure. Critical for multi-entity consolidation, intercompany eliminations, and group financial statements.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements, SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting

attributes.name: cost_center_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a cost center assignment is mandatory when posting to this account. True for expense accounts requiring departmental cost tracking; false for revenue and balance sheet accounts. Enforces cost center accounting discipline and enables OPEX analysis by organizational unit, function, or location.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Accounting, Management Accounting Standards

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: Classification for cost accounting integration. Primary cost elements represent direct postings from financial accounting (e.g., fuel, labor); secondary cost elements represent internal allocations and assessments; revenue elements track income; not_applicable for non-cost accounts. Critical for cost center accounting and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) Cost Element Master, Management Accounting Standards

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created this GL account master record in the system. Supports audit trail, SOX compliance, and master data governance. Part of the standard change tracking required for financial system controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this GL account master record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field required for SOX compliance, master data lineage, and change history tracking. Recorded in UTC or system local time per configuration.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The functional currency in which this account maintains balances. Three-letter ISO 4217 code. For multi-currency environments, specifies the account's base currency for translation and consolidation. Most accounts use the company code's local currency; some accounts may be designated for specific foreign currencies.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, IFRS IAS 21 Foreign Currency Translation

attributes.name: external_reporting_code
attributes.description: Standardized code for mapping this account to external regulatory reporting frameworks such as XBRL taxonomy tags, statutory chart of accounts, or industry-specific reporting templates. Examples: IFRS taxonomy element IDs, GAAP codification references, IMO financial reporting codes. Critical for automated regulatory filing and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS XBRL Taxonomy, GAAP Codification, IMO Financial Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: Configuration key that controls which additional fields are required, optional, or suppressed when posting to this account. Examples: 'G001' (standard), 'G003' (cost center required), 'G010' (tax code required). Enforces data entry discipline and ensures consistent posting data quality across the organization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Field Status Variant, SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: financial_statement_position
attributes.description: The specific line item or section code where this account appears on published financial statements. Maps GL accounts to IFRS/GAAP disclosure requirements and standardized financial statement templates. Examples: 'BS.CA.010' (Balance Sheet, Current Assets, line 010), 'PL.REV.100' (P&L, Revenue, line 100).
attributes.references: IFRS Financial Statement Presentation (IAS 1), GAAP Codification Topic 210/220

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Classification of the account by business function for cost-of-sales accounting and functional expense reporting. Examples: 'OPERATIONS', 'SALES_MARKETING', 'ADMINISTRATION', 'FINANCE', 'IT'. Enables P&L presentation by function (cost-of-sales method) as an alternative to nature-of-expense classification, per IFRS requirements.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements, SAP S/4HANA Functional Area Derivation

attributes.name: intercompany_clearing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used for intercompany transactions and settlements between legal entities within the group. True for intercompany receivables, payables, and clearing accounts that require elimination in consolidated financial statements. Critical for intercompany reconciliation and consolidation controls.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements, SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Reconciliation

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this GL account master record. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and accountability for master data changes. Updated automatically on every change to the account configuration.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this GL account master record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and master data governance. Updated automatically on every change to the account configuration. Critical for SOX compliance and change management controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: marked_for_deletion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the account is scheduled for archival and removal from the active chart of accounts. True for obsolete accounts with zero balance and no open items; false for active accounts. Supports chart of accounts maintenance and master data governance. Accounts marked for deletion cannot accept new postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Master Data Governance, Data Retention Policies

attributes.name: open_item_management_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account uses line-item (open item) management for detailed transaction tracking and clearing. True for accounts like AR, AP, bank clearing where individual line items must be tracked and cleared; false for summary accounts. Enables detailed aging analysis, payment matching, and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Open Item Management, Financial Accounting Best Practices

attributes.name: planning_level
attributes.description: Granularity level at which this account is planned and budgeted. Examples: 'ACCOUNT', 'COST_CENTER', 'PROFIT_CENTER', 'PROJECT'. Determines the organizational dimension for budget allocation, forecasting, and variance analysis. Supports multi-dimensional planning and rolling forecasts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Planning and Analysis, Management Accounting Standards

attributes.name: posting_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Controls whether direct journal entry postings are permitted to this account. False for summary/rollup accounts that only receive automated allocations or consolidation entries. True for operational accounts that accept manual and automated postings. Enforces chart of accounts design and prevents posting errors.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA GL Account Master, Financial Accounting Best Practices

attributes.name: profit_center_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a profit center assignment is mandatory when posting to this account. True for revenue and expense accounts requiring segment profitability tracking; false for balance sheet accounts or centralized accounts. Enforces management accounting discipline and enables P&L reporting by business unit, service line, or geographic region.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Profit Center Accounting, Management Accounting Standards

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a reconciliation account (subledger control account) that must match the sum of subsidiary ledger balances. True for accounts like Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets where detailed subledger records must reconcile to the GL balance. Critical for SOX controls and audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, SAP S/4HANA Subledger Reconciliation

attributes.name: retained_earnings_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the designated retained earnings account that receives the net profit or loss transfer during year-end closing. True for the single equity account that accumulates undistributed profits; false for all other accounts. Critical for automated year-end closing and equity reconciliation.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 Financial Statement Presentation, SAP S/4HANA Year-End Closing

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: Default sorting rule for line items posted to this account. Determines the assignment field used for document number generation, clearing, and reporting. Examples: '001' (posting date), '012' (document number), '014' (invoice reference). Standardizes line item organization and facilitates automated clearing processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Document Management, Financial Accounting Configuration

attributes.name: sustainability_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is relevant for environmental, social, and governance (ESG) reporting and sustainability disclosures. True for accounts tracking GHG emissions costs, carbon offset purchases, renewable energy investments, sustainability-linked financing, and environmental compliance expenses. Supports EU ETS, CORSIA, and voluntary ESG frameworks.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS), CORSIA Carbon Offsetting, GRI Sustainability Reporting Standards

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Tax treatment classification for this account. Determines automatic tax code derivation, VAT reporting category, and tax jurisdiction applicability. Examples: 'INPUT_VAT', 'OUTPUT_VAT', 'NON_TAXABLE', 'EXEMPT', 'REVERSE_CHARGE'. Critical for customs brokerage, cross-border shipping, and multi-jurisdiction tax compliance.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System, EU VAT Directive, SAP S/4HANA Tax Configuration

attributes.name: tolerance_group
attributes.description: Configuration key that defines posting amount limits, payment difference tolerances, and exchange rate variance thresholds for this account. Controls automated clearing tolerances and approval workflows for large transactions. Examples: 'STANDARD', 'HIGH_VALUE', 'PETTY_CASH'. Supports risk management and fraud prevention.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Tolerance Groups, SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this GL account becomes active and available for posting. Supports time-dependent chart of accounts changes, new account introductions, and fiscal year transitions. Postings before this date are rejected by the system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Time-Dependent Master Data, Financial Accounting Configuration

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date after which this GL account is no longer active for posting. Supports account retirement, chart of accounts restructuring, and controlled phase-out of obsolete accounts. Nullable for accounts with indefinite validity. Postings after this date are rejected by the system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Time-Dependent Master Data, Financial Accounting Configuration

products.name: chart_of_accounts
products.description: Master reference for the enterprise chart of accounts defining all GL account codes, account groups, account types (P&L, balance sheet), financial statement line assignments, and IFRS classification. Governs account structure across all legal entities and company codes within Transport Shipping. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the chart of accounts entry. Primary key for this master reference entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Master Data Standards

attributes.name: account_class
attributes.description: Functional classification indicating the operational role of the account: primary (standard posting), reconciliation (clearing and control), statistical (non-value tracking), or intercompany (inter-entity transactions).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Account Class Configuration

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: Hierarchical grouping code that clusters related GL accounts together for reporting and analysis purposes. Used to aggregate accounts into meaningful financial statement line items.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Account Group Configuration, IFRS Presentation Standards

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the GL account providing clear business context for the account purpose and usage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Master Data Standards

attributes.name: account_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name or label for the GL account used in condensed reports and user interfaces where space is limited.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Master Data Standards

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account indicating whether it is available for posting (active), temporarily restricted (blocked), no longer in use (inactive), or awaiting activation (pending approval).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Master Data Governance

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the account into fundamental accounting categories: asset, liability, equity, revenue, or expense. Determines the account's role in financial statements and its normal balance (debit or credit).
attributes.references: IFRS Conceptual Framework, GAAP Accounting Standards

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status for this chart of accounts entry. Ensures proper governance and authorization before accounts become active for posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Master Data Governance Workflow, SOX Approval Controls

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chart of accounts entry was approved. Provides temporal audit trail for governance and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Master Data Governance, SOX Approval Documentation

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who approved this chart of accounts entry for activation. Documents authorization in compliance with segregation of duties requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Master Data Governance, SOX Segregation of Duties

attributes.name: audit_trail_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a complete audit trail of all changes and postings must be maintained for this account. Essential for regulatory compliance and forensic accounting requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Audit Trail Requirements, IFRS Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: balance_sheet_classification
attributes.description: Classification of balance sheet accounts into current (short-term) or non-current (long-term) categories for assets and liabilities, or equity. Not applicable for P&L accounts.
attributes.references: IFRS Balance Sheet Classification (IAS 1), GAAP Balance Sheet Standards

attributes.name: budget_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether budget availability checking is enforced for this account. When true, postings are validated against approved budget allocations before commitment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Budget Control Configuration

attributes.name: cash_flow_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the account for cash flow statement reporting: operating activities, investing activities, financing activities, or not applicable for non-cash accounts.
attributes.references: IFRS Cash Flow Statement (IAS 7), SAP S/4HANA Cash Flow Configuration

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The four-character company code identifier representing the legal entity to which this chart of accounts entry belongs. Enables multi-entity financial management within the enterprise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Organizational Structure, SOX Entity-Level Controls

attributes.name: consolidation_account
attributes.description: The corresponding account code in the group consolidation chart of accounts. Maps local entity accounts to standardized group reporting accounts for consolidated financial statements.
attributes.references: IFRS Consolidated Financial Statements (IFRS 10), SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting Configuration

attributes.name: control_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account serves as a control or summary account that aggregates balances from detail accounts. Control accounts typically do not allow direct postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Account Control Configuration

attributes.name: cost_element_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is also defined as a cost element in the controlling module, enabling cost center and internal order postings for management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling Cost Element Configuration

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who created this chart of accounts entry. Essential for accountability and audit trail in master data management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Master Data Audit Standards, SOX User Accountability

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chart of accounts entry was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for master data governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Master Data Audit Standards, SOX Audit Requirements

attributes.name: currency_type
attributes.description: Defines the currency management approach for this account: local (company code currency only), group (consolidated reporting currency), transaction (foreign currency allowed), or multiple (multi-currency management).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Currency Configuration, IFRS Foreign Currency Standards (IAS 21)

attributes.name: default_currency_code
attributes.description: The default three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for this account when transaction currency is not specified. Typically the local currency of the company code.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, SAP S/4HANA Finance Currency Configuration

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: Configuration key that controls which fields are required, optional, or suppressed when posting to this account. Enforces data quality and compliance requirements at the transaction level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Field Status Variant Configuration, SOX Control Requirements

attributes.name: financial_statement_item
attributes.description: The specific line item on the financial statement (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement) where this account's balance is reported. Maps GL accounts to external reporting presentation.
attributes.references: IFRS Financial Statement Presentation (IAS 1), SAP S/4HANA Financial Statement Version

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Classification of the account by business function or operational area (e.g., sales, operations, administration, logistics) for segment reporting and functional cost analysis.
attributes.references: IFRS Segment Reporting (IFRS 8), SAP S/4HANA Functional Area Configuration

attributes.name: gaap_classification
attributes.description: GAAP classification code or category for this account, supporting dual reporting requirements where both IFRS and local GAAP reporting are required.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric code identifying the GL account within the chart of accounts structure. This is the externally-known business identifier used across all financial transactions and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Chart of Accounts, IFRS Framework

attributes.name: ifrs_classification
attributes.description: Detailed IFRS classification code or category for this account, ensuring compliance with international financial reporting standards and enabling IFRS-compliant financial statement generation.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used for intercompany transactions and the direction: none (not intercompany), payable (amounts owed to related entities), receivable (amounts due from related entities), or both.
attributes.references: IFRS Related Party Disclosures (IAS 24), SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Configuration

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who last modified this chart of accounts entry. Provides accountability for master data changes and supports audit investigations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Master Data Audit Standards, SOX User Accountability

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this chart of accounts entry was last modified. Tracks the currency of master data and supports change management processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Master Data Audit Standards, SOX Change Control

attributes.name: line_item_display_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual line item details (journal entries) are stored and displayable for this account. Essential for accounts requiring detailed transaction audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Line Item Management, SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: open_item_management_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account uses open item management for tracking and clearing individual transactions (e.g., invoices, payments). Critical for accounts receivable, accounts payable, and clearing accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Open Item Management Configuration

attributes.name: planning_level
attributes.description: Defines the granularity at which budget planning and forecasting is performed for this account (e.g., annual, quarterly, monthly). Supports CAPEX and OPEX budgeting processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Budget Planning Configuration

attributes.name: posting_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether direct journal entry postings are permitted to this account. False indicates a control or summary account that only receives automatic postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Posting Control Configuration

attributes.name: profit_loss_classification
attributes.description: Detailed classification of revenue and expense accounts within the income statement structure, including operating revenue, cost of goods sold, operating expenses, and non-operating items.
attributes.references: IFRS Income Statement Presentation (IAS 1), SAP S/4HANA P&L Structure

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a reconciliation account that serves as a control account for subsidiary ledgers (e.g., accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory). Reconciliation accounts are automatically updated from sub-ledger transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Reconciliation Account Configuration

attributes.name: retained_earnings_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the designated retained earnings account that receives the net profit or loss transfer during year-end closing processes.
attributes.references: IFRS Equity Reporting Standards, SAP S/4HANA Year-End Closing Configuration

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: Default sort key used for organizing and displaying line items within this account (e.g., by posting date, document number, reference). Enhances usability in transaction review and reconciliation.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to enhanced SOX internal controls and audit requirements due to materiality or risk profile. Triggers additional approval workflows and audit logging.

attributes.name: tax_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this account are subject to tax calculation and reporting. Used to identify accounts that require tax code assignment during transaction entry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Tax Configuration, IFRS Tax Standards (IAS 12)

attributes.name: tolerance_group
attributes.description: Configuration key defining posting and clearing tolerances for this account, including maximum amounts, payment differences, and exchange rate variances permitted during transaction processing.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this chart of accounts entry becomes effective and available for use in financial transactions. Supports time-dependent account structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Master Data Time Dependency

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this chart of accounts entry remains valid. Null indicates the account is valid indefinitely. Used for account retirement and historical reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Master Data Time Dependency

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Master entity for cost center accounting representing organizational units to which costs are assigned. Tracks cost center hierarchy, responsible manager, controlling area, profit center assignment, budget period, and cost center type (logistics operations, warehouse, fleet, corporate). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance CO module.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center. Primary key for the cost center master entity.

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent cost center in the cost center hierarchy. Enables roll-up reporting and hierarchical cost aggregation. Null for top-level cost centers.

attributes.name: primary_cost_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager or employee responsible for this cost center. This person is accountable for budget adherence, cost control, and operational performance of the cost center.
attributes.references: Workday HCM, SAP S/4HANA Finance CO Module

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_program. Business justification: Safety programs (driver safety, DG handling, facility safety, contractor safety) are organized as cost centers in transport operations. Finance tracks program costs (training, equipment, audits, perso

attributes.name: tpl_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.tpl_provider. Business justification: Warehouse and distribution cost centers operated by 3PL providers require provider attribution for cost allocation, performance management, and 3PL billing reconciliation. Standard in outsourced logis

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: The primary activity type performed by this cost center for activity-based costing. Examples include machine hours, labor hours, shipment volume, or handling units. Used for internal cost allocation and activity driver analysis.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The default percentage used for proportional cost allocation from this cost center to other cost objects. Expressed as a percentage value between 0 and 100. Null if allocation method is not percentage-based.

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: The total approved budget amount for this cost center for the current fiscal year, expressed in the cost center's currency. Used for budget vs actual variance analysis and cost control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance CO Module, IFRS

attributes.name: budget_period
attributes.description: The budgeting cycle period for this cost center. Annual indicates yearly budget planning. Quarterly indicates budget set every quarter. Monthly indicates monthly budget allocation. Determines the frequency of budget vs actual variance reporting.

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the current budget plan. Enables tracking of budget revisions, forecasts, and what-if scenarios. Examples include original budget, revised budget, forecast.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: The business area to which this cost center is assigned. Business area represents a distinct line of business or product segment for cross-company reporting.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The company code representing the legal entity to which this cost center is assigned. Used for external financial reporting and legal consolidation.

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: The controlling area to which this cost center belongs. Controlling area is the highest organizational unit in cost accounting, typically representing a legal entity or business unit for internal management reporting.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: The method used to allocate costs from this cost center to other cost objects or profit centers. Direct indicates costs are directly assigned. Activity-based uses activity drivers. Proportional uses percentage splits. Driver-based uses volume or usage metrics. Fixed percentage uses predetermined allocation keys.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance CO Module, IFRS

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: Functional category of the cost center for management reporting and cost allocation. Production includes operational hubs and sorting centers. Service includes customer support and claims processing. Administrative includes back-office functions. Sales includes business development and account management. Distribution includes warehouses and last-mile delivery. Research and development includes innovation and process improvement. Quality assurance includes compliance and audit. Maintenance includes fleet and facility upkeep. attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the cost center in financial systems and reports. Used as the business identifier in chart of accounts and financial postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance CO Module, IFRS

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the cost center's purpose, scope, and responsibilities. Provides additional context beyond the cost center name for reporting and documentation purposes.

attributes.name: cost_center_group
attributes.description: Grouping classification for aggregating cost centers in management reports. Examples include regional groupings, functional groupings, or business line groupings.

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the cost center, identifying the organizational unit or function to which costs are assigned.

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. Active indicates the cost center is operational and accepting cost postings. Inactive indicates temporary suspension. Blocked prevents new postings. Pending closure indicates scheduled deactivation. Closed indicates the cost center is no longer in use and historical only.

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by its primary business function. Logistics operations include hubs and sorting facilities, warehouse includes distribution centers, fleet includes vehicle operations, corporate includes headquarters functions, sales includes customer-facing units, administration includes back-office support, support includes IT and HR, revenue-generating includes units with direct revenue attribution, cost-absorbing includes pure cost units. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: logistics_operations|warehouse|fleet|corporate|sales|administration|support|revenue_generating|cost_absorbing — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cost_element_group
attributes.description: The primary cost element group associated with this cost center, defining the types of costs that can be posted. Examples include personnel costs, material costs, services, depreciation, or external services.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the cost center is domiciled. Used for country-level financial reporting and tax compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance CO Module, SOX

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which this cost center's budget and actual costs are tracked. Typically the local currency of the cost center's operating location.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The department code to which this cost center belongs within the organizational structure. Used for departmental reporting and organizational hierarchy navigation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance CO Module, Workday HCM

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: The division code representing the highest-level organizational unit to which this cost center belongs. Used for divisional P&L reporting and strategic business unit analysis.

attributes.name: fte_count
attributes.description: The number of full-time equivalent employees assigned to this cost center. Used for productivity analysis, cost per FTE calculations, and workforce planning. Decimal values accommodate part-time and fractional allocations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM, SAP S/4HANA Finance CO Module

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: The functional area classification for this cost center, used for cost-of-sales accounting and functional expense reporting per IFRS requirements.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The level of this cost center in the organizational hierarchy. Level 1 represents top-level cost centers, with increasing numbers representing deeper nesting. Used for hierarchical reporting and drill-down analysis.

attributes.name: is_overhead
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this cost center represents overhead costs that must be allocated to other cost objects. True for administrative, support, and shared service cost centers. False for direct operational cost centers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance CO Module, IFRS

attributes.name: is_revenue_generating
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this cost center directly generates revenue. True for cost centers with direct customer billing or revenue attribution. False for pure cost centers. Used for profitability analysis and contribution margin reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the person who last modified this cost center record. Used for audit trail and accountability per SOX requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance CO Module, SOX

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was last updated. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance CO Module, SOX

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: The physical location or site code where this cost center operates. Used for geographic cost analysis and facility-based reporting.

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this cost center is locked for posting. True prevents any new cost postings. False allows normal posting activity. Used during period-end close and audit processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance CO Module, SOX

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: The planning group to which this cost center belongs for budget planning and forecasting processes. Enables collaborative planning across related cost centers.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center to which this cost center is assigned for segment reporting and profitability analysis. Enables P&L reporting at the profit center level by aggregating revenues and costs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance CO Module, IFRS 8

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Regional classification code for the cost center, used for regional management reporting and performance analysis.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction code applicable to this cost center for tax reporting and compliance. Used for VAT, GST, and other indirect tax calculations and filings.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost center became active and eligible to receive cost postings. Represents the start of the cost center's operational lifecycle.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this cost center remains active. Null for cost centers with no planned end date. Used for cost center lifecycle management and historical reporting.

attributes.name: ifrs_reporting_period_flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: number_of_days

attributes.name: number_of_working_days

attributes.name: period_description

attributes.name: period_end_close_completed_timestamp

attributes.name: quarter

products.name: budget
products.description: Master entity for CAPEX and OPEX budget planning and control. Captures approved budget amounts by cost center, profit center, GL account, fiscal year, and budget version (original, revised, forecast). Tracks budget type (CAPEX for fleet/facility investments, OPEX for operational expenditure), approval status, and budget holder. Supports EBITDA planning and variance analysis.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget record. Primary key.

attributes.name: budget_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or executive who approved this budget.

attributes.name: budget_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this budget record. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: budget_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager responsible for this budget. The budget holder has authority to approve expenditures against this budget.

attributes.name: budget_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this budget record. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: business_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the business unit (e.g., Express Parcel, Freight Forwarding, Warehouse) for segmented budget planning.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the General Ledger account in the chart of accounts to which this budget is assigned.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity company code for which this budget is defined. Required for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center to which this budget is allocated. Cost centers represent organizational units responsible for costs.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center for EBITDA planning and P&L reporting. Profit centers are responsible for both revenue and costs.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_program. Business justification: Safety programs have dedicated annual budgets for training, equipment, audits, and compliance activities. Finance allocates budgets to programs, tracks consumption against plan, and reports variances

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the approved budget that has been allocated or committed to specific projects, purchase orders, or cost objects.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget was formally approved by the authorized budget committee or executive.

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: The total approved budget amount for this fiscal period and cost/profit center. This is the baseline for variance analysis.

attributes.name: available_amount
attributes.description: The remaining budget available for allocation or spending. Calculated as approved_amount minus allocated_amount minus consumed_amount.

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the budget by functional area or spend category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: personnel|fleet|facility|technology|marketing|operations|administrative — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: budget_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the budget. Used for cross-system reference and reporting.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget record indicating approval and activation state.

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of budget as Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) for fleet/facility investments or Operating Expenditure (OPEX) for operational costs.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 16 - Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: consumed_amount
attributes.description: The actual expenditure or consumption against this budget to date. Used for variance analysis and budget control.

attributes.name: control_method
attributes.description: The enforcement method for budget overruns: advisory (no restriction), warning (alert but allow), or blocking (prevent overspend).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this budget record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the budget amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: ebitda_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization) Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line impacts EBITDA calculation for financial reporting and performance measurement.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this budget becomes active and available for allocation and spending.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget expires or is closed. Nullable for open-ended budgets.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period within the year (Q1-Q4 for quarterly, M01-M12 for monthly, FY for full year).

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this budget is planned and allocated. Format: YYYY.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this budget record was last modified. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget is locked for changes. Locked budgets cannot be modified without special authorization.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this budget, including justifications, assumptions, or special instructions.

attributes.name: planning_scenario
attributes.description: The planning scenario or assumption set used for this budget (e.g., base case, optimistic growth, pessimistic downturn).

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget is subject to SOX financial controls and audit requirements.

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory within the budget category for granular spend tracking (e.g., salaries, vehicle maintenance, warehouse rent).

attributes.name: tolerance_percentage
attributes.description: The allowable percentage variance from the approved budget before control actions are triggered. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version of the budget indicating whether it is the original approved budget, a revised budget, a forecast, or a rolling budget update.

products.name: budget_line
products.description: Line-item detail of budget allocations broken down by period, GL account, cost element, and organizational unit. Enables monthly/quarterly budget phasing, actuals-vs-budget variance tracking, and drill-down analysis for CAPEX fleet acquisitions, warehouse OPEX, and freight forwarding operational costs.

attributes.name: budget_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget line item. Primary key for the budget line product.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent budget header or master budget plan to which this line item belongs.

attributes.name: business_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the business unit or division responsible for this budget line, enabling segment-level P&L and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger account to which this budget line is allocated, aligning with the chart of accounts.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: commitment_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commitment item or budget category used in public sector or fund-based budgeting, enabling compliance with governmental accounting standards.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity or company code for which this budget line is allocated, enabling multi-entity financial consolidation.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for this budget line, enabling departmental and operational cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: cost_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost element (primary or secondary) that classifies the nature of the expense or revenue for this budget line.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Cost Element Accounting

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Budget lines have fiscal_year and fiscal_period (INT) but no FK to the fiscal_period entity. Linking enables period-level budget vs actual reporting and period status validation.

attributes.name: fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fund or financial source from which this budget line is financed, enabling fund-based budget management.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal order used for tracking specific operational initiatives or overhead activities, enabling order-based cost control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Internal Order Accounting

attributes.name: primary_budget_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager responsible for managing and controlling this budget line, enabling accountability and budget ownership.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Budget lines can be allocated to profit centers for segment-level budget control. The parent budget has profit_center_id but the line items need their own for granular allocation.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the project or capital investment program to which this budget line is allocated, enabling project-based CAPEX tracking.

attributes.name: quaternary_budget_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this budget line record, enabling accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: tertiary_budget_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this budget line record, enabling accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the WBS element within a project hierarchy, enabling granular tracking of budget allocations for complex capital projects.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the budget line, indicating whether it is in draft, pending approval, approved, rejected, or locked for the period.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this budget line was approved, supporting audit trail and financial control requirements.

attributes.name: audit_trail_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether detailed audit trail logging is enabled for this budget line, capturing all changes for compliance and forensic analysis.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: The allocated budget amount for this line item in the specified period and currency, representing the planned expenditure or revenue target.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country to which this budget line applies, enabling country-level budget reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this budget line record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budget amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP), enabling multi-currency budget management.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate used to convert the budget amount from transaction currency to local or group currency.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21 - The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year for which this budget line applies, typically 1-12 for monthly or 1-4 for quarterly.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this budget line is allocated, typically a four-digit year (e.g., 2024).
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The geographic region or market to which this budget line applies, enabling regional budget analysis and variance tracking.

attributes.name: group_currency_amount
attributes.description: The budget amount converted to the group reporting currency, enabling enterprise-wide consolidation and EBITDA tracking.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21 - The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this budget line record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: line_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering number of this line item within the parent budget, enabling consistent display and drill-down analysis.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The budget amount converted to the local currency of the company code, enabling consolidated reporting across entities.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21 - The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this budget line is locked and cannot be modified, typically set after period close or final approval.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context, justification, or assumptions for this budget line allocation.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The planned quantity or volume associated with this budget line (e.g., number of shipments, TEU, FTE headcount), enabling unit-based budget analysis.

attributes.name: service_line
attributes.description: The service line or product category to which this budget line applies (e.g., Express Parcel, Freight Forwarding, Warehousing), enabling service-level budget tracking.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this budget line is subject to SOX financial controls and requires enhanced audit trail and approval workflows.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the budget quantity (e.g., TEU, FTE, shipments, kilometers), providing context for volume-based budgeting.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The budgeted price per unit of measure, enabling calculation of total budget amount from quantity and unit price.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The start date from which this budget line is effective, enabling time-based budget phasing and validity tracking.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The end date until which this budget line is effective, enabling time-based budget phasing and validity tracking.

products.name: accounts_payable
products.description: Transactional entity managing all vendor payables and supplier invoices within Transport Shipping. Tracks carrier payment obligations, 3PL/4PL vendor invoices, fuel supplier payables, customs duty payables, and intercompany payables. Captures invoice receipt date, due date, payment terms, discount conditions, payment block status, and aging bucket. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance AP module.

attributes.name: accounts_payable_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accounts payable record. Primary key for the accounts payable entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: Carrier freight invoices are processed through AP for payment of transportation services. Essential for carrier payment processing, freight cost accounting, and carrier spend analysis - core logistics

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the general ledger account to which this payable is posted. Links to the chart of accounts for financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the legal entity or company code responsible for this payable. Used for financial consolidation and legal reporting.

attributes.name: contractor_safety_prequal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.contractor_safety_prequal. Business justification: Contractor payment authorization requires valid safety prequalification. Finance verifies contractor safety status before processing invoices to ensure compliance with safety policies and reduce liabi

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center to which this expense is allocated. Used for internal cost accounting and management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: document_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_package. Business justification: AP payment approval for freight invoices requires complete document packages (POD, signed BOL, customs clearance) to validate service delivery and resolve disputes. Essential for three-way match, paym

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: accounts_payable has posting_date but no FK to fiscal_period. AP postings occur in fiscal periods and should reference master calendar for period-end close and aging analysis by period.

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.payment_run. Business justification: accounts_payable has payment_reference_number (STRING) and payment_date but no FK to payment_run. When AP invoices are paid via automated payment run, they should reference the payment_run entity for

attributes.name: primary_accounts_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created this accounts payable record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the profit center responsible for this expense. Used for segment reporting and EBITDA analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier to whom payment is owed. Links to carrier, 3PL/4PL provider, fuel supplier, customs broker, or other service provider.

attributes.name: tax_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.tax_account. Business justification: accounts_payable has tax_code (STRING) and tax_jurisdiction_code but no FK to tax_account master. Tax accounting requires reference to tax account master for proper tax reporting and compliance. Norma

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: The aging category of the payable based on days outstanding from the due date. Used for cash flow forecasting and vendor relationship management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance AP Aging Report

attributes.name: audit_trail_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed audit logging is enabled for this payable record. Required for regulatory compliance and internal controls.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The reference date from which payment terms are calculated. Typically the invoice date or goods receipt date depending on payment term configuration.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number that cleared this open payable item. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this accounts payable record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the invoice amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for multi-currency accounting and foreign exchange management.

attributes.name: days_outstanding
attributes.description: The number of days the invoice has been outstanding since the invoice date. Used for aging analysis and payment prioritization.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The early payment discount amount available if payment is made within the discount period. Calculated based on payment terms.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice is under dispute. Triggers dispute resolution workflow and payment hold.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the invoice dispute. Provides context for resolution and vendor communication.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment must be made to the vendor to comply with payment terms and avoid late fees.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the invoice currency to the company code local currency. Used for multi-currency transactions.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The goods receipt document number confirming delivery of goods or services. Used for three-way matching and accrual accounting.

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payable is an intercompany transaction between legal entities within Transport Shipping. Used for consolidation elimination.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the vendor invoice was issued. Used for aging calculations and payment term determination.

attributes.name: invoice_gross_amount
attributes.description: The total invoice amount before any deductions, discounts, or adjustments. Represents the full vendor claim.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The vendor-issued invoice number or document reference. This is the externally-known identifier for the payable transaction.

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was received by Transport Shipping. Used for internal processing SLA tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: The type of invoice document. Distinguishes between standard invoices, credit memos, debit memos, prepayments, and intercompany transactions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this accounts payable record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The net payable amount converted to the company code local currency using the exchange rate. Used for financial reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: net_payable_amount
attributes.description: The net amount payable to the vendor after all deductions, discounts, and adjustments. This is the amount that will be paid.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about this payable. Used for communication and documentation.

attributes.name: payable_category
attributes.description: The business category of the payable. Classifies vendor invoices by service type for spend analysis and vendor management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: carrier|3pl_4pl|fuel|customs_duty|warehouse|equipment|intercompany|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_block_code
attributes.description: Code indicating if payment is blocked and the reason for the block (e.g., dispute, missing documentation, approval pending, quality issue). Empty if no block exists.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Payment Block Configuration

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the payment is blocked. Provides context for resolution and audit purposes.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date payment was made to the vendor. Used for cash flow reporting and vendor payment performance tracking.

attributes.name: payment_method_code
attributes.description: The method by which payment will be made to the vendor (e.g., wire transfer, ACH, check, electronic funds transfer).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Payment Method Configuration

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number assigned when payment is made. Links the payable to the actual payment transaction for reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: The current payment status of the accounts payable record. Tracks the lifecycle from open invoice through payment completion.

attributes.name: payment_term_code
attributes.description: The code representing the payment terms agreed with the vendor (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Defines due date calculation and early payment discount conditions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Payment Terms Configuration

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the payable was posted to the general ledger. Determines the accounting period for financial reporting.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number associated with this payable. Used for three-way matching (PO, goods receipt, invoice) and procurement audit.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payable is subject to SOX financial controls and requires enhanced audit trail and approval workflow.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount included in the invoice (e.g., VAT, GST, sales tax). Used for tax reporting and reclaim processing.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction code for this transaction. Used for multi-jurisdictional tax reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of withholding tax deducted from the vendor payment. Required for cross-border payments and tax compliance.

products.name: accounts_receivable
products.description: Transactional entity managing all customer receivables for Transport Shipping. Tracks outstanding freight charges, express delivery fees, customs brokerage fees, warehousing charges, and e-commerce fulfillment fees owed by B2B enterprise accounts and B2C shippers.
