Captures invoice date, due date, payment terms, dunning level, credit limit exposure, and aging bucket. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance AR module.

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accounts receivable record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger account where this receivable is posted. Typically a trade receivables account in the chart of accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity company code that owns this receivable. Used for financial consolidation and statutory reporting per IFRS requirements.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center associated with this receivable for internal cost allocation and management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that owes this receivable. Links to the customer master data for B2B enterprise accounts and B2C shippers.

attributes.name: document_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_package. Business justification: AR for freight charges requires complete document packages (signed delivery receipt, POD, customs clearance) for revenue recognition under ASC 606 and collection enforcement. Essential for revenue rec

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: accounts_receivable has posting_date but no FK to fiscal_period. AR postings occur in fiscal periods and should reference master calendar for period-end close and aging analysis by period.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice document that generated this receivable. Links to billing invoice for freight charges, express delivery fees, customs brokerage fees, warehousing charges, or e-commerce fulfillment fees.

attributes.name: primary_accounts_employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID of the person or system process that created this receivable record. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center responsible for this receivable. Used for internal P&L reporting and EBITDA tracking by service line or geographic region.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: tax_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.tax_account. Business justification: accounts_receivable has tax_jurisdiction_code (STRING) but no FK to tax_account master. AR tax accounting requires reference to tax account master for proper tax reporting.

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: The aging category of this receivable based on days past due: current (not yet due), 1_30_days, 31_60_days, 61_90_days, over_90_days. Used for credit risk assessment and collection prioritization.
attributes.references: IFRS IFRS 9 - Financial Instruments (Expected Credit Loss)

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The reference date from which payment terms are calculated. Typically the invoice date or goods receipt date depending on contract terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Payment Terms Configuration

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: The business area code for segment reporting per IFRS 8. Used to classify receivables by service line: express parcel delivery, freight forwarding, supply chain management, customs brokerage, warehousing, e-commerce fulfillment.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date when this receivable was cleared (fully or partially paid). Used for days sales outstanding (DSO) calculation and cash collection analysis.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the payment or credit memo that cleared this receivable. Populated when receivable status is fully_paid or partially_paid.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this accounts receivable record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: credit_limit_exposure
attributes.description: The portion of the customer's credit limit consumed by this receivable. Used for credit risk management and order release decisions.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for this receivable (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for multi-currency accounting and foreign exchange management.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: The customer segment classification for this receivable: b2b_enterprise for large corporate accounts, b2b_sme for small/medium business, b2c_individual for consumer shippers, government for public sector, ecommerce_seller for online marketplace sellers.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: The number of days this receivable is overdue calculated as current date minus due date. Negative values indicate not yet due. Used for aging analysis and dunning.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The cash discount amount available if the customer pays within the discount period specified in payment terms (e.g., 2% if paid within 10 days).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Payment Terms Discount

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the customer has raised a dispute on this receivable. True when under dispute, requiring resolution before collection.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the source invoice or billing document. May differ from posting date due to processing delays.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number for this receivable in the financial system. Used for audit trails and customer communication.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type of receivable document: invoice for standard billing, credit_memo for customer credits, debit_memo for additional charges, payment_on_account for advance payments, down_payment for partial prepayments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Document Type Configuration

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is expected from the customer based on agreed payment terms. Used for cash flow forecasting and dunning.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: The current dunning level for this receivable indicating escalation stage of collection efforts (0=no dunning, 1=first reminder, 2=second reminder, 3=final notice, 4=legal action). Used for automated collection workflows.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate used to convert the transaction currency to local currency at the time of posting. Used for foreign currency valuation and revaluation.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21 - The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total gross amount of the receivable before any discounts, taxes, or adjustments. Includes all freight charges, express delivery fees, customs brokerage fees, warehousing charges, and e-commerce fulfillment fees.
attributes.references: IFRS IFRS 15 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this receivable is from an intercompany transaction between legal entities within Transport Shipping. True for intercompany receivables requiring elimination in consolidation.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was issued to the customer. Starting point for payment terms calculation and aging analysis.
attributes.references: IFRS IFRS 15 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: The date when the last dunning notice was sent to the customer. Used to track collection activity and determine next dunning action.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this accounts receivable record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: The local currency code of the company code for statutory reporting. Used for currency translation and consolidation per IFRS requirements.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net amount due from the customer after all discounts and adjustments. This is the amount expected to be collected and used for cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: IFRS IFRS 15 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes field for additional information about this receivable: special payment arrangements, dispute details, collection actions taken, or other relevant comments.

attributes.name: outstanding_amount
attributes.description: The current outstanding balance on this receivable after partial payments or credits have been applied. Zero when fully paid.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Open Item Management

attributes.name: payment_block_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this receivable is blocked for payment processing due to disputes, compliance holds, or manual review requirements. True when blocked.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Payment Block Configuration

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The expected or agreed payment method for this receivable: bank transfer, credit card, check, cash, electronic funds transfer, letter of credit, etc. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bank_transfer|credit_card|debit_card|check|cash|eft|wire_transfer|ach|letter_of_credit|cod — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Payment Method Configuration

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The code representing the payment terms agreed with the customer (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30 for 2% discount if paid within 10 days).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Payment Terms Master Data

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when this receivable was posted to the general ledger. Used for financial period assignment and accounting close processes.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: receivable_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the receivable: open for unpaid, partially_paid for partial payment received, fully_paid when settled, written_off for bad debt, disputed for customer disputes, under_collection for legal collection process.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Open Item Management

attributes.name: service_line
attributes.description: The primary service line that generated this receivable. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: express_parcel|air_freight|ocean_freight|road_freight|rail_freight|warehousing|customs_brokerage|ecommerce_fulfillment|contract_logistics|last_mile — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this receivable is subject to SOX internal controls and audit requirements. True for material receivables requiring enhanced documentation and approval workflows.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount included in this receivable (VAT, GST, sales tax, etc.) based on applicable tax jurisdiction and customer tax classification.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction code applicable to this receivable for VAT, GST, or sales tax reporting. Used for statutory tax filings and compliance.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Tax Jurisdiction Standards

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The date when this receivable was written off as bad debt. Used for bad debt expense tracking and credit loss reporting per IFRS 9.

attributes.name: write_off_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this receivable has been written off as bad debt. True when deemed uncollectible and removed from active receivables.

attributes.name: write_off_reason_code
attributes.description: The code indicating the reason for write-off: customer bankruptcy, uncollectible after legal action, small balance write-off, etc. Used for bad debt analysis.

products.name: payment_run
products.description: Transactional entity representing automated payment run executions for vendor disbursements. Captures payment run date, payment method (ACH, wire, check), bank account, total payment amount, number of invoices cleared, payment run status, and posting document reference. Supports carrier payment processing, customs duty disbursements, and fuel supplier settlements. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance AP payment program.

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment run execution. Primary key for the payment run entity.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.bank_account. Business justification: payment_run has bank_account_number (STRING) and house_bank_id (BIGINT) but no FK to bank_account master. Payment runs execute from specific bank accounts and must reference the bank_account master fo

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the company code executing this payment run. Represents the legal entity making disbursements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Company Code Master

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: payment_run has fiscal_year (INT) and fiscal_period (INT) but no FK to fiscal_period master. Payment runs are posted to fiscal periods for cash flow reporting and should reference master calendar.

attributes.name: payment_proposal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment proposal that was approved and executed as this payment run. Links to the pre-run selection and approval process.

attributes.name: primary_payment_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved this payment run for execution. Required for SOX compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: quaternary_payment_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this payment run record. Part of the audit trail for financial controls.

attributes.name: tertiary_payment_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this payment run record. Part of the audit trail for financial controls.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment run required managerial approval before execution due to amount thresholds or policy requirements. True if approval was required.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment run was approved for execution. Part of the audit trail for financial controls.

attributes.name: audit_trail_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed audit logging is enabled for this payment run, capturing all changes and approvals. True for enhanced audit trail.

attributes.name: bank_confirmation_number
attributes.description: The confirmation or reference number provided by the bank upon successful receipt and processing of the payment file.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment run record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all payments in this run. All disbursements within a single payment run are typically in the same currency.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error or exception message if the payment run failed or encountered issues during execution. Used for troubleshooting and resolution.

attributes.name: execution_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment run was executed and payment file was generated.

attributes.name: invoice_count
attributes.description: The total number of vendor invoices cleared and paid in this payment run execution.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment run record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: net_disbursement_amount
attributes.description: The net amount actually disbursed to vendors after discounts, withholding taxes, and other adjustments. Represents the actual cash outflow.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about this payment run. Used for operational communication and documentation.

attributes.name: payment_block_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether payment blocks on individual invoices were manually overridden to include them in this payment run. True if overrides were applied.

attributes.name: payment_file_name
attributes.description: The name of the electronic payment file (e.g., ACH file, wire transfer file) generated for bank transmission. Used for reconciliation and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: payment_file_transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the payment file was transmitted to the bank for processing.

attributes.name: payment_method_code
attributes.description: The payment instrument used for disbursements in this run. ACH (Automated Clearing House), WIRE (wire transfer), CHECK (paper check), EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer), SEPA (Single Euro Payments Area), BACS (Bankers Automated Clearing Services).

attributes.name: payment_run_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment run was executed. Represents the business event timestamp for the disbursement batch.

attributes.name: payment_run_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the payment run execution. Externally visible reference number used in SAP payment program and vendor communications.

attributes.name: payment_run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment run execution. Tracks progression from scheduling through completion or failure.

attributes.name: payment_run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment run based on its purpose and processing priority. REGULAR (standard scheduled run), URGENT (expedited processing), MANUAL (ad-hoc run), SCHEDULED (automated recurring), INTERCOMPANY (internal settlements).

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The standard payment terms applied to invoices in this payment run (e.g., NET30, 2/10NET30). Used for discount calculation and due date determination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Payment Terms Master

attributes.name: posting_document_number
attributes.description: The financial document number generated in the general ledger when this payment run was posted. Used for GL reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payment run was fully reconciled with bank statements and confirmed cleared.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of bank reconciliation for this payment run. Indicates whether all payments have been confirmed cleared by the bank and matched to bank statements.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment run is subject to SOX internal control requirements and enhanced audit trail. True for material payment runs requiring additional controls.

attributes.name: total_discount_amount
attributes.description: The aggregate amount of early payment discounts taken across all invoices cleared in this payment run.

attributes.name: total_payment_amount
attributes.description: The aggregate gross amount of all payments disbursed in this payment run, before any adjustments or fees.

attributes.name: total_withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The aggregate amount of withholding tax deducted from vendor payments in this run, as required by tax regulations.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment amounts are debited from the company's bank account. May differ from payment run date due to banking processing times.

attributes.name: vendor_count
attributes.description: The total number of unique vendors receiving payments in this payment run.

products.name: intercompany_settlement
products.description: Transactional entity managing intercompany financial settlements between Transport Shipping legal entities and subsidiaries. Captures cross-border intercompany charges for shared services (fleet, warehouse, IT), transfer pricing adjustments, intercompany loan interest, netting agreements, and elimination entries for consolidated P&L reporting. Tracks settlement status, netting run reference, and IFRS elimination flag.

attributes.name: intercompany_settlement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intercompany settlement transaction. Primary key.

attributes.name: elimination_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consolidation elimination journal entry that offsets this intercompany settlement in the group's consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: intercompany_settlement has posting_date but no FK to fiscal_period. Intercompany settlements are posted to fiscal periods and should reference master calendar for period-end close and intercompany re

attributes.name: netting_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master netting agreement contract that governs the terms and conditions for offsetting intercompany balances between the sender and receiver entities.

attributes.name: primary_intercompany_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved the intercompany settlement transaction for posting. Null if not yet approved or approval not required.

attributes.name: primary_intercompany_sender_company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity or subsidiary that is the sender (debtor) in the intercompany settlement transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Company Code Structure

attributes.name: primary_intercompany_sender_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center within the sender entity that incurred the cost being settled intercompany.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: primary_intercompany_sender_profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center within the sender company code that originated the intercompany charge or service.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: tax_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.tax_account. Business justification: intercompany_settlement has tax_jurisdiction_code (STRING), withholding_tax_rate, withholding_tax_amount but no FK to tax_account master. Intercompany tax accounting requires reference to tax account

attributes.name: tertiary_intercompany_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this intercompany settlement record in the system.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intercompany settlement requires management approval before posting, typically based on materiality thresholds. True if approval is required.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intercompany settlement was approved for posting. Null if not yet approved or approval not required.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany settlement was cleared through payment or netting. Null if still outstanding.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the payment or clearing transaction that settled the intercompany receivable/payable balance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this intercompany settlement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the intercompany settlement amount is due for payment, calculated based on settlement date and payment terms.

attributes.name: elimination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intercompany settlement requires elimination entries for consolidated financial reporting under IFRS 10. True if elimination is required.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert transaction currency to local or group currency for the settlement date.
attributes.references: IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: gl_account_receiver
attributes.description: The general ledger account code in the receiver company code's chart of accounts to which the intercompany payable is posted.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: gl_account_sender
attributes.description: The general ledger account code in the sender company code's chart of accounts to which the intercompany receivable is posted.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: group_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the corporate group's consolidated reporting currency.

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: The calculated interest amount for intercompany loan settlements, based on principal, rate, and period.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate percentage applied to intercompany loan settlements. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0350 for 3.5%).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this intercompany settlement record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the sender company code's local reporting currency.

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: The final settlement amount after applying tax, netting adjustments, and any other modifications. This is the amount posted to intercompany accounts.

attributes.name: netting_run_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the intercompany netting run batch that processed this settlement. Used to group settlements that were netted together.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, explanations, or supporting documentation references related to the intercompany settlement transaction.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The payment terms code defining the due date calculation and discount conditions for the intercompany settlement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Payment Terms Master Data

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting period date when the settlement is posted to the general ledger. May differ from settlement date for period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the reversal transaction that cancelled this intercompany settlement. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intercompany settlement has been reversed due to error correction or period-end adjustment. True if reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why this intercompany settlement was reversed. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Classification of the shared service or resource being settled intercompany. Aligns with Transport Shipping's shared service center structure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fleet_services|warehouse_services|it_services|hr_services|finance_services|procurement_services|legal_services|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Service Category Master Data

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value of the intercompany settlement transaction before any adjustments or netting.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the intercompany settlement transaction is executed and recorded in the general ledger.

attributes.name: settlement_document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique document number for the intercompany settlement, typically generated by SAP S/4HANA Finance. Used for audit trails and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the intercompany settlement transaction. Tracks progression from draft through posting and clearing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|posted|cleared|reversed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: settlement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intercompany settlement transaction. Determines accounting treatment and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this intercompany settlement is subject to SOX internal control requirements and audit procedures. True if SOX controls apply.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount applicable to the intercompany settlement, including VAT, GST, or withholding tax as per cross-border tax regulations.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the intercompany settlement transaction is denominated.

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method
attributes.description: The OECD-compliant transfer pricing methodology applied to determine the arm's length price for this intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date for interest calculation and cash flow valuation purposes in intercompany loan settlements.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated withholding tax amount deducted from the settlement amount for cross-border transactions.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate
attributes.description: The withholding tax rate percentage applied to cross-border intercompany settlements as per bilateral tax treaties. Expressed as a decimal.

products.name: tax_account
products.description: Master entity for tax account management covering VAT, GST, customs duty tax accounts, withholding tax, and corporate income tax obligations across Transport Shipping jurisdictions. Tracks tax code, tax type, tax rate, jurisdiction, tax authority, reporting frequency, and applicable regulatory framework (WCO, local tax authority). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance tax configuration.

attributes.name: tax_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax account record. Primary key.

attributes.name: certificate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.certificate. Business justification: Tax accounts for duty relief, VAT exemptions, or AEO status require certificates as proof of eligibility (origin certificate, AEO certificate, tax exemption certificate). Essential for customs duty re

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: tax_account has gl_account_id (BIGINT) which appears to be a generic ID, not a proper FK to chart_of_accounts. Tax accounts must reference the GL account master for proper tax accounting and financial

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the company code in SAP S/4HANA Finance to which this tax account is assigned. Represents the legal entity for financial reporting.

attributes.name: controlling_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the controlling area in SAP S/4HANA Finance for cost center accounting and internal reporting related to this tax account.

attributes.name: created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the user who created this tax account record in SAP S/4HANA Finance.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee or tax manager responsible for managing this tax account, filings, and compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the user who last modified this tax account record in SAP S/4HANA Finance.

attributes.name: aeo_status_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) Status Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) status is required to benefit from simplified procedures or reduced rates under this tax account. True if AEO status is required, False otherwise.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) SAFE Framework, EU AEO Programme

attributes.name: audit_trail_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed audit trail logging is enabled for all transactions posted to this tax account. True if audit trail is enabled, False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax account record was first created in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which tax amounts for this tax account are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: deferred_payment_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether deferred payment of tax is allowed under this tax account (e.g., customs duty deferment). True if deferred payment is allowed, False otherwise.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO), Local Customs Deferment Schemes

attributes.name: exemption_certificate_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tax exemption certificate is required to apply this tax account. True if exemption certificate is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: hs_code_applicability
attributes.description: Harmonized System (HS) code or code range to which this tax account applies, relevant for customs duty tax accounts. Used for tariff classification and customs brokerage.

attributes.name: incoterm_applicability
attributes.description: Incoterms rule(s) under which this tax account is applicable (e.g., DDP, DAP, FOB, CIF, EXW). Relevant for determining tax liability in cross-border shipments.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax account record was last modified in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax account is locked for posting. True if locked (no new postings allowed), False if unlocked (postings allowed).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this tax account, including special instructions, historical context, or compliance considerations.

attributes.name: recoverable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether tax paid under this tax account is recoverable (input tax credit). True if recoverable, False if non-recoverable.
attributes.references: Local VAT/GST Input Tax Credit Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory framework or compliance standard governing this tax account (e.g., EU VAT Directive, US IRC, WCO Harmonized System, local tax code). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EU_VAT_Directive|US_IRC|WCO_Harmonized_System|OECD_Transfer_Pricing|Local_Tax_Code|IFRS|SOX|GDPR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO), IFRS, SOX, Local Tax Authority

attributes.name: reverse_charge_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax account is subject to reverse charge mechanism where the recipient (not the supplier) is liable for VAT/GST. True if reverse charge applies, False otherwise.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive Article 196, Local VAT Regulations

attributes.name: self_assessment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax account requires self-assessment by Transport Shipping rather than being assessed by the tax authority. True if self-assessment applies, False otherwise.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax account is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal controls and audit requirements. True if SOX controls apply, False otherwise.

attributes.name: tax_account_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the tax account used in SAP S/4HANA Finance tax configuration and external reporting. Externally-known code for this tax account.

attributes.name: tax_account_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the tax account purpose, scope, and applicability within Transport Shipping operations.

attributes.name: tax_account_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the tax account for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: tax_account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax account: active (in use), inactive (not currently used), suspended (temporarily halted), pending approval (awaiting activation), or closed (permanently retired).

attributes.name: tax_authority_identifier
attributes.description: Official identifier or registration number assigned by the tax authority for this tax account or tax registration.

attributes.name: tax_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the tax authority or regulatory body responsible for this tax account (e.g., HM Revenue & Customs, IRS, local customs authority).
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO), Local Tax Authority

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Subcategory of the tax account indicating whether it is input tax (recoverable), output tax (payable), import/export tax, payroll tax, or excise tax.

attributes.name: tax_filing_method
attributes.description: Method by which tax returns and filings are submitted to the tax authority: electronic portal, paper submission, Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), or Application Programming Interface (API).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: ISO country code or extended jurisdiction code identifying the tax authority jurisdiction (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU-BY for Bavaria). Aligns with WCO and local tax authority requirements.

attributes.name: tax_point_rule
attributes.description: Rule determining the tax point (time of supply) for this tax account: invoice date, delivery date, payment date, or service completion date. Defines when tax liability arises.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive, Local Tax Authority Time of Supply Rules

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Standard tax rate percentage applicable to this tax account. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 20.00 for 20%).

attributes.name: tax_reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which tax filings and reports must be submitted to the tax authority for this tax account (monthly, quarterly, annually, semi-annually, or on-demand).

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax account by tax type: Value Added Tax (VAT), Goods and Services Tax (GST), customs duty, withholding tax, corporate income tax, or sales tax.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO), OECD Tax Guidelines

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this tax account configuration becomes effective and can be used for tax postings. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this tax account configuration remains effective. Null if the tax account is open-ended. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: withholding_rate
attributes.description: Withholding tax rate percentage applicable to this tax account for payments to non-resident suppliers or contractors. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). Null if not a withholding tax account.
attributes.references: OECD Model Tax Convention, Local Withholding Tax Regulations

products.name: tax_filing
products.description: Transactional entity tracking all tax filing submissions and obligations for Transport Shipping across global jurisdictions. Captures filing type (VAT return, corporate tax, customs duty reconciliation, withholding tax), filing period, jurisdiction, filing status (draft, submitted, accepted, amended), tax authority reference number, filing deadline, and penalty exposure. Supports SOX and IFRS regulatory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: tax_filing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax filing record. Primary key for the tax filing entity.

attributes.name: certificate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.certificate. Business justification: Tax filings for customs duties attach certificates (origin certificate, AEO certificate, phytosanitary certificate) to support duty relief claims and preferential tariff treatment. Essential for custo

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity or company code within Transport Shipping that is the taxpayer for this filing. Links to the organizational structure in SAP S/4HANA Finance.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: tax_filing has filing_period_start_date and filing_period_end_date but no FK to fiscal_period. Tax filings are period-specific and should reference master calendar for tax reporting alignment with fis

attributes.name: original_filing_tax_filing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original tax filing record that this filing amends or corrects. Null if this is an original filing.

attributes.name: primary_tax_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this tax filing record. Part of the audit trail for SOX compliance and internal controls.

attributes.name: tax_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.tax_account. Business justification: Tax filings are submitted for specific tax accounts (VAT, GST, withholding). This links the filing to the tax account master data. No columns to remove as tax_filing captures filing-specific data.

attributes.name: trade_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.trade_document. Business justification: Tax filings for customs duties, VAT, and import/export taxes reference trade documents (commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin) as supporting evidence. Critical for customs tax compli

attributes.name: amendment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this filing is an amended or corrected version of a previously submitted filing. True if this is an amendment, false if original filing.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the tax filing was formally approved for submission by the authorized approver. Part of SOX internal control audit trail.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: The name of the authorized individual who reviewed and approved the tax filing for submission. Typically a senior finance manager or tax director.

attributes.name: audit_risk_score
attributes.description: An internal risk assessment score indicating the likelihood that this filing may be selected for audit by the tax authority. Higher scores indicate higher risk.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: The confirmation or acknowledgment number provided by the tax authority upon successful receipt of the filing. Used for proof of submission.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax filing record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the tax amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: filing_deadline_date
attributes.description: The statutory deadline by which the tax filing must be submitted to the tax authority to avoid penalties or interest charges.

attributes.name: filing_method
attributes.description: The method or channel used to submit the tax filing to the tax authority (e.g., electronic portal, paper mail, EDI, API integration).

attributes.name: filing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the tax period covered by this filing. Defines the end of the reporting period for which tax obligations are calculated.

attributes.name: filing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the tax period covered by this filing. Defines the beginning of the reporting period for which tax obligations are calculated.

attributes.name: filing_reference_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique reference number assigned by the tax authority upon submission or acceptance of the filing. Used for tracking and correspondence with tax authorities.

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax filing. Tracks the filing through preparation, submission, review, and final acceptance or rejection by the tax authority.

attributes.name: filing_type
attributes.description: The category of tax filing being submitted. Determines the applicable tax regulations, forms, and submission requirements.

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: The interest charges accrued on late or underpaid tax amounts, calculated according to the tax authority's interest rate schedule.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the tax jurisdiction (country, state, province, or local authority) to which this filing is submitted. Determines applicable tax laws and rates.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax filing record was last updated. Part of the audit trail for SOX compliance and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, explanations, or special circumstances related to this tax filing. Used for internal documentation and audit trail.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the tax liability reported in this filing must be paid to the tax authority to avoid additional penalties or interest.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: The current payment status of the tax liability associated with this filing. Tracks whether the obligation has been settled with the tax authority.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The monetary penalty assessed or accrued for late filing, underpayment, or non-compliance with tax regulations. Zero if no penalty applies.

attributes.name: preparer_contact_email
attributes.description: The email address of the tax filing preparer for correspondence and audit inquiries.

attributes.name: preparer_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual or firm responsible for preparing the tax filing. May be an internal tax accountant or external tax advisor.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax filing is subject to SOX internal control requirements and audit procedures. True if SOX controls apply, false otherwise.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the tax filing was submitted to the tax authority. Used to verify compliance with filing deadlines and for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: supporting_document_count
attributes.description: The number of supporting documents, schedules, or attachments submitted with this tax filing (e.g., invoices, receipts, reconciliation reports).

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax liability or refund amount reported in this filing. Represents the net tax obligation after all adjustments, credits, and deductions.

attributes.name: tax_authority_name
attributes.description: The name of the governmental tax authority or agency responsible for receiving and processing this filing (e.g., IRS, HMRC, local customs office).

attributes.name: tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The effective tax rate percentage applied to the taxable base to calculate the tax liability. May be a statutory rate or blended rate depending on filing type.

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: The taxpayer identification number or tax registration number assigned by the tax authority to the company for this jurisdiction (e.g., VAT number, EIN, TIN).

attributes.name: taxable_base_amount
attributes.description: The gross taxable base or revenue amount upon which the tax liability is calculated, before application of tax rates and adjustments.

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Master entity for fixed asset management covering Transport Shipping's capital assets including owned vehicles, aircraft, vessels, warehouse facilities, material handling equipment, and IT infrastructure. Tracks asset class, acquisition date, acquisition cost, useful life, depreciation method (straight-line, declining balance per IFRS), net book value, asset location, and disposal status. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) module.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fixed asset record. Primary key for the fixed asset entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.capex_project. Business justification: Fixed assets are often created from CAPEX projects (asset under construction → capitalized asset). This links the asset to its originating capital investment project.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: Leased equipment (containers, trailers, aircraft) from carriers must track lessor for lease accounting (ASC 842/IFRS 16), depreciation calculations, and asset return/maintenance obligations. Critical

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: fixed_asset has gl_account_code (STRING), depreciation_gl_account_code (STRING), accumulated_depreciation_gl_account_code (STRING) but no FK to chart_of_accounts. Should reference primary asset GL acc

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the legal entity (company code) that owns this fixed asset. Used for financial consolidation and legal reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center responsible for this asset. Used for internal cost allocation and management reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: fixed_asset has acquisition_date and capitalization_date but no FK to fiscal_period. Asset capitalization occurs in a fiscal period and should reference master calendar for CAPEX reporting by period.

attributes.name: lease_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.lease_contract. Business justification: Under IFRS 16, leased assets are capitalized as right-of-use assets. This FK links the fixed asset to its lease contract for proper lease accounting.

attributes.name: primary_fixed_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or manager responsible for the custody and management of this asset. Used for accountability and asset stewardship.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, Workday HCM

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the profit center to which this asset is assigned. Used for segment reporting and EBITDA tracking.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or supplier from whom the asset was purchased. Links to procurement and accounts payable records.

attributes.name: tertiary_fixed_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this fixed asset record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation expense recognized to date since the asset was placed in service. Contra-asset account that reduces the gross book value to net book value.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation_gl_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Accumulated Depreciation General Ledger (GL) Account Code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for the accumulated depreciation contra-asset account. Used for balance sheet reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance, IFRS Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original purchase price or historical cost of the asset including all costs necessary to bring the asset to its intended use (purchase price, delivery, installation, testing). Basis for depreciation calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was acquired or purchased by Transport Shipping. Marks the start of the asset's lifecycle and is used for depreciation calculation start date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: Classification code that categorizes the asset by type (e.g., vehicles, aircraft, vessels, warehouse facilities, material handling equipment, IT infrastructure). Determines depreciation rules, useful life defaults, and GL account assignments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: asset_class_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the asset class (e.g., Delivery Vehicles, Cargo Aircraft, Container Ships, Warehouse Buildings, Forklifts, Servers).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the fixed asset including make, model, specifications, and distinguishing characteristics. Used for identification and inventory purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module

attributes.name: asset_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the physical location where the asset is deployed (e.g., warehouse facility code, airport code, depot code, office location code). Used for asset tracking and inventory management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module

attributes.name: asset_location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the physical location where the asset is deployed (e.g., Chicago Distribution Center, Frankfurt Airport Hub, Singapore Port Terminal).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the fixed asset. Used for asset tracking, reporting, and audit trails. Typically assigned by the Asset Accounting module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset. Determines whether depreciation is active and whether the asset is available for operational use.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: asset_sub_number
attributes.description: Sub-asset identifier used when a main asset has multiple components tracked separately (e.g., engine, avionics, landing gear for an aircraft). Enables component-level depreciation and maintenance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module

attributes.name: capex_category
attributes.description: Classification of the capital expenditure type for budgeting and strategic planning purposes. Distinguishes between growth investments, maintenance, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance, CAPEX Planning Framework

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was placed in service and capitalized on the balance sheet. Depreciation begins from this date. May differ from acquisition date for assets under construction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the asset is physically located. Used for tax jurisdiction, regulatory compliance, and geographic reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fixed asset record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts associated with this asset (acquisition cost, net book value, accumulated depreciation).

attributes.name: depreciation_gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which depreciation expense is posted. Used for P&L reporting of depreciation charges.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance, IFRS Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to allocate the cost of the asset over its useful life. Straight-line is most common for IFRS compliance; declining balance may be used for tax purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was disposed of, sold, scrapped, or retired from service. Marks the end of the asset's lifecycle and triggers gain/loss calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Method by which the asset was disposed of. Determines accounting treatment for gain/loss recognition and tax implications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Amount received from the sale or disposal of the asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal (proceeds minus net book value at disposal).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: impairment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the asset has been tested for impairment and an impairment loss has been recognized. Required under IFRS IAS 36 when carrying value exceeds recoverable amount.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 36

attributes.name: impairment_loss_amount
attributes.description: Amount of impairment loss recognized when the asset's recoverable amount falls below its carrying value. Reduces net book value and is recognized as an expense.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 36

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number covering this asset against loss, damage, or liability. Used for risk management and claims processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Vendor invoice number associated with the asset acquisition. Links to accounts payable and financial audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fixed asset record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured or produced the asset (e.g., Boeing, Mercedes-Benz, Maersk, Konecranes).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model or type designation for the asset (e.g., Boeing 747-8F, Sprinter 3500, Emma-class container ship).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the asset on the balance sheet, calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the remaining unamortized cost.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about the asset that does not fit in structured fields.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number under which the asset was acquired. Provides audit trail to procurement documentation.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life. The depreciable base is acquisition cost minus salvage value.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number or unique identifier for the physical asset. Used for warranty tracking, maintenance records, and theft prevention.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset is subject to SOX internal controls and audit requirements. High-value assets and those affecting financial reporting are typically flagged.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful economic life of the asset in years. Used to calculate annual depreciation expense. Determined by asset class and regulatory/accounting standards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting (AA) Module, IFRS IAS 16

products.name: asset_depreciation
products.description: Transactional entity recording periodic depreciation postings for fixed assets. Captures depreciation run date, depreciation area (book depreciation, tax depreciation), depreciation amount, accumulated depreciation, net book value after posting, and fiscal period. Supports IFRS 16 lease depreciation for leased fleet and warehouse assets, and CAPEX amortization tracking. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance AA depreciation run.

attributes.name: asset_depreciation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset depreciation posting record.

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CAPEX project that funded the asset acquisition (warehouse expansion, fleet modernization, IT infrastructure upgrade).

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: asset_depreciation has gl_account_depreciation_expense and gl_account_accumulated_depreciation as STRING but no FK to chart_of_accounts. Adding FK to reference the primary depreciation expense GL acco

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: asset_depreciation has company_code as STRING but no FK to company_code master. Legal entity context is essential for depreciation posting and fixed asset accounting by legal entity. Normalizing to FK

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center where the depreciation expense is allocated.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: asset_depreciation has fiscal_year (INT) and fiscal_period (INT) but no FK to fiscal_period master. Depreciation runs are period-specific and should reference the master fiscal calendar for period-end

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset being depreciated (fleet vehicle, warehouse equipment, IT infrastructure, leased facility).

attributes.name: lease_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lease contract if this is IFRS 16 lease depreciation for fleet vehicles, warehouse facilities, or office space.

attributes.name: primary_asset_employee_id
attributes.description: Twelve-character user ID of the system user or batch job that created the depreciation posting.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center for EBITDA and P&L reporting of the depreciation expense.

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total accumulated depreciation for the asset after this posting, representing cumulative depreciation since acquisition.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: asset_acquisition_date
attributes.description: Original acquisition or capitalization date of the asset being depreciated.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: asset_acquisition_value
attributes.description: Original acquisition or capitalized cost of the asset in the asset's local currency.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Eight-digit asset class code categorizing the type of fixed asset (vehicles, buildings, machinery, IT equipment, leasehold improvements).

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Twenty-character unique audit trail identifier for SOX compliance and financial audit tracking.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the business area or service line (express parcel, freight forwarding, contract logistics, e-commerce fulfillment).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the depreciation posting record was created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the depreciation amounts.

attributes.name: depreciation_amount
attributes.description: Periodic depreciation expense amount posted for this run in the asset's local currency.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: depreciation_area
attributes.description: Two-digit code identifying the depreciation area (01=book depreciation, 10=tax depreciation, 15=IFRS 16 lease depreciation, 20=group consolidation, 30=cost accounting).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting Depreciation Areas

attributes.name: depreciation_key
attributes.description: Four-character code defining the depreciation calculation method (straight-line, declining balance, units of production, IFRS 16 lease).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Asset Accounting Depreciation Keys

attributes.name: depreciation_run_date
attributes.description: Date when the depreciation calculation batch was executed.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Ten-digit accounting document number generated for the depreciation posting in the general ledger.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Two-character document type code for the depreciation posting (AF=asset posting, SA=GL document).

attributes.name: gl_account_accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Ten-digit GL account number for posting the accumulated depreciation (credit side of the journal entry, contra-asset account).

attributes.name: gl_account_depreciation_expense
attributes.description: Ten-digit GL account number for posting the depreciation expense (debit side of the journal entry).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the depreciation posting record was last modified (for corrections or reversals).

attributes.name: lease_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this depreciation relates to a leased asset under IFRS 16 (true=leased asset, false=owned asset).

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Net book value of the asset after this depreciation posting (acquisition value minus accumulated depreciation).
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the depreciation posting, including explanations for adjustments, reversals, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Accounting date when the depreciation was posted to the general ledger.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current status of the depreciation posting in the general ledger (posted=successfully posted, pending=awaiting approval, reversed=reversed posting, error=posting failed).

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this depreciation posting is a reversal of a previous posting (true=reversal, false=original posting).

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversal if reversal_indicator is true (01=correction, 02=asset transfer, 03=asset retirement, 04=revaluation, 05=period adjustment).

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Four-character segment code for IFRS segment reporting and EBITDA tracking by business line.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this depreciation posting is subject to SOX financial controls and audit requirements (true=SOX controlled, false=not SOX controlled).

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Remaining useful life of the asset in years at the time of this depreciation posting.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

products.name: cost_allocation
products.description: Transactional entity capturing internal cost allocation and assessment cycles distributing shared costs across cost centers and profit centers. Records allocation rule reference, sender cost center, receiver cost center/profit center, allocation basis (FTE headcount, shipment volume, TEU, CBM), allocated amount, and fiscal period. Enables accurate P&L reporting by service line (express, freight, warehouse, fulfillment). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance CO allocation cycles.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Cost allocations post to GL accounts. Linking to chart_of_accounts enables proper GL account validation and reporting for allocation postings.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: cost_allocation has company_code as STRING but no FK to company_code master. Cost allocations occur within legal entities and must reference company code master for proper legal entity context.

attributes.name: cost_element_id

attributes.description: Classification of the currency pairs historical volatility level. Low volatility indicates stable currency pairs (e.g., USD/EUR), high volatility indicates emerging market or commodity-linked currencies. Used for risk management and hedging decisions.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this exchange rate is subject to SOX financial controls and audit requirements. True indicates SOX-controlled rate requiring enhanced audit trail and approval workflows.

attributes.name: to_currency_code

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this exchange rate becomes effective and can be used for currency conversions. Supports temporal validity and historical rate tracking.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this exchange rate remains effective. Null indicates the rate is currently active with no defined end date. Supports temporal validity and rate expiration management.

products.name: financial_statement

attributes.name: financial_statement_id

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id

attributes.name: primary_financial_employee_id

attributes.name: prior_statement_financial_statement_id

attributes.name: quaternary_financial_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this financial statement record in the system. Audit trail field for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: quinary_financial_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this financial statement record. Audit trail field for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: tertiary_financial_reviewed_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or manager who reviewed this financial statement before approval.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this financial statement was approved by the board of directors or authorized management for publication.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 10 - Events after the Reporting Period

attributes.name: audit_opinion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the external auditor issued their audit opinion on this financial statement. Represents the auditor sign-off date.

attributes.name: audit_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the external auditor's audit report corresponding to this financial statement.

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: External audit status of the financial statement. Unaudited indicates no external audit performed; under audit indicates audit in progress; audited indicates clean audit opinion; qualified, adverse, or disclaimer opinions indicate audit exceptions or limitations.

attributes.name: comparative_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this financial statement includes comparative figures from prior periods as required by IFRS IAS 1.

attributes.name: consolidation_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the consolidation group or legal entity group to which this statement belongs, used for group-level financial reporting and intercompany eliminations.

attributes.name: consolidation_scope
attributes.description: Scope of consolidation for this financial statement. Legal entity represents a single company code; consolidated group represents parent and all subsidiaries; business unit or segment represents a sub-group for management reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this financial statement record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which this financial statement is presented (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). All monetary amounts in the statement are expressed in this currency.
