attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the published financial statement document (PDF, XBRL, or other format) stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: ebitda_reporting_segment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Reporting Segment
attributes.description: Business segment or service line for which EBITDA is reported in this financial statement (e.g., Express Parcel, Freight Forwarding, Supply Chain Management).

attributes.name: external_auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external audit firm that audited this financial statement (e.g., Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG). Required for audited statements under SOX and IFRS.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which this financial statement belongs, following the company's fiscal calendar (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: ifrs_reporting_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) Reporting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this financial statement is prepared under IFRS standards. True for entities required to report under IFRS.

attributes.name: intercompany_elimination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether intercompany transactions and balances have been eliminated in this consolidated financial statement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this financial statement record was last modified. Audit trail field for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this financial statement is locked for editing. True when the statement is finalized and published, preventing further modifications.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this financial statement, used for internal documentation and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: notes_reference
attributes.description: Reference or link to the accompanying notes to financial statements that provide detailed disclosures and explanations.

attributes.name: presentation_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code used for presentation purposes if different from the functional currency. Used when statements are translated for group consolidation.

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: Date on which this financial statement was officially published or released to external stakeholders, regulators, or the public.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this financial statement is filed with regulatory authorities (e.g., SEC, local securities commissions, tax authorities).

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the regulatory filing submission (e.g., SEC EDGAR accession number, tax filing reference).

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the financial reporting period covered by this statement. Defines the close of the period for which financial performance or position is reported.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the financial reporting period covered by this statement. Defines the beginning of the period for which financial performance or position is reported.

attributes.name: reporting_standard
attributes.description: Accounting standard framework under which this financial statement is prepared. IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) is the global standard; US GAAP applies to US entities; local GAAP and statutory standards apply per jurisdiction.

attributes.name: restatement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this financial statement is a restatement of a previously published statement due to error correction or accounting policy change.

attributes.name: restatement_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of the reason for restatement if restatement_flag is true. Describes the nature of the error or accounting policy change that necessitated the restatement.

attributes.name: segment_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this financial statement includes segment reporting disclosures as required by IFRS 8 for operating segments.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this financial statement is subject to SOX internal control requirements and audit trails. True for US public companies and their subsidiaries.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the financial statement, used for reference in audit trails, regulatory filings, and external communications.

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the financial statement. Draft indicates work in progress; preliminary indicates management review; final indicates approved for publication; published indicates externally released; restated indicates corrected after initial publication; superseded indicates replaced by a newer version.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 8 - Accounting Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates and Errors

attributes.name: statement_type
attributes.description: Type of financial statement being published. Income statement (Profit and Loss / P&L) shows revenue and expenses; balance sheet shows assets, liabilities, and equity; cash flow statement shows cash inflows and outflows; statement of changes in equity shows movements in equity accounts; notes provide supplementary disclosures.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this financial statement, incremented for each revision or restatement. Version 1 is the original publication.

attributes.name: xbrl_instance_document
attributes.business_glossary_term: Extensible Business Reporting Language (XBRL) Instance Document
attributes.description: Reference to the XBRL instance document for this financial statement, used for structured regulatory filings.

products.name: finance_audit_finding
products.description: Transactional entity recording internal and external audit findings, SOX control deficiencies, and financial control exceptions identified during audits of Transport Shipping's financial processes. Captures finding type (material weakness, significant deficiency, control gap), affected process area, risk rating, remediation owner, remediation due date, and finding status. Supports SOX Section 302/404 compliance and external auditor management.

attributes.name: finance_audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the audit finding record. Primary key.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the general ledger account affected by the audit finding, if the finding relates to a specific account or transaction type.

attributes.name: company_code_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center associated with the affected process area or control deficiency.

attributes.name: financial_control_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the specific internal control that failed or is deficient, referencing the organization's control framework documentation.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fiscal period during which the audit finding was identified.

attributes.name: previous_finding_finance_audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the previous audit finding if this is a repeat finding, linking to the original occurrence.

attributes.name: primary_finance_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or manager responsible for executing the remediation plan and ensuring the finding is resolved.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the profit center associated with the affected process area or control deficiency.

attributes.name: quaternary_finance_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified the audit finding record.

attributes.name: tertiary_finance_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created the audit finding record in the system.

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Business justification: Audit findings cite specific transport documents (AWB, BOL, CMR) as evidence of control deficiencies—missing documentation, unauthorized changes, compliance violations. Essential for audit evidence tr

attributes.name: version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_version. Business justification: Audit findings reference specific document versions to demonstrate version control failures, unauthorized amendments, or backdating. Critical for change control validation, audit evidence, and demonst

attributes.name: affected_process_area
attributes.description: Business process or functional area affected by the audit finding (e.g., Revenue Recognition, Accounts Payable, Freight Billing, Customs Compliance, Payroll Processing, Fixed Asset Management).

attributes.name: audit_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the audit period during which the finding was identified.

attributes.name: audit_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the audit period during which the finding was identified.

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Type of audit during which the finding was identified. SOX compliance audits focus on internal controls over financial reporting; internal audits are conducted by internal audit team; external audits by independent auditors; regulatory audits by government agencies; operational audits assess process efficiency; financial audits verify financial statements; IT audits assess technology controls. attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the auditor or audit firm that identified the finding (e.g., internal auditor name or external audit firm name).

attributes.name: auditor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the auditor who identified the finding. Internal auditors are employees; external auditors are independent third-party firms; regulatory auditors are government or industry body representatives.

attributes.name: control_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the internal control that is deficient or failed.

attributes.name: control_objective
attributes.description: The intended purpose or objective of the control that was not achieved, describing what the control was designed to prevent or detect.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the audit finding record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the financial impact amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: disclosure_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the finding must be disclosed in external financial reporting or regulatory filings (e.g., material weakness disclosure in 10-K). True if disclosure required; false otherwise.

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated or actual financial impact of the finding in the company's reporting currency, representing potential or actual loss, misstatement, or exposure.

attributes.name: finding_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the audit finding, including what was observed, the nature of the deficiency, and why it represents a control weakness or compliance issue.

attributes.name: finding_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the audit finding, typically formatted as audit-type prefix, year, and sequence number (e.g., SOX-2024-00123, INT-2024-00045).

attributes.name: finding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the audit finding. Open indicates newly identified; in remediation indicates corrective action underway; pending validation indicates awaiting auditor verification; closed indicates resolved and verified; deferred indicates postponed remediation; accepted risk indicates management has formally accepted the risk without remediation.

attributes.name: finding_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit finding severity and nature. Material weakness indicates a deficiency that could result in material misstatement; significant deficiency is less severe but still important; control gap indicates missing or inadequate controls; observation is informational; best practice opportunity suggests improvement; compliance violation indicates regulatory breach.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year during which the audit finding was identified.

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Date when the audit finding was first identified and documented by the auditor.

attributes.name: impact_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the potential financial or operational impact if the control deficiency is exploited or results in an error.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the audit finding record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: likelihood_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the likelihood that the control deficiency will result in a material misstatement or loss.

attributes.name: management_response
attributes.description: Management's formal response to the audit finding, including agreement or disagreement with the finding and planned corrective actions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes, comments, or context related to the audit finding, remediation progress, or validation.

attributes.name: recommendation
attributes.description: Auditor's recommended corrective action or remediation steps to address the finding and strengthen the control environment.

attributes.name: remediation_completed_date
attributes.description: Actual date when remediation activities were completed and the control deficiency was addressed.

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the remediation plan must be completed and the finding resolved.

attributes.name: remediation_owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee or manager responsible for remediation.

attributes.name: remediation_plan
attributes.description: Detailed plan outlining the specific actions, milestones, and resources required to remediate the finding and restore effective control.

attributes.name: repeat_finding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding is a repeat of a previously identified and supposedly remediated issue. True if repeat; false if new finding.

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: Date when the audit finding was formally reported to management or audit committee.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk rating assigned to the finding based on likelihood and impact assessment. Critical indicates immediate threat to financial reporting integrity; high indicates significant risk; medium indicates moderate risk; low indicates minor risk.

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis
attributes.description: Analysis of the underlying root cause(s) of the control deficiency, identifying systemic issues, process gaps, resource constraints, or other factors that led to the finding.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the finding relates to a SOX-relevant internal control over financial reporting. True if SOX-relevant; false otherwise.

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date when the auditor or internal control team validated that the remediation was effective and the finding can be closed.

products.name: internal_order
products.description: Master entity for SAP internal orders used to track costs for specific projects, capital investments, and temporary cost collection objects within Transport Shipping. Captures internal order type (CAPEX project, marketing campaign, fleet overhaul, warehouse expansion), budget, actual costs, settlement rule, and order status. Enables granular cost tracking below cost center level. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance CO-OPA module.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the internal order. Primary key for the internal order entity.

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.capex_project. Business justification: Internal orders for capital investments are linked to CAPEX projects. The internal_order has capex_flag and asset_under_construction_number suggesting CAPEX linkage.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the company code that owns this internal order. Determines legal entity and chart of accounts.

attributes.name: controlling_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the controlling area for cost accounting and internal reporting purposes.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the responsible cost center that manages this internal order. Used for organizational assignment and reporting.

attributes.name: primary_internal_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager responsible for this internal order and its budget execution.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center for EBITDA reporting and segment analysis. Optional depending on order type.

attributes.name: tertiary_internal_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this internal order record.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the WBS element if this internal order is part of a larger project structure.

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total actual costs posted to this internal order to date. Updated in real-time as costs are incurred.

attributes.name: asset_under_construction_number
attributes.description: Asset number for CAPEX orders where costs are accumulated before capitalization as a fixed asset.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 16, SAP S/4HANA Finance AA Module

attributes.name: audit_trail_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed change history and audit logging is enabled for this internal order.

attributes.name: available_budget_amount
attributes.description: Remaining budget available for spending. Calculated as budget minus actual minus committed costs.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved budget amount allocated to this internal order for cost control and variance analysis.

attributes.name: budget_control_active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether budget availability checking is enforced for this internal order. When true, postings exceeding budget are blocked.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the business area or division for segment reporting purposes.

attributes.name: capex_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this internal order tracks capital expenditure that will be capitalized as an asset.

attributes.name: committed_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total committed costs (purchase orders, reservations) against this internal order that have not yet been invoiced.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this internal order record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for budget and cost tracking on this internal order.

attributes.name: final_settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when the internal order costs were finally settled to receiving cost objects and the order was closed.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the functional area (operations, sales, administration) for cost classification.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this internal order record was last updated.

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this internal order is locked for further postings or changes. Used during period-end close.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, instructions, or context about this internal order.

attributes.name: opex_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this internal order tracks operating expenditure that will be expensed in the current period.

attributes.name: order_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the internal order for financial reporting and cost allocation purposes.

attributes.name: order_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the internal order purpose, scope, and objectives.

attributes.name: order_end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual end date of the internal order activities. After this date, the order should be settled and closed.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the internal order used in SAP and external reporting. Externally-known unique code for tracking and reference.

attributes.name: order_short_text
attributes.description: Brief descriptive text for the internal order used in reports and transaction displays.

attributes.name: order_start_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual start date of the internal order activities. Defines the beginning of the cost collection period.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the internal order. Controls whether costs can be posted and whether settlement is allowed.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the internal order indicating its business purpose. Determines cost tracking rules and settlement behavior.

attributes.name: planning_integrated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this internal order is integrated with SAP planning and budgeting processes.

attributes.name: settlement_receiver_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific cost object (asset number, cost center code, GL account) that receives settled costs.

attributes.name: settlement_receiver_type
attributes.description: Type of cost object that receives settled costs from this internal order.

attributes.name: settlement_rule_type
attributes.description: Method used to settle costs from this internal order to receiving cost objects such as assets, cost centers, or general ledger accounts.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this internal order is subject to SOX financial controls and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: statistical_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical internal order used for informational tracking only without actual cost postings.

attributes.name: technical_completion_date

products.name: bank_statement_line
products.description: Transactional entity capturing individual bank statement line items for reconciliation against Transport Shipping's accounts payable and accounts receivable. Records value date, transaction date, debit/credit indicator, transaction amount, currency, bank transaction code, counterparty name, payment reference, and clearing status. Enables automated bank reconciliation and cash position management. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance bank statement processing.

attributes.name: bank_statement_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank statement line item. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific bank account for this transaction. Links to the master bank account configuration in the financial system.

attributes.name: bank_statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent bank statement header containing this line item. Links to the overall statement document received from the bank.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the GL account used for posting this bank transaction. Links the cash movement to the chart of accounts for financial reporting.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the company code that owns the bank account for this transaction. Used for multi-entity financial consolidation and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Company Code Structure

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center assigned to this transaction for internal cost allocation. Used for OPEX (Operating Expenditure) tracking and management reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: bank_statement_line has fiscal_year (INT) and fiscal_period (INT) but no FK to fiscal_period master. Bank statement lines are reconciled to fiscal periods and should reference master calendar.

attributes.name: house_bank_id

attributes.name: tax_account_id

attributes.name: valid_to_date

products.name: target_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of corporate sustainability targets to profit centers for performance tracking, accountability, and incentive compensation. Each record links one profit center to one sustainability target with allocation percentages, baseline values, target values, and performance metrics that exist only in the context of this allocation relationship. Enables management reporting on sustainability performance by business unit and supports ESG-linked compensation.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, corporate sustainability targets (carbon reduction, renewable energy, waste reduction) are allocated across multiple profit centers (express parcel, freight forwarding, contract logistics), and each profit center is accountable for multiple sustainability targets simultaneously. The allocation relationship is actively managed by the sustainability team, with specific allocation percentages, baseline values, target values, and ongoing performance tracking for each profit-center-to-target combination. This allocation data is used for management reporting, ESG disclosure, and incentive compensation calculations.

attributes.name: target_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this target allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (typically the profit center manager or sustainability lead) who is accountable for achieving this allocated target. Used for reporting and incentive compensation.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the profit center that has been allocated a portion of the sustainability target

attributes.name: target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the sustainability target being allocated to the profit center

attributes.name: allocated_baseline_value
attributes.description: The baseline measurement value allocated to this profit center based on allocation_percentage and the corporate target baseline. Used as the starting point for measuring this profit center's progress toward the allocated target.

attributes.name: allocated_target_value
attributes.description: The target measurement value allocated to this profit center based on allocation_percentage and the corporate target. This is the value the profit center must achieve by the target year.

attributes.name: allocation_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this target allocation became effective and performance tracking began. Typically aligns with fiscal year start or target program launch date.

attributes.name: allocation_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this target allocation ends or ended. Typically aligns with the target_year from the sustainability_target. Null for active ongoing allocations.

attributes.name: allocation_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the methodology used to allocate this target to the profit center (e.g., proportional to revenue, proportional to baseline emissions, proportional to headcount, strategic allocation). Provides transparency for allocation decisions.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the corporate sustainability target allocated to this profit center for accountability and performance tracking (e.g., 15.50 means this profit center is responsible for 15.5% of the target reduction). Sum of allocation_percentage across all profit centers for a given target should equal 100%.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this target allocation. Active allocations are being tracked and measured. Suspended allocations are temporarily paused. Completed allocations have reached the target year. Cancelled allocations were terminated before completion.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation record was created in the system.

attributes.name: current_performance_value
attributes.description: The most recent actual performance measurement for this profit center against this allocated target. Updated periodically (monthly, quarterly, annually) based on actual emissions, energy consumption, or other sustainability metrics.

attributes.name: incentive_weight
attributes.description: The weight or percentage of this sustainability target allocation in the profit center manager's incentive compensation calculation (e.g., 10.00 means 10% of bonus is tied to achieving this target). Enables ESG-linked compensation.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation record was last modified, including updates to performance values or status changes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this target allocation, including context, special considerations, adjustments, or explanations for allocation decisions.

attributes.name: performance_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the period for which current_performance_value was measured (e.g., end of quarter, end of year). Enables time-series tracking of progress.

domains.name: procurement
domains.description: Manages sourcing, supplier onboarding, purchase order lifecycle, carrier procurement, and spend management for operational and capital expenditures. Owns supplier master, RFQ/RFP processes, purchase orders, invoice matching, and contract compliance monitoring. Powered by Coupa and integrates with SAP S/4HANA Finance for budget control and with fleet and warehouse domains for asset procurement.

products.name: supplier
products.description: Master record for all suppliers, vendors, and service providers engaged by Transport Shipping. Captures supplier identity, classification (carrier, fuel supplier, IT vendor, facility lessor, etc.), onboarding status, risk tier, AEO/C-TPAT certification status, payment terms, preferred currency, tax identifiers, and geographic coverage. This is the SSOT for supplier identity within the procurement domain and serves as the anchor for all sourcing, purchasing, and spend management activities. Sourced from Coupa Supplier Management module.
products.reference: Coupa Supplier Master / SAP Vendor Master

attributes.name: supplier_id

attributes.name: supplier_part_number

attributes.name: tax_rate_percent

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: withholding_tax_code

It captures the commercial terms, pricing, volume commitments, delivery schedules, and quality standards negotiated for each supplier-program combination. Each record links one supplier to one carbon offset program with attributes that exist only in the context of this procurement relationship.. products.name: contracted_service
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between procurement_contract and carrier_service. It captures the service-specific commercial terms negotiated within a procurement contract for each carrier service. Each record links one procurement contract to one carrier service with pricing, volume commitments, SLAs, and allocation rules that exist only in the context of this contractual relationship.. Existence Justification: In logistics procurement, a single master procurement contract with a carrier typically covers multiple distinct service products (express, standard, economy services across different lanes and modes). Conversely, a specific carrier service (e.g., DHL Express EU-to-US) can be contracted by multiple shippers under separate procurement agreements. The business actively manages service-specific rates, volume commitments, SLAs, and allocation priorities that vary by contract-service combination.

products.name: contract_sustainability_contribution
products.description: This association product represents the contribution relationship between procurement contracts and corporate sustainability targets. It captures how specific procurement agreements (carrier contracts, fuel supply agreements, fleet leasing) contribute to achieving sustainability commitments (emissions reduction, renewable energy adoption, net-zero pledges). Each record links one procurement contract to one sustainability target with quantified contribution metrics, reduction commitments, and performance tracking attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, procurement contracts (carrier agreements, fuel supply contracts, fleet leasing) are strategically designed to contribute to multiple corporate sustainability targets simultaneously. A single electric vehicle fleet contract contributes to Scope 1 emissions reduction, renewable energy percentage targets, and potentially Scope 3 Category 4 (upstream transportation) targets. Conversely, achieving a single sustainability target like '50% emissions reduction by 2030' requires contributions from multiple contracts across fuel procurement, carrier selection, warehouse energy, and fleet electrification. The business actively manages these contribution relationships with quantified commitments, performance tracking, and penalty clauses.

domains.name: sustainability
domains.description: Tracks and reports on environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance including GHG emissions (CO2e), carbon offsetting programs, fuel efficiency, and regulatory compliance with EU ETS and CORSIA. Owns emissions factors, shipment-level carbon footprint calculations, sustainability KPIs, and ESG disclosure data. Supports green logistics initiatives, customer-facing carbon reporting, and regulatory environmental reporting.

products.name: emissions_factor

Stores emission intensity values per tonne-km, fuel type, aircraft type, vessel class, vehicle category, and energy source aligned to IATA, IMO, and GLEC Framework standards. Includes scope classification (Scope 1, 2, 3), GWP multipliers, effective date ranges, source authority (IPCC, IATA, IMO, DEFRA), and version lineage. This is the authoritative emissions factor library for all carbon footprint calculations across the organization.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the EU ETS allowance record. Primary key for tracking allowance holdings, allocations, and surrender obligations across compliance periods.

attributes.name: compliance_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.compliance_period. Business justification: EU ETS allowances operate within defined compliance periods. Adding compliance_period_id links EU ETS records to the regulatory compliance period they belong to, consistent with how corsia_compliance_

attributes.name: ghg_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.ghg_inventory. Business justification: EU ETS allowance records reference the GHG inventory for verified emissions. The verified_emissions_co2e reported to EU ETS is derived from the Scope 1 emissions in the GHG inventory. This provides da

attributes.name: allocated_allowances
attributes.description: Number of allowances allocated free of charge by the EU to the operator for this compliance period. Measured in tonnes of Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e). Aviation operators receive limited free allocations; maritime allocations are being phased in.

attributes.name: allowance_type
attributes.description: Type of emission allowance held. EUA = EU Allowance (general), EUAA = EU Aviation Allowance, CER = Certified Emission Reduction (Kyoto), ERU = Emission Reduction Unit (Kyoto). Aviation operators primarily use EUAA; maritime operators use EUA.

attributes.name: average_allowance_price
attributes.description: Weighted average price paid per allowance (per tonne CO2e) for purchased allowances during the compliance period. Used for financial reporting and carbon cost analysis. Expressed in EUR.

attributes.name: competent_authority
attributes.description: National regulatory authority responsible for overseeing EU ETS compliance for this operator. Typically the environmental or aviation authority of the member state where the operator is registered.

attributes.name: compliance_period_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this allowance record applies. EU ETS operates on annual compliance cycles requiring surrender of allowances by April 30 of the following year.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status for the period. Compliant = sufficient allowances surrendered; non_compliant = failed to surrender by deadline; pending_verification = awaiting emissions verification; pending_surrender = verified but not yet surrendered; at_risk = insufficient allowances to cover verified emissions.

attributes.name: corsia_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allowance record is also subject to CORSIA offsetting requirements for international flights outside the EEA. True if operator has CORSIA obligations; false otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allowance record was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: member_state_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the EU member state under whose jurisdiction this operator falls for EU ETS purposes. Examples: DE (Germany), FR (France), NL (Netherlands).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, exceptions, or explanatory information related to this allowance record. Used for audit trail and internal documentation.

attributes.name: operator_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the Transport Shipping operational entity (aviation or maritime operator) subject to EU ETS obligations. Links to the internal operator master data.

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the aviation or maritime operator holding the allowances. Must match the name registered in the EU ETS registry.

attributes.name: outstanding_obligation_co2e
attributes.description: Remaining surrender obligation not yet covered by allowances. Calculated as verified_emissions_co2e minus surrendered_allowances. A positive value indicates a shortfall requiring additional allowance purchases. Measured in tonnes of CO2e.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Financial penalty imposed for non-compliance (failure to surrender sufficient allowances by the deadline). Penalty is €100 per tonne of CO2e shortfall (adjusted for inflation). Expressed in EUR.

attributes.name: penalty_currency
attributes.description: Currency in which penalties are denominated. EU ETS penalties are always in EUR.

attributes.name: purchased_allowances
attributes.description: Number of allowances purchased by the operator through auctions or secondary markets to cover emissions obligations. Measured in tonnes of CO2e.

attributes.name: registry_account_number
attributes.description: Unique account identifier in the EU ETS Union Registry where allowances are held. Format follows EU Registry specifications for operator holding accounts.

attributes.name: reporting_entity
attributes.description: Legal entity within Transport Shipping responsible for EU ETS reporting and compliance for this record. May differ from operator_name in cases of group structures.

attributes.name: sector
attributes.description: The transport sector to which this allowance record applies. Aviation covers flights within the European Economic Area (EEA); maritime covers vessels under EU MRV (Monitoring, Reporting, Verification) regulation.

attributes.name: surplus_allowances
attributes.description: Excess allowances held after meeting surrender obligations. Can be banked for future compliance periods or sold. Calculated as total_available_allowances minus verified_emissions_co2e. Measured in tonnes of CO2e.

attributes.name: surrender_date
attributes.description: Actual date when allowances were surrendered to the EU Registry to cover emissions obligations. Must be on or before the surrender_deadline_date to avoid penalties.

attributes.name: surrender_deadline_date
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which allowances must be surrendered for the compliance period. Typically April 30 of the year following the compliance period.

attributes.name: surrendered_allowances
attributes.description: Number of allowances surrendered by the operator to cover verified emissions for the compliance period. Must be submitted by April 30 of the following year. Measured in tonnes of CO2e.

attributes.name: total_allowance_cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for purchasing allowances during the compliance period. Calculated as purchased_allowances multiplied by average_allowance_price. Expressed in EUR.

attributes.name: total_available_allowances
attributes.description: Total number of allowances available in the operators account for surrender. Calculated as allocated + purchased + transferred_in - transferred_out. Measured in tonnes of CO2e.

attributes.name: transferred_in_allowances
attributes.description: Number of allowances transferred into the operators registry account from other accounts during the compliance period. Measured in tonnes of CO2e.

attributes.name: transferred_out_allowances
attributes.description: Number of allowances transferred out of the operators registry account to other accounts during the compliance period. Measured in tonnes of CO2e.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allowance record was last modified. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the emissions report was verified by an accredited verifier. Verification must be completed before allowances can be surrendered.

attributes.name: verified_emissions_co2e
attributes.description: Total verified greenhouse gas emissions for the compliance period, expressed in tonnes of CO2e. This is the amount of allowances that must be surrendered. Verified by an accredited verifier per EU MRV requirements.

attributes.name: verifier_accreditation_number
attributes.description: Official accreditation number of the verifier issued by the national accreditation body. Required for regulatory reporting and audit trail.

attributes.name: verifier_name
attributes.description: Name of the accredited third-party verifier who verified the emissions report for this compliance period. Must be accredited under EU ETS verification regulations.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: corsia_compliance_record
products.description: Transactional compliance record for ICAO CORSIA (Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation) obligations per compliance period. Captures airline operator ID, compliance period (Phase 1, Phase 2), baseline emissions (tCO2e), growth factor, offsetting obligation (tCO2e), eligible units retired, registry confirmation, submission date, competent authority, and compliance status. Supports ICAO CORSIA annual reporting and offset retirement verification for international aviation routes.
products.reference: ICAO CORSIA Standards and Recommended Practices (SARPs)

attributes.business_glossary_term: CORSIA (Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation) Compliance Record ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the CORSIA compliance record. Primary key for this transactional compliance entity tracking ICAO CORSIA obligations per compliance period.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the airline operator subject to CORSIA compliance obligations. Links to the carrier or airline entity responsible for international aviation emissions.

attributes.name: compliance_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CORSIA compliance period (e.g., Phase 1: 2021-2023, Phase 2: 2024-2026, Phase 3: 2027-2035). Links to the regulatory period definition.

attributes.name: ghg_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.ghg_inventory. Business justification: CORSIA compliance records draw aviation emissions data from the GHG inventory. The annual_emissions_tco2e reported to ICAO CORSIA is derived from the Scope 1 aviation emissions in the GHG inventory. T

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.transport_document. Business justification: CORSIA compliance records must reference the actual air waybills and transport documents that generated the emissions being offset. Aviation emissions compliance verification requires linking complian

attributes.name: annual_emissions_tco2e
attributes.business_glossary_term: Annual Emissions (tCO2e - Tonnes of Carbon Dioxide Equivalent)
attributes.description: Total CO2 equivalent emissions reported by the airline operator for the reporting year, covering all international aviation routes subject to CORSIA.

attributes.name: baseline_emissions_tco2e
attributes.business_glossary_term: Baseline Emissions (tCO2e - Tonnes of Carbon Dioxide Equivalent)
attributes.description: The baseline emissions level in tonnes of CO2 equivalent established for the operator, typically based on 2019-2020 average emissions. Used to calculate growth factor and offsetting obligations.

attributes.name: competent_authority
attributes.description: The national or regional regulatory authority responsible for overseeing CORSIA compliance for the airline operator (e.g., FAA, EASA, CAAC).

attributes.name: competent_authority_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the competent authority jurisdiction (e.g., USA, GBR, CHN).

attributes.name: compliance_phase
attributes.description: The CORSIA implementation phase applicable to this compliance record. Phase 1 (2021-2023) is pilot/voluntary, Phase 2 (2024-2026) expands participation, Phase 3 (2027-2035) is full implementation.

attributes.name: compliance_record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this CORSIA compliance record, used for regulatory submissions and audit trails.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the CORSIA compliance record in its lifecycle. Tracks progression from draft through submission, review, and final determination of compliance or non-compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this CORSIA compliance record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: eligible_units_retired_tco2e
attributes.business_glossary_term: Eligible Units Retired (tCO2e - Tonnes of Carbon Dioxide Equivalent)
attributes.description: The quantity of CORSIA-eligible carbon offset units (in tCO2e) that have been retired by the operator to meet their offsetting obligation. Must come from ICAO-approved carbon offset programs.

attributes.name: exemption_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether any exemptions or special provisions were applied to this compliance record (e.g., small operator exemption, humanitarian flight exemption).

attributes.name: exemption_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for any exemption applied, including regulatory basis and justification.

attributes.name: growth_factor
attributes.description: The calculated growth factor representing the ratio of annual emissions to baseline emissions. Used to determine the operator's share of offsetting obligations under CORSIA.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this CORSIA compliance record was last updated or modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified this compliance record. Supports audit and accountability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this CORSIA compliance record, including special circumstances, clarifications, or additional context.

attributes.name: offset_unit_type
attributes.description: The type or category of carbon offset units retired (e.g., VCS, Gold Standard, CAR, ACR). Must be from ICAO CORSIA-eligible carbon crediting programs.

attributes.name: offsetting_obligation_tco2e
attributes.business_glossary_term: Offsetting Obligation (tCO2e - Tonnes of Carbon Dioxide Equivalent)
attributes.description: The total carbon offsetting obligation in tonnes of CO2 equivalent that the airline operator must retire to achieve CORSIA compliance for the reporting period.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Monetary penalty assessed for non-compliance with CORSIA obligations, if applicable. Currency is typically in the operator's reporting currency or the competent authority's currency.

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the penalty amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: registry_confirmation_number
attributes.description: The unique confirmation or transaction number issued by the carbon offset registry confirming the retirement of eligible units. Used for audit and verification purposes.

attributes.name: registry_name
attributes.description: The name of the carbon offset registry where the eligible units were retired (e.g., Verra Registry, Gold Standard Registry, American Carbon Registry).

attributes.name: remediation_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which the operator must complete remediation actions to achieve compliance, if a shortfall or non-compliance was identified.

attributes.name: remediation_plan_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a remediation plan has been submitted to address any compliance shortfall or non-compliance issues.

attributes.name: reporting_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this CORSIA compliance record applies. Annual reporting is required under CORSIA for international aviation emissions.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the carbon offset units were officially retired in the registry to fulfill the CORSIA offsetting obligation.

attributes.name: shortfall_tco2e
attributes.business_glossary_term: Offsetting Shortfall (tCO2e - Tonnes of Carbon Dioxide Equivalent)
attributes.description: The difference between the offsetting obligation and the eligible units retired, representing any shortfall in compliance. Zero or null indicates full compliance.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CORSIA compliance record was submitted to the competent authority or ICAO for review and verification.

attributes.name: submission_deadline
attributes.description: The regulatory deadline by which the CORSIA compliance record must be submitted to the competent authority. Typically annual submission is required.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the third-party verification of the CORSIA compliance record was completed.

attributes.name: verification_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the verification report issued by the accredited verification body.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of third-party verification of the emissions data and offset retirement. CORSIA requires independent verification of emissions reports.

attributes.name: verifier_name
attributes.description: Name of the accredited third-party verification body that verified the emissions data and compliance record.

products.name: green_shipment_certificate

Supports customer ESG reporting and green logistics commercial propositions.

Supports ESG social and environmental reporting, ISO 14001 compliance, and water stewardship commitments.

attributes.name: ghg_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.ghg_inventory. Business justification: Water consumption records are part of the environmental data reported in GHG inventories and ESG disclosures. For consistency with other operational environmental records (waste_record, energy_consump

attributes.name: compliance_status

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: esg_reporting_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether this water consumption record is included in external ESG or sustainability reporting disclosures.

attributes.description: Start date of the water consumption reporting period.

attributes.name: supplier_name
attributes.description: Name of the water utility or supplier providing water to the facility.

attributes.name: total_water_withdrawn_m3
attributes.description: Total volume of water withdrawn from all sources during the reporting period, measured in cubic meters.

attributes.name: verification_body
attributes.description: Name of the third-party organization that verified the water consumption data.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the water consumption data was verified by a third-party auditor.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of third-party verification or audit of the water consumption data.

attributes.name: water_consumed_m3

attributes.name: water_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of water consumed during the reporting period, including supply charges, wastewater treatment fees, and discharge fees.

attributes.name: water_cost_currency_code

attributes.name: water_discharged_m3

attributes.name: water_intensity_per_employee

attributes.name: water_intensity_per_sqm

attributes.name: baseline_emissions_tonnes_co2e
attributes.description: The reference baseline emissions level against which reductions or growth are measured for this compliance period, expressed in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the compliance period within the regulatory scheme (e.g., EU-ETS-2024-P1, CORSIA-2024).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance period record was first created in the sustainability data platform.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the compliance period including its scope, applicability, and key obligations for the organization.

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance period record became effective in the system, supporting temporal queries and slowly changing dimension management.

attributes.name: emissions_cap_tonnes_co2e
attributes.description: The total emissions cap or allowance allocation ceiling for the organization under this compliance period, expressed in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the compliance period ends and emissions accumulation ceases for this period's obligations.

attributes.name: free_allocation_tonnes_co2e
attributes.description: The quantity of emission allowances allocated free of charge to the organization for this compliance period, expressed in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent.

attributes.name: ghg_scope_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates which GHG Protocol emission scopes are covered by this compliance period's obligations (Scope 1 direct, Scope 2 indirect energy, Scope 3 value chain).

attributes.name: growth_factor_percent
attributes.description: The sectoral growth factor applied to baseline emissions to determine the compliance threshold, accounting for industry growth (used in CORSIA's sectoral approach).

attributes.name: is_voluntary
attributes.description: Indicates whether participation in this compliance period is voluntary (true) or mandatory (false) for the organization based on regulatory thresholds.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary jurisdiction or administering authority for this compliance period. For supranational schemes (e.g., EU ETS), represents the administering member state.

attributes.name: max_offset_percentage
attributes.description: The maximum percentage of total compliance obligations that may be met through carbon offset credits rather than direct emission reductions or allowance purchases.

attributes.name: monitoring_methodology
attributes.description: The prescribed or adopted methodology for monitoring and calculating emissions during this compliance period (e.g., Tier 1/2/3 calculation, continuous emissions monitoring, fuel-based method).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the compliance period (e.g., 'EU ETS Phase 4 - Year 2024', 'CORSIA Pilot Phase 2021-2023').

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or annotations providing additional context about the compliance period, such as regulatory amendments, transitional provisions, or organizational decisions.

attributes.name: offset_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether carbon offset credits (e.g., CERs, ERUs, eligible units) may be used to meet compliance obligations during this period.

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the non-compliance penalty rate applicable to this compliance period.

attributes.name: penalty_rate_per_tonne
attributes.description: The monetary penalty rate per tonne of CO2e for non-compliance (failure to surrender sufficient allowances) during this compliance period, in the scheme's base currency.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the compliance period by its temporal structure — annual reporting cycle, multi-year commitment period, regulatory phase, pilot period, or baseline reference period.

attributes.name: phase_number
attributes.description: The sequential phase number within the broader regulatory scheme (e.g., Phase 4 of EU ETS, Pilot Phase of CORSIA) to which this compliance period belongs.

attributes.name: reduction_target_percent
attributes.description: The mandated or committed percentage reduction in greenhouse gas emissions relative to the baseline that must be achieved during this compliance period.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the competent regulatory authority or administering body responsible for overseeing compliance during this period (e.g., European Commission, ICAO, national environment agency).

attributes.name: regulatory_scheme
attributes.description: The emissions trading or carbon compliance regulatory scheme under which this period is defined (e.g., EU ETS, CORSIA, IMO Data Collection System, UK ETS, California Cap-and-Trade).

attributes.name: reporting_deadline_date
attributes.description: The regulatory deadline by which emissions reports and monitoring data must be submitted to the competent authority for this compliance period.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency at which emissions data must be reported to the regulatory authority during this compliance period.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the compliance period becomes effective and emissions begin to be counted toward obligations under the regulatory scheme.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the compliance period indicating whether it is upcoming, currently active for emissions accumulation, in the reporting/verification window, closed, or archived.

attributes.name: surrender_deadline_date
attributes.description: The regulatory deadline by which emission allowances or offset credits must be surrendered to cover verified emissions for this compliance period.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance period record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: verification_deadline_date
attributes.description: The regulatory deadline by which third-party verification of emissions reports must be completed and submitted for this compliance period.

attributes.name: prior_compliance_period_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on compliance_period (prior_compliance_period_id)

domains.name: safety
domains.description: Manages operational health, safety, and environmental (HSE) compliance including workplace safety incidents, OSHA reporting, dangerous goods handling certifications, facility safety audits, driver safety programs, and emergency response planning across all Transport Shipping operations.

Serves as the SSOT for all workplace and operational safety events.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic region or jurisdiction(s) where this certification is recognized and valid. May be global (IATA/ICAO certifications), regional (EU ADR), or country-specific (US 49 CFR). Represented as comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or region codes.
attributes.references: IATA DGR, IMDG Code, ADR, 49 CFR

attributes.name: holder_name
attributes.description: The full name or designation of the certification holder (employee full name, facility name, vehicle registration, equipment serial number, or organizational unit name). Provides human-readable identification.

attributes.name: holder_type
attributes.description: The category of entity that holds this dangerous goods certification. Employee (individual person trained and certified), facility (warehouse or terminal authorized for DG handling), vehicle (truck, aircraft, vessel certified for DG transport), equipment (container, packaging, handling equipment), organizational unit (business division or operational unit).

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the dangerous goods certification was originally issued to the holder. This is the effective start date of the certification validity period.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: The name of the regulatory body, training organization, or competent authority that issued this dangerous goods certification. Examples include IATA-accredited training centers, national civil aviation authorities, maritime administrations, or DOT-approved training providers.
attributes.references: IATA DGR, ICAO Technical Instructions, IMO IMDG Code

attributes.name: issuing_authority_code
attributes.description: The standardized code or registration number of the issuing authority, if applicable. For example, IATA training center code, CAA registration number, or DOT training provider ID.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this certification record was most recently updated in the Transport Shipping system. Audit trail field for data governance and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which this certification was most recently renewed or recertified. Null if the certification has never been renewed (i.e., still on original issue).

attributes.name: mode_of_transport
attributes.description: The transport mode(s) for which this dangerous goods certification is valid. Air (IATA/ICAO regulations), ocean (IMDG Code), road (ADR), rail (RID), multimodal (valid across multiple modes).
attributes.references: IATA DGR, IMDG Code, ADR, RID

attributes.name: next_recurrent_training_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the certification holder must complete the next recurrent dangerous goods training session to maintain certification validity. Calculated based on last training date plus recurrent_training_frequency_months. Null if no recurrent training is required.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special conditions, restrictions, or comments related to this dangerous goods certification. May include notes on specialized training, limitations on scope, or historical context.

attributes.name: pass_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum score or percentage required to pass the certification examination and obtain the certification. Typically 80.00 or 85.00 for dangerous goods certifications. Null if no formal assessment was required.

attributes.name: recurrent_training_frequency_months
attributes.description: The required interval in months between recurrent dangerous goods training sessions to maintain certification validity. Typically 24 months (2 years) for IATA DGR certifications. Null if no recurrent training is required.

attributes.name: regulatory_version
attributes.description: The edition or version of the dangerous goods regulations under which this certification was issued. For example, IATA DGR 64th Edition, IMDG Code Amendment 40-20. Important for tracking regulatory currency as DG regulations are updated regularly.

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: The date on which a previously suspended certification was reinstated to active status after corrective actions were completed. Null if certification has never been suspended or has not been reinstated.

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the certification renewal process must be completed to maintain continuous validity. Typically set 30-90 days before expiry_date to allow time for recertification training and processing.

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: The current status of the certification renewal process. Not_required (certification is not yet due for renewal), pending (renewal window has opened but not yet initiated), in_progress (renewal training or recertification underway), completed (renewal successfully completed and new certification issued), overdue (expiry date passed without renewal).

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was permanently revoked by the issuing authority or by Transport Shipping management. Null if certification has never been revoked.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: The reason or justification for permanent revocation of the certification, if certification_status is revoked. Examples include serious compliance violation, safety incident caused by holder negligence, fraudulent certification, or regulatory enforcement action. Null if certification has never been revoked.

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was suspended. Null if certification has never been suspended.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: The reason or justification for suspension of the certification, if certification_status is suspended. Examples include compliance violation, incident investigation, failure to complete recurrent training, or regulatory audit finding. Null if certification has never been suspended.

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification holder successfully completed the required dangerous goods training course and passed any required examinations.

attributes.name: training_course_reference
attributes.description: The reference number, code, or identifier of the dangerous goods training course that the certification holder completed to obtain this certification. Links to the training program record.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was last verified with the issuing authority or through an independent verification process. Null if never verified.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: The status of third-party or internal verification of the certification authenticity and validity. Verified (certification confirmed with issuing authority), pending_verification (verification request submitted but not yet confirmed), verification_failed (issuing authority could not confirm or certification found invalid), not_verified (no verification attempted).

attributes.name: renewed_dg_certification_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on dg_certification (renewed_dg_certification_id)

Distinct from the general hse_incident — DG incidents have specific regulatory notification and reporting obligations under IATA DGR and IMDG Code.

attributes.name: proper_shipping_name

attributes.name: quantity_involved

attributes.name: quantity_unit

products.name: driver_safety_program
products.description: Master record defining Transport Shipping driver safety programs and behavioral safety initiatives. Captures program name, program type (defensive driving, fatigue management, distracted driving, speed compliance, load securing), applicable driver population (long-haul, last-mile, hazmat), program objectives, KPI thresholds (speeding events per trip, harsh braking rate, seatbelt compliance rate), enrollment criteria, program duration, and regulatory alignment (DOT, FMCSA, EU Directive 2003/59). Serves as the program definition master — individual driver participation is tracked in driver_safety_event.
products.reference: FMCSA Safety Management Program / DOT Driver Safety

attributes.name: program_duration_days

Distinct from fleet.telematics_event which captures raw IoT telemetry — this is the processed, business-meaningful safety behavior record.

attributes.name: existing_controls
attributes.description: Description of the current control measures, safeguards, or mitigation strategies in place to manage or reduce the hazard risk.

attributes.name: hazard_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the hazard type: physical (machinery, noise, temperature), chemical (substances, fumes), biological (pathogens, allergens), ergonomic (repetitive strain, manual handling), psychosocial (stress, violence), or environmental (pollution, emissions).

attributes.name: hazard_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the hazard including the nature of the danger, potential harm, and circumstances under which the hazard may be realized.

attributes.name: hazard_reference_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number for the hazard entry, used for tracking and communication across operational sites.

attributes.name: hazard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hazard register entry indicating whether the hazard is active, has been mitigated, closed, under review, or pending corrective action.

attributes.name: hazard_subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary or more granular classification of the hazard within its primary category, providing additional specificity for risk management.

attributes.name: hazard_title

attributes.name: identification_date
attributes.description: Date when the hazard was first identified and recorded in the register.

attributes.name: incident_history_count
attributes.description: Number of recorded incidents or near-misses associated with this specific hazard, providing historical context for risk assessment.

attributes.name: inherent_consequence
attributes.description: Severity rating of the potential consequence or impact if the hazard is realized without controls, ranging from insignificant to catastrophic.

attributes.name: inherent_likelihood
attributes.description: Likelihood rating of the hazard occurring in the absence of any controls, using a qualitative scale from rare to almost certain.

attributes.name: inherent_risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall inherent risk level calculated from likelihood and consequence before any controls are applied, categorized as low, medium, high, or extreme.

attributes.name: inherent_risk_score
attributes.description: Numerical risk score representing the inherent risk level, typically calculated as likelihood multiplied by consequence on a defined scale.

attributes.name: last_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the hazard risk assessment was most recently reviewed or updated.

attributes.name: last_incident_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent incident or near-miss event related to this hazard, if any have occurred.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hazard register record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the physical location within the facility or site where the hazard exists, including building, floor, zone, or equipment reference.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the hazard and its controls to ensure continued effectiveness and relevance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or contextual information about the hazard, its assessment, or control measures.

attributes.name: ppe_required
attributes.description: Description of the personal protective equipment required when working in the presence of this hazard, such as gloves, respirators, safety glasses, or protective clothing.

attributes.name: public_exposure_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the hazard may also affect members of the public, customers, or visitors in addition to employees.

attributes.name: recommended_actions
attributes.description: Description of recommended additional control measures, corrective actions, or risk treatment strategies to further reduce the residual risk.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Reference to specific regulatory requirements, OSHA standards, IATA regulations, IMO codes, or other legal obligations related to this hazard.

attributes.name: residual_consequence
attributes.description: Severity rating of the potential consequence after existing controls have been applied, using the same scale as inherent consequence.

attributes.name: residual_likelihood
attributes.description: Likelihood rating of the hazard occurring after existing controls have been applied, using the same qualitative scale as inherent likelihood.

attributes.name: residual_risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall residual risk level after controls are applied, categorized as low, medium, high, or extreme, representing the remaining risk exposure.

attributes.name: residual_risk_score
attributes.description: Numerical risk score representing the residual risk level after controls, calculated using the same methodology as inherent risk score.

attributes.name: review_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between scheduled reviews of this hazard entry, based on risk level and organizational policy.

attributes.name: risk_acceptability
attributes.description: Determination of whether the residual risk level is acceptable to the organization, tolerable with monitoring, or unacceptable requiring further action.

attributes.name: risk_treatment_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether additional risk treatment or control measures are required to bring the residual risk to an acceptable level.

attributes.name: un_number

attributes.name: inherent_likelihood

attributes.name: inherent_severity

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag

attributes.name: residual_likelihood

attributes.name: residual_risk_level

attributes.name: residual_severity

attributes.name: review_due_date

attributes.name: risk_acceptable_flag

attributes.name: risk_rating_methodology

products.name: fatigue_risk_assessment

products.name: program_training_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the training curriculum requirements between safety programs and safety training courses. It captures which training courses are required for each safety program, the nature of that requirement (mandatory vs recommended), frequency of completion or refresher, and target audience within the program. Each record links one safety program to one training course with attributes that exist only in the context of this program-training relationship.. Existence Justification: Safety programs define comprehensive HSE management systems (ISO 45001, OSHA VPP, driver safety, DG safety) that each require multiple training courses as part of their curriculum. Training courses are designed as reusable learning modules that support multiple programs across the organization. The business actively manages program training requirements as a distinct operational entity with attributes like requirement type, frequency, mandatory status, deadlines, and target audience roles that exist only in the context of a specific program-training pairing.
