products.name: hub_emergency_plan
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of emergency response plans to hub and gateway facilities. It captures the operational readiness, compliance status, and drill execution for each plan-hub combination. Each record links one emergency response plan to one hub/gateway with attributes that track activation authority, coordination protocols, drill history, and regulatory compliance specific to that facility-plan pairing.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping logistics operations, major hub and gateway facilities require multiple emergency response plans covering different scenarios (fire, hazmat spill, dangerous goods incident, natural disaster, security threat), and each emergency response plan must be deployed across multiple hub locations where those scenarios could occur. The business actively manages the assignment of plans to hubs, tracking facility-specific activation protocols, drill schedules, compliance status, and coordination procedures for each hub-plan pairing.

products.name: storage
products.description: Master record managing the physical and digital storage configuration for documents within the document management system. Captures storage location type (cloud object store, on-premise DMS, physical archive), storage path or URI, encryption status, compression format, storage tier (hot, warm, cold, archive), retention class, geographic storage region (for data sovereignty compliance), and storage provider. Enables document retrieval, lifecycle tiering, and regulatory data residency compliance.

attributes.name: storage_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the document storage configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: transport_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent document record that this storage configuration belongs to. Links to the master document entity.

attributes.name: version_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this specific version of the document within the storage system. Null if versioning is not enabled.

attributes.name: access_control_policy
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the access control policy governing who can read, write, or delete this document. May reference IAM policies, ACLs, or RBAC rules.

attributes.name: backup_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the document is backed up to secondary storage. Critical for disaster recovery planning and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) compliance.

attributes.name: checksum_algorithm
attributes.description: Algorithm used to generate the checksum value. SHA-256 or SHA-512 recommended for security-critical documents.

attributes.name: checksum_value
attributes.description: Hash or checksum of the document content used to verify data integrity and detect corruption or tampering. Typically MD5, SHA-256, or SHA-512.

attributes.name: class_transition_date
attributes.description: Date when the document is scheduled to transition to a different storage tier (e.g., from hot to warm, or warm to archive) based on lifecycle policies.

attributes.name: compression_format
attributes.description: Compression algorithm applied to the document to reduce storage footprint and transfer bandwidth. None indicates uncompressed storage. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|gzip|zip|bzip2|lz4|snappy|zstd — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cost_per_gb_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Storage Cost per Gigabyte in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Unit cost of storage per gigabyte per month in USD for this storage tier and provider. Used for cost allocation and chargeback to business units.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage configuration record was first created in the document management system. Audit trail for storage lifecycle.

attributes.name: data_residency_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document storage location complies with data residency and sovereignty requirements for the document's jurisdiction. True when compliant.

attributes.name: encryption_algorithm
attributes.description: Cryptographic algorithm used to encrypt the document (e.g., AES-256, RSA-2048). Required for security audits and compliance verification.

attributes.name: encryption_key_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the encryption key used to secure the document. May point to a key management service (KMS) key ID. Highly sensitive.

attributes.name: encryption_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is encrypted at rest, in transit, both, or unencrypted. Critical for security compliance and data protection audits.

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Size of the stored document file in bytes. Used for storage capacity planning, cost allocation, and transfer time estimation.

attributes.name: last_accessed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the document was last retrieved or accessed from storage. Used for lifecycle tiering decisions and access pattern analysis.

attributes.name: last_backup_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful backup of this document. Used to monitor backup health and compliance with backup policies.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the document storage record or the document itself was last modified. Critical for audit trails and change tracking.

attributes.name: legal_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is under legal hold and must not be deleted or modified regardless of retention policy. True when litigation, audit, or investigation is active.
attributes.references: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure (FRCP) Rule 37(e)

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage infrastructure where the document is physically or digitally stored. Determines retrieval protocols and access patterns.

attributes.name: mime_type
attributes.description: MIME type of the stored document (e.g., application/pdf, image/jpeg, application/xml). Used for content type validation and rendering.

attributes.name: path
attributes.business_glossary_term: Storage Path or Uniform Resource Identifier (URI)
attributes.description: Full path, URI, or object key identifying the exact location of the document within the storage system. May include bucket name, folder hierarchy, or file system path.

attributes.name: provider
attributes.description: Cloud or infrastructure provider hosting the document storage. Critical for vendor management, cost allocation, and disaster recovery planning.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Geographic region or data center location where the document is physically stored. Required for data sovereignty compliance, GDPR territorial scope, and cross-border data transfer regulations.

attributes.name: replication_status
attributes.description: Current status of document replication to secondary or disaster recovery storage locations. Critical for business continuity and data durability.

attributes.name: replication_target_region
attributes.description: Geographic region where the document replica is stored for disaster recovery or data redundancy. Null if not replicated.

attributes.name: retention_class
attributes.description: Retention policy classification determining how long the document must be retained before eligible for deletion. Aligned with legal, regulatory, and business retention schedules.

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document retention period expires and the document becomes eligible for archival or destruction per retention policy.

attributes.name: retrieval_sla_seconds
attributes.business_glossary_term: Retrieval Service Level Agreement (SLA) in Seconds
attributes.description: Maximum time in seconds guaranteed for document retrieval from this storage tier. Hot tier typically seconds, archive tier may be hours.
attributes.references: ISO 27001 A.11.1.4 Protecting Against External Threats

attributes.name: storage_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document in storage. Active for operational documents, archived for long-term retention, pending_deletion for documents awaiting purge.

attributes.name: storage_tier
attributes.description: Performance and cost tier of the storage layer. Hot for frequently accessed documents, archive for long-term retention. Drives retrieval SLA and storage cost.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last updated this storage configuration record. Required for audit trails and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage configuration record was last updated. Critical for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: versioning_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether version control is enabled for this document storage location. When true, all updates create new versions rather than overwriting.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that created this storage configuration record. Required for audit trails and accountability.

attributes.name: parent_storage_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on storage (parent_storage_id)

attributes.name: type_id

Values: public (no restrictions), internal (company employees only), confidential (authorized personnel only), restricted (highly sensitive, need-to-know basis).

attributes.name: archival_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether documents of this type must be archived to long-term storage after the active retention period. True if archival is required, false if documents can be destroyed after retention period.

attributes.name: audit_trail_required

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: customs_declaration_type

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document type is specifically used for dangerous goods shipments and must comply with IMDG, IATA DGR, or ADR regulations. True if dangerous goods specific, false otherwise.

attributes.name: default_language

attributes.name: encryption_required

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: document_version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the document at the time the compliance check was performed. Ensures traceability when documents are revised and re-checked. Links to document version history.

attributes.description: Severity classification of the compliance issue. Critical errors block document submission; high errors require immediate remediation; medium errors should be addressed before release; low errors are minor quality issues; informational items are advisory only.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments added by checkers, approvers, or system administrators regarding the compliance check. May include additional context, special handling instructions, or follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided when a compliance check failure is overridden and the document is released despite not passing all validations. Requires management authorization and is subject to audit review. Documents business justification for exception.

attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body or customs authority for which this compliance check was performed. Examples: US CBP, UK HMRC, EU Commission, IATA, IMO. Identifies the jurisdiction and enforcement agency.

attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier holds valid IATA certification for air cargo operations. Required for participation in IATA cargo agency programs.

attributes.name: iata_code
attributes.description: Two or three character airline designator code assigned by IATA for air carriers. Used in AWB (Air Waybill) and flight operations.

attributes.name: imo_number
attributes.description: Seven-digit ship identification number assigned by IMO to ocean-going vessels. Format: IMO followed by seven digits.
attributes.references: IMO - International Maritime Organization Ship Identification Number Scheme

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Maximum cargo liability insurance coverage amount the carrier maintains, typically expressed in USD. Critical for high-value shipment risk assessment.

attributes.name: insurance_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the insurance coverage amount.

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the carrier's current cargo liability insurance policy expires. Monitored to ensure continuous coverage for active shipments.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the carrier's cargo liability insurance policy. Used for claims processing and verification.

attributes.name: iso_28000_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier holds ISO 28000 certification for supply chain security management systems.

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier holds ISO 9001 certification for quality management systems, demonstrating commitment to consistent service quality.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full legal registered name of the carrier organization as it appears on official business documents and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: ISO 20275 - Entity Legal Forms Code List

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, or internal comments about the carrier relationship.

attributes.name: onboarding_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the carrier onboarding lifecycle, from initial prospect through active operations to potential offboarding.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the carrier in the Transport Shipping network. Active carriers are eligible for new bookings; suspended/blacklisted carriers are blocked.

attributes.name: otd_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments delivered on or before the committed delivery date over the last 12 months. Key performance indicator for carrier reliability.

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Composite performance score (0.00 to 5.00) based on OTD (On-Time Delivery), OTIF (On-Time In-Full), claims ratio, and service quality metrics. Used for carrier selection and routing decisions.

attributes.name: preferred_carrier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this carrier has preferred status in Transport Shipping's network, receiving priority allocation and preferential rates due to strategic partnership or superior performance.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact at the carrier. Used for operational communications, booking confirmations, and issue escalation.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the carrier organization for operational coordination and issue resolution.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary business contact at the carrier, including country code. Used for urgent operational communications.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official business registration or incorporation number issued by the country of registration. May be tax ID, company registration number, or equivalent national identifier.

attributes.name: scac_code
attributes.description: Unique two-to-four letter code used to identify transportation companies in North America. Required for ocean, rail, and motor carriers operating in US trade.
attributes.references: National Motor Freight Traffic Association (NMFTA) - SCAC Directory

attributes.name: service_scope
attributes.description: Geographic reach of the carrier's service network: domestic (single country), regional (multi-country region), international (cross-border), or global (worldwide coverage).

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has temperature-controlled (reefer) capabilities for perishable and pharmaceutical shipments requiring cold chain management.
attributes.references: GDP - Good Distribution Practice for Pharmaceuticals

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: The commercial or trading name under which the carrier operates, which may differ from the legal name. Also known as DBA (Doing Business As).
attributes.references: ISO 20275 - Entity Legal Forms Code List

attributes.name: transport_modes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of transport modes the carrier operates: air, ocean, road, rail, multimodal. Indicates the carrier's operational capabilities across different freight modes.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Primary website URL of the carrier for tracking, service information, and customer support.

attributes.name: parent_carrier_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on carrier (parent_carrier_id)

products.name: carrier_profile
products.description: Operational capability profile for a carrier partner, extending the carrier master with detailed service capability data. Captures transport modes offered (air, ocean, road, rail, multimodal), geographic coverage (trade lanes, regions, countries served), service types (FTL, LTL, FCL, LCL, express, economy), capacity parameters (max weight, volume, TEU capacity), equipment types operated, temperature-controlled capability, dangerous goods handling certification, last-mile capability, and digital integration readiness (EDI, API). Distinct from the carrier master identity record — this is the operational capability profile.

attributes.name: carrier_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the carrier operational capability profile. Primary key.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier master identity record. Links this operational profile to the carrier entity.

attributes.name: api_integration_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier provides API (Application Programming Interface) integration for real-time booking, tracking, and rate queries.

attributes.name: api_protocol
attributes.description: Type of API protocol supported by the carrier: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, proprietary, or none if no API available.

attributes.name: average_transit_time_days
attributes.description: Average transit time in days for shipments handled by this carrier profile, calculated from historical data.

attributes.name: carbon_reporting_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier provides CO2e (Carbon Dioxide Equivalent) emissions reporting for shipments.

attributes.name: claims_ratio_percentage
attributes.description: Historical cargo claims ratio as a percentage of total shipments (0.00 to 100.00). Lower is better.

attributes.name: countries_served
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where carrier provides service (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, DEU, CHN).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier profile record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_border_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier handles cross-border international shipments including customs clearance coordination.

attributes.name: customs_brokerage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier provides in-house customs brokerage services as part of their offering.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier is certified to handle dangerous goods (hazmat) shipments.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions, 49 CFR

attributes.name: dg_classes_handled
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of UN dangerous goods classes the carrier is certified to handle (e.g., Class 1 Explosives, Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Class 8 Corrosives). Null if not DG certified.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: edi_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier supports EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) for automated document exchange (e.g., 214, 210, 990 transaction sets).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this carrier profile became effective and available for operational use.

attributes.name: equipment_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of equipment types operated: dry_van, reefer, flatbed, tanker, container_20ft, container_40ft, container_40ft_hc, aircraft_freighter, rail_car, barge. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dry_van|reefer|flatbed|tanker|container_20ft|container_40ft|container_40ft_hc|aircraft_freighter|rail_car|barge|lowboy|chassis — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 6346 Container Type Codes, DOT Equipment Classifications

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this carrier profile expires or is scheduled for review. Null if open-ended.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage_scope
attributes.description: Overall geographic reach of the carrier: global (worldwide), regional (multi-country region), national (single country), local (city/metro), or trade-lane-specific (dedicated corridors).

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier offers cargo insurance coverage as part of their service or through a partner.

attributes.name: last_mile_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier provides last-mile delivery services to final consignee addresses (residential or commercial).

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when this carrier profile was last reviewed and validated by the carrier management team.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier profile record was last modified.

attributes.name: max_insurance_value_usd
attributes.description: Maximum cargo value in USD that can be insured per shipment. Null if insurance not available.

attributes.name: max_volume_capacity_cbm
attributes.description: Maximum single shipment volume capacity in cubic meters (CBM) that this carrier can handle.

attributes.name: max_weight_capacity_kg
attributes.description: Maximum single shipment weight capacity in kilograms that this carrier can handle.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the carrier profile indicating availability for shipment assignment and booking.

attributes.name: otd_percentage
attributes.description: Historical on-time delivery performance percentage for this carrier profile (0.00 to 100.00). Calculated from actual shipment data.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Internal performance tier classification based on OTD (On-Time Delivery), claims ratio, and service quality: platinum (best), gold, silver, bronze, or standard.

attributes.name: profile_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for this carrier profile used in operational systems and partner integrations.

attributes.name: profile_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name for this carrier operational profile (e.g., 'Global Express Air', 'Regional LTL Network').

attributes.name: profile_type
attributes.description: Classification of the carrier operational model: asset-based (owns fleet), non-asset-based (broker/3PL), hybrid, NVOCC (Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier), or freight forwarder.

attributes.name: quality_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of quality and compliance certifications held by the carrier (e.g., ISO 9001, C-TPAT, AEO, TAPA, GDP).
attributes.references: ISO 9001, C-TPAT, AEO, TAPA, GDP Standards

attributes.name: real_time_tracking_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier provides real-time GPS or milestone-based shipment tracking visibility.

attributes.name: regions_served
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic regions where carrier operates (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East, Latin America, Africa).

attributes.name: security_rating
attributes.description: Security risk rating assigned to the carrier based on compliance, incident history, and certifications: high (best), medium, low, or not rated.

attributes.name: service_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of service types offered: FTL (Full Truckload), LTL (Less Than Truckload), FCL (Full Container Load), LCL (Less Than Container Load), express, economy, standard, same_day, next_day, deferred. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ftl|ltl|fcl|lcl|express|economy|standard|same_day|next_day|deferred|white_glove — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sustainability_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier holds sustainability or environmental certifications (e.g., SmartWay, ISO 14001, carbon neutral).

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has temperature-controlled (reefer) capability for cold chain shipments.

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in Celsius that carrier can maintain for temperature-controlled shipments. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in Celsius that carrier can maintain for temperature-controlled shipments. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: teu_capacity
attributes.description: Container capacity measured in TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Units) for ocean carriers. Null for non-ocean modes.

attributes.name: tracking_granularity
attributes.description: Level of tracking detail provided: real-time GPS, milestone-based (pickup/in-transit/delivery), daily update, manual, or none.

attributes.name: trade_lanes_covered
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of major trade lanes or corridors served (e.g., Transpacific, Transatlantic, Asia-Europe, Intra-Asia, US-Mexico).

attributes.name: transport_modes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of transport modes this carrier operates: air, ocean, road, rail, multimodal, barge, courier. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: air|ocean|road|rail|multimodal|barge|courier|parcel — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA, IMO, DOT Transport Mode Standards

attributes.name: superseded_carrier_profile_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on carrier_profile (superseded_carrier_profile_id)

products.name: agent
products.description: Master record for freight agents, general sales agents (GSAs), handling agents, and ground handling agents in the Transport Shipping partner network. Captures agent legal name, agent type (freight agent, GSA, handling agent, customs agent, co-loader), IATA agent code, FIATA membership, country and city of operation, principal carrier relationships, bonding and financial guarantee status, commission structure type, and operational scope. Agents are distinct from carriers — they act as intermediaries and representatives rather than transport operators.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the freight agent, general sales agent (GSA), handling agent, or ground handling agent in the Transport Shipping partner network.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.partner. Business justification: Agent is an external organization participating in the Transport Shipping network. The partner table is the unified master for all external organizations. Linking agent to partner enables unified part

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: The primary street address line for the agent's registered business location, including street number and name.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite number, building name, floor, or department for the agent's business location.

attributes.name: aeo_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds AEO certification, a trusted trader status granted by customs authorities that provides expedited clearance and reduced inspections for compliant supply chain partners.

attributes.name: agent_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the agent relationship. Active agents are authorized to conduct business; inactive agents are temporarily not operating; suspended agents have had privileges revoked pending review; pending approval agents are undergoing onboarding; terminated agents have had their relationship permanently ended.

attributes.name: agent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the agent based on their primary operational role in the logistics network. Freight agents represent carriers for cargo booking; GSAs (General Sales Agents) represent airlines for sales and marketing; handling agents provide ground services at airports/ports; customs agents facilitate trade compliance; co-loaders consolidate shipments; ground handling agents provide airport ramp and terminal services.

attributes.name: bond_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the customs bond or financial guarantee held by the agent, expressed in the agent's local currency. Represents the maximum liability coverage for customs duties and taxes.

attributes.name: bond_currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the bond amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: bonding_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds a valid customs bond or financial guarantee required for handling in-bond cargo movements and customs clearance activities. Bonded status is mandatory for customs agents.

attributes.name: business_registration_number
attributes.description: The official company registration or incorporation number assigned by the government registry in the agent's country of operation, proving legal entity status.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: The primary city where the agent maintains their main operational office or headquarters.

attributes.name: commission_structure_type
attributes.description: The method by which the agent earns compensation for services rendered. Percentage commissions are based on shipment value or freight charges; flat fees are fixed per transaction; tiered structures vary by volume thresholds; hybrid combines multiple methods.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agent agreement or partnership contract is scheduled to expire or was terminated. Null for open-ended agreements.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agent agreement or partnership contract became effective, marking the beginning of the authorized business relationship.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary country of operation for the agent.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this agent record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: ctpat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is certified under the U.S. Customs and Border Protection C-TPAT program, which validates supply chain security practices and provides trade facilitation benefits.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is certified and authorized to handle dangerous goods (DG) shipments in accordance with IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR) or IMDG Code requirements.

attributes.name: fiata_member
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Federation of Freight Forwarders Associations (FIATA) Member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is a member of FIATA, the global representative body for freight forwarders and logistics providers, which provides industry standards and advocacy.

attributes.name: iata_agent_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Agent Code
attributes.description: The unique numeric code assigned by IATA to accredited cargo and passenger sales agents, typically 7 or 8 digits. Required for agents handling air waybills (AWBs) and airline bookings.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary value of liability insurance coverage maintained by the agent for cargo loss, damage, and professional indemnity, expressed in the agent's local currency.

attributes.name: insurance_currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the insurance coverage amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds ISO 9001 certification for quality management systems, demonstrating adherence to international standards for process consistency and customer satisfaction.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent operational or compliance audit conducted on the agent's facilities, processes, and documentation practices.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this agent record was most recently updated, used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full legal registered name of the agent entity as it appears on official business registration documents and contracts.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic audit of the agent's operations and compliance status, typically conducted annually or biennially.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional operational notes, special handling instructions, service limitations, or relationship management comments about the agent.

attributes.name: nvocc_licensed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds a valid NVOCC license, allowing them to issue house bills of lading (HBLs) and operate as a carrier without owning vessels.

attributes.name: operational_scope
attributes.description: The geographic reach of the agent's service capabilities. Local agents serve a single city or metro area; regional agents cover multiple cities or provinces; national agents operate across an entire country; international agents have cross-border capabilities.

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: The most recent performance evaluation rating assigned to the agent based on service quality, compliance, on-time delivery (OTD), documentation accuracy, and customer satisfaction metrics.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code for the agent's registered business address, used for mail delivery and geographic identification.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: The main email address for operational communication with the agent, used for booking confirmations, documentation, and business correspondence.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: The main telephone number for reaching the agent's operations team, including country code and area code.

attributes.name: principal_carrier_relationships
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of carrier names or IATA/SCAC codes for which this agent acts as an authorized representative or sales agent. Defines the agent's network affiliations and booking authority.

attributes.name: standard_commission_rate
attributes.description: The default commission percentage or flat fee amount applied to transactions handled by the agent, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%) or monetary value depending on commission structure type.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: The agent's tax registration number or VAT identification number issued by the relevant tax authority in their country of operation, used for invoicing and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: The commercial or trading name under which the agent operates in the market, which may differ from the legal name.

attributes.name: transport_modes_supported
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of transport modes the agent is authorized and equipped to handle (e.g., air, ocean, road, rail, multimodal). Indicates the agent's operational versatility across different freight types.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: The agent's official website address, providing access to service information, contact details, and online booking capabilities.

attributes.name: parent_agent_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on agent (parent_agent_id)

products.name: agent_appointment
products.description: Formal appointment record authorizing a freight agent or GSA to act on behalf of Transport Shipping or a carrier partner in a defined territory or for a defined service scope. Captures appointment reference, appointing party, appointed agent, territory (country/region), authorized service lines, appointment start and expiry dates, commission rate agreed, exclusivity flag, performance bond requirement, and appointment status (active, suspended, terminated). Manages the lifecycle of agent authority grants across the network.

attributes.name: agent_appointment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the agent appointment record. Primary key for the agent appointment entity.

attributes.name: appointed_agent_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the freight agent or General Sales Agent (GSA) being appointed to act on behalf of the appointing party.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the party granting the appointment authority. May reference Transport Shipping or a carrier partner on whose behalf the appointment is made.

attributes.name: primary_agent_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved the agent appointment. Null if appointment is not yet approved or approval is not tracked.

attributes.name: aeo_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) certification, demonstrating secure and compliant supply chain practices. True means certified; False means not certified.

attributes.name: appointment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the agent appointment becomes active and the agent is authorized to begin operations on behalf of the appointing party.

attributes.name: appointment_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the agent appointment expires and the agent authority terminates. Nullable for open-ended appointments subject to termination notice.

attributes.name: appointment_reference_number
attributes.description: External business reference number for the agent appointment, used in contracts and communications with the appointed agent.

attributes.name: appointment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the agent appointment. Active indicates the agent is authorized to operate; suspended indicates temporary halt of authority; terminated indicates permanent revocation; expired indicates natural end of appointment term.

attributes.name: appointment_term_months
attributes.description: Duration of the appointment term expressed in months. Used for fixed-term appointments. Null for indefinite appointments.

attributes.name: appointment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the agent appointment indicating the nature of the agency relationship. GSA (General Sales Agent) represents full sales authority; freight agent handles specific services; correspondent provides local representation; sub-agent operates under another agent.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the agent appointment was formally approved by the appointing party. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: authorized_service_lines
attributes.description: Semicolon-separated list of service lines the agent is authorized to sell or manage. May include express parcel, air freight, ocean freight, road freight, rail freight, customs brokerage, warehousing, last-mile delivery, e-commerce fulfillment.

attributes.name: authorized_transport_modes
attributes.description: Semicolon-separated list of transport modes the agent is authorized to handle. May include air, ocean, road, rail, multimodal.

attributes.name: commission_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which the commission is calculated. Gross revenue includes all charges; net revenue excludes certain pass-through costs; margin is based on profit; per-shipment is fixed fee per transaction; tiered varies by volume thresholds.

attributes.name: commission_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which commission payments are denominated.

attributes.name: commission_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage commission rate paid to the agent on revenue generated within their territory and service scope. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 5.50 for 5.5%).

attributes.name: contract_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the formal contract or agreement document governing this agent appointment. May link to document management system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the agent appointment record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field.

attributes.name: ctpat_certification_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (C-TPAT) Certification Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds C-TPAT certification, a US Customs and Border Protection program for supply chain security. True means certified; False means not certified.
attributes.references: US Customs and Border Protection C-TPAT Standards

attributes.name: customs_broker_license_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds a valid customs broker license, required for handling customs clearance and trade compliance services. True means licensed; False means not licensed.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent has exclusive rights to represent the appointing party in the defined territory. True means no other agents may be appointed in the same territory for the same services; False allows multiple agents.

attributes.name: iata_accreditation_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Accreditation Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds valid IATA accreditation, required for handling air freight and issuing Air Waybills (AWB). True means accredited; False means not accredited.

attributes.name: iata_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Agent Code
attributes.description: IATA-issued numeric code uniquely identifying the accredited cargo agent. Required for air freight operations. Null if agent is not IATA-accredited.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Minimum liability insurance coverage amount the agent must maintain, if required. Null if no insurance is required.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the insurance coverage amount is denominated.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is required to maintain liability insurance coverage as a condition of the appointment. True requires insurance; False does not.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the agent appointment record was last updated. Updated on every modification to track change history.

attributes.name: minimum_revenue_commitment
attributes.description: Minimum revenue the agent commits to generate during the appointment term. Failure to meet this may trigger penalties or termination. Null if no minimum is specified.

attributes.name: minimum_revenue_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the minimum revenue commitment is denominated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or remarks related to the agent appointment. May include operational instructions, historical context, or exceptions.

attributes.name: nvocc_license_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) License Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds a valid NVOCC license, required for ocean freight consolidation and issuing House Bills of Lading (HBL). True means licensed; False means not licensed.

attributes.name: performance_bond_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the performance bond or financial guarantee required from the agent, if applicable. Null if no bond is required.

attributes.name: performance_bond_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the performance bond amount is denominated.

attributes.name: performance_bond_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is required to post a performance bond or financial guarantee as a condition of the appointment. True requires bond; False does not.

attributes.name: renewal_option
attributes.description: Terms under which the appointment may be renewed at expiry. Automatic renews unless terminated; mutual consent requires both parties to agree; appointing party option allows appointing party to renew unilaterally; agent option allows agent to renew; no renewal means appointment ends at expiry.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the appointment was terminated or suspended. Null for active appointments.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required by either party to terminate the appointment. Null if termination is not permitted or governed by other terms.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of the reason for termination or suspension of the appointment. Populated when appointment status changes to terminated or suspended.

attributes.name: territory_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code defining the geographic territory where the agent is authorized to operate.

attributes.name: territory_region
attributes.description: Specific region, state, province, or sub-national area within the country where the agent appointment is valid. May include multiple regions separated by semicolons.

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Granularity level of the geographic territory covered by the appointment. National covers entire country; regional covers specific provinces/states; city/port/airport/station covers specific locations.

attributes.name: renewed_agent_appointment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on agent_appointment (renewed_agent_appointment_id)

products.name: correspondent_office
products.description: Master record for correspondent offices and overseas partner offices that represent Transport Shipping in geographies where it does not have a direct presence. Captures office name, parent network partner, city, country, office type (correspondent, representative, branch, franchise), IATA office code, contact details, services offered on behalf of Transport Shipping, revenue-sharing arrangement type, and operational status. Distinct from agent records — correspondent offices operate under a formal representation agreement and carry the Transport Shipping brand.

attributes.name: correspondent_office_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the correspondent office record. Primary key.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent network partner entity that owns or operates this correspondent office.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the correspondent office location, including building number and street name.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as suite, floor, or building name.

attributes.name: aeo_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the correspondent office holds Authorized Economic Operator certification, demonstrating compliance with customs and supply chain security standards.

attributes.name: agreement_renewal_date

products.name: partner

Captures partner legal name, partner category, country, regulatory registrations, operational scope, contact details, and network participation status. Acts as the umbrella partner identity record for network participants not covered by the carrier or 3PL provider masters.

attributes.name: iso_certification

products.name: partner_certification
products.description: Master record tracking all regulatory, industry, and quality certifications held by network partners (carriers, agents, 3PL providers, correspondent offices). Captures partner reference, certification type (IATA, AEO, C-TPAT, ISO 9001, GDP, TAPA, SmartWay, FIATA), issuing authority, certificate number, issue date, expiry date, renewal status, and compliance verification date. Enables partner compliance monitoring and ensures only certified partners are used for regulated trade lanes and commodity types.

attributes.name: partner_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the partner certification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the network partner (carrier, agent, 3PL provider, correspondent office) holding this certification.

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: The name of the accreditation body that accredited the issuing authority or certification body (e.g., UKAS, ANAB, DAkkS). Applicable primarily to ISO certifications where the certification body itself must be accredited.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification record is currently active and should be considered in partner compliance checks. True if active, False if logically deleted or archived.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the certification is set up for automatic renewal by the partner or issuing authority. True if auto-renewal is enabled, False otherwise.

attributes.name: certification_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the digital copy of the certification certificate or official documentation stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: The unique certificate or registration number issued by the certifying authority. This is the externally-known identifier for the certification.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification. Indicates whether the certification is valid and in good standing. Values: active (valid and current), expired (past expiry date), suspended (temporarily invalid), pending_renewal (renewal application submitted), revoked (permanently invalidated), under_review (initial application or audit in progress).

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: The type or category of certification held by the partner. Indicates the regulatory, industry, or quality standard framework. Values: IATA (International Air Transport Association), AEO (Authorized Economic Operator), C-TPAT (Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism), ISO_9001 (Quality Management System), GDP (Good Distribution Practice), TAPA (Transported Asset Protection Association), SmartWay (EPA environmental certification), FIATA (International Federation of Freight Forwarders Associations). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IATA|AEO|C-TPAT|ISO_9001|GDP|TAPA|SmartWay|FIATA — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA, WCO AEO Program, C-TPAT, ISO 9001, TAPA, EPA SmartWay, FIATA

attributes.name: compliance_level
attributes.description: The tier, level, or grade of certification achieved, if the certification framework has multiple levels (e.g., AEO has different tiers in some jurisdictions; TAPA has Class A, B, C security levels). Nullable if certification has no levels.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The username or user identifier of the person or system that created this certification record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this certification record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the certification becomes valid and enforceable. May differ from issue_date if there is a grace period. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid unless renewed. Nullable for certifications with indefinite validity. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic coverage or jurisdictional scope of the certification. May specify countries, regions, or specific facility locations where the certification is valid (e.g., EU member states for AEO, specific warehouse locations for TAPA).

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was originally issued or granted to the partner. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: The name of the regulatory body, industry association, or certification organization that issued the certification (e.g., IATA, US Customs and Border Protection, ISO certification body, national customs authority).
attributes.references: IATA, WCO, C-TPAT, ISO 9001, TAPA, EPA

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction or country where the certification was issued (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, CHN).

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent compliance audit or verification inspection conducted by the issuing authority or third-party auditor. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or user identifier of the person or system that last modified this certification record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this certification record was last updated or modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: mandatory_for_commodity_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of commodity types or HS Code (Harmonized System Code) categories for which this certification is required. Used to ensure only certified partners handle regulated goods (e.g., GDP for pharmaceuticals, IATA for dangerous goods).
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System, IMDG Code, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: mandatory_for_trade_lanes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of trade lane codes or route identifiers for which this certification is mandatory. Used to enforce compliance rules in partner selection and shipment routing (e.g., US_IMPORT requires C-TPAT, EU_EXPORT requires AEO).

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next compliance audit or surveillance visit. Used for proactive compliance monitoring. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: non_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any non-compliance findings, audit observations, corrective action requests, or conditions attached to the certification. Used for compliance tracking and partner performance management.

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: The date on which a previously suspended or revoked certification was reinstated to active status. Nullable if never reinstated. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the partner must submit renewal application or documentation to maintain certification. Typically precedes expiry_date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: renewal_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a renewal reminder notification has been sent to the partner or internal compliance team. True if notification sent, False otherwise.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Internal risk assessment rating assigned based on the certification status and compliance history. Values: low (certification valid and in good standing), medium (approaching expiry or minor compliance issues), high (expired or suspended), critical (revoked or under investigation).

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the scope of the certification, including covered activities, services, locations, or product categories. For example, ISO 9001 scope may specify freight forwarding services at specific facilities; AEO may cover customs clearance and warehousing.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system or data source from which this certification record originated (e.g., SAP TM, Oracle TMS, Descartes Customs, manual entry).

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was suspended or revoked by the issuing authority. Nullable if certification has never been suspended. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason for certification suspension or revocation, if applicable. Captures the cause of status change to suspended or revoked (e.g., failed audit, regulatory violation, voluntary withdrawal).

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which Transport Shipping last verified the validity and authenticity of this certification with the issuing authority or through official registries. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used by Transport Shipping to verify the authenticity and current status of the certification. Values: online_registry (checked official online database), issuer_confirmation (direct confirmation from issuing authority), document_review (reviewed physical or digital certificate), third_party_audit (verified by independent auditor), self_declaration (partner self-reported, pending verification).

attributes.name: renewed_partner_certification_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on partner_certification (renewed_partner_certification_id)

products.name: partner_performance
products.description: Periodic operational performance record evaluating network partner performance against contracted KPIs and service standards. Captures partner reference, measurement period, performance dimensions (OTD rate, transit time compliance, damage rate, documentation accuracy, claims rate, capacity fulfillment rate), actual vs. target values, performance tier (preferred, approved, probation, suspended), trend direction, and review outcome. Drives partner tiering decisions, contract renewals, and network optimization. Distinct from contract SLA performance — this is the network-level partner scorecard.

attributes.name: partner_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the partner performance evaluation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier agreement or partnership contract under which this performance is being evaluated.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the network partner being evaluated (carrier, agent, 3PL, NVOCC, correspondent office).

attributes.name: partner_tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.partner_tier. Business justification: Partner performance evaluations should capture which tier the partner was assigned during that evaluation period. This enables tier-based performance analysis and supports tier upgrade/downgrade decis

attributes.name: primary_partner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or team responsible for conducting this performance evaluation.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the performance evaluation record in the review workflow.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the performance evaluation was approved.

attributes.name: capacity_fulfillment_actual_pct
attributes.description: Actual percentage of requested capacity that the partner was able to fulfill during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: capacity_fulfillment_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage for capacity fulfillment as per partner agreement.

attributes.name: claims_rate_actual_pct
attributes.description: Actual percentage of shipments resulting in claims (loss, damage, delay) during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: claims_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable claims rate threshold as per partner agreement.

attributes.name: composite_score
attributes.description: Weighted composite score aggregating all performance dimensions into a single overall performance rating (0-100 scale).

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the partner must submit or complete corrective action plan if required.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective action plan is required from the partner based on performance deficiencies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this performance evaluation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: damage_rate_actual_pct
attributes.description: Actual percentage of shipments with damage incidents during the evaluation period.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, Internal Claims Management Standard

attributes.name: damage_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable damage rate threshold as per partner agreement.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, Internal Claims Management Standard

attributes.name: documentation_accuracy_actual_pct
attributes.description: Actual percentage of shipments with accurate and complete documentation (AWB, BOL, customs paperwork) during the evaluation period.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework, C-TPAT, AEO Standards

attributes.name: documentation_accuracy_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage for documentation accuracy as per partner agreement.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework, C-TPAT, AEO Standards

attributes.name: evaluation_completed_date
attributes.description: Date when the performance evaluation was completed and finalized.

attributes.name: evaluation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this partner performance evaluation is conducted.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the measurement period for this performance evaluation.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the measurement period for this performance evaluation.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope of operations covered by this performance evaluation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this performance evaluation record was last updated.

attributes.name: otd_rate_actual_pct
attributes.description: Actual on-time delivery rate achieved by the partner during the evaluation period, expressed as a percentage.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, Internal SLA Framework

attributes.name: otd_rate_target_pct
attributes.description: Target on-time delivery rate contracted with the partner, expressed as a percentage.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, Internal SLA Framework

attributes.name: review_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes and commentary from the performance review, including strengths, weaknesses, and improvement actions.

attributes.name: review_outcome
attributes.description: Business decision outcome resulting from this performance evaluation (continue partnership, renew contract, place on probation, terminate, escalate for executive review).

attributes.name: service_mode
attributes.description: Primary transport mode for which this partner performance is being evaluated.

attributes.name: total_shipments_evaluated
attributes.description: Total number of shipments handled by the partner during the evaluation period that were included in this performance assessment.

attributes.name: total_volume_teu
attributes.description: Total volume handled by the partner during the evaluation period, measured in TEU for ocean freight partners.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight handled by the partner during the evaluation period, measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: transit_time_compliance_actual_pct
attributes.description: Actual percentage of shipments meeting contracted transit time commitments during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: transit_time_compliance_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage for transit time compliance as per partner agreement.

attributes.name: trend_direction
attributes.description: Overall performance trend direction compared to the previous evaluation period.

attributes.name: prior_partner_performance_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on partner_performance (prior_partner_performance_id)

products.name: capacity_allocation
products.description: Transactional record capturing the allocation of transport capacity from a carrier or 3PL partner to Transport Shipping for a defined period, trade lane, and service type. Captures carrier or partner reference, trade lane, transport mode, service type, allocation period (weekly/monthly), allocated capacity (kg, TEU, CBM, pallet positions), utilized capacity, fill rate, capacity source (blocked space, allotment, spot), and allocation status. Enables capacity planning, utilization monitoring, and carrier capacity procurement management.

attributes.name: capacity_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the capacity allocation record. Primary key for the capacity allocation entity.

attributes.name: blocked_space_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.blocked_space_agreement. Business justification: Capacity allocations are often drawn from blocked space agreement commitments. This link enables tracking of BSA utilization and ensures allocations are tied to contractual capacity commitments. Nulla

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or third-party logistics (3PL) provider from whom capacity is allocated.

attributes.name: carrier_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier_service. Business justification: Capacity allocations should reference the specific carrier service on which capacity is allocated, not just the carrier. This enables service-level capacity tracking and planning. Removes service_type

attributes.name: contract_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master carrier agreement or partnership contract under which this capacity allocation is governed.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner entity (agent, correspondent office, NVOCC) providing the capacity allocation.

attributes.name: primary_capacity_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that created the capacity allocation record.

attributes.name: trade_lane_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade lane (origin-destination corridor) for which capacity is allocated.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Facilitation Agreement

attributes.name: allocated_capacity_pallet_positions
attributes.description: Total pallet position capacity allocated by the carrier or partner for the specified period and trade lane. Applicable to road and rail freight.
attributes.references: ISO 6780 Flat Pallets for Intercontinental Materials Handling

attributes.name: allocated_capacity_teu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allocated Capacity in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU)
attributes.description: Total container capacity allocated by the carrier for the specified period and trade lane, measured in TEU. Applicable to ocean freight (FCL shipments).

attributes.name: allocated_capacity_volume_cbm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allocated Capacity Volume in Cubic Meters (CBM)
attributes.description: Total volume capacity allocated by the carrier or partner for the specified period and trade lane, measured in cubic meters. Applicable to all transport modes.

attributes.name: allocated_capacity_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight capacity allocated by the carrier or partner for the specified period and trade lane, measured in kilograms. Applicable primarily to air and road freight.

attributes.name: allocation_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for any financial terms associated with the capacity allocation (e.g., minimum commitment charges, overage fees).

attributes.name: allocation_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the capacity allocation expires or is no longer available for booking. Nullable for open-ended allocations.

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or operational instructions related to the capacity allocation.

attributes.name: allocation_period_type
attributes.description: Frequency or granularity of the capacity allocation period: daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual allocation cycle.

attributes.name: allocation_reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the capacity allocation, typically provided by the carrier or partner for tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: allocation_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the capacity allocation becomes effective and available for booking.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capacity allocation: active (available for booking), reserved (held but not yet utilized), utilized (fully consumed), expired (past end date), cancelled (terminated early), or suspended (temporarily unavailable).

attributes.name: booking_cutoff_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours before departure or shipment date by which bookings must be made to utilize this capacity allocation.

attributes.name: capacity_fill_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of allocated capacity that has been utilized during the period, calculated as (utilized / allocated) * 100. Key performance indicator for capacity procurement efficiency.

attributes.name: capacity_source_type
attributes.description: Type of capacity procurement arrangement: blocked space agreement (BSA), allotment, spot market purchase, long-term contract, or ad-hoc allocation.

attributes.name: commodity_restriction
attributes.description: Restrictions on commodity types that can be shipped using this capacity allocation (e.g., general cargo only, no hazardous materials, perishables only). Nullable if no restrictions apply.
attributes.references: IMDG Code / ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capacity allocation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: destination_location_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA or UN/LOCODE representing the destination point of the capacity allocation (airport, seaport, or inland terminal).

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of equipment or container associated with the capacity allocation (e.g., 20ft dry container, 40ft reefer, ULD type for air freight). Nullable if not equipment-specific. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 20ft_dry|40ft_dry|40ft_hc|20ft_reefer|40ft_reefer|flat_rack|open_top|tank|AKE|LD3|LD7|PMC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 668 Series 1 Freight Containers / IATA ULD Regulations

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capacity allocation record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: minimum_commitment_amount
attributes.description: Minimum financial commitment or guaranteed payment amount for the capacity allocation, regardless of utilization. Nullable if no minimum commitment exists.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: origin_location_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA or UN/LOCODE representing the origin point of the capacity allocation (airport, seaport, or inland terminal).

attributes.name: overage_rate_per_unit
attributes.description: Additional charge per unit (kg, TEU, CBM, pallet) if utilization exceeds the allocated capacity. Nullable if overage is not permitted or not charged.

attributes.name: priority_level

products.name: carrier_service_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual service agreement between a supplier (shipper) and a carrier partner. It captures lane-specific rates, service commitments, volume agreements, and performance tiers that exist only in the context of this specific supplier-carrier relationship. Each record links one supplier to one carrier with commercial terms, service levels, and operational parameters negotiated for specific trade lanes or service types.. Existence Justification: In logistics operations, suppliers (shippers) contract with multiple carrier partners to cover different trade lanes, service types, and geographic regions, while carriers serve multiple supplier clients. Each supplier-carrier relationship is governed by specific service agreements that define lane-specific rates, service commitments, volume targets, and performance SLAs. This is the operational 'Carrier Service Agreement' or 'Lane Rate Agreement' business concept that procurement and network teams actively manage.

products.name: carrier_offset_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation contract between a carrier and a carbon offset program. It captures the commercial and operational terms under which a specific carrier procures, allocates, and retires carbon offset credits from a specific program. Each record links one carrier to one carbon offset program with attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship, including committed volumes, allocation percentages, pricing tiers, and contract lifecycle dates.. Existence Justification: In the logistics industry, carbon offset program participation operates as a true many-to-many relationship. Multiple carriers participate in the same industry-wide or regional carbon offset programs (e.g., CORSIA-eligible programs for aviation carriers, shared renewable energy projects), and each carrier diversifies its offset portfolio across multiple programs to manage risk, cost, and compliance requirements across different project types, vintages, and geographies. The business actively manages these participation relationships with carrier-specific terms including committed volumes, allocation percentages, pricing tiers, and contract dates.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `transport_shipping_ecm`.`_metrics`.`billing_dispute`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Billing dispute metrics tracking dispute volumes, resolution effectiveness, financial exposure, and service quality impact."
  source: "`transport_shipping_ecm`.`billing`.`billing_dispute`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "dispute_status"
      expr: dispute_status
      comment: "Current status of the dispute (open, investigating, resolved, closed)"
    - name: "dispute_type"
      expr: dispute_type
      comment: "Type of billing dispute (overcharge, service failure, weight discrepancy, etc.)"
    - name: "dispute_category"
      expr: dispute_category
      comment: "High-level category of the dispute for root cause analysis"
    - name: "priority_level"
      expr: priority_level
      comment: "Priority classification of the dispute"
    - name: "escalation_level"
      expr: escalation_level
      comment: "Current escalation level of the dispute"
    - name: "resolution_type"
      expr: resolution_type
      comment: "How the dispute was resolved (credit note, rebill, rejected, etc.)"
    - name: "root_cause_code"
      expr: root_cause_code
      comment: "Root cause classification for systemic issue identification"
    - name: "service_failure_type"
      expr: service_failure_type
      comment: "Type of service failure that triggered the dispute"
    - name: "raised_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', raised_date)
      comment: "Month when dispute was raised for trend analysis"
    - name: "sla_breach_flag"
      expr: sla_breach_flag
      comment: "Whether the dispute resolution breached SLA targets"
  measures:
    - name: "total_disputed_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(disputed_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total financial value of disputed charges representing revenue at risk"
    - name: "total_resolution_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(resolution_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total amount credited/adjusted in dispute resolutions"
    - name: "dispute_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of billing disputes raised"
    - name: "avg_disputed_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(disputed_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average dispute value indicating typical dispute severity"
    - name: "distinct_customers_disputing"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT customer_account_id)
      comment: "Number of unique customers raising disputes indicating breadth of billing issues"
$$
metric_views.description: Billing dispute metrics tracking dispute volumes, resolution effectiveness, financial exposure, and service quality impact.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `transport_shipping_ecm`.`_metrics`.`billing_carrier_payable`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Carrier payable metrics tracking transportation cost management, payment timeliness, and carrier financial relationships."
  source: "`transport_shipping_ecm`.`billing`.`carrier_payable`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "payment_status"
      expr: payment_status

    - name: "payment_method"
      expr: payment_method
